reviews.author: danielpineda2026
reviews.title: Awful service across the hotel
reviews.text: The hotel and its facilities are very good, but the attitude and service of its staff are terrible. They do not treat guests well, they carry out all their tasks lazily, and it is clear that none of the employees are happy with their jobs. I do not recommend to pay the cost of the hotel for the service you are going to get

reviews.author: 155carolinagirl
reviews.title: Uncleanliness
reviews.text: Room had roaches and dead lizard-like creatures, and maintenance gave me a nearly empty can of spray for me use in the room. I was a guest not an employee!! Housekeeping would remove the towels and face cloths daily but would only replace the towels.

reviews.author: xshambo
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Resort itself is nice.  Rooms however weren’t great, beach is overcrowded and full of broken chairs, food was surprisingly bad, especially the buffet.

reviews.author: V15XJninab
reviews.title: A money pit fiasco!
reviews.text: From poor spoken English at the front desk, to a poor smelling, sewer gas, area where our room was located, to money gauging use of discount coupons, and having to make reservations (which we could not get for 2 consecutive nights) @ an all inclusive resort, to finishing up with us almost missing our transport to the airport because they gave blatant wrong place directions for our pick-up.

reviews.author: Ash C
reviews.title: Reported Missing Money, No Resolution Provided
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort from April 15–19 2026 and unfortunately had a concerning experience. On April 17, $100 was taken from our in-room safe. We immediately reported it to the front desk, and a team was sent to investigate. However, we were later told that, according to their records, the safe had remained locked and therefore no theft had occurred.

What was frustrating is that our claim was essentially dismissed, leaving us without any resolution. After this incident, I looked through other guest reviews and noticed several similar reports about missing money from safes, which raised additional concerns.

I recommend that future guests be extra cautious with valuables and not rely solely on the in-room safe. Based on our experience, issues like this may not be acknowledged or resolved.

This is a picture of "Angel" processing our report which got us no where :(

reviews.author: jn585421
reviews.title: Not a 5 star hotel - do not recommend
reviews.text: The hotel had several issues that were not addressed properly. No hot water for 4 out of the 5 day stay. We called about this issue several times and the front desk/technician were not able to fix and did not provide any kinda of resolution. Mold in the toothbrushes the hotel provided. Really bad service at the hotel with several example (no one to give utensils, no one to take our order in dine in restaurants, no one to provide drinks, all the tables being dirty, dirty plates and cracked glasses, etc.). Food was subpar including the dine in restaurants. This is not a 5 star hotel

reviews.author: Capergirl63
reviews.title: Go Elsewhere
reviews.text: Beautiful beach  plenty of loungers servers on the beach were available yet service very slow. Hotel very clean and maintained. Now the bad. Food horrible. Undercooked. Hot food never hot just warm. Could only book à la cartes 2 days ahead. Why?  Easier to book all at once. Going back several times was annoying. Only 1 buffet. They change the name with meals so you think there’s more but it’s the same buffet. Service in restaurants and 3/4 À la cartes was horrendous. Asked for a napkin and cutlery at one à la carte!!!!! The service at the buffet was even worse. English is not widely spoken and my advice is to keep Google Translate nearby. The front desk need a lesson on customer service and hospitality. Not even a thank you or how was your stay. The same front desk people are the same people who put elderly and mobility challenged customers on the third floors. There are no elevators. Entertainment is minimal. No activity coordinators present. The resort is small. Maybe half filled at best. Do not recommend. Go elsewhere. Lots to choose from

reviews.author: Nina S
reviews.title: Awful oceanfront room and terrible service
reviews.text: Went with my husband & 1 child for spring break. We are Circle Melia members. While the hotel is very pretty from the outside and right on the beach, which is gorgeous, unfortunately our room and concierge service was awful. The room (Junior Suite oceanfront) was very old and in desperate need of refurbishing. Room was clean but super old and parts were really gross and absolutely need replacing (see pics). I did report that to management. Apparently, they told us that most of the rooms in the hotel have been refurbished but not our building! The concierge was the worst I've experienced with Melia. The job is make sure we have all our reservations for dinner and to ask us what we need and to make our stay as enjoyable as possible. It was the complete opposite of that. I had to go into the Circle office to confirm the remainder of our dinner reservations and a birthday cake for my husband as our concierge did nothing as far as I can tell. We were not informed of the Circle activities (that are included in our cost) until 2 days into the trip and only after I asked.  We only got to do one activity, and the concierge did not tell us where to go at the sister hotel where it was so we had to ask upon arrival and we were late. I had to go back and forth on What's App texting needlessly (Melia's preferred system of communication for the concierge) to get confirmations done for dinners when I'm supposed to be relaxing by the pool. The room didn't have the bed we asked for (king) and it didn't have the welcome package in the room. Nothing special for our child. Nothing special at all for the price! We got the economy service and a terrible room for a first class price. We will likely not be returning to this hotel.

reviews.author: Meghan S
reviews.title: Disappointed is an understatement
reviews.text:
We are here now for my husband’s 50th birthday trip and the experience so far has been pretty awful, I honestly wish we could just switch hotels. Firstly, the building they put us in had no elevators and my mom is handicap. They gave us rooms on the 3rd floor. We ended up needing to upgrade to swim up suites for an extra $1200 just to get floor level rooms. We were also charged a $30 early check in fee, which made no sense to me, and the guy at the desk made us pay in cash saying the credit card machine was down and then I’m pretty sure I saw him just pocket the cash. Lastly, it’s impossible to make a dinner reservation for our first night here, and nearly impossible to make reservations for the rest of our nights here. We had to settle for 8:30pm reservations at whatever restaurants were available the remaining nights (not necessarily the restaurants we actually want to eat at). 

If the experience doesn’t change soon, I will never come to a melia resort again and I definitely won’t recommend to anyone. It’s such a shame because the resort itself is very beautiful, and some of the staff we have met (Emmanuel specifically) have been very helpful to us.

reviews.author: elianasaranibar
reviews.title: No era lo que esperaba
reviews.text:
Este hotel pertenece a la misma cadena que el anterior donde me hospedé, pero dentro del mismo complejo. Primero estuve en el otro hotel y luego me trasladé a este, que supuestamente ofrecía una categoría superior, específicamente en el sector solo para adultos.
La expectativa era tener un mejor nivel de servicio, incluyendo beneficios como playa exclusiva y atención más personalizada, pero lamentablemente esto no se cumplió. El servicio de playa exclusivo nunca estuvo disponible.
Además, este tipo de categoría incluye servicio de concierge, cuya función es acompañar al huésped para hacer su estadía más placentera (reservas, recomendaciones, seguimiento, etc.). En mi caso, la experiencia fue muy mala. El concierge asignado tuvo una atención prácticamente nula: no hubo seguimiento, ni interés, ni propuestas. Solo se limitó a realizar reservas de restaurantes. Incluso, noté una gran diferencia con otros concierges que sí estaban muy atentos a sus huéspedes. El último día, envió un mensaje de despedida al cual respondí y nunca obtuve respuesta.
En cuanto al hotel, se trata de una estructura antigua, parcialmente remodelada, pero aún se percibe como un edificio viejo. La habitación tenía un fuerte olor a humedad, lo cual resulta bastante incómodo.
Como punto positivo, destaco la gastronomía, que fue excelente en todos los restaurantes. En especial, el restaurante italiano, que realmente se destaca.
Por este motivo, mi calificación es intermedia: la comida eleva la experiencia, pero el servicio y las condiciones del hotel están lejos de lo esperado para esta categoría.

reviews.author: briandabarraza
reviews.title: Mala atención del personal e instalaciones internas de habitación con mala calidad de servicio
reviews.text: Mala atención del personal, groseros y ni te hacen caso, instalaciones internas de habitación con mala calidad de servicio no servía control de TV, ni teléfonos ni frigobar

reviews.author: Christian P
reviews.title: Schönes Hotel wird aber seinem Anspruch nicht gerecht
reviews.text:
Sehr schöne Anlage mit vielen schönen Pools und traumhaftem Strand.

Leider ist das Personal schlecht geschult und wird dem Anspruch des Hotels nicht gerecht. 
Die Zimmer sind in unterschiedlichen Zustand, manche top renoviert andere etwas in die Tage gekommen aber dennoch großzügig und bequem.

Umweltaspekte werden komplett vernachlässigt. Handtücher werden jeden Tag getauscht, ob man es wünscht oder nicht. Die Klimaanlage läuft den ganzen Tag auch wenn keiner da ist. Warm Wasser wird mit Strom gemacht, es gibt nicht ein einziges Solarpanel.
Viele Einwegbecher.

Das Buffet hat eine gute Auswahl aber leider liegen viele Speisen zu lange und sind nicht mehr frisch. Weniger wäre mehr! 
Löffel, Tassen Suppenschüsseln sind Mangelware. 

Die allabendliche, laute Life Musik kann störend wirken.

Alles Klagen auf hohem Niveau angesichts des Preises von $700 pro Nacht.

reviews.author: Karen W
reviews.title: A Big Disaster
reviews.text:
We are back a few MONTHS from Dominican Republic. I gave the travel agent and Apple Vacations time to respond to me before I wrote this review, in order for them to make it right. They still have not made it right in ANY meaningful way. I understand mistakes happen and problems arise, but companies need to be held accountable for their mistakes. I paid for a trip I did not receive. I still had a decent trip, because  I personally made the best of every day. Here is how the events unfolded. 

We arrive in DR and were smoothly collected by our hotel transfer. It wasn't Apple it was Amstar, and they had our names. We were informed Amstar is Apple in DR. They deliver us to the hotel and we approach the front desk. I show them my confirmation email documents. They cannot find my reservation. They then suggest that my email is incorrect/fraudulent. We are told to just have a seat in the lobby while they look further into this matter. We have just arrived to another country. I, personally have not slept in 36 hours, and I am traveling with two 6 year old boys who have not eaten lunch, and just need to eat. We are waiting and we are hungry. We are told we could change in the lobby bathroom, but we can't use the pool or eat yet. We have 6 year olds with us. (We noticed the next day that there were hospitality suites off of the lobby for people to use to shower/change. We were not offered one of those for changing. Instead we are popping our suitcases in the lobby bathroom and getting walked in on, while we are in the midst of sorting through our stuff, and trying to get the right clothes for each of us.) We were treated like unwanted guests/intruders. 

After over an hour they give us wrist bands and allow us to get some food at the only place that was still open and serving. We grab a quick a bite while they continue to try to find us a suitable room. Their claim was that Apple Vacations failed to send them the reservation/booking and so it was actually never booked. This did not make sense to me, since when we arrived, our transfers were waiting for us, and took us to the hotel. I had "IN-ROOM" hair and makeup, pre-booked and tied to my confirmation number prior to arrival. I had emails with the spa onsite leading up to this trip. So it is just not adding up. 

We get in the room and the kids are going to be sleeping on a pull out couch at the foot of our bed. Not ideal, but I am glad we have a room that we can see the ocean from, which was what we booked. However, there wasn't any bedding for the kids to use, for sleeping, on the pull out sofa. 

Let's be direct here, the room was not made for more than 2 people, who see each other naked. There was a floor to ceiling sheer drape that separated the bathroom from the bedroom, no door. 

We get to unpacking and the phone doesn't work in the room. The front desk is a minimum 5 minute walk away. We needed to request bedding, hangers, and extra robes for the kids since there is a sheer for separation for the shower. We had to walk to the front desk to make our requests. (The phones were never repaired the entire stay, so all requests had to be walked to the lobby.) 

We were never properly checked in and no one attempted to help us make any dinner reservations, or talk to us about the hotel at all. (Other than the kid club they did push the kid club and our kids did love it.)

We head to the buffet and the food is not great. So we hope to get to make reservations in the morning for the restaurants. When we get back to the room, two flat sheets have been delivered to the room and just left folded on the arm of the couch. So we took the two flat sheets and figured out how to rig it to cover the mattress that was miserably thin. The next day we go, to set up reservations at the restaurants. We are out of luck for dinner that night and we are only able to get dinner reservations Saturday and Sunday nights. We have now eaten at the buffet for dinner and breakfast and no one is enjoying the food available on the buffet. 

After getting the two dinner reservations we go to look into scuba. The whole reason we picked this hotel was because it had a kids club and onsite scuba diving for certified divers. Our plan was to drop the kids at the club and then hop on dives. Well, there is no onsite scuba. There is no included scuba. The website says there is. The website is wrong. We would have to take a full day to do a dive and we would have to go off site. Well, that won't work. The kids club doesn't open till 10 am. We can't leave early morning. So our dive trip turned into, just a trip. It was logistically impossible to do a dive and we were just incredibly disappointed.

We get a note from the manager later in the evening on Friday, as we are about to head down to dinner at the buffet, again. It is a written note and he wants to speak with me. So Zach and I go down to the lobby with the kids, where, Eduardo the manager is telling us he wants to make our stay better. Passes to a pool? And what else can he possibly help with? So we tell him we were unable to secure dinner reservations and that we were heading to the buffet. He takes us, personally, to the Mexican restaurant...where we are promptly given terrible service. Our food trickles out one dish at a time. Our melted cheese dip was brought out cold/resolidified and they brought it out without bringing out chips, so we really didn't even have anything to eat it with. The point is that if he was trying to make our stay better, you would have thought we would have been given superb service to turn it around. We were not. We were just really perturbed by the whole thing.

Other than getting us into the Mexican restaurant, Eduardo also offered us use of the pools with slides at another section of the property that we would normally have to pay extra for. While we appreciated the offer, that pool didn't open till 10 am and with our schedule we would only be able to go for 2 hours on Saturday. We have a photographer picking us up at 3:40 pm on Saturday and my hair was being done at 1 pm in the room, on Saturday and I explained that to Eduardo. 

Saturday morning at breakfast, before heading to the pools with the slides, my phone is splashed when a waiter is refilling the water. I don't think anything of it, because it is in a case, until later, when I try to charge my phone and it says that there is moisture in the port and I have to use a wireless charger until the port dries. Well we used a hair dryer for 30 minutes straight. We did everything possible to try to dry it out, to no avail. I ask Eduardo if he could procure a wireless charger for me or uncooked rice.  My concern is my phone dying and I don't have a way to charge it. I will need to turn it off and then I lose my camera and any form of communication. I type in Spanish and in English what I need. I send him pictures of what I am looking for. I get no where. I mean this would have been an easy thing for them to bring me and that would have made me think they were trying. I was told I could take a taxi and go buy one. Another manager Laura says, late on Saturday night, that on Sunday she will bring me her personal one from home, to use. She does not. I never see her again. 

Hair and makeup goes smoothly but I don't get to use my credits ($250 worth that I was supposed to have received with my reservation through Apple, which no one knew about)

I'm in the lobby and my photographer reaches out and tells me that the hotel won't let the driver on property. It takes them 20 minutes to let the driver on. Eduardo was instead trying to convince my photographer that he should be coming to the resort to take pictures instead of sending a van for us. I mean it was ridiculous. They made us late to our sunset photo shoot, that was prebooked through our travel agent prior to us even entering the country. 

Sunday we go to Scape Park and that was a very enjoyable excursion. When we get back we start packing and getting ready to go to dinner. The hotel is weirdly trying to deliver hangers and a rollaway bed to our room at 5:30 pm, the Sunday night, before we are checking out. We sent them away. We were literally packing our suitcases. There was no need for additional hangers on the last night.

Now I ask you, if this had happened to your family, where your trip went completely sideways through no fault of your own, but rather mishandled by the companies you booked with, what would your expectations be?

This was our 19th wedding anniversary trip. This was our celebration/gift. We booked it using a travel agent, so that we would be assured that we got exactly what we wanted out of this trip, we planned it almost a year in advance, and it just didn't work out due to failures by Apple and the resort itself.  Next year for our 20th, we are inviting more families to travel with us, to celebrate that milestone, during this same time of year. 

At this point, I would write booking, through Apple Vacations, off completely because this was a disaster that wasn't rectified or explained. The resort blamed Apple. Apple blamed the resort. When we got home the resort was still advertising scuba fot certified divers under "included". 

What has Apple done? Apple has not responded to me. 

If this had happened to your family, what would your expectations be?

reviews.author: twinklerolly
reviews.title: Don't plan to go back
reviews.text: We went with a group of 15 total with adults and kids and we asked ahead of time to get reservations for the restaurants and they kept putting us off and didn't accommodate us.  Our kids at the buffet for all the meals the limited time we were there and the adults were also sick of the buffet.  We have stayed at Paradisus before for family trip and had a good experience so were surprised by the lack of helpfulness or trying to accommodate our party.  When some of the other couples and families left they tried to get dinner reservation for just 4 which is like a normal family and they couldn't.

reviews.author: toddbuchner
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: Not feeling welcomed felt more as inconvenience especially at the buffet. Pool service was slow the bartenders did do a nice job.

reviews.author: jbrit22026
reviews.title: Five Star Property. One Star Experience.
reviews.text: Gorgeous Property. Disappointing Service. Forgettable Food. A Luxury Experience That Falls Short. Expectations were not met.

reviews.author: FL97stang
reviews.title: Sub-par
reviews.text: 90% of the staff does not speak English which makes it very frustrating when trying to request a beverage, food and or directions around the resort. The food was sub-par and was nothing special. From the first night we did not have hot water in the shower. We requested time and time again for maintenance to please fix it. By the third day we had lukewarm water to take a shower and thats the best we received for the 6 days of our stay.

reviews.author: davidkim2026
reviews.title: Location and rooms were good but food and service not good.
reviews.text: Rooms were very nice and resort is on a nice beach. But the food was absolutely terrible and both the buffet and restaurants. They run out of beach towels by 1pm and then you are out of luck the whole day. WiFi went out and is spotty. First vacation where we lost weight.

reviews.author: Frank P
reviews.title: Not the best option for young families........
reviews.text:
We've stayed at Paradisus resorts in the past and thought the Palma Real ("PR") was a no-brainer family vacation package choice based on our previous experiences and recent favorable reviews. We should have been more careful with our research and selection process. 
While there's no question that PR is an expansive and lovely resort with likely the best beachfront in the Bavaro area, if you aren't booking Reserve (Adults Only) or a member of the Melia Circle Club, you're probably better off considering some of the many other, more family-oriented resort options available throughout Punta Cana. 
There are an abundance of swimming pools at PR but sorry..........most of them are adult only. Hundreds of beach loungers at PR but virtually zero for guests that aren't Reserve or Circle Club. Even their Grand Cana guests had a large section of the beach reserved (a less expensive Paradisus resort option). When trying to clarify with various staff, where we could sit or swim, received inconsistent direction.  
Without the benefit of a Reserve concierge, the a la carte restaurant reservation process is outdated and not intuitive. Almost as outdated as the early morning dash for snatching up the loungers surrounding the main pool. Okay, we get it. You want to get them to yourself. I do too. But don't take more than you need and then leave them unused for hours.
Food across the board was pretty good. We especially enjoyed Kanna and the Mexican a la carte. Want a special bottle of wine though?........Sure, that'll be $65USD for a $12USD bottle. It's not that we didn't purchase them anyway (we bought 2), everything just started wearing on us. So much so, that we were in regular contact with the Hotel Manager, who graciously tried everything to make us happy, including reserved beach cabanas and restaurant reservations that we couldn't make directly ourselves. It may not sound like it but we're actually pretty patient and not the complaining type but were kind of relieved to be leaving at the end of our one-week stay. Not the impression you want to leave.
Oh! The check-out was icing on the cake, when we learned that somebody had charged a $200USD bottle of wine to one of our 3 rooms and couldn't convince the front desk staff that it wasn't us. Thankfully, after approx 30 minutes a senior staff member finally appeared to resolve the matter. Word of caution, check any room charge carefully when approving the invoice at the time of purchase.
Had we been more careful at the outset, we likely would have chosen either a Dreams, Finest or Hyatt resort. All of which provide similar or above average amenities and service, but with the added option of upgrading as a family and not just as adults. In fact, we stayed at the Dreams Macao Beach as a Preferred Club guest in Dec 2024 and regularly commented how we had wished to have booked there instead.

reviews.author: Terry P
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere !
reviews.text:
Firstly, Laura Correa,the associate Director from Spain, what a breath of professionalism in this hotel and a credit to Melia who hopefully will recognise this.
We are presently in an ocean front suite in the Reserve adults only.
The dedicated restaurant Sante for the Reserve, the buffets have limited choice, the al carte is generally served tepid and its a miracle if the staff ever get your order right on the first attempt, an affliction which is carried through in most of the restaurants. 
A little off putting the chef was serving the food without wearing any hygienic disposable gloves. 
Generally, the quality of the food is very average or poor to the point we had to use the main hotels buffet restaurant, the Lunchbox, which is more varied but self service and doesn't offer the calm of the Reserve, more of a holiday camp feeding frenzy !
Check regularly the room charges, where extra bottles of wine appear you never ordered !
I hasten to add we are extremely well travelled and sadly this hotel does not deliver on the quality. 
Despite informing the hotel of my wife's nut allergy, she still was given nuts so beware !!

reviews.author: sylviane c
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
The food was very poor quality and we stayed in the Reserve adults only section
The pool was not heated and very cold 
There was nothing to do but lay around

reviews.author: katherinelopezgu2025
reviews.title: Falta de atención del personal
reviews.text: No se asignó el tipo de habitación reservada a través de su página de internet sin tener respuesta del personal o una forma de solucionarlo para tener una estancia cómoda y de acuerdo a lo reservado

reviews.author: Rolando Cristop... G
reviews.title: All inclusive.  SCAM
reviews.text: La opción de all inclusive no es real, te quieren cobrar básicamente por todo.  Ejemplo. Las camas que ponen en la playa debes reservarlas , comprar y pagar una botella de vino (súper cara) para poder usarlas , y así con varias otras cosas dentro del resort.  No me parece Justo y encuentro que esto es una estafa, porque no te lo dicen cuando compras el paquete todo incluido . Por otro lado, comida y instalaciones no son malas, la atención es muy mediocre ,de todas formas, no vuelvo más.

reviews.author: ckjones66
reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text:
The Bellmen were the BEST at the resort. They were on top of things. 

Our stay was chaotic. Lots of construction. 

We travel extensively and this was our worst experience at an all inclusive. The food was cold unless it was during a reservation. The customer service was subpar. We asked our concierge for reservations and to schedule a shuttle. My husband asked for golf tee times twice and they didn’t follow up. They committed but never followed through. 

We were in the presidential suite and the first morning we had no running water. Since I had a spa appointment that morning, I asked our concierge if the spa had showers, they replied, “I think so”. Didn’t offer to check nor did they follow up to tell us the water issue was resolved. 

Had to continually follow up about reservations for dinner, which we only received 1 we wanted. 

The ATM wouldn’t work so the bellman graciously took us to another on property and that one didn’t work, we tried a 3rd and finally it worked. 30 minutes of searching. 

We never got the customer service that was promised for the “Reserve” area which is why we paid the extra money. 

We will not return to this resort.

reviews.author: Dadolena07
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Andres, the concierge, was super unprofessional. Didn’t reply to our requests. He did what he wanted and not what we asked for

reviews.author: Hams201
reviews.title: Bonitas habitaciones. Muy mal servicio/alimentos
reviews.text:
Las habitaciones están genial, super amplias y modernas (al menos las máster suite).
El complejo en general necesita reforma, se ha quedado algo antiguo, pero esta bien.
Lo peor es la calidad de las comidas y cenas que no son aceptables. 
El servicio es lentísimo y no es por falta de personal si no por falta de ganas de trabajar (tienes que pedir todo muchas veces para que hagan caso, e incluso a veces ni siquiera lo hacen. Esto hablando de cosas tan básicas como pedir agua o pan)
La calidad de los alimentos en comidas y cenas es malisima, solo se salva el desayuno. A modo ejemplo el italiano es simplemente pasta y pizza (ambas de baja calidad), el de carnes es solo carnes duras y pasadas. Es totalmente inaceptable.

reviews.author: Nowornever911
reviews.title: Pretty hotel…awful service
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful hotel and a nice location, but the service is awful, the food is mediocre, and it’s just not someplace you’ll want to go back to.

reviews.author: Gianluca L
reviews.title: Peccato per la gestione
reviews.text:
Perfetto il personale finale.
Terribile la gestione che chiaramente viene da i piani alti.
Il personale è molto attento.
Purtroppo non sono loro a gestire le cose.
Peccato

reviews.author: Patty K
reviews.title: Hotel was great... concierge extremely difficult
reviews.text: This review is not exactly of the hotel. However our concierge made this trip extremely difficult.  It would have been better if we didn't even have one.  At this property if you have a concierge most of the requests have to come from them. Which is good if your concierge makes them, in our case she was overall indifferent and annoyed when we even asked about dinner reservations.  Which we filled out on the pre-arrival form as well as the day we arrived.  She was slow to respond, one of our rooms didn't have air conditioning which my sister and brother in law fixed themselves via chatgpt after waiting in the room for 3 hours.  Our safe needed batteries, no one showed up for that either, we were in the room waiting for 2 hours.  We were in the Reserve which included the spa water ritual, that took about 20 WhatsApp messages and hours of my time going back and forth with her. The absolute best part of our trip was the crew at Kanna beach club, Enrique, Yasmalin and Derny.  If we had had a different concierge this hotel would've received a 5/5.

reviews.author: Abraham K
reviews.title: Como dice antes . Falta de honestidad
reviews.text:
Falta de honestidad : Del salón de Conferencias me llevaron mis auriculares Buds Pro y aunque le mostré por el GPS donde estaba , no hicieron nada por solucionarlo.

En el año 2024 a algunos oftalmólogos compañeros de congreso , les llevaron  parte de sus pertenecías en habitaciones del hotel , sin que el hotel tampoco hiciera nada por solucionarlo

reviews.author: TnerbLl
reviews.title: SUPER SHORT version of Disappointing "Reserve" Experience at Melia Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
**NOTE- Our re review is 10500 characters didn't fit**  My wife and I stayed at "The Reserve" (adults-only, all-inclusive premium section) for her 50th birthday. While Concierge Cristian was phenomenal, the experience was extremely disappointing for the premium price.

Poor Communication: Nobody explained "The Reserve" exclusive dining areas or services until our last day. Restaurant locations kept changing without notice—we only discovered a special ordering system on our final day after missing it all week. Staff confusion was constant about where we should eat.

Dining Disasters: At Tokimeku, we ordered vegan/vegetarian meals but were repeatedly served meat. Wrong dishes arrived multiple times. Room service took 80 minutes, arrived with wrong items (chicken in "grilled veggie" quesadilla), and cold, dried-out pasta. Our last night was a complete disaster.
Safety Concerns: Our room had a stuck, unusable deadbolt and a light fixture hanging by wires—serious fire hazard. We found a cockroach on our pillow one evening. Unacceptable for any resort, especially at premium prices.

Construction & Closures: Main pool closed with only 6 days notice before arrival. Construction noise continued all day into evening hours, making relaxation impossible. Many "Reserve" facilities were closed for "off season."

Price Gouging: No general store at our resort—had to visit Grand Cana where a single stamp cost $183 pesos (normally $60) and Tums cost $25 USD. Outrageous.

Adults-Only Violation: A loud foam party in our "Reserve" area lasted two hours with multiple children present (some in swim diapers) despite security staff watching. Left the pool area covered in foam, alcohol cans, and food debris.

Aggressive Sales: Pressured three times to join "the Circle" membership program, including during lunch at Kanna. Staff wouldn't accept "no thank you."

Housekeeping was friendly & excellent with thorough daily cleaning. Waitstaff genuinely tried their best despite challenges. The Dominican restaurant server went above and beyond for our dietary needs. Beach safety staff made us feel secure. Open pools were nice when available.

Cannot recommend Melia Paradisus Palma Real or "The Reserve" until serious improvements are made. Safety issues, poor communication, broken promises about adults-only areas, and constant disruptions made this vacation stressful rather than relaxing.

reviews.author: ingrambalde
reviews.title: El precio no compensa
reviews.text: Muy caro para lo poco que ofrece. Personal mayormente desatento, poco entretenimiento, ofrecían servicios a la habitación que no estaban disponibles

reviews.author: alaiaoptimyz
reviews.title: Very disappointing for price per night
reviews.text: Will not come back as other 5 star hotel are cheaper with better rooms, serive . 24hr bar and better entertainment. No gift shop and atm was broken entire stay. Inconvenience of having to leave hotel everyday for locations food and necessities

reviews.author: BoardingPass305186
reviews.title: Poor staff helpfulness
reviews.text: The staff was not very helpful in its majority. However, all members of the Kicks club were extremely friendly and willing to assist with anything.

reviews.author: Claudia W
reviews.title: Wedding was not what we thought it would be.
reviews.text: Room was great, facility was clean, very few staff spoke much English, some spoke none. Food was not a 5 Star quality. My daughter-in-law made reservations for the restaraunt months in advance, and the reservations were "lost", not accomodated, it was very disappointing. She double and triple checked with staff, and was told all was in order. Room service was horrible. I asked for 6 bottles of Perrier water Tuesday morning, and NEVER received it. I left the resort on Saturday. We ordered meals at 11:00pm, and did not get them until 1:30am.

reviews.author: Matthew C
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, food and service were sub-par
reviews.text: The resort and pool were very nice.  The food was below expectation and the service was inconsistent, most of our group became ill and never left the resort.  Some of the staff was exceptional and some was poor.  The beer and liquor were low quality and the waitstaff was non-existent at the pool after lunch.  The beach was nice except for the constant harassment by both hotel employees and random people trying to sell trinkets and services.  The activities both during the day and night were the highlight.

reviews.author: moshnroll33
reviews.title: Nice people, poor service
reviews.text:
The service was very poor, the food was average at best to poor. Room service is an absolute mess they would either take forever or not answer (suppose to be 24hrs)

There are people trying to sell you stuff non stop, some of which are employees of the resort feigning friendly conversation to upsell you excursions while you’re trying to eat breakfast.

I booked two rooms I was told would be adjoining they were next to each other but not adjoining. There is a bit of a language barrier, some employees spoke English fairly well and some seemed to not understand a single thing I said and would need to ask another employee. They’re all nice but this makes even simple things like ordering coffee a pain at times.

There are other things but I think I made my point. Would not recommend and def not coming back.

reviews.author: mariano_gaydou
reviews.title: Caro pero NO EL MEJOR
reviews.text: El hotel es bueno. El servicio en barras es malo. Llaman all inclusive a un servicio de bufete con baches de.mas.2 horas sin disponibilidad de comida. Pero solo hay chatarra. Si no comes frituras o tomas alcohol. No tenes disponible una fruta o.un yogurt de 15 a 18. Solo ofrecen comida chatarra en la merienda. La gente de las barras salvo excepciones son un desastre no te miran hablan entre dientes, se molestan por hacer un trago. La verdad una estafa eso sentí en estas vacaciones. Nada que ver con Gran Palladium. Incluso Los Pinos en Termas de Río Hondo Argentina ofrece mejor categoría de comidas y tragos

reviews.author: tatiananavalos
reviews.title: Vacaciones familiares
reviews.text:
Nuestra estadía en el Paradisus Palma Real no fue la mejor. Es nuestra quinta vez en la línea Paradisus porque fuimos 4 (cuatro) veces al Paradisus Cancún (y si fuimos tantas veces allá por algo será). Ya desde que llegamos no nos acompañaron a la habitación, tuvimos que caminar un trayecto largo debajo de la lluvia sin siquiera conocer el lugar ya que era nuestra primera vez. La gastronomía en general no es buena, el buffet no tiene variedad, el almuerzo que suelen servir cerca de la piscina a modo de snack está siempre al rayo del sol lo cual no es lo adecuado por una cuestión bromatológica, de hecho hubo gente que se intoxicó por eso. El servicio en general es con desgano, con mala pre disposición, se nota las pocas ganas de trabajar. Vimos a muchos empleados del hotel prácticamente no hacer nada, paseando por ahí. Otra cosa es que los empleados son atrevidos y maleducados, por ejemplo en la playa insisten mucho los vendedores en meterle a uno un paquete de actividades, tanto que si te moves de lugar ellos también lo hacen (al borde del acoso) y no te dejan tranquilo. Y en general los vendedores de la playa son muy molestos e insistentes, no sé si abarcan este sector del hotel o varios hoteles pero deberían restringir la cantidad porque uno no puede disfrutar de la playa tranquilo sin que cada 10 minutos te quieran vender algo. De hecho muchas veces nos tuvimos que retirar de la playa hacia otro espacio porque se volvía insoportable, impidiendo así disfrutar de un día completo allí. Otro caso es que me pidieron reseña uno de los empleados del bar 36 degrees y estaba al lado mío mirando que completaba y tocó mi celular para poner 5 estrellas en las diferentes categorías, imponiendo una valoración con la que yo no estaba de acuerdo.

Debo reconocer que las instalaciones son muy lindas, espaciosas y que los shows por la noche son lindos.

También tienen un espacio para los miembros Circle donde prácticamente no va nadie, calculo que no debe ser una membresía muy solicitada por lo tanto siempre estaba el lugar vacío y los empleados estaban mirándose las caras. Creo que a nivel cadena de hotel, esa membresía no parece ser rentable ni estratégica como para poner un espacio solo dedicado a eso. Se podría aprovechar para que el resto de los huéspedes puedan disfrutarlo de otra manera

El servicio en general no es bueno la verdad, a veces uno tiene que pedir las cosas o resolverlas por su cuenta porque muchas veces los empleados demuestran incompetencia. Si tuviera que volver a Dominicana no volvería al Paradisus

reviews.author: Gianluca L
reviews.title: Quanti soldi
reviews.text: Sono cliente da 10 anni e ormai le soluzioni che vengono offerte sono sempre meno e il prezzo è sempre più elevato…

reviews.author: alekiwi
reviews.title: Ha bajado el nivel bastante
reviews.text: Los servicios, calidad de la comida y la atencion se han deteriorado bastante despues de COVID, cada ano ha bajado mas, desgraciadamente se siente que todavia esta esa mentalidad en el hotel, una pena, el ano pasado me quede en Grand Cana y la experiencia fue mucho mejor en todo sentido

reviews.author: stacey42025
reviews.title: Mediocre at best
reviews.text: It was clean and pretty and that’s where the positives end for me. The food was sub par, very American-ized and lacked any hint of Dominican culture. The prices were insane, 34$ USD for a bottle of sun block. I constantly felt hustled to buy things. There was a vendor night and they all but sprung on you to buy something as you walked by. The drinks were watered down and due to the above I would not return. Get an air bnb and explore the island, it’s absolutely beautiful and the locals are so friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: TishB81
reviews.title: Disappointed......
reviews.text:
I would say that the ONLY positive experience we had was a gentleman by the name of Martin who worked at the reserve section pool and private beach.  He made us feel heard and looked after us every single day.  This was the highlight of our trip.  This man deserves to be management as his customer service and attention to detail was amazing not to mention he never stopped, he was always working and always with a kind gesture or smile on his face.

All else was terrible including the concierge in the reserve section that did absolutely nothing to help us with anything that pertained to our trip.  

Even after we advised him that my mother in law was allergic to the feather pillows he still did NOTHING to help us.  I don't normally write reviews but considering we paid ALOT for this trip we were very disappointed.

This was my husbands first time in DR and he really doesn't want to go back and its too bad because I have been to many other resorts in the DR far less expensive that had much better service.

reviews.author: JP25balt
reviews.title: below avg
reviews.text:
food was below average-poor
advertised water activities not present
casino - offsite, tiny and cheesy

reviews.author: Autry1978
reviews.title: Beware of Upgrading to the Reserve with Concierge Service
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and our first (and last) stay at a Melia Resort.
First off, the property and beach were beautiful, however that beauty was overshadowed by issue after issue. 
Good experiences...Gustavo in Sante is wonderful. Wanda at the Fahrenheit pool bar is fabulous! The 80-minute couples massage that we paid for was excellent. Out therapists Alba and Maria gave us great deep tissue massages. 
Issues that occurred during our stay:
•	We had no concierge on Day 1 and part of Day 2. We were told upon check-in that Adriel would be our concierge, and that our luggage would be delivered within the hour.  I had to call the front desk after 2 hours to have them find our luggage. This caused us to miss dinner on Day 1 . The room service food was terrible. How do you mess up a cheeseburger? Melia can do it! Adriel finally contacted us at 9:30pm via WhatsApp on Day 1. We found out he had left at 5:00pm, so there was no way we would have gotten our luggage without me calling and complaining. 
•	On Day 1, The shower was not draining.  I messaged Adrial and also called the front desk. This issue was fixed on Day 4. The water flowed out of the shower into our room and into the water closet.  We had to make a dam out of towels when we used the shower.
•	Called the front desk and messaged Adrial about air conditioning on Day 1 not cooling enough. This issue was fixed late on Day 2.
•	Our Minibar was not stocked upon arrival.
•	Had to visit the Reserve lounge on Day 2 to ask for an on-site concierge, because our concierge, Adrial, was not going to be onsite again on Day 2. We got Alam, our 2nd concierge, that gave us a tour that we should have received on Day 1. He said he would make our dinner reservations. My wife had to send Alam a WhatsApp message to remind him about dinner reservations EVERYDAY or else we would have not gotten dinner reservations. We requested dinner reservations be between 6pm-8pm. Only 1 dinner was scheduled between 6pm-8pm. The rest was after 8pm. 
•	We received one message about activities the entire stay from our concierges. This was on Day 1 and we did not receive any more. We were supposed to receive a message every morning about the day's activities.
•	On Day 5, Alum told us he was off for the rest of our stay. We were then assigned to Gustavo our 3rd concierge. I didn't think things could have been worse well Gustavo proved that they could.
•	On Day 5 We were told by Gustavo to wait in our room because the manager was coming by to talk to us. We waited over 2 hours and had to get to our 8:30pm dinner reservation. The manager never showed up.
•	On Day 5 the room was not serviced. Green ('Make up room') light was on since breakfast. Had to complain to Gustavo after coming back from our 8:30pm (turned into 9pm) dinner. The room was finally serviced late. The Minibar was not serviced.
•	On Day 6 the concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez, met with me and my wife on our room's patio. I told them everything. They both agreed that we did not receive the Reserve service that we had paid for and they agreed to talk to upper management about refunding us the Reserve rate minus the regular resort room rate (wo/ concierge service). We thought everything was going to be settled after that, but NO!
•	Day 7: We were checking out and I had not heard from Alvaro. I messaged him on WhatsApp (see attachment). Since we booked through Costco Travel they are basically not honoring the agreement from Day 6. Melia owns the resort, not Costco!
After we returned, we contacted Costco Travel. They reached out to the resort and the resort is now saying that they are not honoring anything talked about with concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez on Day 6.
My suggestion…if you go to this resort do not upgrade to the concierge or reserve service. I wish we had had concierges like the other guests had. If you get Adriel, Alam, or (God forbid) Gustavo, you need to request someone else.

reviews.author: Curiosity41029358430
reviews.title: Resort 4 étoiles.  Nourriture et restaurations 3 étoiles...
reviews.text:
C'est la première fois en 20 ans que la qualité des restaurants et de la nourriture a tellement baissé. de 50%
Sûrement dû aux spéciaux 46% 49%... pas la même clientèle. c'était notre deuxième maison... Pour un couple agé. 280US$ pour nourriture est ridicule. Les restos sont bruyants.

reviews.author: Bouchra Boudjeloud
reviews.title: Déçue
reviews.text: Bel hôtel en général mais les chambres ne sont pas bien nettoyés, vous devez vraiment faire des suivis avec vos femmes de chambres ! les poubelles n’ont pas été vidés et les serviettes n’ont pas été changés pour la deuxième journée consécutive. elle a juste fait le lit…  notre sèche cheveux ne fonctionne pas c’est la 3 eme fois que je vais à la réception pour demander un sèche cheveux mais rien ne se passe … ils ont un site en ligne ou on peut demander des choses qui manquent mais personne ne le regarde … pour un hôtel 5 étoiles je m’attendais à mieux ! Il y a du bruit aussi tard la nuit et c’est mal insonorisé, le bar à la plage est seulement pour les adult only. Nous qui avons un bébé on doit aller jusqu’à la piscine pour avoir un drink… l’hôtel est petit et trop segmenté entre le adult only et le cercle membre il ne reste pas beaucoup de choix pour les familles, j’espère sincèrement que l’hôtel lira mon commentaire er prendra des actions

reviews.author: Elizabeth R
reviews.title: Bar staff and setting everything else is a racquet
reviews.text: The setting is beautiful but that's where it ends.  We are here for a wedding and the treatment we're receiving is incredibly poor. The concierge is a joke.  Tipped him as soon as we met have not heard from him once.  Since this is an all inclusive they're trying to make you as cheap as possible, they force you to eat at the truly disgusting buffet by saying there are no dinner reservations. Ever.  To get one dinner reservation at a restaurant I needed to l the BRIDE to schedule it,  unacceptable.  Blue Agave food was good,  drinks were not.  Room service is fine.  Gilberto at the pool bar is a delight. The rooms are tired, we have several more days here and if we game prepaid I would be looking for different accommodations for after the wedding.  We will not return.

reviews.author: helperofkids
reviews.title: Not worth the money and in need of customer service training.
reviews.text: Very Disappointed with the customer services specifically the lack of it. For example, greeted four staff persons on the walk to breakfast and while in the restaurant yet I was not greeted in return and frankly was ignored. Was seated for dinner and was ignored by multiple staff walking right passed us for FIFTEEN MINUTES until we got up to complain. Food quality is not satisfactory; a few main staple food items are regenerated in different forms throughout the restaurants. Towels were not available on a regular basis for use at beach and/or pool. Our shower backed up water and we were advised the issue would be addressed and there was no need to relocate rooms; to note, the back became worse each day until we departed. The mini bar frig barely kept drinks/food at warm/cool temperature. The hotel/restaurants were unable to accomodate food allergies and sensitivies (ie. dairy/lactose free). Staff appeared to cater to those who "partied." Excursion staff did not provide thorough explanation of whale watching trip; (from pick up to drop off; the trip lasted 11 hours and 40 minutes; 40 minutes was spent whale watching). Very few staff appeared as if they wanted to work there or enjoy their job and it showed!!!

reviews.author: echappe
reviews.title: Will probably not return
reviews.text:
excellent location, great beach, pool facilities however poor quality food, service and very noisy resort
however excellent Kidsdome activities, services.

reviews.author: 1957steve_11
reviews.title: Terrible food and concierge awful
reviews.text: Rooms very spacious and clean beach and pool stunning but that's where it . Luiz and Victor at the pool bar give great customer service they are like family but our concierge Gilberto I will sort everything turned out to be aggressive and totally useless! We only saw him two times in twelve days and when I did see him I asked him if he had a problem with me?  As he acted so aggressive and rude he stated it was hot that's all but ended talking to us when he shot off to lunch which was more important to him than us! Gilberto should not be doing this position as he seems just not interested in forming good customer relations we had better service from other concierge who were doing there job. We have been three times before but I don't think we will be returning. As for the food it's awful we had stomach cramps and felt really unwell. Such a shame!

reviews.author: crimafi
reviews.title: Llegada hoy no esperaba esto
reviews.text: Acabo de llegar al resort y la atención no es la q esperaba en la sección  The Reserve.  Habia reservado una habitación con dos camas y nos dieron una king. Estamos esperando en el lobby para solicitar el cambio y no nos atienden.  Estamos como 20 min y nos hacen perder el tiempo.  Espero q mejore nuestra estadía los sgtes dias. Con mucha expectativa esperé este viaje

reviews.author: Kristen M
reviews.title: Look elsewhere
reviews.text:
Not the luxury arrival you would expect no towel no drink and then to make matters work we were  not given or told about resort just given incorrect information about the restaurant situation.
We were told restaurants were open or available to us when they were not open.we complained to the concierge regarding the amount of time and inconvenience we had making reservations.  The concierge told us that he would look into it and get back to us.  We never received further communication from him.
If you have a food allergy stay away I have a lactose allergy.  This was on the reservations card and was told to the staff when we arrived at the restaurant.  When questioned about the food, staff did not know what foods had lactose and at Flora I was given butter in her main dish.  I do want to point out that at Mascalzone the staff did pay attention to my food allergy.

At 11:00 am we were lying out by the adult pool.  However, our peaceful morning was interrupted by staff doing yard maintenance including using a very loud chainsaw.
Children were always in the adult area and pool. This is not enforced at all. Screaming babies and children jumping in the pool.

Every morning when we would go out to lay by the pool at 10:00 am we could not find beach towels.  We always had to wait for them.
We would ask Staff how and where to make reservations, get towels, or how to make our airport transfer. We were provided with different answers or staff didn’t know. This was frustrating because we did not know what was going on.
Staff did not explain what they were doing with our luggage during the checkout process. ie where to go, cutting wrist band, room charges.

I asked when they can cut off the wrist band she stated upon departure no one ever cut anything off of us. Another stupid thing but they all start to add up.

WiFi password was not given to us nor was there information in the room. I called and was given the information to use a certain network that didn’t work and so they said “ooo you have an apple phone, you need to to use this other network and the password was like 1000 characters and numbers. Again no information shared and when it was shared it was complicated for no reason.
On the night we arrived (2/15/25) we discovered a stain on the duvet cover. Waited for over an hour for it to be replaced by housekeeping. They did not replace the duvet cover, just put a sheet on the comforter. The woman was very kind but I figured it be replaced the following day - it never was. The curtains had stains on them. The walls in the toilet area were dirty. The shower is very nice but confusing and multiple guests I heard had to call to have it explained. It took us a bit to figure it out. Again easily fixed by a guide book of some sort. Further the mini bar has lack luster snacks. The light fixtures were very very dusty. The light switches are soo confusing again easily fixed by a room/resort guide. The app is terrible and provides no real help. The funniest thing was the room service photos. They will give you a good laugh. Pros The coffee maker is however nice. They provide nice toiletries! Nice bathroom towels - honestly they were amazing. Huge big bath towels! The floors were clean.

Food & drinks
The hot food offered at the buffet was cold and the cold food was lukewarm. Eating lukewarm ceviche was not appetizing. When we arrived at the Lunch Box we were not shown where to sit. Therefore, we would have to wander around to find a seat. Once we did finally find a seat, we were not given water or drinks. We would come back from getting our food, only to have nothing to drink. This was frustrating. I would have to flag down multiple servers to no avail. when we sat down for breakfast without any beverages we were told that they could not serve us coffee because they ran out of cups. On another day we sat down for lunch we were not given any silverware, because they ran out. An all-inclusive resort that size should have ample culinary sets especially because it was not at capacity when we were there. At the buffet for breakfast, my lactose allergy was ignored . At the omelet station she would tell the staff that she needed a clean bowel for her eggs because the prior one had cheese in it. The staff would ignore this request - despite knowing of my food allergy. Often rolling their eyes.

Noteworthy details
We were told by multiple Paradisus staff that it was easy to get reservations. We did not experience this. We had to get up early in the morning to make reservations. We were told if we were not in line by 8:00 am we were likely not to get reservations and we had to go to the concierge multiple times to make reservations. On 2/16/25 we got up early to make dinner reservations because we did not want to be forced to eat at the Lunch Box (Buffet) again after our terrible experience on the first night. We were told by the staff that we needed to be in line by 8:00 am. This completely defeats the purpose of our vacation at Paradisus. We wanted to relax and not worry about being somewhere at some time. When we were in the concierge line to make dinner reservations, we were unable to make them for the following night on 2/17/25 because the system was down. The concierge told us to be back at 12:00 pm to make the following night’s dinner reservations. Once again, this completely defeats the purpose of our stay and vacation with Paradisus because we were not able to relax and unplug because we had to be back in line by 12:00 for dinner reservations. We arrived at the concierge to make dinner reservations for 2/17/25 at 12:00; however, the system was still down. The line was very long. We had to stay in this line for over 45 minutes while on our vacation just to be able to make dinner reservations.

reviews.author: Christopher N
reviews.title: You don't get what you pay for.
reviews.text: I stayed in a swim-up Jr. suite from 1/28 through 2/3 with my wife. The room given to us had two queens however we reserved a king. They did not make any effort to move or accommodate us in any way. We spoke to three other couples with the same issue so they must overbook regularly. The room fridge was broken as well as the hairdryer. The staff replaced both but it took 2-3 days and the replacement refrigerator was just placed on the floor next to the pool access sliding door with the same items inside. We also found that the TV didn't work as well. (Obviously not a big deal but comical given everything else that was occurring.) Due to our late arrival the first night we had to eat at the main buffet which was a disappointment. Most everything had been sitting out too long under the heat lamps which made most items un-eatable. Two of our reservation dinners, Hibachi and Mexican were pretty bad, a combination of overcooked chicken and shrimp and a waiter who was more interested in getting a tip from a 12 person table. The Italian and Dominican (Flora) restaurants were good. Sadly, we experienced the majority of staff as being indifferent at best to us being there. Seriously, it was so different than Mexico or Aruba. It's as if they just didn't care. This is my first and last trip to this property or any other that's managed by their parent company, Melia. I've been to 12-15 all inclusive properties in the past and this one is by far the worse experience I've had. I take no joy in writing this as I spent a few $K on a mediocore trip at best.

reviews.author: Dylan O
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, Horrible Management/Service
reviews.text:
Beautiful property, horrible management & service.

Problems started at check-in: We were a group of five people and I have two rooms under my reservation: 1 room for two people and 1 room for three. I requested that the room for two guests be one single bed a couple days before arrival as I was told this was an option when I booked only and that the other room have a cot brought in or the pull-out couch made into a bed. At check-in, they confirmed that they were able to secure a room with one bed for the two guests and that they had a rollaway bed brought into the other to accommodate the room with three guests.

The rooms were not ready until about 4PM, which was fine, but once we got into the rooms we saw that both rooms had two small beds and the rollaway bed was put into the wrong room. The three guests who were rooming together only had access to the room with two beds through their badges, so I called concierge to request that they move the bed over to the correct room and mentioned that we were told one room would have one large bed. The response I got: “Is that a problem?” I decided to drop is and the concierge agent I spoke to said they would sent someone to move over the rollaways bed. Hours passed, they never came. We moved the bed ourselves and as we were dragging it over to the other room, a worker walked by and said/did nothing. 

Then we had a 9:30 PM dinner reservation at the Japanese restaurant on the property: Our server was COMPLETELY DRUNK. Spilling water on the table, delayed to bring our requested drinks, some came some never did, and got all our orders wrong for appetizers and desserts. Any time he came to take an order, he could barely stand as he wrote them down. He would forget repeatedly what was ordered and come back to take our order over and over again as he swayed from side to side. The cook knew he was drunk and kept looking at us shaking his head over the situation. This was quite a shock for our first night on vacation but decided not to say anything because we knew it could cause the man his job.

The next day, we go to book a tour at the excursions desk and as we’re doing so, they asked how we planned on getting back to the airport. I had called the hotel a few days before to arrange round-trip transfers for us and paid $95. The agents at the excursion desk seemed confused and asked for the name of the company that brought us to the hotel. Come to find out, the hotel doesn’t even partner with this taxi company according to the agents at the excursions desk. Whoever I spoke with before arriving to ask about transfers probably gave this company my information because they were a friend so they could make a quick buck instead of using the official taxi provider of the hotel. While the taxi ride was fine, I thought this was completely unacceptable behavior for a 5-Star Hotel. The agents at the excursion desk said they’d bring it up with the hotel and we left it at that. The taxi service was fine and while I was annoyed that a hotel worker would act this way, I brushed it off since there was nothing that could be done: I had to pay for the round trip transfers in advance directly with the taxi service.

We got back to our room at the end of the day and we phoned concierge to request fresh towels be brought to us so we could use them on an excursion we were going on the next day. They never came. We woke up the next morning, left for our excursion with towels we went to go grab ourselves and come back to find our room was never cleaned. We requested the room to be cleaned and for fresh towels to be brought to the room a second time. We left for the beach for a couple hours, come back and still nothing. I called concierge a second time to request fresh towels at the least. They never came.

That night, we stopped by the concierge desk in-person to file a complaint about the towels/cleaning service/drunk server/taxi situation because at this point we were quite annoyed. No compensation was offered but he promised to have the rooms cleaned and fresh towels brought to the room. This is now our THIRD time requesting fresh towels over the course of two days.

We go to dinner, come back to the room 2 1/2 hours later and find that the room is not clean and no towels have been brought to the room. I walk over to the concierge counter to speak to them in-person. I let them know that I really don’t care if they clean the room at this point but that I’d like the towels I asked for three times already. He doesn’t apologize about the room not being cleaned/towels not being brought, but calls to request that the towels are delivered to my room.

To no surprise, they never arrived. 

We have two nights left on the property but after going to concierge about the above issues and still not receiving any sort of compensation, apology or resolution, I figured I’d at least share my thoughts in a review for potential future guests to keep in mind. 

The only reason I’m giving two stars instead of one is because of the positive experiences we had with other staff members at the hotel, including bartenders and our amazing waiter at Flora. There are some great people working at this hotel, but there are others that have absolutely soured our experience. 

This is our second time here and I see a dramatic difference in the service we received compared to our last visit. After spending over $5000 dollars for a four-night stay at a 5-Star hotel, you would expect much better too. 

We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Daliachi
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This was our 10th time staying at Meliá reserve quality went down a lot and service was lacking. Don’t get reserve save your $$

reviews.author: joaquimmentor76
reviews.title: De longe o pior hotel da rede em termos de serviço
reviews.text: Sou fã da rede Melia, membro do Circle. Portanto, acostumado com o padrão de excelência em hospitalidade. Punta Cana tem sido meu destino de férias de janeiro nos últimos 10 anos, sempre na rede Melia. Pela primeira vez vi funcionários relapsos, preguiçosos, mal humorados, despreparados. Se nota um gravíssimo problema de gestão. Muitos garçons, o time de conservação e limpeza, excelentes. Mas, serviço de atenção ao hóspede, recepcionistas dos restaurantes, concierge, serviço de praia, cozinha, atendimento Circle todos muito abaixo do esperado. Teria que melhorar muito para dizer que foi ruim. É uma decepção, pois sou fã da marca, reconheço o padrão de excelência, mas Palma Real está completamente abandonado em termos de serviço.

reviews.author: josephskyeung
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Room layout, decors and cleanliness were excellent. Staff services very friendly and helpful. Foods quality were not up to standard of a five stars hotel.

reviews.author: B D
reviews.title: Gone downhill
reviews.text:
Have been coming here for many years with 7 other guys for a week of golf. This place has gone seriously downhill and we will be looking for another location next year
Arrived on Monday and found my room had no working bar fridge and no AC. Reported it to the concierge and as of Thursday still no change and no one follows up too let you know what’s going on.
Fees for the golf course have gone up way higher than warranted for a course of its caliber ( mediocre) and the golf carts are well beyond their life cycle. One of our carts died on the 3rd hole today.
For what this place costs these days you’d be better to look elsewhere!

reviews.author: Connector32212000426
reviews.title: Abysmal service beautiful location
reviews.text:
The goods (few):

1. the grounds are beautiful and the rooms are massive and clearly recently renovated.

2. The food, albeit not on par with any 5 star hotel in the Caribbean is not bad, just need to learn the ropes and understand what’s good and what’s bad. A lot of reviews seemed to slam the food, however we did not find it half bad, there’s not much choice but that is to be expected in a large resort.

The bads (a lot):

1.  The disorganization is palpable, no one knows what to say or what to do, when asked for anything the average wait time is 1.5hr from asking for more water in the room to a crib that was already requested at time of check in.

2. The check in process was ridiculous we arrived at 12, finished the check in at 1235 they told us our rooms would not be available until 3PM we were escorted to lunch. Upon our return at 320PM we were told our rooms were still not ready. We received our rooms at 6PM

3. the service is beyond abysmal, for the price paid  the expectations were high and every single one has been disattented. Very few people seem to have a very little understanding of English, while I understand the fact that we are in a Spanish speaking country, the resort markets itself as international, it is not acceptable that the receptionists do not speak a lick of English. On top of that everyone, other than the room and dining staff, seems to be absolutely annoyed about being there.

4. The concierge is useful for the archaic system of reservation to the restaurants other than the buffet. Unless you like a vacation with the stress of lining up at 8am to book at a subpar restaurant the service may be useful, you get no priority with this service as a group of 7 all of our dinners were either at 6pm or 10pm. The restaurants are always half empty. that’s about the extent of the usefulness of the concierge service, our concierge Rosemary was very nice and responsive that was a big plus for us. 

5. The aurea of exclusivity of the Circle members is a laughable part of this resort chain. The resort sections off big chunks of the space for circle members which is a vacation club that makes zero sense unless you love the disservices offered by Melia. The push to sell you this service, albeit subtle, feels like you’re having a vacation at a passive aggressive used car lot.

6. The general rudeness and aloofness of the staff (apart from the cleaning ladies who always went above and beyond) made this vacation not relaxing at all. Perhaps this goes back to how disconnected everything seems to be. You cannot charge the room for spa services, photos, or the resort store since they are provided by third parties. A purported 5 star resort that requires you to have a CC on you at all times is beyond absurd.

7. When expressing concerns to the front desk, for example our bracelets stopped working for the room we basically got a shrug as a response

For the price you pay for this vacation do yourself a favor and book somewhere else unless you want something pretty to look at. This is not a 5-star resort like they want you to believe.

reviews.author: Amylfg
reviews.title: Beautiful property that’s poorly managed
reviews.text: Spent a week with family. The property is beautiful, immaculate with has tremendous potential. That is about it. The food is horrendous. Other than the egg station at the breakfast buffet, the rest of the food is practically inedible. Same goes for the buffet for lunch and dinner. That are also really very few breakfast & lunch options for in general & there is no wait service by the pool or beach chairs to order food or drinks to your chair (there are bars to get a drink tho) The restaurants are nearly impossible to get reservations for. Even when we did eat at the restaurants, the food is really sub-par and the service is extremely slow. The best food shockingly is thru room service. It is also extremely poorly managed property with staff that is very poorly trained (with the exception of housekeeping and the bartenders). If you ask anyone at the front desk a question, you get one answer and then a conflicting answer and no one ever stands by their word. It is extremely frustrating when you there for a relaxing, carefree vacation but you cannot relax because of poor management and service.  The best thing about the resort is the lobby bar (great bartenders), the pool bartenders and Antonio who works at concierge who really tried hard to assist us with the many issues that we had during our stay. Again, even tho the property is really beautiful, because of the extremely poor quality of food, lack of food choices & wait service to the beach & pool chairs, and horrible customer service by management (with the exception of Antonio at conceirge) we will not be returning to this property again.

reviews.author: Frances K
reviews.title: Don’t bother with this place.
reviews.text: Poorly managed hotel. Asked for rollaway bed upon arrival, promised to receive one , never showed up in our room. Front desk tried to trick us into paying additional $4000.00 USD to “ upgrade”. Didn’t work, so they gave up pushing the idea and gave us our rooms near the beach anyway for no additional fees. Hotel wanted to charge extra for EVERYTHING ! Even using water park for kids at Melia next door, knowing it’s included in our stay. Rude staff at water park! Constantly waiting for fork and knife set while seated with our food at buffet restaurant .  Seems like restaurants were training new staff.  Slow or inconsistent service. Wasn’t overly busy.  Plates being grabbed from under our mouths while eating above the plate. Staff don’t smile.  Booking restaurants is a joke.  Lots of people unhappy.  Many complaints while at the beach & pool.  The vibe was disappointing. Poor management. This place needs a management makeover!

reviews.author: Casal Positivo
reviews.title: Procuraremos outras opções.
reviews.text:
Ponto positivo: comida muito saborosa (principalmente da parte do buffet, do restaurante principal).
Arquitetura bonita.
No bar Sport, local de melhor atendimento, sendo o bartender Robert atencioso e acertou nos drinks. 

Pontos negativos: piscinas geladas, mau humor de quase todos os funcionários. Caso vocês façam reserva dos restaurantes muito tarde (21:30), a cozinha encerra cedo e praticamente eles querem te mandar embora.
E o principal: vergonhoso e humilhante distinção que fazem para os hóspedes que são do The Reserve ou sócios (circle) para os hóspedes regulares. Verdadeira segregação. Atendimento dos funcionários nas áreas comuns, olham sua pulseira antes para ver se vão fazer algo rápido ou não.  Várias piscinas, restaurantes, agilidade no atendimento, no meio do hotel, éramos proibidos de utilizar. Uma muita mera Heineken que seja, não nos entregavam, apenas no restaurante principal (ficando refém da cerveja local “Presidente”). 
Festa de ano novo: festa acabou 02h da manhã, mandando quem ainda estava presente embora. 
Sem fogos (hotéis ao lado todos com fogos).

Mar da frente é bonito, porém, caminhando 100m ao norte: muito mais belo.

Não caia na cilada de ouvir propostas das “cotas”: nos tiraram 1:30h logo do 1º dia que pisamos, e acharam ruim por não queríamos comprar, sendo que nem havíamos pisado no hotel direito.

Enfim, uma rede que MUITO PROVAVELMENTE, não retornaremos (principalmente pelo vexatório apartheid com os hóspedes.

reviews.author: SK0114
reviews.title: 5- star facility with 2-star service and food!
reviews.text: I honestly don't understand how this resort got such good reviews. The hotel itself looks nice, just like any other 5-star all-inclusive resorts but everything else was mediocre at its best.  The quality of food was inconsistent, drinks were watered down, and the shows were amateurish. The only saving grace was the staff members at the beach who were always attentive and caring but for $900 per night, I expected more. Also don’t bother the book the Reserve. Whatever service they offer, you can get it by asking the front desk. Not worth the money. Also the app never worked!!

reviews.author: Francois V
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real - A Disappointing Experience for a 5-Star All-Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real - A Disappointing Experience for a 5-Star All-Inclusive Resort

Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was far from the luxurious experience we were expecting from a 5-star all-inclusive resort. While the location was absolutely stunning, the overall experience was a letdown in several key areas.

Food: The quality of the food at most of the restaurants was mediocre at best. We had high hopes for the dining experience, but it never quite met expectations. However, the buffet was the one positive aspect—there, the food was good and varied, offering a nice alternative to the a la carte options.

Restaurant Booking System: The booking system for the resort's restaurants was frustratingly outdated and inefficient. Despite being the first in line each morning, and the staff arriving late, we were never able to secure a reservation earlier than 9:00 or 9:30 PM, even though we saw many tables available much earlier in the day. This was incredibly inconvenient and disappointing.

Staff: While we encountered a few friendly staff members, such as Jean at the Kanna Restaurant, many others were dismissive and unprofessional. Several staff members would ask if we spoke Spanish, and while we made an effort to communicate in Spanish, the response was often eye-rolling or even rude comments in Spanish. This behavior was unexpected and certainly not what we'd expect from a resort of this caliber.

Room Service: Room service was inconsistent and underwhelming. At times, the orders were delivered incorrectly or were simply not up to the standard we'd hoped for.

Overall, Paradisus Palma Real didn't live up to its 5-star reputation. The combination of lackluster food (aside from the buffet), inefficient systems, and unfriendly service made our stay less than enjoyable. I would not recommend this resort if you're seeking a top-tier all-inclusive experience.

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: Overpriced and awful Service
reviews.text:
- Booked a family vacation only to find out upon arrival that we are in 2 separate buildings. Had to argue with staff to get this fixed. 
- Food was below average, at best. 
- Reservation system for dinners in archaic and only leads to unhappy guests who have to wake up at 8 am to get a dinner reservation. Makes no sense with technology available these days. 
- Gym was full of equipment that had logos  from Planet Fitness. 3 of the 4 spin bikes were broken. 
- Biggest disappointment is the service. Overall it was awful!  Have to ask for simple things multiple times and often time they do not come. Most guests we spoke to at hotel had same thing to say. 
- Our experience with concierge desk was awful. They are useless and unable to accomplish the simplistic tasks. 
- Cocotal golf was awful. Golf course was severely water logged and had no irrigation Service abhorrent and WAY overpriced. Golf clubs we rented were chipped and missing grips on putters. 
- Language barrier between staff and English speaking guests needs to be addressed. 
- Beach is nice but no activities for guests (water activities, sports equipment).

reviews.author: mlagtoubi
reviews.title: Améliorations à envisager
reviews.text: L’hôtel est beau bien placé, mais les services ne sont pas toujours satisfaisants, le service the réserve n’est pas qualitatif, les prestations sont très basiques, ce que l’on peut retrouver dans chaque hôtel , j’espère qu’il y’aura des améliorations

reviews.author: RicardoSantanaMata
reviews.title: El hotel ha bajado de categoría. La experiencia Circle ya no es lo mismo, se ha cualquierizado.
reviews.text: El hotel tiene deficiencia en varios aspectos.  Es deficiente en aspectos como bares, por no contar con disponibilidad de bebidas incluidas, y que si están en otros bares y la actitud del encargado de bar no es la mejor. Es decir, si usted pidió una bebida en un bar, solo podrá volverla a tomar en ese único bar. Los restaurantes se quedan sin disponibilidad. Aun teniendo un paquete de socio y experiencia Circle la es experiencia fue regular, como cualquier otro huésped. No estuvo a la altura. El concepto de promover x cantidad de restaurantes y bares no tiene sentido si el restaurante no está disponible y el bar no tiene la bebida que usted pide, o la que le brindan es la de más baja calidad, como si se tratara de un hotel de 1 estrella. Resulta molesto.

reviews.author: cjac117
reviews.title: Okay at best. Look at other resorts
