reviews.text: Not the best guest experience. Customer service from check-in to departure was subpar. Food quality was okay at best and the only real value is alcohol. Had multiple issues with our room in particular (A/C and safe) and so did other guests in our party.

reviews.author: worldexperttraveler
reviews.title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY!
reviews.text: I pay almost $3,000 it was worth maybe $1000. Restaurants were good, servers were attentive and remember my birthday and made me feel special!! BUT DO NOT ORDER ROOM SERVICE! Front desk EXTREMELY RUDE. The manager was nice though but only can do so much when his workers don't have customer service expertise

reviews.author: albertoare39
reviews.title: Buen hotel mal atendido
reviews.text: Tienes que estar todo el día discutiendo y preocupándote de todo. Pésima comunicación entre los trabajadores de este. Venden una membresía que es totalmente falsa ( soy socio). Nada recomendable este hotel

reviews.author: MARTHA IRENE E
reviews.title: Cuidado con la camarista Melani del Bloque 6, piso 3 Hab 15
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia inicio muy bien me recibió un ángel de nombre ADrian de pueblo lindo , hizo lo imposible por colocarme junto a las amigas con las que andaba.

Dificultad para reservar restaurantes y la chica de reservas no muy sociable específicamente la joven que me asistió en el turno de la mañana del sábado 31 sept , parecía que pedía un favor y al final me negó la reserva.

Señore pagando mi hospedaje para disfrutar y descansar. 

El señor que ,domingo 1sept ,en buffer hace parrillada , molesto y agotado se quejaba de preparar las carnes y no quería hacerla hasta que lo preparo obligado por su supervisor que vio la fila de personas demandando el servicio. 

Un supervisor peleaba feo con los camareros encima de todos y el camarero avergonzado bajaba la mirada , me quito las ganas de comer ver el pobre hombre siendo regañado  feo públicamente.
y para poner la cereza al pastel en bloque 6 Hab 6315 encuentro la hab bloqueada a las 12 en punto como es la regla y por mis culpa , pudo de manera amable a dos empleadas que estaban haciendo supervisión de las camaristas y sin siquiera detenerse ni explicar u orientar , remitió al lobby.
Desesperada con altas temperatura y en un tercer piso sin ascensor buscó asistencia en otra joven que limpiaba piso tres hab 6310 y cuando se disponía ayudar para abrir han y poder sacar las maletas , la señora se percata y evita sea asistida .

Fue muy feo momento en medio del calor y si era una regla no era la forma , quedé muy indignada del trato indiferente , frío y mal intencionado de la señora de nombre Melani y su compañera supervisora q le acompañaba.

Muy linda instalaciones y muy atentas las camareras todas del buffet 
El maletero fue la atención hecha persona y ni se diga del señor del parqueo que nos recibió.

Creo que debe orientar al personal y educar sobre atención al usuario aunque seamos Doninicano.

reviews.author: Andriy D
reviews.title: Paradisus lost forever
reviews.text: Let see. View and hotel are amazing but staying there is a disaster  as at all Melia / Circle  or whatever they call themselves now. Different names same crap . Starting from rules and regulations (go here, eat this or buy it - I'm talkinf about all inclusive ) selling people you some memberships ( trying- dying that's how bad it is). So if you want to overpay and ruin your vacation go to Melia /Circle resorts , which are amazing but destroyed by management.

reviews.author: Ophelie C
reviews.title: Una estancia agradable, pero con serias deficiencias en la gestión VIP (The Reserve)
reviews.text:
Mi pareja y yo acabamos de pasar una semana en este hotel, optando por el servicio all-inclusive con The Reserve (VIP). Aunque hubo aspectos positivos, lamentablemente, nuestra experiencia en general quedó muy por debajo de las expectativas para un establecimiento de esta categoría.

**Aspectos positivos:**

Queremos destacar la amabilidad y dedicación del personal, especialmente para Adriel, nuestro conserje, quien fue siempre servicial y atento a todas nuestras necesidades. Su esmero hizo que nuestras vacaciones fueran memorables y que nos sintiéramos bien atendidos en todo momento. 

Además, la diversidad y calidad de los restaurantes es notable, especialmente el Santé y el Winery, donde disfrutamos de comidas deliciosas en un ambiente acogedor.

También apreciamos mucho los talleres de artesanía y la salida en catamarán con yoga en una playa privada. Estas actividades añadieron un toque especial a nuestra estancia.

**Aspectos a mejorar:**

A pesar de estar en un establecimiento de lujo, hubo varios inconvenientes que afectaron negativamente nuestra experiencia. El más notable fue que el traslado desde el aeropuerto, que estaba incluido en nuestra reserva, no fue tramitado por el hotel. Como resultado, tuvimos que pagar 30 dólares por un taxi para un trayecto de 20 minutos. Ni el hotel ni la compañía Otium se hicieron cargo del incidente, a pesar de nuestras reclamaciones.

También habíamos reservado un upgrade a una habitación swim-up, el cual fue confirmado al hacer el check-in 72 horas antes de nuestra llegada. Sin embargo, al llegar, el hotel no tenía constancia de este upgrade, y como resultado, tuvimos que esperar un día para cambiarnos de habitación. La nueva habitación tampoco era la prometida, y no tuvimos más opción que conformarnos.

El confort de la habitación fue adecuado, aunque encontramos algunos problemas que no se esperaría en un hotel de esta categoría: el minibar no se rellenaba diariamente, y tanto la televisión como el secador no funcionaban correctamente.

Otro aspecto decepcionante fue la falta de respuesta de los managers del hotel ante nuestros inconvenientes. Aunque informamos de nuestros problemas a varios responsables desde nuestra llegada, ninguno se comunicó con nosotros para ofrecer una solución o compensación. En su lugar, parecían más interesados en vendernos un sistema de membresía que, al analizarlo, resultaba ser un 20% más caro que viajar sin él. 1h30 de nuestro tiempo perdido para nada.

Finalmente, antes de nuestra partida, contactamos con Otium más de 72 horas antes para reservar el transporte de regreso al aeropuerto. Sin embargo, a menos de 24 horas de nuestro vuelo, nos informaron que no habían tomado nota de nuestra solicitud, y la única opción disponible era un traslado 6 horas antes del vuelo, lo que resultó ser muy inconveniente.

**Conclusión:**

A pesar del excelente servicio por parte del personal, especialmente Adriel, y la calidad de los restaurantes, el hotel necesita mejorar considerablemente en la gestión y atención a sus clientes VIP para estar a la altura de sus 5 estrellas. La falta de consideración y la falta de resolución de problemas nos hicieron sentir que la experiencia no fue digna del lujo al que estamos acostumbrados.

reviews.author: Paulo S
reviews.title: disappointing
reviews.text: We just arriaved and already have problems: AC does not work, the floor is so slippery that you have to be careful not to fall; and we’ve been waiting for our luggages in our room for almost an hour…so far, disappointing to say the least. Let’s hope things get better from now on.

reviews.author: Junior C
reviews.title: Read before buying here! ( biased perspective)
reviews.text:
My honest review ( im a biased person) first thing first the reservation. I WAS THEIR FOR ALMOST 4 hours to check into my room. 
Most of the people were so confuse. It’s like non of their system was even working! However most of the workers there were kinda nice. Some weren’t. 
just constantly making mistakes like it’s their first day on the job. I mean they gave me and my family the room pass after 6 hours. 
ONLY ISSUE IS THE ROOM PASS WASNT EVEN WORKING. I MEAN WHAT.  Walking back that long route wasn’t for the weak. The way a lot of the workers there were very slow gave me a headache and I’m a paciente person but after 6
hours that takes a toll. 
The entrance however look amazing. 
Same as the rooms that were provided after hours of waiting. 
But it kinda looks like a deserted place; not a lot of people and I can understand why. To say the least I saw a lot of people arguing in front desk because of similar issues. 
Honestly if you’re very social I wouldn’t really fully recommend.
(Unless you’re in a group) Food however was amazing especially the deserts they had!
One issue…. They charge my teenage son like an adult so I was surprise when he couldn’t eat at a restaurant for “ adults”…. Something isn’t adding up!  Keep in mind these are not strip clubs with any sense of inappropriately behavior. 
Just fancy normal restaurant. 
However if you’re not a social person and an
adult and really do want to be alone I say this is perfect for you. But who dosent get lonely. 
The more I spend time in this place the more I’m slowly regretting spending the money. 
Most of the activity they have you have to pay so not only you are you paying in an all “inclusive” but you have to pay for activities and a lot of them. I went next-door to the other resort and it looked like the party looks so social and nice. if I could turn back time, I would change Resort so fast!
My check out was at 3pm… I was force to leave at 12….
That right their move my experience to a whole
2 out of 10 
That itself made the experience worst.
Lastly since I didn’t want to leave early they place my suitcase in a small room. Only ISSUE THEY MISPLACE IT OUTSIDE THANK GOD I WAS THEIR ON TIME. It’s like their communication skill was extremely off. I came here for for two days and only spent 6 hours…. Most of the time I spent was stressing. 
They couldn’t do anything about it; no extra days or anything. 
To end it off I wouldn’t personally recommend this resort. 
My email is juniorcastilloedwardcastillo@gmail.com if you have any questions.

reviews.author: LexiBrian
reviews.title: Not worth the stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for a wedding. The service was poor. The staff barely spoke English. The A/C in every room is almost 70 degrees and didn’t go any lower. When we got back to our rooms throughout the day it was humid and our bed felt wet. The bed is also so hard and very uncomfortable. The sheets were like paper. One of our sinks was broken and the shower water was cold and took almost 10 minutes to get warm. Some days I had to shower with freezing cold water. We didn’t know anything going on in the hotel. At check in nothing was explained. We were just given a map to our room. We didn’t even know the WiFi, activities going on in the hotel, restaurants, excursions, nothing. Room service took 2 hours, they ran out of food, the menu was limited to like 3 things, and it was so burned. The restaurants were booked up. There wasn’t a lot of entertainment. I was in a bridal party and we ordered 8 meals they only brought us 4.

reviews.author: Michele P
reviews.title: Non è un hotel resort da “5 stelle”
reviews.text:
Viene proposto e venduto come “5 stelle” ma la struttura e soprattutto il servizio non sono all’altezza di un 5 stelle. Abbiamo passato quattro notti, ma appena entrati in camera l’aria condizionata ha iniziato a non funzionare correttamente, mancava l’asciugacapelli e il sapone, e la presa di corrente in bagno non funzionava. Abbiamo fatto presente per quattro volte in 24 ore i suddetti problemi alla reception, per 4 volte ci hanno risposto che avrebbero risolto ma non hanno fatto assolutamente nulla (l’asciugacapelli ho dovuto recuperarlo da solo rincorrendo un inserviente…). Alla fine abbiamo passato quattro notti di grande caldo in camera senza che l’aria condizionata funzionasse correttamente. La struttura si presenta bene ma risente degli anni. Nella grande piscina centrale-principale, nelle ore centrali del giorno (un 5 stelle dovrebbe garantire anche un minimo di silenzio-tranquillità ai clienti) si sono alternate musiche ad alto volume, giochi d’acqua, ginnastica acquatica sempre con musica ad alto volume, molto fastidiosa (non c’erano piscine alternative più “tranquille”. Tanto personale che gira ma non adeguato a un 5 stelle (quasi nessuno sapeva una parola di inglese, solo  spagnolo). A titolo di esempio, mi sono trovato ad usufruire del bagno comune a ridosso della piscina principale, con la sorpresa dell’addetta alle pulizie che è entrata tranquillamente pur sapendo che il bagno era da me occupato (ricordo sempre che si tratta di un “5 stelle“). 
Spiaggia antistante il resort bella nella norma, senza particolari servizi “5 stelle”.
L’unica nota veramente positiva il ristorante italiano “Mascalzone”, di ottima qualità e grande cortesia da parte del personale. Nel complesso la vacanza è andata bene, ma ci ha creato alcuni disagi e tensioni non accettabili e giustificabili per un “5 stelle”

reviews.author: maria esther p
reviews.title: No volvería mucho calor
reviews.text: El aire acondicionado no enfría mucho y se corta programandamente sin poder sacar esa programación. Me morí de calor . Muy ruidoso. Y el servicio de atención es malo, cuando pedis cosas no traen nunca pese a reclamos. No reponen las bebidas también tuve que reclamar

reviews.author: michael s
reviews.title: Publicidad engañosa !!!!
reviews.text:
Estuve en este hotel con mi familia desde el 26 de junio al 1 de julio, teníamos una gran expectativa con el hotel , ya que reservamos las habitaciones Nikte que son las más exclusivas del hotel, lo cual fue un gran error porque pagamos por servicios que nunca fueron prestados por el hotel.

Primero que todo llegamos al hotel alrededor de las 20:30 hrs y se supone que te recibe el conciergue que tienes asignado , lo cual no sucedió. Tampoco nos dieron las indicaciones de qué instalaciones podríamos utilizar ni tampoco los servicios incluidos , de todas maneras al ser el primer día nos fuimos a descansar.

Se supone que al día siguiente nuestro Concierge se presentaría y nos explicaría qué servicios teníamos incluidos, lo cual no ocurrió y no lo conocimos hasta que yo lo contacte . Al abrir la aplicación de Melia nos indicaban los beneficios que teníamos incluidos , lo cual al consultarle me indica que esos servicios ya no los tenía el hotel ( adjunto pantallazo con ll que indicaba la aplicación). No tuve ninguna información durante todo el día de los servicios que me indicaba la aplicación y luego de insistir , me indicó que esos servicios ya no los tenía el hotel y sorpresivamente dejó de funcionar la aplicación desde mi cuenta , al parecer fue intencional , al seguir insistiendo que debían cumplir lo comprometido.

Luego me indican que si tenía acceso a bebidas premium y me enviaron un listado , el cual cada vez que he solicitaba algo en particular me decían que no tenían y que debía ir a otro bar, o sea nuevamente no cumplían con lo que indicaban y había un desconocimiento general de lo que ofrecen como servicio.

Me contacté con el supervisor de los Concierge y lo único que hizo por nosotros fue ayudarnos con la reserva para el restaurant de carnes.

Lo otro es que todo el personal que tienen está destinado para hacerte socio de Melia , es lo único que les interesa. Con toda la molestia que les hice ver desde mi llegada , me insistieron que fuera  al charla para la membresía y que por favor los escuchara, a lo que obviamente me opuse , ya que perdí bastante tiempo en tratar de que cumplieran lo comprometido.

En cuanto a las instalaciones no tengo mucho que decir , ya que cumple  con un buen estándar , al igual que las habitaciones .  Pero no puedo dejar que indicar que me siento estafado , ya que no cumplieron ni el 20% de lo comprometido y nadie se preocupó de poder remediar el
Inconveniente. Ni siquiera nos dieron los cupón de descuento que se comprometen a entregar.

Pague más de 4.000 usd por 4
Noches y 5 días , que no valieron la pena porque se supone que al estar en las habitaciones nikte hay un trato diferente , lo cual no ocurrió.

En resumen todo lo que  indican con respecto a las habitaciones Nikte solo tiene los siguientes beneficios :

- concierge que no ayudan mucho.
- habitación vista al mar de frente , hay alternativas más económicas y con vista al mar .

De seguro responderá algún gerente que se encuentra en España o en otro lugar del mundo y dirá que porque no me acerqué a algún gerente del hotel. Les comento que solo se puede llegar hasta el supervisor del Concierge que tampoco resuelve los problemas y que si uno elige un  hotel de estas características no puede andar detrás del personal para que cumplan un servicio que se comprometen desde que uno realiza la reserva.

Espero que les pueda ser de ayuda para todos los que quieren visitar este hotel.

reviews.author: ihatereviewing2024
reviews.title: There are better options in Punta Cana
reviews.text: If you are wanting a relaxing all inclusive stay… look elsewhere. Every day posed a new issue leaving us tired with stress and wanting to go back home. Our concierge was barely present and didn’t even bother to learn our names. The food was underwhelming, with the only decent food being at the exclusive restaurants. If you are not a member, you will be disappointed. The best meal was the octopus at Brisas but it was just a small appetizer. Their risotto was undercooked. The risotto at The Reserve wasn’t even risotto. It was jasmine rice. Steaks were overcooked and poor quality. Shrimp was always overcooked. Everything lacked flavor. The only positive I could find was the decent rooms. The 1 bedroom suites are comfortable, welcoming, and spacious. They did not have an outdoor hot tub or elevator access to higher floors though. They also have daily craft workshops like other resorts that were enjoyable.

reviews.author: Pete L
reviews.title: Not so awesome - poor service unless you pay a lot more
reviews.text:
We booked this based on the high ratings scores more than the reviews - big mistake. Here is a log of our at Meliã Paradisus in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  We give this a moderate rating as there are many staff who do seem to try and the groups were very nice.  However the overall service and food was not great.  Trust these reviews, not the ratings which can easily be staged.

Day 1 - we arrived early and had to wait for our room.  It wasn’t ready until almost 4pm, and then after delivering luggage we discovered it wasn’t what we requested and we had to go back to the main desk. This was resolved by about 4:30pm.

Day 2 we started to notice that the entire room smelled like mold.. this seemed to be in the A/C unit and we were told that no other rooms with our paid-for amenities were available so we lived with it for the rest of the week.

Day 3 the ability to make a request to housekeeping or maintenance services through app was taken away completely and the guest services like wasn’t answered after 20+ rings.  There is no way to get ice but via room service and we tried for 2 days but the requests through the app were ignored.

Day 4 - Room service stopped being functional through the app.

Day 4, it became extremely crowded on weekend - there were times we couldn’t find a single place to sit for breakfast or lunch, and most of the food was picked over or gone completely at the buffet.  There was no way to get a chair at the pool.  

Day 5, had to call to get minibar service at 6pm.  They asked what we wanted and delivered completely different items.

Day 5, had to call to get housekeeping service at 5pm while we were getting ready for dinner.  We were taking showers (there is only a thin see-through curtain for the bathroom door) while they cleaned our room. 

Jackhammering of the flooring also started outside of our room on day 5, lasting all day.  

Day 6, again no housekeeping service or minibar service.  Had to call and minibar showed up but not room service.  Since it was past 5pm we asked that they skip us for the day. 

Other notes:

Food at Italian place very bad, like they took from the buffet line.  There was a giant poster of an American top chef stating that they had a special menu. The fish was so bad - over cooked and rubbery. 

Much of the food at the sit down restaurants was very mushy, worse than a carnival cruise ship.  The exception was the fish at the Dominican restaurant and the flank steak Minas.

Grounds were nice, and swim up pool was very nice.  

Drinks were acceptable, the won’t blend anything and everything is pre-made and very sweet.

Several areas and one of the main restaurants were shut down for days due to an Indian wedding.

The resort is geared towards finding ways to get you to spend more (than the $500-800 per night you already out down for an all-inclusive). Some staff helpful, others wouldn’t go out of their way unless there was something to sell.  Example, they advertise a $120 beachside dinner.  However when you inquire about it they say the $120 is for one plate to food to share!  How misleading is that?!?

There was a “Beer mixology” event one day.  Tastings included Budweiser rather than the local beer (which cost extra, and as we discovered wasn’t worth paying for).

Suggest staying in the adult section to avoid loud neighbors due to adjoining room doors which let a lot of noise through.  Unfortunately some of the best room configurations are on the family side.

reviews.author: DayTrip14107355114
reviews.title: Really BAD experience !
reviews.text:
Lo del servicio nikte  del ritual del agua es un engaño el hotel no cuenta con Spa por lo que no entiendo como lo promocionan como tal. Te llevan a otro hotel de la cadena Melia en nuestro caso al Melia Punta Cana y al momento de la llegada te dicen que no tienen toallas después que la persona que nos llevo sale y consigue dos toallas y queremos hacer un masaje y usar el crédito que recibimos al momento de la reserva para Spa la amble señorita del Spa hace la aclaración de que estamos en otra propiedad.
Pésimo servicio el cliente solamente esta procurando hacer uso del servicio que ustedes vendieron.

reviews.author: Barbara J
reviews.title: Not what you think it will be
reviews.text:
The location is beautiful - the beach fabulous.
The rooms, food and service poor.  The staff very friendly, but most could not speak English.  The buffets were average.  The restaurant meals good to poor. Hard to get a reservation.
Don't waste your money traveling here.

reviews.author: Orlando P
reviews.title: Room Service Breakfast Horrible & customer service!!
reviews.text:
I did not give it one star because the resort itself is beautiful.  This is my 3rd time here and I must say, customer service is horrible.  No one can give you a straight answer, upon arriving to our room the TV remote did not work, I had to unplug the electrical cord on the back to get some sleep, no  blow dryer in the room, called about both, it took 24 hours to get a remote and blow dryer that does not work .  I called about the blow dryer, told me to check the GFI, I had already checked that and plugged toe dryer into every outlet in the room, it still did not work, I am still waiting for one that works!!! We have had to leave the hotel very early and ordered room service breakfast the night before for 6am, yesterday we received it 25 minutes late and this morning after calling them twice I had to cancel.  I requested breakfast for 6am this morning last night at 9pm, I called this morning at 6:10am a gentleman told me it was on its way at 6:30am I called spoke with another gentleman told me it was being prepared and would be arrive in a few, I canceled, we were being picked up at 7am.
The beach, accommodations are great.  The Mavi buffet, the food has been cold both times we have eaten there.
It is a shame that the most important aspect of a resort “Customer Service” has diminished.  I am an understanding person and work around issues, but this is uncalled for.
Hope you are able to resolve this issue for your future customers.  I will not be coming back.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Poor Quality and Experience
reviews.text:
1st time coming here and I had a slew of issues that took far too many requests and days to resolve. My shower drain was clogged and flooded my room day one, beverage and snacks service was lacking until about the 4th day and my registering a complaint, then that was fixed. The food is very hit or miss but expected far better than what we had most days and the drinks and wine selection was pretty lacking as well. The bed was hard as rock. 
I did enjoy my room service personnel. They did a great job cleaning each day. The coffee bar was very nice as well. The steakhouse did have a good steak with our one night event and we did like the hibachi night dinner as well.

reviews.author: gIB4Gib
reviews.title: Over booked! Bad Service
reviews.text:
Booked the Reserve for a couples vacation in mid April.
On arrival was told they were OVERBOOKED !! and would need to spend first night at another resort. After a healthy  debate, miraculously a room was available with a promised upgrade for the remainder of our trip.  This event caused a disappointing two day loss in our vacation while we shuffled around rooms.
The resort, pool and rooms were well maintained, grounds were in good condition.
The service on the other hand was very poor and disorganized despite high employee numbers. Constant trying to up-sale wine at dinner. Tipping  had no value in service motivation, that seemed very odd! The only drive for good customer service was an online review, which a few servers stated it was important for their boss to see the review. 
Butler Service was none existent the first night until we asked and the only value was restaurant bookings. Beaches had a lot of sea weed and many beach peddlers. If the staff service was as good as the peddling , this would be a 5 star !! 
Restaurants food was ok .
Despite the beauty, this place had a bad vibe.
Will not return, do not recommend.

reviews.author: Nick_Sussex_WI
reviews.title: Worst all inclusive we've visited over 16 years
reviews.text:
We traveled early to mid April as a couple and chose to extend a trip my wife earned through work. Not sure if this place is just really hit or miss but the positive reviews shock us and the negative reviews seem spot on.

First off I want to highlight that our butler/concierge Tomas was very good at getting us reservations and responsive to text messages throughout the trip. I'd recommend him since I've heard many horror stories of others not even hearing from their butler/concierge. Derny who worked at the 90 degree swim up bar was always on top of it and poured some good drinks.

The good:
We had a reserve room so check in/out was in a nice private and quiet area. The ocean view room had a really nice view. The resort itself is beautiful and seems newly remodeled. The beach was large and lots of places to sit. Breakfast was the best food item we probably ate daily, recommend Sante for breakfast they offer some menu items and a mini buffet with egg/omelette station. Swimup bar was good at serving drinks and keeping up with demand.

Mascalzone:
The appetizers were good. The chicken alfredo and shrimp linguini were also good. Potentially the best restaurant on the property.

Mina:
They know steak at this restaurant, the new york steak was good and so were the appetizers and bread.

Tokimeku:
So this place is walk in if not doing the hibachi, wish we would have known so we could of avoided the buffet. They surprised us with a special roll not on the menu, unfortunate since it was better than the roll we ordered. But overall tried some rolls and ordered everything under the wok section and enjoyed.

The bad:
Let's start with the room. The mini fridge is placed inside of cabinet, took us 2-3 days to realize you need to leave the door open because there wasn't adequate air flow and the fridge would not cool. Secondly the bathroom light switches were placed in an odd location between top and second from top shelves that were next to vanity. Lastly, the tub would be better suited with a handle near by since the edge was terrible to push on.

The property overall while beautiful, every morning there would be plates and or glasses left at pool chairs or at random places and many times those items would stay for hours after breakfast. This is something I've never experiences before, probably from a lack of waiters which lead to the next point.

The pool service, or should I say lack of service as in waiters. Never noticed one waiter come and take an order from anyone seated around the pool. The adult swimming pool also lacked significant amount of chairs to accommodate the crowd that wanted to be there. Also lack of enforcement by adult pool bar staff to turn away kids.

Reservation system for sit down restaurants, not sure why reservations are needed since most places weren't even at capacity unless its a staffing issue. The restaurants didn't even match times as mentioned on the app. 

The Lunch Box:
Had to eat there the first night since we couldn't get reservations. With went to seafood station and got lobster, its precooked frozen and reheated, the lobster was so overcooked that the meat came off in little tough strings. I went around station to station to try a few things, got onion rings (ice cold), potatos (ice cold), rice and some sort of pork stew for on top.

Kanna Beach Club:
Went for lunch 3 days, first three days ordered the nachos, everyday they came different and not one single day did they come with all listed items per the menu. Wife ordered tacos or nachos and experienced the same issues. 4th day there they had a grill and buffet of sides. Sides were fine but we both ordered the chicken from the grill, both pieces of chicken were undercooked and raw in the middle.

Kicks Sports & Fun Bar:
Went the first night after the huge disappoint at the buffet. Ordered nachos thinking it would be quick and simple. They brought out a plate of chips and a bowl of watery cheese sauce and a bowl of pico, which is not nachos.

Sante:
Figuring this was part of the reserve room upgrade we were excited to try the more exclusive dinner, first off the menu they presented was wrong so it took 10 minutes to straighten that out. Secondly the lobster ravioli and ribeye were both disappointing.

Mina:
I know it was listed as a good but its also a bad. My wife ordered the chicken which looked amazing until you cut to the center and again it was raw.

Blue Agave:
Love mexican food and although the tortilla soup was good. We both ordered different tacos (shrimp and pastor) and were really disappointed by the dryness which made them hard to eat. The margaritas were also a major miss, something in the mix was off.

Flora:
We had high hope after visiting other resorts. Premium steak ordered and was by far one of the worst steaks I've ever eaten, overcooked and full of gristle. Wife ordered gnocchi and a rice item, both were ok. High light here was probably their avocado bread appetizer. 

Summary:
Not sure how this place is considered a 5-star luxury resort. The price point is aligned with 5-star luxury but the resort is not. I've been to other brands such as Excellence and Secrets both which I highly recommend. The Paradisus Palma Real is not worthy of the price and I do not recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: AMR
reviews.title: Stay elsewhere.
reviews.text: I chose this hotel as part of The Hotel Collection with AMEX. Upon arrival service was good though a bit on a shaky start since they could not find my reservation and had me waiting out front with the bellhops which was awkward. Front desk was nice but I was put off by the fact that they offered me a paying upgrade, but when I pointed to the fact that the Program offered said upgrade in a complementary fashion... mysteriously the upgrade then offered was suddenly "not available". Fine. Hotel grounds are beautiful and well kept. Servers are attentive and cheery. Sadly, my stay began to fall short as my dinner reservation at Mina was a disaster. I arrived 10 minutes before as suggested, but ended up gettin to my table about half an hour after scheduled. My dinner took 52 minutes to get to my table: burnt steak and cold potatoes. My guess is they were otherwise engaged with the 10-guy table next to me. Somehow they were timely served. Anyways, thanks to Stephanie who seemed to be the only manager who cared. She was attentive and caring. Dinner at Blue Agave was wonderful, best experience there. Also, I was madre to wait about 35 minutes at Yhi Spa because they were doubtful of recognizing the resort credit that comes with the AMEX program. They finally did and my service was great. Honestly AMEX should revise how hotels are trained about the program because its very annoying to have to be explaining this to them, and they get annoyed if you wish to use your benefits which I find ridiculous. If not for the AMEX program I would have probably not stayed there in the first place. Trip was ended on a bad note as I found a roach, yes a roach in my room (see picture). I discretely expressed my concern to the night manager and he was extremely dismissive, as if nothing happened. He even made jokes as to how big the roach was, since I took a picture with my phone to show him. In sum, for a hotel this pricey I expected a better stay. Will not return. If you want a short answer: stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Ana R
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
I had high expectations for this hotel which unfortunately were not met.  
Although the property is beautiful, the service and the quality of the food made our 6 night stay something we don't want to repeat.  I booked a suite on the Nikté section which they advertise as having many perks and a dedicated concierge.  We arrived at the hotel at noon and were told our room would be ready at 3pm, their regular check in time.  We had lunch and walked through the property in the meantime. 
At 3pm we inquired about our room and were told it that is was still not ready and that it would take another 40 minutes.  We were finally taken to our room by a porter. No sign or call from our concierge during this process.  I inquired at the front desk about the concierge service and they called the person who would be our concierge.  We met him at the lobby and he explained that he could take care of restaurant reservations and a catamaran trip.  We asked about other activities to do and were directed to the Otium tours desk.  This is an outside vendor with a desk at the hotel where you can buy other excursions. I was interested in the activities that they advertise but our concierge did not offer any ideas on the included activities that they mention in their website.  On our second day we walked on the beach and found the place where you can use the kayaks and a hobie cat sailboat (the kayaks are free but the for the sailboat you have to pay $50 for a class.)  When we told our concierge that we used the kayaks, he asked us to give him the details because he had another client who was looking to do that activity as well. This is obviously not what we were expecting from a concierge service. We were offered a catamaran trip, but our questions of where was it taking us, how are we getting there, what's included were never answered clearly so we decided to pass.  Our concierge kept insisting that we attend a 45 minute presentation about a Meliá club, which we repeatedly declined to attend. 
The hotel also has tennis courts which we found through the Melia app.  We asked the lobby porter how to get there, which he did, but he never offered the hotel transportation that we later found existed when we visited the sister property Melia Caribe. The property lacks activities to do during the day.  There are no ping pong tables, no bicycles, no activities to do in the sand.  In summary, we never experienced the "many perks" and the "exclusive on-and off-property Destination Inclusive activities" that Nikté supposedly offers.  

The food at the buffet is mediocre at best.  It is tasteless and bland.  The potatoes, in the many forms that were offered, were always hard.  The steaks made to order were tough and without seasonings.  Many of the dishes were mislabeled or not labeled at all.  The ice cream was always melted (we saw the ice cream being transported in an open cart through a service road in the middle of the day.)  The desserts looked artificial, sponge cakes were dry.
Service was inconsistent.  On many occasions, we had to ask for silverware as the tables were not turned around quickly. Waiters don't offer drinks, we had to ask for water every time and any other drink that we ordered took a while.  One day during lunch, half the restaurant was reserved for a big group.  We had to look for our own table, move chairs, and stand up to get a waiter to bring us water. They don't have spoons at the table nor do they bring them when they serve you coffee at breakfast, so every single time we had to ask for spoons to stir the coffee.  
They have several specialty restaurants for which you have to make a reservation.  They have this system where you have to stand in line in the morning to make a reservation.  Only a selected few get to reserve. One of the perks of our concierge was that he could, with much effort, circumvent this system and get us one of the coveted reservations.  We dined at the Mexican restaurant.  Same tasteless food because it is the same kitchen for the buffet and the "specialty" restaurants. The inefficiency of running the restaurant was very visible.  There were empty tables and yet we were asked to wait.  We counted 14 waiters/employees at that restaurant and 34 guests.  Our experience was not any different than at the buffet.  We tried the Kana restaurant for lunch and were also disappointed.
Our room had a nice ocean view, although it was on a second floor on top of the Kana restaurant so the closest view that we had from our terrace was the roof of the first floor.  Our terrace was spacious and comfortable.  Housekeeping was very efficient and met our needs.
In summary, I do not recommend this hotel. It promises much, but delivers little.  It lacks the level of service and quality of food that its luxury pricing stands for.  We did not receive what they advertise.

reviews.author: Ulysses M
reviews.title: Not the service you would expect for The Reserve booking category
reviews.text:
Stayed at this facility for 5 nights in March 2024. We are a family of 7 and reserved three ocean front rooms at the Reserve more than six months before check in. While the facility is luxurius and the staff were friendly, there were several issues with our stay:
1. During check in, we were not told beforehand that one of our three rooms was not ocean front and only found out when we physically got to our rooms. They did change this to an ocean front room, but not until the following evening, Obviously, this was disruptive to our vacation schedule as we were not provided a specific time for the change in rooms. Importantly, we requested a rate adjustment for the differences in room rate on Day 1. Twelve days later, no rate adjustment has been done despite repeated promises from the front desk manager that it is being taken cared of. Still waiting up to now.
2. At the time of reservation, we were promised that there will be two queen beds in one of the 3 rooms since we are a family of 7. During check in, we were told that only a king bed will be available for all rooms; we eventually got a cot, but only after repeated phone calls to the front office.
3. The concierge was less than helpful in getting dinner reservations. We got so frustrated that decided to make the reservations ourselves for dinner during our son's birthday.

Overall, not the service we would have expected at the Reserve, supposedly their highest level of service.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Not good - awful food
reviews.text:
You don’t have to worry about vacation weight. The food was absolutely awful. I don’t think I can ever eat at a Buffet ever again.  I took one bite into a taco and there was something in it that should have been. I immediately had to spit it out and run to the toilet. I have a celiac kid and they said they could accommodate. But they could not. The first day we were there I asked about gluten free and they showed me the vegetarian stuff. I knew we were in trouble then.  We had an even by the pool and there was food that was sitting in the sun for hours, including seafood. This food was served at the buffet the next day. 
The hotel is nice and the pool is great.

reviews.author: marcevoinea
reviews.title: El servicio al cliente no resultó el esperado. Prometieron más de lo que dieron. No se hicieron cargo de nuestras quejas
reviews.text:
Prometieron más de lo que dieron. No se hicieron cargo de nuestras quejas ni se disculparon. El olor a humedad de la habitación es muy feo. Difícil acceder a los restaurantes que uno quiere. Muy grandes y ruidosos. El personal de playa es dueño de las sombrillas y solo se puede acceder a una buena ubicación si arreglas con ellos…
Una mención especial para el Winery: excelente. Lindisimo lugar. Íntimo. Muy bien atendidos x Johnatan y Juan. Cálidos y profesionales. Excelente la comida!

reviews.author: Michael O
reviews.title: Beware - overcharging
reviews.text:
I rarely submit reviews unless I've had a fantastic or an abysmal experience. In this case it's the latter. The resort itself is very beautiful and in general the staff are helpful and pleasant. I stayed there from 7th-12th March, along with my wife and 12 other friends. We booked dining rooms for three of the nights we were there and purchased wines for 2 birthday celebrations. When I was checking out I discovered that they had significantly overcharged us for the wine (by about $1600). We discovered this just 1 hour before we were due to go to the airport. It took 5 different people / manager to partly resolve some of the overcharging, still leaving us with $450 overcharge. We had to leave it to our friends (who were leaving a day later) to sort out the rest. They believed they had resolved it, and the hotel indicated that I needed to contact them to finalize the refund. I did contact them multiple times with all the details with no response. We remain $450 poorer for our experience.. So if you do stay at this resort, I would offer the following advice.
1.	If you purchase wine, at the end of dinner, take a photo of the empty bottle consumed – you will need this when/if you have to dispute some overcharge.
2.	Check you bill the day prior to departure, or at a minimum, 3-4 hours prior to departure, as you will need that much time to argue your case. I had to argue our case to 4-5 different people behind the front desk before we got any satisfaction.
3.	If you traveled with a group of friends, have all of them check their bills a day before departure, as we found that the waiters had charged 2 rooms for the same wine!

reviews.author: ilineelectricltd18
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Many areas to improve, very poor I would rate at a 3 star at best, I am an experienced traveler and this location is on the bottom of my list . Cockroaches in room, multiple insect bites on my body, extra charges on all inclusive and they kept saying all not included. Playing with included and inclusive

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: CIRCLE=TIMO
reviews.text:
Compramos un plan de vacaciones, CRICLE MELIA RED. Cuando te lo venden es todo facilidades y maravilloso, pero claro!! Tienen una cláusula que exime de cumplir cualquier oferta verbal y cuando llegas a las vacaciones llega la realidad… has pagado el doble que cualquier cliente y eres uno más…. 
Te venden que vas tener exclusividad, exclusividad que no existe!! 
Vas a desayunar y no tienes mesa, llegas a la hamaca y no tienes en tu zona reservada porque se han colado los que van del hotel, para cenar lo mismo, restaurante de una calidad pésima, pides las bebidas en las mismas barras que el resto, haces las mismas colas que el resto, tienes las mismas habitaciones que el resto… en definitiva, MENTIRAS.
Si alguien se lo está planteando no lo compren porque todo lo que te cuenten son mentiras que luego no cumplen

reviews.author: Shadow
reviews.title: The Good, The Bad & The Ugly
reviews.text:
Front Desk/Check-in: 0 out of 10 
We arrived at the hotel at approximately 11:30 p.m. to discover that we did not have a room reservation.  We showed the manager and employee several booking confirmations but they were still adamant that we did not have a booking.  Finally they found our names but told us our room reservation started the following day.  We continued to show them our confirmation that clearly indicated Mar 5-12.  They somehow got authority to give us a room for the evening.  
They brought our luggages to the room and when we got to the room, we couldn't open the door so security was called.  The batteries on the door pad needed to be replaced.  We entered the room and they gave us 2 beds instead of the King that we paid for.  TV remote was broken and the shower took forever to get warm. I called the manager at the front desk and he told me to come back in the morning.  At 6am, I was at the front desk asking to be moved to the room I paid for.  They told me to come back at 8am when the manager arrived.  Then at 8am, I was told to come back at 11am when that manager's manager arrived.  At 11a.m. I was told they might have a room available at 4p.m. Went back at 3:30 p.m. and FINALLY, we managed to find a competent manager who offered us an upgrade to the Reserve area but we were told we couldn't have the concierge service which was fine by us, all we really wanted is a King size bedroom. 

Hotel Layout/appearance: 10 out of 10
I've travelled to many destinations and started my career in the travel industry and have seen some of the most luxurious hotels.  This hotel is absolutely beautiful almost surreal. The grounds are well kept and there's an amazing fragrance throughout the hotel. 

Hotel room: 7 out of 10
Our hotel room was located in building 8 on the 3rd floor, you needed to take the stairs to the room, no elevators.  The modern room is very spacious and has nice amenities. You'll find 2 bath robes, slippers/flip flops, clothes steamer, blowdryer, shampoo/conditioner/body wash, razor and an abundance of towels. Mini fridge is stocked with water, juice and pop.  There's a nescafé coffee maker with espresso pods and a kettle for tea.  Chips and chocolate bars are also provided. There's also a safe but the keypad did stick. What I didn't like about the room was the sensor directly above the bed, not sure if this was the fire alarm but it flashed all night long and being a light sleeper, I woke up several times throughout the night.  
Also, the bathroom walls are replaced with sheer curtains, although this is great for moisture control, it's not for privacy and noise.  The shower door is frosted for some level of privacy and the toilet does have a door.  A/C had a mind of its own and very noisy! I also wasn't impressed with the cleanliness of the room, it never smelled freshly cleaned. Another issue that we experienced, is half way through our trip our room key bracelet didn't work.  We had to call management to open the door and then deal with front desk staff again! 

Restaurants: 7 out of 10
Overall, we enjoyed the variety of food here and if you like fish, this is the place.  Red snapper, salmon, shrimp, tilapia and 1 afternoon, lobster was provide in the restaurant at the Reserve. Because we didn't have a concierge assigned to us, making dinner reservations wasn't the best experience.  You can only book 2 nights in advanced and there was always a line-up.  We ate at the Italian, Japanese and Steak restaurant.  All very good.  The Lunch-box buffet does need some improvement, they had salmon one day at the grill that was under cooked and several flies around the pizza station.  Also, the employee that runs the desserts at dinner is miserable and rude.  

Pool Area/Daytime/evening activities: 4 out of 10
I booked this hotel because i didn't want the loud annoying entertainment that you find at other hotels.  There was daily activities posted but good luck finding them.  There was a painting activity posted that I was interested in but I was not able to find the location.  I asked several employees but didn't get a straight answer.  Very little activities and entertainment throughout the day.  We attended 1 evening event that was amazing, they had a singer that played 70s music.  He was outstanding! 10/10 
The Neon show was scheduled for 9 p.m. but we left because nothing was happening, apparently it started at 10 p.m. The following day they had a Silent party? Didn't seem appealing so we passed on this.

Beach area: 9 out 10
Beach chairs always available, gorgeous white sands, and the ocean is like bath water.  Waves were a bit rough at times but not a concern if you can swim.  There was seaweed on the beach but no issue for me.  Vendors are around throughout the day but once they see you are not interested, they leave you alone.  Accessibility to the beach bars are close by.

THE BAD:
Last day of our trip my husband got very sick, diarrhea, nausea and fever/cold sweats.  We were able to see the doctor that was onsite at 2am and she was able to administer medication to get him well enough to make it on the flight (barely).  The day after we arrived, I had to take him to emergency for dehydration and they are currently running tests to see if what caused this.  

Although there were some positive highlights of our trip, we will never go back to this hotel or DR again.  Our health is more important that 1 week at a poorly run hotel.

reviews.author: craigsG4990DR
reviews.title: Prepare to Be Frustrated
reviews.text: Stayed in the Reserve Junior Swim-up Suite.  Generally the hotel staff was great.  Pools are nice as is the beach.  Food, as everyone else has stated, ranged from very good to gross.  Clearly problems with management - we were told the hotel was "oversold" and that the room category we paid for was not available.  I overheard several others having this same issue.  Spent hours of our short vacation trying to fix the problem - which we ultimately did but 25% of our vacation was over before things were corrected.  Other minor annoyances:  long check-in time, AC in one of the rooms didn't work the first night, room service dishes outside the door for over 24 hours.  This resort has such great potential - a shame they can't get things together.

reviews.author: charlenebrooks
reviews.title: Disappointed.
reviews.text:
I have been vacationing at this hotel every year since  2008.
This is the first time I’ve had a bad experience in all the years that I’ve been vacationing here. I’ve brought friends with me to show them what an exceptional, high quality resort with excellent customer service, and amenities is like in Punta Cana.at this resort. However, my visit this week has been terrible. I understand there was o major renovations, but that does not excuse the lack of customer service,  the lack of information regarding the different levels of service etc. (no more flamingos, so sad.). Dining has never been a problem in the past however, dining at the property this week  (post pandemic) was very disappointing. The beach is always the best part of this property. Unfortunately, I will not be returning to my beloved favorite vacation resort.
Best wishes and good luck!

Loyal Club Meliá vacationer

reviews.author: DayTrip787618
reviews.title: Think twice before going...
reviews.text:
I rarely submit reviews unless I've had an amazing or an abysmal experience. In this case...it's sadly the latter. A business award trip brought us to Paradisus along with 300+ colleagues. To start, the check in was excruciatingly inefficient. We ended up waiting well over 3 hours to get to our room. We were later told by a colleague that we should have utilized the hospitality suite where we could have changed into more comfortable clothing. Wish we had known but we were never told about that. There was nobody in manaagement capacity to talk to trouble shoot the dismal check in experience...red flag! Upon finally arriving in our room, we were given twin beds room instead of a king room. Then we checked out the bathroom which has absolutely no privacy as it is separated by gauzy see through curtains, and we were  greeted by a disgustingly rusted out garbage can (please see posted picture). The simple fact that this "supposedly" 5 star resort thinks it's perfectly ok to display such a trash can left us speechless! 

The food at this resort was sub par. Like others have said, the buffet selection never changed and the food tasted like glorified cafeteria food. I tried a waffle at breakfast and I, literally, could not cut through it as it had been sitting out for so long. The restaurant reservation system is archaic and a total joke. Meat was consistently over cooked, including our formal sit down company dinner where our surf n turf lobster tail was so tough, it was hard to chew. I'm feeling lucky that we didn't suffer food poisoning like another reviewer did.

Next up...pool area ran out of towels several times during our stay and were not replenished in a timely manner. Not a good sign. Empty plates and drinks were not cleared away for hours which meant we had to clean up if we wanted to sit down by the pool. The adults only areas were not monitored so we ended up having noisy kids in those areas. Why bother if it's not going to be enforced.

i think the locals are inherently nice people  but lack the proper management training.   Management has to step up their game if this is going to be worthy of a 5 star rating. One employee couldn't even tell us where one of the restaurants was located since "he just started working there last week" (as he said in his own words)
And NO, I can't blame it on language barrier as I've stayed in plenty of 5 star resorts in Asia and other international places with consistently good and gracious service.  It's absolutely on managment to do better! Simply put...the rusty trashcan says it ALL!

reviews.author: Akar11
reviews.title: Believe the negative reviews….
reviews.text:
Ok, so I pray that someone who reads this listens and does not go to this resort. I will preface this by saying that while we are honestly not picky, we do expect some pretty good quality and service for a 5-star resort. If I expected a 2 or 3 star experience, I would have booked that. Also, we have been to about 15 different 5-star resorts in places like Cancun, Mayan Riviera, Punta Cana, Negril and Ocho Rios. We have had some experience with 5 star stays. I will start with the positives:

The resort itself and the grounds are beautiful and very well maintained. The check in process was smooth and easy- no problems there. The room was perfect- we booked a 1 bedroom with a kitchen area and it was huge and cleaned well each day. The beach was great too and you could find a spot, no problem. The waves were massive, but no problem there- the weather can’t be controlled.

Now for the negatives:
1. FOOD- the food was not good at all. Things were undercooked and not safely stored. I got horrific food poisoning the first night and ended up unable to eat for 4 days, losing 5 pounds. A nightmare. My sister also got sick (more mildly thank God). Trying to make a reservation at any of the a La carte restaurants was a joke- no availability at all, unless you wanted to go at 9pm. Then you would walk by and the restaurants would be empty.
**the exception to this is the Mexican restaurant, where the food and service was AMAZING!!!**

2. SERVICE- overall, not good at all. It felt like an imposition when we had to ask for anything. We asked for 4 towels after a rainstorm and I was told “Mia madre, why do you need 4”. Just bizarre. There was also a little snack hut on the beach where they serve nachos and fruit. When we asked for guacamole (which was there in the bowl, ready to go) the man serving us was so annoyed, it was as if we asked him to donate his kidneys to us. Just wild. Servers I’m the buffet took ages bringing drinks, seemed to be more concerned talking to each other. 

3. ENTERTAINMENT- non- existent during the day, literally crickets by the pool and nothing happening. At night, the lobby bar area has some beautiful live music, but we had no idea until the last day that there was a WHOLE different area for entertainment. Very strange. Kids club is fabulous though!

Last but not least, we killed 5 MASSIVE COCKROACHES in our room throughout the stay. Yes, I understand that it happens in tropical climates, but I couldn’t get past it. At night, when using the bathroom, I had to use my phone flashlight because the roaches seemed to like to congregate around the toilet. Same thing in the other people’s rooms that we went with. 

We were not isolated in this experience-  many people there while we were staying there had the same things to say.

Moral of the story- please spend your money somewhere else and believe the negative reviews. I have never left a review like this in my life and am able to overlook many things and realize I’m in another country- this was just too much.

reviews.author: Lizette F
reviews.title: The place is beautiful, but it’s not worth. There are a lot of beautiful places that serve good food on a daily basis
reviews.text: The place is beautiful but the food was terrible every where. They have a variety of options for each and every option was terrible. Starting with what they say is the best restaurant in the whole resort, which is the Mediterranean one. The shrimps were dirty the octopus you had to chew it 20 times. The food was cold. Another restaurant that they claim to be Dominican that is not Dominican food. I am Dominican, and that was not Dominican food. The lunchbox which is the buffet. They have a lot of choices there, but the food would be either undercooked overcooked seasoned. My mother got sick twice we had to eat outside every day after the fourth night of trying different restaurants that the next one would be better but that was not the case so on top of me, spending almost $10,000 to have everything included for eight days. I also had to pay cabs to go and come back from the restaurants and also had to pay for the food and the restaurants, which means that I ended up spending a lot more money . The smell of cigarettes and cigars it’s terrible people smoke all over the resort they do not have a specific section for smokers. There are children everywhere The adult section is a very small section, and even there there were children the aroma inside the gift store, and the bathrooms is such a hazard for your health. The smells are so strong it is terrible. I am an asthmatic. My son is an asthmatic. My mother is an asthmatic and the smell they just gave me the only migraine I could not even walk past the gift store or the restrooms because of the aromas, they were extremely strong. When you’re at the beach, you have all these vendors just popping up out of nowhere and people offering braids and massages, offering to take pictures with parrots and monkeys they just put they would put the animals on you tell you to take a picture with your phone and then charge you anywhere between 35 and $50 on a daily basis. Selling cigars cheap jewelry excursions,  not one time a day the entire day different ones were just pop up. Personally, I would not recommend this place when you go on vacation you want to enjoy relax and eat good food this was not very relaxing. The food was horrible so I enjoyed very little of it again I booked for eight days so it’s not like I didn’t give the place a chance.

reviews.author: Jessica D
reviews.title: Would not recommended
reviews.text:
Paradisus was unfortunately not a place we would recommend going to. Reading back on some of the reviews online, it seems more recently they’ve had some issues that we experienced ourselves during our stay.

Food was almost never the right temperature, safety of their food is a huge concern. Buffet food was not kept hot/cold. Pitchers of milk, raw meat, yogurt, etc were not kept on ice. Hot food was usually room temperature, the hot plates didn’t seem to work or were not on
Restaurant food was hit or miss. Most of the time food was served room temp or slightly warm. It was rare to be served a hot meal. Salads/desserts were typically not refrigerated. 

Reservations for restaurants was a huge hassle. If you didn’t have a reservation, you likely had to go to the buffet, or wait until 9:30pm for something to open. If you didn’t make a reservation for a restaurant at 9am the day prior, it would be hard to get in anywhere, which made our first two days a challenge. Even when we did have a reservation, we would sometimes have to wait 45-60 minutes to be seated

Adult breakfast/lunch buffet was closed the entire week, so the main buffet was very crowded with families. Adults only restaurant was closed Friday and lunch on Saturday so this left no adults only dining options. There were also private events going on, so we suspected they were understaffed and had to close down a restaurant. They also closed down beach snacks on these days so there was no food available outside of the buffet during the day.

On our second night we found a blood stain on our comforter, and it took two trips to the front desk and a phone call to get a new one. Nearly 4 hours passed, finally got a blanket delivered around midnight. Front desk staff needed some convincing that it should to be replaced, tried telling us it was just from a mosquito.

Overall they seemed extremely short staffed. We rarely were served any beverages/water/coffee at the breakfast buffet, and took quite some time to get food served at dinner, no frequent beach service for drinks, no staff making sure kids stayed in designated family beach area/pools, no evening shows/activities, didn’t ask how our stay was when we checked out, etc

I really never go out of my way to post negative feedback, my husband and I are pretty easy going when it comes to service at hotels! However, this was really not on par with the last few resorts we’ve been to. The resort itself is well-kept and the room was very nice, but that was about it. If the hotel does read this, please address the food first and foremost—I’m a food scientist and you are really taking a huge risk with people’s health with the current quality.

reviews.author: Mark K
reviews.title: 3rd Time Guest But Will Not Recommend Going Forward
reviews.text:
Let me start with some background. This was our third time at this property. This includes another post-Covid visit in 2023. Each time we have paid the premium to stay in the Reserve adults only section. Our net assessment is that there has been a significant erosion in the quality of the guest experience. While there is a lot to be said for the physical plant (well kept grounds, building design, beach area etc.) , operationally, it is a hot mess. Therefore we can no longer recommend this property. It simply isn't worth the price.  For those who are interested, details are as follows:
What's Good-  The proximity to the airport (about 20-25 minutes direct) and the lovely beach area are strengths when it comes to location. The rooms are spacious and comfortable (although a negative is to be found below). The Spa is very nice and the crew at the Ginger bar is outstanding. The grounds are very well maintained as are the pools. The Otium crew, while not hotel employees, was great when it came to transfers and excursions. When it is done right , the quality of the food is very good but there are some real issues in this area which leads me to....
What Needs Work- Operationally we ran into issues across departments from the front desk to housekeeping to food service (restaurants) etc.  The systemic nature of these leads me to call out the General Manager. Too many misses in too many areas. Here are some specific examples:
1) Pre-Check In -  Two forms sent via email. The first for guest information so we could just "pick up our key and go" ( wrong!) and the second for listing preferences. The links in the second form were broken so it could not be forwarded and therefore it was useless. 
2) Check-In - We arrived around 2:30. We knew check-on wasn't till 3 though so we expected a bit of delay. At the Front Desk for the Reserve area, our baggage handler told us to sit at the side and someone would help us. It turned out that It was over for 20 minutes before our presence was even acknowledged. This despite at least 5 employees standing around. It seemed as though only 1 knew how to assign the rooms. There were only 2 other parties there but apparently one group was well known to the staff as what looked like a couple of manager level representatives came by to have a "old home week" visit while we waited. Finally, we were finally told to get some lunch (at 3pm) , we came back around 3:30 and our room was still not yet ready. So much for the pre-check in, get your key and go.
3) The Room- Nice but it had a musty smell. Our concierge immediately called engineering but it was several days before the smell was gone. For the first couple of days we would end up coughing and sniffling in the morning due to this. The hotel offered to move us but it was to a first floor room with no guarantee it too wouldn't have the same issue.
4) Housekeeping- We were short a bath towel and there no face clothes.  I called to request these and was told someone would be right up. They never came. Apparently face clothes are not standard issue. We had to complain at the front desk to get two which were promptly removed the next day and not replaced. Suffice to say our first day, which set the tone for our visit, did not meet expectations. 
5) The Restaurants-  The most troubled area. Menus swaps occurred during 3 of the 5 nights. Without warning, salmon was served instead of halibut. Medium rare duck became well done beef etc. The waiter even argued with me that it was duck! Oh, and the sides of potatoes and peas suddenly became asparagus. According to the waiter the peas were in the brown sauce. Really?   Of course service was extremely slow. A chef friend of ours told us that the goal is to have the entre served with 50 minutes of a guest arrival. We were lucky if it was an hour and 15 minutes regardless of restaurant. The place felt really understaffed in the kitchen.  Reservations were moved. A reservation at the Italian restaurant was moved at the last minute due to what looked like a corporate affair to what was supposed to be a premium restaurant for Circle Club members. And that is where we had the worst experience!  Yet there was no one who looked like a manager to be found. 

Some of the above might sound trite, but remember, you pay extra for the Reserve and there was bit of cumulative effect.  As I said upfront, we have stayed there before so we have prior experiences to compare to. I have to say that I was disappointed by our experience particularly as 3rd time returning guest. I can tell you that Sandals takes a very different approach. This place is clearly taken a couple of steps back. You no doubt deserve better. Time (particularly vacation time!) and money are precious commodities and this is why we will not recommend this place.

reviews.author: Angelina_Serra
reviews.title: DONT book with this hotel.
reviews.text: Summary: DONT book with this hotel. Don't be with Expedia. Major dissapointments Nothing of my reservation was honored. When I arrived my room was not ready. I had to wait 40 min. Poor customer service. They didn't give me the VIP promised pass. They also added terms to the $100 credit that was promised with the spa which were not there during booking.  No elevator. General poor customer service given the very price tag. They promised sparkling wine which never arrived. Take your business elsewhere, LEAVE EXPEDIA.

reviews.author: Bob K
reviews.title: A beautiful place in desperate need of better management and transparency
reviews.text:
Such a gorgeous resort with a beautiful beach and always perfect weather.  But so disorganized.
I have been there 5 or 6 times and the trouble began in 2023.  Maybe they changed management or something.
We had a reservation at Paradisus Palma Real, the Reserve, but when we arrived they couldn't find it.  I, or course, had my email confirmation.  They then told me that my reservation was actually at Falcon Resort (despite saying otherwise), next door though we would be staying at the Reserve as planned.  After much discussion we ended up with 2 sets of wrist bands, one for the Falcon restaurants and 1 for Palma Real.  I still don't know exactly what the cause of the confusion was and neither did the employees there.
That gets me to this year. This time it was to be a Junior Suite at Palma Real.  2 single or queen beds in 1 room and a sleeper sofa in the outer room.  
It started with our wrist band key bracelets being mis-programmed.  We could not get into the assigned room.  After trudging back to the registration desk our bracelets were reprogrammed but then we saw the room.  It was not a suite but rather 1 room with 2 beds and a sofa.  
After much discussion (about 40 minutes worth) they found another room.  This time it has a king size bed and a sitting area separated by a sliding door.  And you had to walk through the sitting area to get to the bathroom.  They had worn me down so we stayed there.
Not ideal for myself and my adult special needs daughter to be in one bed but so be it.  And our friend (caregiver) at least could sleep in a separate area.
Then came restaurant reservations.  They cannot be made before you get there and once you get there, forget about that night.  They are all booked.  
Our reservation was supposed to include transportation from and to the airport.  The from part was fine.  But the to part was a problem.  The hotel had contracted Otium.  They wanted to take us back to the airport 3 and 1/2 hours before our flight was to leave.  We had no bags to check and had our boarding passes.  And having my autistic daughter sit around the airport for 3 hours before our 4 1/2 hour flight would not be a good idea if it could be avoided.  They refused to alter the time despite the fact they have rides going up and back to the airport all day.  So I had to pay for a private cab.
Their evening entertainment has changed drastically.  It used to be a pretty good hour to hour and a half show.  Michael Jackson impertsonator, Elvis, acrobats, Lion King, Cats.  Now it typically is a bit of music, sometimes some dancing, one night something they passed off as acrobatics.  The theater is not used any more for the "entertainment."
This is supposed to be a luxury resort.  And in many ways it is.  I will only go return if I can be assured that my room will be up to specifications.  This means 2 rooms, each with an entrance to the bathroom.  And if it includes transportation, then actual useable transportation. 
I tried to speak with a hotel manageer a few times.  But that is not an option.  They are sequestered away. Instead there is a Guest service desk and my impression is that while the person there will not be able to do anything to assist you, he will be very patient and outwardly sympathetic as he nods his head.

reviews.author: ad202401
reviews.title: Honeymoon Disappointment
reviews.text:
Unfortunately our stay did not meet expectations.

Room
The room was nice, although you can hear everything from rooms beside and above you (bring ear plugs). We indicated it was our honeymoon and when we got our room they provided us with two double beds. When we went to the front desk they couldn’t accommodate a change until the Thursday, we didn’t think packing up that late into our stay was worth it.

Nikte Stay
The concierge isn’t worth it, they aren’t helpful and you end up doing the work yourself. The restaurant reservation system is NOT efficient, you waste an hour in line to make a dinner reservation every morning. It’s also not clear to other guests that your swim up is reserved for your room, guests in the rooms above would sit on the chairs and day bed outside of your room. 

Food
The buffet food is not good, and if you’re vegetarian you are going to be hungry; especially dinner at the buffet. The buffet pizza was good for lunch if you caught it fresh out of the oven. The Italian restaurant was the best food we ate all week. The Asian restaurant and Flora were good. There aren’t a lot of places to get a snack for lunch (you have to go to the buffet).  

Entertainment 
There is basically no night entertainment to go to, there was one show one night (in a whole week). The primary entertainment was karaoke at the sports bar. The team at the sports bar are great. The young man managing entertainment at the sports bar was great, very good with guests. There wasn’t much entertainment at the pool during the day either. 

Spa
The massages at the spa were nice and the facilities were clean and relaxing.

In summary, we were very excited for our honeymoon, but left disappointed. It wasn’t worth the cost. We didn’t have unrealistic expectations but we thought we would get atleast a “congratulations” from our concierge; we got nothing. Ive stayed at two other Melia’s and this is was my least favourite. We are already talking about a redo honeymoon elsewhere to make up for disappointment of this vacation.

reviews.author: Joanne S
reviews.title: Come for the beach…don’t come for the food
reviews.text:
This was our 4th stay here in the Reserve and very, very disappointed in food and concierge service.  (Our only bright spot was Rafael and his crew at the beach!  **they’d get a 5!)
 We had a beach spot every day and great service VS 
our concierge that we only saw for 5 minutes 2 days into our stay! 

One tasty meal in 8 days …we’ve never had that in any of our previous stays! 

Otherwise it’s a beautiful beach and venue - needs improvement on the food and service!

reviews.author: Silvana M
reviews.title: Definitely will NOT RETURN
reviews.text:
Let me start off with the positive. This resort is beautiful. The grounds are gorgeous and the beach is incredible. The rooms are also very very nice. We had a swim out room in building seven and it was perfect. Before I get into the negatives, I would like to mention a few employees, and really the only employees that were friendly and tried to make our stay more comfortable and happy. At the beach, Martin and Pedros took care of us every day. Martin prepared our beach beds every morning, and PedroS made sure to bring us water and drinks all day long.  They were always friendly and pleasant!  Our concierge Kelvin did his best to get us restaurant reservations and tried to correct many of the issues that went wrong.  In the entertainment staff, Reynaldo and Danyelo did a great job of trying to keep everybody entertained!
Now on to the negative. The food at this resort is absolutely awful. I travel every year to the Caribbean and sometimes twice a year and this is the worst food I have ever had. Two years ago I stayed at a less expensive resort in Punta Cana (the Royalton) and the food was much better there. I picked up a parasite and have been sick since returning home.  We were staying at the adults only section the reserve, so we went to their special restaurant Sante on the first night where I was served raw chicken. I cut it open to show the waiter it was raw and he took it back. He brought the same piece of chicken back to me and of course at that point I did not eat it. I had lost my appetite.  we spoke to numerous other people that were also very very unhappy with the food, and also met another couple who were actually quite sick from the food .  The only restaurant that I could say anything good about was the Japanese. The chef and the food there was good. Steakhouse don’t bother the meat is fatty and the appetizers and salad were not good. We could never get into the Mexican, as it was first come first serve so it was impossible. The restaurants are all very small so most people are forced to eat at the buffet as there is not enough seating in the restaurants. Let’s talk about the buffet. Absolutely horrible food. Either overcooked or undercooked and always cold. The chefs working at the buffet are unfriendly and can barely speak English. I would like to mention Luiz - waiter at the buffet as he was super friendly and did his best to make us happy.  Really not much food to snack on late afternoon. Thank God we had snacks in our mini bar. That’s pretty much what we survived on. Room service is decent but that’s actually where you will get the best breakfast. Very very disappointing on the food. This is not a five star resort when rating  the food.
Housekeeping was a hit and miss. We were supposed to have turn down service every night, and we only got it two out of the nights and they would forget to restock our mini bar so I would have to tell our Butler. They also forgot to restock the conditioner in our shower, and I had to call four times for them to do so . They came an hour and a half later. Terrible service at this resort and very very unfriendly staff with the exception of the people I mentioned above. Absolutely would not return!

reviews.author: sudiaz75
reviews.title: Mal servicio
reviews.text:
Pagué por un servicio prestige, con un concierge incluido el cual nunca tuve.  Todo el personal se nota desmotivado.  La variedad y calidad de la comida no es igual que antes.  En sentido general no vale la pena.
Las atenciones de Pedro en la playa fue lo unico extraordinario de la estadía.

reviews.author: Cote F
reviews.title: Aun sigo buscando el lujo ofrecido....
reviews.text:
Llegamos recién después de 10 días en hotel y la verdad que hay varias cosas que revisar antes de ir a este hotel.

En la página de Melia venden una experiencia de lujo y la verdad es que está alejado de eso. 

Si vas con niños, debes saber que el hotel no está 100% disponible para ti ya que tiene muchos sectores de adultos (mezclados con las areas comunes) y para el sector del club circle de Melia, los cuales no se puede ingresar.

Con familia, por ejemplo, solo puedes ir a 4 restoranes temáticos.

Actividades para adultos, el hotel es muerto en ese sentido, muy poco comparado con lo que ofrecen otros resorts, incluso de menor costo que este. 

Resolución de problemas nulo, tuvimos más de un problema, uno de ellos que entro un tipo X a nuestra pieza, esto debido a que la puerta no cerraba bien y nunca fue reparado, lo peor fue que la respuesta fue que "pasa más de lo que nosotros creemos", nadie fue a verificar si estábamos bien ni nada. En este sentido, agradezco a José Sepulveda, quien fue el único que mostro real intención por mejorar las cosas. El resto, nada. Se supone que hablamos con unos de los gerentes de hotel, Wladimir R. (no recuerdo su apellido), cero soluciones, cero aportes.

Si tienes hijos de 12 - 14 años hacia arriba, los llevaras al aburrimiento total. Te recomiendo otras opciones.

De los 4 restoranes temáticos que pudimos probar; asiático, mexicano, de Carnes e italiano:

El asiático un desastre lo malo y poca variedad.

El de carnes, Mina, es el mejor, rica comida y buena atención; Carlos Rincon, Orlando Morel, Miguel Mena, Kendy Castro, Olvi Almonte, Jesus Robles y Jose Eusebio. 

Los otros dos, nada del otro mundo.

Cosas que rescato:

Si bien el buffet no es muy variado, pero la comida es rica, también la atención de algunos es gentil, Sandra Combo, Yudit Ciprian, Rikie y Daniel (chef que habla como pato donals) siempre muy gentil con nuestro hijo.
