Kid Zone; el personal humano aca es muy bueno, mi hijo de 6 años disfruto mucho de las actividades. (poco difundidas por el hotel). Además, se notaba el cariño de las personas al trabajar con niños; aca la lista para agradecer es grande:
Jesus, Sujeidy, Alexandra, Tania, Yessica, Jennifer, Johana Gonzalez, Marta, Johana Santana y Yesmeidy. Si se me va alguno, perdón.

Jesús, un gusto conocerte compadre!! gracias por todo!!!

En el bar de la playa, muchas gracias al equipo de Luis y Jorge y Arisleida y Teofilo en servicio de piscina.

Resumen; el hotel no da lo que ofrece, pero el problema es de arriba, gerencia, cero solución, cero interés por el bienestar del pasajero. Seria pregunta para ellos es, ¿que entienden por experiencia de lujo? que es lo que venden...

Las personas que nombramos, son personas que realmente quieren que si pases unas buenas vacaciones.

Dato aparte el club, circle Melia, una pérdida de tiempo.

Seguramente, la respuesta sera, que la próxima vez sera mejor, etc etc etc. Le respondo ahora, les da lo mismo, se los dije y no cambiaron nada.

Sobre la puntación, 4.8, ojo, que algunos presionan mucho porque les des una buena recomendación.

reviews.author: Norberto R. Magdalena
reviews.title: Paraíso perdido
reviews.text:
Hace 14 años estuve en este conjunto En total con mi visita reciente han sido cuatro veces que los visité. No recordaba haber tenido una experiencia tan mala como en esta oportunidad, el conjunto arquitectónico es estupendo muy hermoso un diseño muy bien logrado,  perfecto y con un mantenimiento excepcional. Las playas es lo que hay que esperar del Caribe, aguas templadas, claras y en esta época del año con tal vez un poco más de sargazo de lo deseable pero es la naturaleza y en Punta Cana todo muy bien con muchas actividades y buen servicio de los camareros de playa. 
Lo que este año me impresionó y me decepcionó y no regresaré sin investigarlo bien de qué se trata y qué me ofrecen a un “All inclusive” en el cual la calidad de la comida y de la bebida en los restaurantes nocturnos ha llegado a niveles tan bajos 
Excepto el Japones “a la plancha” el resto es comida impasable. 
El personal es muy simpático pero no pueden más porque el sistema los aplasta y tienen poca preparación de dialogar con los turistas
Además me impresionó en forma sumamente negativa estando en un país de habla española que lo primero que hacen es tratar de comunicarse en inglés cuando en realidad deberían empezar con el español y si el turista no lo entiende entonces cambiar a inglés, pero la transición es muy lenta Además intentaron durante tres horas venderme el producto Meliá Circle que es una especie de tiempo compartido y fue un tiempo perdido, es obvio que Melia lo que le interesa es beneficios pero lo que brinda al público que no está dentro de su círculo brinda muy poca calidad. Allí no volveré y repito investiguen los detalles del All inclusive antes de comprometerse y reservar

reviews.author: Debbra F
reviews.title: Not our finest vacation stay
reviews.text: It took 6 hours & 4 calls for housekeeping to clean up a broken bottle in our room.  Room did not have security chain/lock. Maids entered room freely. Making dinner reservations was difficult. Most Padded chaises were ripped on the beach.  Food was mediocre at best except for Flora, Santi for breakfast and lunch, and the hibachi Our concierge begged us to attend a 45 minute spiel several times, otherwise she was very helpful navigating and making reservations. Several servers asks us to post a review even though we had just sat  down.  Plenty of shade at pool and beach. Hotel was pristine.  Service in most restaurants was inconsistent. Mains were served before appetizer on multiple occasions.  Many times food came out cold

reviews.author: Gary G
reviews.title: Great property, great rooms, but that's about it. Go to Cancun or Costa Rica, you'll thank me for it later.
reviews.text:
Property, weather, and rooms were great.  Only all inclusive hotel where you'll actually lose weight. Reservation process for restaurants is terrible, need to get in line each day by 8:00 am or you'll never get a reservation. Restaurants are literally half empty, yet people are waiting for two hours to get in. Make sure to eat at the right times or you'll go hungry. Buffett is terrible.
A ton of staff, but all standing around doing nothing. No beach service. Constantly getting bugged on the beach by beggars and people trying to sell you stuff. 
Avoid any tours, huge mistake. We did the ATV tour and it was awful. 5 hour trip for 20 minutes on the ATV.  They take you to places so you can buy stuff.  Went to the beach, which was nice, but you are constantly getting harassed by locals. Once the trip was over, they leave you at the ATV station for 45 minutes so you can buy photos and food, while the busses that take you back to the hotel are parked around the corner.   Seems like they do everything to tow the line of honesty. Ordered room service, never showed. Don't answer the phones, either. They're just not quite ready for tourism, everything is just off. Go to Mexico and maybe visit the DR in about 10 years. They need someone to come in and clean up the operations.

reviews.author: Marty G
reviews.title: Try a different hotel, maybe a different island.
reviews.text: Hotel facilities are decent, nothing wrong there and the place is clean.   The employees are not very friendly, nor accommodating.  They ‘lost’ my suitcase I gave them waiting on my room…..after 4 calls, I finally went down and got the bag myself.  After dinner one night, I came back to salamanders or lizards in my room and called to ask for help removing them.  Called 2 more times, no one ever came so I did what I could and slept that night wondering where they were running.  The food was horrible, and I mean horrible.  The only thing eatable were some of the rolls and a couple of the deserts, the rest was terrible, mind bogglingly bad.  They couldn’t even make a good omelet or pancakes!   The employees walk right by you, never say hello, and many of them stand around on their phones.  I will never go back there and not a big fan of the D.R., I think there are better places to go where you can be around friendly employees who are glad you are there spending money.  One bright spot was the transportation service that hauled me in and back to PUJ, Amstar was their name and they were excellent.

reviews.author: Aman W
reviews.title: Very poor service and buffet
reviews.text:
The issues really started upon when we landed. We had booked a private transfer that didn't have enough room for us.  Then once we got to the hotel, upon check in we were told they had overbooked the hotel and our king bed swim-up suite was not available. We had to spend the first night away from our friends on the other side of the resort in a double bed room on the 2nd floor.  After a lot of arguing, we were given an upgrade for the rest of the stay from a junior suite to a master suite but it meant we had to take that room away from another couple we were travelling with.  They were forced to stay in the wrong room for 2 nights as a result.  It was a complete mess even though we had called multiple times requesting our rooms to be close.  We were told multiple times we'd get a refund and have yet to receive it.  Every time we asked, we were provided with a different response (sometimes it is on the way, sometimes it will take 2-3 business days and finally at check out, we were told it will take 15-20 days).  We lost our faith in the team at Melia in whatever they said to us.

When we finally did get our swim up suite, the water was always freezing cold.  Although we'd expect it to be a bit cool - it was often empty as a result of the temperature.  We forced ourselves to stay in as long as we could.  The rooms also didn't have much privacy as you could hear everything in the other rooms.

The evening restaurants were good but the buffet at times was inedible.  I eat meat but my wife is vegetarian and she had almost no options.  She often had to resort to eating veggies and cheese pizza, every single day.  At lunch it was almost impossible to get her food as the only 'a la carte' restaurant, Kanna had a false menu.  The descriptions of their food items was all incorrect.  The 'popcorn' chicken were the nuggets from the buffet.  The 'NYC' hot dog was the breakfast sausage from the buffet with liquid cheese.  The nachos were stale.  The burger squirted this ooze that landed in the water and completely turned me off from eating it.  The menu needs to change so that people know what exactly they are getting. 

The coffee bar was very limited, it was hard just to get a basic iced coffee.  We just resorted to espressos.

Overall, we did not have the greatest experience.  

Our concierge tried his best but we could tell he didn't have much power to do much.  When we tried expressing our concerns to the front desk, we kept getting different answers.

reviews.author: Rey0151
reviews.title: Paradisus #10
reviews.text: The only thing good was the room clean and big. Worker named Teofilo at the Pool was very good, I will not recommend this place to anyone. Is not the 1st time that we visit Punta Cana must if the hotels there are very nice and people friendly but not in The Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: joaofilho333
reviews.title: Decepção
reviews.text:
Fomos muito mal atendidos no check-in. 
Um show de grosserias. 
Não tinham disponibilidade dos quartos. 
Tentaram nos mandar para um hotel inferior e depois nos colocaram em quartos de categoria diferente.

reviews.author: bolivar22
reviews.title: Una total decepción
reviews.text: Soy fan de la cadena Melia, sobretodo de los hoteles Paradisus. Estuve hace 10 años en este hotel y volvi en enero 2024. La verdad que la calidad de los productos que ofrecen ha bajado un mundo. Para tomar una bebida de buena calidad tienes que ir al bar del Lobby, el resto de los bares ofrecen pura basura, jugos artificiales y licores baratos. La comida de los buffet abundante y variada pero al chef hay que cambiarlo,porque la comida no tiene nada de sabor y la carne no hay quien la mastique de tan dura, a veces pensaba que estaba cruda. Sinceramente, he visitado hoteles mucho mas barato con mejores alimentos y bebidas. Una pena que esos cambios de administracion dañen tan buen hotel. Una pena

reviews.author: J R
reviews.title: Enjoyable- pity about Melia Circle
reviews.text:
Stayed in September, really enjoyed our stay, food was good, Mina was a standout. The room, swim up was nice, room clean comfortable. Service was OK,  room was serviced either late afternoon or evening otherwise no issues at all. However the constant badgering about Melia Circle was beyond irritating, all we wanted was to enjoy our time there in peace and quiet. Eventually our concierge vanished after explaining to him that we were not interested in timeshare or vacation clubs. This is something Melia really has to look at, we are your guests and not there to be conned into some or other club.

The level of service after refusing to attend a presentation was ridiculous, to the point that I will never stay at any Melia property again. We are gusts not just a source of self enrichment. This how you ruin people’s vacation.

BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: lucifashion
reviews.title: Intragável
reviews.text: Uma viagem desde Madrid, de 9H de voo, para chegar a um hotel 5 estrelas e ter uma experiência completamente desagradável . Não tínhamos as camas para os meus filhos feita! Reclamamos e a atitude de solucionar foi lenta e nada simpática! Havia ruído constante do ar condicionado exterior. O serviço de comida foi muito mau. Falta de limpeza. A carne no restaurante temático Mina sabia literalmente a petróleo! Após reclamarmos, até porque tínhamos crianças, o gerente e o cozinheiro afirmou ser normal devido ao processo de preparação! Muito Grave. Enfim uma experiência muito má e frustrante até porque a localização e as instalações físicas do Hotel teriam tudo para ser uma passagem de ano memorável. Mas a qualidade da equipa, principalmente, os seus gerentes não estão a altura das suas funções.

reviews.author: linzzzz2024
reviews.title: Beautiful place, terrible service.
reviews.text:
Place is beautiful with a lovely beach front.  However. it has some of the worst quality of service I have ever experienced.  One day our room was not cleaned and when we asked housekeeping, they just shrugged.  No apology. 
The second day, we ordered room service and it never arrived. 
No one picks up the phone. 
Need to make reservations for the restaurants, but getting one is super difficult. Got one for 10pm one night, only to endure grumpy waiter service.  
In room dining food makes McDonald’s look like a Michelin star.

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Wish it was better
reviews.text: Wish we had better service and restaurant experience. Make sure your hotel transfer is confirmed, was not a welcoming experience and the food at restaurants were pretty average. Great pools and beach experience. Golf course was accessible and great resort course.

reviews.author: Zips
reviews.title: Meh, won’t come back
reviews.text: Here right now. Room is a solid 9/10 even with a small issue first day. Food is a 3/10 with it being a daily battle to just get a dinner reservation when and where you want it. Pools and beach are 6/10 - even though we upgraded to “Nitke” we were still kept out of certain areas and the pool is ice cold.  But the biggest detractor is the hard pitch on timeshares which come at you multiple times a day. No does not mean no to them.  For this and general customer service attitude I’d give a 3/10.  So, good to get out of freezing cold for a few days but we won’t be back.

reviews.author: ledalumbrado
reviews.title: Nos vamos bastante decepcionados, esperábamos mucho más
reviews.text: Somos clientes habituales de la línea paradisus de melia y nos vamos muy insatisfechos de nuestra estadía, necesitan mejorar mucho la calidad de la comida y esforzarse más en la contratación del personal, un hotel como este debe ofrecer algo más de actividades, teatro, deportes, gestión del cliente, recepción acorde con la categoría del hotel, música en la piscina, alegría en general, esto es Dominicana señores y parece un mausoleo

reviews.author: Tourist52064651327
reviews.title: melia 2
reviews.text: Hotel à déconseiller ! Très bruyant sauf en zone adults only (lorsque elle est respectée) Restaurants nuls ! sauf celui en zone adults only ou sinon les modestes buffets. Transfert Inclus mais pas respecté (nous avons dû nous payer le taxi) Bref ne mérite pas 5* (tout au plus 3* cause restos et promesses non tenues) les clients sont mal considérés dans l'ensemble

reviews.author: 1957steve_11
reviews.title: Braclet system not told about before going
reviews.text: Rooms very spacious and clean beach and pool stunning but that's where it ends! The bracelet system I wish we had been informed about the green band is not worth the paper it's written on! Also being told by JJ as he called himself said we should be upgraded to a higher colour as we came from Europe.........total lie! To book a restaurant you have to be really lucky otherwise it's the buffet the whole holiday! Plus the waiter in the Mexican restaurant was really rude to my wife and son as they don't speak fluid Spanish even though they tried I was not well so stayed in the room wish I had been there! Theo at the pool was a shinning light serving drinks to us a really lovely man but my point is check about the banding system otherwise you see amazing restaurants you cannot use!

reviews.author: Pamela M
reviews.title: Es necesario supervisar a todo el personal desde la alta gerencia hasta el maletero.
reviews.text:
Es desagradable que el personal sin excepción sea grosera y no tenga vocación para el servicio y ni si quiera intente aparentar tenerlo, en su gran mayoría hacen caras, contestan de mala manera, o te ignoran. Se necesita supervisión física y constante en todo el hotel, utilicen el recurso del clientes fantasmas local y extranjero así se darán cuenta como sus colaboradores tratan a los clientes o huéspedes sobre todo si el huésped es local.

Fue totalmente una experiencia desagradable, otra cuestión son los recursos disponibles se supone que si el hotel está abierto para 400 personas debe estar capacitado al menos para 410 personas los recursos siempre son insuficientes, deben darle las herramientas necesarias al empleado para que desempeñe su función de la mejor manera, nunca hay carritos nunca hay góndolas, nunca hay nada cuando lo necesitas.

reviews.author: nichole331
reviews.title: Not worth the money- Go to Mexico!
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying the resort is beautiful and well kept (clean). The beaches here are pretty with clear waters and white sand. 
Thats where it ends! The food at this resort is deplorable. The Mina steakhouse was inedible, along with the Lunch Box buffet. Room service was a 4 out of 10. I would give all the other restaurants a C minus. There is no where to eat except one tiny restaurant by the pools with 8 items on the menu for breakfast and lunch, or the buffet. We are not buffet people and wanted to sit down for lunch. The App stated there was several of the dinner restaurants open for lunch everyday (rotating) but when we got there, the staff said the app is out of date. 2 out of 7 of us got violently ill while we were there from the food and/or drinks. Not sure which. 
The staff is great as long as you are tipping well. We spent a lot of money tipping just so we could get an average experience. We are very seasoned travelers, usually taking 3-4 vacations a year for the past 20 years. I would not come back or recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: familytravelfl2023
reviews.title: Only go for the kids club
reviews.text:
Overall the whole experience was nothing like we expected. You pay good money for "All Inclusive Luxury" and get pretty much nothing from it: the service is super slow at best, the food is low quality, the drinks have no alcohol and even getting a restaurant reservation is stressful. You can never find a spot in a restaurant, especially if you are more than just 2 people. Not to mention that restaurants might even be total empty but will never let you in if you don't have a reservation. The whole system is rigged to prevent you from enjoying those things that you "think" you paid for when you are sold an all inclusive experience.
The ONLY thing we were 100% happy with was the kids' club: our kids were always having a great time there.

reviews.author: Alex R
reviews.title: Very nice beach; poor buffet and guests complaints resolution
reviews.text:
We stayed in Paradisus Palma Real All-Inclusive resort from 11.11 thru 11.18.23.
It was our eights vacation in Dominican Republic, plus probably 30+ all-inclusive vacation overall. The main reason for picking this resort was walking by it this past spring, when we stayed in Secrets Punta Cana. We noticed many available beach and pool chairs under the palapas and umbrellas, which is very important to us for providing shade. Below is our detailed review:
1.       Check-in.
We arrived at the resort around 1:15PM on Saturday, Nov. 11th. Typically, at the front desk guests are offered a refreshing tropical welcome drink, but not this time. Not a big deal. Our room number 3218 has been already assigned, but was not ready yet, and we were told to come back at 3PM. We went to the buffet, had a lunch, then spent some time exploring the property. At 3PM we came back to the front desk: the room was not ready and we were told to come back in 30 minutes. That did not sound good, but we agreed. In 30 minutes, at around 3:30PM (that was 2 hours 15 minutes from the arrival) we were back. And they told us that the room was not ready. At which point I raised heat, asked for the manager and requested help. The other guy came talking with us and in literally 2 minutes they said: O.K., the room is ready, you can move in. What? Just 2 minutes ago it was not, and after I complained, it became instantly available? That made no sense at all. The next day one of the employees said that their occupancy was at 47%, which could not possibly explain the issue.
2.       Move-in.
We moved in the room. It was nice, clean and did not smell mildew, like typically in other resorts. Plenty of various lights and power outlets. The A/C worked perfectly fine throughout the entire stay. We did a walk-thru and noticed that the mini-bar chiller was dripping water all around and there was a big puddle on the floor. We saw a cleaning lady in the corridor and showed her the leak. She mopped it off and then pulled the stand with the chiller and other supplies off the wall. As it appeared, the mini bar was unplugged from the wall outlet, who knows when and by whom. She plugged it back in and it started working. See below for more concerns.
3.       Beach and pool.
That was the absolutely best part of our stay. The beach at that part of the island is gorgeous. And this resort does have a lot of empty chairs under the palapas at all times of the day. I am not sure why that is. Maybe, they just have much more of them than other resorts. Or maybe, their occupancy was low.
4.       Bars.
No complaints there. A good selection of top shelf liquors. The bartenders were nice and efficient.
5.       Food.
This is our main complaint. There are two buffets: The Lunch Box (larger) and the Malva (smaller). The first two days the Lunch Box was open, but then they closed it for three days for some sort of maintenance and all guests switched to Malva. It is hard to describe it. The space is so-so-so small, the counters so limited and crammed. We saw frequent lines to get food, sometimes 15-20 people waiting their turn. And food quality? Pretty bad. One day me and my wife had grilled fish, potatoes and thin noodles. She could not even cut that piece of fish with the table knife, that’s how hard it was. The potato pieces were very undercooked. And the same with noodles: they even felt crunchy. 
All food was lukewarm. Apparently, they did not have good warmers to keep it hotter.
We asked for a chef and the restaurant captain brought him out. We pointed all problems to him.
Service in the restaurants. Half of the time nobody would ask or bring us a glass of water. And what’s up with salt and pepper? There were no salt and pepper shakers on the tables. If you ask for them, the waiter would turn around, go back inside somewhere and in a couple minutes bring out a few small packets. And all this time you are waiting with your food getting even colder.
They were constantly out of utensils at the tables and at the serving stations. One time we came to the grilled vegies station where they had about a dozen trays available and just one tongs to pick up the food. Again, I had to find somebody and ask for more tongs.
We went to Flora restaurant one night and it was fine.
6.       Attention to resolving problems.
There was an odd issue with one of the men restrooms on the beach. On the second day, when I used it for the first time, I immediately noticed that the door was hanging crooked and would not open or close properly. When I looked, two out of three door hinges were broken and just the top hinge was holding the door from falling and possibly injuring somebody, which is a huge hotel liability. I saw a hotel employee with a name tag (did not get his name) walking by and showed him the door. He said that he would take care of it. Every day after that I checked the door and it has not been fixed. And wouldn’t the cleaning personal, who cleaned it at least 2 times every day, see it and make somebody aware of this pretty dangerous situation? Apparently, nobody cared. So, after 3 days I took a few pictures (see attached) and went talking to the front desk. The manager agreed to walk to the beach with me. He saw the problem, and on day 4 after my initial complaint the hinges were kind of fixed. I accidentally stopped by it when the technician was finishing fixing. When I asked him, he said that to get it fixed properly, the entire door jamb has to be replaced. I don’t know if or when it may be done.
7.       Conclusion: it was a disappointment, except for nice weather and an excellent beach. But we will not return to this resort and cannot recommend it to other people.
Our feeling is that we kind of wasted our money.

reviews.author: Darryl Q
reviews.title: A la probably not restaurants
reviews.text:
We are 3 days into our stay and are very disappointed.

If you don’t like a la carte restaurants,  love eating buffet almost every dinner then this is the resort for you.

You either can’t book a a la carte,  can only book after 9pm, or they book you at an adults only when you told them you have kids. (Happen to a family member and their concierge booked it) 

They either are understaffed, or are doing this on purpose to make more money.  Either way unforgivable.

It’s currently looking like we might only do two restaurant for our 7 night stay.  And we had bribe our way into those reservations.  I don’t blame the staff for this,  management needs to get their sh&$ together.

Other issues,  
allowing kids in the gym.   

Kids in room beneath us and we are in adults only room area.
Room not made on third day. 
Shuttle from airport swerving around like a madman and almost hitting other cars.
Front desk check in person was new,  didn’t speak much English and we had to drag info out of him(to confirm if room was ready or not and when to come back)

Overall many staff also don’t look very happy.  

Needless to say we will never come back here and would warn anyone thinking of going.

reviews.author: smuise
reviews.title: Dismal service
reviews.text: Travellers beware…. The service here is pretty dismal. Me and my husband are halfway through our trip with other members of my family. We are usually pretty easy going travellers but all of our family are having nothing but problems. Rooms not being made being one of them. We cannot get reservations at all at any of the restaurants. Even if we try to split the family into groups of 4. Some members even paid for the upgraded spots that get a concierge and they have been useless. For example, booking a table at an adult only restaurant for my sister her hubby and their KID. They got so much grief at the restaurant even though my sister had physical proof that the concierge booked it for them. I paid extra for the adults only section only to have kids all over the place.

reviews.author: Mateus K
reviews.title: Decepção!!! Péssimo para trazer crianças!!!
reviews.text: Péssimo atendimento, poucos garçons e uma minoria atende bem. Várias áreas restritas, algumas não podem crianças, outras só para sócios, o tal do The Circle, que está sempre vazio. Se for Nikte, não serve para nada, tem apenas a ver com o tipo de quarto, com piscina ou vista do mar, privilégios se pagar, por massagem, por exemplo. Para conseguir um refri em algum bar será necessário fazer fila para receber um copo pequeno cheio de gelo e dois dedos de bebida. Praia boa, estrutra do hotel boa, mas antiga, e a tal reforma, tinta em cima de tudo, com ferrugem nos detalhes. Dois dias com duas pias entupidas, fazem sinal que estão ligando para alguém, e as pias continuam do mesmo jeito. Sofá cama para a nossa filha de 3 anos é mais duro que um tatame, pedimos alguma coisa para tornar mais macio, tiraram o edredom, daí tem de chamar de novo e pedir outro. Boato de estranhamento entre os funcionários, alguns não falam nem o espanhol, e não têm paciência para escutar, empurram qualquer solução que acham conviniente para eles e somem. Primeiro dia choveu, não tinha como ficar na praia, sentamos no restaurante de praia, nos escorraçaram do restaurante porque não íamos almoçar, pegamos cadeiras e sentamos no único lugar possível, reclamações de todos os lados porque os hóspedes estão sempre “atrapalhando” neste hotel, somos sempre inconvenientes. Cigarro liberado indiscriminadamente no hotel, impossível apreciar a comida sem fumaça de cigarro, mesmo com crianças no local, tenho alergia, passo espirrando. E assim vai… haja paciência!!! Melia e Paradisus nunca mais!!!

reviews.author: Alfonso
reviews.title: Barco a la deriva
reviews.text: Hotel en general bien pero con muchos problemas con el personal. Hemos estado en muchos hoteles todo incluido a lo largo del caribe pero este está entre los peores con respecto a servicio y procedimientos. Cada dia tuvimos varios problemas e incluso tuvieron que ofrecernos un upgrade gratuito para intentar compensar los muchos problemas sufridos, infinita lentitud en ciertos servicios, vino del todo incluido imbebible, descoordinación total entre departamentos, y muy poca falta de trabajar en la mayoría de los empleados. El hotel carecía de director en la semana que estuvimos y se notaba, barco a la deriva. Stephanie, la guest service manager genial, el subdirector bastante ineficaz ante el ultimo problema que tuvimos. Pondremos una reclamación en la central en mallorca. Próximas vacaciones, seguramente con otra compañía hotelera, tipo iberostar, barcelo o similar.

reviews.author: João Paulo
reviews.title: Acredito ter resorts melhores em Punta Cana.
reviews.text:
Nossa má experiência começou logo no checkin. 

Chegamos no hotel às 17h, nos levaram para a área do Circle para o checkin, esperamos lá por volta de 30 min e assim que fomos atendidos, como não tinhamos o programa do Meliá, então nos direcionaram para a recepção principal. 

No checkin online preenchemos que estávamos em lua de mel e isso nem foi mencionado e falamos disso só com o Concierge no dia seguinte. 

Quando conseguimos entrar no quarto depois de 1h da nossa chegada, não era a opção de cama escolhida (king size), voltamos para a recepção, não tinha quarto disponível, ficamos no hall de entrada até às 20h e quando entramos no quarto, o frigobar estava vazio.

O pior de tudo foi que, devido as chuvas, o nosso quarto começou a goteirar. Solicitamos a mudança de quarto, mas foi informado que não tinha outro quarto disponível. Ficamos 3 dias no quarto com goteiras por todo banheiro e corredor, a manutenção chegou a olhar o quarto e deixou o teto aberto por todos os dias. 

Nos disseram que não tinha quarto disponível, mas fomos em baixa temporada e o hotel estava vazio. 

Tão vazio, que ficamos 5 noites e 6 dias e não tivemos a oportunidade de jantar nos restaurantes do hotel porque estavam fechados, como o Flora de comida típica do país. 

Em relação aos bares, a Heineken acabava em todos eles, parecia que o estoque era limitado a 5 latas e precisávamos ficar andando no hotel atrás de bares abertos e com a cerveja disponível.  

Em algumas noites, até a cerveja Presidente acabava, e nos serviam Presidente Light. Ou seja, começámos a noite bebendo Heineken, o estoque acabava, passavamos pra Presidente, o estoque acabava, e por fim, passavamos para Presidente Light. 

Por fim, no checkin não nos foi informado que era preciso agendar o transfer de ida para o aeroporto com 24h de antecedência, e como não fizemos, tivemos que pagar pelo transfer para o aeroporto ($30). Isso porque fizemos a reserva pelo app Meliá que diz que o transfer é gratuito. 

Mesmo assim, tivemos que pagar porque não nos foi informado do procedimento com o transfer. Ficamos no hall em torno de 2h tentando resolver a situação, mas ninguém conseguiu ajudar e tivemos que pagar por um serviço que disseram ser gratuito. 

Pra piorar, devido a situação que ficamos no quarto durante a estadia, o gerente quis nos pagar o valor do transfer para o aeroporto mas para isso precisaria assinar um termo de acordo que me proibia de fazer as avaliações negativas, o que achei um absurdo.

reviews.author: Mamyteamo06
reviews.title: Creo que para el costo deben mejorar o bajarlo
reviews.text: Entrénar el personal  ya Que tienen faltas de respeto con sus empleados, bajar el costo de resort por hay mejores que cuestan menor y la críticas llovían, por tan pocas cosas que hay nada de niño todo lo a mismo

reviews.author: Reece S
reviews.title: A very unhappy group of employees
reviews.text: First, let me say that the resort is beautiful, but the majority of the staff are unhappy, unhelpful, and uninterested in the guests.  And, don’t try to get any change on the property.  Nobody has change.  The store on site only takes US dollars.  Why?  The excursions are overpriced.  The Concierge only makes dinner reservations.  Not that difficult.  They hide the good alcohol.  The rooms have bed bugs.  My girlfriend got tore up with bites.  The food is pretty good.  The best food I have had in an all inclusive. The biggest problem in this resort is the staff.   They haven’t figured out that the tourists are their life’s blood.  If you are booking a trip, try Thailand, Mexico, Costa Rica, Japan, or Hawaii.  While on vacation, I am in a great mood and I don’t want to deal with grumpy people.  It’s a shame since this place looks like paradise.  I would like to thank Victor and Luis, two great bartenders.  Laura, a great hostess.  Jonathan, another great bartender.  A handful of really good employees out of a thousand.

reviews.author: yalbe002
reviews.title: Breathtaking  hotel, terrible service
reviews.text:
There are so many reason’s that I would need a voice memo to give my opinion. 
First of all we get to the lobby for check in and Carlos from the front desk was lacking every single rule in the customer service handbook. After sitting an hour in the lobby and requesting for a manager and traveling for the last 8 hrs with 2 kids, we finally got Marcos to resolve our reservation issue and provide a reasonable resolution. 
The hotel is beautiful, i love the fact that is open lobby, private beach, nice rooms, beautiful architecture and amenities, however, the service and training doesn’t not match the hotel itself. 

Only restaurant were I felt at a high end hotel was the Italian restaurant called Mescalzone and the Asian restaurant called Tokimeku. The service was amazing and the food was elite standard. Everwhere else is a mess. You have to request the server 5 times the same thing and they still get the order wrong. I just which the service would do this hotel justice, because it ia indeed a beautiful hotel. 

We even got robbed by the maid doing the room service. She stole my sisters bag including her airpods, perfume and some jewelry. We were able to get everything back because the airpods had location services and the hotel security team and police were able to confront the robber at her house and get everything back. I just wished things would have gone differently from the chek in, to service, to not experiencing being robbed at our own room. Otherwise this would be a five star hotel because the hotel itself os breathtaking.

reviews.author: belkisabad
reviews.title: sobrevaluado
reviews.text: Nos hicieron un down grade por no terer disponibilidad de habitaciones en el primer piso (aunque llamamos para hacer el requerimiento con anterioridad porque teniamos una persona discapacidad) poca variedad en el bufette y muchas restricciones para hacer reserva en los restaurantes

reviews.author: Vess S
reviews.title: Definitely will not be coming back
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort for 7 days. The drinks were mostly watered down, the food tasted the same throughout all the restaurants.
I even noticed when the chefs prepare the food, they dont use gloves.
Its hard to communicate with the staff, they dont speak clear english.
They did not have many daily activities. You have to make reservations for the restaurants, the Italian restaurant was either always closed or too full.
We had a miscommunication with Patricia from reservations: she made dinner reservation for us at 8:30. Once we got to dinner at the Italian restaurant at 8:30, they told us our reservation was for 6:00.
The staff was incredibly rude, especially Fauslo and Dionys from the Italian restaurant, they were not accommodating at all and we had a horrible experience because Patrica made a mistake on our reservation time.
Also, at the pool closest to our room, the staff tried to steal $20.00 from me because I asked if we can use their floaty for the pool. Those floats are free to use for guests and they tried to steal from us. The rooms are also so far away from the ocean and restaurants. We will not be staying here ever again. We rented two rooms, You would assume service would be top notch, Unfortunately  it was not.

reviews.author: chriskitchens2023
reviews.title: Did not meet expectations
reviews.text:
Overall - Well below expectations for an all-inclusive resort.
Getting service and the actual service at the pools, beach, and some restaurants were hard to get and most given were with minimum effort.
Seemed like a low occupancy at the hotel but poor service to the guests.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos V
reviews.title: Si tienes niños o no perteneces al club Circle ni te lo plantees o te arrepentirás...
reviews.text: Somos una familia compuesta por dos adultos, dos niños y clientes Melia desde hace catorce años y Platinum desde hace nueve años. Teníamos muchas ganas de volver al caribe tras la pandemia, pero con una familia de cuatro no es barato y además teníamos especial interés en ir al Paradisus Palma Real porque lo habíamos visto paseando en varias ocasiones y nos gustaba. Hotel totalmente enfocado a adultos y a clientes que pertenecen al club Circle. Si no perteneces a esos dos grupos de viajeros no vayas, porque te vas a arrepentir desde el minuto uno. No es la primera vez que viajamos a Punta Cana, ya lo hemos hecho en cinco ocasiones con anterioridad y seis a Riviera Maya, vamos que experiencia en esa zona y saber que nos vamos a encontrar de sobras. El hotel en general está bien, es bonito, amplias habitaciones, piscina y playa muy bonitas... pero ahí acaba todo. El buffet es de un hotel de la zona, pero bastante más caro. Todos los días los mismos platos, comida básica de comedor de colegio, algún pescado, algo de pollo o cerdo (ternera con suerte por las noches) hamburguesas, pizzas...  eso sí arroz banco cocido, yuca, plátano y abichuelas no faltan... ¿alguién va a un hotel todo incluido a comer arroz blanco y yuca?... sin comentarios. Los camareros o le sueltas € por adelantado o no vuelven ni a dirigirte la palabra. Algún responsable del hotel debería explicarles que en España se da propina cuando se termina el servicio y si te lo has ganado (atención, simpatía...) y no antes para que así puedas hacer tu trabajo como Dios manda, porque sino lo haces pasan a modo robot y pasas a ser un fantasma para ellos, como sino existieras. La limpieza deja mucho que desear en casi todas las zonas. Cuando nos fuimos del hotel, había pelos en el suelo de la habitación para hacer dos pelucas... en una semana no han barrido ni nada por el estilo la habitación, se limitaban a rellenar el minibar, hacer las camas y una limpieza supersónica a la ducha. Los adultos y los del club Circle tienen zonas, restaurantes, bares, piscinas, zona de playa y piscina (pero si ya tienen una para ellos porque también en la piscina general, no lo entiendo) exclusivas para ellos, es más, en la única zona disponible de playa para los mortales y familias con niños la primera fila de hamacas también está reservada exclusivamente para ellos, de locos!!!. Lo peor de todo, lo decepcionados que han quedado los dos niños ya que tenían puestas mucha ilusión y expectativas en este viaje.

reviews.author: dra claudia p
reviews.title: Muy mal nivel culinario y de solución de problemas
reviews.text:
Bonitas instalaciones y habitaciones
Lo que es pésimo es todo el servicio especialmente en los restaurantes
Mini bar con snacks sin reposición diaria. NO se proporcionó licor en el mini bar como se indicó cuando se reservó. El servicio de atención al cliente es horrible. Las reservas a los restaurantes es una broma. Hay que rogar por cada día que reservamos y lo peor es que la comida de los restaurantes es de nivel regular. Varias cosas del menú no las tienen y otras las cambian sin preguntar  
Al personal no le importa. Mienten y tratan de cubrir los problemas con una falsa amabilidad ya que no resuelven nada. Entretenimiento muy pobre. Gaste su dinero en un resort que lo apreciará como huésped porque este lugar no lo hará. Actúan como si hubieras hecho algo mal cuando claramente los errores y el mal servicio están en ellos. El supervisor no se responsabiliza por los numerosos contratiempos. No se disculpan ni intentan averiguar qué se necesita para mejorar su estadía.
Es lamentable como ha caído el nivel en un hotel que solía ser de los mejores

reviews.author: YG4671
reviews.title: Nikte rooms (premium swimups) are not worth it
reviews.text:
We reserved Nikte rooms (swimups which are supposed to be very good). Were were able to go to our rooms until AFTER 5:30pm. We never meet our "concierge" (NOT even a call) . Minibars were empty and even when they said they would be serviced, we didn't have drinking water at 12AM; we called service room and they never sent anybody. In this hotel you don't have a 24 bar so not having drinking water in your room is outrageous.
You could hear a TV at 6:30 from the other room (the door between us is like a piece of paper).
The swimup pool was almost empty and we were asked not to use it until they fix it (well we couldn't use it for a day, and these been swimups, makes zero sense). The "destination inclusive" included as part of these rooms: staff was not aware of what was included, they never offered spa services. I have been at this hotel 4 times; but for sure this is the last one...

reviews.author: Luz del Carmen P
reviews.title: Muy bello paisaje, además empleados poco amables, parecían temporeros, es decir no tenían mucho servicios al cliente...
reviews.text: La comida no muy buena, sin sazón, mucha carne y sin sabor, obviamente hablo del bufete, el bar cierra temprano, luego no hay nada que hacer, no hacen show, aburrido, podría decir más pero me lo conservo.. gracias

reviews.author: Tamara Pilishvili
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Facilities 3: we stayed at the reserve ( adults only section and it comes with a concierge) and the room was ok: clean, looked recently renovated, cleaned daily 
Def not 5 stars as advertised Mini fridge was not working: we asked through our concierge to replace, took a day and they replaced with a fridge with marginally better performance (our waters stayed slightly cool during the entire stay)
Service 4: staff helpful and friendly but they can not and should not be held accountable for poor management 
Rafael was helping us at the beach, had our chairs and towels ready every morning, and made sure we had drinks throughout our stay
Our concierge Juan Castillo made sure we had dinner reservations every night and responded to all our requests 
Food 0-1: terrible! Not sure how they manage to screw up even simple dishes. Restaurants advertise seafood dishes but once you sit down, the waiters have to start by telling you that they ran out of every seafood option on the menu ( and this happened repeatedly at every restaurant); food was bland and inedible. The staff kept up with orders and service on days when the restaurants were not busy but as soon as the places fill up, kitchen staff were clearly not capable of keeping up (I waited 45 for my fish which came completely over cooked and dry)
The worst part of this experience: On day 1, they tried to rope us into buying the membership for Melia. I turn the request down after booking reservations but upon arrival, our concierge pretty much begged us to show up for a presentation (apparently staff get penalized if they are not able to convince guests to at least show up for a presentation). we had to endure a very sketchy sales pitch. The management should instead focus on improving experience for the money guests are already required to pay without the membership and only then they may persuade guests to pay even more to become members!

reviews.author: kaytay2023
reviews.title: Food, food poisoning, and quality
reviews.text: The value of this review will depend on what you are looking for in a resort. If you are looking for a place to drink by the pool then ignore this review, you will like it well enough. If you are looking for a relaxing experience then perhaps look elsewhere. The part I would be most critical of however was the food. Most of the food was of a very low quality. Perhaps it is expecting too much for things to be cooked in anything other than canola and vegetable oil at a resort like this but even just that small change would have greatly improved the food. In addition there were not many options for those who are carful about what they eat and have dietary restrictions unless you wanted to piece together a meal from sides. The restaurants had better options, but the reservations were hard to get into. The concierge always told us to check on the day of, but then when it came time to do so, they were booked up. So it didn’t help to ask for it in advance. I would caution eating at the “food truck” they have stationed on the beach, as we were given uncooked lamb and we had severe food poisoning for 3 days with no accommodations to help us recover. We tried to get coconut water just to stay hydrated and they told us it would cost $10 a bottle… even though it’s supposed to be included in the mini fridge. Room service meals normally took 2 hours to arrive. So all in all food was the main issue.

reviews.author: Wynnona Nicole B
reviews.title: Disappointment coming from a Loyal Meliá Member
reviews.text:
I had a terrible experience for my birthday. Starting from the room to the concierge.

I had requested a king bed for our room closer to the ocean. The customer service had booked me 2 double bed and in the farthest building from the beach. The power keep going out randomly during the day at least 3 times a day. The room bar service was never refilled. I have requested it to be refilled and they never came. I had to as room service to bring water.

My concierge didn’t txt us the day we met him which he said he would therefore didn’t make a dinner reservation for us on the night we arrived. Luckily my friend had an attentive concierge which helped us more than my concierge. I had to create the group chat with him on WhatsApp at 1pm the next day since he didn’t message us in the morning. 

I have requested specific times for dinner reservations and our concierge confirmed all of them. We arrived to dinner and the front desk attendant of the restaurant said we are either 1 hour or 30 mins early and have to make special arrangements to sit us. This happened 3 nights in a row. He also had promised me to do something special for my birthday but nothing was sent to the room. On the day we left, he messaged the group chat at 1pm for our dinner reservations. I had told him we left and he responded with ok and left the group chat. 

It is a disappointment since I have a better experience 5 years ago. I always recommend this hotel and never again.

reviews.author: NLG
reviews.title: Not worth it.
reviews.text: We went on free business trip for four days.  For free it was great.  I wouldn’t pay for it though.  Service was very poor.  You’d have people come over to take your order and then never bring whatever it was.  I’m vegan and was informed ahead of time that I’d be able to eat here.  It was very very hard.  The restaurant on the premises that’s advertised as vegan - Flora - changed its menu and it’s now fully meat. Both the website and hotel brochures still say it’s vegan though. The restaurants told us they could accommodate me but when we’d get there, it was clear they had no idea what vegan was and couldn’t handle anything off menu other than a green salad - which since the water is bad here, isn’t safe to eat.   If you wanted to eat at a red you needed to make reservations at  a particular desk that closed at 4.  After that they wouldn’t let you in even if the restaurant was empty.  Several times we were told no for something that when our Butler asked magically appeared.  Beach was gross with sea weed.  Overall just not worth it and don’t bother if you eat anything other than meat.

reviews.author: Inspire320199
reviews.title: Disappointing Resort - but the weather was great!
reviews.text:
Very few members spoke English -- which made it difficult to commuincate.  We were upgraded to this resort but felt like maybe we it wasnt an upgrade - No concierge services and the other resort we were to be assigned a personal concierge. 
The Dinner Reservation system is very poor - If you want to reserve dinner times - You MUST PLAN your morning schedule so you can get a reservation.

reviews.author: chrisD4595WA
reviews.title: Food is not good
reviews.text: Nice location and facility but the resort lost me with the food quality.  Restaurants were either closed or had limited hours…always trying to steer you to the buffet. Room service was awful and took one hour and forty mins.

reviews.author: Navigator17227528384
reviews.title: 4th time here - it’s changed.  Price no longer in line with experience.  Poor value
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real has increased prices and decreased service.  This is my fourth trip to the hotel, my first was in 2002.  Other repeat guests are saying the same.  

Let me give you can example: I am staying in the Nikte Double Master swim-up suite. A suite.  Today I went to the beach to reserve some chairs for me and my family.  there were not many folks out there and I was told my room didn’t entitle me to a front row.  Not a second.  Not a third row. (All rows had available chairs).  4th row was for me.   

I’m still here, 4 days left. I’ve spoken with management and I get acknowledgment of the decline in value.  No solutions are presented. Will be pursuing either a discount to align the experience value with the cost or an increase in access and experience. Either is fine with me. 

Doug

reviews.author: Traveler201877345
reviews.title: Poor Experience
reviews.text:
As a family of five that has enjoyed luxurious stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and other Caribbean destinations, our expectations were high for our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We booked two NIKTE class master bedroom swim outs, expecting the same level of excellence we've experienced elsewhere.
While the concierge staff and individual servers have been exceptionally kind and helpful, the hotel management has failed to deliver the 5-star experience we anticipated. The website promised premium quality drinks as part of our all-inclusive package, but we were served “well” drinks regardless of where we went, with the option to purchase premium drinks separately - a bait-and-switch tactic unbefitting a 5-star establishment. NIKTE definitely isn’t worth the upcharge.
Our grievance lies with the hotel's deceptive practices (website language of “premium” drinks), not the dedicated staff who've tried their best to make our stay enjoyable. It's disheartening to see their efforts marred by the resort's management.
If you are considering a five star family experience, seriously consider other options before booking at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. The Caribbean has numerous other luxurious and honest resorts that will provide the true 5-star experience you deserve, reminiscent of our stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and beyond.

reviews.author: Cegbert
reviews.title: Not The Same Paradisus It Used To Be...
reviews.text: Melia, the parent company of Paradisus, has moved to a time-share focused model. They no longer cater to the vacation traveler who just wants to book a trip for their family without committing to a 30 year time-share deal. This was the 4th (and last) trip to Paradisus unless they are able to resurrect their commitment to the vacation experience for the non-time-share travelers to their facilities. The amenities we used to receive as a premium traveler have vanished and the access to the perks has been closed off to the non-time-share guests. The rest of the hotel is tired and falling into disrepair. The premium service, bars, beach areas, pools are restricted to the time share members and the "premium experience" guests are left with the remnants of a hotel in decaying disrepair in spite of the premium price.

reviews.author: Christine K
reviews.title: Not a 5 star experience
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived I was being pestered to attend a sales pitch session to buy into their time share by our concierge and staff. Roof came down in main buffet while we were eating lunch. They closed only buffet and offered a very minimal buffet out in an area that had no tables to sit and eat. We booked adults only and there were no restaurants open in that section. Beach full of seaweed and you are constantly pestered by locals selling stuff. Room was an adjoining room, we could hear our neighbours clearly all night long. Room was not cleaned regularly, we had to call them to clean it late in the day. After pool bar closed I witnessed some guests opening up unlocked bar and drinking out the liquor bottle and putting them back. Came to rest and relax… still have one more day and I wish I was leaving today! Came to rest and relax and I am leaving tired and stressed!

reviews.author: RRMJR13
reviews.title: Not for kids or new visitors to the resort.
reviews.text:
This is a resort that is suited for adults with timeshares and club memberships, and who seek to do little more than relax and be seen.  Avoid going here without membership or enhanced status – regular travelers seem to fall into a “leftover bucket”… rooms not taken by timeshares and/or club members. There's no option to upgrade - at least per the front desk.  You will feel like a lower-class guest.

More importantly, families with children aren’t a good fit for Palma Real Golf.  Kids are highly restricted here... limiting families (with kids in tow) to roughly 25% - 30% of the grounds, restaurants, and amenities.  Further, there is virtually no entertainment or activities for kids – we were saved by traveling with extended family (cousins).  …and electronics :(.

The good:
- Grounds, pools and beach
- Not crowded
- Generally good service – aside from front desk / concierge
- Very comfortable beds / rooms
- Very knowledgeable bar tenders, fantastic cocktails
- Buffet food, coffee, local fruit

The so/so:
- Restaurant food OK at best
- Seaweed cleanup weaker than neighboring beaches
- General disorganization
- Cleanliness of restaurants (dirty plates, silverware, etc)

Not good:
- Family-unfriendly
- Virtually no activities – for adults or kids
- All real activities (snorkel, scuba, etc.) - not managed by resort or included
- Very unclear, and seemingly very restrictive reciprocity of activities and facilities across the Melija sub-resorts.
- Could not get a handicap-accessible room.

reviews.author: karinagofman1
reviews.title: very avarage
reviews.text:
bad points:   beach is windy plus waves all the times!!. 
                        Nothing to do for kids except kids club;
                        nothing to do for adults after dinner too
                        Line to make reservation ( with Laura Rivas)for any restaurants about 3 hours and no guarantee that you will have reservation when you come to this restaurant
Good points: . Pools are excellent.
                          Rooms are very clean and spacious, 
                          resort is new and beautiful.
If you are traveling with kids this resort is not a good idea.

reviews.author: Gigi X 4
reviews.title: Service Lacking
reviews.text:
This resort is lovely, but that’s where the  good part ends. The service is abysmal. Our room was only cleaned sporadically. And not cleaned thoroughly when the housekeepers did show up. It’s a large place and direction signs were minimal. Most of the staff had essentially no English so asking for directions didn’t help. 

The food was mediocre, especially the Blue Agave restaurant. Reservations were difficult to get at the times our group requested even though we supposedly had a “personal concierge”.  

We would definitely return to Punta Cana for the weather and the beach, but will stay elsewhere next time.

reviews.author: Manisha S
reviews.title: Customer service , check in process, overbooking
reviews.text: We booked our stay from Feb 12thto 20th. But the hotel put us in Garden Suites despite of our booking at palma real. We were with 3 small children but they did nothing to honour our booking . We waited 3 hours but palma real was overbooked. Not coming here again. Very poor customer service. Staff ineffective and keeps passing customer from one person to other. After a lot of persuasion they gave us only 3 night stay at palma real . No compensation for charging us full price at palma real and having us stay at Garden suites ( lower quaity) hotel for 5 nights has been offered so far. We are very very disappointed. Beautiful location but very poor customer service. Managers don't want to face customers and help.

reviews.author: P S
reviews.title: BEWARE - Fraud with room changes
reviews.text:
We were a group of 9 and booked 3 deluxe rooms at Paradisus Palma Real many months before our Feb 2023 stay with email confirmation, directly through their website. We also recieved email confirmation of our rooms in Palma Real the morning of our check in. 

When we arrive to check in, they take us by golf cart to Garden Suites by Melia and say this is where we will all be staying (nice but lower level resort with no ocean and small buffet). We could not believe what they were saying. We showed them our email confirmation for Paradisus Palma Real but they did not care and said there was nothing they could do about this since they were "not connected" to that hotel... despite them all being on the same property with the same golf carts, logos, etc. 

Despite several hours of asking them to check us in at Paradisus, they refused. 
We then recieved an email later that night saying our booking had been changed to Garden Suites. 

We never got a discount for staying at the other resort or any apology or explanation for this change. It is very likely Paradisus was over booked and they moved us hoping we somehow wouldnt notice or complain. 

So be careful.... if you book Paradisus you may get one of their lower sister chain hotels and only find out when you check in with very rude unapologetic staff!

reviews.author: Miguel Lertora
reviews.title: Horrible experiencia
reviews.text:
Decepción absoluta, habiendo conocido esta cadena en Mexico, hace unos años, optamos como familia por la buena experiencia. 
Pero claramente nos equivocamos, sin caer en susceptibilidades:
Normalmente no tienen suficientes toallas para los huéspedes para poder ir a la playa o a la piscina, para ir a cenar con niños sólo tienes 04 alternativas (carne, italiana, mexicana y asiática) la última es con reserva.
Los anexos para coordinar algo (lo que sea) normalmente no responden por lo que debes ir personalmente al lobby. 
En el edificio que nos asignaron (10) no hay ascensor, por lo que es un buen ejercicio cuando estás con niños, coches y demás.
Se supone que pagas un servicio todo incluido, pero no es así, solo se limitan a lo que te entregan si deseas beber un trago o cerveza de una marca en especial, esta reservado a los socios pertenecientes a los programas de la propia cadena, a pesar que nuestra estadía es de más de 10 días….
Habiendo insisto conocido la cadena previamente, esto es un fracaso absoluto y no lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: SandraMay_16
reviews.title: Way under what we expected after visiting it when it didn't belong to Meliá
reviews.text:
We had been to this hotel and enjoyed Royal Service accommodations and amenities including breakfast a la carte with amazing dinners, beverages and tranquility. Real holidays.
When we made our reservations we were told that was called Royal Service was now renamed Reserve and that we would receive the same or even better services. 
The first problem of many which made our vacation quite disappointing was our room. In the newly remodeled building and a modern first impression our room looking on to the ocean was big and comfortable but was furnished with old furniture which broke in different parts as the days passed the same as doors which were difficult to move and had broken parts and we even found debris behind one!!! And the worst problem was the typical humidity with smell of cement which penetrated your bones. When we said this was not healthy for us we were led to other options of dark small lower quality rooms and they even expected us to accept the downgrade and sign that we had nothing to claim. They finally cleaned up the room and somehow disguised the smell and we stayed in the first room but our clothes and even our towels were perpetually damp. 
Breakfast was served at the buffet with all the people staying at the hotel no matter what they had paid or what bracelet they wore and they only offered another place which was so air conditioned that it was unbearable, more likely a morgue than a place to sit and eat. So there we went to the buffet which lacked many things as a matter of fact. The food offered was poor, always the same and no special treats. The people at the buffet were very kind and I need to mention Marta who made our miserable stay much nicer as she always had the few things I needed waiting for me. 
The next problem was when I washed my hair, which is abundant and long and I found that the hair dryer didn't work. I called for a replacement and I repeated the call 4 times every 20 minutes and the only answer I would get was "they didn't take it to you?? I will report this" My husband had to go to the lobby and complained and they made excuses which didn't dry my hair and the solution was to ask my son in another room to lend me his otherwise I would remain with no dinner as it was getting late.
The room was well cleaned every dy and towels refreshed but damp morning and night, Mairobi the morning lady in charge was very attentive and kind and the night ladies too.
We spent the 2 weeks complaining and asking for the promised things like good wine as the house wine was very bad and if you wanted to get the drinks and wine that our reserve class were offered we had to go to a special out of the way bar where people smoked cigars ignoring many signs that prohibited this. Of course if you complained nobody acted. We suggested them o simply take of the signs as they were not respected.
The beach reserved to our accommodation status was ok, with good shade and big comfortable beach beds and Pedro and the other man that I can't recall his name were great and always attentive to our needs, towels and some water after our walks.
Nothing to do after dinner only one pool table at the bar where we couldn't get our drinks which we had to fetch at the other one so everything was a mess. 
When we left my husband talked to the clients service manager as he came to ask how was our stay and he said all this to him. Maybe they better things, I hope so for the sake of travelers and the people who work there and are good people only some need guide as many managers are absent when problems crop up. We are not going back, we travel from far and it is the same expense in air tickets to get to Dominican Republic than other islands in the Caribbean. We left the place tired of so many situations and only glad to go back home. I could keep on writing but it doesn't do any good to me to remember the undoubtedly worst experience at a resort hotel for our anual summer holidays which we have every year for the last 25 years.

reviews.author: MRGO23
reviews.title: Falra detalle en servicios
reviews.text:
El Melia Paradisus  the reserve no cubre los standars de servicios exclusivos que promociona y que corresponden a un hotel  5 estrellas.
Falta de atención al detalle en servicios brindados a los huespedes.
Cobro conceptos adicionales por por ejemplo cama balinesas playa.
Incluir importe mas elevado del pactado en cena de playa.
Falta de seguimiento email (solicitud traslado aeropuerto hotel que no contestaron ni cumplieron).
Error de identificación de alimentos en bufet.  Riesgo par aalérgicos (leches), errores en tipos de quesos.
Cucarachas en habitación.
Falta de ciertos servicios en The reserve : SPA y restaurante cerrados

reviews.author: Olivia B.
reviews.title: Desilusión en la estancia
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado las fiestas de Navidad en el
Hotel con mi familia, pero desde la llegado todo a sido una desilusión. En recepción tuvimos  que esperar durante dos horas porque aún no estaba la
Habitación, al paso de ese término en recepción nos indicaron que podíamos acceder a la misma en compañía del concierge, nos llevamos una nuestra gran sorpresa ya que la habitación estaba sin hacer, sucia, sin sábanas, con basuras del cliente anterior, mini-bar vacía.  Entonces perdimos dos horas, más el tiempo que la camarera limpiara la habitación y la
Acondicionará con todo lo cual tardó bastante. Fuimos quejarnos obviamente a Club Melia pues somos socios, pero peor aún, una atención pésima. No nos han dado ni repuesta concreta de lo que paso, menos alguna compensación. Los clientes que viajan con una agencia regular sin ser Club Melia fueron mucho mejor tratado, upgrade de compensación por igual problema a la hora del Check-in. Sin contar que el hotel recién inaugurado no tuvo  internet 6 de los 7 días. Comida poca variable y mala presentación hasta la cena del 24 de diciembre, nada especialmente hecho por la ocasión. Realmente le guardamos de esa estancia bastante desilusión siendo un Hotel Paradisus.

reviews.author: miguelfllanos
reviews.title: Promesas incumplidas
reviews.text: Goteras en la habitación y hasta 2 horas llamando para que vinieran a hacer algo, parte del personal muy poco formado y hasta 3 días llevo persiguiéndoles para recuperar un bañador y una camiseta de objetos perdidos (me voy mañana y siguen dándome largas y se pasan la pelota de unos a otros). El personal de restauración son de 10, eso es cierto, y también hay otras cosas buenas, pero por el precio pagado hay opciones mejores donde te respetaran como cliente y como persona.

reviews.author: Rosanna Gomez
reviews.title: Buffet y restaurants
reviews.text: Por 13 años viajó con mi familia a pasar las navidad allá y ahora encontré un buffet totalmente muy pobre en selección de comida…..y poco cuidado 👀 acerca de los restaurante…..el único que se puede cenar un poco mejor es en Flora…..al restaurante italiano ni se le ocúrras ir si saber lo que es la comida italiana 🙌

reviews.author: Raymond F
reviews.title: Renovated hotel but poor customer service
reviews.text:
The good: food is great at flora; renovations lovely (but ongoing); drinks are good. 

The bad: the reserve is a joke with concierge offering little benefit, rooms are unfinished: front desk not able to resolve issues (combined 30 requests for soap and  hot water). The resort staff said the hotel was entirely out of soap - this is a health and safety issue - how are kitchen staff cleaning hands, guests through resort, etc. 

We did not have hot water and the resort did little to resolve this. 

Outcome: I would say the hotel is in need of structural reengineering to deliver customer service for price and star rating. I will not be back. 

This review is based on mid-stay.

Melia Corporate has also been advised of these concerns.

reviews.author: Rafael E
reviews.title: Aun no están listos
reviews.text: En lo personal una experiencia muy decepcionante con el hotel, veo en la prensa todos los anuncios sobre la inversión que han hecho en remodelar el hotel, pero la realidad es que abrieron sin aun estar listos. En los pasillos están llenos de constructores, lodo, cemento, todavía están sembrando. Restaurantes y bares cerrados, no hay actividades nocturnas, habitaciones incompletas, con articulos básicos faltantes para un hotel de esta categoría. Servicio al cliente deficiente, desde el checkin experiencia horrible (4 visitas al lobby SOLO para lograr que me entregaran una tarjeta para abrir la habitacion, la pulsera nunca funcionó). En fin, tienen todo un trayecto que recorrer aun. En estos momentos no me siento en condición de recomendarlos. Quizá con el tiempo cuando logren engranar todo mejoren, pero aún están lejos de la experiencia que ofertan

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.title: Not great.
reviews.text: Lousy choice of restaurants. Only one or two were good. Breakfast buffet good but not great. Room was great. Very comfortable beds and housekeeping was good and cleaned at our requested times. Entertainment was ok. Be

reviews.author: Jose0554
reviews.title: Pésimo melia
reviews.text: Hotel grande las habitaciones y el personal es lo que lo salva por por lo demás poca cosa.Animacion nula y la poca que hay pésima aburridismo si quieres algo medio que tienes que ir al otro hotel.Comida muy repetitiva y malísimo para ser de un melia y 5estrella madre mia que malo se salva solo cenas a la carta.Piscina y playa regular las hamacas están para cambiarlas ya y playa mala pero eso ya no es culpa del hotel encima media área en obras.Por cierto señor Gabriel que es usted el dueño de melia TODOS somos clientes no solo los socios lo digo para que el trato no sea tan diferente y no me refiero a lo que cada uno paga sino se lo mira mucho más al socio que a los demás que tb pagamos NO REPITO MAS NI PENSARLO ah por cierto en el hotel no se puede cambiar de euros a pesos muy mal

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve.  Room was nice.  That's about all that was above average.  First, the reservation system for restaurants as part of the package is a joke.  Don't understand the need for reservations.  Second, service is marginal.  We paid way too much to struggle getting to the eminitis promoted.  Third,  you really need to speak Spanish.   Very little English spoken or understood.  Would not recommend this place.  Money is better spent other places.  The reviews on Costco travel and Trip Advisor are misleading.

reviews.author: Soledad B
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
Lo peor , la comida , poco variada , al tercer día ya no quieres seguir comiendo lo mismo .
Acceder a los restaurantes a través del  “concierge” era muy difícil y poco eficiente, 
En las noches en el hotel no había cena , por lo que tenías que tomar los carritos e ir a otro hotel aunque lloviera torrencialmente para ir al menú de “ todos los días “
Lo mejor , el personal , amable .
Una experiencia que definitivamente no repetiríamos .

reviews.author: Lilyflower7
reviews.title: Far from reality...
reviews.text:
It has taken me some time to finally be able to write with a clear mind about our experience in this resort. This was not a 5 star resorts and definitely not a 5 star rating. 
Food: Selection was poor and unhealthy.  It only looked good. Food was over cooked, or not cooked at all and too salty. The variety was very limited and no much healthy choices. The seasonal Fruits had no flavour. How is this possible? My kids couldn’t eat anything except for plain pasta and rice. The Lunch buffet was left overs or untouched food from dinner the previous night. If you are use to eating healthy at home and you are a food lover. This is not the place for you. 

Rooms: We were 3 separate families with 3 rooms and all 3 rooms needed extra cleaning. When we brought this to the managements attention  and they saw the condition of our room they changed our room right away. Super inconvenient with 3 kids. The daily cleaning continued to be poor and unsatisfactory. We left $10 tip every day hoping for a better cleaning.

Beach service: don’t expect to get service by the beach. You’ll be lucky if they come by once per day for an order.

reviews.author: _tanushamalaya
reviews.title: Melia is a scam
reviews.text:
We had a very unpleasant experience with sales people in the hotel. 

On Monday, one of the workers brought us to the nearest hotel to see “what benefits we have as Melia members”. But it was actually 2 hours sale. They said that we could get membership for almost $9000 for 7 years. This membership would get us the right to book any Melia hotel for 7 nights every year and any RCI hotel for 7 night every year. Of course, it’s a good deal and we agreed to sign the contract.

They withdrew $1700 from our bank account before we even sign the papers.

When we were signing the contract we didn’t notice that the terms are not the same as we were promised (our fault, I admit). So the same day we wrote them that we want to terminate this contract. They didn’t respond. Then, the next day we went to that hotel and wrote a termination letter. They said that it would be cancelled. But we didn’t get any confirmation of termination, and didn’t get our money back, and they are still ignoring our emails. 

We don’t know what to do. We didn’t expect that such prestigious and huge hotel chain would do such a fraud. We feel like we are being scammed. The whole vacation is spoiled.

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: Dinner Disaster
reviews.text:
We just checked in today. The hotel claims you can call a number or use the Meliá app to make dinner reservations. We are traveling with a party of 8 for a big wedding at the resort and after sending multiple emails, calling the reservations number and attempting to use the app (which is useless) we still have no dinner reservations. 

This is so inconvenient and unprofessional. For an all-inclusive experience, this is not very inclusive. Not a great way to start our vacation.

reviews.author: Matias Shaw
reviews.title: Dicen tener 7 restaurants.. no los pude conocer
reviews.text:
Vinimos dos días solamente ya que extendimos la estadía de nuestras vacaciones y queríamos probar otro hotel. Veníamos de Melia Beach Resort The Level.
Llegamos un sábado y nos vamos un lunes
El lugar? Impresionante. Todo muy bueno. Espectacular digamos. Los shows entretenidos. Mis hijas muy contentas con las actividades nocturnas también
Las habitaciones, al menos la que nos tocó, es un poco venida en años (el beach resort estaban mucho más actualizadas) pero cómodas y funcionales. Nos tocó una habitación con vista al mar, increíble.
Las cosas que no me gustaron. Para conseguír sombra en la playa o pagas una propina al muchacho o tenés que ir a las 730 am... Terrible. Sino, a quemarse al sol. Uno está de vacaciones y tiene que pensar en esas cosas. Hay muy poca sombra para la cantidad de gente que va (pensar que se juntan 3 hoteles de la misma cadena en la misma costa (Grand cana, Paradisus punta cana y Paradisus palma real).
Al ir solo dos días no nos dieron concierge (después nos enteramos porque)... Y para reservar restaurant nos dieron un número de teléfono. Acá empezaron los problemas. 
El Paradisus palma real tiene 7 restaurants... En dos días no pudimos conocer ninguno.. porque? Porque como llegamos un sábado ya estaban todos reservados por los pasajeros que llegan los lunes, reservan todos sus restaurants para la semana, y sin importar ni reconfirmar si van o no, cierran las reservas y nadie más puede entrar al restaurant.
Para que ponernos concierge si no nos iban a dejar ir a ningún restaurant? Ahí entendimos

Entonces habían 6 restaurants vacíos (Sal siempre estaba lleno) y no nos dejaban entrar a ninguno. Estaba claro que no les importaba total está todo pago al ser all inclusive, para que llenarlo, no?
Ante nuestra queja, nadie sabía que decir ni que hacer. solo te dicen que ASI Es el sistema, en vez de buscar una solución. Demás está decir que la gerente de reserva se va a las 18... A esa hora uno está en la playa!!

Mi humilde consejo es que dejen mesas en el restaurant para el mismo día para gente como nosotros, que no llegamos el día que había que llegar. De esta manera al menos tenés la posibilidad.. sino, quedas afuera desde el inicio pero la tarifa es la misma eh. No piensen que les van a cobrar menos. También deberían reconfirmar las reservas.
Entonces mi consejo para los que vengan a este súper hotel es no lleguen despues de un lunes, sino van a comer en un buffet dónde la comida se repite y una cerveza tiene el mismo gusto que una papafrita.. en ese caso les recomiendo que vayan a otro hotel, xq acá son inflexibles y no vas a poder sentarte en ningún otro lado que el buffet.

Nos vamos con un sabor amargo de este lugar que fue muy recomendado... No creo que vuelva. 

Del 16 al 18 de abril de 2022
Adjunto tres fotos de restaurants que estaban llenos según ellos pero en realidad están vacíos y no pudimos comer
Pero también fotos de lo lindo que es el lugar

reviews.author: Claudio L
reviews.title: Don’t hold your breath
reviews.text:
If you expect a 5 start hotel treatment you will be disappointed. 

Check-in: waited for one hour for the room to be ready, beyond the check in time. 

Room service: missing towels, soap and empty mini bar when we arrived. It took several requests to resolve. 

Maintenance: patio being washed without proper wet signs caused my 81 year old dad to fall. He is still in pain back home but luckily our trip did not end with the fall. 

Food: we were not able to try two of the restaurants due to lack of available. I was there for 5 days. 

Melia’s Circle Membership: get ready for being harassed during you vacation

If going back to the US stay on top of COVID testing yourself, as far as times and when exam result is ready

But there are pros: beach is wonderful.  Pool in very great condition. Buffet service is good.

reviews.author: Vince
reviews.title: DOMMAGE
reviews.text: Magnifique hôtel mais évitez les chambres supérieures vieillotes et mal entretenues. La notre avait même une vitre coulissante dont le mécanisme cassé ne permettait pas son verrouillage !! Evitez le mois de Mars où les spring breack americains envahissent piscines et restos et ne respectent aucune tranquillité, meme la nuit. Quand à la plage, des amoncellement d algues non ramassés plusieurs jours ternissent l image de carte postale magnifique. Enfin, si vous ne parlez que le français et l allemand, oubliez aussi. Personne ne parle ces langues et pourtant voyage réservé avec TUI France et Allemagne, mais aucun représentant sur place. Enfin, n oubliez pas le vent fort et quasi continuel... Conclusion : très déçus dans l ensemble

reviews.author: Ravi M
reviews.title: Frustrating stay due to lack of eating options
reviews.text:
One of the first things listed on the website of Paradisus Palma Real is that it offers the choice of Six A La Carte Restaurants as part of its all inclusive package. What is not mentioned anywhere on their website is that you cannot get into any of the restaurants because you need a reservation in advance. Getting a dinner reservation, however, is a painstaking and frustrating ordeal, the stress of which ruined our trip.

When we tried calling in advance, they told us we can only make a reservation after arrival. When we got there, we were told the reservation desk was only open from 9am to 2pm (one can't make reservations at restaurants directly or get put on waitlists). When we promptly showed up at 9am the next morning, we were told that all the restaurants were booked for the next several nights. And so it went on..only after paying off some folks could we get a reservation. We will never stay here again.

reviews.author: Jessica E
reviews.title: Beautiful but SO loud at night
reviews.text: Overall the resort is nice and the service is very good. I am giving 2 stars because it is incredibly noisy at night.
