I have switched rooms once already and every night there is very loud music with bass that is directly outside my windows. This may not be an issue further from the ocean but it’s worth noting that the ocean view and ocean front rooms are not for anyone who wants to sleep before 11pm. I find it unacceptable that I was transferred from one room to an even louder room. I would gladly be farther from the ocean to get a good nights sleep. They should be more understanding to guests sleep preferences and understand that guests are coming from different time zones.

reviews.author: Jose Antonio
reviews.title: It was not what was expected, for the price we paid
reviews.text:
ción
I consider that it is not a 5 star hotel. The room where we stayed from 01-11-22 to 01-19-22, located in building 8 of the Reserve area, in an all-inclusive plan, had a lot of deterioration inside.
Room service, with regards to cleaning, was good.
But we had an incident, two days before the end of our week, with one of the supposedly clean towels (which from then on we began to doubt), which were changed every day, had a sticker attached to it of some kind of cartoon.
If the towels are "washed", how can this happen???

The lack of training, and etiquette of the staff that attends the restaurants for dinners with prior reservation, leaves much to be desired. Something as simple as changing the used cutlery between an appetizer and the main course, in most restaurants is not fulfilled.

I think that this hotel is overrated, since in many aspects, it does not meet a 5-star service. On the contrary, the prices of the plans, yes.
It is an expensive hotel, for the general service they offer.

reviews.author: natacha b
reviews.title: TODO DESMEJORO NO LO RECOMENDAMOS
reviews.text:
Hace aproximadamente 10 años que nos alojamos en lo que antes era "royal service" de paradisus palma real. Lamentablemente después de la pandemia todo se ha vuelto malo.
Partiendo por el check in, fue pésimo, mi esposo pidió una Coca Cola y lo enviaron a buscársela al bar de abajo. Antes, al recibirte te invitaban con algo de comer y beber. Esta vez no había nada en la barra, ni si quiera vasos.
En las habitaciones quitaron amenities como bolso de playa, chocolates en las noches al abrir la cama. Tuvimos que pedir batas y pantuflas porque no había. Tampoco te dejan bebidas como antes (cervezas por ejemplo), pedimos que nos trajeran alguna variedad de bebidas y nos mandaron una botella de vodka como si fuésemos alcohólicos. Escasean shampoo y acondicionador. Dejan dos paquetes de oreos y unas papitas lays.
En cuanto a la comida, poca variedad, encontrar sobres de Splenda fue un desafío. La calidad de los alimentos ha bajado considerablemente. En el Palazzo, -uno de los restaurantes más exclusivo-, no cuentan con cerveza corona, generalmente no había helado de chocolate (básico) y mala atención. En el buffet general, la variedad y la calidad es mucho menor que la de otros años. Cuesta encontrar gente que te atienda. La fruta espantosa, siempre verde. La comida siempre fría.
En cuanto a los vinos, solo ofrecen UN vino, el de la casa, única marca y bastante regular a mala. Solo si uno se queja te ofrecen algo mejor.
La comida de Vento que era un gran restaurante fue pésima, los platos son para reírse de los escasos y la comida es mala.
Las piscinas del hotel y las instalaciones en general están bastante deterioradas, a la piscina le faltan venecitas por todos lados, el baño del restaurante Palazzo siempre estaba sucio y en malas condiciones. En el YHI SPA los chorros de masajes de la piscina nunca cortaban (el ruido era constante y fuerte, especialmente para un spa) y otros chorros ni si quiera funcionaban. Quitaron el agua saborizada y las galletas que antes ofrecían en el spa.
En el gimnasio la atención de Richard fue pésima, había que decirle que exija a los clientes el uso de mascarilla (que es una exigencia) y se molestaba por ello. Luego de esos todos los días que fuimos tuvo un trato malo para con nosotros. Inadmisible.
Lo mejor, la playa y la excelente atención de siempre de Pedro Cedano y de Martín y de Wanda en el bar. También la excelente atención de la persona que hace las hamburguesas en la playa (si no me equivoco Pablo Ariel), quien fue muy amable y profesional.
Destacable el servicio de Goergi Vargas, Gustavo Vásquez, Luz Villa, Jafreisy López y Lisette Montilla quienes a pesar de todas las limitaciones que tienen hicieron lo posible por ayudarnos. Ellas y ellos son lo único que vale la pena hoy de ese hotel, que sigue cobrando tarifas carísimas y cada vez brinda un peor servicio y en nada le importa la fidelidad de sus huéspedes.
Lamentable pero luego de esta experiencia no se lo recomendamos, y no volveremos.

reviews.author: Katy O
reviews.title: What to really expect...NOT 5 Star Service
reviews.text:
I'll start by saying please read the whole review...I am a frequent traveler of Melia properties and have stayed at several Paradisus properties before this trip so there were expectations of service and quality. Our reservation was for "The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real". I am also a Melia Rewards member. While there were some positives with this location the overwhelming number of negatives really let us down. I'll try to group my comments so hopefully readers can find what info they need before planning a trip to this location.

Pre-Arrival: I initiated communication with the Paradisus Palma Real staff about 3 weeks before check-in to verify room requests (neighboring rooms as we are a mixed family) were acknowledged and requesting info on airport transfers. They were good to respond and provide info on airport transfers, but unable to provide any assurance that we would be able to be in rooms even remotely close to each other. They also were not willing or able to make dinner reservations for our arrival night which meant we knew our only option would be room service.

Airport Transfer: You will have to make your own arrangements which isn't a big deal but recommend using a different company than the one recommended by the resort. We used "Dominican Airport Transfer - DAT" found here on TripAdvisor and they were very reasonably priced and quick. I mention airport transfers because as a Melia Rewards Platinum member, transportation to/from the airport is supposed to be included in your trip to any of their properties per their benefits website. Don't count on this and make your own plans.

Check-in: Our reservation was for "The Reserve" side of Paradisus Palma Real. The Reserve comes with several perks like exclusive and expedited check-in processes. None of this occurred. As a Platinum rewards member we are offered an opportunity to check-in virtually 48 hours prior to arrival to allow for an even quicker arrival, which we took advantage of. Upon arrival to the resort absolutely none of the early or quick check-in processes were observed. Took 40+ min for front desk staff to even begin to check us in. When we asked about all the information we sent during our virtual check-in, they had zero knowledge of the info or even the process which we used, so everything had to be redone. (**Let's also mention the manager on duty was in a loud verbal argument with another guest less than 10 feet away from multiple families checking in**) To their credit the front desk staff did their best to speed up the process and were able to make sure our rooms were neighboring as originally requested. 

Rooms: While we were very pleased with our rooms, especially being next door to each other, we were very surprised when they placed our group that included 3 kids under the age of 12 in the Adults Only section of the property. Made for some long walks to get to “our side” of the resort.
Concierge Service: DO NOT PAY FOR THIS. Plain and simple this was the biggest let down, regret, and overall waste of money at this resort. As part of "The Reserve" you are assigned (pay for) a personal concierge who is supposed to help make you stay as relaxing, fun, and stress free as possible. We got the opposite with our Concierge, Franklin. Franklin was not onsite the day of our check-in, but we were assured by staff that he would be in contact first thing the next day. We provided two cell phone numbers (WhatsApp) for him to use when reaching out. It was not until nearly 24 hours later and after several trips to the front desk did Franklin finally make contact. Franklin did not even look at the reservation information and proceeded to make dinner reservations (which could only be done through him) at adult only restaurants. When we corrected him (we had 3 kids with us), he struggled to find other options for dinner outside of the buffet. We found other options on our own due in large part to some awesome service staff at Vento. After Franklin's initial contact getting ahold of him to even ask basic questions about the Golf course, excursions, or the spa was hard. He was less than responsive to texts and was not present around the resort. He did not share any special event info or kids club info. Several nights there were themed dinners and shows that we would literally stumble upon and when we asked why we weren't given those as options he would not reply. We asked for assistance with Golf tee times/equipment rentals and his response was do it yourself on the website. We asked for assistance with spa reservations and his answer was do it yourself at the front desk. We asked for assistance with an excursion, and he told us to find a third-party guy on the beach. After several days of this pattern, we presented the issue to a manager and the final two days of our stay Franklin provided more information ahead of time, but it was too little too late. This was really a disappointment because we had read several reviews on TripAdvisor highlighting how awesome Franklin was...apparently, we didn't deserve the same level of service. 

Room Service: As mentioned you are not able to make restaurant reservations prior to check-in (and they are all reservation only except for the buffet). Our first night we attempted the buffet, but they were nearly closing time and there were very few options left so we decided to settle in our rooms and order room service. We called and placed a simple order for some food and drinks and were told it would be 30-40min. About 90 min later the food had not arrived, so we called down, they had no record of the order so placed it again. Another 90min went by and we gave up and went to bed...no food on the first night! The next evening after a long day of sun, the kids requested a late-night snack so we tried room service again...and again the same wait times with zero food delivered. We did share this information with Franklin our concierge and our comments/concerns about the lack of service fell on deaf ears. 

Yhi Spa: The spa service left us asking so many questions about the management and customer service of this resort and overall, Melia properties. As a Melia Rewards member you can use points for spa services, it advertised this way. So, we went to the spa and requested two 80min appointments and informed the desk that we intended to use points, which they confirmed as an option and told us they would get the manager approval needed ahead of time. Our appointments were for the next day, we planned for the kids to be engaged with the kid’s club staff and proceeded to our appointment. When we arrived, they presented us with a bill for $410, prior to service and we again told them we intended to use points. They told us they would need manager approval and it would be a bit because she was not there, despite telling us they would do it the day prior. After waiting for 40min past our appointment time they finally allowed us to proceed with our treatments. The two people who performed the massages were exceptional and were tipped well for having to also wait while the front desk staff worked out their processing issues. Points were eventually deducted from my Melia Rewards account. Fast forward to check-out day and the spa had applied the $410 charge to our room/credit card while also deducting the points. It took nearly an hour to sort out, delaying our departure. 

Golf: Another tricky advertising scheme. You are told when making a reservation that you get free green fees for the course associated with the resort. What they do not tell you is that you are required to rent a golf cart at $75 per person and only two people are allowed per cart. Equipment rentals are also another $60-80 per person. Nothing is for free….
There were two saving graces to this whole trip. Raul at the pool bar - 10 out of 10 - he was the best! He provided quality drinks and information about things to do in the area. Also, Delvin at Vento - he was the only reason we had any options or plans for dinner when our concierge let us down. He is a true gem and really knows what good customer service looks like at a 5-star resort.

reviews.author: Dancouns
reviews.title: Stay Away!!
reviews.text: The resort itself is beautiful, as is the beach and pools.  The weather was also perfect.  But, the service at this resort was poor at best.  The quality of the food was also some of the worst I have ever tasted.  For the money we paid ($4330 for 2) you would think we would have gotten more for the money.  However, everything of value was an upgrade or you had to pay more for.  We got there a day later, due to flight cancellations and we were not compensated for time lost.  They cancelled our reservation so the app which you needed for “coupons” couldn’t work.  As for coupons, we were offered $30 toward a $100 bottle of wine at the restaurants which obviously is not a savings at all.  My recommendation would be to go to another non-all inclusive hotel in the Dominican Republic and stay away from this one and it’s affiliates.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: 10+ visits here and no longer want to come back
reviews.text:
I've come here for the last 10 years with my family and despite looking forward to it after not being able to go in 2020, I was terribly disappointed. The resort has not been maintained - it is dirty, dilapidated, and lacks the customer service it once had. Easily top 5 most disappointing vacation experience. Unless there are dramatic changes, won't be coming back here

Rooms: Troubles with hot water twice (we had to use the kettle for warm water to bathe our 10 month old), toilet not flushing, mold/mildew on drapes, coffee table (which was basically fake leather stapled over cardboard) inside was missing its covering and had staples sticking out (again, we have a 10 month old), plastic wicker coffee table outside was broken with sharp pieces sticking out (which baby scratched himself on), hardware from the outdoor tub came off (exposed screws), bathroom window tiles cloudy or paint splattered, and mini fridge door consistently wouldn't close properly. Crib was old and wheels were rusty and wouldn't lock. Nespresso machine didn't work, coffee pods not consistently replaced. 

Resort/Amenities: Everything needs a fresh coat of paint (chipping, scuff marks). The equipment in the gym is falling apart and rusting (literally had rust on my hands), the hot tubs in the spa were lukewarm, the mattresses on the bali beds on the beach and by the pool were stiff and crunchy. Tiles falling off the steps in pools.

Food: Everything is bland and/or covered in salt. Or overcooked. The baby spat out scrambled eggs because of how salty they were. We went to hibachi restaurant and I was appalled at how much salt she put over all the food, it as inedible. Everything in buffets is lukewarm or crunchy/dry from sitting under heat lamps. Fruit is pretty much the only thing you can't go wrong with here.

Service: Seemingly lacking any/all motivation or sense of urgency (until it's the day you leave and they come around acting like your best friend seeking a tip).

reviews.author: Jia O
reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text:
This resort has so much potential but the management and receptionist are terrible, food is okay and I honestly wouldn’t bother coming back. 

The only reason I gave this 2 stars was because our server on the beach, Rafael was amazing. He was attentive, made sure we always had a spot on the beach and nearby the pool and honestly suggested amazing drinks to my friends and I. 
If it was not for Rafael, I would’ve gave this 0 stars. 

This hotel needs better management, better service and overall needs to be organized. 
I’ve never had experienced such terrible service at a “5 star” hotel. 
They don’t even live up to the 5 stars - they’re honestly a 3 star hotel and that’s me being generous.

reviews.author: Peter Gallagher
reviews.title: Overall horrible experience yet some of the Staff have delivered in great ways
reviews.text: Ok, we are at day 3.5 of our 7 day stay at the PARADISUS PALMA REAL RESORT and I’ll start with the positives. The Grounds are breathtaking, the gardeners are always working to keep it pristine, the Bartenders are Great especially Johnathan and Anyelina, both are so sweet and want the best for the guests. Pedro and Martin tend to all needs around the pool and beach, they are outstanding. The beach is by far the best beach I have set foot on, pure white smooth sand on every step. In short from the pools to the ocean the experience is great, I stole this line from another family staying here… from the pools inland the experiences has been not so good. Now for the NOT SO GOOD. …We arrived on Monday from the airport at 4pm have been awake since 3:30am and in that time my family only had cliff bar, goldfish and pretzels.  Arriving at 4pm to an all inclusive is not good, no food to be had unless you want to sit in your room and order room service or grab a burger at the beach grill. Paying the upgrade for a Butler/Concierge I figured he could help us out, but nope we were on our own. The challenge is my wife is a vegetarian and we could only get a burger or dog on the beach, she ate a role. Getting to the room we are told to not use tap water for consumption, not even for brushing teeth. The mini fridge had no water in one of the rooms. The fridges were not stocked appropriately. Called room. Service at 6:20pm to have water delivered yet at 7:20pm still no water and we had to leave for our 7:30pm reservation. Our concierge keeps saying you are VIP… and he set a reservation for dinner. Once we arrive no reservation was set for us.  Getting back to the room at 10:20 we still had no water, so I called room service again… and waited and waited, we had been up since 3:30am I just wanted to brush my teeth and go to bed… by midnight I realized no water was coming so I did a dry brush and nestled in for the night.  Tuesday my Butler had me meet with what I thought was Resort leadership and maybe he was but come to find out he works in the Circles Marketing room trying to get folks to join the Time Share program.  He heard my request to simply have Water in the room so at 10am I went to the pool, by 2pm go back to the room and you get it… no water. I went on the hunt for the guy and found his assistant, they finally realized I was serious about having water and it was delivered by the butler and a picture was sent to confirm. From this point we have constant struggles with our Butler service, instead of being proactive and setting an agenda for me and my family of 5 I need to constantly reach out to find what activities are happening (nothing online) remind him to set dinner reservations and say we don’t want late reservations yet on Tuesday he sets one for 9:30 at a special VIP event Glamping. I was like 9:30? We ate lunch at noon… he said… just show up at 8:30. We show up at 8:30 and once again they are not expecting us.  The food at this event was simply not good, it started at 6:30 by 8:30 the food was cold none of the warmers were on except for over the dried out pork, the saving Grace was the Risotto which still had a flame and they kept bringing more out because it was the only thing anyone would eat. We informed our Butler my wife has a shellfish allergy and our 8:30 reservation at the Hibachi restaurant can not include shrimp, he was like ya ok, in short we have a language issue and he YA’s everything. We get to the restaurant and we have 2 other families who were lovely we had great conversations, however shrimp hit the grill so now my wife can not eat. The butler did not give them a heads up, he struggled to communicate that she would die if she had any food contaminated with shellfish. After several embarrassing moments In front of the other families the staff now understood the grave situation we just avoided.  After a few side talks the chef came back and throughly cleaned the grill and made rice and veggies for my wife.  There are a few other painful moments that I will not go into detail, but I had to manually flush my toilet by taking the cover off, it took 2 days to get someone to reset the safe in one of the rooms, the Butler kept dropping the ball. As you might expect all the Reserve VIP guest are talking about the poor experience, and we agree it seems they have opened the resort to more people but they do not have enough Butlers to give the proper experience to the guest.  In short we are paying a premium price for the upgraded service yet the hotel is not delivering on there end of the bargain

reviews.author: Baldwin001
reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: Not a 5 star hotel. Food average and wine terrible. Golf is free with a $75 per person cart fee: a ripoff. TV signal terrible. Nice beach but water full of see weeds . Did not swim in it. Nice view of ocean from the room.

reviews.author: guloya
reviews.title: Awful place to stay( pretty in arquitectural way but awful services)
reviews.text: Beds were full of ants, bathroom dirty with the previus client hairs, a few things went misisng from our group,the employees are mostly on a bad humor, night entertaiment not so much.food wasn't spectacular either

reviews.author: Angelica P
reviews.title: Great service , bad hotel
reviews.text:
First of all, I do want to say service was amazing and all the people that work at hotel are so great and helpful, we absolutely loved the fact that everyone there want you to have a good time. 
Second , hotel pictures are misleading. We stayed at Junior Suite and had to change rooms 3 times. We do not want to post pictures however , 1st room was garden view which is fine but it has a crack in balcony door glass which we also could not open as well as a crack in a tub, room extremely outdated. When we asked for 2nd room we got the same style , still super outdated but we didn’t want to ask to switch again so we unpacked and went to dinner. After coming back to room, I went to bathroom and there was a leak from the sealing above so we requested of course a switch. They told us a s a result they will upgrade us however , next room - identically old (close to beach) , had a small outlet in a closet with exposed wiring…
Moving on to food , buffet was ok (I am really not super picky) not a huge variety. We had to make reservations in restaurants for dinner, the best thing we had was a steak at Sal and Tuna at Brizas. We went to Vento and ordered risotto however it was not cooked all the way. 
Beach is really nice and clean, most of the time was not even crowded which is great. Pools are clean as well, property itself outdated but also kept neat and staff did their best with upkeep. I do realize a lot of it is a result of Covid but I am upset with chain of these hotels and management because their more updated properties were barely 30 % capacity yet they still chose to put a lot of customers into these old rooms that you barely want to sleep in and I think that is just not a good business. We also paid decent money to stay in good conditions and I don’t require myself a super new room but seeing exposed wire , cracks and stain on bedding and curtains is not what anybody should experience. This was our first time in Punta Cana and we got really disappointed overall unfortunately and as much as we loved people there and would love to contribute to tourism we don’t think of coming back.

reviews.author: Dima Polo
reviews.title: Not what we expected from a 5-Star resort
reviews.text:
We booked our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real. We liked the reviews, we liked the pictures of the resort and modern style rooms. The expectations were high, but the experience was not as we expected.

Cons:
Room. When you get a room, you don’t get what you see on pictures. The pictures were probably taken when the room was just built. As of now, these rooms need renovations. The water pressure in the shower was very low, it took them three days to replace the shower head. Why wouldn’t they check it before moving people there? The jacuzzi has cracks and rust by the drain. I don’t think anyone would want to get in and use it.
Staff. Aside from few people, the staff speaks little to no English. How can you ask people to serve you if they don’t understand a single word in English? We had to use Google translation to explain what we need. They know few basic words but beyond that, they’re clueless.
Daily Entertainment. There’s none. You don’t see any daily activities during the day. Not at the beach, not by the pool. You can see other resorts doing beach aerobics and you start to think, why can’t they do it here. There’re some evening entertainment but not every day. 
Food. Food at the buffet is ok. Food at the restaurants is just terrible. People go to restaurants and you can see them later on in the buffet. Salmon we ordered was non cooked at all. Goat cheese pizza on the menu is served with parmesan cheese. If you don’t have it, just tell us or change the menu. And we’re not that picky but whatever was served to us was not eatable. The only restaurant we liked and food was ok was the Hibachi.

Pros.
Beach and bar attendant Pedro is a person who will make your day. He will always put a smile on your face. We just wish there were more people like him.
Butler Edgar was very attentive and helpful. With limited abilities he tried to make all our accommodations.

Regarding the weather. We came in the middle of November. It was windy every day. I don’t know maybe it’s seasonal. Water with high waves and lots of seaweed. Sometimes you don’t even want to get in. They clean the beach which is nice.

Overall the experience was not as we expected. For that kind of money we could easily go to Aruba or Turks where we’ve been before and where the service is much better.

reviews.author: KarelPitro
reviews.title: Una experiencia que no repetiría
reviews.text: Muy básico para lo que debería ser. El servicio es promedio y la alimentación no es buena. En cuanto al servicio tuvimos una muy mala experiencia porque miden a sus empleados al llevar a los huéspedes a una charla para venderte un paquete. ¿Qué es eso? Esperaban que estuvieramos 45 min escuchando una charla para vendernos algo, como una multinivel. No hay variedad de alimentos y la comida se ve vieja

reviews.author: Livia G
reviews.title: Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Hotel antigo,grande,com ótima localização e praia/piscina excelentes
Os problemas que tivemos foram com a acomodação(telefone e hidro não estavam funcionando) e a comida que estava muito ruim!
Tenho que fazer agradecimentos especiais a Reyna que nos ajudou em tudo que precisamos!Otima funcionaria!

reviews.author: Eduardo P
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We arrived to Paradisus Palma Real to join our family for my aunts 50th birthday, everything went well at the beginning, gorgeous hotel,  we went to the buffet food was good only until we made it to the room was that things started to head south. We reserved a Reserve Panoramic Jr Suite, when we got into the room, it looked nothing like what they promised on their website, we requested to be moved and they did. We were ready to settle down with our second room and then we noticed bed covers were all stained, there was paint splattered everywhere, cabinets were chipping, and the sofa had stains all over which looked disgusting. They promised to do better for us, so as we waited we headed down to the pool, as we paid for a premium package we go to have drinks and had to go to three different bars to find out all of them were out of premium drinks, we later head to the pool and for our luck, the towel huts were out of towels, they said try in a n hour. At this point we are ready to just walk out, we speak to the manager in charge of their liquor department, he reassures us that they do have premium liquor and that he really does  not know why the bartender would tell us they didn't. Then we speak to the customer service manager who says to please give him a chance and since the rest of our family is there we decide to give them a last chance, they take us to this other room which still wasn't what was promised, at this point they actually have me send them a link to their own website so that they can see what they sold us. They then proceeded to tell us that sometimes what they promotion online isn't really what they have available. Unfortunate for us we had to ask for a full refund and leave the resort in search for somewhere else to stay. I appreciate that they did try to accommodate us but for what we payed and what was promised it was just very disappointing especially since we wanted to spend this time with my family.

reviews.author: farbod S
reviews.title: Stay away!
reviews.text:
We travelled in Aug 2021. On the positive side it’s a large facility with good size pool and shore. 
On the negative side, the food quality/taste was bad. Very bad management. For example on 3 incidents when we tried making reservation for restaurants there was no reservation available. 
Worst: they charge you for stuff you didn’t order and you didn’t use. Expect a surprise at check out. 
The experience was so stressful, that I’ll stop using all Melia resorts.

reviews.author: ep982
reviews.title: Had much better stays at Melia properties
reviews.text: To pay for phone calls exceeding 30 minutes to get confirmation of the property you will be staying at is not a great way to start your trip. Horrible food and to be charged each time you use room service "delivery fee" when room service is included is crazy. Was bounced around when trying to make reservations for restaurants. Nothing to do at night

reviews.author: Angel l
reviews.title: Don't spend your money here
reviews.text:
Let's start with the good. The people here are excellent. They make you feel welcome, with a lot of warmth. Wish I could say more positive things. 

Now, where do I start; I understand that we are in a pandemic, although I'm from Miami and everything is now open. Not in Punta Cana. Ready for this, NO MUSIC, not even your own. No pool activities or games. The beach, terrible. You have to pay to go to a nice beach. What do I mean, dark, murky water. Excursions, very pricy. Felt as if I was in the states. 

Food!!!!, you can say I was limited on the variety of food I could eat. Forget having Lobster. We gave the chef $40.00 tip and he managed to gather up a couple of baby Lobster tail which he had to make an enchilada so that it could stretch   for 8 of us. And it was more of a sample, not a full meal. The buffet was very small and limited. Not all that bad, but when you get use to other resorts giving you a large variety, this place missed the mark. 
I suggest Cancun. Cheaper and more for your money. 

Good Luck!

reviews.author: MMF M
reviews.title: mala experiencia
reviews.text: habitaciones viejas , buenas instalaciones , poco entretenimiento en días de lluvia, mucha gente ofreciéndote excursiones y las que coges te engañan , camareros solo atentos para buscar propinas, buffet variado pero de poca calidad

reviews.author: Kav_OTT
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
Very pushy with timeshare
Outdated rooms with uncomfortable beds and noisy vents
Annoying dinner reservation structure for restaurants
Only one type of adventure for kids: gawking at captive dolphins!

reviews.author: LoveTraveling29
reviews.title: Less than Second class if you are not a Melia Hotels "Exclusive" member
reviews.text: We paid a premium through Delta Vacations for  a "Luxury" vacation only to find out that the upgrades were not honored by PPR unless we were in their club.  We had a room near the beach but were NOT ALLOWED to use the newest pool, bar, or beach chairs!  We were taken on a tour the following morning and shown "our" permitted areas.  Setting this insult aside, our name was not on the list of staff greeting arrivals, our room safe did not work and required three visits by two staff members to fix, the room was crowded and poorly designed with NO luggage rack, drawers for clothing, robe hooks, or room coffee and tea.  We were napping with the sign out when staff knocked on our door to install a new tv.  Management should have notified us of that ahead of time.  Concrete paths are painted black so they are broiling hot in the sun and have low visibility at night.  You can only access the resort activities schedule and the room service menu if you download the Melia app.  We were unwilling to do that because the resort does not offer a secured wifi network.  Staff were nice but unevenly trained.

reviews.author: anumanapi
reviews.title: Practical, basic, mediocre service
reviews.text:
We stayed 6 nights, 7 days with our 1 year old. Our room was “recently renovated” and our bathtub was not working, the AC made airplane sounds, our terrace had no chairs, our minibar was missing the regular products and the water from the shower ended ip on the bathroom floor. We called for everything and some of it was fixed. I asked for extra towels and extra pillows for 4 days in a row, they only came on the 4th day. We were assigned a concierge supposed to book our restaurants, she never did. Everything she did was wrong and the worse service. Towel guy was ob the phone when I went to get towels and pretty much offended when I interrupted his social call, waitresses and the buffet, rude and as of asking for favors was a sin. 
Really bad service from waitresses. 
It was nice to come and see, never ever coming back.

reviews.author: Brad C
reviews.title: Spotty Service
reviews.text: Arrived two days ago and have to agree with the other comments about service.  The ratio of people trying to sell you things vs what you've already paid for is comical.  I am bombarded by insisting vendors to buy cigars, photos, sunglasses and parasailing on the beach but there's zero chance of getting someone to fetch a drink.  Same at the pools.  There are friendly staff in the restaurants so not a total loss but whomever designed the service model should be fired.

reviews.author: Afsaneh I
reviews.title: More disappointment than satisfaction
reviews.text: We travelled with large group (20). Rooms were dated and not updated. Customer service especially room service was poor. Food was average to low quality. Nor a lot of activities. If it wasn’t for our own group having fun being together we would have been bored.

reviews.author: Sbelliveau
reviews.title: Believe the reviews. Go elsewhere!
reviews.text:
First, the positive. Beautiful resort, clean rooms, lovely pool, good food. Our request to change to a ground floor room for easier access to the pool and restaurant areas with the stroller was quickly taken care of.

Now the problems. At check-in, we were given no information, they did not even give us our wristbands. Next day, we booked a few dinners at the hotel restaurants. We were told a few were closed, it wasn’t a problem. They booked our dinner that evening at the nearby resort, but did not inform us we would be taken there by golf cart - something that should be mentioned when you have a 3 month old baby! As a result of not being aware our dinner was not in the normal restaurant area, we did not have what we needed to take the baby, and this caused delays, which caused us to miss our dinner reservation. 
Two days later, we decided to book our dinners for the rest of our 10 day stay. At which point we are told 9 of the 12 restaurants are closed!!! And, we are now too late to book the only of the 3 restaurants we like. (Despite the resort being nearly empty, it is practically impossible to get a dinner reservation, which leaves only the buffet which is always the same as lunch.)
Our concierge then says no problem, I will get you I to the seafood restaurant, and there is also Dominican Night in the lounge, where you can try local food. Turns out the seafood restaurant is not serving cooked fish this week, only sushi. And there was not food at Dominican night!
The staff are clearly not up to date with what is on offer at the hotel. It was impossible to find out as every person we asked gave different info. They seem to think the spa is closed, and anyway don’t know what services are offered there.
They seem to blame us for not upgrading our stay, saying we can get more restaurants and better service if we upgrade. However, the Royal Service is adults only, and so was not available to us as we are travelling with a baby.
Then, under the guise of offering us an upgraded lunch and free massage, they try to lure us to a timeshare presentation. But, it seems we were “poached” from our concierge by another staff member, so our concierge asked us to cancel this activity as it was booked by another staff member and he would lose his commission. It’s fine with us that he gets a commission, but very unprofessional to tell us this and ask us to change our plans to make sure he gets it.
Moment after he left after telling us this, the guy who poached us came along to offer us a day pass at the other resort. 
So we are constantly having to tell these two to talk to each other so we only have to deal with one person and stop getting conflicting info. I just want them to go away so I can relax on the beach!
The only positive reviews seem to be from those who booked the Royal Service, so unless that is your plan, don’t waste your money here!

reviews.author: hsosa2019
reviews.title: Desafortunamente no lo recomiendo. No tienen disposición en solventar inconvenientes del huesped
reviews.text: Durante mi reservación varias semanas de anticipación seleccioné por error una noche adicional. Pese a que lo comuniqué de inmediato no me dieron ninguna opción para reembolsarme o brindarme esa noche para otra fecha. Simplemente perdí mi dinero de esa noche adicional.

reviews.author: 2001Soccermom
reviews.title: Mini Family Vacation
reviews.text:
This was supposed to be a fantastic getaway based on the reviews I read...unfortunately, we couldn’t wait to return home. We had a 2 bedroom Master Suite on the main floor. The staff at this resort are friendly and do their best with what they have to work with. The rooms were dated and need to be upgraded, the buffet was disappointing as they serve the same thing at lunch and dinner. The beach was nice but the chairs were not very good. There is a lot of segregation on the beach...regular guest, circle guests and reserve guests.
There was pest issues at this resort where we had to have our rooms fumigated twice! We were there from Thursday-Sunday and had to call on both Friday and Saturday as we saw a cockroach on both days. My husband had to kill them both times. At no point were we offered new rooms considering the resort was not full I thought they would at least offer that. We were expected to return to the fumigated rooms with that awful smell! On Saturday night we went to the buffet for dessert as we had eaten at Banu Japanese restaurant (the only restaurant we were able to book in the 3 nights that we were there) and the kids did not like their desserts. When we looked at the desserts I noticed a cockroach crawling around the chocolate mousse dessert. We immediately went back to our rooms and started packing. We have been to many resorts and have never seen that before. We made sure the service department was aware and the front desk. I also a divided the dessert server at the buffet. 
We had been introduced to our concierge on arrival and exchanged numbers to message any questions or concerns which he responded for the first day and a half then we heard nothing after we advised we would not be interested in attending a sales pitch for the circle. Another tier of their resort.
For a resort this side I expected better. I will not be returning to this resort and would not recommend it to anyone!

reviews.author: luizedmund0
reviews.title: Propaganda enganosa
reviews.text: Quartos de frente para o oceano, mas mofados; serviço all inclusive na categoria real, mas me cobraram por uma cerveja corona na piscina; os bares das piscinas fecham à 18hr, mas desde às 17hrs não tem mais produtos básicos para servir, como saquinhos de batatas fritas, por exemplo. Em suma, foi a pior hospedagem em resorts que fiz em minha vida.

reviews.author: sjp3003
reviews.title: Expansive All-Inclusive with Great Beach, Mediocre Service and Convenience
reviews.text:
I am attending a three day Conference at this property.  This was one of the first large scale all-inclusive hotels in Bavaro.  

The good:

Conference facilities are very good, better than the Hard Rock for conferences 
Beach is beautiful
Rooms are nice, nicer than many newer properties although a bit dated.  I was right by the beach in a unit with a kitchenette, living room, bedroom, two TVs, large in-room jacuzzi and comfortable bathroom.

The not so good:
The property is huge, over 1000 rooms with other related hotels spread out throughout the complex.  Moving among these to meet other attendees is cumbersome and uncomfortable given the heat.  It can be confusing as well give them labyrinth of rooms and buildings. 

Service is mediocre: very slow check in, so-so service in restaurants.

Food was mediocre, and despite the all-inclusive moniker we paid $50 per person to dine at the Mina steak restaurant where the food was better than average but the ambiance was loud and less polished than an Olive Garden.

Granted, I am here for a conference which requires business oriented efficiency.  The negatives are less important for a leisure traveler staying one week without deadlines and scheduled meetings.  Nonetheless I would not come here to spend personal time simply because the property is unwieldy, massive, impersonal and service is mediocre....I’d opt for a smaller property.

reviews.author: j0l
reviews.title: Poor costumer service
reviews.text: People don't take ownership, poor costumer service. Unable to make dinner reservations when hotel is in low occupancy. Housekeepers screaming early in the morning. Trying to sell you the timeshare no matter what.

reviews.author: acruz-100
reviews.title: Beautiful place with BED BUGS!
reviews.text:
We arrived to the resort for a family member's wedding. Upon our arrival we were amazed at how beautiful the resort was but two nights into our stay my family and I received bed bug bites! The resort has horrible customer service. We notified staff who did not know how to respond to the situation. I had to ask for a change of sheets and to receive laundry service at no charge to us.

The resort did not offer us anything! No discount! No future free stay! NOTHING! Management didn't even contact us! We had to make all the request! What made it worse was the fact they wanted us to sign a waiver/disclaimer that the laundry service was compensation for the bugs!

We were very disappointed with our stay. However the food was good and the beach is nice and clean. We will definitely not be returning and I doubt any of the 25 other guests we were with will ever stay here either as they also had issues!!!

reviews.author: clara c
reviews.title: Moho y Humedad habitaciones
reviews.text:
Moho y humedad muy fuerte en las habitaciones
Al grado que nos enfermamos tenía que pasar todo el día fuera de la habitación para poder respirar.
Solo lo usamos en la noche para dormir y tuvimos que usar gotas nasales y medicinas.

reviews.author: Pofry
reviews.title: Save your money and your stomach
reviews.text:
Save your money and your stomach - I would not recommend the Paradisus Palma Real to anyone. My husband and I almost aborted this trip twice throughout the week but decided to stick it out (mostly due to the exorbitant cost of changing our plane tickets). 
Let me start by saying that we’ve stayed at a Melia Paradisus property in Mexico twice before, and were blown away by the impeccable service, friendly staff, beautiful grounds, great food, updated rooms, and lively activities there. I couldn’t even believe that the Palma Real is part of the same company. 
My husband and I had originally booked this trip with accommodations at the Paradisus Punta Cana (sister resort), but a week before our trip, Melia emailed us and said that they were moving us over to the Palma Real. Supposedly, a neighboring resort was starting construction and they assured us that this was to make sure the noise wasn’t disruptive to us. In hindsight, I have to wonder if it was just a ruse to fill the Palma Real with bodies. 
We stayed at the Palma Real from a Sunday – Saturday (6 days). We sprang for the Royal Service upgrade, which included a butler, access to a private lounge, private pool, and a private beach area, among other perks.  
At first glance, the hotel was fine. The reception at the private Royal Service lounge was great – they had snacks and drinks set out, and greeted us with a cocktail and cool towels to refresh ourselves. 
The moment we were shown to our room, however, it was a completely different experience. A very strong damp, musty, wet basement smell hit us in the face. We had hoped that opening the slider would air out the smell so we didn’t say anything at the time, but that effort proved fruitless. Clearly the AC/air purifying system does not function well. The door to our room didn’t even lock properly, and we had to slam it hard to double-check that it locked, which I’m sure was a nuisance to other guests. The room itself was pretty run-down and outdated, and whoever designed the bathroom to have a clear glass door to the toilet (with a door that doesn’t reach to the floor or up to the ceiling).   
The first night we had drinks at the bar, and subsequently ended up vomiting (at the exact same time) after about 3 drinks each. The booze is clearly watered down and cheap. Perhaps the ice cubes made us sick, or it was the alcohol itself, but we do not typically get sick at home in the States after just a few (weak) drinks. After that, our stomach problems started. No matter what we ate or drank (or even whether we didn’t drink alcohol), we were sick for days. At one point I had to run off the beach back to our room to avoid vomiting in the sand.  
The food options were very limited and not fresh (with flies all over it), and it’s clearly not cold enough in the room for the food. The meats and cheeses were sweaty and the sushi was warm. The majority of the restaurants ended up being closed due to so few people being at the resort. That often meant that only the buffet was open, with the same foods recycled from lunch to dinner. We also couldn’t find anything open after 9pm, so we had no options for a late-night snack (and that’s not even very late). Wednesday night we ate dinner at Rare and both of us ordered the chicken. I couldn’t eat more than half of mine because it was pink and clearly undercooked. I had to spend all of Thursday and Friday morning close to the bathroom after that. 
We had reservations at Passion restaurant but were turned away at the door because my husband was unaware of the dress code that requires only dress pants and no open-toed shoes. We were supposed to receive a full (free) meal as part of a promotion we received when booking our trip, but sadly were not able to take advantage of it.  It would have been nice if we had the information prior.  
Housekeeping was awful – when they “cleaned” the room, they consistently failed to remove the dirty towels and replace them with clean ones. In fact, one day when I thought they had brought fresh towels and reached for one after my shower, I discovered it was in fact my wet towel from my previous shower, just folded to look like it was a new one. They merely flushed the toilet rather than using any cleaning supplies on it (I know this because I was there when the maid came in). I had to text our butler to ask for the toilet paper supply to be replenished. I also requested on or about the third day that that fresh sheets be put on the bed because the bed was becoming increasingly damp and disgusting to sleep in (it was clear they hadn’t changed the sheets yet). A housekeeper knocked on the door, handed me two sheets  for me to change and promptly left rather than changing our sheets and blankets. 
Housekeeping staff was also consistently yelling to each other in the halls, which is what we woke up to most mornings. Again, I get that at home from my kids; not what I expect on a relaxing vacation. 
Our butler, Armando, was great. He was very attentive and available to text through WhatsApp. He even arranged for a special dessert and wine in our room for us when I mentioned the trip coincided with our 5-year anniversary. He secured palapas by the pool for us as well. He did an outstanding job and if there is anything positive it was him and the seating staff at the Buffett. 
The first evening we arrived, we walked down to the water to stick our toes in and were sad to discover an abundance of trash and seaweed in the water. The next day there were so many ‘vendors’ and beggers bothering us on the hotel beach grounds (including on the private Royal Service beach) that we gave up and spent most of our time by the pool instead - we never even went for a swim in the ocean (which is sad, because my husband and I plan trips because of the beautiful water). Unfortunetly it continued on the hotel grounds where vendors are set up all over the place and bother you through out the day to buy excursions or photos from them.They continuously tried to sell us things and do not let up no matter where you are. In comparison, the Paradisus Playa del Carmen in Mexico had staff on hand to security posted and we were never bothered once on hotel grounds. Not so in Punta Cana – they were approaching people as they walked out of the water after a swim. Again, I paid too much money to have to deal with that. I was also very surprised to see that no staff members came out to the beach to ask if we wanted food/drinks (they were very attentive in Mexico); the Royal Service package specifically advertises this perk. We probably could’ve texted our butler, but we also didn’t want to be glued to our phones on vacation.  
To avoid being on the beach with the vendors/beggars, we tried the large pool that’s available to all guests. Since there were no activities (DJ, etc.), quite a few guests brought their own wireless speakers to the pool and were blasting their own music all at the same time. Not relaxing. After that we didn’t bother with the big pool. . 
There were very few activities going on at the hotel in the evenings as well. I assume that’s because it’s low season (September). Still, I was expecting more. We were in bed with a book by 9-10pm every night just because there was absolutely nothing to do, and we didn’t want to have more than 1 tainted drink at the bar. My husband and I are in our mid-30’s - we like going out in the evenings while we’re on vacation and don’t have to worry about our kids.  
The staff also kept hounding us (following us down the halls and yelling for our attention) to go listen to their timeshare spiel, and it just got to the point where they were rude about it when we repeatedly said no. Again, we waited all year for this trip and expected to be able to relax and not be pressured into anything. They constantly would follow you around asking about their "special promotion", you would have to avoid so many places through out the hotel due to this and the "vendors".  It was just so, so disappointing. I couldn’t wait to go home after about 2 days, and I’ve never felt that way about a vacation before. Do not waste your money at this resort. 
We were going to make a complaint or talk to our butler about the issues, but after speaking to quite a few other couples that where having the same issues (Damp rooms/beds, constantly being harassed about timeshares and by vendors, and being sick). It wasn't just us. He was doing a great job, and we felt that these issues were out of his control, and more about the management and how the hotel was run. 
The only good thing about our trip were the two excursions we booked and were thankfully able to attend once our stomachs settled temporarily. We booked those separate from the resort. If you decide to still visit Punta Cana, I highly recommend Happy Fish Catamaran excursions – they were great. Just don’t bother with the Palma Real for your accommodations.

reviews.author: Marcela T
reviews.title: Decepcionada totalmente
reviews.text:
Habitualmente utilizamos la cadena Iberostar y nos fue siempre todo fantástico. En este viaje a Dominicana ntro. agente de viajes nos recomienda Paradísus Palma Real como un hotel de 5* que iba a superar todo lo vivido, y no fue así. Al llegar nos entregan una habitación"Deluxe" y una simple para mis dos hijas, al igual que al otro matrimonio amigo y sus dos hijos que viajaron con ntros. Las habitaciones Deluxe realmente eran un desastre. Terrible olor a humedad, viejas, sin lugar en placards para guardar ropa y una pequeña cocina que no tenia ningún tipo de equipamiento ni siquiera para calentar agua. Ni un hotel 2* tiene ese tipo de habitaciones.Cabe destacar que luego de ntro reclamo nos la cambiaron a otras un poco mejor. A mis hijas le dieron una habitación pasable, pero también con un olor a humedad insoportable, incluído uno de los colchones que durante las 9 noches de estadía estuvo húmedo totalmente. Al otro matrimonio le pasó exactamente lo mismo, anexando que su hija de 20 años tuvo que dormir en cama matrimonial con su hermano durante 9 noches. Nunca le cambiaron la habitación después de reiterados pedidos.El servicio a la habitación lo cobran u$s5, como no pasa en ningún otro hotel 5*.La comida siempre la misma. No tienen donde comer una merienda, solo un puesto en la playa con hamburguesas y salchichas.Falta información sobre los shows que presentarán por la noche.No tienen prácticamente actividades recreativas durante el día. La pileta tiene jacuzzis pero no funcionan si no es desde las 14 a las 15,30 hs.No hay juegos para niños, solo un ping pong. Una pena porque las instalaciones son muy lindas, pero eso no esta acompañado por un servicio adecuado a la supuesta categoría de este hotel.
Hicimos mucho sacrificio para poder tener un servicio tan pobre con una tarifa tan elevada , realmente una decepción al encontrarnos con todo ésto en ntras soñadas y esperadas vacaciones. Si de algo estoy segura, no me arriesgo a volver a elegirlos.

reviews.author: jdepesua
reviews.title: Pérdida de confianza
reviews.text:
Sin duda este hotel posee una de las mejores ubicaciones de la zona, buenas instalaciones y bonitos jardines Referente durante años como resort de lujo en la República Dominicana, parece haberse dormido en esas referencias, olvidado el presente y lo más importante, su futuro. 
Felicitar y agradecer a todo el personal su esfuerzo en que los clientes disfrutemos de nuestra estancia allí. Otra cosa ha sido la comida y los servicios. Resaltar la baja calidad de los alimentos, poca variedad, y repetición día tras día de los mismos platos. 
Sin duda un buen 4 estrellas, pero pésimo 5 estrellas.
Nos plantearemos de cara a las próximas vacaciones otras alternativas en la zona.

reviews.author: Jenny A
reviews.title: Muy mala experiencia
reviews.text: Desde que llegamos la habitación tenía mucha humedad, y la gran mayoría de áreas del hotel está restringido al uso de miembros de Meliá, en casi todos los bares y restaurante te dicen no lo puedes usar si no eres miembro, como con una tan mala experiencia quisiera hacerme miembro??  La comida malísima, el personal siempre está detrás de ti diciendo esto no puedes hacerlo como si fuera gratis que estoy en el hotel, la verdad no le recomiendo a nadie venir a vivir esta desagradable experiencia

reviews.author: RepDom87
reviews.title: Fin de semana ...terrible
reviews.text:
Lamento escribir esta opinión del Palma Real, estuvimos recién el fin de semana del 16 al 18 de agosto y fue un desastre total. El concepto que tenia de este hotel cayo al suelo.

La cantidad de personas en el  hotel que los enviaban desde otros hoteles por sobreventa de habitaciones fue  terrible. Un publico mal educado sin costumbres, el restaurante principal con las mesas sucias, uno se sentia como si estuviera  en un comedor económico de gobierno el día que llegamos nos quedamos sin comida porque simplemente se termino y no iban a sacar mas platos.

En el fin de semana no se nos acerco ni un camarero para ofrecernos  ni agua  ni cafe, el sábado debí salir yo al bar fuera del Noa para buscar mi propia agua, te decian sientese donde quiera.

De verdad que quedamos con un mal sabor y no esta en mis planes regresar a ese hotel de la cadena.

Lo único bueno fue la  habitación, pero después fue un verdadero desastre tanto con el servicio como con las comidas, reservar en restaurantes era imposible.

Trate de pagar un upgrade a otra categoría para tener acceso al restaurante aqua y tampoco se pudo.

reviews.author: kevinh0lt
reviews.title: Not great....
reviews.text:
Keeping it short...travelled end of July with my wife and 4 kids (10, 6, 4, 3 months)
No kids amenities and everything at the reserve is being renovated (although still selling the option online and only tell you when you arrive).

Near impossible to get dinner reservations as only 3 al a carte restaurants to choose from, even though online I believe it mentions there are 9. Found ourselves eating at the buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner which we didn’t go on vacation for.

Also no elevators unless you are in the adult only area when which we ended up being moved too. Not sure how I was meant to get to the 3rd floor with a new born and 3 kids.

reviews.author: 949douglase
reviews.title: In serious need of a renovation!!
reviews.text: We booked seven nights at this resort, but could only stay one night and then paid for an upgrade to The Grand Reserve. This resort is in serious need of a renovation. The rooms are old, decor is dated, closet doors don't close, furniture shows wear, showers leak...I could go on..wear & tear is evident. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained, but this resort is not what it appears to be on paper. Not a 4-star property for sure. We were very disappointed and probably won't go back to any Melia property at the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Dbeachlover
reviews.title: My fear came true! Can’t sugarcoat!
reviews.text:
Last time we were here was in August 2016. We were automatically upgraded to Family Concierge. The room was spotless clean and we had a great stay; hence the reservations this year. 

We checked in earlier today and are staying for 8 nights. Front desk staff are nice. Our concierge, Jose, is super nice and friendly and helpful (he’s the reason for 2 of the stars in this review)!

Hotel is not as crowded compared to when we were last here. 

We are put in room 3627. The room is worn.. like very worn! It is so moldy and stuffy(I am an allergy sufferer and have taken extra meds already!) The room is not as clean. There are sands on the bedroom floor and on the bed.  The sheets feel like they haven’t completely dried. The water pressure in the shower is very low.  There were not enough beddings for the pull out and we had to call 3 times before we got them. Bathroom sink was broken and they had to come fix it. Nothing close to the 5 stat luxurious experience we had 3 yrs ago. You think they treat their returning customers better, but apparently not! Disappointed and feel I’d have a better room experience at a different resort. Let’s see how the next 7 nights turn out!

reviews.author: Sewon H
reviews.title: The good, the bad, and the ugly
reviews.text:
Overall, I wouldn’t recommend the Paradisus Palma Real. There are lots of negatives but I’ll start my review with the positive.

The GOOD: the restaurants in terms of taste are quite good. I would say the the restaurants compare favorably to hyatt zilara and hard rock in cancun and azul resort in playa del carmen. The restaurant wait staff are attentive and polite. The pool is clean and well-maintained. The beach is beautiful but too much seaweed.

The BAD: Even though there are many good restaurants in the hotel, only the main buffet is open for breakfast and lunch. Moreover, for dinner only a few restaurants are open and therefore it’s quite difficult to get a reservation, meaning that you spend the great majority of time dining at the main buffet. (All restaurants except for the buffet require a reservation.)

They advertise golf as being free. This is quite misleading. The mandatory cart fee is $70 per person, and even with the $15 resort credit is quite expensive. The carts are nothing special — no gps for instance.

The work staff, excluding restaurant wait staff and bartenders, are not friendly.

The UGLY: even though the food tasted good at the restaurants and the waitstaff were friendly, our entire family of six were sick the majority of our stay. When we let the concierge know about the food poisoning situation we got no response.

The check-in and check-out process was the worst experience. They tried to put us in a distant room on the third floor of a building with no elevator access. We had two seniors, two babies, and a big stroller. How did they expect us to get around? When we asked for another room, they said that was the only option, even though the hotel was half empty given the season. When we refused the room and waited in the lobby for a hour, they gave us a room on the first floor but one that flooded each time it rained. The shower stall was also broken and was a safety hazard.

The check out process was equally terrible. We called that we were ready to check out and were told that someone would come for our bags. 25 minutes pass. We call again and they said they would send someone for the bags. 25 minutes pass again. I eventually chugged all the bags to the lobby (when traveling with kids there is a lot of stuff). When I told the staff about what had happened, no apology. Due to the delay we missed our opportunity to eat since the one restaurant that is open for lunch closed.

So there you have it: the good, the bad, and ugly. I don’t think I’ll be coming back to this resort and I certainly wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Wilma-792215
reviews.title: Esperaba mas
reviews.text: Fui a celebrar mi cumpleaños a Punta Cana, el día que llegue vi un cartel de cumpleaños en la puerta de al lado de mi habitación, al día siguiente era mi cumpleaños así que pensé que seria un lindo detalle recibir la misma atencion, pero no fue así, de verdad esperaba que un hotel asi tenga en cuenta los detalles que son importantes para los que van al hotel. El servicio debe mejorar, hay algunas personas que son muy amables pero otras que necesitan urgente capacitación en servicio.

reviews.author: Aziza B
reviews.title: Pas 5* peut-etre 4*
reviews.text:
C'est notre deuxiéme fois à ce Resort, la premiére fois on a bien aimé et c'est pour cela on a decidé d'y retourner; mais la derniére visite était une grosse déception sur tous les plans:
- Chambre beaucoup de bruits le soir des voisins de la chambre
- La nourriture chaque jour le meme menu, le buffet sur la plage il manque de lumiére au buffet c'est trés sombre
- LA PLAGE: ALGUES bourrée d'ALGUES C'EST AFFREUX
- Le service est nul, si tu ne donne pas de TIP on met pas les serviettes sur les transat dans la section The Reserve
- le buffet le service est médiocre
conclusion: on perd notre argent et nos vacances dans un Resort qui ne mérite pas 5*

reviews.author: EJCOLLINS
reviews.title: Boring Hotel, bad experience
reviews.text:
he service was ok, but the relation cost gastronomic offer very poor, every day offered the same menu practically in the days that I was hosted. also attended a conference and to our surprise the reservation staff of the restaurants did not want to take the reservation for them, I imagine that by order of the administration because we happened to several of the attendees, they forgot that although we attended a conference also We were guests of the hotel.

little plaificacion for the number of people staying on this date June 20 to June 23 at the buffet was a chaos because they closed areas of the restaurant and the tables were not enough for guests, in one occasion wait for about 5 to 8 minutes for a table with the plate in his hand.

The disco closes it very early 1:00 am, so when it goes out looking for something to eat, they enable the buffet restaurant as a snack but with only one employee to do it all; assemble food, cook on the grill, etc.

Also something ridiculous room service is free but they charge $ 5.00 for delivery, that is not free, you charge for the room service.

They have very few activities to entertain tourists during the day. It was not a very pleasant experience. I would not attend this hotel again.

reviews.author: Ric’NVic2015
reviews.title: This place is a ghost town- poor amenities
reviews.text: I will post more later but have time as my shower in the junior luxury suite takes 15 minutes to warm up. First comments are that the room is in disrepair. We were denied a birthday upgrade for whatever reason upon checking in and have encountered very unfriendly workers. Instead our room is located about 1/2 mile from the pool and lobby area. Requests at the front desk have been laughed at. We were here last year and had a great time. It appears half the resort is shut down and staff have been laid off. Half of the restaurants are closed and they appear to be doing nightly closures of differing restaurants. Who knew?  Seems we are paying full price for half the resort. Seriously it’s like an abandoned resort. Way less than half full is my bet. If you’re considering canceling and you can, I’d highly recommend it. I said to my wife if we had money we would go somewhere else, but I suspect the entire island is like it. The quality of food at the buffet has deteriorated since last year and one staff member basically confirmed new management combined with the news media reports have wreaked havoc here. Gone is the beach burger lunch. Gabi Beach bar is EMPTY at night. More later.

reviews.author: annak23
reviews.title: Rude Customer Service
reviews.text: We have not arrived yet but have already experienced rudeness at a high level! Originally booked to stay at The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana in a One- Bedroom Master Suite  - a family of 4 (2 children, 3 & 8) and upon calling to ask questions regarding the food/beverage safety (in regards to recent DR events) were bombarded with "Sorry, we have moved your reservation to Paradisus Punta Cana due to construction at the neighboring hotel." Needless to say my answer was I will be canceling this trip. At that point, I was transferred to another rep that told me we will move you to The Grand Reserve. Ok, so now we have tried calling The Grand Reserve with specific questions regarding the room because apparently (unless paid extra) your room is parking lot facing (was not the case in our original reservation) and the first rep had no knowledge of this reservation change and told me that I was supposed to tell him about this change and that simply providing the booking# is not enough. How can this be when supposedly all bookings from July-August are moved due to construction...hmm? When asked to receive a complimentary room upgrade for all of this hassle, well the phone call ended with an abrupt hang up by the rep (this was the 2nd such occurrence when trying to deal with customer service people at this resort). Throughout one of my numerous calls, the guest service rep kept repeating that I should "send an email" instead of calling. We have stayed at The Reserve Punta Cana and Palma Real before and have never experienced such rude and oblivious customer service people. We are now in utter concern not just about the food/beverage situation in Punta Cana but that we have been transferred to a hotel that seems to lack any sort of customer service etiquette.

reviews.author: Sightsee00153527469
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: My roo. Was not cleaned properly,  mini fridge was not restocked  daily unless I called and never refilled  the snacks for children in mini fridge , servers are lazy, had to eat many meals without water or drinks unless my husband grabbed the  drinks from the adjacent bars

reviews.author: Shai
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text:
Attended a wedding and also stayed few extra days beyond the wedding.  The buffet service was horrible.  Trying to get a waiter required an act of God. 

In addition, I used Kayak Search engine and then booked through Melia website, however, I was told, I did not qualify for the resort credit, since I booked through Kayak.  As I told numerous times on the phone, Kayak is a Search Engine.  Melia is whom I booked through.  My credit card charge was from Melia not Kayak.  I would never stay at a Melia again as a result.  Note, we have stayed previously at Melia in Cabos as well as Dubai, so you lost a customer.

reviews.author: Pam S
reviews.title: LACKING CUSTOMER SERVICE AND QUALITY
reviews.text:
Overall, I was underwhelmed with my stay at this Paradisus. I've stayed at other Paradisus and Melia properties and this has been the worst. The lack of customer service and quality in all aspects is disappointing as I've never experienced this from this brand. From the front office management, concierge, and overall staff, it wasn't the level to be expected at a higher end resort. No one seemed happy, lots of sullen faces from the staff, and even when they say "it's a pleasure" you can tell they don't mean it....

The quality of food was subpar. Nothing was special, all under-seasoned and the menus at the restaurants didn't make sense ..... There is limited options as well. At other properties there are several pool side food bars, lots of staff around the beaches and pool and at this one there was not. 

The beach was nice and the workers out there were the hardest working! They were attentive and ran back and forth in the heat. In the main lobby, most guest agents were on their phones with their heads down, no greetings and little English. 

Overall, I will not be returning to the DR to stay there ...

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.title: Poor spa experience
reviews.text:
I stayed with 2 friends at this resort from June 10-15. The 2 stars are for the beauty of the beach and resort. Other bright spots included a number of waiters and staff who were lovely and accommodating. 

Otherwise the trip was disappointing, especially compared to other paradisus properties. The food was not great and breakfast and lunch are both buffets. Our dinners were not booked in advance and we often did not know until 5pm what time dinner would be that evening. To our surprise several of the dinner restaurants weren’t good which again has not been our experience at other melia resorts. What really left a bad taste in our mouths, though, was our spa experience. We booked 2 massages and a facial for one of the days. The massages were a verbal special of $65 (usd) and the facial was from a book that also was apparently a special for $127. We asked if we could use the resort spa coupons for these services and were told not for the massages but for the facial and we repeated and clarified that the coupons could be used for the facial and it was affirmed that this was the case. Upon bringing the coupons to the facial we were told the facial was a special price and thus the coupons did not apply. We could not cancel the spa services as we signed an agreement that we would give 24 hours cancellation notice. Again, we booked the facial with the understanding that we could use the coupons. We spoke with several managers who kept putting off dealing with the situation to someone else and finally at checkout they refused to accommodate us and honor their word. Very disappointing customer service and surprising as again this has not been our experience at other properties from this chain.

reviews.author: Scott L
reviews.title: Service here is a joke
reviews.text:
This is a very beautiful resort.  Unfortunately, the staff is missing a common sense gene and despite what they consider to be their best efforts, they cannot provide good service. 
I was on a golf trip with 3 of my friends. We took Royal Service and each had our own room.  We were assigned a butler. His only task for us was to make us dinner reservations for 7:30 each night.  this proved to be too much for him.
Our butler could not get our dinner reservations right and on the third night, we were treated extremely poorly by the restaurant manager who basically shoved us out of the way to seat other guests.  We had to go to the Royal Service office and summon the butler to rectify the situation. The manager sat us and offered a begrudging apology. There were also several other minor stupid incidents that should not occur at a 5 star resort.  I will definitely NEVER go back there.

reviews.author: Carolina A
reviews.title: Cockroaches
reviews.text: We arrived on a Saturday night, the rooms were musty smell. We changed rooms, but they put us on the 3rd and 2nd floors, and my grandmother is 80 and there is no elevator. TG she is on great health. In the banna restaurant was full of cockroaches. we also found cockroaches in the room and in the main restaurant. I checked the guest service to complain but they did not give me an answer. we were wearing a vip bracelet, they said, but it was total neglect, over and over again. It is my compliment to the service, which despite working hard, always served us well.

reviews.author: Ken C
reviews.title: There are much better values out there
reviews.text:
Much overvalued, overpriced, and over-hyped resort. 

Horrible customer service - this was evident from very slow moving, talking-on-the-job front desk and food/drink service personnel.  May be it is a Dominican way of life to move on about things at a slow pace, but I am there with my family having dropped five large on a vacation on my own time and expecting a much higher level of service.  Keep in mind that we have been tipping generously for good service, which was about 75% of the time. 

Not family friendly at all - rooms have transparent bathroom and shower doors without an enclosed wall separating from the living quarters. This is suitable for adult only resorts but not for a place where kids stay in the room with parents. Kids club program is very subpar- there were no shows where kids would participate so we never used it (our kids were elementary school age). Lower rated Iberostar Punta Cana was the best resort ever with activities. Main pool has a very small wading area for smaller kids but otherwise is about 5 ft deep, which is a bit too deep if you just want to chill and are not in the mood for half a mile swim across. 

Room quality is pretty decent but my TV never showed a clear picture, and lights/safe control required service call to figure out how they work. Making a service call is a story on its own as dialing "0" from the room will not get you anywhere. None of the staff except the front desk speaks English, and they keep transferring you around the resort until you ask for a Front Desk. Asking for a Housekeeping does not work.  

Facilities - public areas are well maintained and show past glory, some majestic views from the moment you arrive, to marble lined buildings. Pretty nice. Grounds are very well kept. 

Food deserves a strong 4+ as it appeared to be less greasy and healthy than most other resorts we stayed at, but buffet menu was very repetitive, the same food was prepared day in and day out for the entire week. Out of all restaurants, giving the highest mark to Mediterranean and the lowest mark to Asian. There is decent standard liquor selection, like Black Label, Remy Martin, and one of the restaurants carries Grey Goose.  What pissed me off the most is having a reservation for 5 PM at a restaurant and having to wait 15 minutes sweating my face off dressed up in a formal wear until the staff will open the place- apparently managers take additional time for employee huddles, talking about the customer service, when the customer service begins with on-time opening. 

Entertainment - really weak in that area unless you like to spend more money at a casino or go to bed after dinner. Had only 2 decent shows (Michael Jackson show and Acrobats), and some funky crew beating in trash cans to make music for a show. Kudos to them for having a DJ with dancing ladies in the atrium, although that DJ really only played to himself lol. 

The beach is the single largest disappointment. There is a net to catch the seaweeds around the resort's beach perimeter that extends like 100 meters into the ocean, but either it is not deep enough or too porous, as the perfectly sandy beach and the water was covered in that crap 6 out of 7 days of our stay. 
After having traveled with family to all-inclusive resorts for at least 5 years, and having been to Dreams, Iberostar, Royalton, Palladium, in Dominican and Mexico, I believe this one does not deserve a price premium and there are much better values out there.

reviews.author: Ерёменко Владимир
reviews.title: Ужасные номера и сервис.
reviews.text:
Здравствуйте, мы прожили в отеле 12 дней, за эти дни произошло много вешей как хорошоих, так и плохих.
Во первых, ужасный персонал, горничные нормально не убирают, roomserves работает ужасно, в ресторане почти нет персонала повара стоят болтают.
Дальше, в отеле есть торговый центр, так вот, вчера мы стояли у остановки чтобы вернуться в отель, написано то что каждые 15 минут ходит автобус, мы его ждали 30 минут, но он так и не приехал, мы пошли пешком, пришли, а автобус даже не собирался ехать.
Горничныйе забрали наши купленные вилки и ножи так как на кухне нет не вилки, ни ножей, ни тарелок, не понятно тогда зачем она.
Все офицанты обслуживают идиально, особенно хорошо обслуживает Янира.
В номере текут потолки, по этому будте готовы просить полотенца на пол. В номере есть джакузи, работает только одна струйка из восьми и течёт хлорка, в душе очень долго переключаеться температура воды(минуты 2 минимум).
Единственное что спасает отель это пляж, пляж идеальный, но достаточно водрослей, советую идти либо в 6:00-7:00 либо уже в 16:00-19:00, в это время меньше всего водрослей.

reviews.author: NatalyaYa
reviews.title: Семейный отдых в Доминикане по-советски
reviews.text:
Поехали в этот отель по одной причине: здесь есть большой семейный номер. Но если бы знали уровень отеля, не поехали бы и бесплатно.
Плюсы: море и песок
Минусы: отель скорее похож на бизнес-центр и место для проведения мероприятий. Ежедневные толпы приезжих с бейджами заполняют отель и создают очереди на центральном входе и в ресторане. Ежедневно проводят вечеринки, но не для отдыхающих, а для приезжающих на конференции или свадьбу. Номера настолько старые и требуют ремонта, что в них находится-риск для здоровья.
