Also, the spa is offsite and while the front desk said it it not a problem to get a ride on a resort golf cart. The one from the hotel lobby was slow to arrive and they seemed annoyed we asked. After our massages were over the receptionist at the spa was similarly annoyed and after calling for one said no one could come and we would have to walk back. A 20 minute walk in 85 degrees and high humidity sort of undermined the relaxing aspect of the massage.

reviews.author: RPYo
reviews.title: Great expansive property but...
reviews.text: The rooms perhaps need an uigrade a bit. The food was not good - roomService basically had only a few things. Sadly while lounging at the pool one couldn’t order food there like any other resort ... and had to go to the buffet to get food. For us that was a big shortcoming. The 4-5 restaurants on site were ok, but mainly for dinner. Not coming back to this property.

reviews.author: Dream646808
reviews.title: Recent stay at the Reserve - family concierge and hotel not worth the money
reviews.text: My family and I recently stayed in a family concierge master suite.  PROS: beautiful property, some very nice people and AMAZING kids club. I would suggest people stay here ONLY if you have a child under 5 and want to use the amenities and kids services (club, pool, dining options).CONS: We did not feel pampered or think that the family concierge service was worth the money. Our cabanas were never pre-reserved (others had their names listed on the cabanas so that no one used them). We asked for ours to be reserved, but it never was. We did not have an issue finding an empty  cabana, but we were 2-3 rows beyond the beach.The major issue we had was that the property did not honor the 1000 USD credit as advertised on Melia.com. We mentioned it to them towards the end of our stay and we were told that we should've gotten it during check-in and because we hadn't, we could not  use it. The front desk blamed the family concierge, the family concierge blamed the front desk. I asked one of the staff members (Sandra) who knew about the benefits and she said, 'yes this is what you're supposed to get'. When I then ask her to communicate this to the front desk staff since we didn't get it, she mentioned something, then quietly walked away as if she did not want to point out that they did something wrong. In the end we were told that this problem would be fixed for future guests but there was nothing that could be done in our case (or even for my parents, who booked a separate room and arrived 3 days after us but did not receive their benefits either). General note: We did enjoy some nice benefits of family concierge (reservations at the restaurants completed by the concierge, nice bubble bath for our daughter, and general friendliness of the concierge) but it was hard to get in contact with her (only through WhatsApp or when we saw her). She was still friendly and we liked her, also other concierges were very helpful when I couldn't immediately locate my concierge.Full assessment:  the property is beautiful, the service is great when it's an off-peak time (the beginning of our stay was during a holiday and service and food was moderate to poor, but towards the end of our stay the service and food was much better). Some staff members tried really hard to make the experience great, but many didn't care or try at all (e.g. front desk staff). I'd definitely suggest choosing another property in this area because the overall experience was just okay, not great.

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.title: Esperava muito mais...
reviews.text:
Trata-se de um complexo de restaurantes, com um fraco complemento de alojamento.
A oferta de restaurantes é boa, particularmente o Restaurante de Buffet com uma oferta muito variada. Alguns dos restaurantes tem um serviço muito mau, desde o tempo de espera para sermos servidos, ao AC muito frio, haviam pessoas com os guardanapos pelas costas, para se aquecerem.
Houve uma noite em que tínhamos marcado jantar para as 21:00hrs e começamos a comer cerca das 23:15hrs, ainda fomos brindados com o copeiro (porque havia um vidro que nos permitia ver a cozinha) a comer em frente aos clientes.
Notória a falta de chefias ou muito pouco eficientes.
Quartos muito antigos, com manutenção desleixada, candeeiros de parede, com pinceladas da pintura, mobiliário com fechos ou dobradiças desmontadas, duche nem sempre se acertava a torneira ou a temperatura... Pedimos berço várias vezes porque temos uma criança pequena, nunca foi colocado no quarto.
Durante uma semana de estadia, nunca tivemos um serviço de quartos digno, ou não eram repostas toalhas, ou não repunham águas, minibar sem reposição diária. 
No dia do check out tínhamos voo às 23:30hrs, pelo que pedimos late check out.
Pediram-nos 250 USD para o mesmo, pedimos para falar com o director, ao qual nunca foi possível chegar, contudo, foi a frase mágica para um late check out sem custos.
Empregados desvalorizam os turistas europeus e focam-se particularmente nos clientes que falam ingles com pronuncia americana...
Não vale de todo o preço que se paga.

reviews.author: NobelMatos
reviews.title: Mucha decepción!!
reviews.text: Estuve visitando este hotel, despues de casi 3 años y la verdad es que me sorprendio lo que habia decaido el mismo vs la vez anterior que lo visite. Lo que más me llamo la atención fue el mal servicio al cliente de sus empleados durante las horas de almuerzo del buffet. Malas respuestas ante solicitudes que le hacia en buena forma y mucha lentitud para atenderme. La calidad de la comida estuvo pésima y poco variada. Todos los días era lo mismo siempre en las 3 opciones. El hotel se notaba muerto, sin ambiente, sino fue porque había un grupo grande de una empresa que siempre  se veia vacio y sin vida. Escuche muchas quejas de ese grupo en relación a las habitaciones, decian que no estaban adecuadas para su necesidades. Aparentemente no se dimensionaron bien para el tamaño del grupo. Quisiera volver algún día, pero antes averiguaré si las cosas han mejorado, porque de seguir así no vuelvo.

reviews.author: smira2018
reviews.title: Punta cana
reviews.text: Punta cana trip : hotel was nice but it was lacking in service for the the restaurants. The staff for food and beverage need to be trained better. Checkin and front desk and management were good and professional

reviews.author: Ali T
reviews.title: Resort is nice but Service  and food was terrible
reviews.text:
Booking directly from their website was a nightmare. They offer ‘discounts’ and promo codes that really end up being the exact same price as from any other provider or travel agent. They show the price in CAD but charge in USD so you end up paying more. When I called the call centre to ask why i was charged in usd they said it would have been cheaper to call in the reservation and to start a ticket with customer service. 5 days now and no reply. 

Check in was a nightmare. They asked for my credit card that I booked with. I didn’t have it. Rather than finding a solution they kept stating their policy. I offered to pay with a another card and they got so excited but wanted my first purchase refunded before I didn’t that and Said that would take a week and done by head office. 
I had upgraded to royal service but it was anything but at check in. In fact I was treated as peasant and a thief at check in. 
And the room wasn’t ready for 1 hour. Seems like that’s the norm they clean the room when you check in not prior. 

Room was ok, it was clean. No views. 
There are no elevators for anyone that has problems with stairs. 

Food was substandard. Cold and dry. Making reservations was difficult and restaurant hosts don’t make you feel welcomes nor are they helpful. Twice they made us feel uncomfortable or rushed us. Once they asked to go to the bar and wait for 10-15 mins and we ordered drinks and before the drinks arrived they said the table was ready. Once time the host kept looking at her watch when we were greeting friends at the door of the restaurant. Very unprofessional. 
The steakhouse rare was a disappointment. We were willing to pay the extra $75 for the tomahawk steak but asked to see the cut prior to ordering and they pretended not to understand English then after 5 mins they said they don’t have anymore. The best item on the Menu was the mushrooms. Each steak was a different temperature and cooked differently. 

Pallazzo is a nice peaceful place to eat for Royal service guests but again we arrived for breakfast and they said there is only 15 mins left to eat. They stood their while we looked at the menu in order to rush us. Food was substandard. 

Many of the service staff don’t speak English and you feel that they don’t want to be there or serve you. I’m always one to tip but I don’t feel they appreciate it. Asking for  bottled of water makes one feel like it’s a crime. One bartender hid the Johnnie walker black label even though for Royal service it’s included. 

The wedding venue was incredible. The decor and ambiance was superb. Beautiful backdrop with the pool on one side and ocean on the other. Service was good, bartenders super nice and never left your glass empty. Food was buffet and cold. Some of the stations didn’t have heat lamps or flames turned on. 

Overall the resort is nice. They public areas are renovated and updated. The rooms have the old decor. The beach has nice sand and plenty of space for tons of chairs and day beds. The water was murky and filled with seaweed. You cannot see the ocean bottom. 

Service needs upgrading. The ocean needs treatment so it can be used. It has potential to be a fantastic resort with some work.

reviews.author: franciscosotomayor
reviews.title: Hotel en decadencia.
reviews.text: Es mi cuarta vez en este hotel y lamentablemente no vale pena volver. Las habitaciones del servicio Royal Service no han sido mantenidas, la alimentación , el alcohol es de muy baja calidad, versus lo que vale.

reviews.author: jmalpica7136
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Took 3 days and multiple complaints to get warm water in BOTH rooms that we rented. Complained the entire time about the lights randomly turning off multiple times during the day in BOTH rooms as well and kept being told it would be fixed and it never was during our 7 day stay. Service on the beach is almost non-existent. Very difficult to get reservations at restaurants and they only have one restaurant for breakfast and lunch. Took several days to get dinner reservations. The beach was full of seaweed which isn’t the hotels fault but Mother Nature- just wish someone would have mentioned in their reviews because I wouldn’t have gone durning the summer.

reviews.author: amac2011
reviews.title: 3rd time not a charm
reviews.text: This was our 3rd time visiting the Reserve and sad to say that it was our last visit. The hotel is showing it's age with rooms looking a little worse for wear. We decided to spend extra money this time and reserved the family concierge, mostly due to the private transfer around the large resort. My 81 years old mother in law could not walk from the reserve to the beach however we could never get a bus and ended up waiting 15-20 minutes each time. Our concierge said to give him 30 minutes every time we asked for a ride to and from the beach. We called the hotel 2 days before checking in to ensure that my mother in laws room would be on the ground floor only to arrive and be told that our rooms were on the 3rd floor. The toilet in the room was broken and so we asked to change rooms or for it to be fixed immediately. We were told that it was fixed only to find out the hard was that it was not.....lets just say that we had to shower and wash our feet every time that the toilet was flushed. We were also not impressed with the buffet as only 1 person was cooking and so we had to wait 20 minutes for meat to be cooked. I realize that there is a lot of complaining in this review but there was nothing about the reserve that made it worth the money this time around. You'll see that my previous review of this hotel was great so you can imagine how disappointed we were this time around. We took time to speak with a manager called Janette and she nodded her head and said she would get back to us about our complaints.....we never saw or heard from her again. Just a total disappointment. We will try the Hard Rock next time and that would be my recommendation for anyone wanting to go to beautiful Punta Cana.

reviews.author: joe_cast_g
reviews.title: Not 5 Star or 4 Star or Even 3 Star
reviews.text:
How far this hotel has fallen since it open only a few years ago, so disappointing .

I'll start with the good as it is very short list:
Hotel renovations are beautiful including restaurant Rare and Brisas 
Really good workers - Santo at the club melia Beach is Awesome- setting up towels and chairs and bring drinks and asking if we need anything. He was very nice and example of a worker this hotel needs more of
Freemon our waiter multiple times was fantastic and WAS very nice to our children.  He was a pleasure and very attentive to our services 
Rare waiter was great his name was Nathanel.  He provided great service and our orders came out perfect which was not a normal
Santo at the Reserve beach was excellent, he got us towels, drinks, and refills every day throughout the day

Let's get to the not so good disappointments of the report
Robes were dirty and had fecal matter on them
We see many waiters at 8 AM for breakfast and then 8 PM for dinner and the next morning again at 8 AM.  What type of labor laws does DR have and even if there are poor ones should Melia treat their employees better, when do they see their families? 
Many of the managers would learn a lot from how the non-managers provide services
Bathroom and tub faucet came off when turning water off and on
Shower temp is wild from freezing to scolding during shower 
No umbrella in room
No extra blanket or pillow in closets, only two sleeping pillow in room
Ironing board in room but no iron - not sure what your suppose to do with that
Rare - 11 open tables inside and we have to wait 27 minuets past our reservation to sit, this is the norm at every resturant.  they tell you its booked so make you eat at the buffet, I did not spend thousands of dollars to be forced to eat in buffet.  Default policy is restaurant is booked please eat in buffet 
We met other people that said they had to buy the ‘premium’ drink package to get non domestic Dominican liquor
We met other people that said they booked with getting a $1000 resort credit and when they went to use we’re told the credit is only good in their Hawaii resort, but they don’t have a resort in Hawaii!!!!!!
Air conditioning return above front door leaked on tile causing very slippery area 
No head women chef or waitress in restaurant - see our picture of the hotels proud list of head chefs with not a single women
Living room bed pullout couch is extremely hard, like a rock
One towel per person so you need to lay on your beach chair towel and use it to dry off - then lay on wet towel 
The hotel is becoming less of a 4/5 start resort And more like a Howard Johnson’s motel 
The hotel does not clean the beach seaweed, Secrets Hotel next door has a machine and they continuous all day long clean, Paradisus is 4 hotels with beach front three times as big and had people cleaning by hand one time every other day.  The hotel says in other posts they clean the beach but it’s once every few days and they just dig hole and bury it.  Secrets next door removes it all down long non-stop - the hotel is choosing not to spend money in a machine to clean the back.  I don’t blame them for the seaweed but I do blame them for the poor effort to clean and remove it
You sink into the sinkhole landfills of seaweed on the beach When walking sometimes a foot downaQ just 
The hotel staff acts like they are doing you a favor when ever asking for anything, they are in hospitality service industry
everyone is rude and makes no effort to help
Golf karts take 10-15 minuets to transport between Reserve and Palma Real  
No hand towels in either bathroom sink 
Air conditioning cycled on and off very loudly and usually woke us up a few times a night

reviews.author: Maria D
reviews.title: PERSONAL POCO PROFESIONAL
reviews.text:
Hemos estado unos días en el Melia Paradisus Palma Real y la experiencia no ha sido como esperábamos ( elegimos este hotel porque nuestra experiencia en el Meliá Paradisus La Perla-Playa del Carmen fue excelente, de 10)
En Palma Real los empleados son mal encarados y no les sigues la corriente o si no les das la propina que esperan , o bien te dejan de hablar o bien te miran de malos
modos. 
Una cadena como Meliá no debería permitir bajo ningún concepto un comportamiento así por parte de su personal. Es una vergüenza que después de haber pagado un extra por el servicio Royal Service, recibamos este trato y hayamos tenido que pasar por malos tragos.
Muy descontentos con la atención de Su, de atención al cliente y de Martín trabajador de la parte de la playa de Royal Service)
Desde luego, no volvemos.

reviews.author: mcastroabella
reviews.title: Que decepción!
reviews.text: Que decepción! Resulta que hay varios niveles de “todo incluido” (cosa que no te explican al reservar) y si no eres “Royal” te maltratan hasta el punto de echarnos de unas tumbonas y decirnos que no podemos tomar cerveza de botella, solo de barril, por tener pulsera verde, ¡alucinante! Con el dineral que pagamos por el todo incluido! Cola enorme de más de media hora para hacer el check in. Los restaurantes no tienen mesas disponibles en toda nuestra estancia (por lo mismo, preferencia para los royals) y para colmo la playa está muy sucia, llena de algas lo que hace imposible el baño. El personal del hotel es muy antipático En definitiva, nada que ver con lo que anuncian. No volveremos!

reviews.author: Devin S
reviews.title: I Wanted So Bad to Like This Resort - Please Read
reviews.text:
I'm just a simple family traveler - 2 Adults, 2 Kids (8 and 5). Not high maintenance at all.

We've traveled to Punta Cana several times and always have stayed at Barcelo Bavaro Palace Deluxe. This was our first time at Paradisus and I want to share this as it could help those that are on the fence. Please see the highlighted pro's and cons below. 

Pros:
- Quick Check-in -- Took maybe 15 minutes -- they have a room escort waiting on you to show you around which is nice.
- Food is good. Always easy to find something for all parties. Bana was the best that we had.
- Beautiful grounds - Pool is amazing
- Workers are very friendly
- Drinks are made well.

Cons: 
Room
- I booked over the phone through Melia. Was told that I was booking a garden view one bedroom suite. We requested to be as close to the beach as reasonably possible and not on the first floor. What did we get....the last building that has one bedroom suites and is apparently next to another resort. This "other" resort plays outside music very late into the night. My kids were unable to fall asleep until 1:00 a.m. or so. View was a dirt road... The next morning we requested to be moved to what we had actually been told that we would get when we made the reservation -- they were able to move us to a building closer to the main area and on the 3rd floor. Room was much more updated and nicer (same floor plan)

- Hot water didn't work in shower only. Due to trying to make it to our scheduled dinner 
we had to take a bath. Not terrible -- just inconvenient. We survived. Reported the hot water issue to the maintenance team and they came to fix. Tip: Of the three knobs in the shower, you're only allowed to touch one. Good luck figuring out which one.

-- Getting extra towels is almost impossible. Took at least an hour each time. For some reason - we only received wash cloths once during the stay. 

All Service:
-- While deserved, you are fully expected to tip multiple times by the pool side waiters. They will wait for you to do so. Same for bellhops. We always tip very well, but have never had servers at Barcelo actually stand by and wait each time. 

-- You will get asked to purchase excursions EACH time you go to the beach. I never experienced this at Barcelo. Due to seaweed, we didn't have to go through this often since we didn't go much. The 3 or 4 times we did go, we were asked several times.

Restaurants:
-- We weren't picky about restaurants and wanted relaxation more than anything. Did hear of member of a family being hospitalized due to something she ate. We didn't have any issues. Also, the buffet is covered, but open air. This could cause seating issues if it rained as everyone would try to move closer in.

Entertainment:
Not even in the same ballpark as Barcelo. We watched the Michael Jackson show and people started to leave before it was over. Out of respect for the performers we stayed, however, it was the same with Lion King. Kids liked it just because it was the Lion King. Tip to resort: Please be easy with the light flickering/flashing during Michael Jackson.

reviews.author: Shrimp23
reviews.title: Time with my husband
reviews.text: So I apologise if this sounds long but I think there are a few things to let potential customers know.  Spent a lot of money with #britishairwayholidays included getting upgraded to a luxury junior suite.  There is nothing luxurious about the suite, handles on drawers in room non existent and just outdated, however I cannot compare to the other room to know if it was worth the upgrade.  Coming to the Dominican Republic from the UK you will get up early, breakfast opens at 6, they do not have tea or coffee making facilities for us early risers, I spoke to guest services about this suggestion because I could not see the manager, (more to follow on why I wanted to see the manager) but I think they just pay you lip service.  Putting tea and coffee making is such an easy win.  And yes I did have coffee making facilities but no fresh milk and my husband could not have tea!  Reason I wanted to speak with the manager is they say they offer a shuttle service to the shopping mall, in fact they took you on a golf cart after waiting for 10 mins.  As #BA left my husbands golf clubs in the Uk we thought we would see what the shopping had to offer.  Not much!  So when we left the security guard called down to the hotel to let them know we were waiting, he did this over 4 times and we were left standing for 20-30 in the sun.  There is no shade, then being the person I am I literally hi jacked the next shuttle that came along and got them to take us back to our resort.  When I arrived back fuming I asked to speak with the manager and surprise surprise could not.  Ok so now to the pool and beach, there is very little that can be done about nature so seaweed aside my observations.  Sunbeds for the normal people (me) who did not go for reserve or royal reserve service they were awful.  You could feel the bar under your back when lying on them, however in those other areas they have much better sunbeds.  They also have a policy of not leaving your beds for 30 mins that is nonsense.  I told this to guest services and basically shrugged his shoulders.  For me no problem, I get up early and bag myself a cabana as they don’t move your towels. This place could be so much better if they paid attention to the details for all their customers. I told guest services I did not require any special favours and I did not take any this is about making this place better.  I am giving it this review for the few people who I think have done well, Anna front desk, Rafael concierge, Luis swim up bar and Maria food reservations. While I am still here until Sunday room 3901 if a manger wants to discuss easy wins happy to.

reviews.author: Pete M
reviews.title: Disappointing Vacation
reviews.text: Great pool. Good shows and restaurants.  However I traveled with a party of twelve, ten of whom developed gastrointestinal problems.  Management acknowledged that the hotel's water system had issues, which was the reason they provided bottled water in our rooms.  No effort was made to communicate the issue to clients, nor a recommendation not to use the tap water.  Two of our five rooms developed maintenance issues.  One had a severe leaking ceiling.  Apparently remedial action was taken in the room above, but no one came to clean our room, even though we reported the problem.  The other room had a leaking toilet, which was quickly repaired.  Customer service was extremely sporadic, ranging from quite good to extremely poor with wait staff ignoring orders, bringing incorrect orders, taking orders and never completing them.  Overall a mess.  We will never return. to this venue.

reviews.author: OccasionalTravel7
reviews.title: Second and definitely last stay here
reviews.text:
Because I was pleased with this property a couple of years ago, I decided to spend half of our anniversary trip here this year. What a mistake! Let me start with the positives, though. The grounds, the pool, and the beach are lovely - if you are here just for that, then go ahead, book the cheapest room and enjoy yourself.
We wanted a little bit more, so we booked royal service, ocean front room. Besides the view, the upgrade didn't deliver this time. We didn't get the phone to connect with our butler (like I did last time and like it was advertised, and STILL is!!!, on the hotel's website). I was curious what was going on so I asked another couple how they liked their butler. They were pleased and told us they communicated via app that he, their butler, installed on their phone when they arrived. Our butler did no such thing!! Not only that but he was making restaurant reservation we specifically didn't want. The restaurants were empty even though we were told they were booked...
The food was also a big letdown. My favorite restaurant from few years ago, Vento, completely changed their menu - for worse. I wish we tried Aqua sooner, that was the only place we would go to again. The tasting menu at Passion was excellent! The buffet was disappointing - the cooling/heating boxes weren't on and flies were everywhere. We even saw a bug crawling in the dessert section. Yuck!
Beware of what you see on the website or what you might have experienced previously. The service is lacking, many amenities that were available are not anymore (there used to be snacks, 4 full size alcohol bottles in the room, sunscreen at the towel stand, greeters at the entrance, etc.). We were told the hotel was under new management and it shows - not in a good way. We stayed at another resort after and noticed another big difference - the butlers here walk around and hang out at bars in groups and seem like they don't want to be bothered.
The only person we have praise for is Anabelle from Care Team. She always delivered on what she promised.

reviews.author: Eric F
reviews.title: A Disappointment
reviews.text: I have been meaning to post a review for sometime but kept getting distracted.   This was my third visit to this resort which had become an annual visit in February of each year starting in 2016.  Much to my disappointment the overall quality of the resort has declined considerably.   The food wasn't well prepared other than the Japanese style restaurants.  Is was not tasty, or it was overcooked.  Rare, the steakhouse had very poor quality beef and twice during dinner we saw a cockroach.   The house wine is terrible.  They need to improve the wine choice that is available by the glass to customers.   At the buffet, either they're short staffed or staffed with poorly trained employees.   Everytime without fail, the tables were not set correctly,  ie. missing utensils, napkins or glasses.  Trying to get a cup of coffee was somewhat problematic as there seldom seemed to be anyone around.  During breakfast that should not happen.  There was a problem with the room which necessitated a room change.  Dirty dishes left outside rooms sat for hours and in 1 or 2 instances for a day.  I had planned to continue to stay at this resort because it is a beautiful looking place but after this experience I will most likely go somewhere else.  I loved it the first time, it was great.  Even last year it was pretty good but this year, a precipitous decline.  The only bright spots were some of the employees who were helpful and professional,  such as Wally who worked at the Reception Desk.  It is my sincere hope that the resort improves but until then I cannot recommend it.

reviews.author: smoochpop
reviews.title: The Paradisus at Palma Nope!
reviews.text:
Our stay at this resort was disappointing for the price we paid. This resort definitely isn’t worth the price or the trip to Punta Cana. 

Check In: Check-in took 3 hours. No exaggeration. When we got to the resort our name wasn’t on their list. So, we proceeded to the front desk. Our reservation was found, however, the booking only included two people when our party had four. We booked through American Express travel. So, although the suite could sleep four we had to call American Express(Amex) to rectify the issue.  Amex couldn’t reach the front desk or the appropriate staff to discuss the problem. Therefore, we spent 3 hours waiting, despite notifying the front desk that Amex was trying to reach someone to discuss the issue. Tired of waiting we asked for the manager and had to wait for the manager to come out of a meeting. Whether this was fault on Amex or the resort we ended up paying $1,000 more in order to check in to the suite that we had already paid for with Amex. Amex later rectified the issue since they determined that we booked the suite for four people and not two. Regardless, waiting 3 hours was unacceptable and the resort could’ve dealt with that issue in a more customer oriented way. 

Staff: The staff was a mixture of pleasant and unpleasant. Some were knowledgeable and some were not very knowledgeable of the resort or couldn’t answer simple questions.  If you tipped the staff a few dollars, they’d go above and beyond to serve you. Overall, the staff was ok. 

Cleanliness: Cleanliness was average but there was much effort to maintain the grounds. The hotel is in need of renovations soon. I did see a roach in the buffet area, which is almost always unacceptable.  As an all inclusive resort there’s limited oversight on cleanliness in the buffet area, which can easily cause an illness outbreak.  

Rooms: The suite was nice and included a full kitchen. Cleanliness was average. Housekeeping was a hit or miss. We had to call the front desk for towels and items, such as tissue, weren’t replaced regularly. When the tissue was finally replaced, the box of tissue was placed on top of the tissue holder. The only indication that housekeeping came into the room is the fact that the bed was made. Also, the phone didn’t work and the tv channels indicated “lost signal”. 

Gym: The gym was very nice and well equipped. 

Internet: Wi-Fi was available throughout the resort. However, the Wi-Fi was spotty and slow. For the size of the resort, I’d say the WiFi was good. However, if your room was on the top floor (3rd floor in our building) there was no signal for WiFi. 

Pool: There’s one big pool and a small pool for “The Reserve” guests. The Reserve was another boutique like hotel on the same property. The big pool was nice. It included a swim up bar and lounge seats. 

Restaurants: There are several restaurants on the property. Our reservations included 7 restaurants. Two specialty restaurants were also optional and cost $80 per person. None of the restaurants did it for me. The food wasn’t great. Therefore, didn’t bother signing up for the specialty restaurants because I was already on edge with all the other issues and didn’t want to add fuel to the fire. 

Activities and events weren’t communicated effectively. Usually, we’d find out about an activity/event by passing by and seeing the set up or by inquiring if there are any activities taking place that day. 

Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this hotel or resort (there are several hotels under this international group and the property). When our reservation didn’t reflect what we booked on Amex they wanted to charge us an additional $3,000 to add the two more guests. I was ready to walk away although I didn’t know where we’d stay. But, after hours of explaining that we did indeed book four and not two, the manager brought the price down to $1,000. What a significant difference in price. 

Also, I’d like to give a special thank you to the staff members who displayed exceptional customer service and made our trip somewhat enjoyable. These staff members also made my daughter’s birthday special, which was the reason we went to Punta Cana:
Johnny - waiter in the Rare Steakhouse
Davidson - waiter at the buffet 
Carolina - concierge 
Kateri - concierge 
Euri - waiter during dinner on the beach
Angel - waiter at the buffet
Antonio - waiter at the buffet 
Anna - front desk
Whali - front desk manager

reviews.author: washedoutjeans
reviews.title: Find better options elsewhere
reviews.text:
This is a review for both the Luxury Junior Suite and the Reserve Beach Luxury Junior Suite Ocean View. 

Luxury Junior Suite - no information was given at check in as to amenities, activities and the likes. When asked, the staff don't bother to explain any more than giving you a standard booklet filled with ads and little useful information. I was handed a total of 4 books after one day, but was left still confused. The room is small and very dated. The linen, towels and bathrobes should've been thrown out 50 washes ago. The bathrobe actually looks grey and feels like sandpaper. Counter and table top was dirty and greasy. Housekeeping was sloppy with the bare minimum done. Room service also has a $5 surcharge. For an all inclusive resort how does this make sense? The only good thing about the regular non-Reserve rooms is they're close to the beach and the majority of the restaurants. I upgraded after one night.

Reserve Beach Luxury Junior Suite - one of the more luxurious rooms in the resort, and is close to the beach. The other types of “Reserve” rooms were in another hotel 10 minutes away and is a hassle coming back and forth to the beach. The rooms much more modern and better furnished and has a nice view of the ocean, on top of being very close to it. The towels and linen feel night and date compared to the regular room. The staff for the Reserve were noticeably more friendly and helpful. You also have a concierge to help reserve restaurants and cabana in the exclusive section of the beach. The cabanas are only reserved up until 11AM, after that it’s first come first serve. Beach towels are provided ONE PER PERSON. Each guest is handed ONE towel card when you check in, and it’s used to exchange for a towel at the beach. There is nothing "luxury" about that. If you must come here, be sure to get a Reserve room. The non-Reserve rooms feel like an abandoned part of the resort. 

Food - all inclusive food options were identical for both rooms so don't make it a factor for potential upgrade. The buffet is just awful, with limited selections and just plain bad food. Flies were everywhere, tables and silverwares were sometimes not clean, making it a very uncomfortable experience overall. The restaurants were better, but there is very limited breakfast and lunch options so you're forced to the buffet quite often. The restaurants were actually pretty good, especially fuego and Aqua. The steaks were good in all the restaurants we tried. All the restaurants claim to have a dress code but it is rarely and selectively enforced. 

Despite the beautiful (though seaweed-ridden) beach, the overall experience provided by this resort leaves alot to be desired. A little more attention to details and better staff training can make a big difference, and the experience here was enough to keep me from returning to Punta Cana in the foreseeable future.

reviews.author: yasminvyferretti
reviews.title: Lastima ,!! Arena excepcional Algas impiden baño
reviews.text:
Había un congreso médico que produjo saturación en los restaurantes, tenían reservados la mayoría de ellos.
Playas y arena excepcional calidad, pero presencia de algas que ensuciaban el agua e impedían el baño

reviews.author: rafaelasetenta
reviews.title: Pós atendimento péssimo
reviews.text: O hotel tem uma estrutura boa. A área externa é ótima. A comida do buffet deixa a desejar, mas os restaurantes são bons, especialmente o Rare e o Mizu. Éramos um grupo bem grande, aproximadamente 30 pessoas, era casamento de uma de nós. Então, a farra foi boa, mas seria em qualquer lugar. Não voltaria a esse Hotel com grupo pequeno ou só casal. Até porque a praia não é maravilhosa (maravilhoso foi o atendimento do garçom da praia: Fernando Gonzalez). Vale a pena se for uma turma bem grande! O PIOR DE TUDO: infelizmente, FUI FURTADA DENTRO DO MEU QUARTO. Fiz a bobagem de não usar o cofre. Deixei minha carteira dentro da mala trancada todos os dias, não peguei pra nada, até porque você não precisa usar dinheiro no Hotel e nós não saímos. Porém, esqueci a mala aberta um dia. Quando me dei conta fui verificar na carteira e faltavam 100 dólares (verifiquei que também faltava meu cartão de crédito, mas já estava no aeroporto). Então, fiz a reclamação lá mesmo, no Hotel, preenchi um formulário e assinei. Disseram que fariam uma investigação e me dariam um retorno por e-mail, porque isso aconteceu na véspera do meu retorno. Perguntaram se eu queria acionar a Polícia, mas eu disse que não seria necessário (me arrependi). Sei que o Hotel só se responsabiliza pelo que é deixado no cofre, por isso não esperei em momento algum que me devolvessem o dinheiro. Apenas esperava uma postura mais decente do hotel. ACREDITEM, 8 dias depois do meu retorno, não tinha resposta do hotel. Então, enviei um e-mail copiando todos os e-mails do Melia que encontrei na internet. Aí sim, já perto de meia noite, responderam o e-mail dizendo que entendiam o meu "sentir", mas que depois das investigações que realizaram, NÃO IDENTIFICARAM O ACESSO DE NINGUÉM NO MEU QUARTO (BASICAMENTE INSINUARAM QUE EU ESTAVA MENTINDO). A diária do hotel custa 500 dólares, ficamos lá 4 noites. Realmente, não faz muito sentido eu inventar que me roubaram 100 dólares... Enfim, numa situação dessa, o que esperamos de um hotel dessa categoria é uma postura decente, profissional. Um pedido de desculpas pelo inconveniente, para se dizer o mínimo. Não recomendo.

reviews.author: Dayanara O
reviews.title: Mucho que mejorar...
reviews.text: Tenía muchas expectativas respecto a este hotel ya que me habian hablado muy bien pero la verdad es que esperaba mucho más... Empezaré por lo bueno... Me gusta la vista de la playa inmediatamente llegas a recepción, la habitación que me tocó estuvo bien, la cama muy cómoda y el personal del area muy atento... Peroooo... de inicio fué MUY confuso encontrar dicha habitación, me pareció complicada la señalización de las villas, es como caminar en un laberinto... La comida “buena” aunque nada del otro mundo, el servicio en el buffet muy deficiente quizás por falta de personal (mesas sucias, falta de cuberteria, mucho tiempo de espera para encontrar algún lugar donde sentarse, recibir un café o un vaso con agua)... Lo peor, muchas historias  de robos (celulares, dinero en efectivo) en las habitaciones y hasta un atraco DENTRO DE LA HABITACIÓN de una compañera... Obviamente estas situaciones son alarmantes y por ello considero este un lugar no recomendado y al que no pienso volver...

reviews.author: sissy516
reviews.title: Servicio malo
reviews.text: Estuve 4 dias en este hotel durante un congreso. Fue una experiencia decepcionante, habia estado hospedado ahí hace años y me habia encantado, estaba feliz por volver al hotel paradissus palma real. Esta vez fue horrible, parece que cambiaron la administración del hotel, el servicio de restaurant pésimo, la comida mala, el persona poco amistoso, parecen siempre estar cansados y agobiados por tanto trabajo, siempre estaban discutiendo entre ellos y quejándose aun delante de los huéspedes. Me sorprende leer tan buenos comentarios de este hotel donde le dan 5 estrellas, en mi opinión no volvería a hospedarme en ese hotel, su precio es muy elevado para el servicio que ofrecen. Lo único que puedo resaltar como bueno es el club de niños y el restaurant aqua.  Una advertencia cuando se hospeden ahí, cuiden sus pertenencias y guardarlas en la caja de seguridad de la habitación .

reviews.author: Joseph Y
reviews.title: DON’T GO TO THE SPA - WASTE OF MONEY!!
reviews.text:
1. My first suggestion is to inform your guests to allow at least 1/2 before massage to get there and check in.  I was not informed that the Spa was a significant distance from the main hotel building.  So allow for walking or taking a golf cart and filling out forms and checking in.
2.  By the time I realized it was ways away it was 1:50pm - I got there right at around 2:03pm.  But there was no sense of urgency - everyone took their time. I finally met my therapist at around 2:20pm.  
3. The facility itself is open air - even the changing rooms!  So I was already sweating and hot when I met my masseuse. Don’t understand that at all given the humid weather. 
4. Therapist confirmed a deep tissue massage; walked me into the room (which was air conditioned - yay) and instructed me to disrobe and position myself face down on the massage table, which is normal.  But I t took her longer than I’m used to to return to the room. Again, just super slow - no urgency given the $3 a minute rack rate.
5. No pre-massage interview to confirm any problem areas, my my previous experience with massages, or any special instructions from me. She just got started.
6. She started with putting her hand underneath my face so that I could smell the eucalyptus oil.  The smell of her hands from previous massages where not pleasant and contrasted with the oil.  Then she began in the left leg and essentially spent the first 10 minutes lathering oil up and down my leg with very little massaging going on. 
7. After a while, I asked if she could move on and focus on my lower back (to give her a hint that what she was doing was adding no value) and she said that it was an 80 minute massage (I.e. I’ll get to it eventually) and got a bit annoyed at the suggestion. 
8. But this was unfortunately how the entire massage went. 10% massage and 90% rubbing oil up and down that area of the body. 
9.  When she got to my hands and feet, she did not take the time to individually massage each finger and toe as I am used to and to take her time with these important areas.  She just quickly rubbed a couple of fingers and moved on. Same with the feet - she focused on my arch but not the entire foot.  
10. There is too much additional detail to provide but there isn’t enough space here to provide it.  
11.  Enjoy the property but don’t waste your money on the Spa.

reviews.author: TrevA77
reviews.title: Nice hotel but staff not that friendly
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel for a conference for work. The work function was only three days, but I added on an extra two days at the beginning of the trip for a total of 4 nights / 5 days. The hotel was clean and stylish. My standard room was large with separate living/sleeping rooms. The furniture was a bit dated. The couch was incredibly uncomfortable. I think it was a pull out bed, but I couldn't even sit on it, so I couldn't imagine sleeping on it. 

The pools were incredible but close at 6pm. It was very hot, so I spent much of my time in the pool under a shaded cabana overhanging the water and making my way back and forth to the swim-up bar. 

The swim up bar, lobby bar, and beach bar were all quite good, with an excellent selection of liquors, juices, and blended drinks. The alcohol seemed to be watered down, as they would mix the drinks 50/50, but they didn't taste that strong. That's probably a good thing as it kept me from getting too drunk :)

The main reason for my overall poor rating of the hotel was the staff. At other 4 and 5 star resorts I have stayed at, the staff go out of their way to make sure I am having a good time. Here, they didn't seem to care one way or the other. None of them were rude, but they didn't do the simple things like saying hello when I pass by or checking on me while I was eating at the buffet to see if I need anything. In fact, every buffet meal I had to wave someone down for a coffee, juice or other drink. And even then, they often said they were getting it but never came back. I also noticed that when walking towards a staff member, rather than them getting out of my way, I would always need to step aside for them to pass. Not a big deal, but it took away from the 'pampered' experience they tout on their website. 

Another problem for me was the lack of English speaking employees. There were a few employees that spoke English well, but most of them didn't speak any or spoke very little English. I understand this is a Spanish speaking country so there is no requirement that they speak any English, but I don't speak much Spanish, so it was difficult for me. In my many other experiences traveling to all-inclusive resorts that cater to international tourists, most everyone spoke English quite well, so I was surprised here. 

Overall, I had a good time, but would not go back.

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Stayed here for son’s destination wedding. Very disappointing. IBM was having a huge event during our stay so all they were worried about was accommodating IBM. My son’s reception spot was changed to accommodate them. He had reservations at the spa the day after the wedding with his new wife that the resort tried to change to the following day. When he said no, they then tried to change them to later in the afternoon. We could not get the room we wanted. The buffet was closed down for IBM. They never told my son when they booked that this was happening the same week. We tried to go the casino one night and security had to escort us because IBM was taking up the entire center of the resort and they wouldn’t let anyone staying there to walk through. Too many restaurants closed during the week at the same time. With the limited buffet this made it difficult to eat. Only highlight was Davidson, a worker at the buffet who was outstanding service! Very, very disappointing for all the money spent and would definitely never stay here again.

reviews.author: TheKatt
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
My husband and I visited this resort for 6 days. Not worth the money! They say it is “all-inclusive”, that is certainly NOT the case. 
You cannot use certain pools, restaurants or parts of the beach unless you “up-grade” for more money.The beach is UN-SWIM-ABLE, unless you are with a large corporation, who happened to be arriving as we were leaving. The seaweed was piled up for 4 feet, until this group who booked the entire resort was due to arrive that day.
Then the trucks were out at dawn making the beach pristine, the lobby had flavored water out and a medical center appeared.
None of this was a priority for the ‘Gen-pop” paying client. Could not use the beach what so ever. The seaweed was so thick and the smell was worse from it sitting there for days on end in the hot sun.
Pools were crowed with meatheads, kids and the party crowd who threw their cups and straws from the swim up bar into the pool rather than return them to the bar.
The room was identical to one we stayed at in Cabo San Lucas last summer for a third of the cost. Beaches, restaurants and local culture were far better there.
Food was average at best, as the “good” restaurants were reserved for the “higher” paying guests who “upgraded”
The only saving grace was the staff. They were wonderful people, kind, helpful, they were the best thing about this money hungry resort where everything was an “upgrade at an extra cost”
Would never return, will be taking my money and going back to Cabo, where the food, hotels and beaches are better and it is a third of the price!

reviews.author: louloutte9117
reviews.title: VACANCES AU SOLEIL
reviews.text:
Nous revenons de l'hotel PALMA REAL ou nous avons séjourné du 4 au 12 juin 2018 . A notre arrivé vu de la réception à couper le souffle !!!! On nous attribut une chambre très correct avec lit balinais très confortable . Les restaurants du soir à réserver sont très correct en particulier LE PASSION qui est succulent !!!! pour le reste concernant le buffet il est répétitif !!!!! toujours la même chose !!! sauf le jeudi soir ou il propose de la langouste .

Le massage est un peu cher mais très bien . Voici notre ressenti concernant cet hotel .. Nous avons croisé tout les jours des dominicains assoiffé de DOLLARDS …
Les sourire ne sont que de façade …. Toujours à essayer de vous soutirer de l'argent de façon orale … C est notre quatrième et dernière fois que nous allons en République Dominicaine .

Le bar de la réception est peut être le pire , ils font la gueule à tout bout de champs …
Mon mari commandait les cafés et faisait le service jusqu'à notre table !!! Un peu limite pour un 5 étoiles je trouve . Aucune ambiance le soir aucun buffet à théme donc nous nous réfugions au casino au sein même de l'hotel et là surprise ; des américains débarque le soir en hurlant pendant que nous essayons de jouer personnes ne leur disait rien … Ce sont les rois là bas car eux doivent lâcher un maximun de pourboires .

Ils ne parlent pas français ce qui à rendu notre séjour un peu plus compliqué . Les cocktails sont servi dans des gobelets : 5 étoiles vous dites ???? Personne nous à proposer à boire durant notre séjour , vous devez allez chercher vous même à boire à deffaut de mourir de soif LOL . Cerise sur le gâteau en partant ( et c est la seule prase française de notre séjour ) une personne de la récéption considérer comme étant la BOSS , nous dit : vous faites le check out , vous aller BOUFFER , et vous partez !!! Attitude parfaitement inadmissible vu le prix payé pour cet hôtel , ce n est ni profesionnel ni sérieux . Un conseil vu le peu de différence tarifaire optez pour l ile Maurice ou ils sont chaleureux hospitalier et accueillant …. PS Je sais d avance qu ils vont répondre qu ils vont faire remonté les infos mais tout est faux LES DOMINICAINS N AIMENT PAS LES FRANCAIS .

reviews.author: Mariya
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
This hotel came highly recommended by a reputable event planner, and by multiple colleagues of mine, so my expectations were quite high going into this. I have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and was blown away, I was almost certain that I would book my wedding reservations here (30+) rooms, and visited just to give myself peace of mind that i was making the right choice. Unfortunately, I was beyond disappointed with my visit. 

From the moment we entered the property, the staff was less than accommodating. The security gave my mother and I a hard time to get into the hotel because we were arriving late and without luggage (my fiance and father had arrived a few hours earlier). They forced them to come out and vouch for us before we were able to get out of the taxi. 
Additionally, they over charged both my father and fiance despite the fact that we had already paid for our stay through the wedding coordinator (I and the hotel have those receipts and we are still waiting for our refund it’s been weeks). 
The hotel wedding planner never confirmed our site visit and never went out of her way to make us feel welcome. The wedding coordinator at the Paradisus Punta Cana also neglected to give us the time of day and fetched a staff member to tell us “she’ll be in her office if you need her”. 
Take all of this into consideration if you are planning to reserve rooms for your wedding here. Now for the review of the hotel itself. 

Pros: it’s nestled on a beautiful beach that had little waves. The sand is super soft and they really keep the area clean. Plenty of beach umbrellas to go around which was a plus. The grounds are also beautiful and well maintained. The drinks are strong and high quality. They have a few activities like Zumba every day and some entertainment at night. We enjoyed the a la carte restaurants especially the Italian place. That’s about where the fun ends. 

Cons: the staff. Again having visited Paradisus in Cancun and after coming from the Hard Rock PC where the service was impeccable, I was less than impressed with their lack of hospitality. The staff just didn’t seem to want to help in any way. We had to ask over 4x during breakfast to get some juice, and the front desk could care less about our concerns. 
The rooms were outdated, with the most bizarre shower. One of our friends complained about a moldy smell in his room and the hotel did NOTHING to help him. 
The food at the buffet was below average, with the quality being significantly lower than other luxury resorts. 
You are not allowed to have food near the pool or even the outside bar. They literally have signs on the TABLES that say “no food allowed”. Bizarre. 
They serve drinks in poor quality paper cups that are flimsy, and I got yelled at for bringing glass near the pool. If that’s for safety reasons then I completely understand, however the way it was communicated to me was not appropriate. 

My advice to anyone who is considering to plan their wedding here is....don’t.

reviews.author: Rich  Sam S
reviews.title: Not satisfied
reviews.text: We had Royal Service.  We did not feel accomodated by our butler. Food was pretty horrible.  When at an all inclusive do you have to pay for booze? There was a lot of seaweed on the beach.  Wouldn't recommend.

reviews.author: Timhbca
reviews.title: Average and over priced
reviews.text: Grounds are pretty nice. We thought the food was average at best.  You have to make reservations every night for the restaurants, yet each we went to was half full. The room we had was very dated. They advertise flat screen TVs, but they're circa 1990s.  They look to have kitchens, but there is nothing in the cabinets, and no way to warm up anything or cook in your room. We had a "garden view" but our balcony was on the back side with a noisy hotel in the back and construction materials laying around.  The entire week, our bedroom air conditioning smelled like urine when it ran. We went to the front desk to complain 4 days/times, and nothing changed. I even requested a move, and they said they would get back to me and never did. Their solution once, was to spray an air freshener in the vent; 2 hours later same smell. We also went to the front desk 3 different days, as the phones didn't work to call them or room service. While we were there, there was so much sea weed in the water, you couldn't even get in the ocean (last week of May). There are signs to lock things up, and you need to. Not sure if it's housekeeping or maintenance, but several things were taken from our bags, as not everything would fit in the small safe. The beds are not comfortable at all. The only way for the TVs to work was to reach behind and wiggle the cords. We had maintenance there 3 times, and they told me there wasn't a problem; clearly both TVs had a short. We did not feel the staff were overly committed to customer service. It almost felt as if they were doing you a favor when asked for help.  It's our first time at a Melia resort, not sure we'd do another if this is typical. Our room was nearly $6k for a week (2br), but we felt it was way overpriced for what you get.  Our room was a 8-10 min walk to the beach. We've spent less at other resorts and got way better service/more imenities.

reviews.author: HB80
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star
reviews.text:
We are currently 3/4 Of the way thru our vacation, and I thought I would contribute to the reviews that helped us make decisions regarding our trip.

First off, I am extremely familiar with all inclusive and non all inclusive vacations. I will be fair and just in my review, No nit-picking of minor annoyances we should expect.

At check in we, and all others were passed off 3 times to various concierge members. We felt they were drawing out the process of checking in. We were advised to show up on day 2 for a meeting regarding our trip. This is standard and it is actually not necessary, it is their opportunity to try to sell you on excursions. They lure you with "you need to confirm your return shuttle"

We had a concierge member escort us to our room. They will sweet talk you and offer to make you your 4 restaurant reservations. They will also tell you they have been approved to provide you with a free massage, however the hook is you must go attend a timeshare presentation off property at their new hotel. We were all given the same pitch. You also have a concierge in each villa who essentially is without a role. We asked them 4 times for a luggage rack and finally gave up. We still have the initial concierge from the check in process approaching us throughout the vacation trying to sell us on something or 'help' us, we tipped him anyways but it annoys me there is so much deceipt in this place.

A la cartes have not been very good. At all. The so called buffet at The Reserve is only open for breakfast and lunch, dinner is off a limited menu. This means we are shuttling to the main property every night.

The property is too large for our liking. Shuttles to everywhere. 

There is zero consistency for entertainment and kids club as others noted. The schedules are all incorrect. They cancel, change, and add activities on a whim. The kids club area is not at all like the pictures. The outdoor area is rundown and not usable and the indoor area for smaller children/babies has some toys mostly with no batteries.

The room service was quite awful. We have found the service in all restaurants to be seriously lacking. We wait patiently for up to 30 minutes for someone to take our drink order, we still tip, and this doesn't seem to even help. Stark difference to Mexico. All but 3 workers we've noticed seem annoyed to be here.

Housekeeping is hit or miss. Only once did they come prior to 5pm. Other days it has been 6pm before we called. We tip no less than $5/day and still garbage are not changed, mini bar is not stocked, Kleenex or toilet paper not stocked.

It has been rather quiet at the resort, never too busy. Makes me nervous to think how the staff would manage when it IS busy.

Make sure you bring all necessary toiletries. The gift shop at the Paradisus is a royal rip off. $15 for a 1.99 pack of wet wipes. $15-20 for tampons lol 

It's sad we splurged for a 5 star resort and this is no better then the 4 star we were just at prior. A lot of hard earned money spent.

reviews.author: Gazalsaeed
reviews.title: Excellent Service and horrendous upkeep
reviews.text:
This was our third trip to this exact resort, the first was 10 years ago for our honeymoon.  This hotel has amazing service, from our butler Carlos who made our ten year anniversary amazing to Edison with his artistic craft drinks. We could not ask more from the staff, they are caring and attentive. We loved every aspect of the service but was very disappointed in the hotel itself. 

They have not upgraded, replaced, or maintained very important aspects to the resort, and your guests do notice the details.  Especially, when they pay for something like "The Royal Service".  Our AC was old and rattled all night while we tried to sleep. The TV was very old, hard to use, and had distorted images.  This would have been great to use when it was pouring down rain our second to last night. The safe did not work.  The tiles in the pools and Jacuzzi wear broken or missing completely.  The towels and bathrobes were overused and instead of having that comfy soft resort feel, they were very rough and coarse.  Every single bathroom lock outside the pool was broken. And even algae in the pool. 

When signing up for the "Roayl Service" we were prmised upgraded drinks and paid extra for it.  After asking the entire week about where and how to get the upgraded beverages it was evident that it was not available. There was NO difference for being Royal Service and not.  We have done the Royal service on the first visit and the last, on the second visit we opted for regular.  If you want nicer wine then you had to pay much more for it, the house wine tasted like gasoline and in many cases had gone bad.  

The buffet and breakfast options where the same every single day, which gave no excitement or enjoyment for a whole week of vacation.  No ones wants the same small options everyday.  

The food at the restaurants was mediocre, and most were just awful.  They had the same restaurants, and options from 10 years ago.   Even, the other guests were truly upset like us. We have been going to this hotel for ten years and took four years off but wanted to go back for our 10th year anniversary. because we were hoping to have the same experience as the first time when it was new and exciting. 
Truly sad to say we will not be back especially with the conditions the way they are.  They asked us several times to check out the new circle, but why would you want to sign up for a Melia "Membership" if you know they will never upgrade anything after a few years of time.

reviews.author: engdanielbastos
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
The experience is being so bad. 

1st was in relation to the transfer between the airport and hotel, the melia charged US 240, round trip. I closed with Visa Concierge for US $ 89.00 round trip.

2nd every time we order some drink in the can or in bottle we are not catered for. 

3rd when I ask for a beef steak, it takes more than 20 min to make them, in Brazil any bar has a beef steak. 

4o the beach is full of seaweed, I know this is a phenomenon that can not be controlled but all other hotels are limoando the edge less the Paradisus. 

5o I have 3 more couples (my father and mother in law) and 1 of them are in the royal service, which is so talked  and at the end of the day, not after many benefits, my mother-in-law and my father-in-law do not know how to speak Spanish or English and the butler is being absent and communicates in Spanish with them.

6o Is all inclusive or not? The coconut is US 5 dolar, is it nice?

My name is Daniel Bastos and my room is 2026

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.title: Beautiful Place, we will not be returning.
reviews.text: This was a mixed bag, some good some bad. Hospitality right from the start was not good. When we checked in, we were told that the room was not ready and we should go to the lunch buffet. Upon our return an hour and a half later, they said it would be another hour until the room ready.  They offered us a room with two beds instead of the king we had reserved. This was totally unacceptable! We have read that this is a common practice for this resort. We asked to have a room that was close to the pool and restaurants, as my fiance has an issue with her foot. They gave us a room that could not have been further from everything. Upon check-in, we were puzzled to be assigned to a concierge, since we had not paid for upgraded or Royal service.  We found out after he assisted us for three days that he was actually tasked trying to get us to listen to a timeshare presentation for their new "Circle" units.  He was very helpful, but this was deceptive and a waste of everyone's time, since we had no interest in a timeshare. At lunch at the Buffet one day, we had to listen to a guy at the next table giving the hard sell for a timeshare to a couple the entire time we ate  On our first night we wanted to watch the Olympics on TV, but the TV did not work because there was no cable box hooked up to it. We like to sleep late on vacation, so when we got to breakfast the first morning we were chided for trying to sit down at the end of the breakfast cycle. We were rudely told to go to another restaurant which only had "snacks" available. The people who were already seated were not chased away. Upon our return to our room one afternoon, we found that our travel document folder on the coffee table had been opened, and a paper containing my credit card number was sitting beside the folder. We reported this to the desk, who assured us that they would investigate, but we were never told the results of their "investigation". Getting the restaurant reservations we wanted was like pulling teeth, as was getting our room refrigerator restocked and getting an adequate number of towels. Luckily our concierge was very helpful with those problems. There were plenty of restaurants to choose from, but sometime we had to go to the buffet afterwards, as the portions were kind of pathetic. The extra $130 we paid to eat at Passion was NOT worth it. There were not enough lounge chairs by the pool, since no one was using the beach due to massive amounts of seaweed (which the resort did not attempt to remove) and extremely high winds that created sand dunes. We tried this resort as an alternative to our usual vacation in Aruba. The facilities at this resort are beautiful and clean, but due to the poor service, we will be going back to Aruba next year..

reviews.author: Alexia T
reviews.title: great bar staff, terrible restaurant staff
reviews.text: I chose this hotel because my boyfriend and I stayed at the Paradisus in Mexico and we had a wonderful time. We were highly disappointed in the restaurant service we received. Going out to dinner required me going to a bar located somewhere else on the resort to get my drinks because majority of the time the waiter never brought them, including water! The food quality was a 3/5. really lacked flavor. trying  to get a waiter to help us was nearly impossible. we did have one food restriction and was clearly spoken to the waiter when our order was taken (even learned how to say it in Spanish) and still the food was incorrectly served. Luckily it wasn't a food allergy. The bar staff really made this trip memorable. Each bar had a gin guide book with special spices to add to gin and tonics. Most of the bartenders remembered our drinks from the previous days. The pool was clean and there was enough seating where we didn't have to wake up at 6am to grab a chair. We stayed in a one bedroom master suite and had absolutely no problem with anything. very clean, nice balcony view of the pool, air condition worked well and it didn't smell.

reviews.author: Ant0nio66
reviews.title: Cuidado!! El hotel no respeta las reservas!
reviews.text: Desde hace casi un año pagué una reserva para el mes de mayo directamente en la página web del hotel. Inexplicablemente al llegar se me informó que el hotel estaba sobrevendido! No respetaron mi reserva y a pesar de mi insistencia, me enviaron a otro hotel de menor categoría. Me sentí realmente estafado porque, en adición a que no respetaron mi reserva ya pagada íntegramente, me quisieron engañar con la idea de un falso upgrade. No volveré a ese hotel ni lo recomendaré.

reviews.author: Kelly L
reviews.title: Paradosis
reviews.text:
Sorry to say but this trip was not at all what we expected. Been to many beautiful family resorts and we were disappointed with this one. First day of check in there was no real explantation or map of resort. No mention of activities or kids club. Went to pool and out of towels. Our room was sufficient for the 6 of us although it needed updating and we were on 3rd floor with an elevator that was broken the whole time. Second day my husband and then my son got a stomach virus, not sure if it was water or the food.  The shower in our room didn't work and was way too complicated to figure out. They had to come by and fix it twice. And The air conditioning broke in the adjoining room half way through the trip. 

Third day, I had booked some spa appointments at a keiosk and couldn't even find it's location, no signs anywhere on where to go and people don't speak very good english or explain things well. They just point and say "go there". Got to appointment and it wasn't even scheduled as it should have been. Luckily they accommodated me with atleast one of the appointments.

Cleaning service came everyday but never refilled our fridge.  We had to call in order to get a couple mini beers and water almost everyday. And the coffee was HORRIBLE! 

Hard to get service at Beach because so crowded and wasn't even able to find chairs most days.  If known that, would have totally done an upgrade to the "The reserve" and for the price we paid we should have been allowed in the reserved. I've paid much more for a resort and gotten better service & food. 

It was almost like this resort felt like a newly opened resort where they didn't really have it all figured out yet.  

On a plus side, it is a beautiful piece of property but I think they've put all their energy into making it look good on the outside but no quality on the inside. Surrounding beach area was very crowded when you walk along beach and your constantly getting harassed to buy stuff or sign up for an excursion.

You had to eat a buffet for every breakfast & lunch and the food was not that great.  The dinners and restaurants were very nice but it took me forever to figure out how to even book a reservation. Everything was a an effort and it shouldn't be like that on vacation.
For example, I had to go buy $17.00 worth of chips just so we could have a snack when the buffet was closed bc there was nothing anywhere.  

Lastly, there were away too many high schooler spring breakers there overtaking the adult bar.  And in the evening we had to turn our air-conditioner up just so we could sleep bc it was so loud outside late into the night.

The staff did know we were upset about things from our travel agent and came to our room to ask what they could do and offered a dinner with a chef...but that wasn't the point..the point was this place has a lot of work to do.

reviews.author: Lorena F
reviews.title: Do not go to this Hotel!!!
reviews.text:
The hotel is NOT well maintained... you can find humidity all over the place... very very - i mean VERY- slow service... you can stay 45 minutes waiting for a bottle of water...
If you go in a low season, there are directly ZERO activities at night. Not fun at all!
Employees seems stressed... underpaid, and unhappy... you can tell... very inefficient in every way. The ONLY amazing restaurant is RES. Best meat, best service by far.

reviews.author: Mauricio G
reviews.title: Cumpleaños
reviews.text:
Esta vez nos vamos en deuda el hotel cambio se nota en su gente ,agradecidos por la atención de Abraham camarero luchito en el bar Sandy como conserge pero ya no es lo mismo , algo pasa una buena atención y estadía lo hace un equipo de personas ese equipo ya  no esta en Palma Real ,deseo de todo corazon vuelva a ser el hotel que visite en viajes anteriores .
Gracias a todos los q nos atendieron y a restaurante fuego quien preparo una rica cena para el cumpleaños de mi esposo.
Señores Garcia.

reviews.author: ReRanieriWanderley
reviews.title: Beleza natural nota 1000 porém atendimento nota 0
reviews.text:
Estivemos hospedados por 7 dias e o motivo da viagem foi para um casamento no hotel que estava divino. A paisagem e paradisíaca, lugar lindo e praia ótima. 
O atendimento do hotel deixou muito a desejar desde o check-in. Chegamos em voo noturna as 23:00 no hotel e demoramos mais de uma hora para chegarmos ao quarto. Não houve nenhuma apresentação do hotel pelo recepcionista. A ideia de all inclusive é um pouco enganosa pois havia somente um restaurante com um buffet “quebra galho” nesse horário. As bebidas alcoólicas não são porcionadas dentro do padrão de doses, dando a impressão de estarem sempre “ sem paladar e fracas “ . Os restaurantes servem apenas até 22:30 e seguem esse horário de forma bem rígida. 
Estranhamente dentro de um grupo de quase 70 pessoas em 3 apartamentos do grupo sumiram dólares e relógio de dentro do cofre. Um absurdo. 
Em todos os locais , como bares , restaurantes os funcionários não possuem cortesia e alegria em servir. 
Outro ponto negativo é que um hotel com varias qualificações de hierarquia de hóspedes pelo tipo de pacote adquirido. Se o hóspede não for do royal service  fica limitado a poucas áreas de uso na piscina e praia , ou seja poderá usar os locais na maioria das vezes sem sombra. 

Não voltaria para esse destino senão fosse por um ótimo motivo como foi para o casamento que estava maravilhoso!!!

reviews.author: suriel892018
reviews.title: peor resort
reviews.text: No vale lo que pagamos. El servicio estuvo pesimo y punto. Jamas recomendaria este hotel a nadie. Unoo asiste esos lugares para pasarla bien no para hacer mala sangre. Mi mama que sufre de asthma estaba en una habitacion donde apestaba a humedad y ella lo habia reportado varias veces y no se resolvio el problema

reviews.author: LUV2TRAVEL70
reviews.title: Looking for a glimpse of Paradise at Paradisius
reviews.text:
I just returned from a week at the Paradisius Palma Real. Although the grounds were pretty, the bad outweighed the good for SURE. Check in was a complete disaster. We arrived and paid the extra to stay at the Reserve. Three other families we traveled with paid the difference as well. We were told that although we have Reserve privileges we would be staying at the other building but one family will be at the Reserve building which we were fine with because we understood they were overbooked. We were told to eat lunch and return to main lobby when the room is ready. After two hours waiting for our room we were told they made a mistake and we would stay for one night at the reserve and then switch over to another building. Of course that would mean we would waste another day transferring our luggage  to the other building. After arguing back and forth they were kind enough to waive the Reserve fee and still allow us to use Reserve property. We appreciated their kindness and decided it was fine.
Service_ I have traveled to many all inclusive and around the world and the service at the Paradisius was by far the WORST we have ever experienced. The staff is lazy and acts like they are doing us a favor. There are no smiles , no enthusiasm. During our one week stay MAYBE we came across two or three people who were friendly. It appears if you give them a tip after a meal  they  tend to be nicer. After breakfast one day the waiter from the previous day asked if we were not happy with his service the day before. The funny thing is we looked for him to give him a small tip but could not find him so we left.  How dare they ask for a tip when this is an all inclusive? Tips are optional especially at an all inclusive. 
Food- going to an all inclusive I knew not to expect anything great regarding food and good thing I did otherwise I would be even more disappointed because the food was an absolute disaster. The only restaurant that had decent food was hibachi at the Reserve. We ate at Passione which was fine but not worth the 80.00 per person for the amount they give you. Several times during meals I asked the people serving what something was and 99.9 percent of the time they could not tell me what it was because they did not speak English.
How do they hire people to work at a resort and not speak English? I would say the majority who worked at this resort did not speak English. Ifyou do not know minimal Spanish, good luck to you trying to communicate.
Rooms- rooms were fine except for the fact that hot running water is hard to come by. My children took cold showers at least four times during our stay. How is this acceptable? We found by letting the water run for a while eventually the hot water comes out but only for a few seconds. I did not bother to  complain because at this point where would it get me. So cold showers it was for the rest of the week. The only thing that I kept thinking was how do people with infants bathe their children?
Truly it is a shame that they can't get their act together regarding service. Honestly, I could deal with terrible food but not having good service to me ruins my entire experience.

reviews.author: AuntJuJu
reviews.title: Packed, did not get room booked
reviews.text:
So....  here now at resort.  Hotel is generally nice but my daughter and I did not get the room we booked.  Booked through Delta Vacations with complimentary room upgrade and access to water ritual at spa.  At checkin, they did not give us a Luxury suite.  I had to ask about the water ritual and they reluctantly changed my bracelet to the one that gives access.  I understand it's not a huge deal but I do not appreciate that I had to argue and fight for it and made to feel like a was trying to get something for free when it's clearly stated in my itinerary.  

The hotel itself is nice enough but PACKED.  People were coming down at 4 AM to reserve pool chairs by the shade.  Beach chairs were gone by 7 also.  I complained and the answer/advice I got was to come down before them.  This is ridiculous. 

And now hat I've complained to the hotel again, they offered to change my room.  I don't feel like packing and reunpacking.  Why didn't they just honor my reservation at checkin?!!!!

reviews.author: santiago09
reviews.title: Insuffisant vu le prix
reviews.text:
Deux jours dans un beau resort pour terminer un séjour d’une semaine, voilà qui était alléchant. 
Bon, alors en vrai. À notre arrivée notre chambre n’est pas prête, alors que l’heure du Check in est passée. La chambre est un peu défraîchie, avec une minuscule télé et plein de câbles apparents, une douche à la limite de la casse. Les cartes qu’on nous donne pour accéder à la chambre ne marchent pas. Impossible de réserver dans les restaurants il ne reste de la place nulle part. Les gens se comportent comme des veaux en réservant des 7h du matin des chaises longues pour la journée ce qui fait qu’en permanence on doit chercher pour se poser alors qu’il n’y a personne qui occupe ces sièges. Faillite du monde civilisé... la plage est moyenne. 
Après, le personnel de l’hôtel est sympa. C’est pratique. On mange bien. On est pas mal. 
Mais pour ce prix, franchement, ce n’est pas à la hauteur.

reviews.author: Harry A
reviews.title: Poor experience
reviews.text: Definitely not a 5☆ hotel. Food is horrible wherever you eat in that resort. Be aware: they try to make you attend their holiday plan presentation and it s a literral harassment. Will never go again in Melia group hotel in dominican republic for sure. Beach is amazing but has nothing to do with Melia. One advise: if you go punta cana do not put a feet in any melia hotel resort.

reviews.author: Sara H
reviews.title: What happened to this resort???:(
reviews.text: We are back for the fourth time after two years of absence and our day one is not what we expected at all,if you read my previous two reviews I thought this place was the best not only in Punta Cana but most of the Caribbean islands my husband and I visited so far.  We travel 6 to 7 times a year, try to do island vacations at least 3 to 4 times so we have an idea of what a four star resort should look like.This  hotel used to be  our absolute favorite but now we came to a royal  service where we got bearly greeted ,got put in a beat up room to change Until our  our room got ready ,went to the pool to find no towels and no beer at 3 PM in the afternoon:(  went to have lunch at one of our favorite restaurants and food was inedible  so we ended up getting dessert at the buffet...   I promise you we are not high maintenance but we want what we paid for and so far we are not getting it !
