We paid extra for Royal service because we like the extra attention ,the food and some amenities that are only available with this package but right now it seems like it is a total waste of money  The staff seems very negative, barely anyone says anything to you even if you ask for  basic things, so I'm not sure what we can expect for the duration of this week ... Both of us have high stress jobs and we really look forward to relax when we can so we are very disappointed to have started our vacation on such a bad note ..... I will  add another review after the vacation concludes, but for now I would say go to Iberostar Grand grand in Punta Cana, this place has lost its magic !

reviews.author: travelbugs244
reviews.title: Does not care about you. Not 5 star quality.
reviews.text: After booking on their website we checked in only to be told they had no rooms and were moving us to their 3 star sister property. Totally not what we paid for. Total lack of concern for our family. Only their money they had already received. After 3 days we had to pack up and come back to this resort. No personalized service even on the beach. Had to get our own drinks and towels. Big buffets for food were nasty. A la cart restaurants were better but reservations weren't always found after our concierge told us they were made. Pool freezing. Kids didn't even want to swim. Entertainment was awful. Much better 5 star resorts out there for your family.

reviews.author: mssirr
reviews.title: Left 3 Days Early...
reviews.text:
*After reading our review, we strongly urge you to please read all of the other one and two star comments, as you'll see they align with our comments. If you notice most of the 5 star comments mention employee's FULL NAMES. My husband and I have traveled to many hotels and resorts and we've never actually remembered an employee by their full name. Suspicious if you ask us!*

To begin, my husband and I are strongly questioning why this resort is rated 4.5 to 5 stars...it shouldn't be. More importantly, we're also curious about all of the 5 Star ratings that are being written up during the same time we were there. We talked to MANY people and everyone was experiencing the same things we were. In fact, we saw a couple in the "Royal Service" lobby and the wife was crying because they were so disappointed by everything. This was their big vacation of the year, they were very upset to say the least.

PROS
Beach: we're from Florida, so we were not blown away, but for those visiting from non-beach locations, it's nice. 

Water: it's like normal Atlantic ocean blue water, beautiful to look at. 

CONS
Resort: SO spread out. You'll certainly get your daily exercise in walking from your room to the lobby. Oh and did we mention how long you have to wait to get on a golf cart to go somewhere (i.e. The Spa). We lost count on how many times we heard "another 5 minutes" until the golf cart arrived. 

Food: Terrible. Always cold, old, and tough. Thankfully we filled up on bread and the cookies were half-decent. We're not big juice drinkers so we can't provide an opinion there, but we love a nice bold cup of coffee in the morning. Unfortunately, the coffee was cold and watery everyday. 

Spa: nothing special. As previously mentioned, we waited about 30 mins for a golf cart to get over to the spa (we must have heard "5 more minutes" 5-7 times). If we weren't already frustrated, the women's sauna and steam room did not work (by did not work, I mean they were both cold). Also, no cream rinse (they said they didn't use it...seriously?! what spa doesn't have cream rinse for women?) To be fair, the men's sauna and steam room worked perfectly fine. My husband and I tried sharing the outside small pool and 2 jacuzzi's but (shocker) they were both cold. When you asked them about it,they would say "That is the way we do it here!" After not being able to relax, I decided to lay on the outside beds while my husband finished his treatment.  The spa is right next to a construction sight and even though it was Sunday, all you heard was loud dump trucks and the strong smell of diesel fuel. 

Staff: about 80% of the staff does not speak English. They're not the happiest people and very difficult to get any service. If you needed something, they promised they would bring it but they would never come back. We're business owners so at the end of the day, we knew this wasn't the employees fault but rather faulty management practices and Corporate. Our hearts went out to many of the staff and we went through many $5, $10, $20 tips. We felt if we could help them a little that's the best you can do, since Corporate & Management did not seem to care about them or the resort.

Overall, we could go on and on and on, but we'll save you the time. We were supposed to stay for 7 days and 6 nights but could not bear this hotel any longer and had to leave 3 days early. We're thrilled to be back home safely in our home this evening.

reviews.author: Romna61
reviews.title: 3 Star Service - at best!
reviews.text: We recently spent 4 nights at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in "Royal Service". The resort, facilities and quality of the food was consistently of a very high standard however the service was absolutely terrible. We had to ask continually if someone could take our order for food or get us a drink and the service fell well short of what was promised. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Fede
reviews.title: NO VOLVERÉ...
reviews.text: Tuve que hacer un cambio de habitación y me quisieron dar una peor a la que había pagado, tenia pendiente un up grade que no me quisieron hacer valer, cuando llegue a Argentina note que me faltaban cosas de unas valijas de cosas que no habíamos usado.  Algunas cosas se solucionaron, otras no.  El hotel nota algunos signos de envejecimiento, algunas habitaciones estaban en mal estado. Melia es una cadena que me gusta mucho, pero al Paradisus Palma de Punta Cana no volveré. El buffet es flojo y mas cuando se llena el hotel.

reviews.author: S N
reviews.title: Had High Expectations - but Very Dissappointing Expirence
reviews.text:
I do not understand how this resort gets such a high rating. We have been to many all-inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico and this is our least favorite. Our room was the furthest from the ocean, even though we booked what I thought was a "luxury  junior suite".  There was noise from delivery trucks and construction day and night, impossible to sit outside on the balcony .  NO hot water to shower. Service at Naos the main buffet restaurant was often slow (water poured when were about to leave) and disorganized. If you don't pay double to be in the "inclusive" area, chairs around the pool are hard to get unless you "save" them early in the morning. It would nice if management would stick to the 30 minute vacancy policy listed in the resort guide. Frustrating that reservations for most of the restaurants need to be made days in advance. Only reason I gave two stars instead of one, is the food was pretty good, and there were a couple of exceptional servers/wait staff that went above and beyond. Also, wifi was strong throughout the resort. 
 We will not return or recommend.

reviews.author: Nigel D
reviews.title: Let me make it simple for you
reviews.text:
Not going to bore you with the ins and outs 
so let me make it simple
its a 5 star Dominican not US standard and the exchange rate is 50 to 1
( makes it a 0.1 star if you cant do the math)
And if you have a Medical need while you are there I wish you the best of luck !

reviews.author: atlmcg
reviews.title: Experience was okay, but far from spectacular
reviews.text: Beautiful property. Service level was mediocre. Food was fantastic at one restaurant (Fuego), miserable at another (Olio), and pretty decent at the rest. This property has SO much potential, but it failed to live up to that.

reviews.author: Olyaall
reviews.title: Тройка за многое
reviews.text: На самом деле отмечали прошлый Новый год (2016-2017) компанией. Четверо взрослых и двое детей. Но отзыв в прошлом году не разместили из-за слова таракан в номере. Которого мы умудрились привезти домой. Что ж попробуем ещё раз. Минусы начались с заселения. Нам предоставили нормальный номер, нашим друзьям с двумя детьми, которые заказывали luxe- такой же как и нам. После трёх часовых выяснений им все же поменяли номер, однако люксом там и не пахло, а жутко воняло канализацией. Путешествуем много, бываем в разных отелях, от 3-х звёзд и далее. Но здесь пятёрку можно поставить только за еду и за территорию. Уборка не постоянная, практически нужно заставлять прийти убрать номер и поменять полотенца. Не подумайте, чай оставлялся и мы не вредные ))) . По мимо этого постоянный обман и желание содрать денег. Прослеживалось во всем. Заказали яхту на день, оплатили деньги - нам ее не предоставили ссылаясь на какие-то непредвиденные обстоятельства. Деньги вернули с трудом и через несколько дней. На выезде предъявили счёт за никогда не бравшуюся бутылку вина (без нашей подписи на счете, без ничего и учитывая, что весь подобный алкоголь был включён). Обман с такси / так же завышена цена, при гарантированной изначально. И так во всем и везде. В общем отель на трёшку. Из плюсов персонал в зоне ресторанов. Русский представитель (девушка) жирный минус.

reviews.author: Ale2253
reviews.title: More downs than ups!
reviews.text:
We were here for christmas and new year. We had a lot of issues with the quality of service. They definitely were not prepare for this peak season! The service was very poor and many had bad attitude.
They were painting the walls during new year and left everything with no wet paint signs so one person from our group got all her clothes stained with paint! They agreed to dry clean but at check out they wanted to charge her!
Another couple from our group got hit on the head with their blackout rail! It seemed it was loose and when they opened the curtain in the morning the rail came off and dropped on her head! They notified guest services and received and apology and that they will fix it right away. When they arrived back to their room the rail was still on the floor. After calling many times they finally went to fix the curtain at 9pm with a drill! The guests from other rooms came to complain because of the noise! It was a disaster!
It you wanted to take towels for the beach/pool during the afternoon many times they were out! And said tough luck!
Most of the staff made you feel that they were doing you a favor!
For the reservation to the restaurants thank god that we found the manager because every time we wanted to book without her help they told us the system did not accept reservations for those days and to come back another day. We were told this several times during our stay but when we spoke to the manager (we loved her! She was super nice and helpful!) she was able to do the reservations for most of our stay without problems. 

The rooms need an urgent renovation! The are VERY dated! The Tv and the mini fridge in our room did not work. Most of the outlets did not work either, we had to use one in the room hallway to charge our phones. A few jets from our jacuzzi were missing. The shower had some jets that dripped constantly.

In the beach we had an excellent service from Bony!!! Even though they were under staffed he always had a smile and did everything he could to get our drinks! Thank you Bony for everything!

We had fun but will not be staying again on this property. I would suggest you think twice before staying.

reviews.author: MNtripmaven
reviews.title: Beautiful location but signfiicant failures with facilities and customer service
reviews.text:
We had numerous issues with our stay, which we brought up with management while we were onsite.  Although the location is beautiful, customer service and issues with the grounds were if a magnitude that it impacted our stay:   
1.  Complete failure of the room key entry system, which required me to go from my room to the lobby 5 times in order to gain entry to the room (none of which were due to proximity to a  cell phone or credit card).  Twice the new key still didn't work and security needed to let me in.  This happened not only to us, but to others we knew at the resort as well.  This was a SIGNIFICANT system-wide problem with the key entry, which each time I was told would be "solved" by giving me a new key. 
2.  Terrible, horrible customer service in the restaurants.  We had to hunt down servers to refill our water and bring us coffee.  No one every checked back to see if we needed more coffee/water. At the pastry counter (where you need to get served desserts for some unknown reason) there was 3 individuals behind the counter...1 serving, and the other two just hanging out...none taking the initiative to help reduce the line.  At Bona, we had to move tables at the Hibachi area (one of the grills failed) for dessert.   Everyone received their deserts, but NO ONE had silverware...furthermore no one returned to check on us to see if everything was ok!  We had to ask repeatedly for a fork, and by that time our ice cream was melted.  Finally, for the first three days we were at the pool, not one person asked if we needed drinks from the bar.
3.  Construction was going on during the day in the buffet area, which was disruptive to our stay..  It smelled of paint and there was a lot of noise from some type of saw.  When  I asked someone from the resort when it would be done, I was told "tomorrow".  However, it continued onto the next day.  I have no idea why they didn't save these types of upgrades until after guests are asleep. 
4.  There was a back hoe that was moving sand at 10:30 a.m  Christmas morning.The noise was very disturbing.  Unfortunately, the need to move the sand was repeated the next day.  Again, why are you doing this during the time that your guests are trying to enjoy the grounds?
5.  "Concierge" system is a joke.  Whoever greeted us when we arrived as was to "take care of us"  I never saw or heard from again.
6.  Staff were misinformed.  I asked 2 people if we needed reservations for Christmas Eve...they BOTH said no.  Needless to say we had to track someone down who could help us at 7:30 p.m. Christmas eve as we realized that the buffet was closed.

These issues were posted on a previous review I wrote, and I was invited to contact the "Customer Experience" manager, who I did on our last day at the property.  She was no where to be found; when I expressed my frustration on the key issue (which plagued us up until we checked out) to the Guest Service Manager did assist us but did not offer anything to address any of the other issues.

reviews.author: Phyllis P
reviews.title: Never again, I'll stick with Iberostar
reviews.text: I went to this resort for a birthday celebration with my cousins. We were with a group of about 40 other people. I will start with the good. There were several stand out people at this resort Santo who was a server at the pool was awesome. He was friendly and attentive and provided excellent service. Vladamir was also great. He was the manager that we eventually went to see for the terrible service we had been receiving. He did what he could to rectify the issues we had been having. The last person who should be recognized is Marvin who works in the lobby bar. He was sweet and personable and truly a joy to meet. Now for the bad. Having been to the DR twice I had something to compare to this resort. My prior trips were to Iberostar Grand Bavaro. Service there was AWESOME and the rooms were superior to the ones at the Paradisus. When there was a problem (minimal) they were addressed immediately. However, problems at the Paradisus ranged from no water in one room in which the offered to take her to another room to shower to long waits (3 hours) for face towels. One person found the safe open upon return to their rooms (nothing stolen). Others got locked in there rooms or locked out of the room as the key cards had been recycled to the point they no longer worked. The refrigerator in our room did not work for the last 2 1/2 days of our trip (we stayed 6 days). Mini bars ranged from a few items to full and seldom refilled. My other cousin had two lights in her whole room that worked. Some others waited 45 minutes to get coffee served during breakfast. The wait staff particularly in the buffet location did not seem happy or cheerful. It was a chore for them to do anything and I heard that they had assigned duties. As a result you would see people hanging around doing nothing while you remained parched from wanting a drink. When we took an excursion we were told to go to the pool area for towels the day before. Our trip to Sanoa Island required towels and we had to leave at 7:30 am. Since the towel area opens at 8 we were told to return the towels we had for the day and get clean ones for the excursion the next day. Upon arrival to do so we were greeted by the rudest jerk of a guy who refused to give them to us. We complained to the manager Vladamire who brought towels to our room that evening. We were told that the jerk of a guy was contracted. He had no name tag but I did take a picture of him to show the manager. It was also hard to arrange transport back to the airport. I was successful in finding him on my fourth trip to his booth. The food was just okay. In fact we left the resort and went to Noah's to get a decent meal. The best food came from Bana and Raw. Oh, and brush up on your Spanish. Most of the folks at Iberostar spoke enough English to get by, but here it was not uncommon to find people who spoke no English at all. The rooms are also kind of dated. The televisions were older and the set up of the bathrooms allowed for little privacy. Our rooms had some sort of shutters that you could see clear into the bathroom. You could not close them. Considering I was sharing a room with my cousin I'm sure we would have like a little more privacy while showering or using the facilities. I would not recommend this resort to anyone unless it was a free trip.

reviews.author: rogerlongbeach
reviews.title: It aint paradise despite the name
reviews.text:
We have been coming here for almost 10 years.  Sorry to say its broken.  Staff room conditions wear and tear on the site alot of b.s.
The restauants are ok but it doesnt come close to making up for the issues 

Melia has lost control.

reviews.author: Kreese32
reviews.title: Not the resort advertised
reviews.text:
I have to say that there are some positives to the resort. I will start with that as the resort does deserve some credit.

Pros: Landscape is absolutely beautiful as well as the pools. Most of the staff are outstanding and happy to be there. The entertainment was fantastic and full of fun. The food options were good for us as we had a “special” level allowing us to eat at all the restaurants. I would research that prior to booking to ensure you can eat at the restaurants advertised. The maid did a good job cleaning our room each day. The walk to the beach was easy and very beautiful. The security guards did their best to keep the locals away from you as you are trying to enjoy the sun. We had a big room with an amazing view and patio.

Cons: For an all inclusive resort I was extremely disappointed with the room service as well as the “stocked” refrigerator. Upon arrival as our concierge was showing us our room she opened the mini fridge to show us our drinks and it was empty with two opened bottles of soda water. Our snack option included a bag of chips and a mini Oreo pack. We called on multiple occasions to ask for it to be restocked and it never was. We called room service and it was a miracle if they answered the phone. The room service menu was a joke in options. We ordered breakfast one day with room service, waited 2 hours and it never arrived. Our bath tub was a set base with a bath fitters insert so you could pull the tub out if you wanted. It was a bit scary because it moved when you were in the tub as it didn’t fit properly. We had made spa appointments and they didn’t have us down upon arrival (we did work this out and get a massage). If you go to the spa don’t forget your swimsuit as most of the amenities were coed (we had no idea so didn’t get to enjoy them). They did not use premium liquor. I asked for Grey Goose on multiple occasions to be told it was extra. Our table on our patio was not even on the base or the top. We didn’t know that an attempted a evening on the patio and everything spilt once we placed our items on it due to balance. They work really hard at trying to get you to write a positive trip advisor review in front of them saying it is a contest. We declined as we use this for traveling purposes and would never recommend to anyone.

In conclusion at the price point I hate to say that I would not go back nor send anyone there. There were some great people but they couldn’t make up for all the things that went wrong. Not stocking a mini fridge to me the entire 6 day stay as well as not giving us any snacks that are advertised in the room seems unacceptable. I could understand if we hadn’t told them the first day however we asked them repeatedly to please refill. Hope this helps someone.

reviews.author: AsturCantabros
reviews.title: Esperábamos más !! Comida mal !!!
reviews.text:
Teníamos muchas ganas de venir a este hotel . Tercera vez en punta cana .
 1- Instalaciones bien cuidadas aunque anticuadas . 
2- Animación y show muy regular .
3- Limpieza habitación buena , aunque habitaciones antiguas .
4- zonas verdes muy cuidadas 
5- seguridad buena 
6- respecto!!!! Comida mal !!!!
 . Malas elaboraciones , poco calidad , poca variedad y poca trabajada . Poca formación a los equipos de trabajo . El buffet que es donde se come el 50% de la estancia no está a la altura y los restaurantes parecidos .

- Snack Bar regulero

El servicio del hotel está bien ( sólo bien ) , aunque no a la altura de lo que debia ser un hotel de estas características ( él dominicano es una persona muy amable )

El resumen es que no volveríamos a este hotel , ni lo recomendaríamos . 
Debe de mejorar

reviews.author: Misviajessonmiplacer
reviews.title: Demasiados cambios
reviews.text:
Lo negativo: sin pajitas, imposible beber un mojito y otros tragos, más música americana que dominicana, una pena.
Si quieres las camas cerca del Gabi hay que pagar 25 dólares el día. La coronita hay que pagarla antes no.
Los postres muy malos. 
Los zumos naturales deberían prepararlos en el momento con tanta fruta, sin embargo parecen artificiales.
La carne muy buena en el bufett. Años anteriores había más variedad.
El italiano muy bueno. El de carne, regular .
La zona de niños y los animadores lo mejor.
No todo está incluido como años anteriores.
LAs plantas bajas de las habitaciones huelen a humedad. Lo mejor es la planta 2.
Había yogures caducados en el bufet Gabi club. Tengo foto.
Los jardines están muy bonitos. Las playas las limpian pero no muy bien. Una pena ya que es muy amplia la zona de playa.
Demasiados cambios . Personal agradable excepto alguno que tiene mala cara . 
Me dijeron que no podía reservar restaurante para todas las noches que tenía que ir al bufet. Esto es nuevo. Y si quería cambiar una reserva tampoco. 
No sé si repetiremos. Lo dudo.

reviews.author: Elyssa78
reviews.title: LOCK UP YOUR VALUABLES!!!
reviews.text:
Despite being a beautiful resort, there is a lot of ugliness behind the scenes. The servers, bartenders and entertainment crew are literally the best I've ever experienced but on my first day, the housekeeper entered my room during an evening turn-down service and stole more than $550 out of my wallet...leaving me with $7!!! The guest services management (Vladamir, Domingo and Malin) led me on everyday during my short stay that this was being investigated and the housekeeper was being interrogated but I came to conclude that they were just stalling until my check out date. They were able to show me a key-card report that only showed the housekeeper entering my room between the time i checked in and the time I reported it the next morning when I woke up to buy sunscreen. I had my money when I tipped the driver that brought me there...the next morning it was gone. Once home, and after calling and emailing multiple times, I finally received an email stating it was my own fault for not having it locked in the safe. The only reason it wasn't in the safe yet was because the front desk was going to be switching our room the next morning to be closer to friends we came with so i didn't even bother unpacking yet. Also, a turn-down service was not explained and I had no idea anyone would be coming in that evening. They claim all valuable should be put in the safe, but their safes are not big enough for even an IPad! 
Also while we were there, we witnessed two waiters pushing and shoving each other in one of their restaurants which was a little unsettling. After reporting that to the above mentioned guest services people as well, they did nothing about that either. 
I have since emailed their corporate offices as well as the hotel manager and no one has even tried to offering me any restitution for my stolen property or terrible service i experienced...not even simply an offer for a free night if I were to choose to come there again!
I am of the impression that they think we are rich spoiled americans and that the money we spend to come to their establishment is just a drop in the bucket for us. I've never in my life been more insulted and made to feel so taken advantage of then I did with this resort. I feel sorry for all those other great employees that I did encounter because all I wanted to be able to do was give them I nice tip at the end of my stay and because my money was stolen I could not.

reviews.author: Jmb916
reviews.title: Food uneatable
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and willing to make our stay as good as possible. Room was nice, pool was great. However, the staff cannot control the food that is served. Food is uneatable. Terrible. Not even close to average. Buffets are removed after hours and I'm positive the same pancakes and some dinner meats are reheated the next day and re served. Mixed drinks not good either. This destination is affordable but not worth the disappointment.

reviews.author: Gail S
reviews.title: Ugh!!!!
reviews.text:
Ok. Here goes.  This is like no because I want you to understand the poor rating.  

We went with friends who have a special type of “vacation” club to this resort.  They purchased over 200 Resort nights in advance and only need to pay the “all inclusive” fee.

They have used over 50 nights in past the 3 years bringing family and friends and have always been extremely happy with service and resort amenities.

Well they gave us 5 nights and then we were to pay the all inclusive rate for those nights to join them on vacation. Then we were adding 6 more nights on our own. But.  We got room and all inclusive rates for the same amount of $$ that we had to pay for the all inclusive rate on another website. So we told them about this.  What a total rip off this “deal” was. We tried to give our friends back their days but were not able to but they at least got some discount to amend the rip off all inclusive rate. 

Now we get there and our friends realized we are at the wrong resort.  They preferred the Paradisus Palma Real. Not Punta Cana.  Well after asking to be moved as soon as we got there and agreeing to pay the increase in the all inclusive fee.  Guess what.  Two plus days of excuses and more and “we are working on it.”  Etc.  our friend contacted everyone in the resort who should have been able to do this easily.  No one had the smarts to call corporate. Finally our friend did just that.  Guess what.  We are moved within the hour.  No problem.  Hope you enjoy the new resort.   We want you to be happy. This took 2 1/2 days.  The new resort is lovely we are having a great time

 

Here are more reasons we were happy to be moving. 

The hotel was doing major renovations in the buffet and around the resort.  Breaking the peaceful Caribbean atmosphere with the noise of power equipment as well as trucks and equipment driving along the walking paths.   

Communication was a joke.   No one knew anything.  We were never given activity schedules though we were told they were in our rooms, NOT!  We asked for copies of these and told they could not make copies, at the gym an attendant showed us the schedule but could not make copies we finally photoed the schedule and had it on our cell phones. 

The electric kept going out. Causing loss of air conditioning as well as refrigeration.  Lights along paths out. Etc.  off and on.  Apparently this problem was ongoing as we read about it in previous trip Advisor articles

There were dirty dishes and glasses sitting outside our rooms for 2 days before being cleaned up. 

Once electric back on our air conditioner would not work.  We called 3 times over 2 1/2 hours.   No one came in spite of promises and promises 
Our friends finally suggested turning off everything and then turning back on.  Which worked like rebooting a computer. So we called and said don’t send anyone it works now.   Then  20 minutes later a maintenance worker shows up.  
 
We were given dinner reservations in the Winery.  Told that although they try to sell up market wine you can have house wine NOT. When we got there we were told we had to purchase a bottle of wine per couple. We were ready to leave and go to the buffet but once the manager at this place realized we were not told about the place he let us stay and drink the bottle of Proseco we were given when we arrived. The manager invited us to a free wine tasting the next evening at 6 pm.  So we got ready, got there on time.  Wait for it...... to be told it was at 5 not 6 like the four of us were told.  Soooo screwed up. Luckily we got moved that evening and by 7 were in a cab to the nicer resort. 

Well. I guess that is enough. The resort is old. Not updated  and just tired looking. Staff not trained in customer service and management does not care or just don’t know,  I actually felt bad for staff because they took brunt of our displeasure but were not adequately trained 

So don’t waste your $$. It is not worth it.  Spend a little more and go to the Palma Real.  MUCH BETTER.  Nicer rooms. No electric issues. Staff very customer service oriented. Worth the little extra $$

Go to Paradisus Palma Real. A real 5.

reviews.author: 05Suburban
reviews.title: Not upscale and lazy staff
reviews.text:
I don’t normally take the time to write a review, but I am so disappointed in this property that I just could not help myself. I am currently staying at this hotel and If you are looking for a high-end experience, this is not the resort for you. While the grounds are beautiful and The Reserve pool is great, the service is less than desirable. This resort is not the epitome of customer service excellence. 

I would describe the service by 98% of the staff as indifferent and lazy. They do not go out of their way to make the guests feel special and often time pass the buck to someone else. No one takes responsibility. They also do not routinely fulfill requests that are made. For instance, I requested items in the minibar and those were not provided. I also asked for additional bathrobes since my daughter had been ill the evening before and they were not provided, even though I asked for them twice. I asked for turndown service and that did not occur either. When we ordered room service, they did not even bring cups for coffee. When you eat at the Gabi Beach buffet, you have to chase down waitstaff to provide you with water or salt and pepper. They just don’t proactively cater to you. You’re constantly chasing after them for assistance.

The air conditioning in our room was not working when we arrived and it took phone calls to five different people to rectify the situation. There does not appear to be a single point of contact to work with to have issues resolved. From what I understand, if you choose to pay for the family concierge that might be something that you get. 

The majority of the restaurants and the beach are accessible via a shuttle that picks up at The Reserve. While the shuttle picked up fairly regularly at the reserve there was not one time where we were able to quickly find a shuttle back from the beach. This part was extremely frustrating.

On the positive side, the rooms are spacious and nicely appointed. The waitstaff at the pool and the beach are very attentive and filled my drinks regularly.

reviews.author: Ralphers
reviews.title: Extortion!
reviews.text: We visited this hotel with a large group of friends for a wedding. We all booked our hotel rooms at least 2 months prior to wedding. We paid in full a non refundable rate. Have an email confirmation saying it's paid in full. About a week before the wedding, all of our friends got phone calls from the hotel saying their website made a mistake and that we owed them more money (an extra 90$ per night). None of us were okay with this so we didn't pay any more money. When we checked into the hotel, nothing was brought up to the guests. However, 2 nights later, on the night of rehearsal dinner, they sent us an urgent letter saying we had to come down to reception. Nobody went down, as we knew they were just trying to collect more money from us. Well, the morning we were all flying home, the hotel told us we couldn't leave the hotel until we all paid them more money. They basically held us hostage (wouldn't give us checkout card that allowed us to get in a taxi to leave) until we paid them more money. We had no choice, and this is clearly extortion. If their website made an error, how is this our fault? We were told we paid in full. Very disappointed in how this large hotel chain could do this to at least 20 guests. For this reason (and others) I would not recommend this hotel. Save yourself the trouble of dealing with "men" like Wally who shake down guests while trying to enjoy a friends wedding. Disgraceful. I would avoid this hotel chain completely.

reviews.author: Pamelaalvarez88
reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text:
Soy una persona que le gusta viajar y conocer diferentes lugares y hoteles. Estaba muy emocionada de visitar este hotel desde hace tiempo por los buenos reviews que tenía. Sin embargo, quede totalmente decepcionada, que solo quería volver a casa por varias razones:
1. Poca diversión y entretenimiento, especialmente nocturno.
2. Están en remodelación y ese sonido molesta bastante, ya que uno va para allá a relajarse.
3. Pocas opciones de sitios para comer, y lo poco que hay no lo saben cocinar muy bien, estaba incomible. Probe todas las opciones que había desde el room service hasta el grill y todo muy malo. Tienen un menú que describen los platos e ingredientes que usan y cuando lo pides te dan otra cosa. Muy mal para un hotel de esta categoría. 

Lo único positivo que tiene este hotel es la limpieza y las habitaciones que son muy bonitas y amplias. También las personas que trabajan allá son muy amables.

Honestamente no volvería a este hotel. Quedé totalmente decepcionada.

reviews.author: Hernan Antonio L
reviews.title: Nuestro 20 años de casados
reviews.text:
El hotel muy bueno. Somos socios del Club, pero tuvimos un mayordomo desastroso. Alberto Mercedes no estuvo nunca con nosotros y cuando nos recomendo algo fue erroneo....cata de vino cancelada, reserva de tumbonas en playa sin confirmar, servicio de frigobar que nosotros mismos tuvimos que pedir, etc etc 
Total abandono de nuestro mayordomo y sin informacion.

Staff grouchy

reviews.author: Ayanbola E
reviews.title: Food is very bad
reviews.text: Their food selection is limited, their dishes are not tasty.. They need to work on improving language barrier, it was very obvious the staff preferred to relate to Spanish speaking folks; if you don't speak Spanish I won't recommend staying here. reviews.author: CarlosAlcalde
reviews.title: Mi estadía en paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana fue desepcionante
reviews.text:
El Hotel es grande y tiene una buena infraestructura,pero está muy mal administrado,ejemplos, los cuartos sucio, sofa manchados  telarañas en la lampara principal salimos a la terraza y no pudimos entrar la cerradura de la puerta estaba rota, y no la arreglaron, al abrir el closet se cayo la tapa del cableado, el delivery al cuarto es pobre y limitado, además cobran usd 5 delivery, la Junior de luxe suite no tiene vista, es como un closet ,el closet es puequeñisimo, elbuffet es regular, No TIENEN JUGOS NATURALES, es un hotel al que no volvería, el restaurant del chef Berasategui Es pagado, las mesas del buffet son sin mantel, ES MALO, en uno de los restaurant que se reserva, el hotel cobra por algunas comidas. Los pasajeros con los que hablamos estaban despcionados por el precio calidad del hotel. 3 días antes estuvimos en el Iberoestar de Punta Cana, menor precio, mejor servicio mejor actividades
Palma real NO es 5 estrellas superior

reviews.author: Ryan Roberto
reviews.title: Needs Improvement
reviews.text: I booked this hotel because it was highly rated on Trip advisor and we are Gold members with Melia Rewards and the Melia Club. Our vacation was a disaster from the arrival. We booked a 1 bedroom premium master suite and they attempted to place us in a paradisus suite. I immediately brought it to there attention and was told "yes this is your suite. After 15 min of arguing I proved to them I was given the wrong suite. When they attempted to change my room category to the correct suite they still gave me the wrong suite. I requested to speak to the hotel manager at this point and was told he is off-site and was unavailable. They told me I could wait for the manager if I wished, which I obvisouly wanted to do at this point since it's been 45 min and I'm still waiting in the lobby with my family. After another 15 min someone from the Reserve Check-In area came back to my family and advised I was "lucky" and they found me a 1 bedroom premium master suite. I'm not sure how luck played any roll in this since I reserved and paid on-line for that exact suite. Another issue that really aggravates me is that I requested a low floor since I had back surgery 2 years ago and multiple flights of stairs are hard for me. I was told that I was being placed on the 3rd floor of building 34 and there wasn't an elevator, and that was the only suite available now. I honestly had no energy left to argue and accepted the third floor suite so my family could start enjoying there vacation and not sitting in a hotel lobby. Once at the room the suite looked accommodating and ample for my family. Upon closer inspection you can see the housekeeping staff doesn't pride themselves on cleaning. We found weeks worth of dust just about everywhere, a jacuzzi that looks like it wasn't cleaned since the last person used it, and dust and dirt just above my pillow on my headboard. This is not what I expected from the Reserve at Punta Cana. I plan to call Melia corporate when I arrive back home. These pictures should show you some of the issues..

reviews.author: Patricia H
reviews.title: Not Really Paradise......
reviews.text: I've never written a review before but was so disappointed by our stay in July 2017, that it prompted me to do so now. While the grounds are beautiful and make a great first impression, the lack of friendly, flawless customer service detracts from the overall experience here.  This was our 4th visit to this resort and it has gone downhill on many levels.  The biggest issue this resort has is the bad attitude of many of its employees, particularly the hostesses at the dining areas, the employees making the dinner reservations  and the folks working in the towel hut. The hostesses and people making the reservations act as though they have never had to accommodate a group of 10 before, and even when showing up at the restaurant with our reservation slip in hand, the hostess at Agave could not find us on her list and was not going to seat us and the hostess at Fuego kept us waiting at the bar for 25 minutes even though the restaurant was empty and our table was clearly empty and waiting.  Ironically, the food was absolutely terrible at both Blue Agave and Fuego.  Some of the wait staff at the buffet were truly wonderful, while others acted put out to have to bring water and coffee. The wine served is absolutely terrible, so guests who are used to drinking decent wine are forced to buy bottles at the Winery....for 5x the price in the USA!  The tap water is not drinkable so it is important to have bottled water in the rooms, yet the minibars were not consistently stocked each day in all 5 of our rooms.  The resort has a recurring shortage of towels- both room towels and pool towels,   Our day of arrival, we made it to the pool at 4, only to find we could only get 2 towels for 10 people! This happened repeatedly throughout our 10 day stay.- if you didn't hoard towels by 10 a.m., you were out of luck.  Has it not occurred to management to  BUY MORE TOWELS ?!?  Same with the beach chairs under the huts....if that's what your guests prefer, shouldn't you be providing enough for all to use?!?  The ocean was full of seaweed as was the beach...and the resort decided to deploy heavy machinery throughout the day to clean it up, rather than doing it in the morning- just what folks looking for paradise want to listen to!    The spa, while very nice, was not worth the money - $270 for a 90 minute massage.     On a final note- Resort Credits- are an absolute joke and should be done away with.

reviews.author: canard199
reviews.title: PAS A LA HAUTEUR DE SES 5 ETOILES
reviews.text:
Je commence par le point positif : le Kids Club
Merci à toute l'équipe (Natali, Martina, Miguel,Michel, Francina, Jack, Benyanirys, Helen Loreni et Paola) pour leur compétence et leur gentillesse à toute épreuve.
J'avais choisi cet hôtel pour le Kids Club et je n'ai pas été déçue.
Points négatifs de l'hôtel :
J'avais pris le service "concierge" heureusement  car déjà ce n'était pas terrible alors sans...
Les chambres avec installations vétustes, eau chaude aléatoire aucune vue (soit piscine avec les inconvénients, soit rue interne à l'hôtel et assez bruyante). Présence de  gros cafards signalés au Concierge (on m'a dit qu'on allait désinfecter la chambre..), ménage sommaire des fois tardif (après 17h30).
Le service de navettes est à revoir : temps d'attente trop long.
Les repas en buffet sont passables sans plus, les quelques restaurants que j'ai faits sont un poil mieux mais rien de sensationnel, le petit déjeuner miteux et le personnel mal aimable.
Bien qu'ayant le service Concierge il faut aller à 8h du matin à la plage pour réserver une place sinon il n'y a plus rien, les clients étant prêts à en découdre.
Sur la plage il a fallu attendre presque 48 h pour que l'hôtel évacue les algues qui avaient échoué sur le sable, les autres hôtels avaient commencé la veille.
Je signale également que nous nous sommes faits démarcher par des salariés de MELIA soit disant pour nous faire visiter le "PARADISIUS PALMA REAL"  qui paraît-il est beaucoup mieux et le faire savoir après en france autour de nous....On a dit oui si cela prenait maxi une heure car nous ne voulions pas perdre notre temps et en réalité au bout d'une demi heure d'attente parmi d'autres clients qui avaient dus recevoir la même proposition on a compris que c'était du "sharing vacation".
Nous avons été très mécontents d'avoir perdu ainsi notre temps, avons envoyé un mail au Directeur de l'hôtel.
Le Guest relations nous a répondu et est venu nous voir pour s'excuser et nous a indiquer qu'ils allaient changer de méthode...
Tout cela fait que nous ne retournerons jamais dans cet hôtel ni dans un hôtel MELIA.

reviews.author: dbonomo
reviews.title: LA DECADENCIA DE LO QUE FUE EL MEJOR RESORT DE PUNTA CANA
reviews.text: Yo soy socio activo de Melia y lo visito cada 3 meses. En esta oportunidad fue desde el 20 al 30 de julio. Una lastima lo que esta ocurriendo con este Resort. Me tocó presenciar como en la piscina bañaban a un bebe con pañales , le sacaron dentro de la piscina el pañal y lo enjuagaban en la misma. Un asco. Gente con parlante conectado via blue tooth a un volumen excesivo con musica horrible en forma permanente en la playa y piscina del Club. No hay control de las jefaturas y se torna inaceptable.  Todo el Resort con muy poco personal , hay que esperar demasiado tiempo para que limpien mesas en restaurante Naos y para recibir una minima atencion.  Esta experiencia ha sido la peor que tenido.  No obstante , sus trabajadores se esfuerzan muchísimo por atender bien al cliente pero no hay suficientes personas trabajando. Quiero sin embargo destacar a todos los que hacen bien su trabajo. Entre ellos Dionisio Rodriguez y todo su equipo de recepcion de pasajeros socios del club Melia. El Sr. Rodriguez es una persona cordial , profesional , seria y responsable que marca diferencia en la atencion. Junto a él Lenny.  Quiero felicitar tambien a Yeimie y Mensia del Rest. Tepanyaki ; a Angela y Soza del Mitzu ; a Felipe y George en la playa ; a Wanda y Pedro en servicio real , a Yesenia en bar de piscina , a Alejandrina Feliz y Jorgelina como mucamas de las habitaciones ,  a Jorge Marte , Kenia , Antonio Rodriguez, Grey Rigo y Edili Martinez por su gran profesionalismo y cordialidad.  Estas personas te hacen sentir en casa , pero falta apoyo de la Gerencia y devolver privilegios de antes como poner bloqueador en royal service, musica de relax en royal service , bebidas en habitacion , reposicion de frigobar ....en esta oportunidad no habian ni sorbetes ( straws ). Impresentable !!! Finalmente nunca olvidaremos a Francisco Estrella de la playa que despues de mas de 7 años trabajando en el Resort fue injustamente despedido. Todo esto habla muy mal de la Gerencia y la actual conduccion administrativa del Resort.

reviews.author: 742cole
reviews.title: Bad food bad service
reviews.text: The food is horrible and the service was horrible. Impossible to get reservations at resturants. The staff is unfriendly and not helpful. They would have side conversations while I was waiting. Very dissatisfied for the cost of the trip. I've stayed at many all inclusives and this one just wasn't a good one

reviews.author: Kendall E
reviews.title: I will not be back...series of unfortunate events
reviews.text:
First off I will say that the resort itself is beautiful. However don't let that fool you. 
Here's just a brief list of everything that went wrong during my stay...

- No pool towels 2 days in a row 
- Plug in AC unit in my parents bedroom 
- Public beach--harassed by vendors numerous times after I've said no...literally every 15 minutes, I could NOT relax 
- Vendors asking to go parasailing/banana boating literally yelling to get people's attention 
- Leak in bedroom closest 
- No hot water in shower 2 nights in a row 
-Small snake in hallway 
- Buffet food--HORRIBLE...same food lunch & dinner
- Impossible to get reservation at any of the restaurants where there's good food (the one night we were able to eat at hibachi and there was a small roach on the table)
- Roaches in the hallway 
- Service horrible--waiters at buffet 
- Saw man by grill at beach--touching cheese with bare hands..no gloves 
- So much seaweed at beach, couldn't even swim...very unpleasant 
- Our neighbors had ordered breakfast room service and it was left out until the next day. It was attracting cats. 
- Fight broke out one night in the club & resulted in broken glass
- Roach on counter top of hibachi restaurant next to plates 
- Sat down at breakfast asked 4 different people for silverware, waited a good 15 minutes with food infront of us before we could eat
- And I'm not sure if it was the ice or the food but my entire family was constantly in the bathroom...I had the runs for 2 days

reviews.author: Kelly Komuro K
reviews.title: Mar Nojento
reviews.text: Mar cheio de algas!!! Não dá p nadar! Precisamos disputar por um lugar na espreguiçadeira ao redor da piscina. Implorar por um drink no.bar! Limpar a cadeira antes de se sentar p comer no restaurante! Sofá cama todo torto!

reviews.author: 211darylr
reviews.title: Week of July 1st Stay Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Nice location, ageing facility, poorly managed.
Serious mesquito issue in our room. I heard the same from others on lower floors. Killed a roach in my room ( I was in a premium 1 bedroom). Ran out of towels at the beach 2 days. Food average at best.... if you can get in any of the reservayions resturants. If your not in Royal or Reserve..... forget it. Everyone else was treated like second class citizens. We stay at resorts across the carribean every year. I will not return to this hotel or the Melia brand. Beware

reviews.author: M. Cass
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Food and service were substandard for a resort that sells itself as top of the line.  Service in certain areas was poor or non-existence.  The menus in the restaurants for lunch were not varied enough to allow for a light meal, were forced to Buffet which was not much better.

reviews.author: ericaa901
reviews.title: Beautiful Property - Terrible Hospitality
reviews.text:
Several room issues throughout my stay. I went for a wedding and it was a pretty big group of people and we all had issues. Whether it was a bar tender who refused to give us straws or when my phone, shower, and toilet broke and it took two days to fix. I would not recommend arriving on a day other than Saturday or Sunday. You must make dinner reservations and you can do those for the whole week on Saturday or Sunday, but if you arrive any other day you can only do it one day at a time and availability was like 9PM for dinner.  Also, they rank their guests so make sure you book not through a travel agent otherwise you will only be able to do dinner at some of the places. I paid for all inclusive and they charge $5 for room service to be delivered. 
Also, they want you to tip. I've never had an all inclusive experience where they expected tips. They gave me longer wait times at bars when I wasn't holding money in my hand. Also, they only want US dollars.

reviews.author: salvadorb454
reviews.title: You do not get what you are offered!
reviews.text: Staff was great, friendly and courteous, food was good. Except for one time only when they made jokes about our Spanish everything with the staff was great. The Hotel is another matter. From not being picked up form the airport, to facilities that don't work or require better maintenance, this hotel promises more than it delivers. We truly believe they took our money. Internet did not work at the room, the phone did not work, we found cockroaches in the bathroom and hallway, the beach was so bad (they claim its the time of the year, but nobody told us when we made the reservation), we had to spend $100 to go to another beach. Tried talking to the manager twice but unfortunately he was not available. Melia touts itself for being a A-1 hotel. It will be interesting to see how they handle this.

reviews.author: annalzubarev
reviews.title: Luxury Resort with an option of a Butler and Theft!
reviews.text:
This Resort has many Pros and many Cons. The Pools located all over this resort. However, Pools are NOT marked anywhere with the depth.  And they are over 5 ft in depth everywhere.   The food was excellent everywhere we ate!  Rooms were greatly cleaned.  There was a THEFT of iPhone's of 2 different people in 2 different room in the same day, which occurred during our Dolphin excursion. 

Bottom line - NO I would NOT come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Viviana G
reviews.title: SERVICE IS HORRENDOUS
reviews.text:
I was a bit skeptical on booking this hotel again since we had some issues last time but this time it really disappointed even more. The hotel itself is beautiful but the service is horrible. The buffet servers and hostesses did not want to really help anyone, especially big groups. We always made sure to tip anyone that gave us any type of service and still, it was hard to get good service. I asked one hostess (Ana A.) if she could find a table for 12 and she said there were no tables without even looking. I told her I was sure there was something so we took a walk and found a table immediately but it needed to be cleaned. She told me I needed to find someone to clean it. I asked a few servers if they could clean it and also bring a high chair. As my family sat and waited to order their drinks, I went to get food for my kids and when I came back, the table was still dirty without any fresh napkins or silverware and no high chair. I almost always had to wait 10-15 minutes for a high chair. One of the cooks by the meat section (not seafood section-he was awesome) was so nasty to me one day that I had to tell him that if he was at something, not to take it out on me. I went to the buffet manager that day (christian) and he took care of us from then on anytime he saw us which was maybe twice after that. My mother asked one of the servers why it was difficult to get service and he explained to her that the hotel is under new management, employees had been laid off and that their work load had doubled but pay was still low so they decided to be on a somewhat strike. 

My mother and 3 grandkids were in another room a few doors down from us. She left her safe open and left to the beach. That night, she was missing $300 from the safe. We reported it to Guest Services but the girl said there was no way the maid would have made the room if the safe was open, but the room was made when she got back. The manager, Domingo, told my mother 72 hours later that he really tried to pressure the employees that were in her room to come clean but no one did and there was nothing else he could do. The woman at guest services said that there would be an investigation with looking at the log of who entered the room but Domingo told me that there was nothing he could do. It was brushed off like it was nothing. Another family down the hall complained about money missing too so it wasn’t just my family that got robbed.

There is now a $5 delivery fee when ordering room service. I was told at check in that this fee was only applicable to food. The first night I called for milk and hot water for my kids and I was re-informed that the $5 fee was not charged if it was just milk/water. I ordered food a few times and was charged the $5 but never when it was just milk/water TIL the last night. I called and asked for milk/water and Juan from room service told me I had to pay $5. I told him I hadn’t been charged the other times and he said he had to charge me. I asked him to confirm with someone because how could I have been told numerous times that it was free but this time it wasn’t. Juan said he was the guy I had to talk to and there was no one else. One of the room service guys had heard me on the phone talking to Juan and he knew who were were from delivering to us and brought us the milk/water without Juan knowing. He told us he knew we had a baby and that it wasn’t fair to us or them because now guests don’t tip them because of the $5 fee. I happened to be extremely sick and I had to go to the front desk to speak to someone because I was already so frustrated with the service. I had a fever, cold and had been stung by some poisonous plant in the water. The water is full of seaweed that you could barely swim in it. There are mounds of seaweed even before you go in the water that should be cleared out so you don’t have to walk thru them in order to step into the ocean. Half of my family got stomach bugs. It could be from the cooks not using gloves or maybe sweating profusely and then touching the food they cook without any gloves. My aunt was the only one that went to see medical care at the hotel (marisa couso). All the others decided there was nothing that could be done really than to just let it pass stay away from the certain type of food. 

I was told that my family would be given an upgrade because of our experience last time, but all we were given was a bracelet that let us eat at FUEGO, which was the night everyone got sick. The bracelet also gave us access to the therapeutic spa which we were excited for, but the one near us was under renovation so we had to travel to the reserve to be able to use it. 

I was really hoping this time that PARADISUS PALMA REAL would not disappoint, but it did in a way that I wouldn’t go back unless there was an extreme change in the service. The atmosphere between the workers and guests is cold and rude. It’s a shame that such a beautiful hotel that had a great reputation is no longer looked at the way it was. 

There are a few employees’ service that stood out: 

Christian (buffet manager)
Francisco Roman (buffet server)

reviews.author: miguel k
reviews.title: ¿Y la sonrisa dominicana?
reviews.text: Cinco años hace que desde que me asocié a la cadena Melía, ¿ por que lo hice? Fundamentalmente porque al visitar los hoteles de Bavaro, que NO es Punta Cana, gozamos de la excelente atención y siempre dispuesta sonrisa del Dominicano. Así fué hasta Diciembre del 2016, última ves antes de está en julio 2017. ¿Qué pasó? El personal del Paradisus Palma Real ya no sonríe, se los ve tristes, apurados, atosigados de trabajo sin alcanzarles el tiempo para atendernos como seguramente ellos y nosotros "clientes" quisieramos.  Ya no hay fiesta en los bares, las estanterías vacias, parecen a punto de cerrar. Hay malestar y se siente en el ambiente. Los empleados tienen afecto por su trabajo, pero temor por los jefes y estos a la ves por sus superiores. No es este el modo de elevar la calidad de un hotel. Mejoren los servicios, apuesten a cosas nuevas. La variable de ajuste no puede ser el empleado o quitarnos cosas a los clientes. En el corto plazo seguramente el Director mostrará mas utilidades a los propietarios y luego que? Nos iremos de a poco o de a " mucho". Y ahi los numeros caerán. HOY NO les recomiendo la visita. Con gran tristeza lo digo porque siempre senti al Paradisus Palma Real como mi casa.

reviews.author: Brazilover1980
reviews.title: L'envers du décor
reviews.text: L'hôtel est confortable mais en dehors de la chambre, on sent vite la différence. L'envers du décor se trouve dans le Resort qui est composé de deux hôtels (The Reserve et Paradisius). 1) Pour un 5 étoiles all-in à 5700 Euros la semaine, la nourriture est médiocre. Quant aux restaurants comme The Grill, il faut réserver à l'avance car même s'ils ont 10 tables de libres, ils vous ont n'en donneront pas une seule si vous arrivez à l'improviste. 2) Les sodas sont de l'eau colorée. Pour un verre de 25cl, vous aurez au moins 10 glaçons et le reste de soda. Quant aux pailles, elles sont inexistantes,  même pour les cocktails. Là encore c'est médiocre pour un 5 étoiles voire inacceptable. 3) On vous fait miroitier que la formule est all-in mais vous allez vite vous apercevoir du piège. 3 des 7 restaurants sont accessibles que si vous êtes membre du Royal Service en échange de 60 Dollars américains en plus par jour. Il en va de même pour soi-disant l'adult Only où une minuscule piscine +18 vous est réservée. Une vraie arnaque ! 4) Le domaine est vaste et il faut 20 minutes de marche pour en faire le tour. Des mini-bus électriques sont soi-disant là pour vous amener où vous voulez mais les chauffeurs passent leur temps à vous envoyer balader car soit le bus est plein soit il est vide, mais ce dernier rentre au dépôt. 5) La qualité du signal Wi-Fi et la vitesse de surf sont bien durant les heures creuses mais en pleines heures de table ou au soir, oubliez vite les upload de photos de vacances car çà rame. 6) Même étant voisins d'Haïti, les employés ne pètent pas un mot de français. Là encore pour un 5 étoiles, ce n'est pas normal. 6) Les chambres sont spacieuses mais le choix des chaînes TV ne correspond pas à un 5 étoiles ni même un 4 ou 3 étoiles. En conclusion, il est facile d'acheter le ministère du tourisme local... pour obtenir ses étoiles et prendre le touriste pour le dernier des pigeons.

reviews.author: Caroline W
reviews.title: Turn and Run...to another resort.
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this resort with a wedding that took place off location but Paradisus was the host resort. 

Upon check in (at 2:45pm) we were told our room would be ready in 30 minutes and that we should eat at the buffet. We ate a lunch, got a drink, and waiting an additional hour before our rooms were ready. While the rooms were nice we heard other rooms had issues with loss of water, loss of power, leaky walls, cockroaches, and the bride and grooms room went 3 days with no AC before they complained enough to get an upgrade. 

Getting reservations for dinner was a breeze if you enjoy eating at 9:30pm. We arrived on a Thursday and then reservations for the week open up Monday morning. So you either know this and plan accordingly, or don't and plan on eating two dinners. That said, the service at the restaurants was slow and the portion sizes were tiny. The desserts were nothing special (which is frustrating for a sweet tooth like myself). Save the headache and just go to the buffet. However, we would ask for water and it would take at least 20 minutes before it would arrive. 

Now, beyond all of that most of the service was mediocre at best. Eye rolls occurred whenever you asked for a straw in your drink, if you go to the towel shack to get a towel would be served with a healthy dose of "I hate what I do" attitude. I understand the DR are open to tips but I should get exceptional service and then give a tip. This is an all inclusive resort. 

Which leads me to the BEST part of your vacation. Once you check in, wait for your room, beg for a straw in your dirty banana, and finally get that bottle of water you also get a handy dandy wrist band. If you book through the resort it's black and if you book through an agent it's green. If you spend an absurd $220 a night for the gold wrist band you probably good service. We had green bands. Maybe this is why we were treated like red-headed step children. 

I'm good never returning to this country or this resort based solely on this experience. Save your money and go to Jamaica where they want you to return.

reviews.author: Mana2391
reviews.title: Lacking service and staff not informed
reviews.text:
Upon my arrival we were greeted at the entrance where we left our luggage and a lady approached us asking for our names ( which were not in the list) she took us to the front desk and an apparently new recepctionist took care of us. She told us our room was not ready and said we should go eat at the buffet ( which was close because it was 4:30), she needed to know that, thats where I was told by her that she was apparently new... She also said that the resort included snorkeling ( not).
We ate at the blue agave and our waitress had a very bad attitude.. My husband ordered a Salmon burger and the rest of us  a classic. The waiter from the kitchen brought our food (after 40min) and it was until that moment we were told there was no Salmon. Where is the comunication between the kitchen and the waiters? I have been to customer service about 4 times know and it was today when they handed me my book of vouchers and they still have the nerve toask me to go to a linch where they want to sell me the resort. Really? ( I arrived on Saturday) and been to Fuego restaurant where I could have used a voucher. I had no concierge upon arrival which I supposed to have. The waiter in Fuego had an attitude he was Mad as if he does not like working here.
It is impossible to get a place at the beach or pool because everyone saves them around 4 or 5am thats crazy!!!!! 
Towels are left in the chairs and you dont know if they are coming back or not, its just a pain..
Last year we went to an all inclusive in Playa del Carmen and the service was exceptional.....
I will not be back at this resort and still I have 4 more days here :(

reviews.author: jmeitz
reviews.title: Disappointing trip
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real from July 9-16th.   I was very concerned after reading all the negative reviews the past few weeks prior to our arrival.  I can tell you they were 100% accurate our first 4 days.   On days 5-8 it was as if the staff got a swift kick in the butt to do their jobs and it was much better.  

The negatives
*service the first few days were non existent.  It took 15-20 min at breakfast and lunch to get someone to bring you water or acknowledge you and forget about refills.  
*food is not labeled at the buffet so it's a gamble on some food items
*limited selection of food compared to other resorts
*seating at the pool is near impossible if you don't get up before 6am.  
*one day we put our stuff in an empty bungalow and someone tossed our items in the pool.  Come to find out if you don't tip the towel service $10, you don't get the bungalow.   
*Room is outdated and needs repair.  Had a 1 bedroom suite that had plenty of bugs and cockroaches.  
*Room service cost $5 per order
*Housekeeping and drink refill was hit or miss along with turndown service
*Olio restaurant is avg
*mosquitoes were horrible both in room and around the resort.  

Positives
*Met some great staff members that made our trip better (Vladimir Rodriquez, Trazy our concierge, Jose Luis Riviera and Wily)
*gluten free food made in back daily
*Rare steakhouse, Mizu and Blue Agave
*Received free Reserve upgrade for all our issues 
*Reserve pool is nice and relaxing
*Beach is very nice and plenty of seating
*kids loved the kids club (Carlos, O'Neil and Samantha)
*Evening entertainment was ok

If our trip would have been like the last few days this would have been a 4 star resort at a minimum.  Management seems to understand there are issues and are addressing them.   My wife and I have been to nearly 20 resorts and this one is at the bottom 2 or 3 of our list.

reviews.author: gracecostaab
reviews.title: vacation in Paradisus golf spa
reviews.text: Beautiful place, very very poor service. staff with attitude seem lost. Making reservation for the restaurant first day arrival all booked. Rooms clean 6pm or 7pm  Not a good experience at all. The beach was dirty lots of seaweeds, if you tip the employees they serve you at the beach, if you don"t tip they never show up. Entertainment very very poor.

reviews.author: Stefanie S
reviews.title: Tropical and clean. Terrible customer service!
reviews.text:
First, it was a beautiful location. Punta Cana was very nice.  Flight and transportation went smoothly.  We arrived at the Resort and were greeted by a family concierge named Sandra. She sat us at a table, gave us a welcome drink, went over the paperwork for the pool towels, etc...Everything seemed to be going well. She then gave us a VIP bracelet to wear during our stay. I had signed up for Marriot rewards prior to going and she stated that this was part of the reward program and got us access to a private seating section on the beach, personalized drink service on the beach, 1 free upgraded dinner reservation, etc.  I thought it seemed odd but went with it.   She explained we needed to choose our dinners and turn them into the reservation lady to guarantee dinner other than buffet each night.  Since we arrived when reservations was closed for the day we turned them in at 9am the following morning when they opened up.  The reservation lady spoke little to no English and wouldn't get anyone to help us understand her better. After a few hours of going back to her to confirm our dinner reservations for our 2nd night there she told me she didn't have any reservations for us and we would need to eat buffet again.  I asked again if she could get us in at any of the restaurants and she was able to at 6:30pm. We showed up at 6pm and the lady told us our reservation wasn't until 8:00. I explained that's not what my paper said and she replied "you wrong, my paper show 8pm. come back then" so we left and ate buffet food instead (2 nights in a row now in addition to breakfast and lunch). The following day I had to go back to the reservation lady and see if she had the rest of our dinner reservations. After 45 minutes she found our paper and it still had not been confirmed for our reservations so we sat there for another 30 minutes while she called and confirmed our reservations. The 3rd night we showed up at 6:30 for our reservations and was told dinner was at 9:30pm. I explained and showed them my paperwork that showed 6:30 and they told me it wasn't right and I had to come back at 9:30pm at this point I was pissed off (there was more that happened with Sandra at this point but I'll get back to that).  I started getting an attitude and asked to speak to a manager. I was told they don't have restaurants managers but hotel managers instead. I asked to speak to one and was repeatedly told no one was available. Finally after about 30 minutes I was told a manager from the Paradisus Punta Cana would talk with us (mind you we were staying a the Reserves so a different resort). I started to explain the situation (and at first I was calm but quickly got loud and annoyed) and the manager just kept saying "I understand but you need to calm down. We have a buffet for you to eat at" he said this at least 4 times before I started to have a fit. I didn't pay $2000 for buffet food 24/7 and my reservation sheet had certain times 2 nights in a row they still wouldn't let us eat at the restaurants.  One of the restaurant workers heard us talking and offered us a table at the steak house. Best food we've ever had on vacation! The waiter was amazing! He kept apologizing for our service at the resort. 
Back to Sandra...after all the formalities she told us to come back the next morning that she wanted to show us around the property and the sister properties. We show up and we all start to walk the property and she's explaining the shows (which are only 45 minutes long 1x each evening), restaurant locations, Casino (3 working slot machines and 2 open table games. The Casino was also only open 7-11pm) beach area, etc...Then she sits us down and tells us to wait a minute that her co worker will be taking us to the sister property so we know how to get around there.  The co worker comes out and gives me a form to sign. It was a vacation club tour!!!!  I had considered doing the tour but they wouldn't fill in how long the tour would take and said "sometimes 1 hour sometimes all day"  well that didn't sit well with me so I said “no thank you” and we left.  After that we couldn't get any good service the rest of the trip. We ignored at breakfast buffet the next morning. Nobody even came to give us water to drink.  It took 2 full days to get a package of bottled water delivered to the room. Room service took 2.5 hours for 1 cheese pizza.  Sandra was not available to speak with in the coming days and refused to speak to us when we left.  We expressed our disappointment with the front desk and there was response was "sorry you're not happy"  and that was it.

reviews.author: Scott T
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, but low quality and service is non-existent!
reviews.text:
Went there July 4th week of 2017 and was expecting a whole lot more than what I got! 

First of all, so I don't sound completely negative, it is a beautiful resort. However, the all-inclusive was a little disappointing; they skimped on the alcohol in the drinks (some of the weakest drinks I've ever had), the restaurants were over-crowed and often times we could not get reservations until 9:00 at night. If it were not for the buffet I would have starved! In fact, we ended up eating at the buffet for breakfast, lunch, and dinner most days. The service at the resort is non-existent! One night it took an hour just to get drinks! Then another hour to get food. 

Our "concierge" who was supposed to assist with dinner reservations did absolutely nothing to get my requested reservations made. The two times I was able to get into a restaurant I made my own reservations. And one of the two restaurants was not included in the all-inclusive package and I had to pay $100 to get in. 

Also, I thought I was going to an adults only resort only to find that was not the case. Supposedly I could have upgraded to a small enclave of the resort they call "Royal Service" which is supposed to be adults only section, however, I could clearly see that section of the resort and there plenty of kids there too. 

The constant barrage of sales tactics also got a little tiring toward the end of the trip. My concierge kept wanting me to attend a 30 minute presentation on becoming an "owner" so I could gain access to the other Melia resorts. Based on the service levels received there was nothing compelling enough to make me want to be an owner. 

Lastly, I do have to say that the Dominican people are extremely friendly and very pleasant. Everyone was very nice, just not real service-oriented. 

I was concerned about coming here based on some of the reviews, but my travel agent assured my that it was a first class resort, and I also had one personal reference that this was a top-notch resort. However, I can tell you from my own experience that was not the case. I've been to other resorts that are far better than this one.  

If you decide to go, good luck! I hope your experience is more like some of the glowing reviews than what I actually experienced.

reviews.author: Ivy184
reviews.title: A staff coup! Families read this!
reviews.text:
Let me begin with the disclaimer that we are well traveled and we did a TON of research to find the best resort for our vacation. We traveled with our 3 year old son and 18 month old daughter. We are pretty easy going but out of 100 things that could have gone wrong - never did i anticipate reason #101 - a staff coup!

The service here was ridiculously bad and no matter how gorgeous the resort, bad service will make the experience a bad one. We read so many reviews before booking our trip. A few years ago, maybe this place WAS amazing with unparalleled service - or so we heard from other returning guests and from the reviews you will likely read. This was our first time here and we tried to roll with the punches; after all, nothing is ever perfect and we are pretty easy going people understanding that we are in a different country. However, the service here got REALLY bad and from so many other guests we met, we were not alone in our disappointment during our stay. We heard all kinds of horrible stories last week from other guests but I can only speak to our experience. 

There is apparently a staff coup going on right now. We learned they have new management, just laid off 250 people and the ones that are still employed are not being paid all of their wages! You can imagine this makes for some pretty disgruntled service. The only means staff have to protest is to put the guests in the middle of this drama which makes situations uncomfortable to down-right intolerable.

The main reason we booked here was the 24 hour ALL INCLUSIVE room service. With wee ones, you can imagine, long naps during the day and early bed times means a lot of time in the room. They began to limit us to 4 beers in the room a day (ridiculous) and charging us for room service! It's supposed to be ALL INCLUSIVE! Room service told us they JUST changed the room service policy a few days ago. Baloney! You cant just change our package half way through! When my husband asked to speak to the manager, they hung up on us and when we tried to call back - they would not answer. Seriously?! For the record, we tipped US$300 in less than 5 days! So the poor service was not for lack of tipping generously. 

Last week, staff CLOSED the main buffet in protest! We have children we need to feed! 

Some staff (housekeeping noted) are very nice but generally, everyone seems to have a chip on their shoulder and I felt guilty asking for things. 

The food was great - no bad stomachs but it was the non stop little things like going to the buffet and waiting 15-20 minutes because there are NO plates! Or finally finding a dirty table just to sit there for another 30 minutes because no one will clean it or bring you a drink as you stare at your prized plate with no utensils! Argh!

I watched as staff got hamburgers smuggled to them on the d-low and .... I kid you not, the guy making your drinks pool side, did not wash his hands in the bathroom as my husband stood there mouth agape, gagging. Care for another hand squeezed lime drink, amigo?!

OMG. The pool chair fights! For some odd reason, for a swimming pool the size of a small country they have VERY limited seating. Most bali beds and chairs were gone by 7am with people's towels on them. One morning, a near fist-fight broke out between guests!! Limited seating, no shade .... and you look over at the dozens of empty seats roped off section for Royal and reserve guests totally empty. Nuts!! Oh, and they ran out of towels. Of course they did.

By day 5, enough was enough! So, we complained to the general manager who was not surprised but is powerless to get things under control. Everything seems to be managed in silos and dysfunctional all around. For example, a lovely fireworks show was provided.... at 11:00pm! Come on! Its a family resort. Who was even awake? 

Oh and for those that are going to this resort for the Michelin star restaurant.... read the fine print - this is not included and it is very expensive. Nor are the good restaurants included as well - you can only dine at some of them if you are again, the "Reserve".

Now, here's the thing. If you booked at the Reserve, chances are you will not be affected by poor service - only when you go to the main resort, will you feel like a second class citizen as you wait for 3 hours for a la carte dining.

The explanation of the oh-so confusing Paradisus Palma Real vs the Reserve....

The Reserve is the upscale gorgeous intimate upgrade resort WITHIN the Paradisus Palma Real Resort. But, the Reserve is a very far golf cart drive away from the main resort, beach and main restaurants. I debated so seriously whether we should upgrade to this area but didn't because some reviews said it was far from the beach and not worth the money. The Reserve also has a kids pool (the ones in the pics with the slides) and a kids club which anyone has access to, even if you are staying at the main resort. So i figured why bother upgrading. However, for the amount that we tipped, it would have been the same to upgrade to Reserve.  

In the main resort, we stayed in a one bedroom master suite 3502. Huge and lovely. We had a full kitchen, full living room and dining room table, pull out king sofa bed, huge bathtub, generous patio with full dinette. Be forewarned. We were one of the closest suites to pool and restaurants so we didn't need a golf cart. However, I can see needing a golf cart for most of the other rooms especially if its super hot, elderly or little children. Our room was right in front of the golf cart pick up which made for interesting people watching from our balcony but very loud at night. 

I have to say, this resort is beyond beautiful. If only the service was on par with the beauty, this place would be top notch. It was disappointing, to say the least and we won't be going back. Such a pity.

reviews.author: Sonia B
reviews.title: Royal service not worth the upgrade
reviews.text:
