We stayed at this resort for a wedding in early July. I decided to use our Amex points to upgrade to the "Royal service", with a little hesitation however for 3 days I thought it may be worth it. The reviews were all amazing and the points needed for one night were more than I've ever used (over 100k or $834) so with that being said I expected the experience to be one of a kind. Sadly we were very disappointed. 
We travel A LOT and have stayed at many different hotels from HoJo's to the Fairmont, and usually when one checks in after traveling your bags are taken from you, here we arrived to check in and were escorted to the "royal service" check in room which was on the other side of the property and not once did our escort offer to help with our bags. Not a huge deal but definitely not 5-star service. Check in was a little awkward and not well explained. I'd expect an exclusive upgrade would include a quick check in not a long drawn out one. Once our "butler" escorted us to our room and explained how everything worked he was kind enough to offer us a tour of the property. After our tour, we were ready for a late breakfast as we'd be traveling all morning. It was about 11/1130 am, our Butler recommended the Mexican restaurant. Once we arrived at the Mexican restaurant we noticed they only served burgers and hot dogs, because the resort was in between breakfast and lunch there was literally nowhere else to eat on the entire property! We tried the pool bars and were told they do not serve food, at all. FYI: there is no poolside food service and minimal poolside drink service. We went back to our rooms and ordered room service (this was included with our royal service) it did take about 30-40 minutes which by that point my husband had fallen asleep waiting. Needless to say, the meal was subpar. I was so disappointed even within the first hour of arriving, it was nothing we've ever experienced and with a price tag of over $800 a night it really put a damper on the trip. 

Anyhow, I'm mostly writing this so people don't expect more than what the hotel can actually offer. It is an all-inclusive resort and you are therefore at the mercy of the scheduled meals. Our Butler was sweet and as helpful as could be but quite frankly not worth the upgrade, through no fault of his own. 

Anyhow, I hope this helps if you are on the fence about the upgrade. We are pretty self-sufficient travelers and adjust well to other cultures. If you're not used to traveling abroad perhaps this would be a good option for you as your given a butler cell phone for you to call him with any needs or questions you may have. 

CONS: 
Royal service overrated 
Rooms only have 1 sink
Horrible wifi connection
Shower handle broke (no hot water for 2 days)
NO decent meal options outside of buffet times
Most meals were mediocre 
No food allowed at any of the bars, including pool bar
No beachside or poolside service 
Room service tag left on door for breakfast- it never arrived 
Dinner reservations must be made at one of the on-site restaurants.
Not all royal service rooms have an ocean view. 

PRO's
beautiful property
pleasant staff
pool activities and shows on property
skirt steak (at RARE restaurant) 
the wedding we attended was well taken care of by the staff
butler drew a nice bath for us without us even asking. Wine, cheese plate and chocolate covered strawberries and all. It was the highlight of the upgrade.

reviews.author: acschwass
reviews.title: Not Worth The Money
reviews.text:
It is always difficult to read reviews and "calibrate" ones expectations with what you are reading in the review.  I know I read the reviews before making reservations, and do understand there are always good and bad reviews.  That said, we have been to Punta Cana three years in a row for our family vacation so have some basic expectation/understanding of what you should get with an all inclusive package....good service, good food, clean and fun/entertaining for the whole family.....and we are a family that does not expect anything close to "royal treatment" if you will.  So, if you are looking for a balanced/honest review from a family that has pretty basic expectations please keep reading.......

I will start with what we liked about the resort:
1.  Clean property
2.  Nice beach with lots of lounge chair seating
3.  Restaurant food/service was pretty good (Rare, Aqua, Bana)
4.  After about 3 days we found several of the buffet servers to be very pleasant/attentive.
5.  Evening entertainment/shows were pretty good....really liked Queen tribute and they did a good job with Lion King for being a "low budget reproduction".

...so here is where the resort fell well short of what we paid for and unfortunately overshadowed the positives:
1.  Check in was awful.  "20 minutes" was the line we heard several times.  We arrived late due to our plane (a whole other story - left two hours late from CLE because the flight was over weight limit.  How can a charter vacation airline be over a weight limit????) and simply wanted to check in so we could get to the pool.  We arrived at 3 and didn't check in until after 5 and only one of our two rooms was ready.

2.  Maintenance service was awful.  We had to call three times over a two day period to get the shower fixed in our kids room.  Ultimately it completely broke and I had to fix it.  

3.  Room cleaning service was rude and of pretty low quality.  The minibar was not stocked very well, we barely ever received wash cloths, and three of the days they showed up around 6PM - which of course is when we are there getting cleaned up for dinner.  The staff was rude to our children.  One evening they were getting ready and asked the staff to come back in 30 minutes....the lady proceeded to tell the children they had 10 minutes and she'd be back.  Who is the paying customer?

4.  Beach lounge chairs - this is of course always a first come first serve deal, and I give credit to those that are willing/able to wake up at the crack of dawn on vacation to get a good spot.  What we actually found was that every morning someone from the hotel staff was putting "stuff" on chairs to reserve for people (and heard later that people were paying her to do it for them) who wouldn't show up until 10AM+ in the morning.  THE STAFF reserving an entire front two rows...wow!!!!  This is a completely unacceptable practice, especially when "tipping is not required".

5.  Blue Agave - food was good but they opened at 7:30 at least twice when told they would open at 7PM.  This is an issue when their entertainment shows started at 8:30!

6.  Daily entertainment - they had some daily activities but the entertainment crew was not very active nor did they have a whole lot of "games" going on.  This is certainly different at each resort, and maybe we were spoiled last year by an amazing entertainment experience at Dreams so take this with a grain of salt.

7.  Understaffed - the resort was generally understaffed at a few key places/times of day.  They should certainly know peak times for the resort, but missed with regard to:  breakfast buffet and bar service in evening at Gabi bar

In the end this was the most expensive of the three resorts we've been to but would be #3 on our list.  We do not plan on visiting again as it wasn't worth the money we paid as compared to other resorts with better service (as ultimately I believe it was the poor service that frustrated us the most).

reviews.author: JeanCarlosMarte
reviews.title: Came To Business With My Couple
reviews.text:
Bad service. Every employee talks about the new rules of the new Director. Everyone justifies the bad service because of him. The pool is too old and dirty. 

But not all is bad. Never go to the Mediterranean restaurant. But you can go to the sushi restaurant, the italian restaurant and the meats restaurant.

reviews.author: juliana e
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING
reviews.text:
We recently went to Paradisus Palma Real and were very disappointed. To Start off, they have a bad ROACH problem. They sent someone to fumigate the room but the bugs had already made their way to our luggage where i found a couple of dead ones as I was packing before coming home. The shower in the room was antiquated and difficult to operate to the point that we had to call several times for them to send someone over who could walk us through it. The food wasn't great, actually the room service menu was tastier than the buffet area where even the ice cream was just a mix of milk,food coloring and sugar. 
It seemed like they didn't change the sheets every day as one day we left the remote control on the bed and after returning found it underneath the sheets tucked in with the "freshly made bed" so I guessed they made the bed with the same sheets. The TV volume didn't work at all, we weren't able to control the volume because the Tv did it on its on going from extremely loud to an impossible to hear level.They didn't have an ATM that dispensed dollars but if you wanted to withdraw you had to use a company they had inside the hotel who only let you take a minimum amount they determine at high rates.   I could go on and on about the reasons I wouldn't stay here again because yes, there are more.... perhaps if you're still considering you should bookThe Reserve where they actually give customers real Haagen Dazs ice cream for like 200 dollars more a person. After paying over $5,000 for my husband,my daughter and I, I fell that the least we deserved was real ice cream for dessert.

reviews.author: Eddy S
reviews.title: Nice hotel but you need to be extremely patient
reviews.text: This is my first time writing a review on a hotel. I have been a few times to Punta Cana, different resorts and I have never had this experience. The staff is friendly generally, the food is good however there's not much variety. We are a group of 25 people that are all pretty upset about the wait time to get a car to move around the hotel taking into account that the beach is pretty far from hotel. We have to wait 35 to 55 minutes for a car to go anywhere in the hotel, like I said, if you are extremely patient you'll have no issues. We are still at the hotel, we leave the hotel on July 5th, 2017

reviews.author: Rado W
reviews.title: Very disappointed so far
reviews.text:
This is our first day of four nights staying here. So far our experience is way below our expectation. Following are some examples:

1. Restaurant reservation: We submitted the restaurant "wish list" right when we arrived around 2 PM but were told every restaurant that requires reservation were full this evening. Surprisingly when we passed by three of those restaurants at dinner time, there were plenty of empty seats. The dinner has two timeslots, and we saw the scenes about the time the second timeslot began.

2. No response: We requested to change to a higher floor room in the hope of fewer mosquito. We understand it may be difficult since it's peak season but what we were upset with is the request went unanswered even we had made two phone calls. We finally went to concierge and she called the reservation office and immediately told us no room is available. Does it mean the person who answered our phone calls never helped make the request? I hope it was not the case.

3. In general, staff not as friendly as described in some of the reviews: People are nice, but maybe there at too many guests they felt "tired" in responding to some ordinary request, for example providing drink. One staff was even a little rude. I said two adults and one high chair but he replied "4 people?" I thought I wasn't clear so repeated it slowly, but he immediately replied, "I know, I speak English." Thank you for speaking English.

4. No enough shuttles: Most of time we  need the shuttle to take us from one place to another, since some takes 15 minute walk and we have a stroller. However in the evening it seems there isn't enough shuttles and some shuttles even just passed us without stopping (we were told by concierge shuttle will stop even we are in the middle of two stops). We think we were not alone since on the way we saw many people waiting on the roadside and looked unhappy.

5. Slow response: We asked room service for hot water to make infant formula. 20 minutes past, no one showed up. Made another phone call, hot water delivered in 10 minutes. I couldn't figure out why it took 30 minute to just get hot water. (There is a coffee machine in the room but we don't want to use water with coffee smell to make infant formula) 

That's it.

We hope things will get better in the rest few days.

reviews.author: Mimi V
reviews.title: bait and switch
reviews.text:
My sister and I booked through hotels.com with The Reserve at Paradisus Palma Real and when we got there, the front desk said we got upgraded to 'Royal Service' and we got sent to another area. Once we checked in at 'Royal Service', we went to the room and realize that the property we were on was Paradisus Palma Real and not The Reserve. When we realize this, they tried to explain and make excuses saying it was an upgrade and that The Reserve is full of families with kids and we would enjoy this property better. And they'll also upgrade us to a partial ocean view room. They then offer to show us a room on the other property but it was not ready. When we did finally get around to seeing the room, it was overlooking a garden (which is fine as it is what we booked) but it was also overlooking a construction site. The room was nicer as it has a separate room from the living room, enclosed bathroom, Jacuzzi tub on the balcony, and two TVs. We decided to keep the room at Paradisus Palma Real since we already checked in and we didn't want to have a view of the construction. I also have a suspicion that they showed us the crappiest room that was furthest from the beach to try to get us to stay at the current resort.

We went back to Paradisus Palma Real and they moved us to a partial ocean view suite room. With Royal Service, you have a butler that you can call at all times to make reservations, etc. We called the first night to make reservations to Bana (Japanese Restaurant) at 6PM and he confirmed. When we got there, it was closed. The second night, we made reservations at another restaurant for 6:45PM and when we got there, they said our reservation was at 6PM. A few evenings we called, he didn't pick up. When we made excursion reservations, we decided to just go do it directly with the company because going through the butler was like playing telephone. There were other things that irked us such as the scale being broken, the safe had no instruction, and one day after being gone all day, we come back to discover our toothbrushes were wet (gross).

Like previous reviews stated, the resort credit coupons are useless. We used all the spa ones. There was a few for the restaurant but when we tried to use a $50 one at Passions, they said it wasn't valid there. That's the only restaurant with a surcharge for Royal Service guest and you couldn't use their resort credit.This hotel is horrible. The only staff member I like is Wander at Vento. He is such a genuinely happy guy.

2/5, I would not recommend this hotel nor would I be staying at a Melia property again.

reviews.author: Ana A
reviews.title: It used to be the best
reviews.text: I have been coming to paradisus Palma real  for over 10 years and before it use to be the best and fun . Now there is no music or activities every person that I talked to there were saying they expected some kind of entertainment but only entertainment they have is a little at called The Avenue which just that a bar. Other things have changed too besides the entertainment they have less waiters to your wait to eat is longer. Rooms are beautiful but with a lot of things not functioning. Our first night we had to sleep with the tv on because it would not turn off, the water from our bathroom faucets hardly came out our back slider lock was. broken telephone did not work they upgraded us to their The Reserve at Beach and the light in bathroom did work and our safe did not work and they took 2 days to fix it. I sit here while I am still at the resort and wondering what happened . Well I guest I am going to have to look for another place to go don't think I will return

reviews.author: trentbakerd
reviews.title: Not a Relaxing Carribean Vacation
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is not the place to stay if you are looking for a relaxing vacation with your spouse. Choose a different resort if you want relaxation. The food was ok, but the overall experience is frustrating due to hotel staff members constantly attempting to sell you the next trip.

reviews.author: Jorge C
reviews.title: Extraordinary staff.  One very good restaurant.  Otherwise: mediocrity and boredom
reviews.text:
The extraordinary:

Yarol, our concierge, Stephanie, at the Family Concierge Reception, Senia and Martin at Passion Restaurant.  Almost everybody else in the staff was friendly, competent and helpful.  

The exceptions:  some of the internal "train" drivers, unhelpful and apparently in a permanent sour mood, and waiters and what we guess were supposed to be Maitre' Ds: they are poorly trained, and when you don´t know what you are doing, a good disposition and a bright smile will only take you so far.

Food.

The resort has buffet restaurants, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and "a la carte" restaurants, which require a reservation and are open only for dinner.

None of the buffets were inviting, and most of the food offered was either mediocre or bad.  With some care and patience we always found something relatively good to eat, but the overall quality was low.

As for the "a la carte" restaurants we visited, mediocrity was the norm.  

An Italian "restaurant" that was more or less a pizza parlor with some unremarkable pasta dishes.

An Argentinian grill where the meat was good, the noise unbearable (that is what you get when you are in a glass cube with no curtains or other noise absorbing surfaces) and the side dishes sad.

An Asian restaurant that announced a variety of experiences, but offered only teppanyaki, at a table shared with 8 unannounced strangers; my family was surprised. A Russian couple, dressed to the tilt, obviously had planned on a romantic dinner, and couldn't hide their bitter disappointment.

The big exception is "Passion". It is not run by Martin Berasategui and it has not earned any Michelin stars, as the casual reader might think. But it is seriously good.  A fantastic experience.

Entertainment.

For unfathomable reasons, in a country full of extraordinary musicians and where you average grandmother on a wheelchair can set a dance floor on fire, there was no live music or dancing.  Instead, a "show" (Lion King! Michael Jackson!) was offered in a room that nobody would confuse for a theater.  If you came here, and you have been really, really bad, and deserve punishment, go to a performance.  Otherwise, watching a re-run of Charlie's Angels or Magnum PI is the superior choice.

Swimming pools.

I don´t know about your kids, but mine, when they were small and we went to the beach, wanted to swim and play in the ocean all day, and play in the pool until late in the evening.  If yours are anything like this, be warned:  the pools are closed at 5 pm here.

Beverages

If you ask for a fruit smoothie, chances are somebody will pull out a bottle of heavy "fruit flavored" syrup from a fridge, mix it with ice, and give it to you.  When we insisted on fresh, unsweetened fruit, mixed with ice and blended, the bartender was bewildered.  All coctails are god-awful, as a result, undoubtedly, of very cheap, bad liquor going into the mix.  If you want alcoholic beverages, stick to JW Black or beer (included in the "all inclusive" price) or go for premium liquors and wines, which are extra.  If you want coffee, there is good Nespresso machine at the Family Concierge reception, with a good variety of flavors on offering.  Otherwise, if have any appreciation for good coffee, stay away from what is offered at the buffet restaurants (I don´t drink coffee in the evening, so I don´t know if the coffee at the "a la carte" restaurants is good or bad).

To end on a positive note, the room we got (Family Concierge Master Suite) was gorgeous, spacious, well lit and well appointed.  And the (included) room service was a good touch.

Walking on the beach one night, we bumped into a beach party hosted by a much cheaper resort down the beach.  A troupe of some eight female and eight male local dancers took turns performing as a troupe and inviting guest to dance with them or with each other.  For an hour or so the beach was full of life and passion.  It was almost enough to make the trip worthwhile.

reviews.author: MMinUSA
reviews.title: Noisy rooms, weird key problems and bad restaurant service
reviews.text:
Well - on the surface, there are some really nice things about this property.   The rooms are nice, clean, big.  The hotel is clean, full of friendly service people and for an all-inclusive, has a nice buffet.   It is FAR from the beach - we knew that going in, so I'm not rating poorly because of that, but I want to emphasize FAR!  

When we go on a beach vacation really the primary thing we want from our hotel is sleep.   We spend very little time otherwise in our rooms.   The biggest reason this hotel is getting a bad rating is due to the amount of noise in our rooms.   We could hear the hotel shuttle transport all night long, other guest's doors opening and closing (I won't say slamming - because it wasn't deliberate, but it was slamming), noise from the central area and other guests and loud music, seemingly from off property, as we could never locate the source.   We got so little sleep it impacted our entire vacation.    This is the key factor in my poor rating - the other items below are significant enough that I feel obligated to mention them - but the noise is the reason that I wouldn't go any higher than 2 out of 5.  

We had weird key issues .  Our door just stopped locking one day - no matter what we did on the inside, it could be opened from the exterior without a key.  One of our keys stopped opening one of our doors, but opened the other.  We were with a large group of people, 7 rooms total - but all separate reservations (different names, dates, # people and even booked on different dates and computers) - and when we checked out, other peoples room keys were deactivated.   

Finally, as I said, we were part of a large group, and we specifically made dinner reservations EARLY, to accommodate our group.   The reservations were communicated to one restaurant incorrectly - instead of being prepared to seat 12, they had the reservation down for 5 (the number of people in the room that made the request) - while this is an understandable mistake - they were really nasty about it, and really unpleasant about accommodating us.  They actually made us go back to the room and get our packet showing the reservation at 12 people.   Another restaurant couldn't seat us in the restaurant (2 tables of 8...) and they sat us in the buffet and delivered the food to us.   Great food - but really weird, made a big "lack of atmosphere" impact.  For a location that advertises for weddings, I was disappointed in the problems we had eating dinner together.   

I do want to say that the staff we dealt with (excluding the restaurants) was extremely pleasant and helpful.   I almost hate to name our concierge as this is not a positive review, but he was incredible.   If you need something and he can fix it, he will.   He knew us by name and stopped and checked on us multiple times throughout the days.   Ronny is amazing!   Thank you for all that you did!  He deserves a 5 out of 5.

reviews.author: DimArh
reviews.title: Испорченный отпуск
reviews.text: В настоящий момент находимся и будем (к сожалению) находиться здесь ещё 9 дней. В Доминикане 2-й раз, но с проблемами столкнулись только в этом отеле. В прошлый приезд останавливались в другом отеле этой же сети - надо сказать, там работа менеджмента поставлена на несравнимо более высокий уровень. Сам отель красивый, да - фотографии вас не обманывают. Персонал приветливый, обходительный, услужливый - к этому замечаний нет. Дальше начинаются "но". Старая мебель и лежаки, нехватка столовых приборов, нехватка официантов. Номер полулюкс парадисус не рекомендую отдельно - неизолированный туалет со всеми сопутствующими ему признаками испортит вам всё настроение от окружающих красот. Рестораном надо заниматься отдельно. Помимо уже указанных недоработок - имеет место некачественное приготовление пищи, постоянно непропечённые мясо и рыба, непрожаренные овощи. По залу снуют мыши. Зачастую не хватает посадочных мест (при этом часть ресторана отгораживается и не обслуживается, там в одиночестве принимает пищу некий загадочный менеджер, указывающий обслуге, как правильно расставлять горшочки с травой на столах, пространно рассуждающий о концепции и идее данного ресторана, но не умеющий навести в нём порядок). По отелю идёт эпидемия желудочно-кишечных расстройств, о чём явственно свидетельствуют звуки, доносящиеся из общественных туалетов и туалетных комнат других номеров. Менеджер озабочен концепцией, ему не до этих мелочей. Детский бассейн представляет из себя небольшую по радиусу грязную круглую лужицу. Не видел ни разу спасателей в зоне бассейна. Наблюдал однажды, как в основной бассейн с баром прямо в одежде, в обуви прыгнул вконец перепаренный уборщик. Сейф в номере есть, но в течение 10 дней нам так его и отремонтировали. В остальном - как обычно, доминиканцы приветливы и добродушны, океан радует тёплым прибоем и почти полным отсутствием волн, дворец прекрасен, несмотря на небольшие недоработки и странные предметы в интерьере. Что делать дальше, как улучшить работу отеля - думать руководству сети Melia

reviews.author: Lorraine K
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: From the disorganized and very long check-in to the food, this was a very disappointing resort. Stayed at this resort in February and was very excited based on outstanding reviews on TripAdvisor. After my stay, i can only wonder if the great reviews were astroturfing. The property and beach are beautiful. If you love walking on the beach, you can walk for miles and that is great. That being said, the service is lacking. Concierge could not be less helpful if she tried. Rooms are well appointed but in need of repair. Air conditioning was 24C when it was 25C outside. Spoke with other vacationers who had 20C and 11C in their rooms. Calls for repair were answered once (out of 3 calls), without any change. Roof leaked, safe wouldn't open even though was keying in right code. Finally problem solved with battery change. Turn down service was at 10:30 pm! For a family resort, far too late. Very noisy because of building materials. You can hear everyone in the hallways (stone stair case) and doors slam very loudly, shut. So when you are trying to sleep, all you hear is people and doors slamming shut. Shower door didn't close tight so had to either have bathroom floor flooded or jam the shampoo tube under the door to keep it closed. Water temp in shower was scalding. Had to let run for 10 minutes before entering. Never ran cool to cold. Food was terrible. Best food at Reseve only restaurant (not buffet or poolside) and room service. Ceviche at Mexican restaurant so salty it was inedible. Everywhere else, very salty too, and not good. Notwithstanding, have to say they had fresh coconut at buffeting the morning and very good oatmeal and yogurt, plus cold soups at lunch very notably good. The alarm clock in my room was set for 12 am and even though I looked and looked, and asked concierge to turn off 3 times, I could not figure out how to turn alarm off. Every morning, I asked concierge to get someone to turn alarm off, yet every night at 12 am, it went off. Finally, after mentioning to staff in Reserve lobby, the clock was turned off, not the alarm. No Do Not Disturb sign, so chamber maid knocked on door every night for turn down at 10:30pm. You have a limit of 4 restaurant reservations for a 7 day stay. Couldn't get steakhouse reservation, was told by other vacationer that they couldn't get steakhouse either, until they tipped their concierge. I have never written this bad of a review ever, of any resort, but after months of thinking about whether to do so or not, finally decided I had to say something. I cannot recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Jodie F
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text: booked a room with 2 beds, was given a king size bed and my guest on a business trip was told to sleep on a stained couch. looked like my mechanic dad sat on it in his work clothes. went to call the front desk to complain only to find out the phone didnt work. walked 1/4 back to th3 front desk to let them know the issue with the one bed and the phone not working only to be told we have the largest room in the villas so its okay. they were not able to provide 2 beds until the day before we left as their other hotel flooded so they gave our room to these people. they brought a twin size bed into the room for my friend to sleep on. we thought all was set until we used the toilet. wouldnt flush. took 4 calls to get it fixed. a couple of days into the trip we saw the same twin beds they gave my friend to sleep on lying out back in the grass of building 39. they were there everyday after that as we checked for the next 3 days. may favorite was discovering blood on my sheets the 3rd night. maid service was hit or miss and a couple of days went by without any clean towels. when they were there you would see your cup moved ontop of the tv or a used rubber glove on the floor. one night at the buffet i found a kleenex in the romaine. i asked for more romaine and it was like this was a common occurance. they really need to put more effort into keeping the rooms clean like they do the common areas. it was common to hear from other guests they had bugs in their rooms amd similar cleanliness issues. many of the activites listed on the website are not available. the only nightly entertainment is  a michael jackson show, cirque de i wanna be solei and robots dancing in the bar. the gift shop staff were dishonest. they would tell you what you had in your hand is 20% off then you would buy it, they would tell you yes, on sale but on the receipt there is no discount and when you asked they would go oh no i didnt say that.

reviews.author: Kristyn F
reviews.title: Fourth Trip a Disappointment
reviews.text: Let me preface this review by saying we were married at this resort, came here a second time, and then brought our one year old daughter here for our third trip last May. All of my reviews have been 5 stars, up until this trip. This May was our fourth trip and we decided, upon recommendation, to use Family Concierge. I was extremely disappointed in the FC service. I was never contacted by Family Concierge until I sent an email to the main Paradisus email. When someone, Estheffani, from FC at the reserve finally emailed me, I filled our her requested forms and then hadn't heard back from her, nor did she answer my questions regarding airport transfer. I reached out again to her, only to have the email bounce back and say that she was not in the office and to contact Silvio. I emailed Silvio and his email initially bounced, but he eventually got back to me and scheduled airport transfer. Family Concierge (our person was Elizabeth) is supposed to do fun things in the room daily for your child, and we only had one thing done, a bubble bath with balloons. The bubble bath was drawn at 12 noon, which isn't really a time for a bath anyway. That is the only special thing done for our daughter. As for the restaurants, I was disappointed that nothing was opened for sit down at 11 AM, with the exception of the hydro grill (which isn't really enough for lunch for a toddler). Estheffani said that Naos was opened at 11, but it didn't open until 12. Eating here was a nightmare with a two year old. The Kids Zone was ok, but really isn't enough for 8 days family vacation. If you are traveling with young children, choose another more family friendly resort, or AirBNB. We are only going to use rental homes from now on as it is much easier with young children to be able to eat when you want to and not have your mealtimes dictated. I am so sad to write this review, but I felt it was necessary so other families don't have to go through what we did. We were so frustrated, we left a day early to come home to rainy New Jersey. No one in Family Concierge asked us where we were going with our suitcases so early. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Jenna L
reviews.title: Nice Scenery, Average Stay.
reviews.text:
I am not one to write bad reviews, as I am usually positive and understanding. However, I guess I went into this excepting more then what I got - 

This resort looks brand new and has a picture perfect scenery. 
The staff is funny and the buffet food is amazing, however, the Mexican restaurant and Hibachi restaurant really aren't good. 

I am giving it 2 Stars because the scenery was amazing. Other then that this place gets real boring after a couple of days.

I wish the staff provided the guests with a daily list of activities, otherwise you will be out of the loop and just spend your days wandering around. 
Also, I was placed in a room that I did not book, I had to tell the front desk that I was put in the wrong room (one without a balcony) and the receptionist rolled his eyes when I asked to be put in the correct room (one with a balcony & Jacuzzi). When I was put into the correct room the light next to the bed randomly dropped from the ceiling one night and the electricians had to come hang it back up to the ceiling. 

Lastly, and most frustratingly, the front desk gave my boyfriend a booklet of "Resort Credits" consisting of free credits that can be used in the Casino , Restaurant and Spa on our LAST DAY. 

He said he "forgot" to give them to us when we checked in. He explained you get resort credits if you are booked for a certain amount of nights. 

However, we were never able to use these credits because they were given to us a few hours before we had to leave. If I received these Resort Credits on the first day I would have without a doubt used them during my stay and had more fun. So if you are staying at this resort for a while I recommend you ask about the credits booklet because this is the thing that really angered me the most.

reviews.author: misty a
reviews.title: 4 days in punta cana
reviews.text:
My review of this property: it seems tired....this was a shorter 4 day Vacation and I have wanted to go home after day 1.

#1. We had a oversized 2 room suite, good in size, but lacked much. The shower didnt work right, minimal warm or hot water, no water pressure. Only day 1 were we provided wash clothes and Diet Coke in the minibar. There was only 1 small beer in the fridge each day. After that it was always a call and a long delay to get them to the room. There was a large empty kitchen, must have been a time share or villa at some point with space for even a washer and dryer. Very dated decor. The television had terrible picture and service. No movie channels. Minimal English. Only 1 working phone. Terrible wifi. And the safe was a disaster! Was hard to get to work and a stress on us to prepare to leave the room every time we had to deal with the safe!

#2 food was a let down overall. Breakfast was the best meal. Lunch offered few restaurants but numerous buffet option. However we prefer to eat al la carte. Alcohol was plentiful, but rarely offered pool side or beach service meaning you had to go to the bar. No food was allowed pool side. Drinks were served in paper cups that crumbled after the first few minute. 
Dinner lacked pizazz even though multiple restaurants. House wines included were terrible. 

#3 there were no hot tubs unless you paid to use the spa. Only 1 large pool for non-reserve guests...made us fee less important.

#4 the beach was pretty, numerous chairs and cabanas at our leisure but were always hassled by locals wanting to sell souvenirs.

#5 the team of 4 that staffed the towel cabana were down right rude and made us feel like we were asking for the moon when we asked for a towel. Every day!!

#6 the hotel ran out of napkins for breakfast and towels for pool during the daytime hours.

we do travel often and have become accustomed to great treatment but I would not return to this property unless it was free and I would want to upgrade to the reserve so I don't feel like I am a bother to the staff. 
I am not excited about punta Cana for sure and would not recommend it!!
Oh by the way, it rained 3 days! No suntan for us and there wasn't much to do with your time when it rained. I am so glad to be going home today!!

reviews.author: Ana Paula P
reviews.title: Impressões de viagem a Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Boas instalações, comida razoável mas os empregados pouco educados, sem qualquer noção sobre como se deve tratar os clientes.
As cadeiras da praia , às 9 horas estão quase todas reservadas, sem ninguém a usá-las e são distribuídas, ao belo prazer de uns empregados sem educação e sempre à espera de gratificação .
Questionei este facto na recepção e a resposta foi q era o serviço famíily concierg e q só as famílias com crianças podiam fazer reserva de cadeiras. 
Não faz qualquer sentido esta explicação pq quando comprei a viagem não me referiram q ia para uma praia  com estes condicionalismos.
Falaram-me então no Royal Service, uns quartos perto da praia,  só para adultos e com serviços especiais.
" SÓ " teria q pagar mais 85 dólares por pessoa/dia ( 170 o casal).
Para isto poderia usar uns créditos promocionais, q vêm mencionados no voucher da viagem mas q só servem para gastar mais dinheiro.
Resumindo, uma aldrabice pegada !
Só num país subdesenvolvido isto é viável.
Fiquei vacinada contra a república dominicana. 
Esperava muito melhor pelo preço que paguei.

reviews.author: bdznyc
reviews.title: Beautiful facility, but be warned... they told us they didn't have a room
reviews.text:
Arrived to the the hotel only to be told they didn't have a room for us (not meaning just for the next few hours, but for the entire trip).  After much back and forth, and wasted time and aggravation, we ultimately were provided a room -- but we watched other guests agree to move to another property so this wasn't an issue limited to just our party.

Otherwise, the remainder of the trip was enjoyable.  The room was excellent.  Food was better than expected.  Drinks were good (although the tequila could use some upgrading  -- $6 additional for Patron).  Pool was fantastic with many chairs and never crowded (even when sold out).  Events at night were a real plus.  

The idea of overselling rooms at an international destination, and not having the courtesy of contacting the guest in advance of their departure is inexcusable.

reviews.author: Beluga1968
reviews.title: Oh la la loin du Paradis!!!
reviews.text:
Arrivé dimanche de Pâques Check in, hors contrôle. mis dans un coin pendant une heure reçois notre chambre au 1 er étage avec vue sur la machine à crème glacée. La place est bondée des très jeunes enfants partout ça cri et ça pleure je suis à THe RESERVE  pour la tranquillité je suis déjà allé à the reserve palm real à 10 minute de la et j avais fait un voyage de rêve. Nous avons voulu Le reproduire avec mon ado de 17 ans.Mais c est pas ca qui s est  passé, On a vécu l équivalent d' une semaine au centre d achat la semaine de Noël pas moyen de se cacher dans un coin tranquille c est trop loader pour l espace disponible. PAS DE PLACE DANS LES SECTIONS POURTANT SUPPOSÉES RÉSERVÉ NI À LA PISCINE, ni à la Plage. ( quand on est obligé de se coucher dans le sable ou sur les abords de la piscine, incapable d avoir des chaises, il y a un mega  problème de gestion !!!!!! J ai essayer de changer de chambre pour un coin moins actif style côté jardin impossible on me propose de Downgrader côté paradisus régulier sans compensation dans une chambre plus que la moitié moins 
Grande et on me fait comprendre que puisque j ai booké  avec un agence ils ne peuvent pas  faire grand chose il me recommande fortement de passer directement par eux la prochaine fois.Donc je vais voir mon représentants sun wing Dans ce  cas ci lui aussi n a pas de solutions, on demande de changer d hôtel il me réfère à une autre personne au-dessus de lui elle nous appelle et elle a l 'air de comprendre la situation nous propose  de choisir 3 hôtels vendus par Sunwing aux  alentours et qu elle va nous rappeler le lendemain entre 11et 14 hrs.PAS DE SON PAS D IMAGE Elle ne NOUS A JAMAIS  RAPPELER et NOUS N AVONS jamais retrouvé le représentant sun wing non plus sur le site.
Alors on S EST  résigné à vivre avec,  Mais ça avait l 'air d un mauvais Cuba !!!!! à un certain moment plus d œufs  au buffet  au déjeuner plus de sprite pendant une demi journée pas de vin rouge à la Réserve pendant souper à la carte ce n est  pas rien !!!! on est au paradisus 5 étoiles étoiles Conseil amenez  vous yde l argent US Le taux de change de l hôtel 55us pour 100 canadiens.Nouveau à punta cana taxe 10.00us à l entrée et 20.00 us à la sortie ou 35.00 canadiens.Prix du vin a la carte exorbitant et 27% de taxe par dessus nous avons fait le Resto payant Passion 7 étoile Michelin 95.00 us chaque avec accord mets vin 55.00 us souper seulement très bon Mais dispendieux pour la qualité du vin servis.Le reste des Resto à la carte évitez  le Grill service pourri et bouffe ordinaire Fuego très bien et une belle gagne de serveurs  attentionnés Aqua ordinaire.  mexicain bon le midi Le buffet du reserve bon Le midi tard et Le soir Le reste du temps c est la jungle les enfant se baigne dans les fontaine aucun contrôle dans la place et le buffet très petit avec les carrosse en plus pas évident.Gros effort des serveurs en général ils ont vécus vraiment l enfer cette dernière semaine et ce n est pas fini ça entrait encore ce matin je me croyais à l entrée d une grosse garderie.Donc très déçu de ma semaine et surtout de Melia et sun wing je voyage depuis 30 ans Mais c est terminé République dominicaine vous m avez écœuré solide et Melia j ai toujours  cru en vous dans plusieurs pays Mais la vous m avez vraiment déçu.

reviews.author: Roberto79
reviews.title: Nice hotel but very loud in Family Concierge Suites
reviews.text:
We liked the experience overall as our kids really enjoyed the holiday but the noise at night was terrible. We arrived on a Saturday night after a long haul flight to be greeted  by music until 4am. My wife and I essentially did not sleep that night at all. Second night being Sunday was better but then Monday onwards we got 2 / 3 nights of more music until 3 or 4 am each night. We stayed at the hotel for second weekend and again Friday and Saturday night we enjoyed the delights of dance music until 4am. Thankfully our 2 children were in an connecting room that was more protected by the noise so they rarely heard anything even though my son on a couple of occasions did mention in the morning that he had heard music overnight but had fallen back to sleep. We mentioned the music to the customer service manager of the hotel on various occasions and yet nothing was done about it. They had a wedding on over first weekend and a beer conference over the following week and hence many events on and the main concern of the hotel must have been the welfare of the big groups as opposed to a families concerns over sleep deprivation.  The management of the hotel are terrible... do not care about the clients concerns as all the customer manager did was apologise (thanks for the apology but what about paying a large sum of money to stay at your hotel and not being able to sleep!!!). Out of 12 nights we stayed at the hotel, we had 5 terrible nights and another 2 with music until about 1am. The other nights we did have decent sleeps. As I said to our family concierge, we don't travel to the Caribbean for a holiday and book what is supposedly a 5* in order to listen to music until the early hours of morning especially when we had booked the Family Concierge section of hotel which one would assume has Families in mind?! I got no adequate apology from the hotel and quite frankly that is not acceptable for the quality of hotel they claim to be.
I will not stay at a Paradisus again (I have stayed previously at the one at playa del carmen and have stayed on business at a few melia hotels) as I would not want to encounter the unprofessional management in any other of their hotels! 
Apart from the complaints, the food was decent (tepanyaki and Francisco the chef was a highlight).. the buffets in general are good. 
The staff apart from managers were friendly and efficient. 
Accommodation in family suites are large but definitely not 5*. I would say this hotel is a 4* superior but don't expect a 5* hotel with all the luxury extras.
Kids club was decent but not exceptional for a resort focused on families. 
My review would be much better if the hotel had done something about the noise and offered to change our room to another location the first couple of nights of our stay.
Our family concierge offered us to look into a change of room 3 days before leaving (i.e. We had been there for 9 nights already!!) of which I declined the offer as we were nearing the end of our holiday. 
Just another thing to add, the hotel are trying to sell their new 'circle' product and it is quite annoying having sales people pestering you on holiday. Going to beach restaurants was like walking the guantlet of sales people!! It was room 3415. I would request a room overlooking the pool for people staying in the family concierge then hopefully you won't get the noise.

reviews.author: SCC112
reviews.title: *Ignore the negative reviews at your own risk*
reviews.text:
I am on the flight home from our stay at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. I read the good and the negative reviews on TripAdvisor before I booked this property. I wish I'd paid more attention to those negative reviews before going. I was swayed by how beautiful the place looked online. And it truly is gorgeous.

I brought my teenage daughter and her friend. I travel regularly, but not super frequently. I stay at varying levels of hotels, (usually nicer) to include a few 5-star ones. This is no 5-star experience. At least ours wasn't.

I'll start with the PROS:
- [ ] The grounds are truly spectacular and lavish. Beautifully maintained and one of the highlights of our stay. 
- [ ] The design of the common areas (pools, lounge, restaurants, bars, sitting areas, etc) is gorgeous! Cannot overstate. The aesthetic is sleek and relaxing at the same time.
- [ ] The trolleys (golf carts) that transport you to the different properties (the Reserve & the original Paradisus property) plus the beach, etc. were plentiful and fun to catch.
- [ ] The numerous workers are so sweet and smiling and always trying to be helpful.
- [ ]  The various classes (I took 2 pool fitness classes) were a blast and the instructors at the Reserve pool were awesome! Just the right amount of fun and challenging for me. I took Paddle Fitness & the pool spinning class. Would love to ditch my gym and just do that all the time, ha.
- [ ] The various cabanas around the pool are just the best. What a nice touch!

The CONS: (not a full list)
- [ ] When we arrived, we were given a 2 bed room despite reserving a K bed. 
- [ ] When I'd previously gotten the email asking if I had any special requests for when we arrived, I'd asked if they could have a Welcome note of some sort mentioning my 2 Spring Breakers by name (thought they'd enjoy). There wasn't one. 
- [ ] If you speak Spanish, your experience is going to be much better than mine and easier for sure. So many things I let go by the wayside b/c to try and explain what I wanted would've taken so long. I'm not one of those who think everyone should speak English. But if I'd known how difficult it was going to be to communicate and understand, I *never* would've booked here. And after 5 days, it was draining.
- [ ] The ongoing self- promotion for the Melia brand and time-share properties was so cheesy and unavoidable. You're offered a 'free' catamaran ride, but it only goes to another Melia property (Palma Real) and you get a tour, a talk about the 'opportunities', from what the concierge said. I chose not to take it. 
- [ ] The second sort of self promotion came from some of the workers. My daughter and her friend had a worker chat with them a couple nights ago for a while and then asked for their phones so he could download the TripAdvisor app--and then proceeded to take one of their phones and type in a favorable review!! Beyond inappropriate.
- [ ] I was required to meet with my concierge, and then we met with a person who explained some of the benefits of having a Melia rewards membership, especially the Coupons you could spend on your stay. Again, more time away from anything relaxing. And when I think of '5-star hotel' a book of coupons does not come to mind.
- [ ] My concierge was sweet and helpful at times, and other times just took up more of my vacation time than I would've liked. Personal preference. 
- [ ] The restaurant reservation process was awful. Again, back & forth with concierge. I believe we had choice of 10 restaurants, a few are buffets, no reservation necessary. For the others, you fill out a Wish List with 4 options. We got 2 (out of 7) of the ones we wanted! Does that sound like being relaxed/pampered(?) because it wasn't to me. I texted the concierge and told her we wanted to at least try the highly-touted Passion during our stay, and if we couldn't,  we would just eat off property that night (not a threat, it was just sounding pretty good right about then). We got to eat there (which is not included) and it was nearly empty. The restaurant was beautiful, and the food was gorgeous. It did nothing for me, and my teenagers said they were going to need to go get something to eat when we finished. (I have no problem with small portions of beautiful food as long as it is delicious. It was not.) 
Room service was ridiculously slow. One night after waiting a full hour, I called them back to see what was taking so long and the (polite) man said that they had ONE delivery person for BOTH the Reserve and the Paradisus. 
- [ ] I inadvertently bumped into a manager on a trolley and we got talking about my concierge experience (coupons, catamaran, taking up more time than I liked, etc) and not liking the restaurant experience. He listened(?) & said that's not the experience he wants guests to have. He asked me more specific questions, then (wait for it) said that if I could give him 30 min's of my time, he could tell me about getting in on the Melia Circle experience for a great price. When I declined, he appeared offended. 
- [ ] The last night, we went to the Grille and ordered steak of corse. My daughter ordered a skirt steak M/M rare. It arrived cooked completely through. They gave it another try and this time the inside was raw. Not rare; raw. Inedible. She'd tasted my Ribeye and liked it, so on her 3rd try she ordered a Ribeye. She got another skirt steak. When we left, the server cheerfully asked So did you enjoy your dinner? (What are you supposed to say to that(?) 

I could go on, but will just say it is unfortunate that such a gorgeous place falls short on so many levels. I actually thought it was a red flag to have those 'pop-ups' floating around on a supposedly 5-star hotel website. In my opinion, Trip Advisor should reconsider listing it in this category.

reviews.author: catlady501
reviews.title: Disappointed- OVERBOOKED ROOMS- not our dream vacation- will not be returning
reviews.text:
This was our second time to this property and we were very disappointed right from our arrival. We arrived to find that we had to spend the next two nights at the sister property Paradisus Punta Cana, as the room we had booked (in DECEMBER!) was not available and the property was overbooked. Really? Welcome back.
We spent our first night being transferred over to Paradisus Punta Cana as there really wasn't anything we could say to get our booked room at Palma Real. No amount of " Royal Service" ( which really was lacking) could compensate for our time lost on our vacation. We bumped into quite a number of people who had the very same thing happen to them; they had arrived on the same day we did. 
We lost one day to transferring over, no apology, no room upgrade. Just a safe and keys that didn't work. also waiting for a long time for luggage.
We also stopped having maid service as the cleaning staff left our balcony windows OPEN all day - two days in a row. 
This experience left us with a bad taste for this hotel chain and we will not be returning to what would otherwise be a lovely resort, However, looks can be very deceiving.

reviews.author: Marc J
reviews.title: Overbooked rooms - sent us to another resort without adequate compensation!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort last year and thought it was nice enough to visit again. We booked our trip in December of 2016, which was over 3 months ago. After a long day of travel we finally arrived at the resort and were looking forward to checking in and starting our week long vacation. Things went downhill from there. The front desk said that unfortunately they overbooked the rooms and had nothing available. They would have to send us to the Paradisus Punta Cana resort for a couple of days and then transfer us back to the Paradisus Palma Real on Sunday. We argued with them for 20 minutes, but to no avail. It's that or nothing. They promised to give us Royal Service when we came back. More on that later. 

We went to the Paradisus Punta Cana and spent another hour doing paper work before we finally got to our room. On Sunday we had to check out at noon and wait until 2 pm to catch the ride back to the Paradisus Palma Real. When we arrived at the hotel we thought everything would go smoothly. We went to the front desk and where they told us there was a separate line by the bar for the overbooked people (there were a lot). We went to that lineup and where they told us to come back at 3 pm to get the room key. Why make us line up again! We came back at 3 pm and they gave us the room card keys. When we got to the room the card keys didn't work. The bell boy opened our door and I called the front desk and asked them to send new card keys, but they wouldn't. You have to go to the front desk in person to get them. So I went back to the main lobby again and got new card keys and they worked in the door, but they didn't work in the safe. So I called the front desk again and they sent out someone to help with the safe. By this time, all of Sunday is a write off. We lost a full day of our vacation. But we got "Royal Service", which is supposed to compensate us for a lost day and all the hassles. 

Royal Service is supposed to come with a concierge. We didn't get one. Some other overbooked people got the concierge and some didn't. We went to the Royal Service beach and there were only a couple of chairs available at the very back near the bar. Lots of chairs had towels on them but were empty all day long. I later found out that the beach staff put towels and old books on many of the chairs and you have to tip them for the chair. A couple we met started to give the beach staff money, but we felt that Royal Service should include the beach chairs without having to pay the staff.

The Royal Service didn't get us anything special nor did it compensate us for lost time and stress. The resort grounds are very beautiful and the Naos buffet is pretty good. We weren't that impressed with the a la carte restaurants and ate at the Naos buffet most of the time.  

A lot of the service staff work hard especially the servers, maids, maintenance crew and bell hops. However, the staff at the front desk have a difficult time explaining and resolving issues. 

Some other overbooked couples told us that cruise ships are much better. We have never taken a cruise, but that's what we will do next time we go on a sunny vacation to the Caribbean.

reviews.author: KlaraNJ
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with terrible service
reviews.text:
Don't even know where to start, but here goes:
1. When we arrived, no one gave us any sort of orientation to this resort...go fend and figure out for yourself!  Even as far as go figure out how to get to your room by yourself!
2. Terrible restaurant reservations system.  Have to argue with them and waste precious vacation time every step of the way.  We even showed up to a restaurant one evening without a reservation and they didn't want to seat us despite the fact that the restaurant was more than half empty. After not backing down they sat us and of course the restaurant slowly emptied (did not fill up further as she initially said it would).  This particular hostess (Kenia Martinez) had a  attitude on her as well...I say this not because she refused to sit us at first but because of the tone in her voice and the smirk on her face.  We got the overall sense that they simply didn't want to work.
3. I asked for the phones in our unit to be fixed several times.  We needed to be able to get in touch with friends in other units.  We asked for several days in a row.....they did not get fixed!
4. It appears that when it was initially built, it was a very cool resort, but they have slowly let it go. An example is the the picture below showing a cracked glass table on our balcony. Another example is the ugly black electrical tape that is placed on the pool railing in lieu of the end cap replaced.
5. The drinks are not good, unless you like the artificially-flavored and extremely high in sugar ones.
6. Restaurants with very good food: Aqua
Good food: Rare
Mediocre food: Vento
Worst resort food we've ever had: Olio. One friend in our group says it tasted liked canned, overcooked food.
7. Overall the property is too dimly lit at night. Some of the guys are driving way too fast at night in the golf carts. We screamed at them one night for it because it's scary when you are walking with little kids in the simply lit walkways.  On the several days that it rained the gf carts passed right by us as we were walking with our children without offering us a ride.
8. Our balcony light was out....we decided to fix ourselves since that was easier than bothering to ask for any service.
9. The bathrooms by the pool are in terrible shape.   The ones located outside between the Naos buffet and the pool are not maintained well throughout the day. There were several occasions where they were not flushing well and it was dirty.
10. Some staff doesn't speak English sufficiently. There were several occasions where they nodded their head and never completed the request...it became evident that they just didn't understand.
11.  Not much night-life. We were here with kids and it seemed to us like we were out later than most.  We could not find any fun past 11pm....had to make our own!  The bar by the beach closed at 11pm...they turned off the lights on us bother days we were there!

reviews.author: Anita L
reviews.title: 13 cucarachas en mi habitación
reviews.text:
La primera impresión cuando llegue al hotel fue muy buena... preciosos jardines, imponente piscina, la habitación muy bonita y cómoda con una vista al mar espectacular.
Me alojé en la habitación 2110, la noche que llegue encontré 8 cucarachas pequeñas (si 8...) llame a recepción para avisar del episodio y me enviaron un joven muy amable con un repelente para insectos para solucionar el problema, me explicaron que no podían cambiarme de habitación "porque el hotel estaba al 110% de capacidad".
A la mañana siguiente encontré otras 3 cucarachas, volví a presentar la queja y me
Dijeron que "iban a realizar una fumigación y limpieza profunda del cuarto"... esa misma noche encontré otra cucaracha saliendo de la nevera... pedí que por favor me cambiaran de cuarto ya que no podía pasar una noche más "en compañía de cucarachas".
Para cambiarme de habitación me sacaron de una cena en la que me encontraba a las 9:30 pm (no pude terminar de cenar acompañada) porque dijeron que "me cambiaba a esa hora o no lo podrían hacer más tarde"... Me dieron la habitación 2032... limpia, pero mucho menos elegante y cómoda que la anterior. Me dejaron sin cenar así que me "invitaron" a pedir comida a la habitación porque ya eran las 11 pm y los restaurantes estaban cerrados. 
Hoy en la mañana pedí el libro de quejas para contar mi experiencia y pudieran mejorar para el futuro pero me lo negaron...
Lo mejor del hotel fue la amabilidad de los meseros del room service. Mi experiencia personal en el hotel Nefasta... solo quería volver a mi casa... si regreso a Punta Cana seguro no será a este hotel 😰

reviews.author: Angelica
reviews.title: A complete disaster of a trip in a gorgeous resort with amazing grounds
reviews.text:
Where do I start.... my family and I (3 kids) visited this resort in November 2016. It was my 16 year old son's "Make A Wish" trip -- he has been battling cancer for almost 2 years but is doing well, thank God, and thanks to immunotherapy -- he does not look like he's battling cancer anymore because of immunotherapy.

This was my 2nd time visiting Punta Cana -- the first time, was an amazing experience (at the Riu), therefore, my son picked this for his wish.

First of all, the 2-bedroom suite that we stayed in was gorgeous the grounds are amazing. However, we were disappointed to find out that this resort "The Reserve" was not beach front.  You must walk quite a way to get to the beach, or take the trolly which bites into your vacation time.

While there, it rained the entire time that we were there without a break -- this had not been seen for over 10 years. The grounds had completely flooded, you could not go to the beach, the pool was closed for a couple days. The food was low quality, they ran out of just about everything (including eggs, ketchup, etc) and the service was that of a 2star hotel.

One morning, since it was raining, my son and I went to the gym to workout. We walked through pouring rain with umbrellas and all. When we walked in, one of the gym workers (the darker thinner guy) stood at the doorway while we switched our shoes from flip flops to sock and gym shoes.  He didn't even greet us and didn't even smile.  He allowed us to spend time changing our shoes only to ask how old my son was. I told him that he was 16 and he then indicated that he could not workout with me because he had to be 18.  I then told him, why didn't you ask that question as soon as we walked in?!  I was so mad... we headed back to our suite and the concierge asked "you came back so quick." and I explained what had happened.  Well... she informed me that my son COULD workout so long as I signed a waiver.  She completed a waiver for me, I signed it and headed back to the gym.

When we entered the gym, that same guy said, I told you that your son cannot workout. I said, "Yes, he can. Here is the waiver and why didn't you tell me that this is all I needed!"... shame on him and shame on the resort for allowing THAT kind of person to run that gym. I would like to see him get fired.

There are so many things I have to say about this resort and our bad experience. It's too much to write... to boot, we all got bit by bed bugs. I got the worse of it -- it took me 3 weeks after the vacation to get rid of the bite marks.  Needless to say, I would not recommend this resort nor will I ever go back -- not even sure I'll go back to DR at this point.

After what my son has been through battling cancer and what we all have been through, this trip was supposed to be a memorable and fun family vacation and it was one of the worst trips we have ever taken.

reviews.author: pamelamaryh28
reviews.title: Property is typical of an all-inclusive but royal service is a royal waste of money!
reviews.text:
Bottom line, don't waste your money on the royal service. For the first 2 days we were put in a non-royal service room right across from the night club. We were moved on day 3 but that was already 1/2 way into the vacation and who wants to pack and unpack more than once?! When we booked we were told that if we were going for our anniversary we definitely needed to spend the extra for royal service. Our anniversary was day one of our trip but our "butler" didn't decide to do acknowledge it until day 3 when he knew that we were not pleased with our experience up until then. We were given the highly advertised butler cell phone on day one which didn't ring. We mentioned this to our butler who said the ringer doesn't work, but he didn't take it to replace it. On day 3 the phone died so he took it  to replace the batteries which took several hours. On the last night the phone died again at 4:00 a.m. and it made a winding down chiming sound which means that we we were up at 4:00 a.m. on our last day of vacation. On day 1 our safe didn't work, our butler said "no worries, it's just the batteries" call maintenance when you get to your room before dinner (keep in mind we had to take all of our valuables with us to the pool) and it will only take 10 minutes. It wasn't the batteries and took over an hour for maintenance to fix so we missed our anniversary drink before dinner. We were told by 2 other guests that their safes were not working as well, shouldn't everything be looked at and fixed before guests arrive? All of this just put a real sour twist on the vacation from the get go and we have now learned that we are much happier when we go on vacation and don't get fooled by all of the advertising hype for upgraded vacations.

The grounds were typical of an all-inclusive resort, but Francisco down on the beach is amazing!

Since returning from our trip I have spoken to the manager who asked me not to put a review on Trip Advisor but to email him all of this and he would get back to me. I emailed him on March 6 and have yet to hear back which is not surprising to us.

reviews.author: TLC B
reviews.title: Needs Work!
reviews.text: This is our first time to the DR. We were so excited. We spent almost 4G on this trip. It is a beautiful resort when you walk in and the staff work extreamly hard. Some of them we have seen the whole 7 days we have been here working day and night. The language barrier is a huge problem. If you don't speak Spanish it is very difficult to get items and needs that you want or need. At least half if not more staff do not speak English. If they do it is just like us speaking Spanish, it is just enough for them to get by. The rooms are nice but old, they need work and updated decore. We had a 1 bedroom master suite and it had a full sized fridge with cabinets although I really am not sure why. There is no silverware, no dishes, no stove. It is weird. However the room was very spacious. The food is all the same and where you eat it is not always very sanitary, especially at the buffet. I know, I know, its a buffet....The food there was very good most days and huge variety. the problem is there was always difficulty finding a place to sit that was clean. They are alwasys short staffed but the staff work so hard. Its crazy. The tables are wiped off but not the placemats and they place your utencils directly on the placemats that 100 other people have used. Also the web sites speaks about this resturaunt and that resturaunt, it is all the same and by day 4 I was so sick of the same stuff no matter where we ate it all tasted the same and service was always slow. Also the lauguage barrier makes it almost impossible to find out what is going on at the resort on a scheduled time. All in all it was nice to be with my family and that is the main reason to go on vaca but next time I will just save the 4G and lock us all in the house without consistent T.V and internet connection and when they do it is in another language that will force us to speak to one another and then feed them the same food eveyday.

reviews.author: Sara1972_12
reviews.title: The Truth About Royal Service
reviews.text:
I looked in several places for detailed information on what the Paradisus Royal Service is, and I could not found anywhere. As a family vacation, I ended up reserving the Royal Service, expectating that we would have a prime treatment and everything else would be easier and better as they describe on the hotel website. Well then, I will demystify the Royal Service, hoping that you will be able to conclude if this illusion really Worth it.
Regarding the rooms, the only advantage in Royal Service is the proximity to the beach, as it is located on the first two block oh apartments. But the advantage ends there!
In relation to the “exclusive” Palazzo restaurant, which offers differentiated items in the hotel description compared to the restaurants in common use (Naos), I state with all lucidity that this does not exist. Quite the contrary, the options are limited compared to the Naos Restaurant, the General Buffet. We had just the first breakfast in this "upscale" restaurant, then everyone else at Naos, wich is better and is available to all guests. So, the exclusivity you paid goes drain away.
Regarding the butler, it's an illusion, because they only talk to you few times a day, making themselves available for anything, because they know that you will hardly ask for anything beyond what the all inclusive offers. In fact, you have no reazons to call your Butler. The only thing the butlers do is to prepare your bathtub once during your stay – and you can do it whenever you want by yourself.
The exclusive pool is a joke! There are no chairs available, hotel staff reserves all of them using books, and then they give the chairs for people who pay them for this. The same goes for the exclusive Royal Service beach - if you do not give a good tip to the staff, there are no chairs available. They even leave quiet seats with old books all day, unoccupied, but they deny you the space if you do not offer money.
So, in my oppinion, it’s a tremendous waste of time and money to book at the Royal Service. Prefer the cheapest room, because you will have to pay a lot of extra money to hotel employees in order to have pool chairs, beach chairs, etc. And the most important detail - the chairs are not occupied by guests earlier in the day. All are reserved by the employees, who then release them by receiving a tip.
I could see a Canadian couple who had been out of beach chairs every day, although many chairs were reserved all day with employee-owned items. 
Concerning to the beach, although beautiful, it is full of drug dealers and prostitutes – no, I am not kidding - It is impossible to walk 100 meters without being approached by them at least 2 times, just to offer their products (drugs) and services. I can not recommend the place for families or people who want to rest, because all this problems with chairs stress anyone.

reviews.author: jeffreyn364
reviews.title: Disastrous stay
reviews.text: 7 maintenance calls in 5 days there.  No hot water in room 1.  Leak in ceiling of room 2.  Floors were flooded all day.  3 different workers said they'd fixed it and it wouldn't leak anymore.  They were all wrong. Finally on our last night I'm there with my girlfriend at 1 am with a guy mopping our floors and trying to make the leak quieter so we could sleep.  Also - several reservation mixups - even with no language issues as my girlfriend is Dominican. Disastrous stay.  Hotel knew of everything, but offered no compensation for our troubles - not even a coupon for a subsequent stay - nothing. Will NEVER go back

reviews.author: Sandro P
reviews.title: Royal Service beach/ pool chairs available only by paying
reviews.text:
I booked the Royal Service suite and although check-in time is at 3p.m., my room was not available when I arrived at 3:30pm. Went to Pallazzo restaurant, exclusive to Royal Service guests, and could realize they have few food options, and I could not realize the better quality they use to say this restaurant has, comparing to others hotel restaurants to all guest. Breakfast there is simply a waste of time - no options and the same itens offered to all guests on the long buffet at Maos restaurant. But the bigger problem is the beach and pool chair. 
As soon as I got to the beach at 7:30 am, all beach chairs had been already reserved with towels, books and magazines, althouth few of them with people. 
I spoke with an employee named Pedro Cedales who said that people wakes up very early to put stuff in there. I spent some time there observing that as people arrived, Pedro leaded them to a reserved chairs and he himself removed the books and etc on it...
I talked to a guest who explained me that the day before he had paid a fee to Pedro to have the chairs reserved, and that is the way things works there.
I got mad and decided to take one chair of the reserved chairs with a book and Pedro immediately told me to leave it. When I said I would not leave, and I asked him to call the management, he took the book, threw it in the sand and shouted that I was going to regret that behavior.
 I spoke to the Manager on duty, Miss Gabriella Giacomini, who said the hotel agreed with that beach chairs reservations by the employees, in order to guarantee that elder people or disability person could have a chair available when they got to the beach.
However, the employees use this hotel directive to earn some money - I could see a wheelchair person who had to leave the beach as there was no chairs "available", while a couple minutes after a young couple arrived at the beach and as they were leaded to a reserved chair by Mr. Pedro Cedales,I could see them giving him some money for the reservation service. So, although the hotel intention was good - guarantee beach chairs for everyone, the employees found a way to make some extra money with the distortion of this police.

reviews.author: DaveThornbury
reviews.title: A nightmare
reviews.text:
A service nightmare in the Caribbean
 
My wife and I along with two other couples decided to spend a week at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Our stay was from February 14-21, rooms 2421, 2422 and 2423.
 
The nightmare begins upon check in which took almost two hours. Our friends ended up getting our suite (which got corrected the following day). We weren’t given any orientation of the property just a lousy map and told our concierge could book our dinner reservations, reserve cabanas for us and so on.
 
We go to our room and then immediately head to our concierge to have her book dinner reservations for us since it’s Valentines Day. She tells us our concierge is not here and she handles the other half of our building. It’s now 5:30 and she finally says it really doesn’t matter because dinner reservations needed to be made by 5 and our only choice now is the buffet. Not a happy camper so we head to the bar.
 
The following morning our wives go to make dinner reservations for the week. They are first told you have to make them day-by-day and had to give a time range. They requested between 7 and 8:30 but were told they had to make the range to 9. They explain 9 is too late for the 6 of us. They check back at 5 p.m. and nothing had been booked at that point and was told to check back in an hour or so. Finally get all our reservations and everyone was at 9 p.m. This took several days to correct and yet we still had a few at 9 and couldn’t get into some.
 
Our concierge was rarely there and when she was she wasn’t helpful at all. We tried to reserve a cabana at the pool or the beach and were told only families could reserve them. When we explained that upon check in we were told that she could reserve them for us she stated that wrong. We are now all a little frosted in the 80-degree weather.
 
Now understand the Reserve is the most expensive part of the resort so we expected superior service. One of the couples with us switched from Paradisus luxury junior suite with Royal Service to the Reserve to be near us at an increase of three thousand dollars. Where they originally had booked they would have been able to reserve cabanas and so much more.
 
Over the next several days we had nightmare after nightmare with service at the various restaurants. They would forget our drinks orders, forget the wine we ordered, forget wine glasses, forget to open the wine, and this includes one of the restaurants that has an upcharge to eat at. It gets worse, we showed up for a 7 p.m. dinner reservation with the reservation card in hand. Remember it took us days to correct all the 9 p.m. seating’s we were booked. The receptionist said they didn’t have us at 7 but at 9 and come back then. We again showed her the reservation card and she really didn’t care. We asked for a manager whom came and started with the same crap and then finally sat us. We asked to speak with the general manager of the resort (which we had asked on several occasion to no avail). The night manager of the resort did come and visit, we explain all our problems and she stated she’d get them all correct (never happened).
 
The next evening we had reservations at the Grill at 8:30 not where we had wanted to go but they could not move up our 9 p.m. reservation at our first choice (booked 5 days earlier). The Grill is a crossed between a restaurant and a buffet. After waiting for over a half hour and still not seated (and they couldn’t tell us when we would be seated) one of the guys in our party gave the hostess $20 to get us seated, final around 8:45 we got seated. Bare in mind our first choice our reservations were originally at 9.
 
Not all experiences were bad, some good restaurants in the mix but it was clear service overall was lacking, no one could ever give us a straight answer or the same answer through the resort.
 
Our last day there we discover there was many water activities included- sure would have been nice to know about them early on so we had a chance to used them.
 
Now for the good, the rooms are very nice and the resort property is amazing. If they can ever get service issues corrected we would consider returning but not now.

reviews.author: sidesx4
reviews.title: Lobby tan
reviews.text:
Not sure if the issue was with Sunquest or the hotel but when we arrived on February 23 2017 the front desk personnel advised me that Sunquest had not booked our stay with the hotel.
In our group consisted of myself, wife and 87 year old mother in law.

Incredibly disappointed after travelling from Toronto and spending a substantial amount of money to obtain non existing lodging.

The hotel staff made some phone calls and eventually but us up on the third floor of the Reserve ( no elevator ) which proved to be very difficult for the 87 year old travelling with us.

We were told that accommodation would be made available for us the following day at the main hotel early the next morning, well that stretched out to be 5:00 pm on February 24.
So in effect Sunquest/Paradisus Palma Real chewed up 1/5 of our vacation and I want compensation.
The facility is really showing its age and during our stay the front lobby area was being repainted. Thier showcase lower main area was under construction with hammering and grinding destroying the serenity of the water falls.

On a positive note the food and wait staff were second to none ( Edwin and Jose )

reviews.author: mhwea
reviews.title: Too many people
