reviews.text: If you want to go to a zoo and eat sub par food this is the place for you.  It starts at the overcrowded airport and finished off when the room is not ready when you wait on line for 45 minutes to check in. I think I've said enough. You get the picture.

reviews.author: CanuckRestaurantMan
reviews.title: PARADISUS PALMA REAL ... NEEDS WORK!!!
reviews.text:
Restaurants/Kids Club/Entertainment/Pros and Cons;

RESTAURANTS REVIEW

Rare Steakhouse 
- good service 
- Starter soup....very small amount, poorly executed, quality and type of bread in soup was not good
- Steak was ok, did not rest, blood all over plate, baked potato poorly executed 
- My son enjoyed his chicken fingers 

Bana Tepanyaki
- the Tepanyaki show at the table was horrible, no show whatsoever except for a bunch of yelling (yelling the same thing too .... every 2 minutes). It even was frustrating my 4 year old
- Service was adequate 
- Food was decent overall

Vento Mediterranean 
- service was adequate 
- Soup starter, weak execution 
- Bread was previously frozen and tasted like it. Butter was rock hard and you could not butter it onto the bread
- Main dish, Shrimp Ravioli was ok, swimming in too much sauce
- We didn't stay for dessert as it was so hot and dark in that room

Olio Italian
- good service, very nice gent named Fernando
- Had the pleasure of meeting with Linny, a F&B manager who came over to chat with us about some of the challenges we had experienced. She was very receptive to our comments 
- Nice appetizer/salad bar buffet to start
- Our son ordered a pizza and was taken up to the pizza bar to tell the Pizzaiolo what he wanted on his pizza and got to watch it being made....he loved this, nice touch!
- I had Pappardelle noodles with a Bolognese sauce and it was good
- My wife ordered the Lobster tail. A touch over cooked however overall she really enjoyed it and the presentation was quite impressive as was the size 
- I would go back here again

KIDS ZONE/CLUB
- overall, nice staff members
- Great spot for age of our son....good food, games, rooms, pool etc
- A few very serious and concerning glitches however; on our first day of taking our boy to this kids club, he was quite shy which is very unusual for him so my wife and I decided to stay for a little while. They were outside on the grounds playing a pirate game when after about 15 minutes into the game my son followed a little girl and they wandered off from the group. There were about 16 kids and two instructors at the time. No one noticed that these two had wandered away and my wife was extremely concerned and immediately went after them. They were both playing near one of the grounds ponds (our son cannot swim on his own and must wear a flotation device when in a pool) which scared us to death as they could each have potentially gone in this pond and run the risk of drowning. My wife brought them back to the group playing and told one of the instructors what had just transpired. She was quite oblivious to it all. I stayed with the group and my wife went into the main kids club building to voice her concerns. A few minutes later they all walked in to the kids club and then this instructor completely denied what had happened and then suggested that my wife was lying and this instructor then stormed away. The lead instructor apologized profusely for what had just occurred. We understand that kids can wander very quickly however problems can arise just as quick but moreover our biggest concern was the fact that this girl didn't take ownership of what had happened. On another odd note, when the kids club walks the kids around, they walk in front and no one is walking from behind the group of kids when they are doing something. This becomes a particularly concerning problem when a group of 15 kids walk 15 inches from a pool with no instructor trailing behind in case one of these kids (a few of whom can't swim on their own) fell into the pool

Nighttime Entertainment 
- Queen cover band was good
- The 'circus'/acrobatic performance was excellent
- Bounce group very good

PROS
- big suite
- Nice big bathtub, our 4 year old loved it
- Beautiful beach and sand 
- Ocean water was amazing and warm
- Pool bar staff very nice and attentive 
- Antonio in the Lobby Bar is a star and I hoped he is recognized for his efforts 
- Mieke {sp} in the kids zone was fantastic and definitely runs a pretty tight ship
- Wily M...server in NAOS buffet very attentive and polite
- Impeccably well manicured and well groomed grounds however the many different shallow ponds throughout the area are not very attractive to look at as there is no movement in room he water and we believe this could be causing some of the musty smell 
- Beautiful lobby
- Buffet, amazing selection, food quality was average
- Very clean resort. Washrooms and all public spaces clean however housekeeper services in bedroom were not good 
- Front desk employees very nice
- Overall the staff were very friendly with our son 

CONS
- both phones not working properly in room
- Both TV's lose signal periodically 
- 1 TV remote broken
- Cassette deck in stereo...really?
- Musty smelling room
- Sliding patio door lock broken
- 2 drawers with no handles
- One drawer falling off
- Dining room chair broken
- No hot water, lukewarm at best
- Shower water pressure was weak
- Hand towels were all old bath mats....kind of gross when you think about it
- Towels were all in old shape in room
- Bedding torn and old, in fact the comforter had a hole the size of a softball with the stuffing coming out of it
- Sofa bed in horrible condition, had to order a cot for our 4 year old
- Railings on third level outdoor deck were in terrible condition and very cheap. We couldn't let our son out there at all
- In room beverages not stocked regularly 
- Very noisy next door resort - loud all night until 3AM every night .... nothing you can do about that but just an observation for anyone in Villa 38
- Power was in and out all day one day
- Water was not running for a couple of hours
- Lack of music at times throughout the restaurants 
- The gents in white T-Shirts by the beach were annoying everyday trying to get us to take an excursion or go shopping etc.
- The market vendors at the hotel (they are there every few nights at the resort) are extremely pushy and would go so far to put jewelry on our son and shove things in his face. He's 4 years old .... have some respect and oh by the way, don't touch my son either as a few of them did! 
- When you order room service, every order has been messed up in one way or another. They never leave a tray for you and therefore you were forced to bring each individual dish out into the hallway which is a little ridiculous. Inconsistenty with items arriving or not as per the order and menu .... one day we would receive two potato cakes, th next day perhaps only one and on one occasion on the same dish ordered previously we received baked potato wedges. Getting Jam proved to be an issue all the time 
- Water faucets in the bathroom sinks pretty much spewed water everywhere but in the sink itself 
- Ceiling fan in bedroom stopped working halfway through our trip
- Never, ever were there beach towels available...they always said in 10 minutes, they were always wrong. After day 5 we complained in a big way to some managers and they brought us 9 beach towels to our room however this doesn't really solve the ultimate issue. We watched some guests grab used towels in the towel bins just so they could dry themselves and their kids off. Shameful not to have these available 
- Terrible WiFi connection 
- Language barrier huge, often used as an excuse
- Massive resort, had to take a golf cart everywhere. My wife has an injury to her foot and while the cart drivers were all nice with the exception of one smug driver it was a pain to call and try to get one to get our villa. We would call the extension for the gold carts and on a couple of occasions they would say ' no English ' and then hang up
- Service was not great in all outlets, in fact I think the worst we have ever come across. Frustrating actually!!!
- The tables and place mats in the restaurants were never wiped with a detergent or even water during service or when tables flipped. It was absolutely gross and quite a deterrent. The tables were perpetually filthy.
- Getting tables re-set properly was a ridiculous challenge. We were always fighting to get napkins or cutlery. There is zero guidance or evidence of onsite management in the restaurants of any kind of leadership
- There is no sense of urgency on serving the guests
- There are way too many different uniforms in the same area confusing the guests. There could be people working in the main buffet with 5 different uniforms 
- All outdoor outlets served drinks on one style of cup which was quite tacky and flimsy to use
- Lighting in restaurants was very dark 
- Some service staff and cart drivers were very Standoffish 
- The housekeeper scolded me because the 'do not disturb' sign was not on my door due to the fact that I was waiting for room service breakfast. I was not amused with her giving me a lesson about that as she came to take care of our room and I asked her to come back in an hour once we finished our breakfast. She continued to argue her point to me and scold me about the sign so I had to slam the door in her face as I care not to be treated like a toddler 
- Often times, we were rushed at each food outlet....it was hard to relax during our dinner excursions. There truly is no thought whatsoever about the guests dining experience 

I in fact met with the hotel F & B Manager and expressed our concerns with him. He seemed like a very genuine, bright and competent person and really seemed to  care about what I was saying but I couldn't imagine his challenges everyday with a workforce like this. I myself operate 5 restaurants and can appreciate the challenges of managing over 400 employees but I think they need to invest more in this department to train, develop, coach and lead these employees. 

For all of these reasons we just don't think we would ever return to this hotel. There was a very smug attitude from a lot of employees on this resort and I don't know if it is a company culture issue or something greater but I am also not sure if we would return to the D.R. again to vacation because of the constant daily issues. Our vacation was significantly affected by this and we cringed every morning when we woke up to start our day. We were anxious to leave this resort and head home. Normally you never want to leave your vacation but we couldn't wait to leave as we just felt our trip ended up being a bust. We spent over $8500 for a 10 day trip and we question about ever going back to a Melia hotel again!

reviews.author: Isabela M
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
O serviço não é coerente com a diária paga. Contratamos um upgrade no check in onde previa um "mayordomo" que nos auxiliaria em todas as reservas e serviços dentro do complexo além de dar acesso a restaurantes restritos. Uma grande decepção! Ficamos sem reserva em pleno reveillon (31/12) por descaso/ incompetência do nosso "cuidador". E não conseguimos ir a todos os restaurantes restritos porque ele não reservou.
Os drinks ruins servidos em copos de papelão no bar da piscina. Você nunca consegue usufruir das espreguiçadeiras porque sempre estão reservadas e passa o dia vazia. Esse seria um os serviços que nosso "cuidador" deveria fazer pois pagamos caríssimo por esse upgrade e ele nunca fazia corretamente.
Outro ponto é que na internet consta que a Praia de Bávaro é a melhor de Punta Cana porém não lembra nem de longe o mar do Caribe. É escuro e cheio de algas.
Ah, o wifi é muito ruim.

reviews.author: AlmaJeppson
reviews.title: Family of 7 (5 kids), not very impressed
reviews.text:
My wife, 5 kids (from 13 down to 3) are here for about 5 days.  We travel as a family a few times per year around the world.  Here's the positives and negatives from our point of view:
Positives:
-Pool is large so no worries about crowding
-kids love the all-inclusive concept on land (similar to cruising), but it is also a negative (see below). 
-room replenished daily with water and simple snacks
-reservation restaurants have been pretty good. 
-staff is attentive and most of them friendly.  When you have sat down to eat you have someone filling your drink quickly.  

Negatives:
-2 items that have been stolen.  My Maui Jim sunglasses (out of my luggage) and my son's shark tooth necklace he got in Maui (a very nice one).  We spoke of a couple that had their entire room raided and many items stolen.  
-towels.  Hmmm...I am baffled here.  We have tried to get towels on 7 different occasions and they are out every time.  Seriously???  I get told, 20 more minutes.  But I learned quickly that they tell everyone 20 minutes, and keep saying that all day long. 
-size of resort:  it is too big for us.  It takes our family 7-10 minutes walking to get to then buffet.  You are required to take a shuttle to get to the kids area.  I prefer a resort that isn't spread out so far, especially with younger kids. 
-off limit areas:  there are numerous areas that are off limit unless you paid to be in a different class of room.  This includes areas of the beach.  Pretty lame.
-finding a table to eat at the buffet is near impossible.  Almost every time I got food it took me so long to find a seat that my food was cold by the time I sat down. 

I would NOT stay here again with my wife and I nor with our entire family.  While it may appeal to some, it didn't work for us.

reviews.author: DJCKH
reviews.title: Feb. 2017
reviews.text:
The Good:
There were definitely very helpful employees: the Hydro Grill chef, Yeysi German, Cleybi Rosario, Cheila Rochiguez, Yatol, Rijo, Oscar Santana, and Raynol Tamayo.
Raynol and Cheila were the best.
Cheila was the one who finally helped me book another night and spent a great deal of time getting an extra restaurant reservation, checking us out, etc.
The food at the restaurants was very good.
We especially liked the steakhouse and the Italian restaurants
The beach was fabulous.
Getting reservations was very simple at The Reserve.
It seemed worth the extra money to stay at the Reserve.
The room was very spacious.
The cleaning staff left us nice presents, like champagne and Towel Swans.
The flamingos were nice to see.
Every day there was a craft/activity table by the reserve pool. We made 2 fun crafts and got a massage.  All Included.  No extra charges. 

The Bad:
There is definitely a language barrier if you do not speak Spanish
Some employees do not speak English. 
If you ask for something, be prepared to ask again, and again.
They say yes to everything, but they don't do it.
For example, there were 2 TVs in my room.  
I asked for a second remote.
They said yes.
I asked again.
They said yes.
Never did get a second remote.

The resort is big and in my opinion, not well organized.
And to find things out, you need to ask rather than someone just providing all of the information to you up front.
It is about a 5 minute walk to the beach and certain restaurants.
There's just a lot of walking if you don't want to wait for a golf cart which are not on any kind of schedule.
The staff is very inconsistent on the resort.
We wanted to go to a show that in the lobby said started at 21:30.
When we got to the show it was over because the sign at the show said 20:30.
I must have been asked by 5 different employees to write a Trip Advisor review.
Not all of the employees are on the same page.
My sons wanted to play basketball.
We were sent to 4 different locations before we finally found someone to help us get a basketball to play.  We finally found Raynol who played with the kids multiple times.  The boys enjoyed hanging out with him.

Our flight was cancelled and it cost over $700 to book one extra night.
When I asked an employee, they told me to go online and book another night.
Why they could not give me the same rate was beyond me.
Eventually, we found someone to help.
Like I said, you need to keep asking before you get to a helpful person,

My teenage boys had a hard time finding activities.
When we went to Mexico and Jamaica, the Activity Guys would walk around and gather kids to play soccer, football, volleyball, basketball, dance, etc.
That was not the case here.

The airport is an unorganized challenge as well.  Be prepared.  When we arrived, we stood in line and paid the $10 per person traveler’s card.  Then we stood in another line to hand it to someone else.  Then we stood in line for customs.  Finally, we were in another line to put our bags in another screening machine.  On the way out, we stood in three separate lines which were not marked.  One was for the machines to print a boarding pass and/or print out a bag tag.  The second was if you had your boarding pass but wanted to check in your luggage.  The third was if you used the machine to print your bag tag and you had a boarding pass.  That third line moved the fastest.  

The Ugly:
The guys on the beach who handle the beach activities like banana boats, kayaking, etc. ruined my trip.
I went kayaking with my boys and the gentleman pushed me into a wave which immediately knocked me off the kayak and knocking my $500 prescription sunglasses off my face.
I asked them if one of the divers could look.  Even said I would pay them.
They said no, it was too rough.
It wasn’t too rough to send us out kayaking.
I went to the desk and they told me to come back to speak with the manager.
I went back and spoke with Adrianna, the manager.
She said she would get security to investigate and she would let me know after a day.
Never heard back from her.
Despite going to the office every day (4 more times) after and asking for her.
She was never to be seen or heard from again.
4 days of going back to the front desk and asking for the manager and if anyone could call the beach guys (No Manager and no one ever answered the phone) and going to the beach guys and asking the divers to go look.
Finally, someone went out and by that point, they were long gone.
It was not right for me to have to keep going back and asking every day (sometimes twice a day). 

I have been to Beaches in Bahamas, Sandals and Hilton Rose in Jamaica, Iberostar and Moon Palace in Mexico, and I have to say, this was my worst experience with an All-Inclusive resort.
Would I use Melia again? Absolutely not.
Would I go to Punta Cana again? Doubtful.

reviews.author: Hernan A
reviews.title: No fue lo que debía ser
reviews.text:
No fue lo que pagamos. Pagamos un costo alto por un servicio bajo. Mucha diferencia en los servicio, desde personas muy atentas hasta otras extremadamente mal educadas. Pedimos hablar con el manager ni nos recibió. La concierge Sofía EXCELENTE. Lo mejor del hotel. El servicio de transporte interno fue un desastre . Es todo lejos y no pasan los carritos a buscarte y cuando pasan no paran, es mas estando con una nena de 2 años no hicieron bajar de un carrito en el medio del hotel sin llevarnos hasta la habitación! Fue un señor llamado Julio Lopez, maleducado , y soberbio, nos bajo literalmente del carrito, nunca vivimos algo igual. Los mozos de los restaurante algunos respetuosos y atentos y otros no te traían ni la bebida, teniendo que salir a buscar a un bar! En la playa gracias si te daban las toallas a pesar de estar en the reserve ni te acomodaban en las reposeras ! Muchos empleados pero relajados como que no les importaba mucho lo que pasaba! 
La comida nivel medio. Buffet malos, restaurantes medio.

reviews.author: Deborah H
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Dinner at the Palazzo was amazing and our waiter Miguel Jimenez was excellent. Our best meal in the entire resort. Also liked the Hibachi Grill with the friendly staff and amazing magician located at the bar between the Hibachi and Rare. The Blue Agave wasn't so good for lunch or dinner and the service was slow. The only food available during the day was the buffet. 
Our Butler Jeuri was excellent. 
For the extra cost, I would pass on this service. 
The rooms were okay. I didn't like the opening to the bathroom, it didn't allow for privacy and they were in need of repair and maintenance. The lighting in the main hallways, stairways and pathways were too dark and almost dangerous. 
It was confusing to find your way around the villa's!
The beverage service at the beach wasn't so good, pretty much self service. Also no snacks or food service available in the beach or pool area. They really need a pool grill area with a nacho bar or something. 
Live entertainment, some evenings with very nice talent. 
Departing from the resort was very quick and efficient and the taxi was very reasonable.

reviews.author: GagaWorldTraveler
reviews.title: Costco Travel Resort Credits
reviews.text:
Not sure if this is a review of the resort, or rather a review of how Costco Travel misled us into believing that 1500 Resort Credits was an added value to this vacation package.  We have purchased trips from Costco Travel before and were offered excursions, golf, and spa services at no extra charge.   Because of this past experience, I assumed that the resort credits were of this same bonus structure.  No where did Costco Travel make us aware of the details, which we learned upon check in at the resort.  Each coupon was merely a discount to an already overpriced service or item.  Example, 20 resort credits ($20) off the purchase of $100 worth of premium wine.  Or 150 resort credits ($150) off the cost of a romantic dinner which would still cost us $140.  A disappointing 300 resort credits toward room upgrade, for which we were told none were available and to check back later in the week.  Also daily free golf was offered, which did not include a mandatory cart rental charge. 

We used none of these resort credits during the entire week.  

Costco Travel remedied the situation by saying they were sorry and would look into the wording of this promotion, if allowed in the contract with Paradisus Palma Real.  

Buyer beware. Never put any stock into the "freebies".

reviews.author: Anshelly C
reviews.title: Lived up to the Negative Reviews!
reviews.text: Overall service is very poor at this hotel. Rude, confrontational, full of "Misunderstandings" (making you at fault) and very lacking basic customer service. Usually you find the more you tip the better the experience at resorts, but this place is too big to tip everyone just to have a pleasant experience after all the money already spent. Front desk staff is friendly, but have a way of getting you in a room you did not choose with no way out. Good restaurant staff is spotty at most. The only way to have a good time is to stick to the beach and the pool all day until you have to go to one of the restaurants to eat. Riu Palace is way better, will not return here.

reviews.author: colin c
reviews.title: OK if you like cigarette and cigar smoking resorts and lots of children and can speak Spanish
reviews.text:
Weather was great as you would expect - people staff friendly and welcoming but english language level was poor. Learn spanish for an easier visit as ECL is low

If you do not care for resorts where every table has an ashtray in every hotel room every restaraunt and every table at the pool and beach this is not for you...yes I am an anti smoker when I book a smoke free vacation on Expedia.

Food was bland and average for the most part with as much as you want to eat all day - service in booked restaraunts was awful with very pleasant staff.

reviews.author: Cesar C
reviews.title: Jamas Palma Real es un 5 estrellas
reviews.text:
No volvería
Todo mal. Restaurantes de regular calidad a excepcion de Bufett
No hay tumbonas ,siempre reservadas ,de mala calidad ,sin colchonetas
Robo de efectos personales en la playa y nadie te advierte de esa problemática. Nunca tus problemas son resueltos.
me costó 8 dias que me cambiaran de almohada y me trajeron otras igual de malas,etc,etc

reviews.author: yenisbelh2017
reviews.title: not very happy
reviews.text:
no early check in provided food very bad
the room was very far off the installation
we paid 1400 USD for 1 night and received services which where very poor
it was not even offered to compensation  that we didi not get the early cake in which we paid

reviews.author: jevin e
reviews.title: Some good things but overall terrible
reviews.text: Some good things but overall, we had a terrible experience and I would not go back there.  First the good: Great weather, long and smooth pretty beach, very nice pools, easy to get chairs on the beach, very friendly service, very large suite.  Sounds great, right?  However, the food was beyond terrible.  We all barely ate and lost weight.  Three of the five of us got sick at night after eating.  The food quality was the lowest I've seen in a hotel.  The tennis courts and golf course were disgraceful--I would say at the level of an "inner" city public court or golf course in the United States--shockingly bad.  Our "upgraded" suite was dark and damp. When we got to the room, the TV didn't work, a light didn't work, a faucet didn't work. Our children's room never had hot water and the safe kept breaking.  The customer service manager could not have been nicer to try and help fix the problems.  He arranged a private dinner by the pool, which was good and also treated us to dinner at the one restaurant, Passion, which costs extra. That meal was good too.  He also gave my father, who treated me and my kids, a certificate for a free stay to try it again.  I suspect my father will try it again.  I will not.

reviews.author: Dumbledore555
reviews.title: Not worth the time or money
reviews.text:
Do not spend any time or money on a vacation at the Reserve at paradises punta Cana.

We are still on the property for our 5 night stay.  We arrived yesterday at 1 PM and had to wait a couple hours before our roos were ready.

There are a number of things wrong with the room that we have reported it multiple times to the management and have still not been addressed. 

The concierge service is a joke so do not waste your time on paying extra for it.  The concierge could  not get us dinner reservations
And had to be reminded multiple times of our requests.

The food across the complex is disappointing -- stay away from the buffets. 

Be aware that the property is quite a distance from the beach.

reviews.author: Vrp18
reviews.title: 5 star resort with 0.5 star Management
reviews.text:
A diamond with a huge flaw. Resort is perfect, if you eliminate Front Desk / Housekeeping management. All the staff is very hospitable, albeit the people who are the "face" of hotel care less about guest issues.
Never heard front desk staff asking you to take an appointment to meet the Supervisor, at a minimum notice of 3 hours...that's a first!!

Room had several issues - water leaking from bathroom ceiling, broken shower door, broken drawers, broken sofa bed, dusty closet space, etc.
Sofa bed was fixed with some new springs, but none other issues were addressed throughout the stay. It was agonizing to see no follow-up done by HK or FD, and FD staff promising everyday for looking to change the room, once available.

A blanket takes 1 & 1/2 hour to be supplied.

Resort is top notch in terms of formal restaurants, decor, lobby, pool, beach, activities, etc.

But...never seen management staff in a hotel that doesn't care to even communicate with guests who have problems.

Deserves a 5 star, if front desk staff is not considered.

reviews.author: Tom_Adopye
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, Soviet Style
reviews.text:
I travel a lot for business and pleasure. I come back from almost every vacation in love with the destination, whether exotic or mundane. This trip was no disaster, but my wife and I agreed, "never again."

First, the positives. We visited in December, and we had lovely beach weather, if a bit windy. It rained briefly each day, did not interfere with outdoor activities. The beach is smooth, the surf is gentle, the water is warm, and there are almost no stones or shells. There is a lot of seaweed and the water seemed a bit murky for the Caribbean, but still a nice beach. Plenty of chaise lounges under shaded grass tents. If you like to read, bring your kindle, because you have to fight the wind with a conventional book.

The pools are large, clean, and beautiful.  There is only one swim-up bar, and it seems to be reserved for special people who aren't me. Will talk more about that in the negatives.

If you are on the all-inclusive plan, you will eat most of your meals at the buffet, which is not bad by buffet standards. A huge selection and decent quality, although I'd expect fresher fish, fruits, and vegetables on an island nation. Yes, free drinks but only "Presidente" beer and low-end Carlo Rossi wines. Waiters get few tips and still are reasonably attentive.

Bana - the Japanese restaurant, is OK. You never get great food when the whole schtick is the cooking show, but this was as good as Benihana. I was surprised. The Latin fusion place Fuego was truly an excellent meal with superb service - our best overall experience.

The property itself is a grand design, but not kept up like an American hotel would be. Lots of "piso mojado" signs to warn guest of wet floors from leaky roofs.  Our hotel room was big and comfortable, although the fridge was stuck on "luke warm."

Negatives? 

1) The power was out from 9am-6pm one day, the wifi was out even longer, and no accomodation was made.   There is no phone signal and the wifi is slower than dialup.

2) Making a dinner reservation is absurd. You can do so only from 9am-4pm the day you want to eat. Fail to comply and you default to the buffet. We attempted to reserve a spot at the Japanese steakhouse but were told we didn't need one.  We showed up and then were turned away. The hostess chased us down, offered a reservation for the next night, which we accepted. We show up the next night, discovered she had put us into the regular steak house which is adjacent to the Japanese place. We complained, she said what we ended up hearing too often "nothing I can do."  When I complained to a manager, we finally got to eat the Japanese food.

The buffet restuarant keeps odd hours. Doesn't open for lunch until 12:30.

No coffeemaker in the room (there is an espresso maker). Had to tramp down to the buffet for lidless paper cups of bland coffee.

When the buffet is closed, the only place open is Blue Agave, for snacks. And it is awful. Stale oily corn chips, cold cheese sauce, and french fries that would be bad even at a turnpike rest stop.  

There is a cool little coffee and gelato shop - I saw it open only once in our 4 day stay.

We booked with Costco, and got lots of coupons to save on excursions and things like the spa. We soon discovered that the events are overpriced, and these coupons are simply a way to squeeze more money from you. My wife signed up for a $180 massage and applied a $50 coupon. The desk clerk tried to charge us $260 for this. When I complained, he brought it down to $162. Still a ripoff.

On your first morning, you have a mandatory meeting with "Angel" which is supposed to be about your departure time back to the airport.  He covers that in 3 minutes, then spends the rest of the time pitching excursions to you. "All-inclusive" must mean that they intend to include all of your money in their cash register.

All the restaurants are included except "Passion" which is $70 per person. Costco provides a $50 coupon, so you can eat at this place for $90 more per couple than the other places.  Why would you do that unless you got conned into thinking you're saving $50 instead of wasting $90?

We both got Montezuma's revenge. What is the point of a "Five Star" resort that cannot assure clean water?  We lost a full day to throwing up and diahrrea.

We were at the "black bracelet" level which gave us access to a few more restaurants - which we never tried due to our illness and the byzantine process of making reservations.  But ourt bracelets never earned us any service at the beach, and we got tossed out of one section reserved for folks with better bracelets.  No signs, no indication of who carries which set of privileges. 
Giant pools and a huge beach and hundreds of guests - but I never saw one lifeguard.

I came away feeling that - for the most part - neither management nor the employees have an understanding of customer service.  I felt hustled, I felt that someone was always trying to extort an extra dollar from me, and I felt confused about what my black bracelet entitled me to have.  I paid for all-inclusive to have minimal worries and decisions, but found myself on the defensive here.

Not going back.

reviews.author: LaurLaur29
reviews.title: Unsatisfied traveler
reviews.text:
Let start by saying I was there for a wedding and it was absolutely perfect. The Bridal Attendant (Raquel?) and her team were on point and helped in making my best friend's wedding an unforgettable day!
The resort itself is beautiful but it is very big. Easy to get lost and pack your walking shoes... There are golf carts to bring to you the main part of the hotel but it isn't always easy to find one. So don't worry about the all you can eat & drink because unless you will get your steps in if you are on staying close to the main pool. 

The main reason I am giving this hotel a poor rating is because I had a terrible experience with the front desk and it is unfortunate because up until this point I was enjoying my vacation. In fact up until this point I would have given it a rating of Very Good. 
I was sharing the room with a friend but she was checking out a day earlier than I was. Upon her checking out, they told her that I needed to leave as well. Luckily I was in my room when they called me. I went to the front desk with all of my paperwork stating that I had the room until the following day. They told me I had to check out of that room & into another room, that was on a different part of the resort. They said it was a separate reservation. I asked if my room was going to another guest checking in that day. They said maybe but they were not sure. I asked if I could just stay in my room for the last night. I was told no.. I asked why I wasn't told when I was checking in that I would have to change rooms. There was no answer or explanation given. Just a shrug of the shoulders. It was now almost 11am and I had until noon to go back to my room, pack everything up, return to the front desk to check out. And then check in for the new rooms wasn't until 3pm. I also had an 11:00 massage appointment that I needed to cancel due to this mess. There was zero help from the front desk and by the time I did everything I had to do, more than half of my last day was wasted. I was so stressed out & full of anxiety that I was actually crying when I finally got to my new room. What started out as an amazing trip ended as a terrible experience and for that reason I don't know if I would return to this resort. Left a very bad taste in my mouth.
Also, just a note - use the in room safe for everything, not just money. A pair of Ray Ban's went walking. My fault because I didn't think I had to lock up my sunglasses, but just a warning to the next traveler. Lesson learned.

reviews.author: marzenapd
reviews.title: Nice beach, nice rooms but the same low qualify food every day and poor service
reviews.text: We were there last week for Thanksgiving Break.  We stayed in Reserve part.  The rooms were nice and clean. There was the same food served in buffet area every day and very small variety.  Cheap food...and to get some fried eggs or fish you needed to wait a long time.  The service is really very low class. These people are not smiling and it takes them sometimes to get 20 minutes to bring you coffee.  During breakfast time, the ladies are so unpleasant that they spill coffee o the plate and all over the table. SHOWS - THE LOWEST QUALITY EVER SEEN- the Dominican Night show - 4 dancers did the entire show. After that show we decided to skip the rest of the shows. We never spent Thanksgiving so poorly and so badly - no Turkey was served in the restaurants, no special celebrations and the local knew it was very important American Holiday.  We spoke to other quests there, on the plane on the way back - NOBODY WOULD RECCOMEND THIS PLACE TO ANYBODY AND I WOULD NOT GET BACK THERE ANYMORE

reviews.author: kristie s
reviews.title: Not five star resort
reviews.text:
This was our first time to Punta Cana and sadly this resort fell very short of all the great tripadvisor reviews. Upon check in we were pressured into upgrading our concierge service and paying $500 extra, after telling the lady three times we were tired and just wanted to check in, she kept trying to sell us the upgrade?

I guess unless you pay for the upgrade you don't get any concierge service, because the ladies at our concierge desk were horrible!!! It was raining outside one evening and we saw a ton of people walking around with umbrella's, but our concierge ladies could not even inform us upon leaving that we had an umbrella in our room????

Then upon checking out, the lobby was closed and the ladies at the concierge desk were watching video's on their phone, when the guy loaded up our luggage(after sitting in plain view of the ladies for 20 minutes)then they decided to tell us that we needed to check out with them???? HORRIBLE, HORRIBLE, HORRIBLE SERVICE!

Only good thing about this resort was Calalino that worked at Mole and La Bana restaurant, only person at the resort that offered any form of customer service.

WE WON"T BE BACK....TWO STAR RESORT

reviews.author: lnapol4303
reviews.title: should have done more research before booking
reviews.text: Arrived at the hotel on Nov. 7 with a migraine headache. Staff insisted that we take a tour of the grounds and make dinner reservations.  When I insisted that I needed to lay down for a few hours they gave us a difficult time and had us taken to our room which was three flights.  We called down to the front desk and asked for the upgrade that was included in our resort credit and was told that there were no upgrades available but they would move us to a lower floor. We were moved to a room where our view was blocked by  palm trees. At the same time, they were also telling us that the excursion we booked for later in the week would have to be on Tuesday..... no reason why, just that it was better to do it on Tuesday instead of the day we booked.   If you want bathroom privacy, this is not the place to stay.  The bathroom is in the room, enclosed in a glass door, where you can hear EVERYTHING your spouse is doing.  Needless to say, my bathroom usage was in the public bathrooms.......  The refrigerator and coffee/creamer are  NOT RESTOCKED everyday.  You need to call room service for them to restock it.  Don't be surprised if what you had in the morning is gone when you come back.  I. don't mind them drinking, the juice, put at least replace it.  maintenance is minimal.  You may want to bring your own towels.  The will remove the towels you use in the morning, but they are not replaced.    We had to call twice for bathroom towels. Thank goodness for Google translation because I've been leaving notes for them to leave clean towels.  Food was a disappointment.  The hot foods were warm at best. Bacon is clumpy and cold; sausage is overcooked and hard.  Food at the steakhouse was well prepared.  Avoid Fuego, unless you don't mind wobbly tables and chair legs.  The food was lukewarm at best.  There is no one on the beach to take drink orders.  You have to get those yourself.  Better yet, buy your own liquor.  The drinks seemed to be watered down.  Granted, the resort is not adults only; and I have no problem with that; I do, however, have a problem with children being left unsupervised and rough housing taking place in the pool.  If your sensitive to smoke from cigarettes and cigars, STAY AWAY!!!!! Smoking is permitted everywhere except in the restaurants, which doesn't really matter, because they stand outside and smoke. We moved several times while trying to relax and could not enjoy the tribute to Queen this evening because the guests are allowed to smoke..The lounge chairs at the pool and the beach are uncomfortable, old and worn.  Some of them sink into the ground or the sand when you lay on them.  I am average height 5'5 and average weight 140 so its not because I was overweight.  They say no smoking in the rooms, but I have to leave the terrace twice because of the smoking being done on the terraces on either side of me.  The grounds are pretty; however, they aren't cleaned frequently.  The public restroom near the pool had debris all over the floor for two days already.  Staff seems pre occupied and I'm  pretty sure they do more than one job.  The resort is NOT quite at night... expect music to be playing someplace... Be careful if it happens to rain. The floors are extremely slippery.  Our room was in the middle of no where and the lighting was so poor, I did slip.  Thank goodness my husband had my hand.... I have to say I was quite disappointed in my birthday vacation.  I'm not quite sure how this was a five star resort.  I have one more day here, my birthday tomorrow, lets see if I need to revise my review.

reviews.author: 706traveler123
reviews.title: Quite disappointing
reviews.text:
I booked my stay at this facility to celebrate my anniversary. I was excited about visiting Punta Cana, enjoying the amenities described during my booking, and having the time of our lives. Check in time went fine, everyone seemed very nice. In fact,that first day, there was a gentleman that introduced himself as our concierge, that he will try to help us book our dinner times and whatever we needed. Sounds like royalty, right? Well I have to be the bubble popper but it was not royalty at all. We were invited to a " complimentary breakfast the next day." My husband and I overslept and did not make that invitation. Ever since that the concierge was completely MIA.
The room was big, similar to the one showed on the pictures. The bellboy even told us that the bar in the room , had some drinks... water, Diet Coke,orange juice and sprite. That "every day the staff will check and make sure that there were refills on whatever drink ..." Did that happen? No. The room, although nice looking and big, needs TLC on the lights, the shower is breaking down, I may go on and on, that it may lead you to boredom.
The food... according to the reviews and even the facility's description, the hotel had several restaurants to choose from. Well, what the add doesn't say is that  3 restaurants you have to pay at least $71 dollars per person, the other places you have to make a reservation or otherwise u have to go to the buffet.
The buffet was not bad, food was tasty, but not every one likes to eat on buffets. But I guess that's the price of the 'All inclusive'. The servers I have to say were very attentive and nice. They even try to make u feel like you are at home. So I guess that was a positive note on all this mess.
 Last but no least, in order to get all the amenities showed on the pictures or have a decent treatment, you have to join their VIP club membership or pay a Royal service with a butler that will cost $1,000.00 dollars more than the fees they charge. I personally felt discriminated, pretty much like my business was not important at all. I would not complain if I was paying the rate of a Days Inn, or a Motel 6. Unfortunately, since I was charged $450.00 a night, I expected a service and treatment worth of that rate.
 My husband and I decided to have a good time regardless, but what a disappointing location to enjoy our honeymoon. God knows how hard I worked to make this trip special. Well, I guess there is a lesson to be learned... Do not trust or book my vacations on Meliá hotels, unless I want to get ripped off.

reviews.author: davike2016
reviews.title: Poor customer service, and greedy
reviews.text:
The check in process was a mess. here's how it went...

First off, the airline canceled my return flight, so we had to fly back a day early. We were informed of this 3 months pror to travel. We asked the hotel if they would be willing to refund us the one day, and they said no. We asked for a credit, or an upgrade, and they said no... I feel the Hotel should have worked with us on this.

2... During check in, we oped to upgrade our services to the Royal club and also upgrade our room to an ocean view. When we got to our room, all we could see was the garden but no ocean. We complained and the hotel person said "if you step onto the balcony and stick your head over the railing and look around the corner, you can see a piece of the ocean" Obviously this wasn't going to work, so we asked for another room. The view still sucked. Since we paid $100 per day for a better room, it didn't seem worth it to me, so i asked for our normal room back...

3... it gets worse... The hotel assistant issued a full refund (not just for the room) but for the royal club upgrade as well. Then he asked for my CC again to "redo" the royal club

4. after all is said and done he asked for the "butler cell phone back" We got this "as explained to us" as part of the royal upgrade. We asked why and they said "you can only have a butler with the room with an "ocean view" ugh... frustration is setting in here... we wanted the butler because he was to coordinate our meal times and reservations for excursions... so we were forced to then upgrade the room AGAIN...

5. The hotel person ran my CC again to correct his mistakes... All of the credit and charges from my bank account. It took me another hour on the phone with CHASE to get the account to be unlocked again.

6. The credits took one full week to get back into my card, so I had double charges for a week...

7. no accommodations for the hotels mix ups were offered...

i would no attend this hotel again... I would not recommend this hotel to anyone...

reviews.author: Pawan G
reviews.title: Big promises but poor quality all the way
reviews.text:
We booked 10 rooms seeing big promises and big rooms fantastic service good overall experience great ratings but when we landed in hotel our experience was horrible. 1 of our room
Was booked by the son and proper authorization paper were there. Still he was not allowed to check in unless he paid full amount again. After that we went for having tea at Mexican restaurant where we left 1 I phone which was vanished in 10 minutes and nobody was even ready to listen. When wanted to give laundry they did not accept unless 
deposit money or block your card again separately. We booked one bed room master suite. Leaving area which is 60% of total room is complete waste. Pantry is not equipped. All the appliances either taken out or not functional. Sofa is soiled, it's not usable. Furniture is too old. All in all very bad impression of the hotel. Service is pathetic be it room service house keeping or calling a cart. Barring few in front desk and guest relation.

reviews.author: ManuelNN
reviews.title: Mejorable
reviews.text:
Llegamos a las 21:30 fueron muy amables en recepción, pero al llegar a la habitación (LUXURY JUNIOR SUITE) nos encontramos con una gotera enorme en medio del salon, nos cambian inmediatamente a la habitación de abajo, en esta habitación la limpieza dejaba mucho que desear, aguas a medio consumir, pelos en el suelo... pero como fue de urgencia y en el ultimo minuto no lo tuvimos muy en cuenta.

Lo que sobre todo pensamos que puede mejorar es el servicio de limpieza de habitaciones, en dos ocasiones tuvimos que llamar a las 15:30 para que hicieran la habitación, aun seguimos esperando unas toallas que pedimos y sin embargo seguramente allí seguirán las fundas de las almohadas sucias que nadie se molesto en llevarse de donde las dejaron, si es cierto que nos dejaron en lugar de toallas jabón, de echo unos 10 botes amontonados en el lavabo, honestamente el servicio deja mucho que desear, así mismo en los restaurantes el personal es muy amable pero conseguir una bebida es a veces una aventura, el servicio no se corresponde ni de lejos con el standard de Melia y menos con la categoría del hotel... No quiero pensar que será en temporada alta y con el hotel lleno

Deberían revisar sus estándares  para que no se convierta en un hotel mas de playa, que desde luego no es lo que íbamos buscando ni por lo que pagamos..

reviews.author: Karolajna B
reviews.title: Mediocre en su categoria premium
reviews.text:
Siendo que es un hotel dentro de la categoría PREMIUM, debo calificarlo como MEDIOCRE. Explico porque:

1. En vez de cerrar el hotel durante el periodo de mantencion en temporada baja (como lo hacen otros resorts), esta haciendo trabajos mientras tienen mucha gente hospedando y la calidad de la estadía sufre muchísimos. Nos ha tocado que cerraron el buffet principal y han adaptado uno de los restaurantes tematicos para que cumpliera esta función. En resultado: no había variedad de comida, no habían mesas para sentar a toda gente, el lugar se ha hecho muy incomodo para toda la gente que pasaba por ahi. 

2. La variedad de comida EN GENERAL bien pobre. Cos escasos mariscos y pescados (no como uno espera de esta categoría de hoteles). Casi todo comida tipo ¨junk food - mucha pizza, mucha pasta y arroces, pero poca comida de calidad. 

3. La atención menos que mediocre. Los camareros de los restaurantes temáticos no saben nada, traen platos sin saber lo que traen y a quien, no saben explicar que es lo que contienen los platos. El tiempo de espera para PEDIR - al menos media hora y luego otra hora para recibir el plato. Les recuerdo que estamos hablando de temporada baja. 

4. En todos los bares el alcohol es muy básico, para no decir que inaceptable en algunos lugares. Ejemplo, uno de los bares de la playa/piscina sirve solo "genérico" - alcohol sin siquiera una etiqueta. Para obtener una copa con alcohol de marca global uno debe indicar específicamente que es lo que quiere, sino recibe el "genérico¨. De nuevo, no es o que uno espera del hotel 5* PREMIUM. Los alcoholes mejores SE PAGA aparte, y no un precio menor. 

5. El servicio concierge... quería dejar sin comentario. Pero que les sirva a todos, lo voy a describir: 

Pedi un dia al concierge el servicio Jaccuzzi - a la hora pedida debe estar preparado un baño en la habitacion, con espuma y pétalos de rosa, debería estar decorada la pieza con los pétalos y también traen una botella de champaña, un poco de fruta fresca y frutillas de chocolate. El costo de este servicio - 55 USD (impensable también en este nivel de hoteles - tengo experiencia). Quería sorprender a mi pareja en el día de nuestro aniversario y acorde los detalles y el mensaje con cual le iban a dar la bienvenida en la pieza. A lo hora que supuestamente todo tenia que estar listo, entramos a la pieza y lo único que he visto era el champan con frutillas y fruta. Ni vi los pétalos, ni el jaccuzzi preparado, ni el mensaje, ni nada. Me he enojado y fui a conversar con el cosierge. Había otro de turno. No tenia ni datos de la reserva del servicio, ni sabia nada. Tenia que comunicarse con otras personas... Al final, el servicio mal realizado y no cobrado (al menos esto). 

6. Los trabajadores del hotel con mala actitud y contestando feo o haciendo comentarios raros. Un trabajador de la piscina se negó ayudarme sacar la bicicleta aquatica porque "no quería mojarse". 

7. Clases de Yoga que no pude tomar - cuando ya llegue al lugar de las clases de yoga (alejado muchisimo de las habitaciones) no había absolutamente nadie. Fui al SPA al lado y pregunte si alguien podría ayudarme y decir si las clases se harán o no. Se contactaron con la recepcion. Después de 10 min llego el instructor, se dio cuenta que estaba sola y me dijo que no va a hacerme clases, porque se requiere de un mínimo de 3 personas. 

8. Un lugar un poco aburrido, sin música en la playa o la piscina. 

9. RECOMIENDO MUCHISIMO MAS EL IBEROSTAR GRAND BAVARO-  dentro de la misma categoría premium. A ese no le falta nada!

reviews.author: AleMoya
reviews.title: Gran desilusión
reviews.text:
No es primera vez que venimos de vacaciones a Punta Cana, por lo que conocemos otros hoteles de la zona. Esta vez era distinto porque viajábamos por primera vez con nuestro hijo de 1 año. Por esta razón elegimos este hotel. Decía ser el mejor para unas vacaciones familiares. Lamentablemente no fue así. Primero comentar que la atención del personal en general es deficiente, no hay interés en ayudar o informar al cliente. Salvo algunas excepciones como Francisco en el desayuno buffet, Jhunior y Felix en la cena del buffet. Nos hicieron nuestra estadía mucho más grata. Nos ayudaron con el lavado de los biberones y calentar la comida de nuestro hijo. Por otra parte, las habitaciones están bastantes deterioradas y mal mantenidas. Encontramos todo tipo de fauna en ella: cucarachas, polillas, arañas y lagartijas!!!!! El televisor estaba dañado en su pantalla. El frigobar muy pobre. Las instalaciones del hotel destacan (área de piscina, bares y restaurantes), se nota que son nuevos. Lo malo es que nadie te explica nada. No pudimos conocer todos los restaurantes de reserva porque la persona de atención al cliente no hizo todas las reservas, incluso nos agendo una noche en un restaurante que no se necesita reserva (Blue Agave). Un chiste! 
Lamentablemente no podría recomendar este hotel ni tampoco volvería a hospedarme aquí.

reviews.author: AQA
reviews.title: Aucune Ambiance
reviews.text:
Amis Francophones, si vous maitrisez mal les langues étrangères, nous ne vous conseillons pas cet Hôtel, personne ne parle Français quasiment ( dur pour les kids du coup )
De plus, aucunes activités n'est prévue pour les enfants ( ou est le mini club de la Documentation ) et il n'y a aucunes ambiance, hormis celle de la clientèle américaine = Tremper à hauteur de torse dans la piscine en fumant cigare/cigarette ( que l'on retrouvera flottant dans l'eau quelques heures après ) et en passant véritablement sa journée à boire, boire et reboire
Je pensais les américains bien plus festif et remuant que cela ( surtout avec la plage à 100m )
Ceci étant dit, nous revenions du Club Med, et du coup l’expérience du Paradisus nous est apparue comme ultra fade
La nourriture est très correcte
Par contre la plage, nous sommes passés de celle du club qui était ( pour de vrai ) paradisiaque à une vulgaire plage de la manche, nous n'en revenons toujours pas avec mon épouse : sale, eau toute noire, quasiment personne dedans, étalée sur des kilomètres avec les vendeurs d'excursion qui ne vous lâche pas, un moment de vacances gâché par rapport à cela clairement
Les Chambres sont très bien, les infrastructures aussi, mais on s'ennuie ferme, nous étions impatients de rentrer en France et surtout tellement déçu derrière le club med ou règne clairement une réelle ambiance, ici c'est encéphalogramme plat et couchage à 21h00 ( à part un spectacle Michael Jackson sympa )

reviews.author: jlpp
reviews.title: Hotel e praia maravilhosos!!! Comida e atendimento horríveis!!!!!
reviews.text:
O check in e check out foram péssimos!! Mal atendimento!!!
A praia talvez seja uma das mais lindas das que já fomos! Visual do hotel incrivel!!! maravilhos à noite!! Mas o atendimento em geral é displicente e indolente!!! Muita gente que  não tem a mínima vontade em atender bem !! Na entrada, nosso quarto estava com cheiro de mofo e com latas de cerveja do cliente anterior!! Péssima limpeza!! A medida que se passaram os dias , fomos dando gorjeta para o pessoal da limpeza e ai tudo ficou ok ! Quarto escuro, lamentável! Travesseiros horriveis! Dormindo sentiamos coceira no corpo! Má higienização!!!  Comida sofrivel! Repetição todo dia igual!!! Muita gordura, pessoal que faz grelhados tem má vontade, fica tudo muito ruim!! 5 estrelas????? Reservar a la carte é um desafio! Nunca tem !! Péssima comida tanto no VENTO como no RARE ( que carne era aquela , o cowboysteak, só gordura e pagamos US$ 82 por essa terrivel carne !!) Café da manhã bom!! Buffet do almoço e jantar sofrivel!! Falta higiene ! Que tal o funcionario pegar com a mão a salcicha do hot dog? ou jogar leite no mexido de ovos, já pronto, não sei para que?? Não tem padrão!!! O café cada dia vem de um jeito, por mais que se peça!!! Realmente a maioria dos funcionários tem má vontade !!! Esse esquema de all inclusive é péssimo mesmo !! No check out o fucionário não me deu a discriminação da conta, só falando o valor ! Lógico que exigi e ai me deu , com extrema má vontade!! Precisamos de comprar um remédio com urgencia e má vontade do pessoal da portaria foi incrivel , até que consegui que nos levassem até à farmacia  !!! VALEU a Praia de Bavaro beach e as instalações do hotel (exceto o quarto !) Teria mais a falar , se alguem da rede Melia quiser entrar em contato!!!

reviews.author: HSTravelGal
reviews.title: Slow service, poor connectivity
reviews.text:
While this resort is certainly beautiful,  my second trip to the Dominican is sure to be my last. 

My husband and I had been to the Dominican before and one of my previous reviews will show you, the trip was less than stellar. When the opportunity presented itself to take a second trip on my company's dime, we figured why not give it a second shot.

Bad idea. 

Upon arrival, we were able to quickly make our way to the front desk for check-in. Given that we arrived earlier than the rest of our group, we were able to upgrade to the preferred Club Suites. They seem to process everything pretty quickly and brought us into the preferred area to wait for our room to be ready. After an hour-and-a-half wait and a staff that was not able to communicate very clearly with us, we finally got into our room. 

The better part of the afternoon had since been wasted as a result of this delay. While we were waiting we were attempting to connect to the Wi-Fi, which was unsuccessful. We were unable to check voicemails, and Access Wi-Fi on a regular basis, which meant that I was unable to tend to business while on a business trip. 

We were provided our own personal concierge while staying in the preferred section of the resort. We were given a cell phone to call our concierge whenever we needed something specific or wanted to book a service. 

Most of the time the phone was just ringing and nobody answered. At one point we scheduled a cabana to be reserved by the private pool so that we could have one day of relaxation. The day we had it reserved we could not locate our nameplate on one of the Cabanas. We were told that our name would be listed and that it would be reserved for us. They ended up reserving it for the next day, which was our last day in the resort. 

We considered partaking in some of the spa services, but the rates are so much higher here than they are in other areas of the Caribbean.

When all was said and done, my husband and I vowed to never again travel to the Dominican Republic. We have had so many great trips to Mexico and have come to the conclusion that if it ain't broke don't fix it.

We will continue to travel to Mexico and possibly other Caribbean island but, if you are considering a trip to the Dominican please do plenty of research and ask around. It's worth the extra effort to get full scoop before you go.

reviews.author: sandrabch
reviews.title: Buenas instalaciones, mal servicio, mala comida
reviews.text: El hotel tiene buenas instalaciones, las habitaciones son comodas, la piscina grande. El mayor problema es el servicio. las personas no son amables. En la playa, el salvavidas separa la primera fila esperando propina, coordina tours y llama al servicio de bar. Hay una zona que es royal service que tiene poltronas mas comodas. si quieres estar ahi, le pagas una propina al que cuida. El personal discute en voz muy alta, haciendo imposible el descanso. La comida es mala. El buffet muy malo. El restaurant que es bueno es Passion pero cuesta US$70 por persona. Lo demas, no es recomendable. El hotel es caro, pero no tienen el cuidado en la comida que deberian.

reviews.author: Jaumes65
reviews.title: No volveremos, una decepcion
reviews.text:
Realmente hacia mucho tiempo que queríamos estar en el Palma Real, y al ser una pareja, con Servicio Real. Somos clientes asiduos de la cadena, pero también nos gusta ver otras opciones para comparar.
La verdad es que nos esperábamos mucho mas, estamos acostumbrados a hoteles de solo adultos donde el servicio suele ser exquisito, no ha sido el caso del Palma Real. 
El Royal Service es una sección independiente del Palma Real, pero como sección no hay una separación física importante, haciendo que constantemente, tanto en la playa como en la piscina, hayan huéspedes del Palma Real (general), y por tanto niños.
El Royal Service (RS) tiene una parte de playa reservada y una piscina privada. En el caso de la playa hay un sistema de reserva con el personal del hotel, que premian al que mas días este en el hotel, ya que las primeras posiciones delante del mar son para quienes mas insisten y mas tiempo llevan, por tanto olvídense si quien estar tres/cuatro días y optar a la primera linea.
La piscina y el servicio de bar Sunset tienen buena calidad, sobretodo la barman Srta Wanda, gran trabajadora y con una muy buena predisposición hacia los huéspedes, un 10. También Francisco y Pedro muy volcados en el buen servicio.
El restaurante Palazzo, solo para RS, es un lugar idóneo para desayunar, comer y cenar si se quiere respirar tranquilidad, el resto de restaurantes temáticos suelen tener un servicio aceptable pero un ambiente poco romántico para una pareja, y definitivamente estresante en algunos casos. El camarero Miguel y sus compañeros en el Palazzo hacen agradable los momentos que pasamos allí. 
La comida suele ser muy repetitiva, sobre todo si decides pasar mas de 10 días. Hay una única opción de vino: blanco, rosado o tinto y cava, todos de la misma marca, a diferencia de otros hoteles de adultos , el Palma Real apuesta por ser muy simple, demasiado.
El circuito de spa no funcionaba al 100%, tenia una cierta dejadez, aunque para hacer un baño de 10 minutos es suficiente, pero no relajante. Los precios del spa son desorbitantes, imagínense un masaje de 50 minutos por 150/200 usd, cuando un salario medio de un trabajador del hotel suele estar en 250 usd mensuales.
La habitación era correcta, aunque la cama era de 2,5 metros de ancho, no entiendo estas medidas cuando no las has pedido, pero la valoración general es buena.
El SR incluye un servicio de mayordomo para facilitar algunas actividades del propio hotel. Esto incluye un telefono mobil para contactar com el mayordomo, en mi caso, lo dejamos en la habitación, ya que estábamos en vacaciones y no queríamos continuar teniendo un telefono 24 horas. Las posibilidades que da este servicio son relativas a la reserva de restaurantes por la noche, contratación de alguna actividad y concretar algún servicio para la pareja. En nuestro caso lo utilizamos escasamente, solo para la reserva de restaurantes. Nuestro mayordomo Luis fue muy correcto durante los doce días que estuvimos. 
Sobre la gestión del RS, contactamos dos meses antes con la responsable de la sección Srta Gabriela. Teníamos un upgrade y así lo notificamos, pedimos una habitación con orientación al mar. Después de varios emails, uno de ellos no pidió que preferencias teníamos (almohadas, comida, bebidas, etc), cosa que después no sirvió para nada ya que ninguna de las preferencias fue aplicada en nuestra estancia, nos emplazamos al dia de llagada. 
El check-in fue correcto pero no funcionaba el tpv, nuestro mayordomo nos enseño las instalaciones y nos preparo la habitación con velas (buena sorpresa), pero una gran decepción ya que la habitación era completamente opuesta a lo que habíamos pedido (opuesta al mar). Dos días después, la Srta Gabriela nos ofreció otra habitación con vistas parciales pero decidimos descartarla, a partir de aquí no la vimos mas, para ser la responsable del RS esta muy, muy alejada de los clientes, simplemente no ejercicio de directora.
Utilizamos las instalaciones del gimnasio, muy completas, limpias y con un personal muy agradable. También jugamos al golf, el campo se encuentra a 5 minutos del hotel, y con SR tienes bonificado el fee del campo. El transporte al campo es cada hora, seguramente hubiera sido mejor un transporte personalizado como tienen otros hoteles y no tener que estar sujeto a un horario estándar. 
El resumen general es que si uno busca un hotel para adultos con un servicio exclusivo, el SR del Palma Real no es nuestro hotel, se encuentra alejado de otras opciones de Punta Cana que cuidan mas al cliente, y donde el ambiente esta mas centrado en las parejas.

reviews.author: dashka
reviews.title: Very poor service
reviews.text:
I want to begin with saying that we stayed at many different resorts. We now try to stay at more upscale resorts because of service. Here is the short for the good and bad of the resort:

Good:
Beautiful grounds. Mostly very maintained.
Beautiful beach. Although some complain of the seaweed, it is not the resort's fault. This is nature. Some days you have clear water, some days not so much. Overall it is a beautiful wide beach.
Rooms are comfortable. We stayed with two children. The sofa bed was comfortable to sleep on. Beds are comfortable.
Children were happy with room service food. I tried desert and was pleased.
Bad:

Service is horrible. At times you will get a waiter that will go out of his/her way to accommodate. Most speak no English. I understand that being in a different country is difficult but basic English in the resort is a must to me. For example, When asking for mineral water, you have to explain that it is water with gas, or medium well steak is steak with no blood. You get either medium or well. Everything outside of that or in between does not exist.

Do not expect the service staff to say 'Hola' when you walk by. You will be lucky if they do not take you down with the cart. You will have to step aside when the service staff walks by you, off duty, they will never yield. I understand this may not be a big deal but it feels different in other resorts.

Coffee shop that serves somewhat decent espresso is open 11-4. I stopped by at 10 before 4 and was cursed at in Spanish because the crew was already cleaning up. It was not a very pleasant experience.

Rooms are comfortable but very poorly cleaned. At times we came home after the beach at 4:30 pm, the room was still not clean and we had no fresh towels. Kids accidentally dropped chocolate cake on the sheets. Two days later it is still there.

Premium alcohol is not as advertised. It does not exist. Many bars will tell you that they are not allowed to serve premium liquor without extra money. That is OK if you do not advertise premium liquor. We have upgraded to Royal service to get better alcohol as two people traveling with us got poisoned by whatever else we were served. With an upgrade we still do not get served premium liquor in all bars. There is only one bar that will serve decent alcohol to you WITH Royal service privilege only.

Food- pretty bad. The people posting they are satisfied with food may not have been in upscale resorts or restaurants. We have stayed at Paradisus in Mexico and were very happy with the food. Here is a different story. I would be happy if they served food that was at least fresh. Many times, I had to throw out spoiled fruit and undercooked eggs at breakfast. Poor choices at the buffet.

Several times saw cockroaches during dinner time next to table, seating and walls. Maybe ok to some. I am not too used to it.

Service at the beach- pretty much non-existent if you are in regular area. Very very poor in royals service and family concierge. 

Tip:
If you choose to stay at the resort, upgrade to family concierge or Royal service. You will at least get an access to an extra restaurant and decent beach lounge chairs that could be reserved for you by your concierge. Otherwise, you are on your own at 7 am reserving uncomfortable beach chairs.

reviews.author: Adriana M
reviews.title: No volveremos
reviews.text:
Paradisus
Hemos venido con mi familia muchas veces a este hotel y año tras año viene en baja sin duda.
La falta de mantenimiento general hace q las habitaciones hayan empeorado en vez de haberse modernizado. Desde toallas viejas, asperas, secador q no funciona, ducha deficiente con conexiones sueltas (sin contar q tuvimos 2 días sin agua caliente) caja de seguridad que tampoco funcionaba, puertas que chillan al abrirse (ni pensar en ir al baño de noche pues uno despertaría a su acompañante claro) hasta faltaban tiradores en los cajones y no podian entonces utilizarse claro.
La comida del bufet repetitiva y poco variada.
Difícil conseguir reserva en algun restaurant y una vez q uno cree la tiene, al llegar a la noche no la encuentran en el sistema. Tampoco la calidad del servicio y comida de los restaurantes es buena.
Escaso personal en general pero peor es la falta de capacitación.
Pedimos vs veces desde la habitación, en un caso shampoo, en otro q nos repongan las bebidas de la heladera y nunca vinieron....
Tienen unas rocas parlantes en los jardines con un volumen muy alto que de noche molestan para dormir.
Sistema q reservan las mejores ubicaciones en la playa para aquel q arreglo previamente con un conserje....
Poca energía puesta en actividades casi inexistentes.
Este fue un hotel muy bueno en una época pero ha retrocedido en gral y lamentablemente para este hotel, actualmente hay muchos nuevos por conocer.

reviews.author: Donnapcdr
reviews.title: Would not return....
reviews.text: Having visited Punta Cana Bavaro beach many times, and having stayed at numerous resorts along the beach I would not recommend this hotel for people looking for a good customer service experience, and a typical welcoming Dominican attitude.  This hotel may appear quite upscale but that is where it ends.  The hotel is extremely expensive compared to most all other Bavaro resorts, and other than the food being somewhat better, that is where it ends.  It is strictly business, as they will tell you, and are not at all concerned with accommodating their guests.  For the very high price point of this resort the poor level of customer service and lack of it is simply unacceptable.  They don't seem to be phased with any problems that you encounter because evidently plenty more people are coming.  Do not expect any emails or cosideration regarding room preferences or special accommodations sent ahead to be read or recorded, expect broken furniture literally falling apart, expect any change of room to be at their convenience in maybe 24 hours wasting plenty of your vacation time, be sure to bring a mosquito canopy for the bed if they stick you with the unwanted first floor, do not expect them to have the extra amenities offered on the card in room because they mostly don't exist or they don't know what you're talking about. But do expect to be hounded to go to the timeshare breakfast daily by your concierge because that is what is most important, and they obviously are under very high pressure to do that.  The spa there is an absolute joke and consists of a front desk , bathroom, and massage huts. No steam or sauna just a very public water pool of which I never saw anyone in probably due to its lack of appeal.  The real spa evidently is at the Reserve down the road which is a family resort at an even higher price point.  This place is so overrated its not even funny. You can expect to spend $5000.00 for a week with air from the east coast and that is ridiculous for all of this nonsense. Spend half of that and spend 2 weeks instead of one at a high volume no frills place like Palladium and get the same low end service, or spend less for a week and get quality service and be treated as a valued guest at Excellence.

reviews.author: Elabelle2
reviews.title: Too many issues
reviews.text:
Bavaro beach is loaded with motorized activities and agents trying to sell you parasailing, banana boat rides, party/ disco boats, tubing and more. We don't like all the noise that comes with that and the gasoline smell with it. There are few very tall palm trees in front of the resort and palapas. The ocean has a constant float of seagrass. Not much but you can't escape it. Personally I can't agree with the statement that this is amongst the beautiful beaches on our planet. There are many nicer ones, cleaner ones and less crowded ones. 
We are a family of 4 and my 10 year old son found plenty of kids to play with in the big pool every day. My teenage son on the other hand was reading one book after another and went to the gym twice. 
We had a one bedroom garden view, first floor with family concierge service and were allowed in the VIP Lounge. Our suite had a bad smell to it and was rather dark. The sofa bed for the boys was broken and I asked for an additional roll away which we got right away. We stayed 8 nights and we only had warm/ hot water on the first three days. After that we showered with cold water. Two of the four jets in the tub were broken and jolted water onto the floor. We only tried it once and left it alone afterwards. The water pressure is very low and one evening the water in the shower stopped flowing all together. Room service and maid service was friendly and happened in a timely fashion. We sometimes did not get towels but a quick phone call solved the problem.
We have never been to the Dominican Republic before and took our kids mostly to the Riviera Maya. We all agreed that Mexicans are much nicer and warmer and always made us feel welcomed. We encountered serious problems with our payment at the Paradisus. They had a credit card on file that I could not present and they made us pay for the entire stay again and did not initiate a refund on our prior payment. I had proof that I made the payment 7 months prior to our arrival. I gave them a print out of my credit card statement which showed the transaction. They did not accept this proof as it did not show the card number they had on file. My bank had probably issued a new credit card during the seven months that had passed but the fact that I was not able to present the card itself was a huge problem for the resort and they now want to investigate my payment before issuing a refund. I got insulted by two of their employees, one lady in the VIP lounge who basically asked me to leave the lounge because I didn't wear the appropriate bracelet (huh?) and another employee in the lounge who accused me of possible criminal activity with the credit card used to pay the first time (???). 
I experienced a few very disrespectful incidents which is sad since it only take few rotten tomatoes to spoil the entire sauce.
Lee and Geridulino (probably spelled wrong, sorry) are very nice bartenders at the pool bar in the main pool. The female bartender at the family concierge pool bar (sorry, I forgot your name) was super nice. All the waiters on room service have been very nice as were the maids. 
The gentlemen at bell service who helped us greatly with taxi service were wonderful. 
We ate mostly at the buffet and at Fuego, Mitsu and Olio. Well, the best meal we received was outside of the resort, my review for this little gem will follow.
We don't like big quantities but value quality, creativity and presentation in the food department. We were vomitting on two occasions after eating at the buffet. But then again, there are too many little kids racing through the buffet without supervision and they are just overwhelmed and have their fingers everywhere. 
We did not get seriously sick. 
Overall this entire vacation was frustrating and depressing on many levels.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: 5* price but 3* quality and service
reviews.text:
This should have been an amazing experience, the beaches are fabulous, the gardens and setting of the hotel are beautiful.  The rooms are large and comfortable.  We had a 2 bedroom master suite which comprised of 2 at least queen sized beds, 2 full bathrooms with a jacuzzi in each, two sink / kitchen spaces, 2 living rooms and one room with a dining table.  perfect for a family of 4 traveling with 2 teens.

The problems though started at check in, which took an inordinate amount of time, but failed to inform us of anything about the hotel or restaurants.  Instead we were told that our concierge would be there to guide us in all the resort's amenities.  How wrong that was!  We went straight to the concierge desk after being shown to our rooms.  Having previously stayed at a luxury all inclusive in Mexico, where we could reserve restaurants online at home, we were nervous to arrive in high season with no restaurant bookings.  Not without cause!  Angie our less than helpful, ( read unfriendly, negative and very unhelpful) concierge told us that we were only guaranteed 4 restaurants other than buffet for our 7 night stay.  Also that we had to request the restaurants and say whether we wanted to eat early or late.  I'm sorry!  I am paying the bill yet I'm told where and at what time I am going to eat!  We were told that she couldn't tell us when we would know but for tonight the restaurants are all fully booked, so only the buffet options was available.  Not a very auspicious start to our vacation.

The next day we asked in the morning what our reservation was for that night and were told that she didn't know yet.  It took until mid afternoon to find out that we were booked into the Mole Mexican restaurant, annoyingly we had chosen to eat there for lunch and found it very low quality.  So to be told we were going back for dinner did not thrill us at all.  So this pattern went on for a couple more days, not knowing where we would eat until late in the afternoon, and despite asking for early times, we never once received a table before 8:30 one of which being 9:15.

Generally the food in this resort is not good.  The breakfast starts off the day as ok, as long as you choose to have something freshly cooked.  Lunch is passable but the dinners are awful.  Low quality food, poorly prepared.  Usually we enjoy getting dressed for dinner and going out to eat something yummy on vacation, but pretty much every night we were disappointed.   

Bana restaurant had reasonable tasting sushi, although the rice was weird.  The entrees were overly sweet or salty or just clearly not what they were listed as.

Fuego had the filthiest table cloths and fly and food debris covered menus.

On the last but one day, a new concierge Yanit was at the desk and she asked us how things were going.  I told her how utterly disappointed we were and how we had been treated by Angie.  She resolved to try and do something and indeed did offer us dinner at the Palapa restaurant which is not included, and also sent a bottle of prosecco and chocolate covered strawberries to our room.  This was a nice gesture but certainly did not make up for the poor experience we were having.

Palapa certainly felt more  like what we had been expecting from the restaurants.  Sadly the food, whilst beautifully prepared, lacked flavor, with the exception of the foie.  If I am being super picky it was a shame to see individual catering packs of buttered served at a higher level restaurant too.  

We ate one night at the beach barbecue which was dreadful, we arrived at our appointed time but to find that the beef was already all gone and what was left, looked like it had been sitting there kept warm for hours.
