The entertainment was interesting, one night was a Freddie Mercury tribute which was fabulous, next was an odd mix of a clubby atmosphere mixed with girls parading a stage in bikinis of different nations, another was a rendition of the Lion King musical.

The pool area in the Reserve is very nice but does get very littered with the paper cups that all drinks are served in poolside.  It was relatively easy to find a cabana or lounger.  Drinks were very available, although hearing the waiter call 'drinky drinky time to get drunk no one knows you,' did not come off as very family friendly.  The pool side in Paradisus is very crowded and not especially clean.The drinks whilst plentiful are generally laiden with sugar and watery.  The best cocktails are at the beach bar.

There are bicycles scattered around the property, and whilst it would have been great just to pick one up and ride it to the next bike park, this was not how it worked.  You had to reserve them and then lock them up.  So many bikes were locked up but we rarely saw people riding them.  The kids did have fun on the trampolining and rock climbing wall.

We did enjoy our stay, but that was thanks to the beaches and the water sports that we signed up for and enjoyed.  If you are booking an all inclusive know that they are not all created equal and if food and restaurant cleanliness is at all important to you, I would choose somewhere else.

reviews.author: CookieJavier
reviews.title: Below average
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. The wait and entertainment staff (shakey-shakey, gasolina, cocoloco) are superb and made us happy. Unfortunately the front desk staff need customer service101 and guest services staff need to speak to each other so everyone is on the same page. We stayed for 5 days but my room was cleaned only twice with housekeeping knocking at 10:30 pm. Reservations at restaurants were very difficult to make. They said they were booked when they weren't. Dinner at restaurants were not guaranteed even with a reservation ticket. Loved Punta Cana but may try a different hotel where my vacation can feel like a vacation.

reviews.author: ceciliaj838
reviews.title: NI UN POQUITO CERCA DE ESTAR ENTRE LOS 10 MEJORES HOTELES DE PUNTA CANA COMO INDICAN
reviews.text:
SON MUCHOS LOS RECLAMOS. Elegimos este hotel ya que estaba entre los primeros 10, pero no estan ni cerca del 100. El personal muy malhumorado, quedamos sorprendidos ya que en las anteriores oportunidades que visitamos Punta Cana en otros hoteles, lo mejor fue el trato del personal, pero en este hotel fue en general muy malo. Parecia que estaban todos enojados por algun motivo y se lo desquitaron en los huespedes. En la piscina no tienen el servicio de meseros paseandose con las bebidas como en los demas hoteles, nos parecio de lo peor ya que tocaba salirse de las piscinas para rogar por un trago en los bares. Ademas, nos aburrimos ya que no habia ni musica ni suficiente entretenimiento. Los que habian, duraban unos cuantos minutos. Nos decepciono ya que Republica Dominicana es muy alegre y siempre tienen musica bailable al vivo.
Las habitaciones necesitan mucha remodelacion y mantenimiento. Como puede ser que un hotel 5 estrellas tenga varias cosas rotas, como la puerta de la nevera, el vidrio de la mesa en el balcon, la cerradura y otras. Varias cosas no funcionaban. Los televisores muy antiguos y los nuevos estaban colgados de un brazo medio dudoso y peligroso. Las reservas para los distintos restaurantes fueron una pesadilla. Muy complicado. Los shows nocturnos eran lindos pero muy cortos...solo duraban 45 min. En los demas resorts duraban como minimo 2 horas. Los colchones de los sofa cama eran de terror. Pedimos que nos lo cambien unas 3 veces y nunca lo hicieron. Intente llamar varias veces al Spa varias veces e inclusive fui varias veces y no los encontre y la unica vez que pude encontrarlos hice una cita y despues quise modificarla y nunca mas las encontre y me quiseron castigar descontandome minutos del masaje. Me moleste tanto. Muchas diferenciaciones dependiendo del color o tamaño de la pulsera. Nos parecio muy discriminatorio. Cuando queriamos dejar a los niños en el kids club ubicado en the reserve, los adultos no podiamos tomar ni comer nada ahi porque no teniamos la pulsera indicada. QUE PRETENDEN?? QUE DEJEMOS A LOS NIÑOS AHI BOTADOS Y CAMINAR OTROS 20 MIN DE VUELTA A LA PLAYA? . NOS PARECIO DE LO PEOR. NI TOALLAS QUISIERON DARNOS. TERRIBLE!! Por ultimo, mis suegros se alojaron en una habitacion ocean front (SERVICIO SUPER VIP) y no lo sintieron para nada... les parecio ABSURDO todo lo que les cobraron y no tuvieron nada a cambio. Lo unico bueno fue la comida y la playa limpia y reposeras muy comodas.

reviews.author: Mohammad A
reviews.title: You don't get the quality you paid for
reviews.text:
I've been in this place this July from 18th to 25th with my family. Frankly speaking if you don't speak Spanish avoid this place because other than a few English speaking staff nobody understands you if you don't talk their language. I noticed that most of the guests are from Spanish speaking countries or regions. 

Our experience is somewhat mixed of good things and horrible things. At arrival we had to wait two hours to get our rooms because they have messed up with our two rooms reservation. One of the room they gave us was in front of an engine room with horrible noise (even doors and windows closed). When we complained about that it took another hour before they gave us a room in another area of the resort far from facilities we have signed for. We started by upgrading our reservation to family reserve to get a butler and be able to get access to a reserved beach and be able to reserve in restaurants because everything is crowded and over booked. During our stay they didn't change towels, linens etc. even if we asked for many times. I ordered room service many times to bring me fresh towels but they never came (I wonder if they understood our orders) I finally tipped to a maid to get some fresh towels. The same for drinks and other perks in the mini bar. I tipped the man in charge to get some beverage and perks (they are included you say). At many occasion the room key cards got wiped (too frequently) and we had to walk again to lobby to get them fixed. The bath in the rooms is separated with a half wall from the sleeping and living area. The toilet and shower had glass doors so goodbye intimacy ! Picture that. 

The reserved beach area is a set of wrongly setup double beds in the farthest area of the beach with poor access to all amnesties. The poor man who works there is always going and coming far away between orders so you don't practically see him. We also generously tipped him to get some decent service. Also the beach is full of seaweeds that they don't clean (have a look at satellite pictures and compare the beach areas)

The food in buffet is just acceptable but not very special compared to what I've experienced elsewhere. We tried some speciality restaurants. Fuego serves sea food and it was great. We tried Rare and the food was not right. It is a steakhouse included in your package but you should pay for steak !!! We tried Mizu (Asian teppanyaki) and it was just ok. Olio (Italien) restaurant serves you Pizza and Pasta I have nothing to say about. 

We paid a hefty amount of money to try Passion and the experience was nice but somewhat expensive specially the wine tasting. The staff were nice however. 

About entertainment, because the reserved beach is so far from everything we didn't really see anything at day time. At the Evenings they have some shows and dance stuff running which is entertaining for a while. 

The resort is very big and some amnesties are in the "reserve" far from beach. They have golf cart service taking people between places. There is a horrible odor coming from a steady water between two parts of the resort. The site is very well kept and taken care of however. 

I used business service and the personnel were kind and helpful. The Internet connection was good all around the resort.

The kids zone (in the reserve area) is a great place for kids with many activities. My daughter enjoyed during two sessions she has been there.

Anyway I'm not returning to this resort, too much hassle and disappointment for the expensive price we paid.

reviews.author: 380louisd
reviews.title: Get ready to beg for reservations
reviews.text: Every day had to take many trips to the guest services desk to get reservations for the evening. They keep giving everyone the same story - that the computer reservation system was "crowded".  Drinks by the beach and pool were very weak.

reviews.author: gabrielaserra
reviews.title: Completamente decepcionados
reviews.text: Fuimos un grupo familiar de 12 personas, hicimos la reserva con 5 meses de anticipacion. El dia que llegamos nuestro check in pudo ser realizado a las 8:30 pm xq no contaban con las habitaciones disponibles( viajamos con niños y solo pediamos poder hacerlos descansar.. No lo logramos). En una de las habitaciones habia un Tv 14 pulgadas, inadmisible para este tipo de hotel.. Durante la estadia siempre faltaban toallones en las habitaciones... Fuimos a casi todos los restaurantes que tiene el hotel, en el Rare no tenia disponible menu en español, esperamos mas de media hora y no logramos que nos consigan uno.. Tengo que destacar la amabilidad del personal en este restaurante. En el Olio solicitamos para 12 personas, nos prepararon una mesa para 10 y me preguntaron si no podia tener a mis hijos a upa xq no habia mas lugar... En el sector de playa muchas reposeras estan rotas, y siempre ( a la hora que vayas) estan reservadas. Por ultimo un error imposible de concebir... Mientras estabamos tomando algo se desprendio del techo ( 12 mtrs de altura) una lampara pesadisima.. Podria haber sido una gran tragedia y eso es imperdonable xq es por falta de mantenimiento... Ante los reclamos por todas las cosas que pasamos me dijeron que debia hablar con el gerente general: Domingo o Vladimir.. Solicite una cita con alguno de ellos y me dieron mil vueltas y no me lo concedieron.. Una lastima xq de esa forma no van a lograr mejorar sus fallas. Sinceramente nos decepcionamos, somos usuarios de la cadena Paradisus y en este caso no cumplio en absoluto con nuestras expectativas.

reviews.author: Topnotch680
reviews.title: Disappointed and I haven't even traveled there yet!
reviews.text: I have become very frustrated with trying to get in touch with the hotel. I have called several numbers and emailed the resort several times, even calling Melia directly and receiving an empty promise of a return phone call. I will be traveling with seniors and very young children and need to request a few things prior to our arrival in 3 days. I have traveled all over the world and have never had an issue with contacting the hotel directly. This is ridiculous.

reviews.author: Jrtuned
reviews.title: Very expensive for what you get
reviews.text: I had the misfortune of being put a room that was very far from the main are, it was noisy, broken bathroom and had no wifi access. I asked to be swapped and was told no rooms where available, yet when I went online I could easily book a room that night. Also the words mini bar should not be used when describing the barely there fridge with 2 beers, 2 waters and 2 sodas in it.

reviews.author: Bob C
reviews.title: Highly over-rated resort
reviews.text: I found this resort to be highly over-rated by trip advisor. The beach was dirty with cigarette butts all around the beach chairs, food was not very good. There not enough chairs by the pool or on the non exclusive family section of the beach. Cups and trash as well as towels were all over the place. The staff cleaned up the towels at the end of the day so it always appeared as though all the chairs were being used. Everyone was always looking for tips regardless of what they did for you.

reviews.author: SoleilLisbon
reviews.title: Poderia ser muito melhor
reviews.text:
Estivemos uma semana no Paradisus Palma Real com minha esposa e tres filhos. Optamos pela pulseira The Reserve para beneficiar das instalaçoes e Kids Zone assim como restaurantes.

Com este tipo de hotel e preços pago as expectativas sao altas.

No geral começando pelas boas coisas, Francisco Estrella na Piscina do Family concierge é otimo, restaurantes Bana Teppanyaki e Rear sao otimos e Kids Club simpatico assim como todos os espaços de piscina no The Reserve aonde se tem muita tranquilidade.

Apesar disto, muitas coisas deixaram a desejar dirante nossa estadia: o suposto majordomo nunca mostrou a cara! Pedimos para jantar as 19h-19h30 pois temos crianças e as reservas já estavam todas feitas para as 21h30 e apenas um dia conseguiram mudar nos informando as 18h! 

O serviço no café da manha é muito lento e pouco proativo, muitas vezes as mesas estao sujas e nao tem ninguem e as pessoas nao limpam por antecipaçao apenas quando chegam os hospedes e se espera muito e depois de sentado falta atençao ao detalhe. 

O restaurante Vento deixou muito a desejar, entradas muito fracas e pratos de baixa qualidade vs. Outros restaurantes. 

O carrinho entre palma real (praia) e The Reserve tambem é muito lento e se espera muito, desagradavel com crianças pequenas.

Uma pena pois horel tem enorme potancial mas muitas falhas. Nao é a primeira vez que venho gosto do hotel e sou membro do SMVC Club Melia e desta vez deixou muito a desejar o Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: kpuello2016
reviews.title: GREAT LOOKING RESORT, WITH TERRIBLE MANAGEMENT AND STAFF!
reviews.text:
I have to begin my review by giving credit where it is due, the resort, pool and beach are magnificent. The minute you walk in it is much breathtaking to see the ocean view and the huge pool. Then... the let down begins; to start the front desk employees are awful. They have no decorum in treating guests and treat you like you and your time do not matter. i arrived on a thursday evening and took over two hours to get our room. My family of four , including two young children were exhausted. They handed us an envelope with two magnetic keys, some coupons and didn't even explain anything about the resort.

 A young man named Franklin approached us to offer a tour of the hotel and a VIP breakfast, but would soon disappear. Turns out after a few days of running into him, he was The Salesman for melia club and was just trying to get our family to sit for some nonsense  TIME SHARE presentation. Ridiculous!

Once we finally got our room, it had no air conditioning, a broken mini fridge and a broken safe. So here i go exhausted back to the lobby front desk where the massive indifference and attitude begun. They acted like giving me a new room was a favor of great magnitude. some guy kept showing me a map of the rooms I couldn't get and after asking for a manager a girl came out to play the same game .I took a room like a mile away from the beach just to get my kids to rest. Im Pissed about this so far, since a booked an upgrade (luxury junior suite) room not to deal with any issues.

The room assigned was nice inside, but full of mosquitos that proceeded to eat us alive for six days. Turns out a backed up sewer drain in the shower brought up bad smells and bugs. How can this happen in a top resort.

FOOD- was below average in the buffet, and getting a restaurant reservation was nearly impossible and when it happened it was after 830. The specialty restaurants were OK, nothing to rave about and by the end of our vacation we all had stomach illnesses. Couldn't wait to get home to get a decent meal. I Had to pay the hostess at vento to honor a late reservation. ALL MONEY WITH THE STAFF.

STAFF- The staff at this hotel will ignore you most of the time until they see money in your hands. There were Great people that were exceptional Like LUIS At the pool bar. He was amazing, energetic and loved his job. Also Gregory at Blue agave was Great. Thanks to both of them.

POOL- The pool is really nice but get ready to be KICKED out of a certain roped off Royal service area. My Kids mistakenly swam into this SPECIAL area and were yelled at by an old security guard they have posted there. Not only is this ridiculous given the fact that no-one was in there and no division is in the pool. Once i questioned why he yelled at my family the security guard became rude and dismissive. I requested a supervisor who never came and i was asked to fill out a review by the towel girl. Between the royal service and the reserve it feels really SEGREGATED and if you don't pay extra will be treated like trash.

VLADIMIR AND DOMINGO- These two individuals came up to me after i sent them an email about the incident and tried apologizing for the incident. They assured me that the security bully guard would be moved, this NEVER happened. 

  Overall for the money you spend in this hotel, (which is pretty expensive) save yourself the aggravation and book another resort. I will not be returning to any Paradisus or their other hotels due to these issues. I will post this review anywhere i can to warn people of this pace. STAY AWAY PLS!!!

reviews.author: SwiftyOWB
reviews.title: Wedding trip that could be better
reviews.text: Alll offerings are limited and focus more on providing value to Reserve and Royal Service guests. The dinner restaurants disappoint with service and quality. The bars have very limited offering on only rail liquor without a $10+ upcharge. The resort is very spread out so get ready to walk!!

reviews.author: Manuela G
reviews.title: Stay at La Reserve Paradisus Facility Concierge at the end of Jun 2016
reviews.text:
We stayed for a week at the Family Concierge at Paradisus. It was a family vacation and we traveled with 2 children ( 3 and 7) and 2 grandparents. There were some positive sides to the vacation but also quite a few negatives. 
Here are the positive:
- the grounds are really beautiful. The gardens are well kept with all sort of native and lush plants. - - - The kids swimming pool at La Reserve is perfect for little ones- with slides and a shallow area where even the 3 years old could touch the bottom and swim safely. The chairs around the swimming pool are comfortable and offer plenty of shades. The kids swimming pool is located next to the kids club where our 7 years old had tons of fun with all sort of activities.
-The big swimming pool is also clean and ha water features and chairs to lounge in the water.
- The beach is clean and with very soft and white sand. In the week we were there most of the days there were some waves so kids could not safely swim by themselves but they could jump in the waves with the help of adults. We did not see too many seedweeds- it would depend on the time and the day. 
 -The beach is about 15 minutes walk from la Reserve but they have golf cart that go around the property constantly so it was easy to reach even if you did not feel like walking.
- the dining was good. they have a lot of different buffet style restaurants that do not require reservation and have a good variety of food. For a la carte restaurants we tried Fuego (which had a poor service and poor food) and The grill which we enjoyed. 
- the hotel is clean - both the rooms and the common areas. 

Negative facts:
- our room was really dark as it was on the ground floor and 2 of the windows were facing a very close wall. We had booked the Family Concierge Service but did not benefit of any of these services. Our room was not located in the Family Concierge Building (because of overbooking they told us) and we did not have easy access to our Family Concierge. The booking of the chairs at the beach or at the pool and at the restaurants were messed up in several occasions and we did not receive the phone to contact our concierge so hd to solve the issues by ourselves (which would not be a big deal but with little ones make become more stressful).
We booked a 1 bedroom suite and asked to have the couch made into bed for our kids. the room was so small that when the bed was pulled down there was really no room to move around.

reviews.author: Xonia1
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I had previously stayed at this hotel when they first opened and I always wanted to come back...
The hotel itself is a beautiful property and the staff is wonderful and helpful and the food is amazing, however if you want a peaceful gate away this is not for you... 
In the summer till November they allow kids for free, so you can imagine all the kids running around and screaming and taking over the facilities...
Also music was very loud at the buffet area and I enjoy dancing and listening to music but I think it was a bit much..
So for those reasons only I have to give them two stars...

reviews.author: rick b
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort in good location with very good service once you get to a restaurant for dinner, but outside of dinner, service is poor. We arrived and were greeted with a very nice private check-in. We were a little early and our room wasn't ready which is understandable. We returned at 3:00 for a room key and were told to stand in line with everyone else just arriving. Why would we get a private checkin and then have to stand in line for 20 minutes for a room key?Room is clean and spacious. We were surprised by a very huffy housekeeper that was upset when we asked her to make the sofa bed and simply provide a pillow for the bed. Another housekeeper was very friendly and helpful. This is what we experienced throughout our stay that ends tomorrow. We sat down on day one with our concierge to make dinner reservations for the entire week. She struggled to find availability for some restaurants and when she did it was 9:30 pm.  The buffet is average food and doesn't change the entire week. The buffet is the primary option for breakfast and lunch. One other lunch option, blue agave, but same poor service. Buffet is very crowded and it appears there are enough servers however water refills are slow to non-existent.  I had to ask for coffee three times one morning and eventually went and poured it myself.  Throughout the week we felt like Spanish speaking guests were treated much better than English speaking guests. Restaurant service was excellent and food was very good. We were surprised how empty the restaurants were given the difficulty getting a reservation. It is obvious they drive guests to the buffet. It was difficult finding lounge chairs at the pool and beach and occasionally no towels!  More frustrating than the poor service was management's response to our issues and concerns. We perceived negative attitudes toward us and positive attitudes toward Spanish speaking guests. I read this same comment on another review.  Mid week I asked to pay for access to the reserve pool and beech hoping for better service but the front desk quoted me $800 for 3 days (without room upgrade). 

All in all just disappointed considering how much we paid and overall just not feeling like the level of service was in line with the price.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: No Clue about what personal concierge means
reviews.text: Our concierge started by telling us that HE would pick the restaurants, not us! The service reps and the concierge would give us lip service with no follow through. HE told us he would slide reservation under door for a 7pm reservation, we were still waiting at 6:45 with no answer. Beautiful facilities. My advice is to make sure as soon as you reach hotel to sit down and work out all your plans, and follow through. Will not be going back.

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.title: @ $1300 per night-2 stars_@ $500-$600 would give it 3.5
reviews.text:
OK, I am going to be real and fair about this place. You can check my profile and travel history. I have been around the globe in modest to "5 star" resorts. I am a self made entrepreneur who is not afraid to splurge on travel yet believe one should get the value they pay for. if you are traveling with a company or inherited your wealth or work for the government and will go on the taxpayers dime, stop reading reviews, this place is beautiful and you'' really enjoy yourself. For all others, here is my review:
I stayed in a two bedroom master suite, me, my wife, and 2 teens. The total square foot was nothing short of massive. When booking online I tried just for 1 room but because my kids were 13 and 15, it defaulted to two rooms, I could find no way around this despite the fact our family could have easily and comfortably fit into 1 master bedroom. I point this out as if you can figure a work around to this booking issue, you can shave $$ off your trip. The cost for 4 nights was $5,202, or $1,300.50 per night, US dollars. WOW. A record per night rate for me, beats private condo ski in ski out at Beaver creek in high season and concierge level at Oconee Ritz, or likely any Ritz.
For $1300 per night, I expected a 5 star + experience. Now I am a laid back southerner so my "demands" are pretty basic, straight forward. Top notch help, top notch rooms, top notch service, top notch food, top notch grounds. 
Checkin: Excellent, with note. We were pretty late at night, super quick, gentleman was very nice, tried to explain what a guest needs to know. I knew we needed to make dinner reservations and he mentioned this as well: very simple, no worries, simply come down at 9.00 or 9.30 and speak with one of us, we'll take care of your reservations. 
Rooms: The rooms and grounds were awesome and beautiful, we were top floor (No elevator for those that may need one), huge rooms, Jacuzzi on each of the 2 balcony's. 2 bags of potato chips, Oreos and a small fridge with 2 beers, mil and coke/diet coke.
Reservations Restaurants: Not Acceptable. 
Water Sports: Not Acceptable/None Available for length of our stay
Service @ Beach chairs(Drinks, food, anything): Not Once
Overall food/taste/quality: Not Acceptable.
Ok, we go down at the prescribed time our first morning and a woman pops in and says shell handle our needs, please wait one minute, what restaurants/time do you prefer. We weren't picky and gave her the restaurants (virtually all) with a preferred time from 6-7.30. She came back in 5 minutes and said 100% of all restaurants were 100% fully booked, for all of the remainder of our 3 nights. I kid you not. $1300 per night we are paying and we are stuck with all day buffets?. Beyond words or comprehension. My wife and I looked at each other and in our polite southern slang simply said, please, please, you have got to be kidding, this is not OK. She promised she would work on it and leave us a message or a note. She did, for all 3 nights. We were able to go to the steakhouse at 7.30 first night, then it went downhill. She had to 'work" each day for that evenings reservation. The next night it was 9.30 reservation along with the third night, a 9.30 reservation. Were not an old couple but we are Americans and our family eats at 6, 6.30, 7 is getting late and grumpy, 7.30 all bets are off.
9.30 we are in bed.
We managed to do 9.30 the second night and by the time we ate we were exhausted, starving and the food (Mexican) was really pretty bad. To top it off the place was virtually empty, I mean it, like 5 other diners in the whole place. Teens ate nothing as the resorts food was simply "just gross" (My teens eat out a ton with us and are not picky eaters)
The super weird thing was, 2 of the 3 dinners, 30-60% of the tables were flat out empty, our entire meal, we could not believe it, steakhouse, Mexican, go figure, way for the resort to save money? No incentive for servers to seat no shows as all inclusive? Truly no idea but insane and infuriating none the less.

Staff: 85% were awesome and eager to please. (Not so much in the specialty restaurants)

Random salesman at pool: Not Acceptable
On our final day my wife and I had a very rare alone time by the pool in the early evening, just us, kids upstairs, beautiful surroundings, quiet, peaceful. We were fully engulfed in conversation and each other when an interruption occurred, a nice looking man asking how our stay was, ahh, a manager, that's nice I thought. We replied fine, and he proceeded on for a good 15 minutes pitching/trying to solicit some Melia nonesense, we kept trying to get him to shut it and leave, no luck. 
Are you joking? This was at The reserve, $1300 per night. Insane.

Make no mistake, this resort is stunning and has some great qualities, but it did not come close to measuring up to its price tag.

reviews.author: Andrey B
reviews.title: БОЛЬШЕ НЕ ХОЧУ !!!!!
reviews.text:
отдыхали с семьей в этом отеле с 24 мая по 10 июня 2016 г.
что могу сказать если это лучший из отелей их сети, то здесь есть над чем работать .
номера старые и убитые половина шкафов либо не открывались либо нужно было приложить много усилий, питание ужасное (они обьяснили это не высоким сезоном и экономией), помимо всего вся еда находилась в небольшом помещение где всегда было много народу и очереди которые там скапливались просто убивали, тебя все толкают, наступают на ноги, а после того как ты достал себе еду тебя ждет еще одно испытание, ты должен выйти на улицу на  +30 и выше и истекая потом попробовать пообедать или поужинать. десерты это вообще отдельная история их тебе выдают из-за стекла ( стоит мальчик и ты пальцем тыкаешь и просишь, что тебе нравится , если он вышел куда то то скапливается такое количество народу что ужас, он самое главное дает тебе всего одну штучку , попросишь две уже враг народа . это что касается питания . пляж довольно чистый хоть и много водорослей в океане , тут особых нареканий нет , что касается баров не дал 1-2 дол следующий раз сделают не коктейль  а помои , анимация отстой полный , вот когда вспомнишь турцию . короче ехать туда если вы были в других ( хороших отелях в доминикане не стал бы советовать ) если в первый раз найдите другой , если что это была моя 8-ая поездка в эту страну

reviews.author: emccurle
reviews.title: Our June 3-7th Stay at the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana
reviews.text: Food was a constant issues during my stay at the resort.  At certain resort restaurants, food was listed but i was told they were out or it was unavailable.  Food quality was average at best regardless of what is listed.  Room(s) were extremely nice, but had difficult time getting mini frig. restocked with snacks and drinks.  Shuttle service around complex was unreliable.  During check in the resort went to up selling immediately.  No need to do this the upgrades were misrepresented and no need to spend the extra money.  I would not go back.  Too many other options for travels throughout the Caribbean.

reviews.author: Martin Z
reviews.title: 12 day visit
reviews.text: beach and resort night life was great. food is horrible . service ehhh they need to make some major improvements on the buffets. the restaurants at night are okay. i stayed at Riu penninsula in cancun and food was much much better there.

reviews.author: Denilson Torres
reviews.title: Jamais Voltaria!  We'll never come back!
reviews.text:
Não tenho prazer algum de escrever um comentário como o que faço agora. A palavra que define o Paradisus Reserve Punta Cana/Royal Service para mim é “DECEPCIONANTE”. Viajo para resorts há pelo menos 10 anos e tenho muito conhecimento sobre o que se pode esperar ao se hospedar. É normal a expectativa de que quanto maior o valor pago, maiores serão seus confortos e serviços, porém, isso não necessariamente é uma verdade para esse resort.

Quem busca um resort dessa categoria, procura por serviço de qualidade, estrutura grandiosa, diversidade de serviços, restaurantes, bebidas e infelizmente não foi isso que encontramos em nossa estadia de 7 noites.

O hotel até sua chegada se comporta como se fosse 5 estrelas, mas não é isso que acontece após você ser apresentado ao seu próprio quarto. Grande parte dos funcionários do hotel não são simpáticos, sequer dão um “bom dia ou um olá” ou coisa parecida. São incapazes de lhe cumprimentar. As pessoas lhe são simpáticas se estiverem lhe prestando um serviço diretamente e, é lógico, minha experiência mostra que aquela simpatia é contada em algumas notas de dólares. A limpeza à primeira vista é satisfatória até que você se depara com baratas em seu quarto e foi o que aconteceu conosco. Situação essa que levou o hotel inclusive a nos mudar de quarto.

Esqueça se você pensa que ao chegar no hotel terá os restaurantes temáticos, mexicanos, espanhóis, italianos, japoneses, não, não vai mesmo. O que você encontrará, com raras exceções, será uma comida sem graça, insossa e muitas vezes nem de longe se assemelhando aquilo que você imaginou comer. Como exemplo falo do restaurante mexicano. Qualquer restaurante mexicano de praça de alimentação de shopping será melhor do que o locado no Paradisus. Pedimos uma comida que continha guacamole, ou seja, é como pedir arroz com feijão no Brasil e o garçom disser não tem porque acabou. Espera um pouco, como podem me dizer que algo acabou se pagamos diárias tão altas para termos esse atendimento? O próprio restaurante em si funciona numa espécie de corredor, onde as pessoas transitam em sua entrada e não há sequer qualquer referência ao México, mas o que esperar, se nem a comida lembra o tema do restaurante?

O restaurante italiano que seria a salvação do resort peca na sua simplicidade do cardápio. Não há requinte ou sofisticação, é um cardápio seco de opções, mas aquilo que se serve é bom e aceitável para um restaurante de resort. E por falar em opções, acredito que o diretor executivo do hotel não se preocupa em finalizar as refeições com boas sobremesas. São quase sempre as mesmas em todos os restaurantes.

Uma boa pedida, finalmente, é almoçar e tomar café da manhã no buffet. Há ali comida para todos os tipos e gostos. Há muita variedade e tudo pode estar sempre fresco. Falo, em hipótese, porque eu e meu parceiro no almoço do penúltimo dia comemos apenas uma coisa igual, foi o atum grelhado. Na tarde desse mesmo dia estávamos com desarranjo intestinal que perdurou por um dia, e com certeza não levamos ao conhecimento da gerência, pois até então já havíamos passados por situações bem constrangedoras no hotel.

O restaurante mediterrâneo é elevado a um dos melhores por causa de uma boa comida e na verdade do atendimento de YUDERQUI JAVIER que é uma das garçonetes. Se mesmo depois desse post você ainda assim reservar suas férias nesse resort, lembre desse nome, ela realmente é a diferença nesse restaurante. Como nem tudo é perfeito, voltamos a esse restaurante 3 dias depois e Yuderqui Javier infelizmente para nós estava de folga, além de nos servirem vinho mais gelado do que cerveja, a comida estar longe do razoável, não nos davam qualquer atenção e sem atendimento levantarmos da mesa e fomos embora sem falarmos com os garçons.

Voltando aos quartos, não posso deixar de mencionar o fato de que neste resort não há  amenidades básicas que se espera encontrar nos banheiros. Apenas shampoo, condicionador, loção para corpo e uma toca de banho são encontrados. Se você precisar de um cotonete deve ligar para o “guest service”. Precisou de algo para lustrar o sapato, faça o mesmo. O botão da roupa soltou, com sorte terão uma agulha e linha para lhe emprestarem, sim, emprestar, pois dificilmente lhe darão uma linha e agulha sem cobrar, apesar do que nas diárias você já pagou por tudo isso e muito mais. Ressalto ainda que as camareiras repõem os itens usados, mas não tiram aqueles finalizados.

Uma das coisas mais impressionantes que notamos é o fato de que não há qualquer bebida quente nos quartos. Como já disse, ficamos em mais de um quarto por causa de baratas encontradas. É normal que nos apartamentos de resorts encontremos vodka, rum, tequila, coisas do tipo. Nada, absolutamente nenhum tipo dessas bebidas. No frigobar você encontrará água, coca-cola, fanta, Sprite, duas caixinhas de suco de laranja e só. Chocolates, guloseimas? Será melhor folhear uma revista de gastronomia.

As tarifas são demasiadamente altas para o que se apresenta. Não vale. Se cobrassem menos e oferecessem o que de fato oferecem seria justo, mas o preço está supervalorizado dadas as condições de serviços, comida, atendimento, comodidades que são oferecidos.

Seria leviano de minha parte não tecer alguns comentários de pessoas que realmente fazem diferença. Com tantos contratempos que tivemos, houve pessoas cruciais que conseguiram que mantivéssemos a calma necessária para continuarmos nossas férias e apenas esperá-las terminarem. Falo de GABRIELA GIACOMINI, gerente do Royal Service, e de SAMUEL RODRIGUEZ, que foi designado nosso mordomo. Essas duas pessoas, com as quais tivemos mais contatos, são realmente 5 estrelas e mesmo criticando o resort como fazemos neste post sabemos que tudo que eles fizeram estava ao alcance de cada um. Empenharam-se em nos dar dias cada vez melhores, desculparam em nome do hotel quando algumas situações aconteceram e se dispuseram a nos ajudar no que fosse preciso. Por eles e por outros que quase anonimamente fazem seu serviço com excelência, como NORESIN BAPTIST, TOMAS GUERREIRO, STALIN estes do restaurante NAOS e YUDERQUI JAVIER do mediterrâneo, damos nossos muito obrigado e nos desculpamos por estarmos sendo tão incisivos com a empresa que os emprega.

Também não poderia deixar de dizer que a praia que serve o hotel é maravilhosa, águas calmas, mornas e mar muito limpo e isso é um diferencial, não proporcionado pelo hotel, mas pela própria natureza. O conforto na praia poderia ser muito maior se não fosse o fato de que as bebidas são servidas em copos de papel. Esqueça belas fotos de coquetéis, melhor não tirá-las, pois a apresentação da bebida é por demasiado pobre e não reflete o que se espera.

Como viajante, e com toda a autoridade que tenho no assunto, pois aqui no Trip Advisor já estou no grau máximo, por tantas contribuições, sugiro a quem estiver lendo esses comentários que repensem uma, duas, cem vezes antes de fechar a reserva. Definitivamente não vale 60% do que cobram. Você irá pagar por um serviço mediano, sem qualidade, sentirá falta de vários itens e não será capaz de ter férias ou lua de mel da forma como sonhou.

E para você que está fazendo sua primeira viagem para um resort all inclusive, não vá na empolgação, pesquise melhor, seja calmo ao escolher, leia as dicas no trip advisor e tente ler também aquelas que avaliam com notas baixas, pois sempre há muita informação ali. As pessoas que avaliam com baixas notas são as mais atentas e com certeza serão as que lhe darão as melhores dicas.

Para concluir, posso lhes afirmar que jamais voltaria nesse hotel.

reviews.author: BHSolo
reviews.title: What a Disappointment
reviews.text:
This review is from someone who has visited the Caribbean before, stayed in high-end and low-end hotels, and is pretty forgiving. With that being said I would not recommend this hotel.

Right after book I realized I made a mistake of 1 instead of 2 people, originally it was a solo trip but my friend was going to join, I called Melia to try and switch it. I received 4 different answers, including the hotel saying they would charge me $200 more per night than the website was saying. A manager was to call me to explain why and I am still waiting for that call 2 months later.

The hotel:
Pros: 
Nice beach area with plenty of palapas with great shade coverage when wanted and 4 chairs all underneath each one.
Fuegos - a delicious restaurant with every good service
The pool was very nice with the beds in them
The gym was your pretty decent average hotel gym but I really did enjoy the paddleboard fitness and yoga, those were great.

Cons:
Upon arrival the bellman was dismayed, offended, and seemingly annoyed I came by myself - asking why I didn't have any friends? The maitre 'd at the buffet also was quite insistent on being upset I was traveling by myself. Thankfully I am a strong person to stand up to this but it was very offputting.
After being in my room and about to get ready for dinner I had no bath towels, the clock did not work, my fridge was not full, the outside light was out, the lock did not work well, the tv you had to get up to turn on and off with a missing channel button, and when I went to call to have these items fixed I found out my phones also did not work.
On the beach, the waiter went to get me a mudslide to only come back and say they had no Bailey's. Strange since I was able to get it at the bar right afterwards. The next day I tried again, assuming they would replenish, when the waiter said they were still out. So instead of him going to another bar to get it for me he told me to get up and get it myself.
The safety at the resort was also a bit disconcerting. The hotel doors only have a lock that maybe works, no chain. The partially lighted path is many times empty at night and becomes pitch black when the power goes out during a storm.
The overall service was bleh and at times a bit rude.

reviews.author: Shoogi123
reviews.title: Not impressed one bit - false advertising
reviews.text:
Not sure why anyone raves about this place . The check in process is terribly slow , the rooms are very dated and the service is suboptimal .  They advertise that if you stay for a week  you get 1500 in spending credit . Well this is false. You get coupons towards what they want you to spend on the products they want to promote. For example you get 20 off - bottle of $100 wine - it's not like you get $ 1500 to spend on what you want it is $1500 in random coupons instead. This is false advertising. They drop you off at your room and don't tell you how complicated this place is to navigate. If you don't have a reservation for dinner you are eating at the buffet and the food there sucks. So they get your money up front and there is no food to eat - so the all inclusive is part is not exactly accurate - you can't find food  anywhere until 6 PM. The staff is indifferent and not very helpful.
They also promote free room service but If you order coffee it can take over an hour to get it . The blue agave is disgusting and I can't believe they call that a snack bar. The food looks terrible and it's just sitting out with no food options to pick from. We just got here and I believe we'll be lucky to get a descent meal all week. I am extremely disappointed and would never return - I would caution others to think twice about visiting this place. Lots of rules none of which benefit the customer. They could care less. Not impressed and I am one unhappy customer. You should go elsewhere. If you expect quality this place is not for you. Everything is a bait and switch situation. Not sure exactly how they have earned any good ratings. The place needs to be better maintained. It's old and not well kept . Customer service sucks they don't care about their guests. Sorry I chose to spend my vacation here. I would caution you not to make the same mistake! Go elsewhere !

reviews.author: pE3597JX
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: The grounds of the resort are beautiful, and the staff tries.  The place itself is very expensive to start then everything is an up charge.  The worst all inclusive I've been too.  Our trip was great in spite of the place not because of it, very disappointing.

reviews.author: SomaK95762
reviews.title: They took extra money and are not responding. Stay away for cheaters.
reviews.text:
Hotel is nice but I got cheated and no response for my emails or phone calls.
Check all my reviews and most of my reviews are very positive because I am not picky. This hotel was supposed to get 4 rating but I am giving 2 because they took additional money from me and do not respond to my emails.
Here is the story:
We booked a room for 4 of us 2 adults and 2 kids (12 and 14) since kids under 12 stay free (promotion) we had our friend who is single but we booked a room for 2 adults so we can adjust our 14 old in his room.
We stayed for 4 nights and day before check out we got a call to pay extra for the kid we told them that we booked another room for 2 adults and only one is staying there and my 14 yar old need to be adjusted as a guest for that room. Initially they did not understand and finally they did and the supervisor told me that he will adjust. Next day morning when we are checking out the lady at the front desk insisted that we pay $866.45 extra for the kid. When I told them the whole thing and asked for supervisor. Every one kept on saying that they are the supervisor and I have to pay. They did not let me leave the hotel without paying and they actually had me sign on credit card receipt that was in local currency which I signed in a hurry (not to miss my plane). Later I came to know that they charged me $1722.90 (double the amount). They charged for my 12 year old also. I contacted them by email. no reply. When I called them no one seem to understand the issue and they keep saying that the charge is correct. I placed a dispute on my credit card and that got declined because the hotel showed my signed credit card receipt. This happened during thanks giving of 2015. I waited all these days to see if they respond and refund my money. First of all, they should not be charging $866.45 for additional kid (when the whole payment I made for 4 nights for all fo us was $1110). They actually charged double by mistake and are not returning my money.
So stay away for this cheaters......

reviews.author: Climber19534
reviews.title: Getting worse every year...
reviews.text:
It's quite sad.  We used to love the paradisus palma real and have come multiple times... But this will be our last trip ever.  The rooms are very old, they are not maintaining the hotel at all.  Shower did not have hot water the whole week, the bed sheet had a blood stain that we complained about everday and nobody ever bothered to change, the pillows had a stain and were very uncomfortable, the shower leaked all night after we took a shower and we had to get someone to come tighten it every night.  The ceiling was leaking in our room and 3 other of our friends rooms--The room service never brought the right order-- i ordered lasagna, they brought penne pasta.  Nothing was done right.  When I would complain they never apologized, always had an excuse.

Note to hotel: the only way you can improve your hotel and services is if you recognize your problems and try to fix it and improve.  Do not bring excuses when customers complain.

The grounds are beautiful, but the rooms are awful, the overall service is poor and they don't care to give you any kind of service.  Its self service, do not expect to be pampered, nobody will even hand you a towel or drink by the pool... this is a 2.5 star hotel.

reviews.author: Jasmeen K
reviews.title: Slow and Poor Service...not helpful staff
reviews.text: Slow and Poor Service...not helpful staff.  Room wasn't ready when I arrived.  No one seemed to know anything. Food was terrible...nothing tasted like it should have.  We ordered lobster risotto and it wasn't cooked at all!

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Disappointing Service and Food @ Palma Real
reviews.text: My wife and I are currently staying on a 7 day couples retreat minus kids. The service and each restaurant at the Palma Real is subpar. The servers are not friendly and yes, we do tip. We've dined at Blue Agave for lunch and dinner; both terrible experiences with undercooked  meat and little to no service. We had to be shuttled to The Reserve where we found friendly staff and good food. The views and the beaches are great but good luck getting a drink on the beach from anyone. The bartender by the pool was so rude he didn't even acknowledge us waiting at the bar until he felt like it. As far as the room goes, the shower is small. It's maybe 3x3 feet. The tub in our room did not work and the when we tried to fill it up the water had a brownish tinge. We saw the shows nightly and they were ok. This will probably be the last time we visit this specific resort. We went to their location in Riviera Maya and its lights years away in terms of friendliness and accommodations.

reviews.author: Rachel C
reviews.title: My first and last time to Reserve at Paradisus
reviews.text:
The weather was a little dismal, just bad luck I suppose. 
Our room was nice, although the AC was set at 58 and we were frozen. Asked for blankets at 10pm , they only had one. We ate at several of the restaurants, watch out they push you to eat the buffet until you wise up and say something.
Edible but nothing great. The grille I was annoyed because I upgraded to a porterhouse for 50 dollars and it was tough and nasty. Didn't help that there were no steak knives just one that you could use on a plane. Waitress was a sour woman. Never brought our sides and had a bad attitude. That was the only night I didn't leave a tip. My daughter also got food poisoning from eating the ribs at the Grille.  We stayed in the reserve and the rooms were nicer than the regular Paradisus however you eat the same food as the regular  Paradisus We had a family concierge, it started out non existent but after I voiced my concerns over the lack of service, it did improve. She was hanging around as the last day approached to make sure she got her tip, too little too late . Getting a reservation at the restaurants would be a challenge if you don't have that but other than that, you don't need one. The best employee they have is Santos who works on the beach. 
Maybe I am not an all inclusive type but I was very disappointed.
I had to ask for the kids welcome bag twice, only one pillow pet person and no extra blankets in the freezing room. No mini bar restock service, only decaf coffee in room. No cell phone was available that was part of the package until the day before we left. 
I would not recommend this to my friends, it's just adequate on the food and service is marginal at best. 
My final straw was prior to leaving it was 6:30am and the buffet at the reserve restaurant was all out and it was a sauna in the area it is kept. They blast the AC 10 mins before people walk in and unknowingly eat the buffet that has been exposed to 90 degree humidity. I was mortified and that was the nail in my coffin. 
The kids club is fine, my 8 yr old went once. It's geared for kids under 6. 
I am not a prude but the endless drunk  behavior and poor choice of bathing suits ( skanky) was not what I envisioned at the regular Paradisus pool for a family. I like to drink and have a good time but there was a lot of loose behavior and bad language. Not my cup of tea........ 
Also check in takes an hour it sucks.........

reviews.author: Ryan Roberto
reviews.title: Wasn't worth the premium expense
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here from April 22nd- 26th in a Jr suite. Upon arrival we were assigned a room 3062, this was a 3rd floor room and the building had no elevators. The building was also far from all the central activities. After calling the front desk 3 times and getting knowhere I decided to walk back to the main lobby and request a room change. I asked for the hotel manager who was not available instead I had to deal with a front desk employee which took almost an hour of arguing to get him to change my room to one with an elevator. Then I was assigned to room 2018 which was centrally located and very close to the main lobby and restaurants. The problem with this room was the air conditioning wouldn't go below 73 degrees even though I had it set to 65. The other issue was the shower stall had constant water running and when I called the front desk to advise them of these issues I was told they would send someone to investigate. 2 days later and the water is still running in the shower and the shower valve system is loose and swinging all over the place. Now on to day 2, the family and I went for breakfast around 8 and then to the pool and beach. We arrived back to our room around 3pm to find the room cleaned but no towels or face clothes. I called the front desk who advised me they would send someone up immediately, well 90 minutes later the towels arrived. On the 3rd day the same issue occurred so I went and spoke with the front desk and they advised me there was a shortage of towels and that the laundry dept would bring me towels and face clothes ASAP. Around 4:30pm the towels arrived and my family was finally able to take a shower. When you spend $500 a night at a resort this issues are unexceptable and show be non existing however the employees advised me these are a everyday occurence. While the food is mediocre and the pool and beach is great the customer service and guest relation priorities are absent. Next stone I will stay elsewhere for $500 a night.

reviews.author: davidwladue
reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text:
This property as compared to other options for your travel dollars is average at best.  To be more specific;

*Avoid the Royal Service rooms.  No better than an upgrade at a typical Hilton Garden Inn.  Absolutely NOT worth the price.  Avoid, avoid, avoid...do NOT fall for this rip off. 

*Very average to poor food.  If a restaurant in the US served food like you find here it would be out of business quickly. 

*Customer service is average at best.  The employees seem to be "just doing there jobs" without any real interest in their customers.  Almost uninterested and unengaged...

In general, you can find many much better options for your travel dollars.

reviews.author: NancyGreyStreet
reviews.title: Nancy Greystreet
reviews.text: Unfriendly staff.  I far prefer Jamaica or Cancun for an all-inclusive . Front desk Personnel are not very helpful .  8 Atlanta and the buffet so far  in both  we're not great . Below average food.  Beautiful setting. Nice enough rooms.

reviews.author: bethr599
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: If you go make sure you are part of Royal Service or on The Reserve otherwise it's a waste of money and very expensive for no reason.  Grounds are beautiful but staff was less than helpful, reservations for dinner were a mess and overcrowded.  Food and drink was average of all inclusive.  Wait staff was not very engaging and got impression most didn't speak English.  If you are part of RCI timeshare exchange definitely don't go here...room was terrible and charged enormous all inclusive fees on top of your points. Have a feeling if didn't go part of RCI it might have been better?

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We experienced numerous issues with our room including no hot water in the sinks, loud music outside our room every night until after 11 pm, the ceiling fan in the bedroom not working.  We complained about these items 4 times during our stay and nothing was done about any of them!  Also, the golf is advertised as "free".  If you call having to rent a cart for $150.00 free!  Every year our family tries to experience a new "beach vacation" and unfortunately this one ranked as our least favorite.

reviews.author: Antoinette M
reviews.title: Super mediocre Family Easter / spring break
reviews.text:
stayed the the reserve and had HIGH expectations since last year I stayed at Palma Real. Actually this was booked by mistake, it's very confusing on line when you look at both hotels even the restaurant names are same. But big difference! We paid extra for family concierge but he was a fill in from Royal service because they were busy. 
Rooms were runned down and dirty, the doors walls needed to be wiped down they had marks finger prints, I didn't even let my kids touch the light switches! After 3 days there I emailed the GM wLeticia Del Rosario
Regional Sales Manager USA & Canada, who I spoke to weeks before asking to please switch me to PR that it was a mistake. (They were booked so I had no choice but she reassured me I would be well taken care of). I showed her pictures of the room and told her this was unacceptable. It's been about 6 days still no work back from her but she must have got my email because the day before we left someone came in and changed the entire shower body! Good for the next people.
Pool Activities mediocre. I was told wrong time for yoga class rushed all the way to beach it was over! Kids zone pool is the last pool, closest to road where we smelled fumes all day in our cabana. We made the best of it and we did meet a few nice people like Raynold who the next day took the sample painting that my daughter couldn't particate in and hand delivered it because he saw how upset she was. 
We even paid $5!extra per drink because we asked for top shelf vodka! 
I could keep going... Not my idea of a luxury resort by far! I won't be back:/

reviews.author: Alexandre P
reviews.title: Extremely Overrated
reviews.text:
Hotel is just about average - far from the best in the Caribbean. 

Pros: nice pool, beautiful spa, all inclusive, good infrastructure, great weather
Cons: dirty beach (seaweed, garbage and even human poop in the sea believe it or not), confusing segmentation (there are places you can't go with your wristband and you just know when they kick you out), disorganized reservation system for the dinners, annoying people trying to sell time-sharing and other stuff you don't need, misleading promotions (coupons) that don't work, incompetent people that can not solve any problem, lack of privacy in the room bathroom (it is fully open), people afraid to lose their jobs every time you ask for something different, poor wifi speed, noisy gold carts transporting people disturbing your rest, etc.
I think it is clear this is not the best place to go in the Caribbean, right? If you can, go to St. Barths, St. Martin, Turks and Caicos, St. Thomas, Bahamas, even Cancun and Playa del Carmen. You will never regret. Stay away from Punta Cana and Meliá if you can.

reviews.author: Mkatz411
reviews.title: When all the rights go extremely wrong.
reviews.text:
One thing must be made clear about The Paradisus Punta Cana and it is that it is one of the most beautiful hotels in Punta Cana not to mention one of the biggest. They take good care of the grounds, pool and the beach. The sense of peace flows from the moment you step outside and encounter nature, the rooms though show tear and wear are still comfortable, it isn't like one spend a lot of time inside anyway. The hotel itself is wonderful but that's as far as the wonders of this hotels go. I have been coming to The Paradisus (The Reserve) since 2009, and I can attest to the many changes the hotel has gone through. This isn't necessarily a bad thing, but at some point during those changes the focus was switched and what we were left with is a shell of what true costumer service was supposed to be. As I have complained before, the hotel focus is 100% family - they not longer cater to couples or singles. If you are a member you are perhaps having a better time than just who are regular paying guests. 

My husband and I travel at least 2 times a year for vacation and this is a hotel we always felt compelled to returned to until we started noticing the changes. It started slow, with minor things such as finding where to sit by the pool (only Family Concierge is guarantee a cabana by the pool or beach - mind you we opted for this option this  year due to prior experiences when we had no place to seat almost for the entire stay). 

We wanted to make sure this trip was better than prior stays, so we decided to go for the Family concierge which guaranteed us a better experience (we are a couple with no kids). That sadly was not the case, we couldn't get a dinner reservation, we couldn't use our Mas Reward points to pay for Spa services. Their excuses went from we had to make the reservations early (even after giving our concierge the list early on our arrival day of places we wanted to eat). Their excuses moved onto say that they are at full capacity and everyone already book dinners in advance (those staying more than 1 week). So basically you have to stay 2 weeks if you actually want to eat at any restaurant that isn't serving a buffet. I am very sadden that this will be the last time we stay at this hotel, and I am angry at the same time that they do absolutely nothing to better our situation. The worse happened today at the Spa, I got confirmation late from our concierge that our massages were scheduled for 1pm and that the points were confirmed. So when we got there the front desk person informed me that only 1 services would be covered by my points, that I have to pay $160 dollars for the other. Not only did I get the run around the day before because I was never informed that my reservation was booked, but I was awaken early this morning around 8am to tell me it would be for today at 1pm to then not being exactly what I was confirmed by the concierge. 

I can go on and list everything that went wrong but I think I made that point already. The service has gone from excellent to terrible and I can't stress enough the need for training for everyone in this hotel. They are friendly, they go out of their way to greet you, but do absolutely nothing to make your stay amazing. 

NOTE: We were here in November and expressed our dislike for the service and how people were treated (we have noticed how other guests were also complaining about not being taken into account and even forgotten), and we expressed that we would not be coming back, they pleaded with my husband to give them another chance, perhaps we shouldn't have because this has been the worse experience yet. We gave them another chance, spent $1700 for 3 days, and it was worse than the last. We have stayed at others Melia hotels such as Mexico, Santo Domingo & Punta Cana.

reviews.author: AlexT2000
reviews.title: Worst vacation ever!
reviews.text:
We were very excited to come to Paradisus Palma Real as we stayed here (at The Reserve) about 4 years ago. However our vacation turned into disaster. 
Cons:
•	Rooms were not being cleaned on time
•	Not enough towels, do not even bother calling they will not bring them
•	Balcony door was being left open by maid, and I had to spend time killing of mosquitoes
•	Food at restaurants (Mexican and some other) took about 2 hours to arrive
•	Do not even bother asking for wine or beer at main buffet, they will not arrive. It is much easier to get them yourself at the bar which is located right near buffet. The only section were service was good is the one near the hostess by main entrance.
Now, I normally do not let things like above to bother me too much. It is vacation after all, and I was spending time with my wife and 2 kids under fantastic weather. But here is what made it into disaster.
More Cons:
•	One of the waiters spilled something at buffet, no one bothered putting chairs or wet sign around the spill. When my wife went to get food she slipped and hurt here knee badly. Even after I complained no apology was given
•	The thing that made me furious is that the resort is having Hand, Food and Mouth decease issue and no one warns about it. My son got infected on 5th day. His hands, legs and face got covered with horrible rash (the full effects came out on the way home). He was truly miserable. The day before his symptoms started showing up, the staff drained and refilled kid’s pool. The day after, I overheard conversation on the beach from a group of people, that all theirs kids (same age as my son 2-3 year olds) got sick, and that they complained. This must have what made them drained the pool, and yet no warning was given. 
If you ever decide to come here, make sure to keep yours kids away from kid’s round pool and clean high chairs with wipes every time. Trust me, this decease WILL MAKE YOU CHILD MISERABLE!
At the end, all I asked for was a late check out (2:30 pm), but even that they could not do. When we came to our room at 1:15 all keys were expired.
Few Pros:
•	Great kids club. Staff there is fantastic
•	Beautiful white sand beach
•	Free Wifi everywhere

reviews.author: Brandon D
reviews.title: General reservations vs Royal Service
reviews.text:
This review will only reflect the differences we encountered during a 7 night stay, where 4 nights were in general reservations (Garden View Junior Suite), and 3 nights in Royal Service (Garden View Suite).
Sadly to say, there is an immense difference between the two reservations. 
I will start by noting that we stayed at Paradisus La Perla in Mexico one year ago. VERY IMPRESSED!

Our original booking at the Palma Real was 7 nights in the Garden View Junior Suite, which upon arrival was less than impressive. We were not blown away by the front end staff, who simply provided us room keys, and handed us over to a staff member to show us to our room. Upon arrival of the room, we were very unimpressed with the quality of the room, so much so, that we immediately called front desk to ask for a nicer room. The issue was that the room was very dark and closed off. The room was separated by walls surrounding the bed, with broken kitchen cabinets hanging in the kitchenette (which were not useful as they contained no dishes, utensils, cups etc. Just empty cabinets). The couch in the living area was very small, and uncomfortable, to the point where you could not even sit on it without sinking to the floor. The bathtub area also housed the closets, which made for difficulty in retrieving clothing, and getting dressed. The closet doors barely opened fully without hitting the bathtub or eachother.
After a discussion with front end staff, we were asked to come back to reception to discuss options for alternate rooms. A 30 minute discussion ensued with multiple front end staff in an attempt to simply find a nicer room. We were not looking for the resorts best room, just something more modern with better amenities. The staff were very confused at our request, and continued to try to book us into Royal Service, or the Presidential Suite. Both of these options were significant upgrades (thousands), and not what we wanted. Just a different room. The staff would not show us alternate rooms, and continued to say that no rooms existed that we would want. We left the reception area unhappy.
We stayed in the original room for 3 nights, putting up with flooding shower drains, lack of bottled drinking water, and a general unhappy feeling. After the 3rd night, we decided to return to the reception area to again discuss options for upgrading. We were willing to pay for a better room, and made that clear from the start. After discussing all of the options with the staff, and looking at binders of pictures of the different room types, we asked if we could see a room in the Royal Service (Adults only) side of the resort. The reception staff laughed in our faces and walked away to chat with the other staff members working behind the counter. At this point we were very confused at the approach of the staff. We were willing to pay extra money, on top of the significant expense of the resort already, and they were laughing at us. 
After another 30 minutes of discussions, we were shown to a Royal Service room, which included a brief walkthrough of the amenities of the Royal Service area (pools, spa etc.). Upon entering the room, we were blown away at the difference from our initial room to this new room. The Royal Service room was all white, bright and clean, well maintained and modern. We instantly agreed that we would upgrade the next day. 
The staff member told us to return to the lobby at 7:00am the next day to meet with her to transfer to the new room. We did this promptly at 7:00am as advised. She did not show up, in fact, the staff that were available questioned us as to why we would wake up at 7:00am to transfer to a room that wasn't ready until at least 11:00am. Needless to say, the room was not ready, and we were left in limbo with packed luggage and a feeling of being lied to. We were advised to go to the Royal Service lobby to get the new bracelets so that we could at least take advantage of some of the RS amenities while we waited. 
When we arrived to the RS lobby, the experience changed. We were greeted with mimosa's and warm smiles. The staff were incredibly caring and did their best to have a room ready as soon as possible for us. Our butler was called and brought in early to meet with us, and we were settling into the room by 10:00am. 

This is where the vacation changes entirely.

Although lacking in some service areas (pool bar at RS). The RS is a must at this resort. I questioned whether the $65 US per person per night upgrade was justified, but its absolutely required! The general population (non RS) guests at this resort would be appalled to know how much better the service is for the RS guests. I was appalled! We paid a lot of money to stay at this resort (almost $5,400 CAD) for the week, and held high expectations for the resort. It wasn't until we paid an additional $540 CAD for the 3 nights in RS that we felt pleased by the resort. 

For potential guests wondering if this resort is for them...the grounds are incredible, the food is good, the rooms are less that impressive, and the service was fair. Unless....you upgrade to RS. Then everything seems to get much, much better. For us, the upgrade couldn't have come any sooner. But the scars left by the front end staff cut deep and will leave lasting impressions.

For seasoned travelers with high expectations, steer clear unless you are considering the RS upgrade. General reservations will leave a sour taste.

reviews.author: cris m
reviews.title: Housekeeping thieves
reviews.text: We had a great time but 3 different rooms in our party had money stolen. 1 room reported it and was interrogated like we were the theifs. They even searched our room. They were suppgosef to let us know about the " investigation " never heard from them again.

reviews.author: Medic_5
reviews.title: Gorgeous Property-Poor Service
reviews.text:
This is a tough one as the resort is in great shape, our room on the third floor (no elevator) in The Reserve was very clean, and the pool and the beach are fantastic.  There are tons of staff around who all are happy, smile, and answer any questions.

Unfortunately The Reserve portion of the resort is geared only to families.  There is a family concierge in each building, families are greeted and given an orientation, there is stuff for the kids, and the concierge will reserve a Bali type bed at the pool or the Reserve section of the beach.  Well.....we did not come with kids. We did not receive any orientation and it was day 3 before we found out that there is a trolley to the Reserve beach.  We had no idea what each restaurant served nor were we told the process to make any reservations.  We also learned the hard way that while we were at The Reserve there was no reserve for us as only families could reserve space in advance at the pool and beach.  The place is large and we asked for a map and were told they were waiting on more to be printed. 

The building concierge smiled a lot but was basically useless.  Requests to restock the mini bar were apparently ignored.  Restaurant reservations were challenging to make.  Basically there was little communication with us.

After 4 days we met with Monica, the Family Concierge manager and later sent her an email expressing some of our concers.  These included housekeeping not leaving any towels except for bath towels, turndown service that occurred twice out of four days, and a mini bar and snacks that were not replenished.  She responded quickly that she would take care of the issues.  Well....it is out last night here. The mini bar was not fully restocked yesterday, nor today.  On our way out to dinner this evening I asked the building concierge to have this taken care of.  After dinner we found it had not been nor was there any turndown service this evening.  Very frustrating.

The buffet restaurants are good for breakfast, OK for lunch, and pretty terrible for dinner.  The HG poolside snack bar at The Reserve was great for lunch.  The all carte restaurants Fuego and The Grill were good.  We didn't really love Aqua.

The trolley system is good and comes frequently.  This was our first time to the DR and with so many other placed I could not recommend The a Reserve at Paradesius Punta Cana.  Surprisingly Royal Service, which is a separate group of buildings, would have been less expensive than The Reserve.  We chose a The Reserve based upon recommendations of others and while the room was fine service was lacking.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Un Royal Service deficiente y con cucarachas.
reviews.text:
Despues de 17 dias de vacacionar en el hotel Paradisus Palma Real de Playa Bavaro regresamos a nuestro hogar. Decidimos esperar unos dias antes de escribir este comentario para poder decantar adecuadamente nuestras reflexiones sobre nuestras vacaciones. 
Este fue el tercer enero seguido (2014, 2015 y 2016) que nos alojamos en el Paradisus Palma Real en el Royal Service.
A diferencia de nuestras dos estancias anteriores, esta fue deficiente y decepcionante.
El Paradisus Palma Real tiene muy buenas instalaciones y un staff  que, en su gran mayoria, dan dia a dia lo mejor de si. Lo que FALLA (basando nuestra opinion en la experiencia que hemos vivido recientemente y que comparamos con las dos estancias previas), es LA GERENCIA, salvo algunas excepciones. 

Un Royal Service con cucarachas y con una gerencia debil.

El Royal Service es el producto premium del Paradisus Palma Real. Su costo es de alrededor de 500 dolares por pareja, pero puede ser aun mayor dependiendo del tipo de habitacion y de la ubicacion de las mismas. 
Durante  las estancias de 2014 y 2015 nuestra experiencia (basada en el tipo de servicio que recibimos) fue muy superior a la de 2016. 
En esta ultima oportunidad encontramos cucarachas vivas en dos ocasiones en el restaurante Palazzo (el mas exclusivo que tiene el Hotel para sus pasajeros del Royal Service) en el sector de la comida a la hora del desayuno. En las dos ocasiones se lo reportamos al encargado para que pudiese constatar nuestro hallazgo.
Y en una oportunidad, encontramos una cucaracha muerta  en nuestra habitacion (3007) en el exclusivo sector del Royal Service. Esta ultima fue reportada a la mucama quien constato la existencia de la misma.
Estos 3 desagradables hallazgos de cucarachas muertas y vivas fueron reportados, asimismo, a nuestro mayordomo y a la gerencia del Royal Service, al Director de Alimentos y Bebidas  y al Managing Director. La respuesta que recibimos de parte de la gerencia del Royal Service fue decepcionante.

Otras deficiencias.

La mayor debilidad reside en la debil gerencia del Royal Service. Pero no es la unica. 
A ella hay que sumar una larga lista de deficiencias adicionales: 1) un internet de muy baja velocidad que incluso en determinados horarios se vuelve imposible de utilizar; 2) dificultad para conseguir alimentos basicos de manera regular como helado de chocolate o carne de calidad (entre ella picania) o agua Perrier (sustituida por Club Soda) en varios de los restaurants como el Naos (dificultades que luego se fueron solucionando gracias al apoyo de parte del Staff y de ciertos gerentes como David); 3) deficiencia para que repongan diariamente el frigobar (obligando al cliente a tener que llamar frecuentemente); 4) falta de mosquitero en la ventana-puerta que da acceso al balcon de la habitacion por lo cual ante cualquier descuido ingresan mosquitos y/o cucarachas a la habitacion; 4) falta absoluta de innovacion en los menues de los principals restaurants incluido el exclusivo Palazzo cuyo menu es basicamente el msimo de anios anteriores; 5) falta de renovacion de las habitaciones las cuales si bien son espaciosas (al menos la del Royal Service) siguen siendo igual a las de 2014; 6) entrenamiento deficiente de parte del personal; y un largo etcetera.

Nuestro reconocimiento a un grupo excepcional de profesionales.

Al Royal Service del hotel Paradisus Palma Real lo sigue salvando (parcialmente) un grupo de profesionales con la camiseta puesta que da dia a dia dan lo mejor para que el cliente tenga una muy buena experiencia durante su estadia, la mayoria de los cuales no forman parte de la gerencia

Deseamos expresar nuestro reconocimiento y agradecimiento a las siguientes personas: Pedro en el sector de Cabanas y Camas (un brillante professional que lleva mas de 15 anios de trabajar en el Paradisus y de cuyo profesionalismo y vocacion de servicio podrian y deberian aprender varios gerentes, empezando por la gerenta de Royal Serice); Gerardo Raposo (otro excelente professional siempre atento y dispuesto a ayudar y colaborar); a Wander; a los encargados de Rare y Vento; a Miguel Jimenez por su amabilidad y cordialidad en el Palazzo; a Richard y Ricardo en el Gym; y a David, el Director de Alimentos y Bebidas con quien conversamos en un par de oportunidades sobre nuestra decepcionante experiencia y con quien compartimos muchas de nuestras frustraciones y recomendaciones.

Resumiendo.

En esta oportunidad, a diferencia de las dos anteriores, dejamos el Paradisus Palma Real con un sabor amargo y sin ganas de volver debido a los problemas y deficiencias que experimentamos.

Hacemos estas reflexiones con mucho pesar pero tambien con mucha franqueza. 
A diferencia del pasado, en esta oportunidad RECOMENDAMOS NO UTILIZAR el Royal Service del Paradisus Palma Real para sus vacaciones. Es un servicio muy caro (minimo de 500 dolares diarios por pareja) para recibir un servicio deficiente y decepcionante. Por esta suma de dinero hay mucha otras opciones en Playa Bavaro y Punta Cana, muy superiores a las que actualmente ofrece el Royal Service del Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: NJBetsy
reviews.title: NOT PARADISE: Disappointing week-long stay
reviews.text:
What an expensive let-down for my four sons (9, 14, 18, 21) my husband & I.  The positives: pretty beach, pretty grounds and several nice servers. We had two rooms and stayed for a week Dec 24-31. 

The first night we had a huge flood in our room due to a broken air-conditioner.  My boys complained for the first 3 nights that the hot water ran out after 1 shower. Eventually this happened in our room and I had a freezing cold shower that wasn't fixed until my husband went to the front desk with his displeasure.  Phone calls got you nowhere here.

The room is dated.  The shower is complicated to use. There is zero bathroom privacy as there are wooden spindles that do not block light.  Glass door on both shower and toilet. 

The absolute worst part of the trip was waiting at the concierge desk everyday for at least 45 minutes to get a reservation for that night's dinner, only to be told "nothing is available"  The system is a joke.  Reservations were offered at 6 pm or 9:45 or at buffets.  We NEVER were granted a time we wanted (anywhere from 7:30 until 8:30) and actually were turned away WITH a reservation.  We met several other unhappy families each morning at the concierge desk with similar complaints...no hot water, smelly room, no dinner reservation availability. 

The food is mediocre to poor.  The only option for breakfast AND lunch was the same buffet, so we had breakfast and lunch at the same place 15 times.  By dinner time, it was frustrating when our only option offered was yet another buffet!  The few restaurants we managed to get into were actually filled with empty tables, therefore nothing was ever FULL.  Having met other unhappy American travelers it became apparent that you could walk in and 20 dollars would get you a table.  Tables are actually held for this purpose.
