If I was a little less emotional maybe i could have gotten some consideration for all of the crap that went down. As it stands what i have is a wedding album that makes me cry every time i look at it and a husband who doesn't understand why looking terrible on my special day in a setting that was all wrong upsets me when all that matters to him is that we are man and wife. I don't know how to explain to him that i dreamed of this my entire life and poured endless hours of planning and heart into my vision for it. I just sniffle and smile at him because i was lucky enough to marry a man who didn't see a mess standing at the altar, just his bride.

reviews.author: Arielo0611
reviews.title: "Not a good choice"
reviews.text:
On August 1st we were celebrating our wedding anniversary and decided to go to Punta Cana, before we visited 2 diferents resorts. So far this one is the worst.
Even do we reserve with more than 3 months in advance and specially ask for a King bed for our room they gave us a two queen bed together that was a mess. We ask for a King size and they told us that the resort only have a few of them (5 stars resort??). Then the second night we have problems  with the shower hot water. We have to take a very cold shower. Later they send an employee to fix the problem. The last day we went to check-out to the Royal service lobby, Elizabeth told us that they p/u our luggage that morning when we let them know.
When we went to our room after breakfast we find out that our luggage was not there not even our personal handbags. ?? We have to run  to the luggage room,we need some personal items. Finally we find our items and we have to go back to our room to finish packing. When we were ready to leave to the Airport we encounter another big problem 2 of our luggage were sent to the airport with another guest.(??????) After an hour and a half they found our luggage in a Taxi that took the guest to the Airport. We almost lost our plane, have a lot of stress and even we have to pay our Taxi back to the Airport. The hotel don't even excuse for their mistake . Horrible. 
What we found  excellent was the food specially at the Martin Berasategui Passion restaurant,the Gabi Beach restaurant and the Palazzo. Waiters Osvaldo, Hose Silvainne, at the beach Pedro Cedano was outstanding. Luisaida , Elizabeth and Saray at the Royal Service were excellent too.
For being a "5 Stars hotel" a lot of improvement is required !!!!!!! 
Ariel and Isabel  Cabrera

reviews.author: Ken S
reviews.title: Cockroaches in room and on tables in restaurants
reviews.text: The facility and beach are beautiful.  Unfortunately, the restaurants, other than Vento and the Mexican restaurant  were horrible.   Everyone in the family got sick for at least four days.  In Bana Japanese restaurant, there were cockroaches on the serving tables.  I could have vomited.  There were also cockroaches in the rooms.  We've been to many All Inclusives.  If food is not a factor in your plan, definitely visit this resort.  But if food is important, this is not the place for you.

reviews.author: 7AMAR
reviews.title: Dining Reservations Nightmare
reviews.text:
The hotel was good and food was good but had an issue with our dining reservations every night! We had the VIP service but were never greeted by anyone. Went to guest services and gave the list for the whole week with 2 options for every night to make it easier. We were told the confirmation would be sent to our room which  never happened. Next day went at 5:00 to guest services they told us no confirmation yet to go to our rooms. Called at 5:30 no answer. Called the front desk got transferred to 8 different places were no one picked up. After 40 mins finally got the front desk to get someone from guest services on the phone and they told us our reservations were at 6.00 which meant we were already 10 mins late and we had to be there now or lose our reservations. We were a group of 10 with kids so it was very difficult to just pick up and go so we rushed out the best we could and got to the restaurant where we were told there was never a reservation! They finally came up with the solution of sending us to a restaurant in a different hotel (The Reserve). We get there the reservation is for 8 people not 10.... This is just an example of how our vacation went. I had to deal with some issue every night!! My nightmare would start at 5:00 at the guest services desk were I was well surrounded by other screaming guests with the same exact issues!!! And would have to hear the same lies that I had been already told over and over because to make it more aggravating not one thing I was told turned out to be true.

Very disappointing!!!!

reviews.author: Jamila C
reviews.title: Terrible Royal Service Reservation Staff
reviews.text:
I would love to give this hotel a 5 because it's extremely beautiful, however, because of the incompetence of the reservation staff, my trip started off on a sour note. 

When I got there, the reservation staff didn't make any reservation for me, even though I received a confirmation in April. I traveled from July 23-27. The representative I was stuck with, Astrid, was not helpful and at some points rude. She refused to accept that the staff screwed up and wanted to charge me more money for a larger room that I didn't ask for because the forgot to book the room I originally asked for. I asked for a manager and she refused to get one. No one else who was there could help. It was a mess. When the issue was finally resolved (not to my liking), I spent about 3 hours disputing with them. Of course I emailed the manager when I returned, but to no surprise, there was no response. Which basically reflects on why this staff is so incompetent. 

Moving on, the only perk I realized that the Royal Service package have is for the Palazzo restaurant, a pool that has no screaming kids, and top shelf liquor which is only given to you if you asked. We had a butler named Alvaro.  We rarely saw him, but he did do our reservations that we requested and brought fruits to the room. We actually received more help and attention from Franklin, who was not our butler, but way more attentive and sweet. If you get him, you are in good hands. 

The Palazzo had the best breakfast, lunch, and dinner. And it was the only place where wifi worked because it definitely did not work in the room. The waiters were all nice. Especially Hosse and Francis. It was the best perk about Royal Service. 

The bar by the adult pool had the best bartender in the hotel named Leonardo. Leonardo made my drinks with love and gave me a flower everyday. He was a real sweetheart and you would be good in his hands. My other favorite bartender, because he was so funny was Liony.  He was another sweetheart and made great drinks. 

The nightclub was something to do after hours. The DJ will play your requests, but do not expect any mixing. He'll play the song and walk away. Caesar was the bouncer for the club and excellent at his job. He's another great employee that was extremely helpful. 

I think the other best place besides the palazzo to eat was the lobster tails at the Gaby Beach Restaurant. Everyone who was working there was great and the Lobster tail was delicious. 

For the place to be so beautiful, the place lacks music. No music by the bar. No music by the pool.  Dominican Republic has a bunch of wonderful music and it was so bland during the day. Yes, adults would like to relax, but relaxing does not mean not having fun. 

I would love to recommend this place, however, I would not want anyone to go through the horrors of the reservation staff like I did.

reviews.author: Rebecca M
reviews.title: Beware and know what you're getting
reviews.text:
While the hotel is lovely there are many up charges and issues with check in. Our reservation with another Paradisus hotel was changed by the hotel 3 days before our arrival, and since the hotel names were so similar, we didn't realize we were put in a different resort--one much less nice than the one we reserved! We had to wait forever for our room, got put in a tiny room when we already paid extra for a larger suite. Had to wait again. They were very nice to give us the family concierge service for free when I complained. The food was mediocre but were able to make reservations through our concierge. Also, because of confusion and translation issues with transferring into a larger suite from a smaller one we reserved through RCI, we were given a discount verbally over the phone. We tried to get in writing but again, language barrier was an issue so we went with it and prepaid immediately. 
At check out they tried to charge us the same rate as the nicer hotel AND would not give us the 15% discount we were promised. Very disappointing. We are still working with the credit card company to recover funds, months later. BEWARE and know what you're supposed to get or you will get taken advantage of.

reviews.author: C Q
reviews.title: impressive setting let down by inefficient management
reviews.text: A veautiful lication and stunning buildings on the surface, the Palma Paradisus resort suffers from piirly irganized and traibed staff. The staff are unflaggingly cheerful and eager to help,  but they have not geen provided the training or freedom  to improve a very inefficient and frustrating system.  Restaurant reservations are a complete fiasco, but required for the most desirable dining options. Every time we requested one, ut was recorded in a nitebook and we were informed it would be taken care if. Not once did we get a scheduled time within 90 minutes of our request. And usually we were not notified. Once we were notufued at 6:30 pm that our requested reservation was set at 6:00 pm. What? They have computers but thus process is apparently done by phone with no one overseeing the process at either end.

reviews.author: Tara R
reviews.title: Paradisus Real
reviews.text: Such a beautiful resort and the staff is so friendly.. but beware, customer service is terrible, and if you book a reservation through Melia that claims to offer resort credit and free transfers to and from airport.. also beware.  We arrived and the transport company Melia told us to use would not take us to the hotel because Melia had not made the reservation for us. We had to pay ourselves for a taxi.  Once arriving at Paradisus and explaining the issue at check-in , we were told we would have to call the 1-800 # and speak directly to Melia to get it resolved.  After 3 days, we finally received confirmation they would take us back to airport at the end of our trip but that they would not reimburse us for our expense to get there.  The family we travelled with who booked under this same promotions deal, were less fortunate.  They spoke with Melia several times during the week and promised to be emailed travel vouchers, but it never happened.   In addition, if you do not upgrade to the royal service or stay at the Reserve (both cost a good bit more), you will have a terrible experience making restaurant reservations.   Without that upgrade, you can not put your request for time and restaurant in til 9am the same day, and do not receive a confirmed reservation til , they claim 4:00 pm; however, we as well as several other families hovered around the concierge desk until as late as 6:30 on some evenings, still awaiting restaurant confirmations and times.  Out of the 6 nights we were there, we only got the restaurant request we asked for the very last night... and this was just because we were so frustrated by night #6 that we we elevated the issue to the concierge & basically refused to leave the desk until a manger was called on our behalf.   The communication and customer service here on a scale from 1-5 is a "1".   The amenities of the resort are a "5" on scale from 1-5.   The servers at all restaurants are very gracious & friendly.   Just beware, customer service or lack of will be extremely frustrating so evaluate the cost of this place after you add the "royal service" additional cost in to the price & if you have children as we did, royal service is not an option.  You would have to stay at the Reserve to get same service.. also more expensive & further away from the beach.

reviews.author: kuhristea
reviews.title: This isnt for people who enjoy the REAL carribean.
reviews.text:
Ok- so i will be as open, kind, and fair is possible.

Arrival: We stayed in royal services, mainly because we read this is where you have the best attention and the better trip. So when we first got into the hotel, we were brought to their specific part of the resort and given our paper work and armbands. FYI- they need to put a 500 (US)$ hold on your credit card upon arrival. This was no problem for us, but for some of the younger couples- it might be, i thought that was important to know. After that we were introduced to our Butler: Jonfi (i apologize if i misspelled his name). He was great, sweet, nice, and always available. AS he showed us around the grounds, we went back to the room and thats when my inspection began. Our bedskirt had liquid or something all over one side, when i flipped our sheets back our mattress had something smeared all over the foot portion, the shower had "jets" put half were missing caps, and the other ones did work. We decided we would let some of these little things go... after all we were on vacation. So, we thought we would turn some music on while we got ready: the CD player doesnt work, the coffee pot never brewed, the scale in the bathroom didnt even turn on- ultimately, i think non of the electronics worked. We get ready to go walk the resort, we have some food at Market- which was pretty ok, we enjoy part of the 80's show- which was actually nice to see everyone dance. A rain storm comes in- not unusual in this part of the carribean, so my husband and i are rushing up 3 flights of marble stairs to our room, and he slips and falls- busting his eyebrow open on the step. I, as a seasoned nurse, take him back to the room, clot his head and preform any necessary neuro checks i've got. He needed stitches, but -we- have never been to this country, did not know ANYTHING about travel insurance- SO BUY IT, BUY IT, BUY IT! The next day, he as serious swelling and bruising- none of which is too concerning to me, as again, i am a seasoned nurse. I know we need ice and to keep his wound clean, his TD is uptodate! Our butler arranges for us to go to the pharmacy, from there to the clinic- where they want to charge 125$ for her (i assume this was supposed to be a doctor?), to POKE him in the eye, rub one hand across his head to check for the abrasions i told her about, and to walk out of the room. It was INSANE. All the while this is our 2nd day, and this entire day is spent being shuffled and talked about in spanish by a lot of the staff in the clinic. I had had enough, and finally called my mom back in the US, who is fluent, and asked for help, as i am talking to my mom asking her to speak spanish because i understand everything they are saying here, i just cant talk back in spanish i hear the smirks and rude remarks stop- for the time being. It sickens me. So so far- you need travel insurance, and ifyou speak the language- you are already 10 steps ahead. After having enough, i called a doctor back in the states and got all the information and treatment i needed to last us through our trip. Upon arrival back to the hotel- the assistant manger (i wished i could remember his name), was great. He asked what happened, why we didnt call for help (again because i know nothing about the country and i am a nurse!), and he brought us majority of the supplies i needed to doctor his eye. So a full day wasted with the run around- we went to dinner Plazzo- amazing service, and quality of food. We needed this after a long day! 

Side note: I think it's weird you have to call your butler everytime you need ice, this is just one of those things that would be nice to have access to when you need it. In our case- we needed it a lot to ice the wound. However, Johnfi was always there to bring the ice when we needed it. 

Day #3- our first day to really be able to go to the beach and enjoy, we got talked into doing the club melia- DONT WAST YOUR TIME. After 2hrs, and being offered membership for 126,000- this is HOUSE in texas! We were finally able to enjoy the beach. IT was funny, we met some couples who went on the same tour and were offered membership for 15-20,000. We were screwed so i am so glad we didnt join. We ate at Market, which they  turn into steak and lobster in the evening this night, it is NOT kidfree. We sat next to a trouble full of at least 8 kids having food fights and screaming. I LOVE kids- we have an 8 year old, but when we go on an adult trip, we really enjoy " adult" time. I didnt let it bother me too much, as we knew that kids were allowed on certain areas of the property. So we sucked it up. Food was great- our server was willie this night. My husbands lobster came out a little "weird", so he took it back and brought us 3 more- wonderful! 

Day #4- we went on an excursion with BLUTRAVEL- never do it. They are theif's! My Galaxy s4 was stolen right off the bus, and i got the run around. I pleaded my heart out and just cried- all my memories on that phone. I could care less about the phone, i work hard for my thing and i will work hard to replace it- but i cant replace my pictures. Needless to say, that is why i can not post the great and the bad and it stinks. It is truly one of the most disgusting things that has ever happened to me and i feel violated. After endless searching and pleading with "Merley" the tour guide- we got no where. Our phone company said we should file a police report- this is a joke. We got to the service desk, she was the rudest person i have ever dealt with- cold hearted. She too was laughing and talking rude in spanish- sometime i just wished people would understand- i may not SPEAK this language, but i can understand a lot of spanish a s my mom is mexican. I had enough and was so defeated- we just wanted to go home. She informed us if we wanted to file a report- we would have to wait 45 days, have our travel agent show up, get a date, and then go back for the report. Um...wthell? At this point we quit. There was no point in asking for any help with anything..... 

Day #5- we had planned to go on dune buggies- but after the past days we had, luck just wasnt in our favor and we trusted NO ONE. This one was with VIP tours, i have no review for them because blu made it so bad. We spent the day laying on the beach, counting down the hours until we could finally go home. We finally met some people from TEXAS- thank you Lord! and we were able to have a better, last night. 

Day #6- they came to get our bags on schedule, we turned in our stuff and WE HEADED TO THE AIRPORT!! Hallelujah!!!! I have never been so thankful to be back in USA. I will NEVER go to any part of the D.R again! 

This resport was full of European 40+ travelers and families (which is no problem), i was looking for a younger crowd for my husband and i's sake. The food was pretty good actually, i could see after 5 days how the same food may get redundant- but i really enjoyed it and ate nothing bad. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from, we never could because our trip was so terrible. The nightlife- eh, if you are looking for one- travel with a group and make one yourself. Beach service- NONE. Resort staff is pretty nice. Huge thank you to Johnfi & Luisa- best set of people i have ever met.  Always happy, charismatic, and willing to extend an extra hand. 

WAYYY TOO MUCH MONEY for what it's worth. I've heard so many people complement this beach as being a beautiful carribean sea, however- i now know that none of these travelers have seen a true carribean blue see, dont waste your money- GO TO SANDALS MONTEGO BAY and you will see the WORLD class difference in every aspect. It was my choice to go to punta cana this year instead of jamaica because i wanted to try something new- biggest mistake ive made and it cost us greatly. 

Hope this was half way helpful- needless to say, dont wast your money, it not a carribean blue sea, and it's not worth it. 

If anyone finds my phone, id love to have it back!  You broke my heart Punta Cana, "Merley", blu travel and i am SO disgusted that you violated me and stole from me in your own country. I trusted your company and it makes me SICK. Those were all my memories- all my at home memories, my childs pictures and you stole them. This company is sickening and i have no words. Have a heart and give me my phone or AT LEAST my pictures back. Gross!

reviews.author: Iliana Leafy
reviews.title: Nada del otro mundo
reviews.text: Mi nombre es iliana es mi 7mo viaje a punta cana pague caro para ir al paradisus y nada comparable precio calidad. La comina en los buffet muy mala , poco variada y a veces poca todo se terminaba ,la limpieza de los cuartos pesima ,mi shawer tenia mugre y la puerta rota ,cogi un cuarto con jacuzi y no la pude usar estaba muy sucia en tres ocaciones venian a limpiar el cuarto a las 6pm cuando llegabamos al cuarto cansada.Fuimos con el programa my time y nos vendieron el paquete con bebida premiun y cuando llegamos al hotel habia que pagar la bebida premiun.Los restaurantes a la carta muy buenos ,los muchachos de animacion exelentes .El trencito muy demorado .conclusiones no lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: Leslie S
reviews.title: Ineffective staff
reviews.text: Most requests for help or service never materialized over the 7 days of our trip.  Reported a glass, full sz door was hanging by 1 screw when we arrived. Was still that way when we left. Maids were often out of towels for the rooms. My purse was stolen from the bridal suite. Was promised to be secure to store things until after the reception and that we bridesmaids had the only key. Key was changed to let maintenance replace mirrors and to fill the wet bar!  We bridesmaids were the only ones who couldn't get in at the end of the night to get our stuff!  Had to go to the front desk for a new key.  The hotel did almost nothing and then refused to take responsibility for the theft. When we were back in the USA they emailed a voucher for a stay at . . . The most stressful, inefficient, overpriced and least restful hotel we had ever been to. I just wanted the iPhone, watch and money they invited a thief to steal, or at least an offer of replacement or a voucher for the price of the stay we already had there. We will not be going back. The Voucher is useless!

reviews.author: Sightseer107467
reviews.title: Unhappy Visitor
reviews.text: This place is gorgeous and you think you are going into Paradise and then you go to the Paradisus Palma Real.  From the time you arrive and want to make dinner reservations for the entire stay you are given a lot of nonsense.  They only let you make one reservation per day and it is not always when you want to go but when they fit you in.

reviews.author: adollinger
reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: The reviews about this Resort were less than accurate.  The food was some of the worst I have encountered at a "5 star resort," and the whole place was antiquated.  The bathrooms in the suites have glass doors, so privacy in unavailable.  Electrician's tape was abundant in the wiring behind the bed where all the plugs and master fuse were located.  And room service was regularly taking upwards of an hour for simple orders on non-busy times.  Will NOT be returning, and suggest you find other options if the D.R. is a must-visit destination.

reviews.author: Stephanie M
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real Experience
reviews.text:
The Hotel at first glance was pretty.  The pool and ocean was warm.  There were beer cans in the ocean.  We were only allowed to stay in one area on the beach because bracelet colors.  We were told we had to pay more to sit on the other sides.  The food was average at best.  Room service was terrible.
The cost was expensive for poor service and food.  Will not be going back.

reviews.author: Ross T
reviews.title: Over rated!
reviews.text: Watch out for perpetual disappointment and frustration at this hotel. The Paradisus brand has been good but this year's experience at this hotel has not been the opposite. First the positive points: the rooms are good and in general quiet, so one can get a good night's sleep. The property grounds are well groomed and the pool area clean by the morning. However, the main disappointments are: i) the limited (reduced) number of restaurants and those that are al a carte seem to be able to take only a limited number of guests. Securing a table at a specific time in a restaurant of choice is chaotic and simply soaks up too many hours of the vacation time we want to spend relaxing, and ii) the internet is 'spotty' at best making it hard to keep in contact with business or family. The staff are helpless - they all promise a solution but the solutions are never found. Give this hotel a miss!

reviews.author: Cat-Stones
reviews.title: Treated Horribly until we paid for  Royal Service
reviews.text:
I have always read reviews on tripadvisor and wondered how anyone could be so unhappy with a hotel, when they were surrounded by paradise. We have been to six different all inclusive resorts and always been happy!! With that being said here is my first complaint on tripadvisor...

There were four in our party and we arrived at the Paradisus on a Friday. After checking in and getting our green bands we were taken on a tiny tour of the resort. We were quickly told that we weren't allowed to eat at three of the restaurants and that the royal service was a much better option. We figured our group was pretty laid back and didn't need to upgrade. We are the kind of people where you give us a pool, drinks, and the ocean, we are happy. However, because I had read the reviews prior, I knew we needed to make reservations right away. We went to the guest service table and was glared at by the lady at the desk, she motioned for us to sit down in front a gentlemen who was on the phone. She was not going to help us. After waiting 10 minutes the man was still on the phone, another couple came over and was begrudgingly helped by the lady at the desk, even though we had been waiting. She finally finished with them and decided to help us make one reservation at the Thai place. we tried to make more for the next nights but she said we would have to do that the next day. Ok great, let it go, she is just cranky. In the meantime my husband and friend go to the lobby bar for a beer. They ask for a beer and are told you have to wait 20 minutes to have one.  A minute later a guy walked up and asked for a beer and was handed one immediately.  Again, shake it off, we are on vacation, we let it go. 
We get to our room, double beds. Not a huge deal, but it would be nice to have the king bed we booked. We go to the pool. Bar tenders are nice but not a great drink selection.  Kids are splashing us and hanging out all over the swim up bar. We are starting to get a little annoyed at this point. We go to dinner and want to order an appetizer first while we figure out what we want for a meal. We are rudely told we are not allowed to do this. There are prices next to the wine, even the Woodbridge is $30. So much for the all inclusive aspect. We are extremely frustrated at this point. The next morning We go to the front desk and ask what the difference is with the royal service and ask if we will be treated more kindly. We don't really feel like we should have to pay more money for people to be nice to us, but we are on vacation and don't want to dwell on it. We are told we have hotel vouchers and if we use those it will be $250 to upgrade for the rest of our trip. We also ask to talk with the manager. We set an appointment and speak with Domingo about an hour later, more vacation time wasted. We tell him we are disappointed with the service and how we have wasted a day of our vacation dealing with this. He does nothing to help, but he does listen somewhat.  We go to the counter to upgrade and he walks to the counter with us. He stands there, and then the front desk lady says it will be $350. We are dumbfounded! We were clearly told earlier in the morning it would be $250. We are beyond upset at this point. Domingo looks at us like we are crazy. I ask to speak to the lady we spoke to in the morning so she can tell him what she told us. They just keep calculating numbers. I don't care what you are punching in your calculator, we were told a different price, treated terribly on three separate occasions,
didn't have the room we booked, and now you are going to argue
with us on the price we were quoted by YOUR staff. The VERY LEAST you could do is give us the price we were quoted. So after 15 more minutes wasted arguing, we are finally told our room will be ready later that afternoon and we will be charged the $250. We ask for 3rd floor and are told the hotel is completely booked. Funny because later on in the trip our butler tells is that they aren't and it's a pretty slow time.  We have now wasted a full day and a half dealing with this mess. Now to the good parts...

Royal Service was a different world. Francisco had our chair ready every morning by the pool and Leonardo makes the most delicious drinks! Both these guys went out of their way to make sure we had an excellent trip!! I can't say enough great things about the quality of service they provided us!

Our room service experience was wonderful also.  Fernando, Frankie, Jonathan and Jose, were so attentive and went over and beyond. Management needs to take a page out of these guys books because they actually know how to make people feel welcome and appreciated. 

We didn't let all the negative parts ruin our trip. However, vacation time is valuable to us and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. The way we were treated  is unacceptable regardless of what color bands were on our wrist. I will go out of my way to not stay at a Meila hotel. The staff tells you that you are treated better with the gold bands, they are rude if you don't have one, and management does nothing to remedy the situation. This could have been handled correctly by Domingo, but it was not! We had a great time and I am sure if we had started with the royal service it would have been different. I however feel that regardless of what part of the hotel you stay in, you should be treated with respect.

reviews.author: Elvis K
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: I am two nights into a 5 day stay and have been thoroughly underwhelmed. The service has been extremely lacking.  First, the in room WiFi did not work for two nights. I called and was promised a techniciann would come out no less than 4 times. Each time I waited in the room and no one came. Half way thru the 3 day a tech came and found a bad router in our building. This was supposed to be a working vacation for us and now we are way behind. This housekeeping staff has also been sub par. After the first night we found stains that appeared to be blood on the floor and the hand towels were not replaced. At 1600 on day three, I came back to the rooms to take a nap before dinner and the beds are stripped but not remade. Overall the staff seems to be inattentive with no sense of ownership.  As far as the rooms, they are decent, any lack of accommodations could definitely be overcome with good service. Unfortunately, that has not been our experience. The only exceptions to poor service has been Franklin at Gabi Beach restaurant and Francisco our beach attendant. We are currently staying in 3737 and 3738 paying $900 per night and we feel like we are constantly being ignored. We will not stay here again.

reviews.author: Tina T
reviews.title: Beautiful but just mediocre at best
reviews.text: We had a family reunion here. Nice place, nice rooms but incredibly disorganized. Several times our room wasn't made up or they'd forget towels or water. The dinner reservation situation is a disaster. You can only make reservations at the concierge desk between 9-5 but they won't tell you the time you get until after 5. So time isn't really a choice. Would not come back.

reviews.author: gabriel s
reviews.title: Aspectos por mejorar
reviews.text: Soy visitante frecuente del Hotel, y en esta oportunidad debo mencionar lo bueno y lo malo: LO BUENO: indiscutiblemente son sus empleados, hacen un esfuerzo inmejorable en la atencion al huesped superando mis espectativas, seria injusto no dejar de mencionar a Hipolito Cedano, a todo el personal del Gabi Beach ( mi restaurant preferido ). Considero que todo el personal, es el verdadero motor de este Hotel, ya que en esta oportunidad mi opinion hubiera sido mala. LO MALO: la comunicacion por medio de internet es malisima, manteniendose este problema hace mas de un anio, por lo tanto no hay excusa  por no haberlo resuelto, ni tampoco podrian argumentar remodelacion del Market Grill, ya que este inconveniente es anterior. Por otro lado los eventos privados que se realizan reiteradas veces en el area exclusiva de socios melia, ya que impiden el paso en esa zona y el acceso al bar sunrise, incluso con el riesgo de lastimar a personas, ya que al preparar estos eventos, dejan elementos en el piso, desde carretilla hasta cristaleria, todo esto a tres metros de la piscina, y en el horario de 16 hs.

reviews.author: Richard S
reviews.title: Why the reservations for dinner?
reviews.text: We ate at the same place three times because they told us there were no reservations available for the nicer restaurants.  Those same nights we walked by these places and there were plenty of open tables.

reviews.author: Juan T
reviews.title: Not as good as expected
reviews.text: The hotel is not bad, but we expected much more from it. Wifi access was only available in the main lobby. Food was average. Booking a restaurant for dinner takes multiple calls, requests, etc and many times you cannot make it, so you end up eating at the buffet. People are nice, and the beach is beatiful, but this is far from being one of the best hotels in Punta Cana. A lot to be improved on cleanliness and customer service. Next time I will definitelly look for another hotel.

reviews.author: Jeannine S
reviews.title: Very High Expectations but was disappointed
reviews.text: I planned this 25 person trip for my best friends 50th birthday Celebration.  She trusted my opinion and decided on the Paradisus rather than AM Resort or the HardRock. Two restaurants were closed.  We were not told in advance. The casino was closed. We were not told in advance and the weekly beach party which I had raved about was cancelled and the ajacent restaturant Gabi Beach was closed for a private function.  The food choices were horrible.  This was my second time here and it will be  my last. There are too many other places in the DR and the world to experience

reviews.author: Aracelis R
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Stayed for 6 days first it took half hour to check in,second they assigned me to a Room that was already occupied by other guests,if it wasn't for the maid I would had walked in on other guests,then it took like an hour to get another room,they upgraded me to VIP but it didn't make no difference,food was OK,service was poor and I was tipping anywhere from $3.00 to $5.00 per service but I guess that wasn't enough.For $350.00 a night I expected more,although the Resort is a Beautiful Place,but it LACKS of Good Service and Good Entertainment and also Good Food,unfortunately I can't say that I would return to this specific Resort.

reviews.author: saml01
reviews.title: To many things went wrong.
reviews.text:
The main buffet and one a la carte restaurant burned down approximately 1 month ago, we were never told or warned prior to our arrival.  The new buffet, situated either in the large conference room or the theater and moved daily was all prepared ahead of time. Based on their website they claims they offer "extensive dining" and "fine dining". Sadly it was anything but, all the food was prepared ahead of time and offered very little variety and much of the time it was not edible. Everything was presented in cafeteria style heating trays like you would find at a cheap buffet. The result was either something that looked cold or just did not look appetizing because of how long it would sit out before being refreshed. Furthermore, things like cheeses, deli meats and fruits which should be cooled looked awful after sitting out in ambient air. A lot of the time we could clearly tell lunch items were recycled for dinner with the additional of one special item.

Because the main buffet was closed they did not have enough room to sit everyone so sometimes we actually had to wait to get seated at the buffet. When we finally did get a seat we often times sat with strangers because they did not have enough private table. Due to the lack of seating the wait staff was eager to grab at your plate while you were still sitting in hopes of getting you out faster. Every dining experience at the buffet felt rushed, especially in the earlier evening hours.

Electricity was off periodically during our 6 night stay. We learned that when the power is off there is no running water either. This happened several times throughout the day across 4 days. Times that affected us most included: 1 night when the AC shut off on a particularly hot night; 1 morning when we woke and were getting ready to go to breakfast and were unable to wash up or flush the toilet; 1 afternoon when all the hotels guests were by the pool and the public bathrooms were filthy and when we finally got into the restaurant that we wanted we ate half the dinner in the dark. No apologies made and we were always told it never happened before. However, we did find out from one of the waiters that the blackouts were common since the fire. 

Every time we went to reserve an a la carte restaurant we were always told they were booked. When we tried to make reservations in advance we were told that it would be possible for the next day only. When we would agree we were told every time to come back again after 3pm to confirm that a spot had opened up. If a spot did open the reservation was always for 9 or 9:30 at night. It seemed like the companies who were present with their employees received preferential treatment for a la carte restaurant reservations. Furthermore, the last two days of our stay we got mixed messages regarding the reservation policy, some people at the concierge desk told us that restaurants can be reserved for every day of the week in advance and some told us only 1 day at a time. 

The wait staff was impolite and careless. The buffet staff would regularly forget to bring the drinks we asked for and if they did they would take upwards of 20 minutes. We watched a waiter drop a wine glass from a nearby table and did not even bother to clean up the glass shards from the floor. When we did get into the Thai restaurant the waiter took forever to bring our order, forgot the things and then after he did bring our plates he literally tossed them in front of us. Then he brought deserts we never ordered and gave us an attitude when we tried to order something else. 

2/3 of resort is not accessible for regular guests, requiring royal service bracelets or club melia participation. This meant that only 1/3 of the beach and 1/3 of the pool was accessible to us. Besides the private buffet reserved for royal guests only which we didn't care about, every time we walked anywhere we had to walk around these special areas because normal guests were not allowed to walk through. Nasty security posted everywhere to remind you as well. 

Upon arrival we discovered that 2 restaurants on the premises are not all inclusive. One requires a 60 dollar per person cover charge and the other beach restaurant is for club melia guests only. The neighbor resort, the reserve, has additional restaurants but they were duplicates of the restaurants in our resort and given that one restaurant burned down reservations became a commodity. 

WiFi did not work in the rooms or by pool.

Room fridge was not restocked; we had to ask every day.

Towel at the pool not always available; Several times we were told that the laundry service did not deliver fresh towels.

Since the buffet was held in the conference room, all private parties were held in the theater therefore all the shows which we expected to be on stage wound up being outside. One night there was no party so we finally had a theater show. 

We voiced our concerns to the front desk people and even mentioned them to employees on the ground but they really could not do much about the facts. In the end, I don't blame them because really what could they do about the power or the buffet, though half the time I felt they didn't understand us anyway. After a while we just gave up on complaining as it was beginning to upset us even more.

This place was terrible, and what made it worse was that it was our first vacation in 3 years. This is the second time we got burned in DR. Suffice it to say we are never coming back to this country.

reviews.author: George S
reviews.title: Over booked us and then overcharged us
reviews.text: We were booked at the Paradisus Punta Cana, they overbooked and sent us to the Real, which they kept telling us it was better, only after I paid 650 to upgrade to the royal, without the Ocean view I originally booked and not outdoor spa like I originally booked. It took over 3 hours to get checked in with everyone uttering "it's my pleasure" after not getting the answers I needed. The WiFi barely worked as advertised, the service was slow at the bars so you had to wait very long to get your drinks and on the beach if you ordered from a waiter you would die of thirst. If you don't tip someone for slow service you will never see that person again.

reviews.author: BirTurk
reviews.title: Overstaffed!
reviews.text:
I will be frank on my comments knowing that GM Rafael Torres only responds to excellent rated comments. This resort is part of Spanish owned Melia Group and it's their most outstanding resort in the island. However, it's overstaffed and the resort will still run effectively if you cut the personnel in half!
We did not pick Royal Service, so I cannot judge the treatment most people are happy with it. But our first impression was horrible. The room they gave us smelled humidity and heavy mold odor the moment we stepped in. It was a first floor room and the shower drainage was also clogged. The clerk in the front office told us due to a wedding, all upper floor rooms were full, but they were only able to switch our room the next day afternoon which was a second floor and closer to the beach. I give full credit to Anthony Madrid at the front office. 
Our concierge AC was very helpful from the time we arrived till we leave. He was constantly checking our needs. Although we have requested late reservations like 7:30 or 8 pm at the restaurants he was able to book only at 6 or 6:30pm. We noticed that most people do their reservations and do not go there at all. So, from the second day we decided to go late to our reservations since they accept us as long as our names are on the list. A little corruption but won't hurt!
We are definitely beach people not pool. If it's an adult only property, we would have tried the pool. The beach was wonderful, and you can easily walk miles on the soft sand with warm water wetting your feet. However, the service to the beach was very poor and one can hardly find a waiter. Best to go to the pool bar, order and carry your own drinks. The beach has a blue flag - internationally recognized cleanliness; but every day at 5pm the flag and the other beach flag identifying the weather conditions were brought down and locked! Seems like there is a theft issue! Besides the guard leaves the watch tower and no one is watching the ocean but security. Oh yes! Plenty of security, everywhere on the beach. Sometimes neighboring resort guards meet at their borders and chat. Looks funny:)) 
Almost everyday there is a wedding at the time of the year we were there. The four days we were there, not a single day our beach chairs and tables were wiped or cleaned! The water bottles stayed under the same shade all the time and no one picked them up!
Market Grill meat and lobster are terrible. Meat was undercooked, lobster was very dry. Aqua and Mizu in the Reserve were better restaurants than like Bana  or Vento in PPR (Palma Real). Especially Aqua was impressive. We did not try Passion nor Gabi Beach since it was for Royal Guests. Palazzo for Royal guests was the most impressive (don't ask how we got into). The breakfast and luncheon buffets in the main dining hall was average but plenty of fruits. Seems like spraying the grounds don't work well, since there were a lot of flies all over the food, both in Market Grill and Main Buffet. Contrary to most comments, we had no upset stomach from the food.
The concept of Royal Service did not appeal to us. It clearly discriminates the people who are paying more for the butler and additional services where it should be open to everyone who is paying extra. Instead you are being identified with a different color wristband and for some people we have talked, it's humiliating.
The evening animation was nice so was the dancers. We didn't like the bazaar one night in the middle of hacienda since the vendors tripled their prices and once you say no, they come after you lowering their prices. Not good for a five star resort!
The gardens are beautiful and worth to walk around although in some places it identifies as Royal Service guests only! You can hardly see anyone walking and enjoying the gardens.
There is no consistency on the room cleaning either. One day there was no cleaning until 4pm. We have requested extra towels and moisturizing cream, it never showed up. We had to visit the front office to repeat our request. 
Beware of the Melia Club sales tactics. Don't even waste your time to listen the presentation.
If the question is would you be back to this resort, our answer is NO! It may be a world class resort but without running efficiently, my score is less than average.

reviews.author: Rosanne T
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana the beginning of June. Very disappointed to say the least. While the grounds are beautiful, try getting a reservation at one of the 3 restaurants available. While I understand there was a fire at the main restaurant and space was limited, the hotel made no effort to accommodate guests that were not one of the 4 weddings or 3 conventions taking place at that time. When I checked in I provided my Melia rewards card and asked if that gets me anything. The response was "Oh yes". What it got us was a room next to royal service. We were only able to get dinner reservations after 9:00 pm which is when the entertainment was taking place so we ended up eating most nights at the average buffet. I understand their sister resort, the Melia Caribe had wonderful restaurants which should have been offered to us due to the fire but was not. The venue for entertainment was below adequate. I actually came home 5 pounds less than when I left which is usually the opposite for me when I return from vacation. It was impossible to get a decent seat by the pool because of the large crowds from the weddings and conventions. On a good note, the beach was beautiful. That is about all I can say other than I cut up my Melia rewards card and will never go back to a Paradisus Resort. There are just way too many other resorts to compete with the over-priced Melia resorts.

reviews.author: Todd
reviews.title: Ignored by Butler and Inattention to detail
reviews.text:
We stayed in a room with the Royal Service. It initially seemed great with the private check-in, pool, and beach areas, but the inattention to detail and poor butler service made this a disappointing stay. Upon arrival our butler, Eduardo, informed us, “you do not need to do anything for yourself here. That is my job.” We soon found that not to be the case. He failed to carry out simple things that were included on the list of services, e.g., bringing a beach tote bag to our room (never done), arranging snorkeling (said it was too popular and didn't even attempt to arrange it), unpacking service (never done), booking spa appointments (completed but he booked the wrong treatments). He never informed us of the activities and amenities available to us and also did not inform us of dinner reservations he made. We contacted a receptionist at the Royal Service counter and she essentially laid the blame on us because we did not inform them in a timely manner of these problems. (We contacted them two days before departure because we wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt.) She then indicated a manager would contact us but that never happened.  As for the room, it was not very cleanly on arrival. Appliances were dirty and the telephones reeked of body odor.  The bed sheets and towels were rough and worn from repeated washings. The minibar and snacks were not replenished after the first day. As for the in-room dining we ordered on four separate occasions, it always arrived late, cold, without any condiments, and occasionally the wrong items were brought.  

On the plus side, the resort is very large and impressively built.  It provides a great atmosphere. Most of the staff are very friendly and speak English.  Francisco at the beach and pool was excellent. He was always friendly and provided attentive service. The private cabanas filled up quickly but they were also very nice. The restaurants were decent but the service was always great. Plazzo probably had the best food followed by Vento, sushi at Bento was not surprisingly disappointing, Passions was excellent in terms of service and food quality, though I'm not sure it will be worth the extra $60/person to most, Gabi beach was average, and the Market Grill was little more than glorified cafeteria food.  We did not eat at the main buffet save for the desserts, which were okay. 

While I think the average vacationer would find this resort very good, I had much higher expectations given the glowing reviews on

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Unhappy :(
reviews.text: This was our 3rd time to this resort in the past year and a half and it has always been outstanding to say the least.   This visit, however, wasn't at the level that we had been accustomed to.  I am a Club Member and could have chose to go to any of their resorts worldwide.  As a Club Melia member, I feel we should be kept up to date on any communications that may be happening at the resort where we booked our vacations.   When we arrived at the Palma Real Resort, we were told at check in that the Naos restaurant was closed due to reconstruction.   What we were not told was that it was closed due to a fire.   We heard from other guests that it burned down due to a fireworks display.  As a member, this would have been valuable information to have prior to arriving at the resort.   In addition, the location of the rooms that we requested ended up being right next to the construction at Naos and they started every morning at 8 am with the jackhammer and other banging, clanging equipment.   This was not told to us either at check in.   We were just told that we had very nice rooms with a great view.  Also, during our week stay, the casino was closed due to reconstruction.  Was not informed of that either, we had to hear that from the other guests.   I had received an email from Club Melia prior to my arrival informing me of the improvement to the culinary experience for the members and guests with the addition of Master Chef Martin Berasategui in the Passion restaurant.  With that being said, I would have thought as being a member, that we would have been informed of the Naos restaurant closing (fire) and also the closing of the casino.  We made an appt with the Sales Manager at Club Melia to hopefully go over some of our concerns.  We arrived at our scheduled time only to be surprised that he was busy with another customer and basically did not have time to meet with us.   Marie at Club Melia was able to arrange for us to meet with the Quality Team to discuss our frustrations and concerns.  To date, we have not heard back from them.    The service at the resort was not as it had been previously.   There were alot of little things that kept popping up that became an real annoyance.  Just to name a few, running out of juice glasses at breakfast, having to flag someone down to get coffee, running out of butter, etc.   Our mini bar was not stocked unless we called to advise them of it and we never received any snacks in our room like we had previously.   I could go on.   One of our biggest disappointments was not having Ramon Fuego at the pool bar.  Ramon made that area fun.  He is one of the best bartenders and should be where the majority of the people are.  We have always told our friends about our fun experiences at the pool bar but this time there is not much to say.   We did meet some awesome people though that i want to make sure not to forget. Servers/Bartenders--- Diego Gonzalez, Santo Imarrero, Jonathan Arias---you rock.   Rosa Abreu, bartender, you were amazing!!   Ramon Fuego (my friends/family) we love you!!   We do HOPE to see you back at the pool bar where you belong.  I also want to mention Francisco, Angel and Big Mac (Francisco).  They are all awesome!!! Great dance lessons, etc.   After all of our frustrations, I do want to say that this is a beautiful resort.  I hope with the frustrations and concerns that we shared with them,  will help to continue to make this resort better and better--more like it was in the past.

reviews.author: Carmina C
reviews.title: Beware the bait and switch
reviews.text: Our first room's safe was completely disconnected from the wall.  The second room's safe and wi-fi  didn't work, and took hours to repair.  No close access to elevators from the room (we never saw where the one was in our building, if there was one).  Room service took almost two hours the first night.  The mini-bar service was incomplete and infrequent, and always had to be requested.  Estrella Garcia, the manager, was amazing, as was our wonderful, attentive concierge, Franklin de la Cruz, but neither could help with the final problem, which was that no one told us that the resort credits for an upgrade expired in 24 hours, and when we were offered an upgrade for 250 and came back to pay, we were then told it was 750- that was the final straw for us. No one at check in told us that we had the credits, or that we needed to contact a different person for the credits,located in a different area of the resort. We spoke to a number of folks who also had the same issue regarding the resort credits. Each time we had an issue there were other equally upset patrons waiting in line with similar issues. Every step in the trip was an issue, including the transfers to and from the airport.  The sleep sofa was so bad we had to request a cot. If you didn't make reservations for many of the inclusive ala carte restaurants the first day you didn't get to eat there despite many empty tables.  Given this experience, I would not recommend this hotel, especially for the price we paid.

reviews.author: Rosemarie M
reviews.title: Food was Disgusting
reviews.text:
Everything about this hotel is top notch except the food.  There were nights at the buffet where the food was so bad we couldn't eat it.  Also the room service food was deplorable.  We left 2 days earlier than planned because we were starving!  The Market grill did not even have cheese to put on a hamburger or buns to fit the hamburgers, they gave us hoagie rolls.

This was my 2nd time at this hotel and I will not return.

reviews.author: Elizabeth D
reviews.title: Terrible Service, especially from the women
reviews.text:
I have traveled to many resorts and am very low maintenance.   I have never felt the need to write a bad review unti this experience.  Had it not been for the magnificent pool and beach I would have asked for a refund.   We stayed in a Garden View luxary suite.  It was clean which was great, but that was pretty much it.  Poor lighting, dark, and while it was spacious, the over-all feeling was "heavy" and uncomfortable.  

Making a reservation for dinner took such effort that I actually gave up after 2 attempts.  I stood waiting at the conceirge (the resort process) for 1 of the 4 staff members to ask if I needed help as they all seemed very busy talking with each other, one staff person dialing a number on speaker phone which kept getting a busy signal and she continually hung up and dialed again (this went on for 10 minutes while I waited and I had no idea at the time that this was the procedure to make a dinner reservation).  Finally someone asked me (in a way that made me feel like I was interrupting their day) if I needed help.  I said yes, I would like to make a dinner reservation.  They did not explain the process and asked me to write my name and room number down, when, where and what time and they would take care of it.  I left that exchange not feeling completly confident.  Needless to say my intuition was correct as that night I discovered the reservation was not called in.   The next day I went back to try again.  My initial experience was the same….mind you this was at 9 a.m., during an off-peak time.  This time I sat down and the young woman dialed a number on speaker and got a busy signal (I surmized that this was the process) this went on for 5 minutes as she hung up and redialed looking angry and annoid as she did it until she got an answer.  She then asked me when, where, how many and what time….just like that.  I told her Monday at 7 pm. for 2 people (this was saturday) and I kept hearing her say to the person on the phone in spanish that the reservation was for tomorrow.  I said, "excuse me, it's not for tomorrow it's for Monday".  She said, tomorrow is Monday and I said no, tomorrow is Sunday.  She never apologized, she looked irritated and made the adjustment, told me it was booked, hung up and walked away.  Just like that. 

I also inquired about a boat cruise and was told that no one was availble to talk with me at that moment, was asked for my room number and was told someone would call me in 30 minutes.  It never happened.  

The staff working in the resort gift shops were rude and unfriendly. 

I will never return to this resort.

reviews.author: Heidi D
reviews.title: Terrible Service at a Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real, Royal Service the first week of May 2014. My husband won the trip from the company he sells for. I am usually pretty laid back when it comes to traveling; I do not consider myself a picky person when it comes to food, service etc. but the “Cons” outweigh the “Pros” when it comes to this resort. Unfortunately, I do not think we would ever go back unless it was for another free trip. 
I will start with the Pros. The grounds are absolutely beautiful and very well kept by the staff. The beach is amazing and the view from our room breathtaking. We had the Royal Service Imperial Romance Ocean Front Whirlpool Suite, 2nd floor. 
Our butler Alvaro was awesome to work with. He helped with dinner reservations and was always available when needed. We were able to get reservations at every restaurant, and the food was good. Melvin at the Market Grill went out of his way to take care of our table one rainy afternoon when there was nothing else to do. He made sure our drinks were always full and brought out made to order guacamole for our table. We ate breakfast at the Palazzo every morning, and it was always delicious. The girl that greeted us every morning was very welcoming; I wish I would have got her name. She was one of the few that offered exceptional customer service

The Cons: 
Our shower did not have hot water during the week we were there. We had to take baths if we wanted hot water. Apparently there was an issue the staff was working on, but it was never fixed while we were there. 
The resort lost power several times during our stay. One night it was out during our dinner at the Market Grill, no one could see to order and we had to pull out our phones and use the flashlight just to see the menu. 
As a Royal Service guest, I do not feel the bar service was any better. There was not one bartender that stood out as being exceptional. There was talk around the resort that you must have money in your hand to get better service at the bar. I do not tip until the end of my stay and only to those that made the extra effort. The liquor seemed watered down; you are better off making your own drinks from the liquor in the rooms. We drank a lot of rum and cokes and a lot of Presidente. Disappointed that there was no Corona at this resort!
No one ever came to get our drink order while we were sitting in the Royal Service area of the beach. Again, maybe if we tipped first we would have had drink service? This seems backwards to me and shame on the staff if that’s the only way to get good service there. 
The lunch buffet was the same every day. We had friends that were not Royal Service so they could not eat at the Palazzo with us. We ended up at the Market Grill every day for lunch and got bored of the same food every day. Most of the time, we would have to ask to have coffee/water refilled.  At the buffets, several of the staff stood around and waited until we gestured that something was needed. For example: coffee/water refills.  I have been to other resort where you never needed to ask, it was there before it was needed. 
I was VERY upset with the girls that work in the resort gift shop. They were rude and not helpful at all. I was in the gift shop twice during our stay. Both times, the girls were gathered at the counter laughing and chatting with complete disregard to customers needing help. I stood at the jewelry counter for several minutes before finally walking to the front and asking for help from one of them.  They then started laughing, and chatting amongst themselves. Needless to say, I left without buying anything although I would have if I was treated differently. You are better off walking down the beach to the local vendors…they are more than happy to help you and are not rude in the process.

It’s unfortunate that such a beautiful place, with such great potential was so un-impressive when it comes to service. You only have one chance to impress a first time guest. Sorry, but we would never pay that kind of money for this level of service, regardless of how beautiful the grounds are. There are plenty of other resorts along that same stretch of beach that wouldn't have to go very far to provide better service than was provided to us by most of the staff at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: jballs1002
reviews.title: Disappointed- Minimal entertainment, extremely segregated with "packages" and hard to make dinner reservations
reviews.text:
We were highly disappointed with our stay at the Palma Real. There are several "packages" to choose from, which decides which pools and restaurants you can go to dinner to. Families, wedding parties, and royal service guests were all separated from the main stream regular guests, so it felt very segregated. Restaurants were so-so and many tasted the same. For example, they have 3 restaurants that are Asian cuisine. So you end up eating Asian food for half your stay. It was a joke trying to make reservations too- the 2nd day of our trip we were told that reservations were going to be made for the remainder of our trip and wouldn't have to worry about a thing. We were supposed to receive our dinner "tickets" under our room door once completed. Well, that never happened and when going back to the service desk to inquire about it to another employee- was told that they never received our requests and nothing had been done. We had to go back to the service desk at 3 pm each day and usually all of the restaurants were "booked solid" or closed for a special event. This was extremely frustrating. 

The resort had one extremely small (1-3 person jazz band or just DJ music in lobby area) night-time show in the evenings that lasted maybe 30 minutes. So, the entire resort cleared out completely by 8:30- 9 p.m. since there was nothing else to do, unless you budget to play in the Casino every single night. 

We were bored by the middle of our 7 day trip and just wanted to come back home.

reviews.author: Brownmo14
reviews.title: Still on my honeymoon and counting the days until I get out of here
reviews.text:
Still here and writing a review...
Day one
Our reservation was at the reserve, or so we thought. The shuttle driver dropped us off at the paradisus Palma real. Went to check in and they didn't have our reservation and directed is back to the reserve. Get driven on a golf cart to the reserve, where they tell us that our reservation is at the paradisus Palma real. We finally get to the right desk at the paradisus Palma real, when the woman asks for a credit card to pay for the all inclusive fees. I showed her the email (that I printed out before I left- thank god!) and she informs me that I should not have prepaid and the hotel doesn't do that. She was not sure why I was emailed to get prepayment. Anyway, a whole 4 hours after landing we make it to our room. Loosing an entire day because the people at this  hotel DO NOT have a clue of commonsense. They may be very nice, but will NOT go out if their way to help. We tried to get a late lunch/ early dinner only to find that you need reservations for dinner and only one of the two lunch places were open. So we grabbed some quick food at the one place that was open and went back to the check in desk to make reservations. We ended up making reservations at a hibachi place for that evening and the rest of the week. The hibachi food/ menu was good and typical hibachi. The guys working the grill were charming and funny. We didn't feel like joining
In the dancing festivities so late, plus we were Exhausted so we just went to bed by 10pm. 

Day two
Started the day early at the pool. Bartenders were accommodating and cheerful. Moved to the beach early afternoon where there were still open cabanas. Tried to go to lunch, but yet again, only one of the two lunch spots was open. Same old resort buffet (ignore the flys) and it is only day two.  We went back to the room And thought we could salvage lunch by ordering room Service. Boy were we wrong! It's not that it wasn't edible. It was just I've never had food like that. The calzone was more like an empanadas, which are premade, so no customizing for food allergies. The pizza was made on a tortilla shell, that want too bad, a little salty tho. The only thing that I recognized was the Fruit platter of watermelon, cantaloupe and pineapple. Went back down to the beach and had a great rest of the afternoon. Came in from a long day of sunbathing to realize we didn't get our dinner reservation tickets for the week still! Go to the front desk and to talk with Heidwi and Patricia to find not all of my reservations have been made. What the heck, can something please go right? For dinner we had reservations for the Market grill. Our Server extremely friendly and the salad course was timely and rather Delish. But then we waited an hour ten for over cooked steak and undercooked lobster. Since I am pregnant and CANNOT eat raw or undercooked meat this was especially disturbing. We Left food not eaten on table, searched for another restaurant. We could not find another restaurant that could Accommodate and or we were underdressed. So hear we are night two on our honeymoon ordering room service and watching in room movies with subtitles.

Day three 
Started off with no running water. Called to alert he front desk where the woman that answered the phone, Patricia, hung up on me. Ordered room service breakfast and there were two small flies in the eggs. Absolutely disgusting. The only edible thing was the toast. Go to the pool and find our reserved cabana and lay our towels out. Decided then to head to the ocean for an hour or so. When we returned to the pool the cabana that had our name on it, to reserve it, no had someone else laying in it with someone else's name on it. None of the staff would help correct the issue and or find us a new cabana. After basically having a nervous breakdown because my honeymoon couldn't get any worse they found us a "new" cabana. Basically I am in a foreign country, no one can speak English and when there is a problem there is no one to help. Have 5 days left in hell. Definitely wouldn't tell my worst enemy to come here.

reviews.author: Martha C
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real, Never Again
reviews.text:
This resort has its cons and pros. Last year we stood at Melia, which was amazing! We ended up buying a timeshare so this year we decided to stay at the Paradisus since it's supposed to be an upgrade.

The resort itself is beautiful and well maintained. The food and drinks are good as well. We are Melia Club Members and didn't feel that we received any special treatment at Paradisus Palma Real as we did last year at Melia. We had a couple problems throughout our stay. 

First thing is that as club members we are guaranteed a bed by the pool. We were told we would have it the next day. When we arrived to the pool, of course we didn't have one. It took them a while to figure it out. The following day, we had the same problem. Second thing is that our concierge made our dinner reservations for the remainder of our stay. On the second to last night we were there, we went to the restaurant and they didn’t have us on their list. Luckily, there were a few tables empty so they were able to fit us. On our last night we didn’t end up having dinner until 10 pm because again, they didn’t have us on their list. We went to guest services and they couldn’t figure it out. When they tried looking me up by my room number, my name wasn’t even on their system. They had another family with a party of 6 in their system for our room. Another problem was room service. Every time we ordered room service, they screwed up the order. They never gave us our entire order. One of the times we were finished with room service, I called them so they could pick up the plates. After two hours of waiting, I decided to put the plates outside the room since it was late and we wanted to sleep. The next morning the plates were still there with a horrible smell since there was ceviche. We were also told that the servers were supposed to constantly come up to us by the pool to see if we wanted any drinks, we had to complain multiple times to get this type of service. It seemed that they only came around when we started tipping larger amounts and when they would come around they didn’t have our complete orders. We also thought that the hotel’s nightly entertainment was pretty boring. On our last day we bumped into our concierge and told him about all the problems, he looked like he could care less about anything. During checkout I also informed the receptionist and she didn’t seem to care either.

As I stated before, the resort is beautiful and the food and drinks are great. But I feel that for it being the Paradisus Palma Real, the service is horrible. Being a Melia Club Member, I expected better treatment was greatly disappointed. We will not be returning to the Paradisus Palma Real. Hands down, Melia gives you the treatment and service you deserve.

reviews.author: Dana1980159
reviews.title: Awful food
reviews.text: They had many restaurants but they were already booked before you arrived. So your options were a ten o'clock dinner or the Buffett every night that had the same food night after night. The staff making the reservations could care less if you ate or not. They barley spoke English and would lie to you just to make you think they were going to take care of any requests you had. They only carried one beer and much of the food tasted old or bland.

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Muchas oportunidades
reviews.text:
Nos hemos quedado en varios Melia ya que somos socios y sin duda alguna este es uno de los que tiene más oportunidades especialmente a nivel de servicio. 

Se supone que cuando estas en el club no tienes problemas con reservar sitio en la playa...pues todo lo contrario, hemos ido y no han tenido lugar para nosotros.. y hemos visto como solo le reservan a familias que les dan una "buena propina" por adelantado. 

En otros melia nos han asignado a una persona que se ocupe de hacer todas estas cosas... en este nos asignaron a un tal Frankelin que lo que ha hecho es tratar vendernos paquetes de excursiones que no queremos.... 

Muy lamentable esta situación ya que estamos pagando las anualidades de "los privilegios" del club Melia. 

Todavia seguimos aqui, esperemos que mejore.

reviews.author: javeria s
reviews.title: Paper thin walls!!!
reviews.text:
Hi 
This is out first time to the reserve at Paradisus. The resort itself is very beautiful and has lot to offer. 
I am here with my 19 month old who can not sleep due to constant noise from ouside.I can hear my neighbours talking and even moving around. Yes its that bad!. This is not fun. Despite all the luxury the noise level is too high to relax. 
I complained about this at the front desk and the girl just said oh im sorry. Thi is getting unbearable as my toddler is cranky all the time because she cant sleep properly. 
Please keep this thing in mind when booking this resort. Beside this we have no complains

reviews.author: paradisesxm
reviews.title: BEWARE! THEY'RE MONEY HUNGRY!!
reviews.text: This experience was surprisingly disappointing considering the money spent. As soon as we got there, they wanted to be paid immediately and pushed for it (i was told we could pay on the last day). On top of paying thousands in cash, we got charged 575 on our credit card without being advised of it when we were made to provide it for incidentals, so I demanded to be refunded. It took a week to get the money back. This all happened first day, 2nd day, we were told to go to a breakfast buffet at Gaby's Place and was taken there when later to find we were going to be pitched a presentation. We were "told" what to check off on the questionnaire and sat down before eating breakfast when we were starving. The presentation was supposed to be 90 mins, turned into FOUR hours, and we had our two yr old with us who never spent time with anyone but his parents. All of us were held hostage for 4 grewling hours when later to find out the Mgr of "MELIA" only cares about how much money you have, NOT your needs. Our concierge Luisa was wonderful but she scheduled many activities in advance and didn't tell us until the day of which was a slight inconvenience so we had to cancel many reservations. Do not get your nails done, the polish will chip off the next day, the food was terrible, i got food poisoning on the first night, don't eat at the dominican buffet. The best thing was the massage on the beach! We will not return again, this was a waste of 4500.00 for 5 days!

reviews.author: rmergent
reviews.title: Excellent Service from Starky, but most of the rest was just "O.K."
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort last week.  Starky Valoy was a bar tender, and I want to write an excellent review for him.  He was kind, responsive, and always looking to serve.  We don't drink alcohol and he was always so creative in making delicious drinks for us.  We appreciate his service.  He was excellent!

My other experiences were not as good though.  We were not able to have the Royal Service or stay on the reserve due to capacity constraints, so my review may be lower than others because of that.  Also, we had to ask for this and it was not even mentioned at check in--maybe because they were very full when we were there.  Our room was below expectations.  It was smaller and not as nice as the last all inclusive we stayed at in Tulum, Mexico.  The food was below my expectations, though there was a large variety of things.  Also, the service, aside from Starky, was sub par in part because we were not staying in the nicer parts of the resort.  Many times I felt like I was not able to communicate with the hotel workers due to the language barrier.  Further, we were blocked from even crossing parts of the hotel to get where we wanted.  This was annoying.  We weren't even trying to stay in the "Royal Service" places.  The main parts of the hotel were amazing though.  Also, the location is the best.  The beach is beautiful.  I guess I just expected to be treated better and to have better overall service (aside from Starky) given that I paid $3,600 to stay there.

reviews.author: Corey M
reviews.title: Not that good
reviews.text: The pool and the beach views were great.  The food was ok.  Service wasn't very good unless they talk you into buying one of their "time-shares".  I wouldn't recommend staying here unless you only want to hang out at the pool or beach.  The food and drinks were not very good.  We had to change rooms 3 times, the first time the room just wasn't ready although they told us it was, the 2nd time, there was a leak from the floor above.  The 3rd room was ok, but our king size bed was actually two full size beds pushed together.  For the price it isn't worth it.

reviews.author: Ronald H
reviews.title: Disappointing vacation
reviews.text: Room was in very poor condition--looked like in middle of remodel. TV never worked in master suite after having maintenance there 4-5 times. No hot water to shower one night. Dinner reservations hard to get.

reviews.author: Rafael  S
reviews.title: No me gustan los all Inclusive, pero quize tratar
reviews.text: Fui con esposa y dos hijos de 8 y 6, al decir la verdad, nunca me gustaron los hoteles todo incluido, pero este me pparecia que podia hacer la diferencia. LAs habitacione no son gran cosa, son bastante Standard, el servicio tambien Standard, el unico restaurante que valia la pena es el Gabi Club, comida bien realizada, pero nada especial, carta de vinos pequena y mas de la mitad de los vinos de la carta no estaban disponibles. Los ninos la pasaron muy bien, la playa muy buena y las piscinas tambien. Mi review es subjetiva, dado que no me gustan estos planes. probablemente a otros les encante.

reviews.author: 355amandaz
reviews.title: Don't come here if you are a light sleeper and early riser
reviews.text: We are staying in one of the family concierge suites in the Reserve. My son is just over a year old and wakes up very early.  My husband and I try to go to sleep early so we can enjoy our mornings together.  It is 11:30 PM and I am being kept awake by music blasting from one of the nightly shows.  We have already moved once after complaining about loud music coming from one of the theaters. Our head board vibrated because the music was so loud. They moved us from a from a nice sunny room on the third floor to a similar, but darker room on the first floor.  The hot water doesn't work in the shower, but hopefully they will fix that tomorrow. Somehow, we still hear very loud music, though I believe it's coming from somewhere else.  Now we also have to contend with the sound of foot traffic since we are on the ground floor.
