I have 3 more days here and I am starting to loose it.  If music is an issue throughout the Reserve, then why did they put us through the trouble of packing and unpacking?  This absolutely does not feel like a five star hotel experience.

reviews.author: Ehdiver
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: This place is Vegas at the beach. Great if you like constant noise and drink all day. There were at least 30 boats passing back and forth on the beach all day. Lots of hawkers on the beach. I was on the beach enjoying the quiet one evening and was approached by a prostitute. My final three days were spent nursing food poisoning.

reviews.author: Jeff H
reviews.title: Safety Beware
reviews.text:
While eatting breakfast at the buffet a cat was walking around. This cat had been there for the past few days. Like any normal child my son put his hand down to rub the cat, it bit him. I asked the Staff for some peroxide, benadryl, to place on the bite because it had started to swell pretty big. They brought us a band aid. Really??

The next night my son was taking a shower, he is 19 and weights about 140, his foot went through the shower floor. Luckily he did not get cut by the sharp edges from the broken shower floor. We called maintenance after 1 hour no one had shown up. I went to the front desk, explained what had happened, was told to go back to our room and wait. After 2 hours no one had shown up. By this time it was 9:30 pm. After going down to the front desk again, they moved us to another room.

The night before check out we went to the front desk to make sure everything was in order for check out. They said we needed to pay for an extra night, which was not right. After 1 hour, they found their mistake and said everything was fine.

On our morning of departure, we went to the front desk to check out. AGAIN they said we needed to pay for an extra night. We explained we went through this last night and we do not owe for another night. The girl that helped us the night before was at the front counter but didnt seem to remember anything about it, even though she worked with us for over 1 hour the night before. Our bus for the airport was leaving and if we didnt get on it, We might miss our flight. The front desk still insisted we owed for another night even though we had the papers that said we didnt. At these resorts, if the hotel does not release you, they will not take you to the airport. After the situation got pretty loud and ugly, they determined it was their error and released us from the resort.

WE had gone with a group of 100 other people. After returning home, this exact thing had happened to a few others.

BEWARE....of this scam! They know that you have to be released from the resort before the shuttles will take you to the airport and if they hold you long enough you will take a chance of missing your flight. 

Other than the problems we had it was a pretty resort.

reviews.author: HelmsFam
reviews.title: Warning.....
reviews.text:
We just returned home tonight after 5 days. When checking out they tried to charge us for another night. They we not going to let us leave! The reason this is so alarming is we had just been at the Paradisus three weeks ago and the same thing happened. 

We were with a group.... After talking with others the same thing happened to them. 

Please check your bill close!!!! DO NOT FALL FOR THIS SCAM!!!

My son was taking a shower and his foot went through the floor of the shower. It took them 3 hours to send someone to look at it and another 3 for have his room changes. He only weights 140 so he is not very big. You could see that the shower floor had been repaired before.

We will never return to another Paraidsus Resort!!!

The hotel is beautiful, rooms clean but staff was very lazy and didn't want to serve you. This is our fourth time to Punta Cana...it is their nature to be lazy!!!

reviews.author: R B
reviews.title: Not great (see also wedding review)
reviews.text:
This place has gorgeous grounds and friendly staff that will try to please you.  However, things are broken in the rooms (among all the people in my group 8 rooms altogether we had a broken closet/shower/safe/iron/toilet the first they we arrived.  Within one day they fixed everything (except I had to wait 2 days for a working iron).  Some of the rooms were dark (on the first floor) and smelled musty (the covers on the bed had moldy spots and smelled musty).  Our room was separated from the neighbors by a door and you could hear everything. The food was just OK.  I had a few complaints regarding my wedding and the night before we left me and my hubby sat down with one of the managers to talk with him about all the bad experiences we had (see below) but he just smiled took some notes and did nothing about it.  He said we will hear from him after he looks into the matter but we never did.  DO NOT eat at any of the restaurants you have to pay at.  As a treat my husband took me to Passions the day after our wedding for a 5 dinner course paired with wine.  For $150 we had food that was a joke (the dishes looked and tasted like plastic jelly - it was supposed to be French but tasted nothing like it) and was paired with cheap Spanish wine (our "champagne" was Spanish Cava).  Don't waste your money, just eat at the inclusive restaurants they were all ok except Bana (which I did not try but nobody in my wedding party liked).  Also they will not let men with open shoes in the restaurants.  My uncle has gout and they would not let him into Vento with his sandals even as I pleaded with the staff.  He had to put on closed toe shoe that made him uncomfortable the whole nite.   The positive about this place is that the grounds are very pretty and the staff is nice. That's about it.

I decided to have my wedding here last October and it took me a while to get over my disappointment and write a fair review hence this review is 5 months after.  The reason I decided on PPR was the glowing reviews other brides wrote and at the time it was considered #1 on destination weddings list in Punta Cana.  It was a small wedding (14 people) and since the amount I paid was just as much as if I had 24 people attending I especially expected good service.  The staff in charge of the wedding instead of taking care of my dress and the groom's outfit (as stated in the package I paid for) gave me a steamer that ended up leaking hot water all over.  Here I was the morning of the wedding trying to steam my dress with my mother and getting our hands burned all over.  So instead of steaming we decided to use the iron (thankfully I had a short dress without any complicated ruffles).  BTW the iron was replaced 2 days after we arrived (the one in the room was broken).  We got a working iron the night before the wedding so my fiancé can iron his shirt.  On the top of everything I come back to my room the morning of the wedding (after I had my hair done) to an unclean room (it was around 11am) and had to call the reception to send someone asap as my photographer was coming an hour later to start taking pictures (here I was trying to put makeup on and get organized and rushing the poor cleaning lady).  In addition, it was raining cats and dogs, so they had to change my wedding ceremony and reception location and they wanted me to let everyone know about this change.  At this point I decided to put my foot down so they decided to call everyone but I still had to provide everyone's room number.  Not to mention that my wedding party was placed all over the resort (not in one building as they should have been) and the place was pretty empty.  I am wondering why did I have to provide them with everyone's name and flight information a month before we arrived.  What a waste of time! The night of the wedding they were supposed to do a turn down service in the room (fill the tub, put roses in water and around bed and leave a bottle of champagne for us) which we never received.  When I complained we came back the next nite to rose petals on bed which at this point was a waste.  Overall I would not recommend this place for a wedding!  It was a very stressful experience that left me beyond disappointed.   As a couple that paid a lot of money for a wedding we did not receive the best service.  On the other hand a couple that were attending our wedding got the service of their life just because they attended a time share seminar upon their arrival (2 days before we arrived) and had dinners comped at Gabi, a person who checked with them every day to see what their needs were etc.  They received all the at  A few details about the services they offer: the person that did my hair was excellent, however my maid of honor's hair fell apart as soon as she started dancing.  So I guess it's upto who you get but I think they try to give the bride their best.  However, their nail polishes are really old, my French manicure did not last and did not look that great.  I recommend the DJ, they were excellent.  However, I made a cd just in case they did not have some of the songs I wanted and those particular songs they used from my cd did not sound great.  The day of my wedding it was a downpour (which started the night before) and they did a really good job moving me from beach terrace to the Apollo foyer, however there was no air circulation in there even though it's an open space.  After a night of dancing everyone was passing out from heat exhaustion.  The table setup was really nice but instead of candles I ordered in hurricanes they put cheap tea candles so bring your own if you can.

reviews.author: kirky171
reviews.title: bad management & horrid managers! ruined our 2weeks & birthday!
reviews.text:
the hotel is beautiful and sadly from the moment we arrived we had bad experiences it over 5 hours to get our room sorted and check in, spent 10-30mins each time daily on the hotel phone trying to book dinner/activities or sort things out. when we complained to the front desk they offer little or no result ion or advise.!!!
The rooms claim they are 5 star I would rate at 2.8- 3* max! the food was average and deserts disgusting! for the service 3.5* and quality of food 2*

Spent two days trying to speak to a proper manager by this point we had been fobbed off 4 times, very rude check in staff and even MORE RUDE MANAGERS! I will never book my business or personal with Melia again! they have done nothing to say SORRY or offer and help! ADVISE GO ELSE WHERE!

reviews.author: ArnaudParis
reviews.title: Too many bad points
reviews.text:
Positive points :

- the gardens
- the beach area
- the pools

Negative points :

- master suite at the reserve : old furnitures
- staff: no smile, sometimes really rude
- music on the gardens, why ? People wanted to hear birds and nature !ee
- restaurant : buffet are really poor and the others restaurants are not better.
- smokers of cigars evereywhere, even on the restaurant !!!!!
- we wait about 35 min for the check in, difficult after 10 hours flight
- I have reserved for a master suite but nobody escort me to the room at the arrival
- the service is one the worth i have since a long time.

One question : where is the management on the hotel, where is the General Manager ?

reviews.author: Jimmy P
reviews.title: ROOM WAS A DISASTER.  WILL NEVER STAY AT ANOTHER CLUB MELIA RESORT
reviews.text: Prior to booking our vacation my wife and I closely looked through many different hotels in the Punta Cana area.  We finally decided on the Paradisus Palma Real based on the recommendation from family and through the trip advisor rating.  Upon arrival we were introduced to our butler Luis Conan Zapata who was very helpful.  He walked us through the resort and booked our dinner reservations for the first 4 nights.  On our second day, we were given the Club Melia sales pitch which we thought was a little odd because we had just arrived and didn’t get a chance to actually experience the resort, let alone considering to invest $70,000 on becoming a club Melia member.  In addition, the food at the resort was below average.  As for the room service food goes, I would NOT feed that food to my dog. However, one restaurant I would recommend but it is only all-inclusive to royal service members is called the Palazzo. For the cost of $25 per person, everyone at the resort can experience it which was well worth the price.  The grounds were very well kept and the staff was extremely friendly.  The rooms, although very nicely set up, ours was a complete disaster.  The toilet on average took 4-5 flushes.  The shower drain filled up with water as we were showering, leaving us in dirty, sandy filled water.  Then, upon waking up one morning, I ended up stepping on a piece of glass.  Following this, I ordered breakfast and after opening the napkin I noticed ants crawling around inside of it.  The overall trip was not a disaster. The friendly staff and time spent on the beach helped us forget about the terrible food and horrible room experience.  I can honestly say this was my first and last time staying at the Paradisus or any other Club Melia Resort.

reviews.author: Noah_Webster
reviews.title: Friendly people, musty rooms, faulty printers and stingy showerheads
reviews.text:
The friendliness of the staff is almost enough to offset an underachieving luxury resort experience.  You cannot say enough about the pleasant demeanor and helpful attitude of the staff.  My guess is that if you are in your twenties or thirties and looking for sun, beach, pool and a "vibrant" nightlife, this resort will be just fine for you.

The physical plant, though, fits somewhere between annoying and difficult to live with.  My room was quite musty. I am not that sensitive but my wife, were she here, would have been in agony. While my room was air conditioned that didn't keep my clothes and other materials from wicking up a lot of moisture. 

To get a boarding pass you need to go down to the business center, bring up your pass and then e-mail the pass to the supervisor of the business center.  The computers that guests can use are not hooked up to printers.  The shower is quite elaborate, with sprays in all sorts of directions.  The main shower from above however emits only a thin stream of water with any sort of force.

The resort comes with eight different restaurants.  One, Passion, is fit for the foodie.  The rest are only so so based on my own experience and the members of my group.  In some ways you may be best off going to the buffet, Naos, for most of your meals rather than getting your hopes up for good sushi or Italian at the correspondingly themed restaurants.

The beach in front of the resort is quite nice as is the beach slightly to the north.  Walking along the beach beyond these points is a bit of an experience.  If you travel as a couple you are liable to be offered the opportunity to take a look at a time share.  Traveling as a single male will allow you to get multiple offers for a massage.

reviews.author: txcook
reviews.title: Beautiful but disappointing!!
reviews.text:
Beautiful views!! The resort is very spread out and if attending with a group I would prefer a resort that isn't stretched out parallel to the beach but more depth so the rooms can be closer together. 

We arrived at night and it was very hard to see the signage for the rooms and we walked around in the dark trying to find our rooms. Some rooms are so far from the main building that you literally waited for pick up in a golf cart. 

- Beds were very comfortable and rooms were clean. 
- Food was okay, nothing amazing at all and comparable to a stand buffet. Arrived on Friday and Saturday I had stomach virus affects that has now lasted 8 days. Came home and went to the doctor to confirm a stomach virus. A few others in our group had stomach issues too, so I would recommend bringing tums and be prepared! 
- Cocktail drinks were very weak and would recommend ordering a shot on the side if you want to taste any alcohol at all. 
- Massage that was amazing and would recommend that and can say that was the best part of this trip! 

We left an iPhone behind at the bar and actually found the person that turned it in to the Front Desk.  When I went to the Front Desk to claim it within 10 minutes of realizing I left it behind no one at the Front Desk new anything about the phone.  I spoke with Security who said he would follow up and never heard from anyone.  I had to keep asking with Guest Services too.  How does a iPhone disappear so fast wen turned in and no one knows anything?? Disappointed in the dishonesty there, so I would also recommend using the in-room safe! 

Beverage selection was good, but drinks were VERY weak!

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.title: Sobrepreciado, no vale lo que cobra
reviews.text:
El hotel es grande y bonito, pero el servicio deja mucho que desear. No es servicio de 5 estrellas, con la excepcion del servicio de desayuno a la habitacion que fue excelente, pero quizas fuimos solo afortunados de que nos atendiera Cesar Laffle.
Los restoranes tambien son aceptables, pero el bar de la piscina no tiene buenos licores y el servicio es muy lento.
Lo peor es el servicio de limpieza y la segregacion en el hotel con muchas areas donde no se puede entrar si no se dispone del bracelete del color elegido

reviews.author: Lauren D
reviews.title: nice atmosphere...poor food
reviews.text: We stayed at the reserve, some of my family was in the royal service and the rest were in the main hotel. The hotel is beautiful and the staff accommodating but the food is terrible. We ate at every restaurant and the only one that has something going for it is bana. Things were either overcooked or not cooked enough. The best meal we had was our wedding meal because its freshly cooked and not cold. All the Buffett's were cold, had no flavour and didn't open till 1230 - 1 ish then closed at 3.  We were lucky we stayed on the reserve and the hydro grill was open with hamburgers and pizza. I have been to the dominican dozens of times...first time at this resort and the first time ive had such terrible food. Then romance team is great if your planning a wedding once you get there. They are horrible to deal with via email. I felt bad for the 20 people that we had come down because there wasn't enough food variety for everyone to enjoy a meal.

reviews.author: nslancergurl08
reviews.title: Major let down especially over the New Year!!!!!
reviews.text:
Our stay was very nerve racking before we even left the U.S. as my husband and I were going there on our honeymoon. Before we left I called several times to pay our all inclusive fee and to arrange transportation to the resort from the airport. Every time I called no one knew what I was asking and was transferred several times. Half the time the phone rang and rang before I hung up. I finally checked the Punta Cana airports website for transport.

Once we arrived the staff was very friendly and our concierge walked us around to our room. He told us that in the morning we could make dinner reservations and that there was a dinner show that night for us to go to. We went and ate dinner but were very tired and did not stay for the show. In the morning we went down to talk to our concierge and told him we wanted to eat at Mole and the Market Grill. He called someone and then told us that we should eat at the buffet that night. He told us that he would make us reservations for the rest of the week and let us know. Needless to say he never made us any reservations and we ended up making them ourselves at the concierge desk the last two days. We were upset that almost every night there was supposed to be a beach show and it ended up never happening. We also did not see our concierge the last three days of our stay.

We were not made aware of the New Years Eve dinner either. The was no advertisement any where and our concierge told us to eat at the buffet again. When we went there for dinner there was maybe 5 other couples or families eating in there. After dinner we went to the avenue bar to watch the nights entertainment which was a DJ and I felt as if we were in a coffee bar listening to jazz music. The music was not up beat and we ended up leaving around 10 to go back to our room.

Another thing was while walking around we got a few whiffs of what smelled like sewer water. NOT very pleasant needless to say.

The service most days was horrible. When sitting down for breakfast it took at least 10-15 minutes just to get a glass of water. One morning I was tired of waiting so I went to the 24 hour bar and got us two bottles of water which was lukewarm at best. The same thing happened at lunch and dinner due to the fact we ate at the buffet for all three meals of the day. We just started getting our own drinks before we even walked into the restaurant.

We could tell the most of the bartenders had never formally been trained. I ordered a rum and coke which ended up being two thirds rum and maybe if I was lucky one third pop. My husband mostly stuck to beer and out of the tap was never very cold. One afternoon I ordered a strawberry daiquiri which was a glorified lemonade with grenadine and rum. Also on one afternoon we saw a few people with Corona's so my husband ordered on and was denied due to the fact it was not included. If I'm paying double what it cost to stay there that week then the rest of the year I think we should be able to get a damn Corona. We also got a different glass every time we ordered a drink which I thought was odd.

The pool was very nice but we could never get a towel. We went to the pool on three different days and the only reason we had towels was because I took them from the reserve side of the pool before breakfast (the only time I saw towels sitting out). The pool side bartenders made very good frozen drinks but were not very speedy (a trend we found out). One time I actually had to get out of the pool to get served.

The one thing our concierge did right was book us golf which in hindsight the front desk actually did most of it he just sent us to the right people. When they say golf is included it's really not. They tell you the greens fees are included but we ended up paying $65 a person for a cart rental. The course was not very challenging and was very dry.

I would make a trip again to Punta Cana but not this resort and would not recommend it to anyone. My husband is a teacher and I work in customer service and we paid a lot of money for a crappy honeymoon. I know we visited during the "most expensive" time of year but we were not impressed by anything. I have been to the Virgin Island's and St. Lucia before and had far more outstanding service and was able to be understood.

reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.title: If you are a seasoned traveler, do not go to this resort
reviews.text:
The beach, pool, and kid's club are great. It ends there. If you stay on the road where all the noisy golf carts that need lubricating drive by all night and then where the cleaning crew congregates in the am before walking to their rooms talking and laughing loudly, and the hotel next door which has live music until, plan for no sleep at all. I complained about the cleaning noise and it stopped for 2 days.
 The restaurants have no idea how to provide service to a diner. It took forever in any of the restaurants we tried and the food came out cold each time. No taste. For New Year's Eve, we were told we had to eat at 6 pm or 8 pm. When we went to the restaurant at 8 pm, it was half empty and never came close to filling up. They tried to serve us in 10 minutes to get us in and out. Served us a raw steak and looked at me like I was crazy to ask hem to cook it longer.

There are no kid's menus at any restaurants and my 5 year old struggled all week to find anything other than a hot dog at the snack bar to eat.

One of the restaurants had 3 waiters come to take our order and they couldn't even get 3 vodka soda's correct.

Never got wash clothes when the maid service cleaned the room. When I called for some to be delivered, the arrived with robes. Received turn down service once out of 8 nights. Room phone didn't work for 3 days. Room service took 2 hours to arrive another day. Forget ESPN, not going to happen. 

A great deal of the help does not understand English. They are slow to respond to requests. 

If you are Spanish speaking, you are well taken care of as there were many guests from the DR or South America. 

We are done with the DR and will stay with Sandals or Beach's. They realize what it takes to provide a total vacation environment.

We spent 10k dollars including airfare and this was not worth it at all.

reviews.author: vaclover2013
reviews.title: Worst Customer Service...will not return!
reviews.text:
I will keep it brief so you can clearly get the gist of our trip and this property.

Positives:
Excellent service at the beach...drinks delivered to your recliner.
Waiters were excellent especially Juan at Gabi Beach
Beautiful beach and grounds...towels readily available along with plenty of places to sit.
Excellent entertainment on a nightly basis.
A la carte dinners were good.

Negatives!!!
1) The dinner reservations process is RIDICULOUS! Many fellow vacationers I met also said this.  I tried to call over five times to no avail.  NO ONE picks up their phones on this property.  The VIP concierge (Christian-beware of him) said he would do it and when confronted later, he said everything was booked.  No suggestions given just a "sorry about your luck" attitude even after I tipped him five bucks ahead of time for his efforts or lack their of.  The self-assigned label of "MR. Fix it" was more than exaggerated.  I had to ask for the manager and only then were my requests taken seriously.  Thanks to Yasy for taking care of our meals.  I really should not have to be firm (to say the least ) on my vacation over dinner reservations.  There were tons of empty tables at each of the restaurants so I am not sure what the problem was. The buffets are not that great and I would have been very unhappy to have to eat there all week.
2) BEWARE of Melia's hotel credits...they try and scam you with faulty details to get out of giving you what you are owed/offered.  I had to fight for this too.  If you don't mind wasting your precious holiday time waiting for people to do their jobs, please feel free to go to this resort.  It is definitely not a five star resort.  
3) COCKROACH in the room.  I am not kidding sadly.
4)The concierge (Christian) constantly asking you to go to a seminar so he can "get a commission".  Really, does he think I would help him out after doing nothing?
5)BE AWARE...if you visit the nearby mall, with free shuttle service from the hotel, there is a policy that they WILL NOT refund your money for any returned purchases.  They do not share this information other than in Spanish on the receipt and will not tell you in person.  Also, I learned the hard way that prices are heavily inflated!

Overall, the administration at this beautiful resort has a lot of work to do before it can be a truly 5 star resort.  As of right now, it is not. I will not return to the Dominican for a third visit.  I am not sure where all of these positive comments from others are coming from unless they had a butler at the Reserve section of the resort.  My advise...keep researching other properties to visit.

reviews.author: joseborges
reviews.title: paradisus ou "inferno"
reviews.text:
cliente frequente da rede melia, mais uma decepçao com o palma real, primeiramente um check in horrivel, por volta de 30 minutos. uma concierge, sra. mindy, que nao nos explicou absolutamente NADA sobre o hotel. em geral uma equipe mau humorada, em especial o bar ao lado da recepçao, um horror, otimas bebidas, mas com atendimento pessimo. bar da piscina tambem  horrivel, neste as bebidas nao uma lastima. com relaçao ao hotel , muito confuso, diversas areas reservadas a tipos de clientes diferentes, as pessoas sao convidadas a sairem de inumeras areas comuns, realmente dificil de entender. em relaçao a programaçao de animadores, esta praticamente nao existe durante o dia, se vai com CRIANÇA, escolha outro hotel pois o palma nao tem NADA, tem um clube no the reserve, que fica longe , tem q pegar um carrinho de golfe, o que dificulta muito a vida de quem viaja com criança.
um fato em especial causou um aborrecimento enorme, com a reserva feita a meses, onde foi mencionado o fato de que minha esposa faria aniversario durante a estadia, nada foi providenciado, pelo contrario, em reserva com 3 dias de antecedencia, no restaurante acqua, fomos impedidos de entrar pois nao nos foi avisado a necessidade de traje especial, um absurdo!!
agradeço no entanto o empenho em tentar reverter este mau entendido do gerente o sr. vicente rubianes, que no dia seguinte nos preparou um almoço e um jantar muito especial, fica o nosso agradecimento a este excelente funcionario, coisa rarissima no palma real.
agradecemos tambem o carinho dos garçons os srs.luis severino, darlin inirio e  baron justus, tambem excelentes em seu atendimento.
em resumo, se quer um paradisus, va para o paradisus la esmeralda, em playa del carmem , mexico, com verdadeiro atendimento exclusivo!
quanto a punta cana, de algumas ilhas que conheço no caribe, certamente esta é a pior em duvida nenhuma em todos os aspectos.

reviews.author: Brian M
reviews.title: A diamond in the rough...
reviews.text: We had a very difficult honeymoon experience overall at the resort. But I will instead focus on the one true positive from our trip. Pool bartender Ramon Fuego was beyond our salvation. His amazing attitude, hard work and passion for the job were absolutely infectious. We wanted to take him & and his partner in crime Luiz home with us, and threatened to do so several times! They became like family, to the extent that our farewell was truly an emotional one. Were I to open my own business, Ramon would hands down be my very first hire. Much of the waitstaff on this level in general did a fine job. But none could quite reach the heights of this particular dynamic duo. We have never connected with anyone on this level on a trip in our entire lives. The administrative and housekeeping staffs could both stand to learn plenty from these two unbelievably phenomenal employees. They were the absolute best, bar none. Unfortunately, we could say the same in regard to the rest of our experience. Ramon and Luiz, you guys are the best!!!

reviews.author: Wittle_traveller-11
reviews.title: Good luck getting towels
reviews.text: The service at this resort is hit and miss. Good luck getting your room cleaned before 7pm if you don't call housekeeping each morning to remind them. Towels are in short supply both in the rooms and by the pool. The towel girl will only give out one towel per person and will give you attitude if you request a second. As for the food, I had some surprisingly great meals followed by horrible meals. But much better than I had anticipated for the region.

reviews.author: Markus G
reviews.title: No value for money
reviews.text:
Rooms need to be redecorated, checking staff unfriendly with poor English language skills, beach chairs already occupied in the morning with towels,

Good drinks, nice location, nice evening live entertainment

reviews.author: trippyNYC
reviews.title: big vegas type resort
reviews.text: from the minute i got there, i couldn't wait to leave. but had to attend friend's wedding so stayed til my plane departed. i really don't like big hotels/resorts. the women staff outfits are cute. the rooms are comfortable enough, pretty roomy. wireless in room wasn't very stable. food is absolutely horrendous, worse than dormitory food. how can breakfast buffet have like a hundred inedible offerings?  only good thing was the fresh juices. went to the teppanyaki restaurant and the guy left our meat cooking on the burner for an extra 20min after it was clearly cooked. so basically we got a bunch of dry scrappy chunks of meat. surprisingly the pool wasn't that well-used.  it's enormous and would be good for long laps if i could swim in a straight line.

reviews.author: Guilherme Silva
reviews.title: "Feira"
reviews.text: O hotel é bonito. Possui uma boa estrutura mas em matéria de serviços e atenção ao hóspede, é pessimo: wi-fi não funciona (oscila demais), empregados ousados com os hóspedes, não avisavam para entrar nos quartos. Muito bagunçado: se não gosta de tumulto, não vá!

reviews.author: Cinzia M
reviews.title: Staff do no welcome you and help you...
reviews.text: Very nice place but staff is not gonna welcome you in the right way, no information is given, no visit of the property - so we had to find everything by ourselves, no help if you ask for something and most of all : restaurants impossible to book !!! We spent too much time at the front desk or service desk trying to book restaurants. Also when you ask for a service, 1st reply is "not possible" and you have to insist (for example we asked to change a big note into smaller notes - to give tips to waiters - but nor at front desk, neither at the bank it was possible...)

reviews.author: Scott K
reviews.title: Great beach / Awful drink pours / Mediocre Food
reviews.text: Staff has no knowledge of the ingredients that should be used in mixed drinks, no knowledge of the amount of liquor that should be in the drink, and the food is similar to a Barnhill's Buffet. The butler service seems like a great thing when you arrive, but don't let that fool you. You will be cussing the idea later.

reviews.author: 1938Roberto
reviews.title: Dissapointment
reviews.text:
We Went to Paradisus Reserve Punta Cana  we are a member of Melia Caribe Tropical they dont have anything available for that week so I call the Network and we do the reserve 1 week we are very dissapoint because we pay more money for the all inclusive. 2 nights they don fix and change the towels we always stay in the Royal Service at Caribe Tropical. The bathroom they have a very hot water that we have to call to fix that I went to claim what we thought I have the right since we belong to the Member Club. In  other word we don't go back to that hotel, the only thing we really enjoy was the staff, Jose at the Gabi beach excellent person very "complaciente" and always in a very good mood and Juan Cruz at the bar pool
very nice too Rafael Evangelista at the pool bar that men is a such nice person very complaciente too. If for some reason I have to go back I go for the staff in general.
 
I HAVE TO GO BACK IS FOR THE STAFF.

reviews.author: Clarence H
reviews.title: Expected much more for the money
reviews.text: We arrived on the Sunwing flight late p.m.. No one showed us around the premises until the next day when we asked for help. The mini bar in the room was empty when we checked in, and it was not replenished at all unless we called for room service to bring something. The first room was very noisy as it was next to a small roadway used by maintenance trucks & carts starting at 6:00 a.m. daily. Also we had a problem with the sun directly coming into the room through the large window over the bed. We asked for some sort of better curtain to block some of the light, but didn't get anything. We tried to "upgrade" to a better room, but there were none available. Also, there are no ocean view or ocean front suites at this resort. We were given an identical room two days later somewhat further away from the noise and with less direct sunlight in the morning, although this room had broken clocks, toilet that would continue to "run" and other minor annoyances. After putting out the "do not disturb" sign two evenings in a row, we received a card under the door basically telling us that because of our sign, we would need to call the desk to request service from now on. The hotel seems to have focused their priorities on business customer gatherings and weddings, which resulted in the nightly "shows" not being held in the theater, but rather small groups of dancers, etc. parading through an upstairs lounge. The single towel hut location ran out of towels every day. The $1500 "resort coupons" given to us were basically worthless. There were far too few chairs with umbrellas at the beach, and too few around the pool as well. Of course we could have remedied this by purchasing "Royal Service" for an extra $1000, which would have given us a towel and cabana daily, and the extra added bonus of getting to order Corona beer instead of El Presidente. Luckily we chose not to pay for this. The casino was the tiniest we have seen.  If you go here and get a massage at the beach, make sure to tell the person not to be rough, because they were very, very rough. The beach was pretty and busy, but there was a severe seaweed problem. The positives were the overall friendliness of the staff, with the exception of the bartenders (although the poolside bartenders were very friendly), and another positive was having the buffet on the beach two times during our week there. This was very nice. Hate to be this negative, especially in light of all the positive reviews we saw about the resort before we went. We have had far better experiences with the Riu chain in Cancun, with Atlantis in the Bahamas, and in other locations in Antigua and St. Lucia, as well as with many cruises.

reviews.author: Juan D
reviews.title: If you vacation once a year, don't come here
reviews.text:
First and foremost, IMPORTANT, READ READ: The Reserve does NOT, I repeat, DOES NOT have direct access to the beach. We traveled all the way from CA only to find out that you need to wait for a train to pick you up to take you there (if you decided to walk, is a 15 minute walk!). This was a mood killer. You have to do a lot of work on the service side to revert the fact that you have no beach close by and, sadly, this is not the place you'll get great service :(
Arrival was messy and there were more guests unhappy than otherwise. All you hear about room service, is right! They do something smart actually: they just don't pick up the phone and let your call go to a voicemail that is full. I thought that was ingenious :). What we did is call the concierge and have them call room service, that did the trick. Food at the buffet is reasonable (not good, but reasonable). Bar service is just not up to par, period. Piña Colada comes out of a dispenser?! Poor quality liquor... I'm sorry, but very disappointing. The food available between meals is junk food, there's no other way to call it. Towels are not replenished periodically. No in-room entertainment (movies to rent). I'm actually still in the property, I'm staying 5 more days :( But the whole experience is been so underwhelming that I felt the need to leave this, my very first TripAdvisor review, to warn other travelers of this place. Kind of sad...

reviews.author: knarf2013
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Punta cana is beautiful, and the facilities here are quite lovely to see.  Not so lovely to experience.

Check-in is very slow and unorganized.  It took three different people to get us checked in, and the room was not ready until 4:00 (check-in time is 3:00).

At check-in, we met our new best friend, Previs.  Once we made it clear that we would not sit through the 90-minute time share presentation, Previs disappeared, and the dinner reservations he was going to make for us were not made as requested.

Our room did not have a working shower.  I expect hot and cold running water (even Motel 6 has that), but the shower was never fixed to work properly.  Also, the housekeeping staff removed our used hand towels, but had to be asked to bring us new ones.

We arrived a little late, and were the only participants for a couple of the activities, but the leaders declined to conduct the scheduled event.  Apparently, "island time" is a one-way option for some folks.  Most of the other staff were very friendly and helpful.  

The buffet food was "meh," but the meals at the reservations-only restaurants were better.

I would not recommend this hotel.  The experience was disappointing.

reviews.author: Fabinhobp
reviews.title: Murphy's law
reviews.text:
First of all, let me say I am writing this review from the hotel. This is our 6th day of a 1 week trip. 
When we booked 3 suites at the Reserve our entire family was looking forward to a relaxing week however it turned to be an unpleasant situation. 
Let me start by saying we are very experienced travelers and have been all over the world, so we do not overreact to small issues that you can find even at the best hotels.
I'd like to start with the positives: the hotel is beautiful and the suites are nice despite needing some renovation, the hotel area and specially the landscaping is very nice , the staff is very friendly (with a few exceptions) and the beach is also very nice.
The food is decent, we never expect too much from all inclusive hotels in the Caribbean therefore that should not be an issue to be concerned as well.
Now let me relate some of the issues we've had: Let me start by saying their wireless service is TERRIBLE, you have to be moving from one place to another always looking for a better connection.
The worst however were the serious issues we had with our rooms (yes, our family had 3 suites and we had problems with all of them). 
Little but annoying things like the power main switch would not work sometimes and we would be left in the dark, mini bar did not work.
The worst of all however was a serious problem with the running water in 2 of our rooms: It was boiling so we could not brush our teeth or take a shower. They were able to fix the problem in one of the rooms but on the other one they kept asking us to be patient and only moved us to another room more than 24 hours later when they realized the problem could not be solved. That's just not acceptable.
We were lucky to have other rooms so we could go there to shower and brush our teeth.
Throughout our ordeal we kept going to the front desk to speak with the manager on duty and saw several other dissatisfied guests, so this was not a case of our "bad luck".  
My conclusion is the hotel needs and urgent renovation otherwise they will continue to dissatisfy their future customers.
If you wish to come to this hotel, my advice is: Do not come to "The Reserve" as there is nothing special about it. 
The Reserve is farther away from the beach than the regular hotel and only have 2 extra restaurants there are not better than the all the other ones at the main hotel. So at least save you some money and stay at the regular Paradisus Punta Cana.
Good luck to you and your family.

reviews.author: D L
reviews.title: Not as good as the first time!!
reviews.text:
My wife and I travel 3 to 4 times per year and usually stay at Melia, Hilton, Rosewood level places. Having said this, we are not the unreasonable and needy type of travelers.

We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real about 4 years ago in October and the experience was wonderful.  So much so we came back again with expectations because we where here before.  Me, wife and our adult son visited and I had a 2 bedroom suite.

The good:
-------------
The resort grounds are extremely nice and I think one of the best well designed resorts I have seen, in terms of layouts and facility and ambiance.  Great entertainment as something was always going on and the Michael Jackson show was awesome.  Never a boring moment.

The bad & ugly:
--------------------

Service was horrible. (It takes allot for me to say this so please appreciate it)  We just returned last week (July)  and the place was full to capacity. Having said this, it was like they needed more personnel at the front desk and concierge.  You would either be waiting for a long time to get service or the person you work with would not spend quality time with you.  I have to direct this specifically to the concierge desk.  They need more people to serve in this capacity and they need big time training on hospitality.  The personnel was a bit young and not too experienced on how to handle people.  At times they were very flippant and didn't go the extra mile to assist.  I experienced this with a young lady when trying to get golf reservations.  The Palma Real has a kiosk to assist in reserving tee times for playing golf so I tried to use this kiosk.  Problem was the kiosk never worked and I could get NO help from the concierge desk.  The kiosk offers you to reserve tee times at several courses other than the Cocotal (which is the Palma Real course) but when the kiosk didn't work I attempted to reserve tee times at courses other than the Cocotal thru the concierge. No one could speak English OR Spanish. (yes being a little sarcastic!)  I finally got someone (Bell person) to help me.  Turned out to be a nice connection for golf but this wasn't the right person doing this job.

Palma Real has 5 or so restaurants (which were very good) but you have to make reservations to dine.  Again, been to Real before so expected this but getting restaurant reservations was frustrating. To reserve you have to go to the concierge and therein lies the adventure.  They were so busy AND the attendants didn't have or didn't share knowledge of the restaurants.  They were constantly on the phone in general because the attendants could not get a line out (go figure) to call out to make reservations for restaurants, golf, etc.  I was told on many occasions that the restaurants were fully booked but when I did finally get reservations and then when I dined at the restaurants the restaurants were barely occupied.

** here is some good... Viento and the Passion restaurant food was great**  You have to pay to dine at the Passion.

Room service was extremely late.  Each day no one came to clean the room no earlier than 3pm.
The last few days (we stayed 4 days) we told the cleaning people not to bother and just bring us fresh towels and soap.  That didn't happen properly in that they would take the dirty towels but would not bring back all towels to replace what they took.  (ie. they would bring one towel  back instead of two and one day NO face towels)  We had to ask for soap on several occasions because no one would bring the soap.  Keep in mind these complaints span both rooms that I had. (The 2 bedroom suite is basically 2 rooms with a adjoining door.)

Internet service did NOT exist.  Service was available from my room (building 39) on my first night of stay but after that was unable to obtain service.  I called the front desk and was told the internet was down and would be fixed.....it never worked during my stay and I stayed 5 nights.
The only way to get internet service was near the front desk area.

I really could continue but I won't.  Maybe you can attribute the poor service to the larger resort crowd in July versus the October visit that I experienced 4 years ago but I expect the same level of service and there is NO excuse for not being hospitable.  I didn't pay less because its July!!

I would like to suggest to management to revamp the front desk and concierge personnel so they are better trained in the area of hospitality and get older more mature attendants who understand how to manage people in adverse conditions.

Unfortunately I was so turned off by the Palma Real (again after having a wonderful first experience) that I probably will no be returning to this resort.

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Overall not impressed
reviews.text:
The good:
- Resort is extremely well maintained. Rooms were clean. There's constantly crews taking care of the property. They put a lot of pride in their appearance and it shows.

The bad:
- They messed up our reservation and forced us to switch rooms mid-trip. Additionally, they told us we had to check out by 10am and the new room wouldn't be ready until 3, so we could sit at a restaurant with our luggage and wait. 
- They give out "towel cards" for you to get a towel by the pool. However, most of the time, they do not have towels available to give out. 
- For over 1000 guests staying at the hotel, they have 107 chairs available by the pool (yes, we counted). You have to go out to the pool by 7am to claim chairs.
- The rooms (at least the one we got) had a kitchen in it, but the cabinets in the kitchen are empty. Not even wine glasses, which was frustrating as we brought a half-empty bottle of wine back from one of the restaurants. 
- You have to make dinner reservations well in advance. We stayed for 9 days and made most of the reservations when we arrived.
- They claim to have internet in the rooms & around the pools. NOT true. We had to stand on our balcony to get any wifi signal at all.
- Food overall was just average, but I would imagine that's not uncommon for an "all-inclusive" resort (although I've been to other all-inclusives that had better food). Avoid the sushi restaurant at all costs!
- Constantly ran out of alcohol and occasionally would secretly substitute for a different alcohol (my rum & coke was made with tequila as they had ran out of rum... I knew it tasted funny and then overheard someone else talking to the bartender about how they were out of rum)
- Service is slow or nonexistant. No one brings drinks at the breakfast/lunch buffet (we eventually learned to go to the waiter station and pour our own drinks). Little to no drink service at the pool or beach.

The list goes on... overall, I feel there are much better places to go, ESPECIALLY for the money.

reviews.author: 001globetrotter
reviews.title: Waste of time and money
reviews.text: When you think of a vacation, you'd expect relaxation, respect, patience, security and honesty.  At this resort, don't expect it.  They are really fake from all aspects.  As stated from another tourist, it is really true that unless you speak Spanish, you are somewhat ignored.  If you are in any part of the resort, including the reserve area for kids, carefully place your belongings where you can always have a clear view of it.  There are those who watch and prey on vacationers.  FYI:  This resort claims to have a high standard of security, don't be fooled, they don't even have security cameras.  Only guards who sporadically may walk around to check out the scenery of those in bathing suits.  In all, I highly do not recommend this resort in any way.  Example, I left a towel on the bed that was stained from food.  To find later in the evening, that housekeeping had just hung it up on the drying rack close to the shower stall, instead of replacing it.

reviews.author: cam_flyer
reviews.title: Beware of "all inclusive"
reviews.text:
We just got back from spending 10 days here.  We had both good and bad experiences. We arrived early PM Saturday (Jul 6) after a red-eye flight from Los Angeles.  The checking in and getting a room was a total ordeal.  After waiting in a long line, the girl helping was neither friendly nor helpful.  
After a few minutes, she told us to go have lunch and to come back after but would not say why. We thought the restaurant was about to close.  Upon returning, she wanted to know why we were back and told us to talk to someone else.   After one very frustrating hour, we were sent to a room that was a looong walk away and had not been cleaned. 
I finally made contact with one of the Spanish managers that directed someone to help me.  We finally got a room 4-5 hours after arriving.  The front desk clerk just handed me a package with no other information. I had to ask for how things worked at the resort.  He did so with a poor attitude as if he was really put off by my asking. 

The room was very nice and the facilities are very good. The staff is generally friendly. The service at the main restaurant is a hit and miss. Many times I had to hunt for napkins, utensils and drinks.   The food becomes boring after 3 days. 

Beware that making reservations for the theme restaurants is not easy and seldom can you get one.  They used a very complicated and antiquated method. Even though the people at the concierge desk make the reservations, they do not control them.  They, themselves, have to keep calling some phone number to someone that controls the reservations and that person hardly ever answers.  As a result, they tell you to come back in the PM and to try again.  It is very backwards.   We did however, get into a few of the places and the food is very salty.  Only the Italian restaurant was worth the reservations hassle.
 
The water sports center is another hit or miss deal. The catamarans are not for unlimited use and you only get ½ hour per day and you better book in advance as soon as you get there. No one tells you this when you check in.  The wind surfers are old, lack center keels and do not have friction strips.  Don’t even try them as it is very frustrating.  The scuba diving guide and boat driver were fantastic.  They were very professional. 

There are a few good attributes about the place.  All drinks are included and you can have as many as you want.  The bar tenders are good and willing to serve. The facilities are superb and the beach is great. 

The cooks in the main restaurant are very good and helpful.  The make great omelets and cook very good fresh meats.  There was one employee named Sujelia(sue) that was a very helpful.  She was instrumental in getting reservations and guided us on how to get things done.  
The WiFi only works in the main lobby and has a very weak signal.  Don’t expect great internet connection with your own devices.

It is a shame that this place has so much potential and seems to be saddle with really bad management.  I was told by an employee that a Mexican General Manager was replaced with a Spaniard and that is when the service went downhill. 
If you go there, make sure to get them to explain how it all works as the people in the front desk will not do it on their own.   Good Luck! I give the facilities 4 stars and the service 2.   I will not be coming back to this facility again.

reviews.author: Samir P
reviews.title: Some good, some bad
reviews.text: Resort was very clean and well kept but the service was horrendous except for 2 people: Ramon Fuego and Wilson Ofanez.  Ramon is a bartender at the swim-up bar and goes out of his way to help families with kids.  He treats everyone well and tries to make your time at the pool the best it can be.  Wilson is a waiter at Mole and he simply is the best waiter at any of the restaurants.  We ate at Mole, Vento, Market Grill, Mizu and Ibana and Wilson was the only one who undersood customer service of the waiters we had.  He tried his bets to make our dinner perfect although he couldn't do much about the so-so food at this resort.  The food is not gourmet at this resort and the drinks ar only top shelf at a few bars.  They load up the bars heavily used with local liquor.  Also, you only get Presidente as far as beer unless you stay at the Reserve.  We won't stay again at this resort and recommend the Iberostar Grande or Riu Palace from speaking to others down there and seeing those resorts.  Also, the sauna, steam room, spa, beds on the beach, etc.  - nothing is included unless you are with the Melia timeshare or Royal Service.  You have to pay extra for everything beyond food at 5 restaurants and some of the bars.

reviews.author: EasyToPlease2013
reviews.title: Great Vacation Location, until.....
reviews.text:
I had a great time with my friends and family at Paradisus Palma Real. Unfortunately, this all ended on my wedding day. There were numerous mistakes, which is understandable, however the response I received from the hotel was unacceptable. If things are going well, you're lucky. If you have any complaints or need to share your concerns, don't expect a sympathetic response. The place is beautiful, but I will never return again. Well, as long as the hotel management remains the same. Perhaps, different owners will serve this location well. 

Here is what to expect: 

Pros:
* Beautiful grounds
* Decent food
* Courteous housekeepers
* Availability of activities

Cons:
* Don't expect to win a disagreement. The client is never right.
* Room mix-ups
* If you're having a wedding, the Romance Team will make mistakes. Some are pretty rude.
* Communication issues
* Rooms are a little stuffy, but understandable in a tropical region.
* Reservations at restaurants are difficult for large parties
* Hefty fee for visitors from other resorts

reviews.author: Vbc123
reviews.title: Not worth the money!!!
reviews.text:
I have to say that I am very disappointed in most of the service given. Coming from a hospitality background I know what good service is. The bartenders and servers are very nice! Especially "Ramon Fuego", and Luis at the pool bar. They were awesome!! 

I paid extra for the concierge service, and it was a total waste of money. As a matter of fact I had a terrible experience with my concierge. He actually lied to us telling us that the restaurant we wanted to go to was closed when it wasn't. I am suppose to be guaranteed 3 dinner reservations and I got nothing! When I spoke to the concierge manager his solution was a fruit basket and my jacuzzi being filled for me!!

Also the wifi and internet didn't work for 3 days. So I couldn't do any work. 

The door to the toilet is a clear glass door. So if you have kids it's not convenient at all! Who wants to see someone using the bathroom???

They serve drinks by the pool in paper cups which they don't pick up during the day. So there are cups everywhere as well as floating in the pool. 

I wouldn't recommend to anyone!!! Go to the Iberostar grand! 100 times better!!!!

reviews.author: Jenny N
reviews.title: Not What I Expected
reviews.text:
I was looking forward to visiting Punta Cana after hearing such great things about it. The opportunity came after a friend decided to marry at the Paradisus Palma Real. I had a great opportunity to celebrate this event and make a much-needed family vacation out of it. 
Let's start with the positives:
Beautiful grounds, gorgeous pool, nice room, everything was impeccably clean and well-manicured. Staff was courteous and friendly for the most part. And the teppanyaki restaurant at The Reserve was the best meal I had the 6 days I spent there. Also a beautiful wedding venue and smooth event even with a rainy night and change of venue. Great massage at the spa by Quintilla.
Unfortunately moving on very quickly to the negatives:
What do you look forward to most from a Caribbean island? THE BEACH...below par. Not sure if its this part of Punta Cana but the beach was rough and wavy; not beautiful and crystal-clear blue like I have seen on other Caribbean vacations. I spent most of the time lounging by the pool, for that I stay home in my own pool. The staff was friendly but I felt like they expected more from you. The service in the buffett was aweful! It was like pulling teeth to ask for silverware or drinks. We would practically be done with breakfast by the time we ended up getting what we had ordered. We even walked to the bar that bordered the buffet and got our own drinks before the waiter even brought it to us. Something else I noticed was that waiters did act quicker and were more hospitable when tipped. Now I did not know that this was the norm here. I already paid a small fortune to vacation here with my family and I'm in my beachwear, I don't have cash at hand at all times to be throwing around. That really bothered me, all-inclusive should be all-inclusive or stated otherwise. Now onto the worst experience of the trip....the food was always just ok for the most part except for the Mizu restaurant at The Reserve, unfortunately my family got sick to their stomachs with diarrhea. It was some cheeseburgers they had for lunch at the Market Grille that I did not eat. They did not look right while they were being cooked on the grill  and my husband said they did not taste good. In fact, he did not let my children take more than 3 bites of each burger and still they got so sick. My son was the worst ill. We spent the last 2 days of the trip dealing with a sick child. To the point that the last day we spent the day at the hospital with my son getting an IV, blood drawn, an IV infusion of fluids for rehydration. It was a very scary experience for a parent and one that could have been prevented with proper food hygiene in a resort you would expect more from. Several other members of our group complained of stomach issues as well. I do have to say that when I did call to state that I wanted to see a doctor it was speedily coordinated. $600 in medical bills later my son is still ill but recovering at home. This is why I give it a poor rating vs. an average rating. I'm sorry to say I will definitely not be back here.

reviews.author: Peaches132161
reviews.title: Palma Real Punta Cana NOT A 5 STAR
reviews.text:
If you want to plan your wedding, this is the place.  Seems to be geared towards weddings as they had weddings at least once a day.  Lobby bar really, really, hot, so be prepared.

Unless you upgrade and pay for Royal Service, everything is, in my opinion a 3 1/2 star.

Also, try not to get talked their "not time share" (so they say) meetings.  They are going to try to sell you a room at thousands and thousands of dollars and you are in this meeting a couple of hours.

reviews.author: Anonymous371
reviews.title: Wouldn't pay to stay here
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for a company incentive trip. It was a free vacation for my wife and I. Will try to be objective:

Positives:
1. Most beautiful ground I've ever seen at a resort. Stunning.
2. Both SPAs were nice and relaxing. They do a nice job there. 
3. Alexander Jose (one of the beach activities guys) was pleasent, energetic, and went out of his way to accomodate everyone he came into contact with. He's a nice kid who works real hard to make your stay enjoyable. Thanks Alexander!

Negatives:
1. **Service was down right aweful** It took forever to get anything (even when you were the only one at the bar or restaurant), The staff was visibly annoyed if you asked for 'anything'. (which kind of defeats the purpose of an all inclusive). They simply have no motivation to help you, even when you tip well.

Note: the one exception is if you tip the guys on the beach serving drinks ahead of time, they will go out of their way to take care of you.

2. Minibar in room and room service selection were sub par compared to other resorts.
3. With some exception the restaurant food was not good (Other reviews are accurate)
4. Beach and Ocean were beautiful, but sea weed everywhere. Didn't make it enjoyable swimming in the ocean. It was all over you. 
5. Different levels of inclusivity annoying and confusing at times.

To sum up: I personally would not pay money to stay at this resort. It's a shame, because the proprty is truly amazing. If hotel managment would train the staff to give even 'a little' effort, people would be clamoring to come back here. Hope this helps.

TIP: Whatever you do...REFUSE to let them deliver your bags upon check in. They will push back and insist. We gave in, and 3 hours later, received our bags. (Result: by the time our bags were delivered, it was too late to go to the beach/pool). What a waste. Also, some of our friends had their stuff stolen.

reviews.author: Mikki78
reviews.title: Royal Service is a scam
reviews.text:
I do not know where to begin. We paid an extra $950 for "Royal Service"  to get the Internet in the room and butler service. Well the Internet in the room does not work. We stayed at the resort for 5 nights. Every day they said they would write up a ticket and it would be fixed. Well that never happened. Also we asked our butler Doward for serveral items which never got done. We asked him to reserve us lounges  at the Royal service pool with the bar..,that never happened. We rarely saw him. He stopped by yesterday and asked what time we would be leaving we told him and he assured us a bellman would be at our door at 11a....We were mot surprised that never happened either.  He was a nice enough person, but clearly needs better training and follow through. We never got and special treatment with Royal service. 

We also were never told when we checked in that the Plazzo restaurant had a dress code for men. They need to wear long pants.  Communication and training is an issue with this property.

reviews.author: BP369
reviews.title: Would not recommend this resort
reviews.text:
We choose The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana for our family vacation.  We were a group of 25 people and three of the families choose to book a family concierge for a stress free vacation with kids.  Before going on with the negatives, I would like to start off on a positive note appreciating the service provided by Ovido our Family Concierge, Sergio the manager at Vento, Melvin the grill chief.  These guys went above and beyond trying to make the best of our vacation. Especially helping with providing meals when needed for our children and us.
Overall the resort was very disappointing.  The variety and quality of the food in the buffets was not up to standard.  It seemed as though you were eating basically the same food for all 7 days we were there for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  We have been to other all inclusive resorts and we would never run out of choices in the 7 days were there in the buffet, but his was not the case at the Paradisus.  
The rooms are nice but the walls are paper thin.  You hear everything in the halls and the room next to you.  The guest in the room next to you would be having a conversation in a normal tone and you would hear the conversation because the walls are so thin.  The doors to the rooms don’t align so to open and close them you have to slam them so this disturbs your neighbors and everyone else in the building.  
To add to our frustration during our stay, to get to anywhere on the property you needed to walk or wait for the shuttle.  The wait for the shuttle would be about 15minutes.  While waiting you would see all the Club Melia cars driving around empty but since you were not a member you could not use them but there were tons of them around but not enough of the shuttles for the non members.  This really was frustrating to see empty carts go by and you were not able to use them. 
Moving onto the Family Concierge concept we paid extra for was a waste of money.  Each family who had the Family Concierge was supposed to get a cell phone; in our case 3 families had the service so we should have had 3 phones.  However my husband and I arrived first so we got our phone the day we arrived, but our sister and brother did not.  They were told they did not have enough phones on that day so if we can share the phone for the time being and they would get it the next day.  So my sister got her phone but they still did not have another one for my brother who then just said forget it.  This should not have occurred we should not have had to share phones just because we were one large family.  The hotel knew beforehand how many Family Concierge groups there were and they should have had all the items ready based on individual numbers.  
Then the next incident occurred with reserving the cabanas at the beach.  The concierge is supposed to reserve a cabana for each individual family either at the pool or the beach.  Well on Monday we requested to have 3 cabanas (one for each family) reserved at the beach for Tuesday.  We were told he would not be able to book 3 cabanas for us at the beach.  We would only be able to book 1 at the beach and 2 at the pool.  How is that possible?  If we were three separate families then we would have been able to have 3 separate cabanas at the beach but since out last names were the same and we were together we needed to share again.  Where is the value of paying extra for a service we are not really getting?
The Family Concierge also offers turndown service, well not once in the entire time we stayed there were we able to use this service.  They would always come knocking after 9PM or sometimes even 10PM for the turndown service by then our children would already be fast asleep.  If you know there are kids in this area they should come earlier to provide the service.  Most kids would be in bed before 9, only older kids would be up that late.  So yet again we are not getting what we paid for.  
The Paradisus Punta Cana – The Reserve was chosen since it seemed to be kid friendly however our experience makes us question the kid friendly aspect of the hotel.  Our four children ranged from 18 months to 24 months.   They are young and their meal times are early since they go to bed early, however the hotel does not accommodate for this.  It is an all inclusive resort therefore food available 24 hours but you can’t keep giving them the same food every meal for the 7 days we were there.  Our children are not old enough yet to understand they need to wait an hour before the restaurants open.  Breakfast time was fine but the restaurants don’t open for lunch till 12:30 and the kids eat at 11AM so if we order from room service we have to order them breakfast food, which they already had at breakfast plus you are stuck in the room till your order comes since they can’t bring it anywhere but your room.  Then dinner doesn’t start till 6:30 but the kids eat at 5 so yet again you are ordering room service but now the lunch menu, plus you are confined to your room once again.  So the kids miss out on eat anything off the dinner menu.  We spoke to our concierge about this and early in the week he said he would not be able to do anything about it because that is how the hotel policy is but then towards the middle of week he would try to go in the back and request the chiefs to make us some food early for the kids.  I know he was given a hard time each meal by the staff for not following the policy.   This was very stressful for the parents because when lunch and dinner time came around we would have to preorder the food to ensure we would have it on time for the kids.  Half of the day went in us stressing out of what to do for meals, this should not have been the case in an all inclusive resort.  Older children would be able to wait until the restaurant open for meal times but how do you expect young kids to wait that long?  
Over all we were very disappointed with our stay at The Paradisus Punta Cana The Reserve, especially with the whole Family concierge concept.  I regret to say this but we would not recommend this resort to anyone, especially families with children.  We really feel the money and effort we spent for a nice family vacation was wasted and regret booking with this resort.  In an all inclusive vacation the resort makes the vacation memorable and in our case it made a bad memory of a vacation.

reviews.author: NevioSavieto
reviews.title: RESORT 5 ESTRELAS SÓ NO NOME
reviews.text:
Serviço de limpeza de quarto péssimo, todo dia era preciso implorar para limpeza.
Restaurantes a la carte deixaram muito a desejar
Nos acessos externos ao quarto, as fossas liberavam cheiro de esgoto o dia todo, até na área do Royal Service
Falta de informações, no primeiro dia, o jantar foi alterado de lugar e ninguém nos comunicou.
Ar condicionado no quarto precário, internet precária

reviews.author: W_Wonka13
reviews.title: Lower your expectations!
reviews.text:
The check-in process is a mess....especially if you are a large group.  We are a family of 9 with three rooms reserved. The check in took 2 hours -yikes!  Two hours at these rates is irritating and it took away the best hours of sun for that day. 
As an all inclusive resort you have the usual buffets but the real goal is to reserve at the "special" themed restaurants. Problem is that if you ask the front desk, we checked in at the reserve, they tell you they will try to make reservation but they lie.  When you go back and ask what happened they say the reservations desk closes at 5:00 PM. 
Yes they do put the hard sell on for a "tour". This is actually the time share pitch mentioned in other reviews. The buffet is nice the first couple of times but gets tiresome when you can't book alternatives.  
The hotel staff are numerous and friendly but with the exception of the pool staff they smile, affirm their cooperation and then don't deliver. I think this is part of the training process.  Keep smiling even though you know you can't really make something happen. The guest will move on and ask someone else or just jump in the pool or get a drink. 

We have four days left. Things could improve.  If they do we'll update this review. At the moment this feels very underwhelming  for an exotic place that is in the $$$$ category!

reviews.author: Babyk09
reviews.title: Not a very pleasant experience
reviews.text:
Stayed at Palma Real resort four nights in last week with my wife and daughter.  I am still diarrhea as of now writing this review. 

Let me talk about the good experience first.  We arrived at the resort around 11:00 am, the room is not ready yet.  The front desk arranged us to take a shower at the hostility room so we can changed our clothes, which is very good as we took a very early fly to Punta Cano.  After we have a lunch, the room is ready.  The resort lobby is beautiful, the pool, beach and sand are all met our expectation.  Overall, I could not complain the services, every services man and woman are friendly and said hello everywhere and any time.

The negative experience: 1. The safe box in the hotel room not working.  we called the front desk, they sent a maintainer guy to fix it.  After the guy left, we putted stuff in the safe box and closed it.  Not able to open the box as we followed the instruction step by step.  We called again, the maintainer guy came and spent sometimes to open the box but unable to fix it.  So, they brought another.  The new one was not in working condition too.  After waste at least 2 hours for the safe box issue, we finally gave up as we were about hour late to our first dinner reservation.  
2. The Light in the showroom is not work too, we were forced to take a shower in a almost dark environment.  3. The showroom water flow out are so slow, we either have to take a quick show in less than 2 minutes or make a stop in the middle of show, and wait at least 15 minutes then turned on water again. 4. Very poor Wifi Internet connection, almost not existed.
After talked to the front desk on the next date, they did offer other two rooms for us to change.  We didn't make the change because the road construction work were in front of these two rooms and created huge noise.  My daughter has to take nap every noon time, and it was too tired to pack everything and move to another room which is no better then current one. 5. This is the main reason I list this experience as two star. I became diarrhea on the fourth day of my stay.  I don't know why, should be food-fish at the buffet restaurant, but my wife and my daughter are ok.  As of now almost a week after returned from the trip, I am still diarrhea.  I think I should visit doctor's office over the weekend.  In conclusion, I think I might want to go back in the future, but not at the price we paid.  My wife said "NO & Never"

reviews.author: karine k
reviews.title: décevant
reviews.text:
Nous rentrons d'un séjour d'une semaine dans cet hotel et nous n'avons pas passé un séjour de reve.Cet hotel est surdimensionné la nourriture est vraiment limitte dans tous les restaurants.Heureusement nous avons payé un droit d'entrée pour la réserve et y avons passé toute la semaine.Aprés avoir passé plusieurs vacances à l'ILE MAURICE nous n'avons pas du tout apprécié Punta Cana et ce type d'hotellerie gigantesque ne nous satisfait pas.
Cependant,les chambres sont agréables et propres et la plage de l'hotel est trés belle voici les deux points positifs.

reviews.author: stilltraveling_13
reviews.title: A beautiful resort but...
reviews.text:
I just returned from a week at the Paradisus Palma Real with my family. 

The resort is beautiful and has a beautiful beach which is perfect for swimming.  There were plenty of beach chairs and huts available.  The pools was also beautiful although it was not heated so it was too cold to swim in.  The pool has plenty of seating as well, although the practice of going out and putting down towels to "save" chairs is rampant so you really do need to get out there early if you want a spot at the pool.  The best employees we encountered were Luis and the rest of the bartenders at the pool bar.  

Unfortunately, the rest of our experience with this place wasn't so positive.  We arrived at 3pm, the resort's posted check in time and were told that our room wasn't ready and that we would be shown to a restaurant where we would have lunch, after which time our room would be ready.  We were exhausted from our long trip and just wanted to get to our room to relax but we understand that sometimes the rooms aren't ready exactly at the posted check in time.  After lunch we returned to the front desk for the remainder of our painful check in experience.  The employees seem unmotivated to work any faster than a snail's place.  After standing at the front desk for about 45 minutes (there was no one in front of me on line), I was told that it would be another 45 minutes to an hour before our room would be ready and so they were going to change my room.  I was unhappy about this since we were meeting other family members at the resort and were supposed to be in the room next to them but I agreed since we would be moved to another room in the same building but on a different floor.  We were finally shown to our room nearly 2 hours after arriving at the resort.  Unfortunately, as soon as we walked into the room, we were hit by the overwhelming smell of mold/mildew.  I returned to the front desk and insisted that we would not stay in that room.  We were then re-assigned to another room but were now in a different building from the rest of our family members.
Upon walking into our new room, all of the windows were open and there was no obvious issue.  However, what we quickly discovered was the unpleasant odor of sewer gas each time we returned to the room.  We believe that the smell was coming from the sink and jacuzzi tub drains, and the cleaning people would close the sink drains each time they cleaned in an attempt to minimize the odor but it really didn't help.  The lock on our sliding door to the balcony was completely broken off, although we did not complain about this since we were on the third floor of the building.  
Housekeeping was not good at all and we often had to call to request that someone come clean our room.  They advertise that the minibar is re-filled daily but we often had to call to get it re-filled and consistently throughout the week found water bottles in our mini-bar that had evidently been re-filled because the safety caps had clearly been previously opened.  

When the rest of our family arrived we went to their rooms and discovered that there was a water balloon in their freezer and a half eaten bag of chips in the room.  Clearly their room had not been well cleaned and also had the same sewer smell, although not nearly as strong as in my room.  Housekeeping also spends most of the day in each building and you consistently hear them yelling across the building to each other and hear carts banging into things and dishes clattering.  

We regularly ate at all of the restaurants included in the Paradisus Real all inclusive plan.  The hibachi restaurant was the best but was still average at best.  We consistently found bones and cartilage in our burritos or other food with shredded chicken or beef.
