The service at all restaurants and bars was poor and we often ate entire meals while still waiting to get our drinks.  At one meal, I actually got so frustrated after reminding the waitress twice about our drinks that I got up from the table, walked out of the restaurant and to a bar to get our own drinks.  The drinks were hit or miss, with about 50% of the drinks being so poorly made that they were actually undrinkable.  

We ordered room service for breakfast most days, which was probably the best food we had all week.  Any dinners that we ordered through room service were horrible.  The food arrived cold.  A  Club Sandwich consisted of 3 slices of stale white bread with ONE slice of ham and ONE slice of cheese.  
We did schedule a scuba trip from the resort to Catalina Island and had an excellent experience.  The dive masters were very personable and helpful.  The dive locations were great and the time we spent on Catalina was extremely relaxing.  The only complaint that I have about the dive experience is that the wetsuit they brought for me was a men's medium (I am a very slim female) which was completely baggy on me and therefore did not keep me warm at all.
On our final night, immediately after I showered, my boyfriend went in to shower only to discover that there was no water in the shower.  We called the front desk and were told that there was a problem that was being repaired.  We waited an hour and a half before he finally ended up taking an ice cold bath in the jacuzzi tub (without hot water, no water would come out of the shower) since our family had waited an hour for us to go to dinner and finally left without us.

Overall, although this resort was beautiful, we would never return to this resort.

reviews.author: Dana B
reviews.title: Disappointing Service
reviews.text: The resort is really lovely, and they seem to cater to large groups, but I wouldn't recommend it for a couple or relaxing family vacation.  I've only been once, but I was pretty disappointed in the service level.  The check in process took an exhorbitant amount of time because they shuttled you between different people and rooms to try to upsell you on upgrades and sign you up for timeshare sessions.  We almost missed lunch because of it.  I was sick for 24 hours after eating the lobster in the seafood restaurant on the beach (great view though).  My biggest frustration was the lack of WiFI.  I'd planned to Facetime with my kids each night and couldn't at all because the WiFi service was almost non existent.  I complained vehemently to several people after I couldn't event get service in the lobby (even though I'd been told the lobby had the strongest signal).  I asked to speak to the GM and was told they were not available (repeatedly), and the GM never even called me.  I was also told the IT manager was going to come to my room to try to help (although I'm not sure what could be done) - they never came.  The jets in our jacuzzi tub were broken.  Our "concierge" was really more of a timeshare salesman who slightly harassed us everytime he saw us about coming to a timeshare presentation.  The property seemed so large that there was very little focus on customer service.  I would not come back.

reviews.author: viajerosAsturias
reviews.title: Gran Lujo/Gran decepción
reviews.text:
Teniamos grandes expectativas respecto a este hotel pero nos ha decepcionado enormemente.
 
Nos hospedamos en este hotel del 05-01-13 al 12-01-13 y una semana antes del viaje y tambien a nuestra llegada al hotel solicitamos una salida tardía del hotel el día 12 pero han sido incapaces de gestionar nuestra petición en todo este tiempo y finalmente mañana debemos abandonar la habitación a las 12:00 y eso que estabamos dispuestos a pagar los 200$ (una pasta) que nos pedían por dejarnos la habitación hasta las 19:00, pues ni con esas, segun ellos por falta de disponibilidad de habitaciones. 
El resto de solicitudes que hicimos via correo electrónico previas a nuestra llegada tampoco fueron atendidas y tras enviarles varios correos nos contestan diciendo que pensaban que teniamos la reserva en el hotel Reserva Paradisus Punta Cana, osea que poco más llegamos y no tenemos ni habitación.

Este hotel pretende ser un gran lujo pero a nuestro entende no lo es y ahora me explico.

El día que llegamos a las 11 de la noche no solo no nos hicieron el habitual recibimiento que suelen hacer en otros hoteles de este nivel en los que te ofrecen algo para tomar sino que ni siquiera nos indicaron donde podiamos comer algo ni nos indicaron que podiamos llamar al servicio de habitaciones que es de 24 horas y cuyo carta de contenido no encontramos por ningún lado en la habitación y que a día de hoy seguimos sin tener. Además en otros hoteles incluso de un nivel inferior a este te suelen dejar algo de fruta en la habitación el día de la llegada y hay amenidades en el minibar pero en este nada de nada. La guia de las instalaciones y de uso de los restaurantes nos los dieron solo en inglés cosa que me llama la atención y además no nos explicaron nada a nuestra llegada si bien al día siguiente muy amablemente Hugo "Boss" nos dio un detalle de las mismas y nos hizo las reservas de los restaurantes a la carta .

El servicio de los restaurantes buffet es desastroso, es imposible encontrar una mesa que este totalmentre preparada para comer o desayunar, a la que no le faltan los vasos le faltan los cubiertos y al que no las servilletas. Tienes que andar buscando a un camarero para que te vaya dando poco a poco todo lo que te falta lo cual te puede llevar entre unas cosas y las otras tus diez minutos. A eso falta sumar el tiempo que te puede llevar el que te sirvan el agua o el cafe y si pides algo diferente ya ni te cuento, puedes terminar de comer o desayunar y seguir esperando. En fin deben de mejorar enormemente la coordinación del personal en el servicio de comidas porque llega a ser desesperante.

Por otro lado el equipo de animación en compración con otros hoteles es inapreciable, no solo no se les ve por el hotel sino que ni siquiera hay un folleto con el horario de las actividades y si quieres conocerlas debes descargarte la aplicación para la tablet o el teléfono móvil.

Lo mejor del hotel es el servicio de bar en la piscina y la playa.

La calidad de la comida es bastante buena sobretodo en los restaurantes de especialidades aunque se agradecería mayor variedad en el buffet de la comida.

En resumen me da la impresión de que es un hotel que debe mejorar sobre en todo en cuanto a la atención a los clientes y sus solicitudes asi como en el servicio de comidas porque la calidad-precio es bastante discutible.

Espero que les haya servido este comentario y si deciden visitar este hotel tengan mejor suerte que nosotros.

reviews.author: John R
reviews.title: What you need to know
reviews.text:
The positives. This is a very beautiful complex, beautiful room, beautiful setting on a lovely beach. Very clean and for the most part the staff is friendly but if you do not speak spanish the language barrier can be an issue.

The negatives of which there are a few. There are different levels of service  and we agreed to be upgraded to the Reserve service which gives you access to another of their hotels down the street, additional restaurants and pool/beach areas. What we were not told was this is primarily for families and there are lots of kids, whom I adore, but went as a couple. What they did not tell me was the highest level of service is Royal and even though this is where are room was located they never mentioned the service available. Royal has their own private lounge, restaurant, spa, pools and basically conceirge/butler service. They also have what they call premium liquor which, was sort of a joke because it is the same alchohol offered through-out the complex. The difference in the Royal service the booze is not mixed with water like the rest of the complex. We are not big drinkers but we did enjoy having a couple of drinks at night and the occassional mudslide on the beach. Trust me they water down the alchohol significantly. It was noticeable how many all inclusive pro's had there own bottles stuck in baby strollers or beach bags.

The food is atrocious, almost unedible. There are a couple of the fancier restaurants where it was edible but 5 star it is not more like 1 or 2. It is very apparent that food is recycled and kept around for several days. What should be hot is cold and what should be cold is warm and in many cases soggy. Became very ill the first night eating grilled lobster tails that were served within 2 minutes of ordering them, had to pry out of the shell with a chisel and were like chewing on a rubber snake. Woke up in the middle of the night very ill and felt that way for 48 hours. The rest of the week was a guessing game as to what you were willing to take your chances on to eat so you eat very little. It was that bad.

We have a tendency to tip quite nicely and even in doing so, you generally had to ask 3-4 times for anything and even then you were lucky to be serviced.  Many times we just walked away and said skip it. This was true in the diningrooms, beach service and the bars.

On the 4th day my partner finally blew a gasket and that was after we tried to find a flight to get out of there asap without luck,  and had a rather frank conversation with one of the top managers and they refunded our Reserve service upgrade and comped us the last two days in Royal service area. The last two days were pleasant, no watered down alchohol, food that was edible and reasonably fresh for the resort, nice service on the beach.

Would I ever go back? That will not happen which is kind of a shame because it really is a beautiful, clean although rather big complex. But the negatives of really bad food, really bad drinks and really bad service left to much of a sour taste in our mouths. I for one would have gladly paid more money for fresh food and for drinks that did not have water poured in the booze bottles once they were half empty and I would not tip a soul until you receive what you ask for. I would definately stay away. Interesting if you read the negative comments you will see a response from the manager and they say the same thing on every one and if this review gets a response, I suspect it will be their generic response.

reviews.author: Nathalie L
reviews.title: Une déception littéralement
reviews.text: Nous revenons a peine du paradisus nous y étions du 8 au 15 décembre 2012. Au départ a notre arrivée a l'hotel notre chambre n'était pas prête, nous avons du attendre plus de 3 hres pour pouvoir enfin nous s'y installer apres un vol de 4h15. Pour poursuivre notre aventure tout ce que nous avions d'inclus supposément dans notre forfait et chambre n'y était pas vraiment..... sur le total des restaurants a la carte seulement 3 étaient ouvert ??? donc dans la meme semaine nous avons mangé 2 fois dans chacuns des restaurants et le menu est sans variation d'un soir a l'autres avec peu de diversité. Il nous aurait fallu passer plus de temps au service a la clientèle qu'a profiter de nos vacances. Le réseau internet ne fonctionne pas bien. Le service de serveur  a la piscine et a la plage est difficile. Notre chambre a été oublié certain jour pour un entretient il nous a fallu appeller encore au service a la clientèle et pour finir la boucle nos bagages on été envoyés avec l'autobus d'un groupe quand pour notre part avions un transport privé pour nos déplacement entre l'aéroport et l'hotel le jour de notre retour a la maison hors donc avons du faire des recherches pour retrouver nos effets qui étaient rendu avant nous pour reprendre l'avion mais nous ne le savions pas oufffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff. La nourriture au Buffet Naos est toujours froide mais tout de meme avec une belle variété. Nous n'avions qu'une semaine disponible pour voyager cette année et croyant que ce 5* était exceptionnel nous avons investi plus de 5000.00$ pour celle-ci vous dire si je le recommande pas du tout vraiment plus que décevant . Mise a part un jeune serveur tres courtois qu'il faut souligner Angel Luis qui s'est préocupé de nous voyant que nous accusions tant de déception .......... Plus jamais je ne retournerai meme en service royale dans cette établissement

reviews.author: antonio D
reviews.title: IS PARADISUS PALMA REAL STEALING VACATIONERS’ MONEY?
reviews.text:
IS PARADISUS PALMA REAL STEALING VACATIONERS’ MONEY?
This resort is located in the Dominican Republic. The beach was lovely. The resort area was truly tropical. I enjoyed the sounds of the rain falling on the roof, the wind ruffling the trees, then the bright clear skies that followed. The resort staff was friendly. That was the good part. 
What follows is not good.
High humidity in any closed environment leads to mold and mildew. The mold and mildew is everywhere; in the air conditioned ducts; in the sofa, the curtains, the bed spread, the sheets and pillow cases.  It affects your health badly.
The design of the resort has a major flaw; the sun and the wind are not allowed to flow into some of the suites. The closets and the toilets are dark and damp. The window in the bedroom cannot be left open because it faces the incoming rain.
The patio door cannot be left open because of mosquitoes and gnats. There are no more orifices for natural ventilation or sunlight. 
One method that can eliminate this problem is to keep all the rooms at constant temperature i.e. at or below 77 0 F.  This would be a huge financial burden on the resort. 
The next method and the preferred one is to keep the customers ignorant, deny that the problem exists, and do nothing about it
This is stealing money since services are paid for and they are not being delivered.
I suffered severe itching, respiratory distress and lack of sleep.
In addition, I am still suffering from respiratory distress and itching.
The food at all but one of the restaurants is bland.
If you crave hard liquor 24 x 7, enjoy food that is sort of OK , and you do not mind throwing away you hard earned money to a 2 star resort masquerading as a five star then book the Paradisus Palma Real( A REAL IMITATION  5 STAR RESORT!). 
If the health of you and your loved ones is not important, then this is the place for you.
CHOOSE WISELY!!

reviews.author: Sanders J
reviews.title: Our expectations were not met
reviews.text:
Looking at the reviews my husband and I were excited for this vacation. We've been all over the Caribbean and to Punta Cana 2 times before. We paid almost 2K (From Toronto) and were expecting a 5star but were completely let down. 
The timeshare salesmen were relentless, after we refused them 3 times they finally stopped harassing us. We paid a lot of money to go on vacation and that's the last thing we wanted.
The food was edible, nothing fancy. There was a variety of food but nothing spectacular. They also reheat the food from breakfast to lunch and sometimes into the dinner buffet.
The rooms were disgusting. I found hairs in the sheets and sinks. The toilet was clogged twice and the showers were not cleaned thoroughly.
The beach was the only redeeming factor was the beach, though I wish there were more sun huts. It was impossible to save one before 9am.

I

reviews.author: D I
reviews.title: Beautiful Place, Terrible Service - Avoid
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was, in kind words, not the relaxing, pleasant vacation we hoped for. I have traveled to a lot of places around the world, and been to neighboring 5-star resorts. The service here was terrible, and value we received from the get go was MAYBE 2 or 3-stars (not 5). So stay somewhere else.

Just to clarify as to WHY I say that, from the get-go we had issues. They changed our reservation from the standard king-size bed to two doubles. When we talked to them about it, they said push the beds together - multiple times. That was a no-go for us (since we just got engaged the day before). Then after fighting with them for hours (after a 12-hour trip BTW), they put us in a room with a king-sized bed, but we lost our ocean view. Also, they wouldn't clean the room - there was "something" on the walls in the toilet room. It took us 3 times to get someone to clean it. Then the minibar guy walked in on us showering, and DIDN'T immediately leave - just did his thing. Lack of respect for privacy. Not to mention the time when we came back from lunch to change for the beach and they were caulking the shower in the middle of our stay, stinking up the room with fumes. The three people caulking the shower wouldn't leave so we could change - we had to get the manager. Still puzzled as to why it took 3-people to caulk a shower. Speaking as the son of a handyman, and someone who has had to caulk their own bathroom in a renovation, they did a half-*** job. Just saying.

For an all-inclusive, it took us until the LAST DAY to get snacks in the room. For 5-star all inclusive, and I can't get some chips - that's wrong. And there was not a drop of hard-liquor or wine in the minibar either. Not the "fully stocked" as is listed in the description.

Plus, it took until day 3 just to get some stinking washcloths. Not joking.

I'm not even going to get into the sales pitch they want you to go through. Our concierge, who initially was great, asked for us to go so he could get the bonus. Fine, but the French sales director was a jerk. I don't go on vacation to get pressured into financing a trip package roughly the cost of a car, just to get insulted on top of it. The resort credits given for that time had so many conditions on use, we couldn't use any without spending more money.

The redeeming quality of this place was the setting. The pool and beach really are beautiful. Also, the attitude of several of the restaurant wait staff was superb. They weren't always on the ball with their service, but they were usually very nice and friendly. That goes a long way when 2-3 hours of each day of your vacation is trying to get something with your room resolved.

So, long story short, don't stay here. Go somewhere else. And since this is a Melia resort, if I were you, I'd avoid all those too. My fiance, soon to be wife, and I won't be considering those places for our honeymoon. Or any future trips. We were kinda glad all this happened on this trip, so we knew where NOT to go on our honeymoon.

Best wishes to you in your search - I hope you've found this review helpful. May you have safe travels, and happy memories thereof.

reviews.author: Maria Elena E
reviews.title: Decayendo
reviews.text:
Vengo llegando de una estadia de 1 semana con toda mi familia en el Paradisus,si bién todo estuvo muy bueno debo reconocer que la calidad del servicio y de las comidas han ido decayendo con los años,me alojo en este hotel desde el año 2004 y con mucha pena debo decir que cada año veo que la calidad del servicio empeora,hasta su gente que era tan alegre y amable esta vez los encontré más apagados,menos atentos,las piñas coladas de aquellos años nada tienen que ver con el juguito de piña que te sirven ahora,restaurantes cerrados,varias reposeras en mal estado,toallas de playa deshilachadas,poca variedad en las comidas,en la ducha el agua sale caliente,el baño sin aire acondicionado,las toallas de cara pequeñas (que antes ponian 3) hay ahora que pedirlas y te ponen solo 1,ya no más apetizer de playa en Royal Service,cero aire acondicionado en los restaurantes,lo que hace a veces insufrible comer ahí...en fin para mi próximo viaje a Punta Cana escogeré con toda seguridad otro hotel...porque este dejó de ser un hotel de lujo y de las 5 estrellas ya va en 4.
Lo que no cambia es la alegría y atención de Pedro en Royal Service de la playa..solo por él volveríamos, un encanto de persona que a lo largo de todos estos años sigue igual.
Si no haces reserva antes de las 5 de la tarde para cenar en algún restaurant tienes que ir al Gaby de la Reserva donde es imposible soportar el calor y la humedad de ese lugar con ventiladores en el techo que de NADA sirven ante la humedad del lugar...y si llegas después de las 20 hrs la comida escasea y la variedad es mínima...una mala experiencia La Reserva.
Bueno espero que el Gerente del Paradisus lea este comentario y se ponga las pilas para retomar lo que un día FUÉ ese maravilloso hotel y recupere todo lo que se ha perdido con los años.

reviews.author: manny e
reviews.title: Very dissapointed! Not the Same!  Please be carefull!
reviews.text:
We are a repeated client. 1st time i was there was in Septemper of 2010 and we had a great experience with Paradisus. After that we visited several more hotels witch where not at the same level as paradisus but adversited as a 5 star hotel ( fine we learned our lesson - you pay what you get ) I didn't want to take a chance on not having a GREAT experience again so i decided to go back to paradisus since we were very happy from our last visit. 

1st of all we did our reservations Direct with them with : Loremy Sanchez / Reservation Agent Groups & Local Market  Tel: +809.221.1111 Ext: 8433 | Fax: +809.552.0572
Mail: loremys@solmelia-caribe.com Paradisus Agent. I specificlly informed them this is our anyversary visit. Boy they disregarded that! they tried to make it right on check IN by giving us another room wich is bigger. ( they did but they put us in a room that you have to walk like a MILE to get to the bar - Beach or pool area --> that my freind SUCKS ) 

2nd- They advertise International Drinks ( johnny walker - Vodka Absolute & more ) Boy we where wrong - NO BARS had, when we requested why? they had to go to manager to obtain a bottle witch was already open. WTF? Even one of the bar personal told us this is the Slow time of the season so managers are cutting up Expenses ---- what the %^# do we care! we payd over $1150.00 for a 3 day stay. No champaign becouse they run out. Cheap drinks witch will leave you with a HANGOVER! guaranteed! 

3rd- They never have reservations for the restaurants they have available. the buffett is great as long as it inside the hotel in PARADISUS PALMA REAL. I say inside that resort since they have another sister hotel located next to them and they send us there instead due to they closed down their original buffett since there wasnt that many members! we went to have dinner there WOW that SUCKS! maybe 3 variaty of dishes and its just Sad to see how they have lacked in the preffesion.

This is one of the best hotels or was in my opinion, and they lost a customer that goes at least 1 a year. Very poor treatment when it comes on what they adversite. 

Staff is very freindly and allways available to help out. But the management sucks! I will not recommend this hotel even if they give me a free stay.

reviews.author: bbfarm2012
reviews.title: No es un hotel gran lujo
reviews.text:
Acabamos de pasar siete dias en este hotel y hay cosas que no entiendo ocurran en un hotel calificado como "gran lujo" :
Toallas de la piscina con agujeros,hamacas de la playa manchadas de batido y no limpiadas,botellas de agua o vasos sin recoger en la piscina.
Limpieza de las habitaciones deficiente(protector salva slip de otra persona en cajón de mi mesilla,pie del wc lleno de pelos dia tras día,tapiceria de las sillas y sofá lleno de manchas).
No se recogian las bandejas del servicio de habitaciones puestas en el suelo de los pasillos hasta el día siguiente.
La atención del personal de los restaurantes deja mucho que desear por cosas como:pedir más de tres veces agua y que no te rellenen el vaso,no te ofrecian bebida siempre que te sentabas a comer,no recogian los platos que utilizabas a lo largo de la comida y los tenías que poner en la mesa de al lado a modo de torre(los veían y pasaban totalmente de recogerlos)
Los sillones azules del restaurante de la playa estan manchados de caca de pajaros en vez de limpiarlos les dan la vuelta.
Cenamos sólo en dos restaurantes a la carta y en ninguno pude tomar postre porque se habia acabado la opción que no tenía chocolate y nadie ofreció nada.
Pasividad total y absoluta del personal.
En la piscina nadie te ofrecia nada tenias que moverte tu a todos sitios buffet, bar...si querias una bebida o algo de comer.
Por todos estos detalles no es un hotel de gran lujo y la relación calidad-precio no es acorde.
Están más preocupados de venderte upgrade de habitación, royal service,resort credits...que de atender en condiciones al huesped.
He de decir que el personal de recepción es correcto así como los camareros del bar de la piscina.

reviews.author: RomaBuongustaio
reviews.title: Scarso!
reviews.text:
Premesso che ai Caraibi, con la stessa cifra si trova molto di meglio, il resort Palma Real non è niente di ché; avevamo una suite con il royal service (che loro pubblicizzano molto e che se proprio volete andare vi consiglio di fare perché senza è ancora peggio!), che dire...il mare è pieno di alghe (anche in Messico è così in questo periodo ma i resort puliscono almeno la spiaggia), il servizio in camera ci mette la media di due ore se sei fortunato che qualcuno ti risponda, al di fuori del royal service i ristoranti sono scarsissimi e il casinò è tristissimo. Note positive solo la spiaggia privata e il lettino King se fai il royal service. Le suite sono molto modeste.
Per finire, racconto un grave episodio capitatoci: la donna delle pulizie ha lasciato completamente aperta la nostra stanza e mi hanno rubato il tablet...il Resort, ovviamente, non ha fatto nulla, devo aggiungere altro?
Lo sconsiglio vivamente!

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Beautiful place, but service was horrible
reviews.text: We went to this resort for a short trip and left feeling bitter and jilted. The service stunk. We never received our "credits" and didn't find out until the day before we left that we have to ask for them, people who don't know to ask don't get them. The lights in our room repeatedly went out and were slow to come back on. The smoke alarm in our room was low on batteries so it beeped every 5 minutes. We asked for assistance in taking care of that over and over again. When we left it was still beeping. They never fixed it. Many of the employees there were very nice, but most were rude and treated us like a bother. On the plus side, it was quiet, there weren't very many people or crowds, it was gorgeous, and had plenty of good food. But overall, I'm pretty sure I won't be returning to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Rob W
reviews.title: *** Please Read Before Booking ***
reviews.text:
This hotel was by far one of the worst I have ever been to in terms of service.  Do NOT book the Private Services as you will just be throwing money down the drain.  I can tell you that on a daily basis when on the private beach, the hoodlums from the hotel next to you constantly come over and invade your privacy, the security does nothing about it unless you escalate to the front desk (basically taking away time from your supposed 'relaxinhg vacation'.  And god forbid you dont speak english, you are ignored constantly unless you pump the waiters and bar tenders with cash - on top of the $ you already spent on the all inclusive vacation.  

There are PLENTY of other places available for less money - if you can stand an hour + ride to Excellence, that resort blew this one out of the water.  The only saving grace for this trip was the butler assigned to us by the name of Carlos Pepen, had it not been for him we would have been out of this resort on Day2 - although the guy cant be around at your every meal.  The ongoing joke was what will take longer to get a drink served to you (including water) or the main course at every meal.  

The beach is groomed in the AM - however by about noon its full of seaweed and is unwalkable as it dries up and becomes like thorns stabbing into your feet.  Also if you like to snorkel around the resort - wrong place to come, there was nothing in the water other then garbage thrown in by the party boats which park out front and blast music trying to drum up business.  yeah great way to relax, watching a 'Cancun like' party boat park for 3 hours in front of your beach chair blasting LMFAO.  

And walk the beach at your own risk - there are plenty of shady people there trying to sell you anything from boat rides to ganja - and believe me if you flashed a wad of cash they would probably try to roll you.

Positives as I am tired of slamming the resort - its too easy.

The resort itself is beautiful, the people who work there - couldnt be bothered for the most part.  We stayed in room 1109 which was a short distance to the beach and had a private pool which was nice - however there was not a moment when the token 'fat guy' doesnt sit down and spark up a stogie and blow the smoke in your direction..  Also the pillow service they offer is great - we did get a good night sleep, only to come back to dreading the day.  

I left the resort more stressed out then when I arrived - not a way to spend your vacation when you are shelling out well over $4K for a couple.

reviews.author: Jeremiah T
reviews.title: Unthinkable
reviews.text: My family is well traveled, we just took our 3rd trip, this one was by far the worst, soon as we landed, they try to sell membership to no end, we resisted, once we went to room, he calls and suggested we meet in breakfast for 90 min and we get coupon for restaurant, who cares? So finally we relented to hear him out, they advertise wifi in room, it doesnt work, it comes on for a second, off for several min, cant do anything, I called that evening, they said they'd fix it, never did, we stated there 10 full days, next water leak on fridge, caused me to fall badly, called numerous times, ok they say, left without fixing, next, calling all inclusive in room dining, good luck, they hardly answer, u call for help? they tell u keep calling, we ate out 3 times, food is below avg, bland.. worst, my wife tried 3 times to reserve at Italian place, no luck. i personally talked to manager on 4th attempt, apologized and said hed put us for that night, went there, not on list.. highly incompetent people there who lack service skills, ive never experienced anything like is. bright spot, Reynaldo Cabrera, peter frias, ricardo at cafeteria waiter.. it was unreal. had to call daily for towels, they dont leave enough, i definitely will never return to that place, even for free, so many places to see for half the cost with better food, if high on wifi, dont believe they will provide in room, we met several people that said same thing, like any other hotel, walk all the way to lobby which is mile away it seems.. stay away if possible.

reviews.author: Tomas B
reviews.title: Demasiadas espectativas para lo que realmente fue
reviews.text:
Viaje en Junio 2012 con mi familia, mi padre, mi hermano con su mujer y sus dos niños, de 4 años y 7 años. Viajamos en esa epoca porque sabiamos que era una temporada baja/intermedia y el hotel no iba a estar desbordado de gente. No fallamos, nos encontramos con un hotel a un 30 por ciento de se capacidad. nos encontramos con un hotel espectacular, con unas piscinas enormes, miles de palmeras. Habitaciones hermosas, con excelente aire acondicionado y servicios. 

Los problemas surgieron cuando mi hermano quiso llevar a sus hijos al club de niños con el que cuenta el hotel, del cual estabamos enterados de antemano, y resulto que la mas pequeña no tenia edad suficiente (el año pasado con tan solo 3 años fue incluida en otro hotel del caribe). Como resultado de este contratiempo, el mayor tampoco quiso quedarse solo y asi comenzo a modificarse la razones por las cuales habiamos elegido este hotel, donde los niños estarian contenidos gran parte del dia, asi los adultos tendria tiempo de relajación. Otro problema que tuvimos, fue durante todas las cenas que hicimos en los distintos restaurantes en los que hay que reservar. Las cuatro veces, reservamos en el horario de las 21 hs, pero por razones normales, nunca nos sentábamos antes de las 21.20 hs. Ni bien nos sentábamos, nos recibian siempre de la misma forma,-MIRE QUE A LAS 22 HS CIERRA LA COCINA, una forma muy descortés de informar que la velada iba a ser a las apuradas. Nunca en mi vida de viajero fui tratado de esa manera en un restaurante de un hotel. 

Cuando uno viaja, estas cosas lo molestan un poco, pero no por eso hemos pasado malas vacaciones. El destino es hermoso, el hotel es un paraíso. Pero un hotel 5 estrellas no es solo infraestructura, también es la capacidad para mantener al viajero cómodo y sin contratiempos

reviews.author: Jessa2911
reviews.title: 5 star NOT 5 star service or worth price of inclusive
reviews.text: After having never been out of the country this was something to look forward to, but not after our experience... As stated in many other reviews this facility is clean and beautiful and the beach takes your breath away and the pools are wonderful. However the food is only so so. The food is better in the restaurants that you need a reservation for, but still not over the top. The drinks are NOT strong. We had to change rooms because the hot water didn't work. The air in your rooms is always musty (can't handle taking the humidity out I guess) Its interesting they want to watch water conservation and towels but the showers leak into the bathroom area floor all over. Hmmm... Now, for every 3 or 4 persons working there that couldn't answer our questions or help us there were one or two persons that were great. The people there are friendly but then again we are not fluent in spanish so who knows. Also WATCH it on the excursions several of them are all dayers so if you go to them guess what you are not around to take advantage of your all inclusive fees you have paid. They will try and get you to go on them the first time you arrive. The excursion Bravaro runners was very interesting because you learn about the country (the horses you ride looked emaciated)  (All day) the dune buggies excursion only half day but make sure you are ok with your little buggie maybe falling apart. Keep an Open Mind. The Sanoma Island excursion (ALL DAY) probably NOT worth it. Hour and a half drive on a coach bus to get there (I got nauseated) then an hour boat ride to swim in ocean then another 20 min to Island. There you just watch everyone get sumburned and tipsy. Not a good combo. We did not get back to hotel till 7:30 after having left at 7:30am! Overall probably wouldn't recommend this place for the money spent.

reviews.author: OKreview
reviews.title: Royal service Palma real
reviews.text: We are here as we speak. While the bar tenders are wonderful, Malvis the royal service supervisor doesn't seem  too concerned about making her guests happy. She seems to be disconnected and unsympathetic. Many mistakes have occurred, and there is no urgency to make guests feel better. The resort is absolutely beautiful but for an expensive vacation, the managers should be at least willing to make accommodations better. Let me re-emphaize that the staff such as the waiters, bartenders and spa hosts have been fantastic. It is simply the higher ups that seem to feel they are unappreciative that guests are here and unhappy. We have stayed at other Paradisus resorts and were made to feel special and welcome. Several guests checking out today recommended we leave and go to Santuarry or Iberostar Grand. Other guests we have conversed with at the pool have been just as unhappy as we are so apparently it is not just our bad luck. It's been very disappointing sadly to say and honestly it may worth it to check out and go to the other rec'd hotel.

reviews.author: Gisella17
reviews.title: Bonitas instalaciones pero pesimo servicio
reviews.text: Tomamos el Royal Service pero no vale la pena, todo se queda en buenas intenciones Ofrecen cosas que no pueden hacer. Que pena porque el hotel es muy bonito pero la administracion no tiene un buen manejo de la gente.

reviews.author: Raul V
reviews.title: In my personal experience one of the worst I have ever had
reviews.text: If you ever go to this Hotel place make sure they advise you everything, and they treat you for what you pay. If I can rate this Hotel, except for certain things I will surely make a 2 star hotel , but with a price of a 5 Start Hotel , I don't recommend anyone to go to this Hotel, but If you have to go before confirming your reservation make sure everything is totally clear.

reviews.author: travelbug185
reviews.title: Be aware
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Punta Cana in search of a resort for my daughter's wedding next summer.  We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for our first two nights and the Iberostar Grand the following two nights.  Believe me, there is no comparison in the two...Iberostar Grand FAR exceeds the Palma Real.  I travel quite extensively and do have upper end tastes so keep that in mind as you read this. 

My first recommendation is to know that there are only three non-buffet restaurants available for non Reserve and non Royal Service guests without extra charges.  Here is a capture of our experiences there:

1.  When we arrived, unlike other resorts, there was not a warm welcome with cold towels etc.

2.  They told us our room would be available later and to go to lunch.  When we got back, we got our rooms (which were nice by the way) but they did not escort us to our room.  They circled a building on a map and sent us on our way.  Really?  We got so frustrated, having to ask 3 times about where our room really was.

3.  They upgraded our room to Royal Service but didn't tell us anything about it.  Great to have the nice room but it was only the room upgraded, not the service.  Unknowing of that, we went to the pool closest to our room and got reprimanded for not having the right color of bracelet.  

4.  There are only 4 "decent" restaurants at the resort according to reviews I had read and one of them was $40pp extra (Passions), and the other required you to be a Royal Service member to get in free (Gabi Beach).  Once we found this out, we tried to get our bracelets upgraded and were then told that only our room was upgraded.

5.  On our first night there, we tried to go to one of the other non-buffet restaurants and were told that it was a 30 minute wait since we did not have reservations and there were only about 5 tables seated.  Once we said to go ahead with that we were told that the gentleman were not dressed appropriately.  

6.  We ended up at the only restaurant that would take us...Asian Fusion...it was horrible.

7.  The next day, we went to the beach, sat down...then this security guard with a baton came after us saying we had to move because we were in the Royal Service area...arrgh.  We moved 5 feet down the beach...really???

8.  That night we went to what was supposed to be the best restaurant, Passion...the chef was supposedly a 3 star Michelin chef, etc. etc.  We paid the $40 pp extra.  The meal was just "okay" and they refused to serve us the way we wanted. We wanted risotto with our steak and they had to serve it in the way they wanted, not the way we wanted : ).  It became humorous...My daughter and I refused to let them take the risotto out of the way...lol.  We really caused them heartburn!

9.  Both of our significant others got really sick from some food they ate...we think it may have been the lamb at Passions as that is the only thing they both had that we didn't.  We now call the hotel "Parasitus".

Hope this helps someone in making a decision...for the same price, go to Iberostar Grand.  Although there is still a "caste" system at Iberostar in general, at least you don't feel like a third class citizen within the resort you choose.

reviews.author: 473leonor
reviews.title: Decepcionante, ausencia total del Director
reviews.text:
Viajamos habitualmente a R.D. y jamás nos habiamos encontrado con un hotel con tantas carencias como el Paradisus Palma Real.
Primordialmente se dedican a captar clientes para sus programas Gaby Beach...etc, etc. Hay una tremenda desorganización con respecto al personal, dado que el director, con el que decidimos hablar despues de muchos dificultades , dificiles de resumir en tan poco espacio, no se encontraba en el hotel en ninguna de las ocasiones que acudimos a Direccion. Los propios camareros/as nos decian que llevaba muchos días sin ir al hotel (dificilmente se podria enterar de los problemas de los huespedes) .
La cena buffet, si no reservabas en un restaurant (escasa comida) te sentias perdido, al no existir un restaurant/buffet fijo para la cena. En un hotel de esa categoria es inasumible que no exista esto y  que no  haya personal suficiente para todo lo que esperas del mismo.
Los huespedes  que no lo sabian, se encontraban perdidos, teniendo que coger un carrito de golf y acudir a otro sitio para cenar (un buffet malo). En atención al cliente, no sabian en que sitio se debia de ir al buffet. Esto es inaceptable desde todo punto de vista.
Escaso personal para un hotel de este precio y categoria.
El personal mostró que nadie estaba contento con la gestión del director del hotel.
Buenas instalaciones, pero no merece la pena ir a unas vacaciones para descansar y encontrarse  esta infinidad de problemas que nadie te resuelve.
NO SE LO RECOMIENDO A NADIE.

reviews.author: valeska_11
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
Visitamos por segunda vez este hotel el miércoles pasado, desde el comienzo fue muy distinto a nuestra primera visita.
En la recepción no fuimos informados que el restaurant buffet no se encontraba abierto lo que nos ocasionó grandes dificultades para encontrar un restaurante con disponibilidad ya que todos eran con reserva, finalmente cenamos en el Vento, donde también hubo problemas con la atención y con el menú.
La habitación tenía el ventanal con seguros malos no cerraba, la cual tuvieron que ir en 2 ocasiones para arreglarlo.
Eramos 3 adultos y la habitación no estaba preparada con 3 camas a lo cual también hubo que llamar en mas de 3 oportunidades para que se instalara.
El 3 día encontramos una lagartija en nuestra habitación,al solicitar que se capturara el personal que fue no era el apropiado por lo que no logro sacarla  y tuvimos que quedarnos en esa habitación el reptil.
La mujer que atiende en el sector de playa ofreciendo bebidas pésima atención solo se preocupa de atender a las personas que le dan propinas y los demás tiraba las botellas de agua y no miraba a los pasajeros cuando le hablaban.
En el check out la donación para la UNICEF la hacen parte de una cargo obligatorio no como un aporte voluntario como lo es realmente.
Todo fue muy distinto de la vez anterior, no habrá una tercera vez.

reviews.author: Gudulo
reviews.title: Globalement décevant
reviews.text:
Nous revenons d'une semaine au Palma Real. Globalement très mitigés. Le resort est certes très beau! Vraiment une très belle infrastructure! Plage magnifique, superbe piscine, tres jolies decorations. Les chambres sont spacieuses et le service de chambre est impeccable. Le all inclusive (bars, snacks...) est irréprochable. MAIS..........  Cet hôtel  est tout sauf un 5 étoiles! Premier souci: manque de flexibilité et de professionnalisme d'une grande partie du personnel. Premier exemple: possibilité de réserver les restaurants à partir de 9 heures. Un matin, nous arrivons à la réception à 8h45. Nous nous faisons "remballer" pour 15 minutes de différence. Nous revenons donc à 9h et ... le système informatique est en panne. On ne nous propose pas de prendre note manuellement de notre réservation. Service: zéro! Ce n est qu après un gros coup de gueule qu'un "manager" daigne nous dépanner. 
Deuxième exemple: à notre arrivée, nous sommes pris en charge par un jeune homme qui nous fait visiter l'hotel. L'intention est bonne mais visiblement nous ennuyons notre hôte... Il nous guide et parle sans nous regarder presque en soufflant. Après 3 jours, nous réalisons qu il ne nous a pas explique un tas de choses: pas un mot au sujet du Spa, ni de la salle de finesse par exemple! Tout au plus un rapide tour près de la piscine et un petit mot sur les restaurants mais tout sauf engageant! 
Deuxième gros souci: la qualité de la cuisine et le fonctionnement des restaurants. Le buffet est dans le all inclusive mais n'est pas ouvert tous les jours. Dommage parce que la cuisine y est bonne. Les autres restos inclus sont eux vraiment mauvais. Fuyez surtout l'italien! Le steak grill: cata! Et l'asiatique est tout au plus acceptable. Nous n'avons pas osé tenter le sushishop bar.... Le passion, resto gastronomique, est lui étonnement bon mais est en supplément (40usd, raisonnable pour la qualité proposée). Nous avons eu l'occasion de fréquenter beaucoup d'hotels 5 étoiles. Jamais nous n'avons été aussi déçus de la cuisine. 
Troisième gros souci: la stupidité du concept "royal service". À notre arrivée on nous a proposé d opter pour un service royal pour un supplément de 1100 USD pour la semaine à deux. (soit dit en passant, après 5 minutes, ils nous le proposaient à 800 USD). Nous n avons pas opté pour le service, pensant que  la qualité normale d un 5 étoiles nous conviendrait. Or, tout au long du séjour, nous avons ressenti cette "cassure" entre deux hôtels au sein du même hôtel. Plages différentes, piscines différentes, sieges de plages differents, restos différents. Athmosphere détestable! Un soir nous demandons à réserver une table dans un resto non inclus et initialement destiné aux clients royal service. Cette possibilité nous avait été proposée à notre arrivée. Nous sommes prêts à payer le supplément mais.... On nous répond que l accord du manager devra être reçu, vu que les clients royal service pourraient être choqués de voir des clients non royal service dans le restaurant! En toute modestie, Nous sommes habitués à manger dans des restos étoiles en Belgique et en France, et nous avons refuse de nous voir traités de la sorte pour manger dans un simple resto à 40 USD....
En résumé, je pense qu il y a certainement moyen de trouver mieux à Punta Cana pour ce prix (4500 eur à deux en fin de saison pour la semaine)

reviews.author: Catherineaf
reviews.title: Poor after service!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel about a month and half ago. We paid extra for the royal service fee, which is no different than the regular service. We didnt meet our butler until two days into our stay and he never was ale to make our dinner reservations.
To add to this we paid for a beachfront room and none was available at the time so we moved to a garden view, the concierge assured us that in ten days time the money would be reimbursed to our credit. One month and half later we have response from the hotel, have written more than twice and no money in our account.
Would not reccomend!!!

reviews.author: Samantha L
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying that sadly, this is the first time I have written a bad review on TripAdvisor. My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real from March 29-April 3 expecting a nice all inclusive getaway. We ended up leaving frustrated and annoyed, it was the first time that we were excited to leave a vacation!! It was a complete shock considering the positive reviews that I read on here! 

The Negatives: Other then Edgar, our concierge, the entire staff was rude. We would wait roughly 15-20 minutes for water and napkins at the buffet and the market grille. We learned very quickly that we had to bring a bottle of water from the room refrigerator with us to breakfast, and grab drinks from the pool bar to bring with us to lunch-I have honestly never encountered such a thing in all of my travels. Secondly, there is absolutely zero poolside service...in 5 days we had a waitress come up to us ONCE and ask us if we wanted drinks...we tipped her exceptionally hoping she would come back, but no. The food...don't even get me started. The buffet was pretty inedible. Market Grille was functional, Vento (which we had high hopes for) was disappointing and we both ended up with sour stomachs afterwards. Our two good meals were at Gabi Beach (which is an additional cost) and at the hibachi side of BANA. Other frustrations on our trip were the amount of rude guests...the stories are endless. I lost count of how many times I had conversations with other americans regarding the blatant rudeness of other travelers and the staff. We also scheduled beachside massages, showed up at the beach massage space 5 minutes before out massage was to start. 20 minutes later our massage therapists come casually walking up and have us wait additional time to put fresh linens on...no apologies for being 15 minutes late. During the massage, the therapists spoke in spanish to each other (so much for relaxing) and hardly touched a knot in my back, so needless to say, it was a complete waste of money. Lastly, do not believe the advertisements for wifi...it is non-exsistant everywhere but the lobby, and scattered here and there by the pool. 

The few positives-Edgar our concierge was AMAZING. If it weren't for him, our vacation would have been a nightmare. He was so lovely and helpful and understanding of our frustrations. Another positive was that the grounds, pool and beach are amazing. The rooms are decent, with a jacuzzi bathtub and nice decor....but zero bathroom privacy, a shower that never got hot, and sheer curtains that had us awake at 6:30AM.  

The hotel came at the recommendation of our close friends who have been to stay at the Reserve part of the hotel, which is apparently completely different then the hotel itself...they rave about it, and were shocked at our poor experience.

Bottom line, I would never recommend staying at the Palma Real. :(

reviews.author: Tamatha F
reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: I just arrived back home last night from march26th until the 31st.My husband,my 7yr.old son and myself.When we first arrived and were standing in the lobby it looked so nice.then it was all down hill from there.The food taste so awful.And I mean everything.The coffe is gross with god knows what kind of milk.We just had to find something that you could handle and stick to it.I basically ate fruit and salad with balsamic vinegar.The dressing was not good.The drinks were also terrible cheap booze and sugar mixers no fresh fruit in any cocktails.The service was discraceful.Especially at the golf course.It is not included its $30 for the cart and no food on the cart at all.nothing...I hate to be so negative but We meet so many others vacationing there as well and said the same.I'm not sure if they'll take the time to write a review.The room we paid extra for ocean view was not ocean view at all.It was trees and if you lend over your balcony and stretch your neck over you could see a glimps of water through the trees.I know mother nature is in charge of the weather.But it was sun in and out all the time.Humid.And poured rain all day and night 2 of the days.And that leaves you with nothing to do at this place.Well live and learn.I would never go back to this Island or recommend it.Others at the airport said the most decent place is the hard rock and thats not saying much..Spend your money else were and enjoy..This place looks beautiful on the computer, and is nice in the lobby.But the rest of the experience is the pitts..

reviews.author: bruno t
reviews.title: beau clud de vacances mauvais 5 etoiles
reviews.text:
arrivé à l hotel on vous propose une formule plus qui comprend un service supplementaire
en plage' en chambre' en spa....30dollard par pers et par jour ( on est déja en all inclusive)
la chambre ( 5 etoiles je le rapelle) unemachine à laver?une tv , un ventilo qui ne fonctionne
pas une prise de chambre demontée et le plus .. un écoulement d'eau dans les toilettes toutes les 15s,uncanapé défraichi mais bonne literie.
la plage transat sans matelas ail le dos! plus manque de paillottes ombragées donc vous avez des voisins qui s' invitent.on comprend mieux le service à payer en plus ,à 50m de large transates matelassés,et des paillottes par pers+ services de plage.
les restaurants bof..cela va faire trop mais table instable, verre ébreché et nouriturre...
on mange mieux au buffet.
on essayera de vous vendre le club denia dans le monde mais bon aprés cela on ne doute de rien.
juste pour dire j' ai la chance de partir 2 fois par an dans des hotel dit de standing
et pour la premiere fois je donne mon avis le pris correspond juste à un  club et surtout pas à un hotel surtout au prix.
les gens sont trés gentil et la mer est remarquable voilà le bon coté.

reviews.author: voyager157
reviews.title: You can find a better place
reviews.text: In short, beautiful property! Immaculate grounds, gorgeous beach, nice rooms. BUT, the service is very lacking and the food unbelievable. Here are a few examples of poor service: my phone in the room didn't work and they never were able to fix it, our screen door didn't lock, it was never fixed, our iron didn't work and it took 2 days to get a new one not to mention 4 reminder calls, you have to make reservations to eat at the on-site restaurants which always seemed to be a time consuming ordeal). And finally, the food......almost inedible. Plenty of choices, none of them good. Many people in our group got very sick and I suspect it was the food to blame. Honestly, the worst food I have ever had in my life. I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Paula T
reviews.title: El sistema de CONCIERGE PERJUDICA al Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Somos una pareja joven que gusta de viajar por el mundo, y siempre elegimos hoteles de gran categoria porque privilegiamos disfrutar las instalaciones del hotel, mas alla de que sean de playa o ciudad. Nos ha pasado de recibir excelentes recomendaciones de los concierges, que son quienes mejor conocen tanto el hotel como lo que los rodea, pero JAMAS nos ha pasado de que el CONCIERGE DECIDA POR NOSOTROS SIN CONSULTA PREVIA. El primer inconveniente fue cuando nos hizo las reservaciones para cenar a las 6 de la tarde (cuando pedimos que minimo 7.30 por ejemplo) o que ellos eligan por nosotros el tipo de comida o restaurant (aduciendo que no hay otra opcion). O que teniendo el hotel 6 restaurantes + buffet nos diga que tenemos que ir a cenar al hotel de al lado (La Reserva) porque tampoco hay disponibilidad. Al escuchar todo esto me siento con esta persona y le pido tiempo para diagramar las cenas de las 5 noches que le restaban al viaje, y realmente recibo evasivas, percibiendo falta de ganas, de compromiso, y de estar acostumbrados a hacer lo que les guste y no lo que el cliente le pide. Termine llamando yo misma desde mi habitacion al Servicio de reservas de restaurantes y gracias a la buena voluntad y excelente atencion de la Sra. Carmen es que pude cenar todas las noches en horario de mi agrado y en lugares de mi gusto dentro del hotel. Otro dato particular es que ellos nos acercan y nos piden que las excursiones las contratemos con "sus amigos" por el tema de sus comisiones, por lo cual uno tampoco es libre de decidir el operador de las mismas. Otro punto....es increible despertarse 7.30am, llegar a la piscina o a la playa y ver que todas las sombrillas y\o camastros estan ocupados porque los concierges le hacen dicho favor a los clientes mas "generosos". SON PERSONAS QUE SE MUEVEN POR INTERESES Y BENEFICIOS PROPIOS, AUN POR SOBRE Y HASTA PERJUDICANDO SU LUGAR DE TRABAJO . Y para terminar, lo mas vergonzozo que nos ha tocado vivir es que, al ser la segunda noche de nuestra estadia mi cumpleaños, solo he conseguido cenar en un lindo restaurante dentro del hotel, a cambio de concurrir al dia siguiente durante 90 minutos a una charla de ventas donde intentaron venderme una especie de vacacion durante 50 años en cualquier hotel de la cadena Melia, todo esto llevados de la mano por el concierge....realmente no caben palabras para esto, jamas me ha pasado en ningun hotel en ningun lugar del mundo. Por ultimo, luego de que fuimos a la charla y dijimos que no nos interesaba, despues de contratar las excursiones con quien indico el concierge, y  una vez realizadas por mi misma todas las reservaciones para cenar.....el concierge NOS ESQUIVO y NOS NEGO el saludo por el resto de la semana.....IMPRESENTABLE. Lamentable la actitud de este señor, BOLIVAR GUZMAN y su coequiper ALVARO CASTILLO. Una belleza el hotel en unas playas paradisiacas, pero estas personas con sus actitudes hacen que uno nunca jamas piense en regresar.

reviews.author: jill d
reviews.title: what a change
reviews.text:
this is our third time here.  things have really changed and NOT for the better.  there appears to be a change in hotel management~service has suffered, quality of food and beverage has diminished dramatically. top shelf liquor is no longer a staple.  beach service is practically non existent.  employee's are treated poorly by managers and believe me these people providing restaurant service work really hard only to be pushed harder and harder.  it is impossible to do what is required of them and do it with a smile.  cannot blame them~it's not their fault.  language appears to be another problem.  so many do not speak english~a big difference from years past.  we were told that when the new administration took over over 60 percent of the original staff were let go.  what a shame.  housekeeping is marginal at best. again it's not their fault.  they are required to to the same job as before but with reduced help.  physical property is still beautiful.  it was only two years ago that this property was a LEADING HOTEL OF THE WORLD.  i can see how they lost that rating.  this property does not cater to the luxury traveler as before.  if you are looking for quality food, drink and service this is NOT the place for you.  lots of families with small children running around way into the night.  other guests tended to be rude and loud.  men walking around at night after dinner without shirts.
so much as changed in a years time.  would not recommend this property for those looking for an exceptional experience.

reviews.author: svengali82
reviews.title: Not so good
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited this resort in late October as part of "reward perk" for her achieving sales goals in her line of work. So her half of the trip was free and I paid just my airfare. That fact lessened the pain of what I am about to write.

We arrived mid-week and stayed four days. The weather was great and typical for the Caribbean this time of year. This is a large resort with different accommodations and levels of service. Our group was treated to the Royal Service plan in The Reserve which is supposedly at the upper end of their price range. Royal Service has more privacy, it's own checkin desk, concierge and features a butler 24/7 for your needs.......supposedly :^(. Each guest was provided a cell phone to contact our butler and hotel services as  needed. This is a great idea, but the phones we received did not work. Our butler escorted a group of us to six rooms offering help as we dispersed. We were escorted to our room last whereupon  I tipped the fellow $20......... and never saw or heard from him again for the entire stay. 

Our room was very nice with tile floors, somewhat comfortable bed and all the expected amenities. The wifi service did not work so well.

The resort states that its many dining opportunities are "world class"...........Hardly!!!........Reservations were virtually impossible without the help of our vanishing butler. The food is of lesser quality than what one would receive at a typical chain restaurant in the US and certainly not "world class". There were opportunities to try Dominican cuisine which is almost identical to Puerto Rican fare and very bland in my opinion.

The beaches with cabanas and pools with outdoor bars were the best part of the vacation. There were other activities available including spa services that were unexpectedly ............. sublime. The groundskeeper does a great job keeping this resort looking great, too.

All inclusive resorts should be just that and this one did not measure up. I do not recommend Paradisus Palma Real Resort as an all inclusive based my experience.

reviews.author: Rosario A
reviews.title: Dissapointed!
reviews.text:
we made a family trip to this hotel in October, 2011.  We were a group of 42 from different countries, we planned this trip for few months as it was an opportunity for all the family to get together. We were excited and choose this place as Melia is a good chain and this is sold as "the top hotel" of this group.  Yes, it is "sold as top" but is very far from it.  This hotel is not good, it was in 2005 but not anymore.  Quality of food and drinks are of a 1 star hotel, we got sick with poison food, drinks are poor brand and low quality, they have problems with restaurans and air conditioner.  Staff try hard to make you feel fine, but the hotel seems to be in a low performance and lowering the quality and service.  
It was not a good experience and we were all very dissapointed with this hotel.

reviews.author: CMStendhal
reviews.title: Bad experience,poor service to costumers.
reviews.text: I arrived today, November 2nd. 2011. First surprise, a lizard was waiting for us on the bed. Later I asked for a feather pillow, a simple request that was an impossible task. The hotel has them, but I was told that they were not available for our room category! We are paying 300 dlls per night and come with a convention of 200 people, I went to the reception desk and asked to speak with the manager, another impossible task. Everything here seems to be very complicated. The guest services guy told me that he needed to be in good terms with his boss, not with the guests at the hotel. the safe wasn't working, we reported it and told them we needed it fixed before dinner. We waited for more than an hour, and after calling several times we finally had it fixed and, of course, were late for dinner. I still haven't got my pillow and its already midnight. This hotel is supposed to be a luxury resort, but it is really dissapointing and except for one guy who attended my call at reception at 11pm, people are rude. I will never come back again.

reviews.author: LAURA P
reviews.title: Luna de mil decepcionante
reviews.text: Tras una ruta por los EEUU decidimos descansar uns días en Punta Cana. Como era la luna de miel no escatimamos en gastos y elejimos el paradisus palma real con servicio real. No era mi primera visa a RD pero el hotel es completamente decepcionante. En cuanto a gastronomía comimos fantásticamente....el problema es la actitud de los empleados. Tras hora y media esperando el segundo plato en el restaurante a la carta Pasión nos fuimos sin cenar, era vergonzoso, en el suelo cuando entramos habían restos de comida en el suelo que seles había caído y los camareros saltaben por encima, tras hora y media nos fuimos y allí seguía, uno de ellos le dió una patada a un cristall y le tuvimos que decir que por favor lo recojiera. Teníamos mayordomo pero entre los mismos empleados no se comunican. Casi nos coaccionaron para que fuéramos a una charla sobre el club meliá al día siguente, ese mediodía decidimos salir a bailar y le pedimos al mayordomo que anulara la cita pues al dia siguiente nos llamaron despertándonos y pidiendo explicaciones de xq no habíamos ido. Mucho servicio real pero no valie la pene, los camareros en la piscina no eran capaces de pasar para ver si querías tomar algo. Todos buscaban la propina, cuando veían que no había nada parecía que te perdonaran la vida. Apenas hay animación por eso de le los huéspedes son de slto postín y se pueden molestar. Los horarios de los shows estan pensados para los que cenaban a las 7pm, los de las 9 pm apenas teníamos entretenimiento. Realmente decepcionante.

reviews.author: JustECOSM
reviews.title: Keep your expectations low
reviews.text: This is a very large (maybe too large) property that looks good when you arrive. The lobby is spacious and attractive. It is also an all inclusive. I was there as part of a conference. There are many problems, especially for the experienced traveller. The front desk staff, including the manager, were very weak in terms of unserstanding English. This is true throughout the property. Getting an olive in a martini is a chore that takes several requests.The place was 30 per cent full and I was given a room very far from the lobby and the beach. The room was of decent size, but a bit tired. The floors in the halls and rooms are dangerously slippery when wet. The mattress was soft and not comfortable. One very strange thing is that in the standard room there is no solid wall separating the bathroom from the bed room, which limits priivacy .The food, except in the Vento restaurant, was very weak. The steak was horrible and the lobster tails were consistently overdone. The best is the breakfast. At night, look at the fresh fish offerings and have it grilled. Be careful, however, because they tend to overcook everything. I love to snorkel and it is very weak off the beach.  The beach is not bad, but the sand is gritty and there is so much seaweed they have to use a front end loader to remove it. On the plus side, the hotel does provide a  good number of covered chairs and beverage service on the beach. You are not permitted to go on your own to a reef which is in sight. There is a  "free" snorkel which is in a row boat for an hour where you better be good at climbing in and out of boats. There was no ladder. There are excursions that you can pay for. The one they push is for 76.00 on a small cat with no sun coverage. All in all, I was pretty disappointed with the experience.

reviews.author: l0vethebeach87
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort....BUT
reviews.text:
We ended up going to Paradisus as part of a trip I earned through my company.  At first glance, the resort seemed beautiful.   We checked in and the process was easy.  The rooms were very nice and I was happy to have finally arrived.   While waiting for our luggage we checked the stocked mini fridge and I was happy to have two cold beers waiting for me (or so I thought).  I grabbed one of the beers and it just so happened that it was open and half drank.   Yum.  Evidently the people staying before us didnt want to finish that beer.   Anyways, we went down to see the resort and it was very nice, the pools, grounds and ocean were beautiful.   There was a bit of seaweed in the ocean but no big deal, still a very nice beach.   

The big issue I had with this resort was the food.  When you come to an all inclusive, you expect to eat at least decent food.   By no means am I a picky eater who is accustomed to five start luxorious dining, far from it.  In fact, give me Outback Steakhouse and I'm happy so that pretty much puts it in perspective.   The first pain in the neck is even trying to get reservations at the restaurants.   Between them randomly being closed and being forced to make reservations days in advance, it was ridiculous to try to even find a place to eat.   Once you got in the restaurant, the food was average at best.   The only decent meal i had all week was at the hibachi restaurant.   Juan Jose was great cooking for us.   As far as the only other real option for breakfast, lunch, and dinner was the buffet.   Not only was it horrible, it made me sick and I was not able to eat or drink a thing the last two whole days I was there.   What a great way to spend your all inclusive vacation.   I didnt think it was possible to screw up scrambled eggs and bacon...until I came here.   Runny eggs, chewy bacon, no thanks.   I've eaten better food at my high school cafeteria.   I stayed at a 3 star resort in Jamaica last year at the Starfish Trelawny that had much better food.  4 days later and finally home my stomach has finally stopped cramping.   It wasnt just me saying this about the food.   We talked to several other people at the resort about the food and not one had anything good to say about it.  For this reason I would HIGHLY suggest staying elsewhere when choosing a destination to spend your hard earned money.   

The drinks weren't much better unless you were at the lobby bar.   Depending on who made your drinks, they ranged from average to disgusting.  Nothing like a frozen pina colada that's barely frozen.  We even saw a bartender pouring low shelf vodka into an absolut bottle, nice.   

We had no real problem with the service, everyone was pretty pleasant, didnt speak much English but I guess that's to be expected.  

All in all, the weather was nice, resort itself was beautiful but I wouldnt stay here again for free.

reviews.author: Niamh
reviews.title: Staff work on commission and they'll hardsell you a timeshare package - STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
The photos look fantastic but don't be fooled.   This place is HUGE - way too big and impersonal.   If you're into complex compound living - this is for you.  There's an adjoniing 'exclusive club' that you're not allowed into without the appropriate wrist tag.  There's a reason these places are 'all inclusive' - and that's because the food and drink is only average. 

At check in the first question we got was if we wanted to pay extra for an upgrade.  We didn't and the receptionist lost interest as that was considered a lost commission.  

The room was lovely and the pools very nice.  You're in Punta Cana in the Caribbean so the water's gorgeous and sandy beaches are fabulous.  

One of the waitress's gave us a sob storey about needing to pay for kids etc., and so we stupidly agreed to go along to a 'breakfast talk' one morning - it lasted for hours and they WOULD not let us leave - it was timeshare selling at its worst.  The deals on offer were atrocious and you'd get more entertainment burning your money.  They brought us on a tour of the 'exclusive club' which happened to be a lot of the photos on their advertising material so don't think that's what you'll be getting.  They turned almost aggressive when we tried to leave. 
 
It's a nice hotel but I wouldn't go back - the timeshare experience completely ruined it for me and then we bagan to notice how everything had a 'commission edge' to it. 

We booked this hotel as it was one of the 'Leading Hotels of the World' however, I see that they're no longer a part of this.  No doubt it's for good reason that they just don't belong at that level of hotel.

reviews.author: Pixtonian
reviews.title: They don't understand customer service yet
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing, the rooms were great, the food was great, the beach and the water were amazing, but most of the hotel staff were rude and didn't understand customer service.  You would expect thta when you pay over 500 a night that you would be treated with great service as you would anywhere else in the world.  In the Dominican Republic it is just the opposite.  From the taxi drivers to the people at the airport they just didn't know how to treat people.  I was surprised to find the same attitude at a nice hotel.  First they sent us to the airport when they knew that there were no flights leaving that day.  Rather than informing people before they left they just said bye and when you came back and tried to get the same rate they wanted to charge double for the same room.  We asked to talk to the manager I had to wait 20 min while they filed paperwork right in front of me.  This was after I had checked out earlier and had a $20 credit left because they had overcharged my card.  I asked the front desk to refund my card or just give me cash if that would be easier.  They told me they couldn't do that and if they did it would take 30 min to file the paperwork.  Really?  They then told me to go down to the gift shop and spend it that way I could just use it.  I went down there and found nothing to buy, but decided just to get some dumb souvenier and went to the register and they said they couldn't credit me anything like the guy at the front desk had told me.  I then went up and expained this to him and he said sorry and I finally just said screw it since it was only $20 but I imagine it would have been that same had it been $1000.  We ended up spening our last night at a different hotel becuase of the way we were treated.  We decided to go with something with a more American style of management at the Hard Rock.  We had no complaints there but part of the reason you travel is to see and expirience new things.  I will never go back to this country.   It is beautiful there but the people make it ugly sorry Dominican Republic but I would never recommend that anyone go there and never ever go to this hotel.

reviews.author: Ingrid V Nap
reviews.title: Very disappointed with Paradisus Palma Real 4th of July weekend
reviews.text:
This was our third time staying at the Paradisus Palma Real as SMVC(Sol Melia Vacation Club) members, our family of four. I have to say that I spent more time complaining with the quality of service at the SMVC Customer Service Lounge, than I spent at leisure.  The sofa bed was a disaster, only one plasma or LCD TV for the so called Family Suite. I had sent e-mails a week before to make reservations at their various restaurants with no reply, then when we check in  they give us such a hard time to make reservations with its restaurants which was very stressful(we had to pay $90.00 p/p per day for the dubious upcharge of  the all inclusive, definitively not worth it). By the way the food and service at these restaurants,was nothing eventful, it was short of mediocre. Please skip the Bama Pan Asian restaurant as it is the worst and move on to Gabi Beach as the best.To top it off the transportation arrangements from airport to hotel to airport which we paid ahead, they tried to charge us more and resulted as an argument between SMVC Customer Service and the transportation company. No beach towels for the beach the only sunny day(Monday, as it rained during the whole weekend) during that long 4th of July weekend.
I hope some of the management of this particular property is reading this "critique", because since our  two other stays, this hotel has gone down in quality and service.

reviews.author: JoyK
reviews.title: Far from Paradise...Pretty resort with no clue what customer service means
reviews.text:
I've never written one of these before, but having just come back from my trip to Paradisus Palma Real, I felt compelled to share my experience so I could warn other travelers.  It was the talk of the hotel, at least for Non Reserve guests, that service was very poor and there were many disgruntled guests.

When we got there, our concierge Alberto told us that we could not secure ANY reservations for a restaurant for at least 3 days because they were "way overbooked."  I told him that we had already paid our money, so didn't understand how that could be the case.  He had no answers for me and appeared completely dumbfounded as to why I would be upset that I couldn't get my 2 young children into a restaurant.  After wasting about 30 minutes with him and another concierge,I demanded to speak to manager, who was finally able to help us out the next day.  Even when we showed up for that first reservation, the staff said they had no record of our reservation and gave us a hard time until I again had to demand to speak to the restaurant concierge who had worked with the manager I had spoken to.  A lot of unnecessary stress for a vacation to get into restaurants with pretty average food.

Once our meal situation was solved, we had to deal with getting seats at the pool or beach.  After not being able to find any seat for our family of 5, we were told quickly by other hotel guests that the trick was coming out and getting seats by 6 am.  And again, despite it being a vacation, my husband or I were out there every day between 5:30 - 6 am securing pool side chairs.  I've stayed at beautiful resorts in Anguilla, Turks & Caicos, Hawaii, etc. and have never had to do something so ridiculous.

Other areas of service are spotty.  The on-site tour company that handled our transfers tried to swindle my mother-in-law into paying $90/person for a snorkeling trip until I told her it was free at the hotel.  While the people at the pool told us we had booked a snorkeling trip for one day at 11 am, I found out the next day when I went to the aquatics area that the reservation was actually made for 3 pm and that we were only "waitlisted."  Once I told them that was not what we were originally told, they said they could accomodate us, which was nice.  While there were some hiccups in getting this booked, I'm glad we did make this trip, as my kids loved it and the staff was good.

I had heard from people we met at The Reserve that they had a better experience.  Honestly, I would recommend that you just skip this "paradise"  and do yourself a favor and stay at a Four Seasons, Ritz Carlton or mid size boutique hotel that understand what it means to please and satisfy customers.  This is a pretty place, with spacious rooms and nice grounds.  However, there are many other nice resorts to go to where you can just relax and not constantly have to talk to manager or your travel agent to make sure you get what you paid for.

reviews.author: Kennytwins
reviews.title: Overall, we were very disappointed with this resort! Not worth the money.
reviews.text: This resort is very nice to look at and the rooms and suites are well appointed. The photos on-line reflect what  you see when you are there. The pools and beach are beautiful but thats wher my complements end. The problem with this resort is the lack of service. The whole place needs new management. The staff are pathetic. They did not have our 2 BR suite available when we checked in so we had to go to two separate rooms for two days. There was no apology, no explanation, no attempt to make us happy. The check-in staff wer not sympathetic in any way and had no problem telling us that our room category would not be available till later in the week. Most other hotels, would give you some spa creidts or something to makeup for this inconvenience but not here. It also seems like they bend over backward for vacation club owners. There are separate restaurants, separate pool area, separate beach area with cushioned chairs. If you are not an owner, you are not treated well. We had to get up at 7 am just to get a chair at the beach while the vacation club area was empty. There was a definite feeling that if you were not an owner, you were a second class citizen. It was also very very difficult to get reservations for dinner. Many nights, we had to eat tthe mediocre buffet because the restaurants were all booked. The entire week was just very frustrating an dot t all what I expected or paid for. All in all, I would never go back to this resort!

reviews.author: Cswolfe
reviews.title: Welcome to the caste system
reviews.text:
Review of Paradisus Palma Real

Date of trip: April 19 to 23

I went to Dominican Republic with my two younger children, ages 11 and 15 to get some warmth and fun for a few days.  PPR came highly recommended so we decided to give it a try. While the facility is relatively new, rooms are clean, the beach is beautiful, and the pool is lovely, there exists at the PPR an underlying class system that will thwart any intention of someone going there from having a great time.

So unnerved were we and many other families that we met by this experience, that it ruined the experience that a resort of this nature should have left us with.

First off, when you check in, they give you a colored bracelet. Mine was white while my children's were red.  Along the way, I saw purple, brown, light blue, and a myriad of other color bracelets.
