It's a subtle way of letting you know that you are part of the plebeians without actually stating that fact at check in.  Here's how the bracelet system works from what I can tell. If you are part of the low class race that I was in (and mind you I did pay a small fortune to stay there), it is nearly impossible to get a reservation at one of the many restaurants the resort offers and a seat at the beach.  

We arrived on a Tuesday and were lucky to get access to the sushi bar for dinner on Wednesday night.   However, much to my dismay, we noticed that Bana, the restaurant that offers a teppanyaki menu, an Asian fusion menu as well as a sushi menu, was mostly empty while they claimed it was booked.  They utilize only 20% of the restaurant space at any given time.  The sushi bar where we ate would ONLY serve sushi to us, even though there was Asian fusion food offered at the table next to us.  Also, the sushi menu was very limited, maybe 10 items in all, too much rice and they couldn't make anything off the menu.

Wednesday at 4 is the time when you can book for Thursday and beyond. I got on the line w the concierge at 4 and by the time I arrived EVERYTHING was booked at ALL restaurants.  The alternative is a buffet dinner which looks like regurgitated food from breakfast and lunch w some steak offered.  People were livid and were made to feel like second class citizens.

Okay, so on with the beach access and pool. About 2/3s of the beach is available only for reserve and royal patrons.  Not sure what the ratio of plebeians to the upper class is, but the end result is that 2/3s of the roped off beach is empty while the plebeians are are waking up at 5:30 am to get a shaded spot at the beach.  When you try to venture over to the other side, there are guards with batons that look like machine guns that kick you out and really make you feel good about your choice of staying there.  People also leave stuff on the chairs from the night before.  The hotel really should be on top of this as we witnessed two world wars while there. Same situation at the pool and especially the coveted shaded beds they have around.  I was less concerned w the pool as I'm a beach person.  I did manage to get a nice spot on the beach for two days by waking up at 6:30.  On our last full day, nothing was free so I piggybacked on someone's space, who was gracious enough to share their shade. They claimed their space the night before!

The water sports desk, run by scuba quatics, is inadequate to handle the needs of the resort.  For a resort that large,(I think there are 2,000 people there?), they have only two hobie cats, one windsurf (adults only size) and a few kayaks and one paddle boat.  It took us two days to book a reservation for a hobie cat and even then we had to wait an hour for it.  People I spoke to were very frustrated with the wait time to get access to water sports and gave up.

I'm not sure the owners of this resort understand that it isn't just looks and a nice beach that will keep the hotels reputation up to snuff.  People going on a vacation want to sit at the beach, partake in whatever water sports or amenities are available, they want to relax, and at the end of the day, they just want to sit down and have a nice meal and be served.  I personally felt very slighted by my experience there.  I have been to many beautiful resorts and have never been so overtly made to feel like part of the underclass.

Going forward, I would not recommend this hotel and I, for one, will only go to a resort where all men and women are treated equally!

reviews.author: mjfunk
reviews.title: Service ranges from spotty to rude
reviews.text: I just returned from this resort and was quite dissappointed at the overall experience.  First of all the food was bad.  Not ok, bad.  The breakfast buffet was ok, but it took 10 min to flag somebody down for coffee.  The dinner choices were ok, but the results were not.  And the service, especially the hostess at Venta, was very poor.  At the casino, drunk gamblers were abusive to the staff and other guests w/o any consequence.  The resort itself is tired.  Rooms are ok, but just beneath the surface you see signs of age.  Very few on staff seem incented to help anybody.  Perhaps its the all-inclusive nature of the resort that dis-incents its employees to try harder, who knows.

reviews.author: Colorado2011
reviews.title: Poor Management, Would Not Recommend...
reviews.text: Although the resort appears beautiful on-line as well as in person, this is not a resort I would recommend anyone to visit.  Upon our arrival 2 weeks ago, we were informed our room at The Reserve would not be available until Monday without any reason as to 'why'.  As we spoke to many other families in the same situation, we learned DISH NETWORK had reserved the entire section of the RESERVE and all others guests with confirmed confirmations at The Reserve were forced to stay in the other section of the resort.  We booked our trip 10 1/2 months in advance, and no one from the resort ever contacted us OR our Apple representative to share that changes had been made.  No discussion to the matter was offered, as we had no say in the matter.  The resort tried to offer us a 2 night stay for FREE, however, why  would we want to return to a resort who didn't value us as a guest?!?!?  And isn't that a wonderful marketing ploy:  offer 2 nights FREE and the guest has to pay for the remainder of the stay, NO THANK-YOU!  And to top if off, the family concierge who shared with us that our room was not available until Monday, had quite an attitude and couldn't understand why we were upset??!!??  And as mentioned in other reviews, if you request to speak to a manager, good luck with that happening.  The only way we got anywhere was with our Apple Representative taking care of it all...  Once we were at The Reserve, things improved slightly but many negatives with the resort were quite obvious...  Shuttle service to and from the lobby/Reserve was inconsistent, pool side service did not happen once lunch began, evening entertainment was HORRIBLE for kids and adults, the AC in the rooms was questionable, AND attempts to swoop you into a 90 minute presentation about their time share options - annoying, leave me alone, I'm on vacation....  I would not consider this a family-friendly resort compared to other resorts we have stayed at.  The Paradisus Palma Real has alot to figure out when it comes to service, management, customer service, etc...

reviews.author: JarredK
reviews.title: Nice facilities - terrible in most other respects
reviews.text:
With two kids under age 3 and a full time job, I rarely find the opportunity to write reviews anymore.  I just couldn’t let the poor service that we received at this hotel go without at least being heard.  Let me begin by saying that, since we were traveling with 4 kids all under age 4 (we went with another family with 2 kids), we made sure to repeatedly confirm everything before the trip.  Confirmed cab from airport to hotel, room, cribs, crib sheets, etc.  Upon landing, cab was nowhere in sight and when we finally found someone from the cab company who knew something he said that the hotel just informed them of our arrival 20 minutes before.  Upon check-in, there was mass confusion at the reception.  No one was sure what room we had or our rate, we were walked around the hotel aimlessly looking for our room, and then finally taken through a back-entrance to our room – which was not in the location we requested, did not contain the correct bed configuration (we asked for 2 queens and instead got a queen and 2 double beds) and did not have the requested cribs.  We were never given a layout or description of the resort.  Our luggage only came to our room several hours later after we saw it sitting on the curb by reception where it was left and complained.  When the cribs finally came (right before bedtime for the kids), they came without the requested crib sheets forcing us to create an unsafe crib sheet from regular linens.  We were unable to get reservations at any of the resort restaurants for the first 2 days that we were there and only got a reservation for the 3rd day after wasting hours complaining to several different people – forcing us to get room-service for the first 2 days – which consisted of cardboard/cold pizza that took almost 2 hours to get.  Once we were finally able to actually eat at the restaurants we realized that the food was not all that much better – absent a random dish here or there which was okay to decent at best. We asked to speak with a manager on no less than 4 separate occasions concerning these lapses (leaving requests with various people at reception (since each time we tried to speak to a manager one was not available).  Not surprisingly, no manager ever came to see us or even called to address our concerns (we're still waiting).  The shuttle service from the Reserve to the beach (or anywhere else) was sporadic at best, and calling in advance to request one did not seem to help (which is problematic when you have 2 screaming kids and beach toys that you have to lug).  On one occasions, I called no less then 3 times to get a shuttle so that I could make an 8:40 a.m. dive only to arrive at the dive shop late to find out the dive had been canceled due to conditions (a call would have been nice).  Turn-down service would continually come at 9:30 p.m. – when the kids were sleeping despite repeated requests to come earlier.  When we told the hotel that a child pooped in the pool it was met with a staff member walking around the pool and ultimately doing nothing.

On the positive side, as others have mentioned, it is a pretty resort, the rooms were nice, the children facilities and kiddie pools at the Reserve were nice, the beach was nice, and not one person bothered us with a time-share push (which seems to be a major complaint on this board).  Unfortunately, the pros of this resort are only skin-deep.

reviews.author: Fflo123
reviews.title: Muy caro y mal servicio. No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: Fuimos en enero y encontramos muy caro este hotel para la calidad de sus comidas y pcinas. Los jardines son pequellos y te asedian vendiendote cosas que te hacen sentir que en lo que estas no es bueno.

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: Pressure to buy Timeshare
reviews.text: The backdrop of this resort is beautiful, but the pressure to buy a timeshare truly ruined our honeymoon. We were constantly questioned why we hadn't attended a presentation on the timeshare. We finally broke down when we were threatened that our transportation to the airport would be cancelled. They wanted my credit card number during the presentation which I would not provide. We paid top dollar for this trip and did not expect to be hasseled in this manner. I would strongly suggest looking at other fine resorts in the area, but avoiding this one.

reviews.author: roberto30187857
reviews.title: nettamente peggiorato
reviews.text:
Ci sono ritornato dopo tre anni perchè a suo tempo ci ero stato benissimo . E' da allora nettamente peggiorato sopratutto nel mangiare . Ricevimento scortese e degrado visibile .
Lo avevo decantato ai miei amici e non ho fatto una buona figura . Sono andato nella spa per una pedicure e mi sono rimediato una ferita al piede con infezione !

reviews.author: Martin K
reviews.title: Review by a travel agent
reviews.text:
We have just returned from a 12-day holiday at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel. We chose the hotel because it was part of Leading Hotels of the World. We wanted to make sure that we would stay at the best hotel on the Island, but unfortunately we got very disappointed. Yes, it is a 5 star hotel, but it is definitely not a Leading Hotel of the World. It’s missing the final touches and attention to detail which you usually find in this kind of category. One of the biggest disappointments is the staff. Most of them speak hardly any English. Even basic questions such as “Can I have a beer please?”, they cannot understand and you need to learn a few words of Spanish during your holiday in order to get what you want. In addition they are extremely slow. In the restaurants and on the beach you will find them standing around chatting to their colleagues without anybody supervising them. During meals you will find that most of the time you will have finished your first course by the time they serve you the first drink.

The beach is separated into 4 different sections – Royal Service, regular clients, VIP (same as regular clients but separated) and Vacation Club (the Time Share Property which is part of the same complex). The beach chairs for the regular and VIP clients are very uncomfortable and you need to get several towels in order to make it more comfortable. The Royal Service chairs are very nice but only available to Royal Service Customers. Also the Vacation Club chairs are much more comfortable than the ones for the regular hotel guests, but they can only be used by Vacation Club customers. If you decide to use them as a regular hotel guest, the beach staff will refuse to serve you or ask you to leave. 

The hotel rooms are nice but not luxurious. You will find everything you need but don’t ask for anything extra. On the first day we asked for feather pillows. We had to go through 5 members of staff and finally the duty manager to get one. Also a lot depends on who services your room. For example, sometimes you get 4 towels, sometimes just 2. There doesn’t seem to be any system in place. Also please be aware that this hotel has a serious leaking problem. As soon it starts raining you will see it leaking in all different kind of places, including the guest rooms. At one stage we had to change rooms because it was leaking right above our bed!

There are a lot of activities in the hotel, but knowing about them is pure luck. None of the staff really has all the information, which means that you have to go and search for it. In addition everybody gives you a different answer which makes it even harder. We missed a lot of special events or buffets because we simply didn’t know about it in advance.

The main selling point of the hotel is the food. The quality and choice is very good. There are different restaurants available which need to be pre-booked because not every restaurant is open every night. You can’t really book last minute as most of the restaurants get fully booked quickly. Therefore the reception or Concierge will make all your restaurant reservations in advance for the entire week when you arrive. This is a bit of a shame, because you can’t really go for the restaurant you feel like on the day. In addition they set a fix time for you which means even less flexibility. Who really knows what they feel like eating next week and at what time they will be hungry? And who wants that sort of schedule on their holiday?

At the end it all comes down to expectations. If you expect a Leading Hotel of the World 5 star hotel, then I would suggest you have a look for another hotel. If you are ok with a local 5 star property, got a good deal through your travel agent and you don’t require a great level of service, you can still have a good time at this hotel. 

If you do decide to stay at this hotel, try to make contact with the Concierge “Genaro” on your arrival. He is one of the few good ones we came across and he will try his upmost to help you with anything you need. He has limited authority but at least his attitude is good and he speaks good English.

reviews.author: cartoncorpsrl
reviews.title: buena estructura pero la atencion desastrosa
reviews.text: fui 15 dias y me fui al cuarto dia.llegue y ya me dijeron que si perdia el brazalete multa de 250 d. internet 15 d. x dia y encima se cortaba a cada rato,dicen que hay 7 restaurantes pero para desayunar y almorzar 1 solo,para cenar 3 0 4 y siempre tenes que llamar para reservar,pedis la bebida te tardan 2 horas,no te  resuelven los problemas,piletas de niños no hay,la que hay pertenece al otro palma real reserva y no podes hacer uso.No es un 5 estrellas pague 482 d. x dia y no se justifica,recomiendo el Moon Palace incomparable en todo,atencion estructura.CONCLUSION:Clarin hoy 31/10 lo recomienda pero la verdad es para amargarte

reviews.author: Angie1000
reviews.title: How do you say anaphylactic mold reaction in Spanish?
reviews.text:
First I will say this review will be jaded because I had an anaphylactic reaction to what I suspect was mold in the room coming from the airconditioning vent. Upon arrival, our room smelled musty but a lot of beach hotels have that smell so I didn't complain.  First I got a terrible headache that wouldn't go away and one morning I woke up at 5am with my airway constricted so that I was wheezing for breath.  I took  5 benedryl and woke my husband to get to a doctor.  The front desk got someone to drive me to the on call doctor at another hotel.  By the time I got there the benedryl had kicked in and I was breathing.  The doctor said it was most surely an allergic reaction to something and to take benedryl every 4 hours and avoid unknown food and plants and if it happened again go straight to an emergency room.  Okay, back to the hotel and back to sleep.  Next came the mucosal edema which caused me to cough like a 100 year old smoker.  Then came the runny eyes, nose etc. that lasted the entire trip and are only gone now that I am home.  This is just a warning for anyone who has a known mold allergy to beware.  My husband was fine.

Check in was a fiasco.  Although we were supposed to be in the Reserve, it was overbooked so we ended up at the main hotel.  The problem I had with this is that they didn't tell us what was going on.  We went to check in at the Reserve and they said no, you have to check in at the main hotel so we just thought we would be coming back but instead, in a stealth maneuver, they gave us a room number at the main hotel without a word.  After our discovery, we went back to the front desk to ask some seemingly innocent questions about the Reserve versus the main hotel to a different hotel reception representative.  He said it was about $150 more a night for a similar room and he said it was much nicer there with more ammenities.  Then I told him we were supposed to be at the Reserve and we were given a room at the main hotel instead.  He disappeared and produced another clueless agent.  When we told him our story he simply said that the Reserve was overbooked and that our hotel room was an upgrade because it had an ocean view.  He cut off the main hotel bracelet and gave us a Reserve bracelet acting like he was doing us a favor saying we could still use the ammenities at the Reserve although we would be staying at the main hotel.  The Ocean view turned out to be, if you could swing like a chimp from the balcony you might be able to see a pea size speck of blue ocean.  We tried to get some additional compensation like a free massage or something and they ademently refused saying that our room was comparable to the Reserve.

When you arrive you are gifted a consierge.  How nice you think.  He is the one to schedule all of your dinners and help to schedule activities.  He also happens to be the timeshare sales rep.  It is quite genius really.  If you would like to eat or do anything, he has another chance at trying to get you to go to the time share presentation.  He will call your room almost everyday or stalk you by the lunch buffet.  Our sales rep was nice but did get somewhat annoying, especially when I was sick and he was still trying to get us to go to a meeting. 

The pools were nice although the the sides and bottom needed cleaning.  The nicer more private pools were at the Reserve.  It was easy to get a palapa there.  I loved the palapas.  They were very comfortable.  It was nearly impossible to get one at the main hotel pools.  They had nice soothing music playing and it was easy to take an afternoon siesta in a palapa.

The beach had a lot of seaweed but other than that, it was clean.  I never saw any staff make any attempt at cleaning up the seaweed.  It was just there...They had a lot of free activities to do at the beach.  The way they described it to us, if it doesn't use gas, it is free.  They even taught free classes like scuba and windsurfing.  You could also use their boogie boards etc.  It was easy to get towels on the beach.  You didn't need to give them a room key or anything, just go ask for as many towels as you wanted. 

The food to me was bad.  My husband thought it was just ok.  I think this is the first vacation I have ever been on that I actually lost weight.  When you go to a restaurant and order from the menu, the menu makes things sound so wonderful but then when you taste it, you would not be able to match it with the menu description.  They also feel free to substitute something on the menu if it is out without asking or telling you.  For example, anytime I ordered something with scallops, it came out with shrimp instead.  Also, it seems that some menu items will have different descriptions at different restaurants but you are really getting the same thing just a different name for yuck.  Beware of some of the soups, I think it is just there way of recycling food.  Some of the soups just tasted like they threw some semi rotted vegetables into some water and cooked it for several days.  One day at the buffet I saw a manager showing an employee how he was supposed to to through each of the bins and pick out the things that looked unappealing and put them on a plate and stir up the rest to keep it looking good.  I also saw a cockroach crawl by on the back of the wall as they were sprucing up the buffet and they seemed oblivious to it.  Two good restaurants that I actually enjoyed were Vento and the Hibachi grill restaurant.

The rooms were relatively clean other than the mold.  The beds and pillows were very comfortable.

A few words about the bathrooms.  What in the world were they thinking when they designed these things?  The bathroom is separated from the sleeping area by some wooden shutters and some wooden balisters.  The toilet area has what can best be described as a frosted shower door on it.  In other words, the toilet has virtually no privacy.  In addition, you have hit the lotto if you can get a simple sheet of toilet paper to go down the toilet with one flush.  It is so sad when you have to stand there and wait for the toilet to flush and you feel like cheering when it is successful.  What can be worse than watching excrement swirl through six flushes not knowing if you are going to have to learn how to say plunger in Spanish?  Other than the obvious privacy issues of the toilet, if you go at night, the light also shines through to the bedroom.

I enjoyed a massage at the spa.  It was very relaxing.

We did schedule a few excursions but had to cancel when I got so sick.  The nice thing was that they did give us a refund for the excursions although they said it will take a few days to go through on the credit card I guess it remains to be seen if we really will get a refund.

I don't think I would ever go back to the Dominican Republic.  I like Mexico better.  We have been to Cancun many times and they have wonderful resorts there where the hotels are spotless and the service is wonderful.

reviews.author: SunLuvnGirl
reviews.title: IF YOU DON'T MIND PEOPLE/THIEVES WALKING INTO YOUR ROOM WHILE YOUR SLEEPING STAY HERE!!!!!
reviews.text:
BEWARE!!!! 
Upon arriving to the hotel at 130PM, our rooms would not be ready till 3PM, so our group had drinks at the bar in the lobby and waited for our rooms.  Once we got our room keys, we were exhausted from the day of traveling and the heat and settled into our rooms for a nap, leaving the do not disturb sign on the door.  My friends staying two doors down said they were woken up from their nap a few hours later when the maid had let herself in & started "reorganizing" their belongings.  What she actually was doing was riffling through their belongings!!!  When I woke up, I not only found things had been moved but my ring was missing from the night stand next to my bed where I was sleeping!!!  Someone let themselves into our room & had stolen my ring while I slept!!!  I was more terrified than appalled that someone had the audacity to come into our room while we were there sleeping!  We could have been raped & killed!!  I reported this to security which pretty much told me that it was my fault for leaving the ring on the nightstand but that they would look into the matter and get back to me w/in 48hours.  This was July 29th today is August 4th and I never heard back from them.  Before checking out I contacted security again and was told the man who was handling the situation wasn't there but would call me, no one has!  This definitely put a damper on our vacation but we were grateful to be alive & tried to enjoy our friends wedding.   We will never go there again & I would never recommend staying at this hotel to anyone!!!

PROS: From a distance its a beautiful place filled w/lush gardens, over-sized pool, bars every where, 15min drive from airport & located directly on the beach.

CONS: Up close the hotel needs a face-lift.  Paint was peeling every where & every Sunday instead of scrapping off the paint & repainting, they just painted over everything in the lobby.  Pool & Beach closed @ 7PM!!!  Food was average at best & I'm being too kind, w/the exception of BANA - the staff & food were amazing. Most people were unfriendly & spoke no English (except for the bartender Nelson located in the hotel lobby, who went above & beyond my expectations of what customer service should be.) No entertainment other than a 30min show on the weekends, which got old quick.  Rooms were moldy, leaky showers & mosquitoes in the room because the maids would leave the doors open while the cleaned! 

LUXURY HOTEL??? FAR FROM IT! STAY AWAY SAVE YOUR MONEY & STAY SOME WHERE ELSE FOR HALF THE PRICE!!!

reviews.author: agvaia
reviews.title: NOT PLACE FOR A FREQUENT TRAVELOR
reviews.text:
The first day you arrive at the Palma Real and the setting is lovely and the staff are friendly.  It goes downhill from there.  Some of the issues (not necessarily in order of severity):
1.  Breakfeast (one buffet restaurant everyday); same stuff different wrapper.
2.  Lunch (one buffet restaurant everyday); 95% if the same stuff, different wrapper.
3.  Dinner - Not counting the buffet restaurant there were 3 Restaurants.  Out of 5 strars, the best of them rates 3.  If you want to eat in one of them, you better make the reservation from the day before because even if they are half empty, they wont let you in without a reservation.  And oh yes...top-shelf alcohol...hahaha, ask to see the wine list...one un-named red wine is iincluded...all the 50+ other wines were not included in the all-inclusive.
4.  Rooms...the room must have been nice when it was first finished, probably 5 years ago.  The toilet (with a toilet paper waste basket) ughhhhh, has a glass door that opens up into the lavatory / jacuzzi area, that opens up into the Bed Room.  If you have any friends with stomac trouble visiting your room, I promise you'll be playing the TV loud and holding your nose....
(By the way...it seems all rooms have jacuzzi's and their ocean view is a waste of money). 
5.  Spa...We stopped by the Spa for a massage...we were told +/- $140...I said, but my sister just got a massage for $105 yesterday..."oh she must have had a package"  She didn't and here's the kicker, we got a one-hour massage on the beach for $85 (negotiated with masseus).  Lessons:  If you don't get a massage with any frequency, you may find it ok.  If you do, save your money....if you pay more than $25 it's not worth it.  With regard to price...this place is a joke.
6.  Staff...Overall the Restaurant Staff was the one bright spots...they were great!  The front desk staff were ok..but when I had a problem and wanted to talk to the Manager the young lady told me that she was the assistant Manager and she could handle it...after one minute she decided that she couldn't help me and the Manager was no where to be found.
7.  Para-sail...hold on to your hat for this one...weather was of no concern when (I saw one but was told it happened to two people) a customer broke free in a wind storm.  It was scary.  The last I saw, they were heading towards the hotel...I pray they landed safely.

I would never go back to this place...at half the listed price it may be tolerable...but compared to the other all-inclusinve resort I stayed at, for 25% less money there was no comparison...

agv

reviews.author: TravelinJunkies
reviews.title: bad food and bad service but nice beach and pool
reviews.text: Stayed for a week and started getting sick to my stomach from the food by the 2nd day. The room, beach and pool were really nice but you can't enjoy if you are sick. Tried eating away from the resort and stomach seemed to recover some so must be in their food. My wife and I were with another couple and all of us got sick so wasn't a fluke. Spoke with some other guests who had been coming there for many years and they said the quality was getting downhill. The overall service was really bad. Most of the staff couldn't answer any of our questions. They were generally nice but did not seem to be trained or given information by management. The ala carte restaurants were impossible to reserve yet were always empty when we walked by at night (seemed like a scam). Steakhouse grill and others were not even open. Only place to eat was buffet and food was pretty much the same every day and bad. Actually, I could deal with bad but getting sick from it was the problem. This pace is trying to be upscale and delivers on the room, grounds and pool but falls flat on service and quality of food. I was very disappointed by my stay and would never go back.

reviews.author: Geoff
reviews.title: Trouble in Paradisus
reviews.text:
Just returned. 

First the good: Beautiful grounds and resort, rooms were nice, good ala-cart restaurants, free snorkeling and scuba lesson.

The bad: Buffet restaurants were average at best. Food was stale and cold. 

The ugly: It's not a vacation, it's a time-share sales gimmick. Every day you must confront a strategically located gauntlet of sales people. It starts with your concierge and never ends. You can't even get beach towels without a sales pitch.  

Conclusion: It is a shame that such a beautiful property has been turned into a scam. Steer clear.

reviews.author: asalaMiami
reviews.title: A huge disappointment
reviews.text:
Don't even know where to start. We were there to celebrate my husbands 40th birthday... I felt so bad for him since we were not enjoying the place at all. In the end we were calling it our version of the  "National Lampoon Vacation". LOL

- The most important thing for you to know: there is no solid wall separating the bathroom from the bedroom. You hear EVERYTHING that goes on in the bathroom, so every time one of us needed some privacy the other had to go to the balcony. Not very romantic at all.

- We decided to upgrade to the Royal Service when we got there. I didn't care about the "butler" they offered with the RS, I was more interested in the oceanfront view. The butler, as well as the rest of the staff in that resort, barely spoke English. It was a nightmare of misunderstandings... We would ask one thing and she would do another. 

- I saw 3 roaches in our room in our very first night at the resort. I also woke up with bites on my legs, probably from flees or bed bugs.

- The food is mediocre at best. Not to mention the flies on top of all the food. Very unsanitary. 

- Staff was rude and did not make any effort to help you. I had never heard so many "no's" in a resort before. One example of their attitude: I went to the bar and asked for a bottle of water and the bartender handed me a bottle that was very warm, so I asked for a cold one. Without even looking at me he replied: not at the moment. Didn't offer me a glass with ice or anything, just turned his back and that was that.

- Stay away from the "vampires" at the vacation club, as one reviewer called them. Our 90 minute tour turned into a 3 hours nightmare. I am 4 months pregnant and was already tired of the walking around... We felt uncomfortable and pressured and after 3 hours I had to tell the 2 salesmen that were pressuring us to sign a 50 year vacation club contract: I am not going to sign anything, I need to go get something to eat now. As my husband and I were walking out the salesman tells us: next time have lunch before coming. Unbelievable. When we left the meeting it started to rain. We lost our day.

The positives? We were treated very well and had a great relaxing time at the spa. 

Not too many other positives, though. Next time we will go back to Iberostar Bavaro where we had a wonderful time in 2007, and paid less.

We will NEVER go back to any Sol Melia resort after this experience. It was very disappointing...

reviews.author: JoseManuelRivera
reviews.title: no justifica el precio
reviews.text:
Nosotros estubimos la semana pasada en el hotel, y la verdad es que hemos estado en varios hoteles mas en el mismo sector y de todo tipo de calidades.
Este hotel es un hotel extremadamente caro para lo que ofrece, y como atienden.
Es un hotel demasiado masivo y no tiene toda la entretencion como debiera, todo tiene un pero, por ejemplo, el gimnacio no puede tener las maquinas en mal estado y ademas sin el debido reapriete y acondicionamiento correspondiente, el check out es a las 12 del dia, pedimos poder estar hasta las 12:30 y nos fue negado, se equivocaron en el valor de la cuenta y nos fue dicho que ellos no tenian nada que ver con esa equivocacion y teniamos que ir al spa para que la arreglaran, muy poca versatilidad en los programas, no se pueden ocupar las instalaciones de los otros hoteles de la misma cadena que son vecinos, no hacen ninguna diferencia cuando uno ha estado en sus hoteles anteriormente, en el caso de nosotros hemos estado 3 vece, en fin varias otras cosas que no vale lapena mas comentar, y  que de verdad no justifican el precio pagado.
La atencion del personal en los restoranes, en la piscina, y los bares es buena, nada que ver con los de la recepcion.
Muy desconforme y creia que alguna diferencia podiamos tener, lo unico que les interesa es poder vender el tiempo compartido.
Aparte de todo internet era pagada y con unos computares que las teclas estaban casi todas malas.

reviews.author: archiphile
reviews.title: I'm not going to sue but
reviews.text:
We had a below average break at this resort.  We found the food in the buffets average at best.  The restaurants require a reservation an they messed ours up so I'm not that happy with that aspect.

We also intended on Kayaking, and sailing however the red flag (wind) was up for the four days of our trip and we were not allowed out on the water.

The guy at the pool yelling fire water really put the icing on the cake for us, I mean do I really want a shot pool side at 10am?  if so do I really need a guy to scream at me to do it?  and then to imitate as though it is him urinating in my mouth with the bottle?  
The place is a little confused between new age relaxation and DR frat boys gone wild.

reviews.author: pachanga
reviews.title: Not a 5 star..horrible service  .....beware upgrade scam!!!!!
reviews.text:
let me begin by first saying, i travel the world, & this is my first ever review of a hotel.  my husband & i booked this trip to punta cana to celebrate out 29th wedding anniversary.  i researched hotels in punta cana for over a month.  yes, i read the reviews on trip adviser &they were probably 60% in good favor.  i decided to book this resort mostly because of the 5 star rating & their partnership with leading hotels of the world.  this is a joke!!!!
1.  food -  it is 3 star at best.  if you like cruise food then you won't be dissappoined.  the buffet is disgusting.  gabi beach was just okay.  the service there was horrible. it took on average of one hour to eat lunch & 1.5 -2 for dinner.  chinese was terrible.  japanese was okay.  best was vento which we ate at twice.  beware.... everything  & i mean everything is overcooked.  what a waste.  and all the fruit on any bar on any day was not ripe.  wasted!!!  coffee everywhere was like drinking murky water.  no cream anywhere on this resort.  you drink 1/2 coffee & 1/2  milk.  smoothie bar was pretty good but flies were swarming all over the fruit. the idea of reserving dinner every night is a joke.  even though you have a reservation the hostess cant ever find it.  our concerige forgot to make our reservations & usually called when we went into the office to find out where we were going.
2.  service -  its the worst of any hotel i have ever been. everything they promise is a lie took 24 hours to repair tv in bedroom. ask for milk never got.  ask for beer  never got.  ask for hanagars took 24 hours.
3.  room -  nothing fancy.  the photo you see on the internet must be from their grand opening.  my room was so musty i could not breathe  or sleep.  our concerige came in & said this was normal.  i am still trying to get the smell from my clothing even the inside of my purse still smells.  it cost me $100 to dryclean all my clothes.
4.  beach -  good.  hotel did good job leaning seaweed.  never had trouble finding cushions. however i stayed 7 days & only saw a waiter come to take my drink order "1" time & i never saw attendant help find cushions.  but i loved the chairs very comfy.
5.  pool -  beautiful no complaints still no service would have loved to have been served a drink.. had to go fetch just like the beach
6.  golf -  was ok says free but you have to pay $40 cart fee which were from the ice ages.  they were very dis organized never started on time & they did not place golfers on any schedule.  a mess!!!! 
7.  spa -  did not get a service.  went to use the facilities which were not bad...except... i was sooo embarrassed when the attendant said she could not let us have a locker because we did not pay for a service.  the entire spa was empty!!!! we had to carry our clothing, phone, etc to every pool, etc. finally my husband was so furious & demanded a locker at once & they finally gave us one we looked silly carrying all our stuff to every pool!
8.  casino -  very small only 4-5 tables, but was fine
9.  shows - alittle cheesy but the staff tried hard to entetrtain us.  live music was good  gave us something to do after dinner
10.  bars all around the resort made terrible drinks  used very cheap liquor unless you requested good stuff.  the lobby bar & bartenders were excellent this was our hang out!!
and finally... beware of the upgrades they try to sell you!  do not do the new "vip" upgrade it is a joke!  a $700 joke foir us.  a big mistake on our part. this is something they try to sell you when you check in & has n othing to do with any package type on the internet this is their own package deal.  it is very confusing & the arm bands suck!!!

after reading this you decide to go or choose another resort.  but if you do come here dont have high expections or you will be ery dissappointed!!  i have watched this resort go from #14 to # 25 in past several months.  yes, i have voiced my opinion to the resort management.  they admitted they are aware of all my regrets & complaints, but did not try in any shape or form to make them right.  they said they are working on them.  that a very sad response, after i paid thousands for this vacation.  i will never return to this resort

reviews.author: stuart58
reviews.title: My travel agent warned me.
reviews.text:
So much potential.  We stayed at the Reserve area of the hotel in two adjoining master suites.  We had wanted to get connecting rooms but they were all booked so the kids had their own room.  The rooms were very spacious with nice balconies that had room for a round four seat table, a sitting area with a love seat and chair and a jacuzzi. 

The pool area was beautiful with plenty of chairs and covered sitting areas.  This is in contrast to the main hotel where a 7 am wake up call is necessary if you want a chair by the pool.

However once you get past the physical structure the experience drops off quite significantly.  Our room had mold which was there prior to the water damage caused by a Christmas eve downpour.

The biggest problem though is in their staffing.  We do not speak Spanish, which definitely would have helped, so there was limited communication with the staff of the hotel.  They require all dinner reservations be made through a "concierge".  No one quite seemed to know how the system worked, whether you could book at 9 or 11 am the day before, but it didn't really matter.  It meant that everyday I had to go run down my guy to book tomorrow night's dinner.  The penalty for not doing this was dinner in their "International Buffet", which didn't compete well with Old Country Buffet, because all of the restaurants would be booked.  The food in the restaurants was good to very good. This system requires a very competent staff person handling the interaction and ours was more interested in getting us to listen to their time share pitch.

I would consider going back but this time only after my travel agent says that they are ready for American tourists.

reviews.author: srpina
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
Hemos viajado por hoteles de playa en Europa y Asia y realmente el servicio de este hotel es el peor de un 5 estrellas:

- Teníamos un habitación standard y lo primero que nos dicen es que no podemos acceder a uno de los restaurantes ni a las zonas de la playa del royal service y del family concierge. La habitación estaba bien pero tenía un fuerte olor a humedad
- Nos dice el concierge que nos va a invitar a conocer las zonas a las que no tenemos derecho, ya que si hubieramos ido a través de la agencia de viajes de Meliá las podríamos haberlas utilizado, lo que nos pareció un insulto.
- Llegamos a la zona de la playa en la que podíamos estar y las hamacas no tienen colchonetas y son duras mientras ves que en las zonas a las que no tenemos derecho tienen colchonetas, muebles de diseño y camarero que te lleva las bebidas, mientras que nosotros teníamos que ir a buscarlas al bar ya que la camarera pasaba cada dos horas.
- Con el fin de no amargarnos la estancia pagamos la extorsión y nos cambiamos al royal service, el trato cambia considerablemente y el mayordomo que nos pusieron fue muy amable. La habitación era similar a la primera pero sin el olor a humedad. La ducha inunda el baño y los pasillos están llenas de bandejas de room service sin retirar, a veces estaban en el pasillo 24 horas
- la playa y la piscina del royal service son buenas y con buen servicio, además, nuestro mayordomo nos reservaba en cualquier restaurante sin ningún tipo de problema. obviamente el mejor restaurante es el gabi, en el que no nos dejaban entrar con la habitación standard.
- el acoso para que quedáramos con un representante para hacernos del club melia de vacaciones fue diario, dijimos no por lo menos 10 veces y aún así seguían ofreciéndolo. Fue tan kafkiano que ya los tomábamos de coña. No nos dieron ningún folleto sobre el tema, pero un representante siempre se ofrecía a invitarnos a almorzar en un resort de todo incluido!

En definitiva, llegamos allí pagando un dineral y nos encontramos conque nos daban una pulsera de segunda categoría y un servicio de 3 estrellas. La única forma de disfrutar la estancia es ir al royal service con un sobreprecio importante.

reviews.author: GaTraveler1950
reviews.title: Pretty place but food and service are very mediocre
reviews.text: This resort is in a beautiful spot, with nice wide and long beaches.  The resort is very large, and it can take you 5 minutes or so to walk from your room to the beach.  The resort's architectural design is very good, and it makes a great first impression. Our room, however, was musty, and after cleaning it smelled as though oven cleaner had been used as a disinfectant.  The food in the buffet restaurants is not good at all--the food in the speciality restaurants is better--but they are hard to reserve--it seems there are not nearly enough tables there to accommodate the size of the resort..  The staff can at times be very nice, and at other times rude.  You can understand why--they are subjected to large groups of people who demand prompt and attentive service and who, it seems for the most part, don't tip or otherwise express their appreciation for good service.  If you think of this as a land-locked cruise ship, and one that is at the low end of the quality scale, you will be just about on point.

reviews.author: Mishi16
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, But Watch Your Personal Belongings
reviews.text:
My fiance and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Oct 2009.  We attended a friend's wedding.  We had a great time and the rooms are beautiful.  We also went diving and had an amazing time.  We attended the wedding and reception, which was held in the VIP section.  The wedding was very small and intimate.  About an hour after dinner was done and everyone started dancing, I mentioned to my fiance I was going to grab my sunglasses off our table.  He asked me to grab his Oakley sunglasses also.  

When I went to the table, my sunglasses were there, but his were missing.  I reported it to the head server and she immediately stated that she knew all her servers and no one would do that.  They looked under the table skirt and told us the sunglasses were lost.  I stated in Spanish that the sunglasses were not lost, but stolen since they were next to mine - and mine were still on the table.  She told me to search the servers then.  I refused to ruin our friend's wedding by doing that.  The night manager and head of security arrived shortly after my conversation with the head server, and told us that they were sorry the sunglasses were lost.  I stated again - they were stolen.  The manager asked me the cost of the sunglasses, which I told him.  He then asked what my sunglasses costed, and I told him they were cheap.  

The manager then stated that they would interview the staff before they left the hotel premises and call me in the morning.  I never received a call.  The next day, I asked at reception to speak to security regarding the situation.  I was told that no sunglasses were returned to the lost and found.  The receptionist then returned to typing on her computer.  

Had this happened by the pool or in any common area of the resort I would never had suspected the wait staff.  However with a wedding of approximately 25 - 30 people who all know each other and in a restricted area.... I was very disappointed in their lack of customer service and how they handled the situation.  After spending approximately $1000 for a weekend hotel stay, I would expect a little more effort on the part of management to assist their guests.  It ruined our weekend and I will never choose this hotel again.

reviews.author: Paul_D25
reviews.title: Beautiful, but service is terrible!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Reserve (newest and trendiest part of the hotel inagurated about 10 months ago). Expect a beautiful property with fantastic decor and ambiance. The quality of the food is also quite nice specially if you pay the higher scale all-inclusive packages that grant access to all restaurants and hotel areas, as well as the water sport activities (worthwhile for the relatively small difference). One drawback is the amount of seaweed from the ocean (plenty of it at least during October) that might bother some people, but didn't bother me. 

Service was quite variable and we had a couple of instances where service was awful (the type of things you don't want to experience in a good vacation). For a 5 star hotel service was overall bad. I would recommend instead the Paradisus in the Mayan Riviera (Mexico) if you are looking for the same but with a nicer beach and much better service.

reviews.author: pgbmaloney
reviews.title: make a different choice
reviews.text:
On the up side, the people of the Dominican Republic are incredibly nice, including the ones who work at the Paradisus Palma Royal. They are nice to each other and nice to strangers, not to be taken for granted when traveling. The resort is beautiful (if you like a Roman Temple look in the Caribbean) and it has armed guards at the entrances, even along the beach. But I found it to be very poorly run and I also had one of the most infuriating travel experiences of my life and I am in the travel business. 
We only had two half days and a whole day there and two of those days were utterly ruined by having to deal with the management and the front desk. 
We had booked a suite through Orbitz. When I realized that the number of guests had gone through as 1 instead of 2, I called the resort and was told no problem. Sure enough, when we arrived, there was an envelope with both our names on it and they happily tied two bracelets to our arms.
I had booked the suite for 4 nights and invited our son to meet us there. We had to leave after two nights but he was going to stay. I advised them that there would be a third person for the first two nights then actually only one person for the final two nights, as we had to leave.
 First they wanted $250 per night for him to stay on our sofa, then after much discussion in a sweltering lobby after nearly an hour of waiting to check in, they reduced this to $162 per night, which we paid, even though it seemed high. But, they told us he could not stay in the room after we left because their software could not accommodate this since the room had not been booked in his name. They said we would need to pay again and then would need to contact Orbitz in hopes of getting some money back from them. Finally, after a sweaty ) hour and a half, they said to come back in two days, they would see if their software would permit it. 
Needless to say, that day was ruined. The next day they called me to come to the lobby again and announced that I had not paid for two persons initially. They were very accusatory, like I had been caught cheating them. I pointed out that I had called immediately and they were clearly expecting two guests and had in fact checked us both in. Thereupon they charged $162 more for my husband. So I had now paid the original rate on Orbitz plus an additional $326 per night. Then they said my son is too young to stay in the room after we left. After producing his passport showing that he is 21 they very reluctantly finally agreed he could stay for the two nights we had already paid for. I never did figure out why they wanted to have nearly 3 hours of arguing about something so simple, what do they care if we are still in the room or not? The experience was truly incredible, I would not have expected this in a cheap hotel in Europe never mind a Leading Resorts of the World property catering to wealthy people. Allegedly.
They could not possibly have been more unyielding, illogical or less concerned about angering a customer. So after spending nearly $3500 for a 3 day vacation, 2 of the 3 days were completely marred by arguing in a roasting hot lobby with the hotel management, who bordered on belligerent in my opinion.
As someone who has stayed in MANY of the Leading Hotels of the World group, never ever with any problem with any of them (that is why one uses these places--no hassle) I came away really regretting having gone.
Is it worth its **** status? If you have never stayed in a **** or a ***** it may seem so. But it is not of this calibre. The resort itself is very pretty, beach is nice, food mediocre but plentiful, lots of package vacation/canned wedding types staying there making a lot of noise and behaving in ways one does not generally encounter in a hotel that charges this kind of money--raucous in restaurants, shouting to one another, etc. Bars were a pleasure to deal with, restaurants were not, difficult to get coffee in the morning in the restaurant and although room service is included, room service alcohol is not so you have to go on a long walk for a glass of wine to have with your meal. My room servce caesar salad with shrimp was a little bundle of leaves and 3 shrimp. And took 35 minutes to bring.
Also, they advertise WiFi in the rooms. Not. You rent a cable and once in use you have the speed of a dialup. This was significant for us as we had some essential things we needed the internet for and didn't have it.
All in all, not worth the money, an incredible source of frustration and annoyance, poorly run and lots of sizzle without the steak to match. You can do far better for a destination wedding or a vacation. Nearly $700 a night for the three of us and serious, serious hassle pretty much the entire time. No extra charge for the attitude either.

reviews.author: ThePates
reviews.title: Beautiful but service is awful
reviews.text:
After a terrible day of traveling (missed flights, lost luggage, etc) we were so excited to arrive at the Paradisus Palma Real for our honeymoon. The resort is absolutely gorgeous, but it was not at all what we expected. It was very VERY difficult to find someone who could speak english well enough to help us find our luggage and we had to ask them repeatedly to help us. I thought maybe they would give us a tour of the hotel like they were doing to other guests but no such luck. Before we went to our room I asked the concierge if they had any samples since we had no toothbrushes, toothpaste, contact solution, sunscreen, etc. He said no and that we would have to go to the hotel store. The hotel store had everythign that we needed....for the craziest prices ever! We ended up spending over $100! Then we got to the room and they had the samples i needed and refused to let us return what we had bought! The food was ok but definitely not great, and its very difficult to get a reservation when you want it. They will tell you that there are no reservation left for 8 and that you have to go at a different time, but at 8 there are 4 tables taken out of 30 in the restaurants! After just a terrible trip all we wanted was smiles and a warm welcome and all we got were snide remarks, false information, and bad attitudes. We are not demanding people! We read other reviews like this and thought that the people were just being to picky but we were so wrong! DO not go here! BTW, internet costs extra if you aren't part of the royal service or the reserve, and the pillows smelled so bad that we had to have them exchanged.

(Hi Juan Carlos and Beth!)

reviews.author: boston45321
reviews.title: 4.5 Star Facility - 2.0 Star Service
reviews.text:
I recently came back from a 6 day trip to the Palma Real.  

Positives:  Beautiful resort - the beach is fantastic, the design of the lobby, bars, eating areas and bedrooms are beautiful and modern, the resort has a casino, several restaurants and  some very nice pool areas.  

Negatives:  The food is below average - the food at the buffet was often over cooked and appeared to be sitting under heat lamps for long periods of time, reservations to the various restaurants can only be made thorugh your assigned customer service rep (who will solicit you for tips before arranging restaurant reservations and activities).  Even when you tip the customer service rep, you will likely only get your 3rd or 4th choice.  The customer service rep will also pressure you into participating in boiler room time share presentations (be strong - they sell you hard!!!); dont expect anyone to serve you drinks while by the pool or at the beach (it's primarily self serve at the Paradisius).  You also wont be able to order any food or snacks while at the pool; when checking in you will likely wait several hours before getting your room (we waited about 2.5 hours and based on discussions with other guests, we were lucky to get our room that early);  

Tips:  Some of the best food and service can be had via room service (hamburgers and club sandwiches), they also have a nice breakfast.  Make sure to have the customer service rep book your dinner reservations early. they will try to draw it out to get more tips; don't veer to far from the hotel area or you will be swarmed by vendors selling you adventures, trinkets, and more.       

The resort is beautiful but it has many drawbacks that makes it difficult for me to recomend to others.  The shame of the resort is that if they cared a little more about the customer, it would be a great vacation spot.

reviews.author: David.brunat@free.fr
reviews.title: médiocre
reviews.text:
nourriture sans goût 
cocktail sans goût
rhum sans goût et sans alcool
vin sucré médiocre
piscine glassée 20°
mer qui est  l océan 21°
plage avec dune dur de se déplacer
impossibilité de parler français à la réception , on vous regarde sans rien faire
room service ne parle pas français donc impossible  de commander
connection internet cable 12$ + 24$ toute les 24h du vol en faite
pas de lumière le soir music d ascenseur

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: Quite odd but a beautiful property
reviews.text: As an American traveler this place just might drive you a little crazy. It is a beautiful property with a first class beach, beautiful sand and warm water. The processes and procedures are at best confusing and at worst devious. Eat in the cafeteria as the reservation restuarant scene is an exercise in frustration and quite honestly did not have very good food. There were quite a few individuals in our group including myself who developed some stomach issues which I assume were food related. Clearly the resort caters to travelers from Spain and I can't speak for their needs and wants but we were a bit underwhelmed by the sevice and the food. Our room was very nice and clean and for the most part up to date, no issues there. As I mentioned earlier the property was excellent, well maintained and on a fantastic beach. On balance this place needs some better management and is wasting a wonderful asset. We stayed at the Paradisus in Costa Rica a few years ago and enjoyed our stay and the Country much better.

reviews.author: rrf1234
reviews.title: Not what was expected
reviews.text:
I would highly recommend avoiding this hotel. The food was mediocre.  Most of the breakfast and lunch choices were from a buffet, where they do not keep perishables ie. lunch meats etc chilled.  We were sick much of the time until we learned what foods to avoid.  The dinner restaurants were a little better, but certainly not at a quality level that we would have liked for a vacation.  The dinner menus were very limited.  The extra charge GABI restaurant was a little better, but definitely not worth the additional charge.

We were supposed to have a King size bed, ocean view room.  It turned out that after being upgraded, we still had a garden view room with two queen size beds attached together (not our idea). The ocean was visible, but several hundred yards away.  We couldn't even see the beach or pool. 

The beach was full of sea weed and the ocean water was rough.  This hotel had the worst water conditions of any hotel on the beach.

We asked for softer pillows because my wife had a stiff neck.  They gave us soft pillows with goose feathers sticking out so that they would hurt your face if you slept on them.  I then demanded better pillows.  They told me I had to have "Royal" service for those pillows.  They finally relented after I threatened to check out, even though we had to pay in advance for the two full weeks we were scheduled to be there.  Turns out, the only way to get ocean view is to have the "Royal Service".  

I would recommend this hotel if you feel like being abused by staff, having mediocre (buffet style food) and getting sea weed all over you in the ocean.

reviews.author: travelingMan75
reviews.title: Not so much.....
reviews.text:
Ok, I’ll make this pretty simple but I’ll be sure to be as detailed as possible.  We're a young couple in our late 20's who visited the DR and this hotel specifically for a close friend's wedding. We just got back this week.  My feelings were confirmed in that I would never opt to stay at an all inclusive for the reasons ill lay out below.   We are very well traveled, and have been to many resorts in the past, so we a lot to compare this to.   I know people tend to be very picky on these reviews after spending a lot of money per night at a resort…..my below review has nothing to do with what we paid….I would write the same review if we stayed at an airport Marriott and paid $100 a night….This is the first review I have written because I just want to warn people what they are walking into. 

The resort is beautiful, the water is very pretty from afar and the rooms were nice….the staff was also very nice.   As you get closer to the water or into the water you will see the abundance of seaweed and sea grass….not the end of the world, but certainly not the most welcoming beach.  Service was really nice….we brought a ton of $1’s and handed them out pretty regularly…..it’s a very poor island, so it was much appreciated.   For some reason the toilet’s have clear glass doors on them in the rooms, and then the bathroom is pretty much open to the rest of the room……be prepared to get very close with whoever you are sharing a room with because there is no privacy.  You hear, smell, and know everything that is going on in the bathroom if you are in the main part of the hotel room.  We had an ocean view which was great and well worth the extra money (I would not opt for the Royal Service as it seems to be a way to squeeze you for more money with limited benefits).   

All this is great, but to me, eating is a major part of survival and a major part of having a nice vacation.  To say that the food is atrocious would be putting it mildly.  I’ll be honest, I am a bit of a food snob in that I like to actually eat things that are edible…..i’ve eaten at some of the finest restaurants in the country and can still find enjoyment with a hot dog off a street cart, so I’m just looking for something that is eatable…..I’ve had better buffet experiences at the local 7/11 where at least the nacho’s and hot dog’s taste like food and not shoe leather and blood.  The meat is so repulsive that the fact that it’s called a hamburger is shocking in its own way.  Bana the Tepen-yaki joint would have been fine, but they cooked the food until you couldn’t recognize it anymore.  Naos and Market grill are the only 2 lunch options….Market grill is actually the most eatable option in the resort.,….this is due mostly to the fact that the cook who runs the flat top actually has some sort of culinary training.  He knows how to make a skirt steak and its semi decent (again, I wouldn’t pay $5 bucks for this in the US, but in comparison to rest of the resort this is like eating at Arnie Morton’s!).  

Dinner…..wow was this rough.  Apparently there is one kitchen between all 4 “upscale” dinner dinning options.  The restaurants are all surrounding this one kitchen and its all really the same food dressed up to look ethnic for each different theme…..fine, I can deal with that if the food is actually food…..but, I wouldn’t serve my dog what was served to me.   We’re talking about food that was obviously cooked at 5:00 pm, held in chaffing dishes, and then literally microwaved (I know this because the chicken was cold to the touch, but when you cut it open it exploded with steam).  Vento is disgusting!  Don’t eat there….Passion is even worse.  I ate pasta and rice for 6 days until I begged my wife to go with me to Hard Rock café at their sister hotel…..I had to eat enough at hard rock to hold me the rest of the week.  Even the bread at this hotel is awful.  Breakfast was probably the safest out of the 3 meals… you’re safe with eggs and pancakes…..hard to mess that up. 

All and all we had a great time because we had a lot of friends there and drank an enormous amount of booze.  I guess we made up for what we didn’t eat with what we drank.  We didn’t get physically sick from the food (but emotionally I was damaged), so I guess that’s also a bonus.  I wouldn’t go back for the food reason and because I think there are just way too many beautiful places in the Caribbean which aren’t 3rd world countries.

reviews.author: alpinevelocity
reviews.title: Should have gone on a cruise for half the price!
reviews.text:
We just came back a couple of weeks ago from a 7-night stay for our honeymoon at Palma Real.  I'm 32 and my wife is 28.  I wanted to write an objective and unbiased review based on my experience to help others who might be considering this place.  Unfortunately, due to a tropical system we had non-stop rain for the first four days of our stay.  I do not hold any negative feelings toward the resort in this regard, after all they can't control the weather.
In a nutshell, the property and grounds are beautiful and impeccably maintained.  Clean and spacious rooms, manicured lawns, and very good general upkeep of the property.  We were upgraded to Royal Service and had the assistance of a personal butler.  Although our first butler was attentive and helpful in securing reservations to the restaurants that required it, our second butler assigned to us halfway through our stay was never heard from.  I would definitely not pay the extra $150/night for this sham service.  Overall service and attentiveness was pretty good and the employees were friendly, but there was room for improvement and more pampering.
The room was great except for the toilet situation.  There is a need for more personal privacy. This is very tacky and makes it somewhat uncomfortable, especially for someone in my situation as a newlywed.  The toilets are inside the bathroom area but are only separated by a 2/3 size glass door with huge two-foot gaps at the top and bottom.  Also, while there are nice jacuzzis inside every room, there isn't  a heated one poolside anywhere on the resort, except  at their "spa" which you must pay extra to access.  Their famous "spa" is worthless and you can find a better one at your local neighborhood gym.  Don't waste your time and money here, though my wife did have a 50 minute massage which she says she enjoyed.
My biggest problem was with their food.  This is is a five-star resort with 2-3 star food, and I'm being generous.  Unfortunately, good food was the exception rather than the rule.  Look, I enjoy good food and do consider myself an adventurous eater but I am in no way a food snob.  I can find as much delight in eating fresh sushi and imported meats and cheese as much as tasty tacos and good meatloaf at an old fashioned diner.  Their Naos "world cuisine" buffet just plain sucks.  Any cheap $6 buffet in the US or a Luby's will beat their flavor and selection.  I tried to avoid eating there at all costs.  Breakfast was the only decent meal there.  Unfortunately, for non Royal Service guests this horrible place is the only option for breakfast and lunch.  The rest of the restaurants (that require reservations) were decent but lacking in overall flavor.  Plate presentation was beautiful and the ingredients were mostly fresh, but food was often overcooked and just did not taste good.  It was all looks with no substance.  Coming from the U.S., don't even try the steaks.  You will not like them.  The meat is very tough and tastes very different than American beef, you can really taste the blood in every bite.  As expected, the seafood selections were among the better items.  Many dishes would have been much better if they would just have kept it simpler.  They tried to over-reach with lots of sauces that did not taste good or complement the ingredients.  After a while I noticed that all their sauces were a slight variation of the same nasty stuff.
Also, their beach activities are very limited with no motorized watersports.  The company they contract with for the acivities "Scuba Caribe" and its representatives will try high-pressure sales tactics to sell you everything they can that is not included.  I went to Catalina Island for what was supposed to be a scuba adventure and they cancelled the trip due to raw sewage flowing into the sea from the island.  We did get our money back, but it took three days of them supposedly not having any change.   The only activities included are:  Kayaking/canoeing, catamaran sailing, windsurfing (which for some reason was never available), and pedal boats.  I did all but windsurfing one day and pedal boats and kayaks were extremely BORING followed closely on the boring scale by the catamaran.  There is no horseback riding on the beach (you have to go inland), and the one kinda fun thing we did get to do was the Segway off-road tour which was not included.
Considering the price (not cheap), I paid US$453/night on sale, I would have opted to go on a cruise instead.  We could've had a top-of-the line room, the food would have been way better and there would have been lots more fun activities to choose from.  Not to mention the fact that you could visit different ports of call.  While Punta Cana is nice, there is not much to do other than lay out on the beach and get a killer tan.  I would not go back to this resorts and probably will be staying away from the all-inclusive type resort.

reviews.author: LIRon53
reviews.title: Credit card stolen
reviews.text:
Just back from Paradisus Palma Real, my wife and I booked Royal Service. We had a room on the first  floor number 1098 close to the Royal service pool. As the title of the review states my wife had her purse and credit card stolen from our room. We returned from a walk along the beach at 10:30 in the morning on Saturday to find the maid and the butler standing at the door with my wife's wallet and FAA badge asking if they belonged to her. The credit card issued to her for business travel was missing. All the other credit cards were in the wallet. We made several calls to the US and we were able to have the card cancelled within two hours . We contacted security immediately and we we assured they would contact us the next day. We also contacted the person in charge of the complex and again were assured they would get back to us. No one ever got back to us. The room was locked the only people with access to the room are employee's of the hotel. Also my wife was at the Spa the next day and a woman was complaining her watch was stolen. 

Aslo room service would come by and 11 pm wanting to make up the room this happened several times. The hotle was not crowded we were their week og Aug 21 - 25 they had all day to make up the room. 

The hotel is very nice and the grounds are beautiful just leave your credit cards at home.

reviews.author: plf1234
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but food and service not up to par
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful.  The beach and pool are magnificent except for tons of seaweed at the beach.  There are plenty of shaded lounge chairs at both the pool and beach.   The hotel has plenty of towels and towel service is on the honor system-no checking towels in and out...definitely a plus.  We did not use royal service and found  that we were treated as 2nd class citizens.  It was difficult to make a dinner reservation between 6PM and 9:15PM because this large time block was reserved for the royal service guests.  The assigned concierge's main job is not to assist you but rather to harass you to attend the Sol Melia Vacation Club presentation.  We eventually went and it was the biggest waste of time.  The salesman never got to the point and could not answer basic questions about the product.  After a half hour if listening to this garbage, we decided that we were not interested and  wanted to leave and we were denied our promised $50 spa credit because we didn't stay for the full 90 minutes.
    The restaurants were very average, nothing spectacular, either in food or service. The best restaurant was Passion, but since the tasting menu did not change, we only ate there twice.  The Market Grille was the next best pick, serving surf and turf.  The other restaurants were really substandard.    Despite drinking only the bottled water, our entire party came down with both abdominal issues and severe skin rashes, diagnosed as hot tub dermatitus.   We have been back for a week and these issues are still with us.

reviews.author: Tooomm
reviews.title: Do not waste your money here
reviews.text: Me and my girlfriend have spent one week in this hotel. Our first impression was that if only we had not moved here from Excellence punta cana. The hotel location is OK, but the recepcionist was very rude, and we hardly got our room, because we had to listen to the concierge guy speech which was really bored us. The room was good one of the few things we liked (although the door couldn't be locked from inside anytime some cleaning staff could come in!!!).The food was great and you have lot of choice of many different type of seafood etc. The beach looks marvellous from a certain distance but if you get closer you can see the plenty of weeds or some flowers swimming on surface it really disturbes us. I can say that for this amount there are more better hotels in Punta cana (Excellence Punta Cana, we moved from there). Very poor sport activities!!!

reviews.author: DAR2599
reviews.title: A Lost Opportunity
reviews.text: This is a property that had the opportunity to be a great resort but they squandered their opportunity. The physical plant is quite nice with a modern sculpture garden that is the centerpiece of their lobby. However, they fall short when it comes to their personnel. Check-in was long and frustrating. Their front desk was woefully understaffed. Within twenty-four hours of our arrival, the hotel staff spent two hours trying to sell us a membership in their vacation club. When we turned them down, they made it seem that we had wasted their time when in fact they had wasted ours. Trying to get food or drink service often meant standing up at the dining table in order to attract a waiter. The food was actually quite good. Their entertainment/nightly shows were another story. The shows repeatedly started one to two hours after the advertised time. The resort lacked basics such as ping-pong tables, pool tables, and jet skis. This was problematic when the teens are looking for activities with which to spend their time.Their housekeeping was highly variable in quality. Though the hotel advertised that it had free internet access, they charged daily access fees plus a $12 fee for a 12 inch ethernet cable. Overall, we were highly disappointed with the facility especially since it was advertised as a 4.5 star resort. I would look elsewhere if you are planning a trip to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: BUZA
reviews.title: No está a nivel de su categoría
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados 1 semana en el mes de julio, tenia mucho interés por conocer este hotel, ya que, en otras visitas a Pta. Cana había visto como lo construían.
Efectivamente las instalaciones son estupendas, pero el resto deja mucho que desear para la categoría de hotel que tiene, y como lo venden indicando es uno de los mejores hoteles del Caribe. Puedo asegurar, que conozco bien el Caribe, y para nada es un buen hotel. Empezando porque parece un mercado, cada 100 mts. tienes o una mesa con un comercial o te asaltan a lo largo del hotel, para venderte una especie de multipropiedad. Yo creo que este tipo de servicios deberían hacerlo de una manera discreta, y con elegancia. En cuanto a la comida se refiere, creo que esta enfocada al turismo América, mucho frito, hamburguesas, pizzas, costaba trabajo comer algo de calidad. Y ni que decir tiene el servicio, aquí si me quede alucinada, teniendo en cuenta el buen carácter Dominicano, creo que han contratado a los mas resabiados de la Isla, contestando con desgana y si comprobaban que no eras turista Americano con sus propinas, no te hacían mucho caso. Durante mi estancia de tan solo 1 semana, ha sido constante el comprobar el mal servicio, y a excepción de 2 camareros y el cheff del rte. Asiático, un desastre.
Por mi parte, no volveré a este hotel, habiendo como hay magníficos hoteles en el Caribe, y recomendaría al Dpto. de Auditoria de esta gran cadena hotelera hicieran una visita sorpresa y comprobaran lo escrito.

reviews.author: harry207
reviews.title: not the pampering we expected
reviews.text: View of resort is beautiful and resembles pictures viewed on internet.  My husband researched and then confirmed with trvl agnt resrt to be every bit a 6apple/star rating. NOT.  Very nice 1-bdrm suite with home amenities, but really wanted to be pampered, like on a Vacation.  Never had enough towels, hard to locate maid, need res for all but one restaurant, need to call the day b-4 after 6Pm, our choices were 6pm or 9pm, had to wait for pool towels most days 20+mins, one swim-up pool bar,thank goodness the bar tenders were terrific, faster to get yourself a drink  when lounging pool side, resort maybe under staffed(?). Gym does not open until 7AM and 3 of 8 machines were out of order, free weights  and spinng bikes available.  Sorry to say we will not return to this resort.  Good luck to all who venture here.

reviews.author: theblues5
reviews.title: Really wish it had been better!
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 5-day stay here (6/8 - 6/12). The resort is beautiful, the beach is beautiful. They have a huge staff, and they all work very hard. Security is very evident around the complex ... but

Our room safe was broken into. Somehow this was done without knowing the code, or changing the code, but it was done. Thank goodness they did not take everything. After this, we were very careful (on 3rd floor). We would be completely certain that when we left our room the balcony was locked and the room door was locked - still though, every time we returned we would just push on the door and it would open ... the balcony slider would be unlocked too. Really put it a damper on the trip (1st day).

The 2nd day a convention of 450 people came. They were treated extra special, but they did not act extra special. They were dirty and loud.  Something to keep in mind that may happen to you if you book at a large resort with meeting rooms.

The food was presented beautifully and there was never a lack of; however, it wasn't all very good. The a la carte restaurants were, but very few things from the buffets actually tasted good.

Before going I had read a lot of reviews regarding the time share people. Yes, they were present, but if you said no they left you alone.

Bottom line ... it was very beautiful, but bad things can happen. If the food doesn't mean that much to you, you can tolerate a large group of people that are partying hard, and you know that you have to be safe (somehow), go here.

reviews.author: nekkoleg
reviews.title: Royal Service Ripoff
reviews.text: Stayed at this facility in early May 2008 and have to say that the grounds are beautiful.When we checked into our "Royal Service " Room it was still dirty from the prior guests with uneaten food everywhere. Our " Butler " was embarrassed and invited us to tour the facilities while our room was attended to. When we finally went back to our cleaned room there was hair & dust everywhere including the whirlpool tub in the bathroom which was disgusting.The "Butler " is an individual who you will see upon checkin who will give you his cell phone number than you will never hear from him again.
