In fact, Fernando blamed us that he didn’t understand what we wanted. Mind you we spoke in his native language Spanish and repeated it multiple times. Service to the rooms, call them like 4 times to get anything. We even had a part of the family say in the Nikete level, they paid more money for even worse service. They actually didn’t anything they were promised and the lower end rooms where nice then the more expensive room. They had issues with their room from the start of the trip and their dedicated concierge was a complete lie, he didn’t show up and didn’t help. Activities are scarce. The food was okay. But for the price, go to another resort and have a blast. This one looks like they painted it from falling apart and the service was terrible.

reviews.author: Yegzeru A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Good day,
I am writing to give feedback on my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. I am a member for about 8 years. There are times I stay using my options, and there are times I go to Punta Cana just because my family and I love it there. We have always have good experiences and this was the first time we didn’t. 
We checked in and our room was not ready. Understandable, because we arrived to the hotel at 1.  After checking in, the person at the front desk told us to come back at 3 to see if the room was ready. We went to the beach and grabbed a bite to eat before heading back to the front desk. I found it weird how I wasn’t given a concierge right away so that the concierge would let me know when the room was ready, but I figured I would get one soon enough. 
The following day, I decided to make a reservation for a restaurant. Upon trying to make a reservation, a concierge came to me and said that he wasn’t notified of my arrival and he was waiting for us, meanwhile this was the following day. He went ahead and made a reservation for us that Saturday night at the Italian place. He told us the reservation would be under another room because I guess that person cancelled. The reservation was at 8. We usually never eat that late, but we took it. When we got to the restaurant, we gave the person the room number that the concierge had given us. They asked our name and told us there was no reservation. We showed them the text message from the concierge but they said there was nothing they can do. We left the restaurant disappointed because we could not eat there and because now we were forced to eat late at the buffet. 
The next day, the concierge let us know there was another reservation made for us at the Mexican place. When we get there, we give our room number and name and they tell us that the reservation was made for one person. They told us that luckily they had room so they were able to squeeze us in. Another disappointment for us having to be told the reservation was made incorrectly by the concierge. 
The day I met the concierge, he knew I wanted to eat at either the steak house or hibachi for our final dinner which was Monday. He let me know that reservations can only be made 2 days in advance. So when we asked him on Monday morning, he said everything was booked. So for our last night there, we ordered room service. 
This whole trip was disappointing. My family and I have never experienced this and I ask myself, is good service given to members only? If that’s the case, very sad. Melia is a huge company and has to remember they have members that don’t always come using options and regardless great service service always be provided. 
There were 2 employees that were nothing but nice to us and that was Eric that was our waiter at the buffet for lunch and  Vanessa who took take of us while at the beach.

reviews.author: Nubar K
reviews.title: Deception, disgusting and disappointing
reviews.text:
I would give this hotel a 0 if i could. Recently got back from our 1st family vacation in years and was run through the typical mill of ripping off tourists.  
We booked connecting rooms as we have 3 small children, all was confirmed over the phone.  A week prior we are told rooms are not connected and there is no availability.  Of course when i arrive at the front desk what am i told  by front desk "if you can pay $700 cash we can give you connecting rooms"  What do i do? I traveled 1k miles with my kids, I was left with my pants down and had to pay.  Insane extortion.
The facility itself is beautiful, I cant knock it.  The majority of the staff is disinterested in your happiness and comfort.  There were a few absolutely selfless and dedicated employees on site, good luck finding them as it wont be hard since most are so rude and make fun of you when you try and speak spanish.
Room keys always malfunction so you need to go to front desk all the time.
The pinnacle was after the 1st room cleaning, we came back at night and found a stain on the sheets - you decide, blood or feces that was not cleaned.  Although they immediately changed it the customer service after claimed it was RUST.  How does a cloth sheet rust???? absurd.  
Think twice before you book.  Truly gives the Paradisus name a bad look.  My post stay complaints with the hotel were absolutely worthless and you can see from every comment on these reviews.  They apologize and hope they can improve next time.  

So much for a paradise.......

reviews.author: Eric C
reviews.title: I don’t recommend you can find better place
reviews.text: Food is terrible, people preparing breakfast don’t know what they doing. They cannot make even simple eggs over easy. Half of the restaurants you not allowed to go too unless you are a member you cannot use full facility because you’re not a member and bars are restricted to a member or adults only section, Communication with the guests are terrible. They had a big event and they did not notify anybody that you cannot use buffet for a dinner. They made me eat in Mexican restaurant which I don’t like. None of the bars can make a piña colada. They told me they don’t have piña colada in this hotel. I can have anything else, but piña colada the simplest drink to make and specially in Caribbean. Waiters and maids working great rooms are very clean. Waiters are polite, but everything else in this place bad

reviews.author: Teresa B
reviews.title: NO SERVING UTENSILS at BUFFET
reviews.text: If you like to use your hands to get food vs serving utensils at the Buffet then this is your place. 🤮. Not every item on the buffet had serving utensils and people were using their hands. GROSS & NO THANK YOU

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.title: Hard Pass.
reviews.text:
We had the most disappointing stay here. We upgraded to a Nikke room so we would have upgraded services and a butler to help us with our stay. Our room was old and dated. Our butler did NOTHING for us. Not one reservation. Didn’t answer our texts. We did not get the promised amenities or services or experiences. We called, talked to front desk, emailed Melia. No one cared. I’m furious and beyond disappointed. 

Nothing in the resort is amazing. Food is meh. Activities are very few and far between. Go elsewhere.

reviews.author: scott a
reviews.title: poor customer service and cold showers
reviews.text:
I am really not one to write reviews but I had no choice after our recent visit.  My wife and I organized a trip for our daughters spring break and convinced 15 other families to join us.  
Let me start with a couple positives:  this location has great weather, the swim out pool was amazing and the beach was walkable and really nice.
Here we go:  the customer service was flat out pathetic!   I was fully expecting somone to understand english but the majority of the resort knew little to zero english.  This really makes communicating or asking any questions nearly impossible.   The food was maybe a 2 out of 10 and our entire group was sick the majority of the time.  (3) of our days/nights were without hot water in both of our rooms.  When I asked to have this addressed, nothing was done.  When we went to check out and I asked to speak to our "butler", he walked the other way.  When I asked to speak to a manager to discuss our frustrations, no one had any authority to do anything.  I was not looking for a huge portion off the bill, but wanted someone (anyone) to take accountability for no hot water.  I would never, ever recommend staying at this resort!

reviews.author: Heather O
reviews.title: TERRIBLE! Spend your money elsewhere
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for four nights and I would never return. The staff are the opposite of helpful and they hide behind the language barrier and act like they don't know what you are asking for. When we asked in fluent Spanish, they still act like they don't understand you. All the staff want are tips, tips and more tips. If you don't have money waving in front of them, they ignore you. A roach was in my room -- they don't care. We were out of towels, toilet paper and tissues - they don't care. It's really shocking the terrible service. The food is plentiful, but not appetizing at all. The first vacation in my adult life that I have lost weight. The breakfasts were good --- you could get an omelet. But it went downhill from there. The meat is chewy and has a funny taste. The hotel boasts a personal concierge in the adults only "Reserve" section, but I never laid eyes on my concierge in five days! I am convinced he is a bot in another country. They only communicate via Whats Ap and they ignore any requests for dinner reservations, etc. The room was over $700/night yet you would get better service at a Holiday Inn.

reviews.author: rajase417
reviews.title: Not worth the Money
reviews.text: Visited inarch 2024 The quality and variety of food is bad and lack of bar options. The Rooms Maintenance is also not good. There was a bad smell coming in the lobby of deserve buildings. Totally disappointed with overall service and hotel

reviews.author: CAM
reviews.title: Thieving staff with management that accommodates this behavior.
reviews.text:
Until the day of our departure, the stay was not perfect but okay. The last hour was disturbing and management’s response incomprehensible.
Fifteen minutes prior to check out time, we returned to our room and were shocked to find multiple cleaning staff inside. They had unzipped our two flight carry-on tote bags and were wading through the contents spread across a table.  Luckily, we arrived in time to catch them in the act – with the only a baseball hat stolen (not misplaced as someone had to physically remove the hat by opening a carabiner attached to a tote bag). We collected our items and went to the front desk.
We talked to the desk manager, Wladimir R.  He took our contact information and said he would investigate and get back to us, strangely adding “there are two sides to every story”.  As we had booked through Delta Vacations, I called them to inform them of the situation mainly for their awareness.  They were helpful and ended up playing intermediary for communications with the resort - as I never heard directly from resort management. After three weeks with a few communications clarifying details, we received a message saying the hotel reviewed “CCTV images and found no inappropriate actions on the part of the staff”. 
Not sure what we expected from management, BUT we certainly did not expect them to lie and protect thieving staff.  Suggestion: type in “theft” in the review search box to see similar issues with theft at this location.

reviews.author: D J
reviews.title: Not a Five Star Resort - Overpriced - avoid
reviews.text: 1. Refund policy was used as a shield to charge us an extra night for 2 rooms booked. We attempted to change the room booking almost 2 months in advance and was unsuccessful in having the charge reversed. Still working to have this situation rectified. 2. Upon check-in we were given a smaller room (with 2 twin beds) than the one we booked that was supposed to have a king bed. This also happened to the other suite we booked for another conference delegate. The front desk was not very helpful in addressing the issue until some extra money was paid under the table. 3. While beautiful, the hotel room had the A/C break. This happened on three separate occasions and always in the evening. Subsequently, we had to sleep 3 out of 7 nights uncomfortably without A/C. Furthermore, it required us to call the front desk at least 3-4 times every time it broke as we were repeatedly told it would be fixed "right away". It usually took over 12-14 hours to have the issue addressed and only after multiple requests to do so. 4. We were extremely disappointed to see that the only option for breakfast and lunch was the Lunch Box. As a supposed five star resort, having options for a la carte dining is expected - at the very least, we expected to have more than one choice of restaurant. 5. The A/C in the Lunch Box was not consistent nor were the cooling trays holding perishable food, leading us to believe that food safety was not a priority. This was further evidenced by the fact that over 12 people attending the sponsored pool party became ill with a couple ending up in the hospital. 6. No waiter based food or drink service was available at any of the lounge chairs in the pool areas. Again, this is an expectation from a five star resort. 7. Dinner reservations - on our first night, we attempted to book a reservation for dinner at 4PM due to our arrival time and was told that the reservation system closes at 4 and our only option was to eat at the buffet. 4PM? I find it hard to believe that you can't make a dinner reservation at this time of day, secondly, we went to the reservation table the next day and a sign was posted clearly showing the hours of closing of 5PM. We were also told that we could only book reservations for the evening, not for subsequent days however, the reservation desk moved to the conference area and delegates were being told they could then book multiple days in advance. It seems like the rules change all the time without any notice.  Consequently, we were only able to secure reservations past 9PM and for the restaurant we had already been to. During our whole trip, we only visited 3 different restaurants. 8. While we did experience some good service from a few people, in general, we felt like there were plenty of staff, none of whom were interested in serving anyone. We had to constantly get up to request things like more water or other beverages and when we did so, the impression that we got was that we were an inconvenience for the workers who are supposed to be there for the guests. Ultimately, we will never return to any hotel owned by Melia nor would I ever recommend anyone to go there.  I've stayed at other resorts both in the Dominican Republic and in the Caribbean and I can say that this was by far the worst experience I've had in over 20 years.

reviews.author: holaco11
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: It all started at check in when I booked a King bed and when I got to my room it was two double beds. When I went to the front desk to try and rectify it I was basically told too bad thats all we have. When I explained that I had booked a king bed the guy waked away from me. It all went downhill from there.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.title: Ernesto at Circle By Melia scammed us!
reviews.text: Very disappointed with the hotel staff that conned me into attending their vacation sales meeting. I was told by Ernesto that if I attended, I would be given a free week at a Melia resort, even if I didn’t purchase their vacation package. THIS WAS IN A TEXT MESSAGE.  I spent almost an hour and a half of their sales pitch. After the meeting, Ernesto promised the certificate, but has failed to deliver. I have messaged him repeatedly.  Please don’t fall victim to their scam. Stay clear of the Circle By Melia sales presentation. Waste of our precious vacation time.

reviews.author: serakim1985
reviews.title: Horrible experience. I don’t recommend anyone even if it is free
reviews.text: This place is the worst resort i have ever been. Workers need to check their attitude especially the guys from Mexican restaurant and carlos from the front. do not advertise If you guys gonna ask for tips and harassing us. we usually tip 25% at the restaurant in US. The reason we didn’t have a cash is because you guys advertise as tips included

reviews.author: Sherpa63895127646
reviews.title: Bed bugs!!!!!
reviews.text: We got bed bugs in our room. We had to insist to get another room because they wanted to spray the room?!? Either they are taking us for imbeciles or they don't know how to manage a bug infestation which is very worrying in both cases. We finally got another room that had no climatisation. For a five star it is absolutely unacceptable. The food is also really below what is expected in this type of property. Finally the concierge harassing you every day to try to sell you their scam timeshare is also a complete turn off. It is really a shame since the rooms, the beach and the hotel are really beautiful.

reviews.author: A B
reviews.title: 1 star is being generous.
reviews.text: This property is not 5 star and is not all inclusive of anything. Not inclusive of good food, good service, good amenities, nada. There are a few redeeming employees who went above and beyond for us - Luis, Carolin, Wanda. There isn’t enough room on this review page for me to outline the failing of Paradisus Palma Real.  As a group of approx 100 ppl on our group - we couldn’t get reservations to the restaurants, we couldn’t get washcloths, rooms were hot, food mediocre at best, no beach towels two days in a row (sat & sun!).  Steer clear, folks.

reviews.author: chrisconlon1262
reviews.title: Disgusting food. Not worth the money.
reviews.text: The food was tasteless at all restaurants. Very disappointing choices in seafood. Salvage, the food was barely warm, no flavor and poor service. Sante, service was OK, food was flavorless. Mina was OK at best. Steak was OK, seafood was over cooked and flavorless. The only bright spot was Rafeal at the beach. He worked hard to make sure all of his guest were taken care of. Too bad the rest of the place did not match his efforts.

reviews.author: ashumilinski
reviews.title: Horrible Service
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is incredibly disappointing, to say the least. From the moment we arrived, it was evident that the level of service was far below acceptable standards. The staff seemed disinterested and unhelpful, making our stay feel like more of a burden than a vacation.

Throughout our stay, we encountered numerous instances of incompetence and indifference from the staff. Requests for assistance were met with apathy, and simple inquiries were often ignored or brushed off and given poor service. It was clear that the staff were not properly trained or motivated to provide satisfactory service to guests. Staff has asked to compensation several  times.

Additionally, the dining experience was subpar. The food quality was mediocre at best, and the service in the restaurants was slow and inattentive. We also experienced difficulties making reservations at the on-site restaurants, further adding to our frustration.

Overall, our experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort was highly disappointing, and I would strongly advise against staying there. The lack of professionalism and basic courtesy from the staff, combined with the poor quality of amenities, made for an unpleasant and regrettable stay.

reviews.author: Jaime
reviews.title: Brutal unless you're a Circle Member
reviews.text:
IF YOUR NOT PART OF THE CICLE CLUB, DO NOT GO TO THIS RESORT! Worst experience for such a beautiful hotel. We were a party of 5, 3 in 1 room and 2 in another. For our party of 3, they had 3 different room in 4 days, key bracelets never worked, and spent half the trip getting them reprogrammed on the daily. Had a gentleman who was to be our concierge, ( because thats what we PAID for) and his hands were so tided and we couldn't get into any of our restaurants, poor guy had little to no support from upper management  and they actually fired him.  With no concierge. WE ALL MISSED OUT ON 3/4's of what was included in our package because we couldn't book anything ourselves (without having a concierge). The restaurants that we were able to finally get into were overrun by the circle members, so our dinners took forever to come, and when we did get them, they were cold (wasn't even worth the wait as the food was not very good at all). POOLS we freezing as they are not heated! First time I have been to any resort that had no real entertainment, NO theater, not shows, a bit of life in the Ginger bar mid afternoon, some evening music but really nothing for actual entertainment at night. No late night snacks other than room service, which is completely not convenient and forces you to go back to your room to eat.  With all that I have mentioned (there is a lot more but those are the main points that really affected our trip) they was absolutely no care in the world from any of the management, which is completely disgusting as we paid and extreme amount to have the first class experience.  
ONLY 2 shout outs: Misael  aka "Big Mike" absolutely a great guy! Always smiling always and very very pleasent young man!!! They are very lucky to have him! SANTE restaurant (where we didn't need a reso) was the best food in the whole resort. They made us feel very welcome and were excited to see us every night! And our amazing Beach guy YUDERI who prepared our beach chairs every morning for us!!! He was so kind and so friendly and just made our day everyday! 
Overall, this resort ruined my vacation. We paid a great amount of money for an experience we never received!!! Completely disgusted!!!

reviews.author: Eitan R
reviews.title: Fine location horrible reception
reviews.text:
What’s a terrible way to treat people.  We’ve been coming here for ever. We are Meliã Platinum and yet were welcome by the most unfriendly reception in all our years of travel, to this or any property.
We asked if we would be getting an upgrade as is the case of Platinum members. This unleashed a chain sequence of  eye-rolls  followed by a wait followed but more eye rolling. When we were told there are no rooms available for the upgrade we just sent them a screenshot of the available rooms and said we don’t need the upgrade we are fine paying for it. Suddenly an upgrade was available due to a last moment cancellation. What a joke!!

reviews.author: Jurabek Menglibaev
reviews.title: If you’re used to the level of customer service and attention to detail of Cancun, Mexico, do not even consider visiting
reviews.text: If you’re used to the level of customer service and attention to detail of Cancun, Mexico, do not even consider visiting this resort. It’s evident that most workers simply don’t care about your needs and will try to avoid any initial requests you may have by saying it’s impossible. The food at any restaurant is quite sub-par and the food is terribly under seasoned. No matter where you go in the resort there is an issue with the food. It’s always either terribly chewy, undercooked, or charred to a crisp. Food options are extremely limited, especially for kids who are often forced to consume nothing but terribly bland chicken nuggets that have been sitting under a heat lamp for hours. There are also security concerns with peddlers on the beach constantly harassing guests to buy parasailing tickets or go snorkeling. These people are not only very persistent and don’t let you rest, they also try to extort unknowing guests for money and in some cases steal belongings when nobody is around. Hotel staff and management lured me into a timeshare presentation with the promises of a “special lunch” as well as “room and service” upgrades. Upon listening to these people try to lock me into a contract for several decades and politely declining, they provided no services that were initially promised by just listening to their presentation. Essentially, I was robbed of several hours of my time. The grills at the buffet are questionably dirty just like everything else in the buffet. The food at the snack by the beach, the only place to eat lunch if you’re not a special circle member, has some of the least appetizing and dry food ever. For the thousands that were paid up-front, it was expected that the management would not block advertised foods and services behind several pay-walls and tier-based memberships. When complaining to management, I couldn’t even get to talk to someone for 3 hours. I wouldn’t ever consider returning here considering that the food, location, services, and overall resort are much better in Cancun for an even cheaper price! Even if you tip the workers, which I had done, the level of service or food doesn’t improve. Terrible experience, ruined vacation and such a waste of time and money!

reviews.author: Vicky D
reviews.title: Wouldn't go back
reviews.text: Rosanna at the buffet told me to write a Google review,  took my phone out of my hand marked all 5 stars and told me to write down her name,  Georgi, Edio and others.  As soon as she walked away I deleted my review. The food was sub par, cheese was warm/melted,  nothing was cold that should have been cold.  The only great server we had was Olvi at Mina, but they served raw chicken.  We didn't get 5 star service until our last day when they wanted us to TIP MORE.  They expect you to tip and don't even appreciate it or say thank you.  The 2 gentlemen at the Otium excursion desk were phenomenal! Truly nice and said hi everytime we walked by.  They were the only people on the resort that were nice!!!! I don't know if it's all DR people that are rude or just this resort.  Our tour guides and drivers for the airport transfers weren't very friendly either.  Bottom line you couldn't pay me to go back to this resort or the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Laura V
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel
reviews.text:
El hotel no tiene buena calidad de nada . La gastronomía de pésima calidad. Muy caro para lo que brindan . El personal no entiende cuando se le realiza una pregunta . Hotel sucio, pésimo sistema  para reservar restaurantes .
No lo aconsejo para nada .

reviews.author: Roger Jung
reviews.title: Never visited it, they charged my card anyway
reviews.text: Worst hotel ever.  I cancelled my reservation over the phone two weeks before and they still charged me $753. I wrote them several emails explaining, evwn ahow them proof in writing and they didnt care.  I WILL NEVER STAYED AT A MELIA property ever again

reviews.author: Dreamer113819
reviews.title: Don’t recommend
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful and right on the ocean. However, there are just to many issues with food and service for this to be a good review. It took us two  hours to check in because they were originally telling us that we didn’t have the upgraded Reserve room booked… even though I had an email with it booked and paid. They eventually figured it out but two hours later. Then they sent me to the Hospitality area so we could get a “concierge” person assigned to us which is part of the upgraded Reserve benefits. The girl in the “hospitality” suite on 1/25 on the afternoon was so rude and unhelpful. She said that we had to wait until a concierge was available. After another half hour, we asked for f they could call us because we were so hungry. Never received call and it is virtually impossible to eat at any establishment here without help of concierge. And buffet is absolutely terrible. This does not seem like a four star hotel.

reviews.author: Niall M
reviews.title: The worst service followed up by a gag clause!
reviews.text:
This hotel uses non disparagement / gag clauses to suppress honest reviews (pictured). 

To be able to write this review, it cost me MeliaRewards points worth 500EUR. The service at this hotel is truly the worst and most incompetent I have experienced at any price range. This was despite having Melia top tier status + staying in their most expensive suite. 

After an awful stay with numerous issues, almost 2 months to get any explanation for any of my experience, and despite a written promise of points from staff - I was offered 100000 points ONLY IF I would sign a release forbidding me from writing about my stay (I declined and lost the points). How can we trust the ratings from this hotel when they not just discourage honest feedback, but put in place legal methods that grant them the ability to suppress it?

Melia more centrally appear to have no escalation process for handling disagreements with their hotels. And so despite years as a Melia Rewards Platinum member, this is the end of my spending with Melia hotels.

I would ask that the hotel do not provide a copy/paste response to my review as they were notified of issues (+ follow up) while I was there to ensure they had every opportunity to respond, but they chose not to. I believe their responses of 'we wish we would have known so we could make it right' to other reviews are completely disingenuous. 

I will just refer to a few of the issues related to this stay:
- Despite having confirmation, booking with Melia and noticing myself the room disappearing from sale shortly after booking, my stay does not appear to have been processed properly prior to my arrival. Something went wrong and the room appeared for sale before I checked in, I was sent to the wrong check-in area and told I would have the wrong type of room. After being quizzed about my booking and providing all documentation I was kept waiting in reception for around an hour for them to get ready the suite which they obviously didn't expect me in and I was lucky wasn't resold! 
- When asked, they provided no explanation while I was there and were unavailable to comment. Subsequently a call with the 'Insight' team acknowledged that they'd confirmed my wait but bizarrely denied the issue, saying they had expected me to be in the right room (no explanation given for why I was being given the wrong room initially or why I was directed to the wrong check-in area). Furthermore I was told guests can expect to wait "an hour or even more" for their rooms even when arriving at 7pm.
- The personal concierge / butler service has been downgraded such that they really only book your meals and send you activities. Other hotels utilise good apps. My concierge didn't contact me until almost 24 hours after arrival and I had no dinner. When the concierge was in contact, he would send activities in the morning after they had begun (once 2 out of 3 activities had started/finished before I got them). This repeated despite me telling the concierge and continued with the next concierge (despite reassurances it wouldn't).
- As well as no concierge for my first day, the person who was assigned went on leave 3 days later and the replacement concierge again waited almost 24 hours to contact me. 
- There is no beach waiter service despite what's advertised. Because of multiple bookings at once, I have unfortunately stayed at this hotel for 4 weeks before + 1 week recently. The waiters choose not to walk the beach. 
- Despite waiting a long time for the room, it was not checked. Cleanliness issues, missing items (e.g. a bottle opener for wine or beer from the minibar), a mostly empty minibar with a half empty bottle of coke. 
- Requesting a bottle opener at least 6 times gave no result. The follow up call suggested bottle openers are not provided in rooms for the beer and wine. 
- On my 4 week stay after they never had in stock the fillet steak (from day 1) I was told they'd just run out. 
- Food & drink choice and quality are very poor.
- They had no change for tips for 5 days! Furthermore they can never advise when change will come, and so 10 walks to reception checking gave no results. 
- I could go on listing issues but it is essentially missing any aspects of good or even competent service. Lovely setting, but I think it would be crazy to spend the prices charged for this hotel when there are better more honest options. Melia should reconsider how they position the Paradisus brand, as they are so far from luxury all inclusive. Do not expect Ikos, Domes, Excellence hotels levels of service. 

In summary, don't do it!

reviews.author: Jay_18_1163
reviews.title: No safety/security
reviews.text:
Stayed for 1 week at the beginning of December. Upon arrival one luggage has been dropped at the wrong resort. When checking in we received the wrong room. Had to wait 30 min for room change and luggage to arrive.
As we came late at night, we ordered room service. Only 2 items available on already small room service menu for a 5* hotel 
We were told it would take 45 min. Called over 1hr later and told 20 min longer. Had to call again as it took 3hrs for cold/dry food to arrive with no cutlery! 

Biggest problem was on our third night as someone entered our room before midnight. Doors have no safety latches! Once asked who it is, they ran off saying something in Spanish. 
At guest services making a report, they told us it might of been housekeeping... right before midnight? And why would they not announce coming in and run away..
We were told to come back as it would take 24-48hrs for a investigation. Next day there was still no answer and manager never showed up. 
There was a camera right outside our door. Then they made up a story of it being an electrical issue and the camera not working. So we ended up not getting anywhere

Most buffet food was always cold and had minimal taste. 
One night we asked 3 servers for a spoon and finally got it over 10min later. Service was always bad

Service at the pool and beach was almost non existent, same as the day/night entertainment. Room was not cleaned everyday. Most of the staff don't speak English. Also not enough towels at this resort 

When leaving, there was only 1 shower for people after check out. Sports bar has a small menu but don't serve food at all.
Could not eat anywhere after 5pm before leaving the resort at 6:30pm

We tried all the restaurants and the food was always good and hot. Best service received was at Flora

Resort itself and beach are very nice 

This is definitely not a 5* hotel, after paying almost $2000, you'd expect better service and safety/security compared to other resorts we've stayed at

reviews.author: personashop
reviews.title: Not worth spending the money they charged
reviews.text: Was sorry to see how bad the hotel became.  Absolutely not worth money spent.  Look for something else.  Do not go there!!!  The food compare to much less expensive hotel is so not worth what this hotel charge. Rooms are sooooo small!!!

reviews.author: LizJJ12
reviews.title: not luxury, nor 5 star resort
reviews.text:
This resort is not a 5 start resort, at best it's 4 stars with bad service and overworked staff.  My friend and I stayed for 3 nights and every staff we encountered was rude and unpleasant.  As simple as asking for water and coffee takes 2-3 times of us asking with an indifferent and unwelcoming response. 
It's nearly impossible to get at reservation for their restaurants; we had to eat at 10pm one of our nights and the meal was subpar with bad service.  The next night at "Blue Agave" it wasn't any better.  We were seated nearly 45 minutes after our reservation time.  And service was poor with just ok food.  The resort is overcrowded and under staffed.  The beach area is crowded with the loungers too close to one another.  
If you want a luxury experince and good service, do NOT book this resort.

reviews.author: Christina S
reviews.title: Beautiful place awful service
reviews.text: As pretty as this hotel is, I would never come back or recommend to others. Let’s start with how surly the reception staff is.  The drinks are watered down and pina colada among worst I ever had. Can’t make dinner reservations at a reasonable hour as they all get booked immediately. App is maddening, when ordered room service they didn’t have half the choices at 7pm and food arrived cold and my son found piece of plastic in his hamburger. At the buffet lunch, my husband asked for sparkling water, they gave him a glass of still and he took a sip and asked again for sparkling. They then gave him a bottle of sparkling, took his glass, but then gave it to a person at another table even though he had drank from it. Buffet choices are just awful and desserts are tasteless. We had a problem with our key card to our room- took eight trips to reception before they finally fixed it. So many better places for the money.

reviews.author: Zubair V
reviews.title: Do not visit!
reviews.text: Terrible experience, horrible food, lack of service and no one seems to care. Spend your money elsewhere. The buffet served undercooked and raw food, including salmon. The buffet closed early half the time and the food options, quality and taste were terrible. No service on the beach, no service at the pools. The quality of this resort is terrible and do not waste your time or money!

reviews.author: BackPacker394120
reviews.title: Dont come !!!!Couples only in adult section no privacy
reviews.text: It is a couples vacation spot mom and adult  son .we  booked a junior suite with a bedroom and separate sitting room with sun wing We got a room with a flimsy curtain for privacy  so you change in the toilet or have to leave room.hoel management did nothing  sunwing did nothing we paid over $3000 each.

reviews.author: Sherpa16076
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text:
Avoid this place!!! Food, Beach,  room - zero quality.  After renovation,  even worse.
It was our 8 times to this hotel. Never again! No service,  no delicious food, not even enough fruits. A lot of people in the buffet,  dirty. Room too small. Swimup room like 20 meters to the pool.

reviews.author: Departure56055529360
reviews.title: The Third Time Uncharmed
reviews.text:
This is our third time staying at this resort, seventh time at a Melia property in Punta Cana. 

No matter what you do, dear stranger, do NOT sign up for the timeshare at Circle or the Reserve. Though you may feel like a second class citizen during your stay because of your lack of access to many better (?) restaurants and amenities, you will feel worse when the same thing happens to you when you’re a fully paid up member 8 years later.

Us, to Slick Sales Person: but we used to be able to eat in all the restaurants with our membership.
Sales: only at your “Home Resort”
Us: Untrue. We’ve stayed here twice before and had full access
Sales: Under your contract, we don’t have to do that. Only at your Home Resort
Us: Our Home Resort has been closed for renovations for two years and will not be open for at least another two years
Sales: Yes. But if you give us $25k more you will have full access at all the resorts 
Us: (Much internal cursing.)

So if you come here, do yourself a favor and do NOT talk to the timeshare people “for 30 minutes” (read: 3-4 hours). Just enjoy the space. Your booking on TripAdvisor or Expedia cost the same as what members pay.  You’ll experience the following:

The food quality has taken a sharp downward turn in the five years since our last visit.  Options for breakfast and lunch are limited. The buffets are large and somewhat bland. The fresh fruit, vegetables and cooked-before-you stations are your best options. Dinners at the named restaurants are hit or miss. Avoid anything cooked from unrefrigerated containers of raw meat sitting out for some time. (I’m looking at you, hibachi restaurant.) (Also avoid the sushi.)

The newly built suites near the beach are large and bright. The pools are clean and well cared for and the grounds are beautiful. If you can get past the so-awful-they’re-comedic 24-hour muzak versions of popular songs played at the pools, you will enjoy relaxing outside. I recommend sleeping with a pillow over your head to block out the 11pm-7am muzak. 

BUT: The beach is gorgeous. Dominican people are warm and kind.  The employees of the resort are helpful, friendly, and thoughtful, notwithstanding a bit of hotel disorganization. 

Visit for the relaxation. Do not stay for the presentation.

reviews.author: Marilyn O
reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text:
At the resort now and Absolutely terrible!!! Save your money and go to another resort. We had reserved a king bed ocean front room but was given a double Queen instead. To sort out the mixup, we were given the run around the whole first day. We were told to come back to the front desk at 6 and then the person who was helping us (Carlos) had forgot he told us to meet him and had to wait another 2 hours to get our room. We eventually got the room that we had booked at 8pm (after arriving at the hotel at 1pm). This was highly inconvenient given that we were traveling with our 4YO and 2YO. 

The manager mentioned repeatedly when we requested we get the room that we had booked that we should “read the fine print”. When we got the room that we requested it was actually nice. 

The food is absolutely the worst and disgusting. The only good meal we have had so far is the Italian restaurant. We ate at blue agave today and there are 0 vegetarian options although we repeatedly mentioned that we are vegetarian. The buffet and room service is barely edible. 

Not to mention that it is almost impossible to get a reservation. Our butler Luise (who was extremely nice) tried his best but it was a gamble everyday not knowing if we would have a reservation or it would be having fruit at the buffet. 

The only thing that we did like was the ginger bar which serves coffee, tea and cocktails. 

Other than the butler, the service in general was lacking. 

The whole thing is highly unfortunate since the hotel and room are nice but the food and service don’t make it worth it.

reviews.author: Avi G
reviews.title: Primeras vacaciones que nos queríamos ir antes de tiempo…
reviews.text:
¡Una decepción total! Pasé 6 días en el Paradisus Palma Real con mi pareja, todo fue un desastre desde la llegada. En el proceso de check-in se equivocaron con nuestra habitación, después de eso tardaron 2 horas en darnos la correcta, y aún asi no tenian los detalles pedidos en la reservación para nuestra ocasión especial. 

Estos errores suelen ocurrir en los hoteles, pero lo que nos sorprendió fue que al personal del hotel parecía no importarle ni sorprenderle la situación. 

A cada pregunta que teniamos sobre el hotel nos respondían que el mayordomo se encargaría de informarnos. Que sorpresa, el mayordomo no servia para nada, no respondía a los mensajes en tiempo razonable, ni nos solucionaba los problemas. Además, en dos ocasiones mencionó haber reservado nuestra cena, solo para llegar al restaurante y enterarnos que no fue así.

El hotel tiene un gran problema con el servicio y la comunicación entre sus departamentos, el secador de pelo de nuestra habitación no funcionaba, insistimos tres días seguidos en que nos lo cambiasen, al final desistimos, lo mismo sucedió con las batas de baño, se las llevaron y nunca las repusieron. 

El personal no hace bien su trabajo, nadie te sirve en la piscina o playa, y siempre llevan mala cara. En cuanto a la comida y bebida, un decepción constante, de verdad la calidad no está a la altura de un hotel de 5 estrellas. Después de todos estos sucesos decidimos hablar con el gerente, no sirvió para nada, el ejemplo de la desorganización. En resumen, nunca le recomendaría a nadie una estadía en este hotel.

PS. No se dejen engañar por las buenas reseñas. Los empleados que te sirven aceptablemente te hostigan a dejar buenas reseñas a traves de un QR que te lleva a crear una reseña del hotel. Insisten en que menciones su nombre, pero la reseña es para el hotel. En fin, quieren mantener la imagen de que el hotel es una experiencia de 5 estrellas, mientras no hacen los ajustes requeridos para mejorar significativamente. Muy lamentable.

reviews.author: Hetal G
reviews.title: Warning: you will not get what you sign up for
reviews.text:
We booked a Nikte master swim out suite 5 months before our stay. We stayed for 6 nights. We were traveling with other families. I attempted many times to contact the hotel beforehand with room requests with very delayed response times, if I even got a response. That should have been my warning about how this trip would go. 

Check in/management: When we arrived, we were told on check-in that the hotel was overbooked, and that we would be downgraded to a junior swim out. No warning prior to check in was given, even though I had been trying to contact somebody about our room before hand. As a “courtesy” they would only charge us for our new room rate and give us access to the adults only area. We asked for some other compensation, since we were traveling with little kids and would be unable to go to the adult only side. They were unable to offer anything else. We were basically told we had no choice but to take this. There is no way the hotel was full, the place was half empty when we checked in and got considerably busier for 2 days on the weekend. Not sure why we were targeted to be downgraded. Attempted to speak to a manager, but kept getting blown off. We were eventually told that they would be able to move us to our original room type the following day. we packed up and were ready to do that but then we were told that it would be yet another day. On that subsequent day suddenly, the front desk had no record of any of this. Essentially wasted hours of vacation time due to their incompetence. At that point, decided it was not worth dealing with them anymore and that we would just keep the room. The real slap in the face came on checkout when they charged us an extra 200 for the “all inclusive” fees. None of our friends that we traveled with were charged this.

Concierge: Our concierge started out good. With a group of 16 and little kids, we asked her on day, one to set a reservation for us every night. She did this great the first several days and even relayed dietary restrictions. We had her contact through WhatsApp, and she kept telling us that if we had any issues to go through her. However, when we did actually have issues, she was either not responsive or not helpful. We called several times to have the air-conditioning fixed in our room and informed her of the issue as well. This never got addressed in our 6 nights stay. The concierge service then got bad when it became clear to her that we had no interest in sitting in on the presentation she was pushing so hard. Stopped setting up dinner reservations, stopped checking in on us. Did not respond to multiple texts. Ultimately called her when we had an urgent need, and she was clearly annoyed. in initially in our stay, she would stop by at dinner to say hello, and check in on things. On our last night, she was 5 feet away from us and didn’t even acknowledge us.

Food: the dinner restaurants were decent. You have to have reservations, even though the restaurants look empty. The buffet, which was the main option for breakfast, and lunch, was definitely lacking. Several times we were served food that had clearly spoiled. it got to the point that we just stuck with toast on our last morning and were desperately looking forward to airport food.

Beach: the beach was lovely, very clean, swimmable. Lots of chairs with umbrellas. Appreciated not having to fight for a spot. One of the few good things about this trip. 

Entertainment: there was some sort of live entertainment in the evenings where the restaurants are located, which was really nice. Music and dancing. The other solid thing on this trip. 

Service: overall, very disappointing. Room mini bar was never restocked. Called many times to ask for restocking and still nothing. I went to the spa on a sister property and left the kids with my husband. I had an immediate shuttle to the sister property and a short ride over. On my way back, I talked yo at least a dozen different people to try to find a way back to my main hotel. Everyone kept deferring me somewhere else. Telling me it’ll take 30 minutes for a golf cart. Ended up taking 1 hour and 45 minutes to finally get someone to take me back. Very few of the workers with face contact with guests speak English. I speak some Spanish, which is probably the only reason it didn’t take me even longer to get back since It was challenging to communicate my frustration. 

Overall, the property is nice, well kept. Beach is wonderful. Has so much potential.  However, the awful management and subpar service makes it a resort that I would highly recommend avoiding.

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.title: The Food in Disgusting
reviews.text: If you want to lose weight go to the Paradisus Palma Real.  Seriously!  My partner was able to shed a couple of pounds during our stay.  The food is inedible!   It's a real shame because the room, pool access and beach are fantastic.  I spent extra money and booked a swim-up suite.  This was supposed to be a premium experience.  I was asked to fill out a preference form in advance or our stay.  I mentioned that we were celebrating an anniversary and that I was interested in an option for a romantic dinner on the beach.  My preferences were completely ignored.  Was never mentioned.  I won't be going again.

reviews.author: felipeherrmann2023
reviews.title: Place is mediocre at best.
reviews.text:
Came here for two nights with my sister and kids before heading to Casa de Campo. Let’s just say I should have skipped this hotel.

The rooms are nice. The major issue is the food, especially the buffet, which is nasty. Also the restaurant reservation process to book an outside restaurant (non buffet) is a scam. Always full, although we followed the front desk instructions and arrived early, and I heard many other people complaining about the same. I had to speak with the manager to get a table. I am sure it is a scam so you eat the mediocre buffet food and the hotel saves money.

Stay away from the place. Truly nasty and VERY VERY far from “luxury”

reviews.author: Nader F
reviews.title: Very bad Service for the high price I paid
reviews.text:
Bad staff service, they have no experience, team not well trained and perform poorly.
It’s not worth the high price I paid.
Infrastructure is very nice, but service sucks.

There’s no beach service, and there was 1 waiter only for the whole principal pool area. I had to change the concierge service because the first one wasn’t fulfilling my needs

reviews.author: Shuhrat O
reviews.title: Worth place for family
reviews.text: This hotel is good for mostly adults only less kids swimimg  pools most of the pools are designed for Club members amd adults only thats why i gave 1 star cause on google it showes they have a water park but actually they dont it is in other hotel  Melia Caribe  restaurants all over discustimg inside drinks fly

reviews.author: luv2cater
reviews.title: Mom’s 80th
reviews.text: It started off with the check in process and getting our keys (wristbands).  None of them worked once we arrived to the room.  The concierge had to let us in.  We went back to the front desk more than we can count to get the key situation corrected.  We still ended up with one key not working when we checked out on the 4th day.  There are a few team members that are worth mentioning, Maximo(The Winery), Antonio (Ginger Signature Bar), Carlos(Front Desk), Marc Ceasar(Restaurant reservations) and Mr. Susa.  These people made us feel welcomed and appreciated.  The rooms did not meet my expectations.  They were not thoroughly cleaned, the hot tub was inoperable, no washcloths in any of the four rooms we occupied, the hot water did not work in two of the rooms on the last day.  The food was only lukewarm at the Buffet.  We called for a cart to pickup my elderly Mom and cousin and the driver shows up with one seat.  WTH!!  The resort is beautiful on the outside but they have a lot of work to do behind the scenes.  We won’t be back!!

reviews.author: jpeurrung
reviews.title: Worst All Inclusive I have ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
This place is an absolute dump. You will get harrased at the pool or beach from the drug dealers, excursion people, or the people trying to sell you other items. The food is terrible, the air in the bedrooms do not work very good. Do not even get me started on the attitude of the staff here. 

do yourself a favor and go someone else.

reviews.author: Holly W
reviews.title: It seems a lot nicer than it actually is
reviews.text:
The resort is nice but the help is very slow and honestly often times do not fully understand what you are asking them. Our motto for the trip after the second day was you get what you get and you do not get upset. Anyone with health or diet restrictions - they do not understand how to make substitutions. 

Sunblock at the gift shop was $58. I expect to pay a premium at a resort gift shop but everything was double if not tripple. 

We were here with a large group for a conference and they could not handle the volume. We got in and had to wait 1.5 hours in line for check in and then another 45 mins for dinner reservations. When we got through the dinner reservation line the only ones left were at 9:30 and some of the restaurants were sold out. 

Pool never had towels for all the guests.

Gym was decent for a hotel gym- although small. Nice tennis courts with racquets and balls available.

reviews.author: Alejandro M
reviews.title: Muy mal atendido, pésima comida en en general. El servicio y la atención son increíblemente deplorables
reviews.text:
Deplorable, increiblemente mal atendido, comida pesima, problemas por todos lados.
Soy socio de Club hace 5 años, y en este momento ofrezco mi membresía a la venta en USD $100 ya que es la última vez que vengo a estos hoteles.

reviews.author: ezequiel g
reviews.title: El peor hotel de la cadena melia.  No vengan. No compren planes. Son una estafa
reviews.text: Es una cárcel demasiado estrictos. Nunca quieren solucionar las cosas. Siempre ponen trabas en el camino nos dejaron sin comer a 5 niños de menos de 5 años xq llegamos 5 minutos tarde, la mesa estaba vacía y quedó vacía toda la noche.   Otra más.  No tienen ni ventilador ni aire acondicionado en el buffet. Parece que si no sos vip no tenes voto y tratan de complicarte y que pases una muy mala estadía.

reviews.author: Luisa
reviews.title: Bad costumer service
reviews.text:
The hotel is okay, but some employees are just ridiculous rude and unprofessional. 

The lady that was our concierge she really change her attitude after we told her that we don’t want to take the membership meeting. 

Also around the main pool a lady called Rina was the worst person that you can ever had. 

We was expecting at least some balloons for our special dates, they don’t do nothing, we will never return back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: NO VALE LA PENA.
reviews.text:
No es lo que parece, o por lo menos no con todo el mundo. 

Le informamos al hotel de que era nuestra semana de cumpleaños y aniversario y no hicieron absolutamente NADA. 

Quizás por no somos dominicanos o americanos, nada en la habitación nada absolutamente nada. 

La concierge que nos toco, inmediatamente le dijimos que no queríamos hacer la charla de membresía cambió su actitud, no es justo porque es un servicio caro y ella no ayudó en casi nada. 

La playa estaba sucia, apestaba el mal olor. 

El aire acondicionado no funcionaba. 

Las muchachas del spa hacían demasiadas preguntas personales, y a veces se pasaban de la línea de respeto en los masajes. 

Visitamos el casino y el servicio de todos fue PÉSIMO, el señor calvo quiere que juegues a la mala, las muchachas del black jack eran poco profesionales. 

Vimos a una empleada llamada Rina gritarle a un huésped. 

Yo a este hotel no volvería porque no hicieron nada especial en nuestra semana especial, los empleados son mal educados, y en conclusión no recomiendo este hotel.

reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: Worst all inclusive resort you can go
reviews.text:
I believe that the experience of a hotel or resort is 50% structure and 50% services. You have shamefully failed in the services part, starting with the check in.

We arrived 2 hours before check in and yet, they delayed delivering the rooms by 2 and a half hours. They didn't put us in the rooms we had asked for at the time of booking, which I did through Melia's call center.

After having wasted my first day, solving the problems created by you (around 7 pm), I went to try to “enjoy” my vacation with my family, expecting a service worthy of what was promised. WRONG AGAIN! Service in the restaurants is terrible, staff totally unprepared. Upon our arrival, we went to Sante for lunch, a place where you order a drink and need to repeat the order several times, until the waiter gets tired and at great cost delivers the item, with a delay of 15 minutes or more.

I had the feeling that they were stealing my time, because I had less and less time to enjoy the pools, beach and other activities. This was repeated on EVERY DAY, in ALL RESTAURANTS.

There was a restaurant where we ordered pork ribs with potatoes. It was delivered without the potatoes and when my wife questioned the attendant she said: "it's in the kitchen", and went back to order the potatoes. WHAT A FUCK? We were totally stunned, we didn't even answer her.

A glaring unpreparedness, it gets to be ridiculous! We were previously staying at the Sanctuary Cap Cana, the resort of your competitor, Marriot Bonvoy. There you have a service worthy of a 5 star hotel. Total disappointment to have left there and stayed at Paradisus.

Another item that is bizarre is that we pay to stay in “The Reserve”, an exclusive space with other amenities and differentiated service. Not having a restaurant in the pool and beach area for quick snacks is a disgrace. First time I WAS HUNGRY AT AN ALL INCLUSIVE RESORT! Every time we were hungry, we would have to change our clothes, because all restaurants have a dress code and we couldn't go in with bathing suits. This made us plan to eat only for breakfast, lunch and dinner so that we could enjoy the beach and pool. I have no words to describe such disappointment.

In my room, a fridge that didn't freeze anything. Maintenance staff was called and they told me that it didn't get colder than that, and this is confirmed for the other rooms where my uncles and cousin stayed. I've stayed in a 2 star hotel with an infinitely better minibar.

THERE ARE MANY, MANY THINGS STILL OUTSIDE THIS REVIEW, BUT I AM GETTING TIRED OF DETAILING EVERYTHING AND I JUST WANTED TO LEAVE IT FOR THE RECORD, BECAUSE I BELIEVE YOU GUYS ARE NOT GOING TO DO ABSOLUTELY NOTHING WITH IT, IT WILL BE LIKE SPEAKING WORDS TO THE WIND.

I only have 2 compliments, and those go solely to the service of our concierge Zenovia, who from the moment she took care of our family she did everything in her power to make us comfortable.

And another goes to Pedro, from the beach bar. Extremely friendly and proactive person, doing everything to ensure that we were being well served in relation to drinks.

2 examples of extremely capable people in the sea of ​​incompetent people who work at this resort!

Finally, I will never return to this resort, as well as my family, who have the same feeling of disappointment in the delivery of services. You managed to tarnish the name of the Melia Chain for us and whenever possible, I will no longer risk staying at any hotel/resort connected to the chain.

Congratulations on the mismanagement!

reviews.author: Jaime B
reviews.title: Hotel dedicado a un congreso (al que no estábamos invitados)
reviews.text:
Una lástima que mi buena opinión de Meliá y de Paradisus se haya visto tan enturbiada estos días... Más allá de no ver el lujo prometido por ningún lado, a ratos nos sentimos tratados como ganado. Honra a Meliá que han tratado de compensar esta mala situación, pero lo cierto es que la ilusión reconvertida en decepción con la que afrontábamos estos días, ya no nos la devuelve nadie. 
Por favor, si celebran congresos en el hotel, 1- refuercen plantillas y el resto de recursos, y 2- avisen al resto de clientes que se plantean reservar con Vds. Eso, o cierren el hotel para el congreso. Si no, consiguen clientes insatisfechos con demasiada facilidad y cambiar esta percepción va a ser muy muy difícil (lo que es triste tras muchos años siendo clientes suyos).

reviews.author: andrima04
reviews.title: Hotel 2 estrellas
reviews.text: El personal si eres local te tratan como si estuvieras pidiendo, la comida es la misma de desayuno, almuerzo y cena TODOS LOS DIAS. Los platos que preparan en los restaurantes con especialidades es de muy mal sabor, mala calidad. Había estado aquí hace unos años y todo fue excelente, la calidad y el servicio se merecen como mucho dos estrellas. Lo único positivo que tiene el hotel es la playa muy bonita y las habitaciones, después MAS NADA VALE LA PENA.

reviews.author: ErickManyari
reviews.title: Mucho por mejorar
reviews.text: Playa muy linda, baja calidad y poco surtido en la comida, personal con falta de capacitación, no fueron amables ni solucionaron las quejas que mi esposa dio! Una lastima porque nuestras expectativas eran altas debido a que nos hemos quedado antes en otros Meliá.

reviews.author: David K
reviews.title: False Advertising and Major Disappointment.
reviews.text: The resort is a waste of money. Spending $350-$400/nt is not good enough for them. They cater to members and treat regular guests poorly. They mention several restaurants in there advertisements but only have a few open at a time, it appears  they are failing as a resort. Menu descriptions are false. The specialized restaurants are ridiculous/ low quality. The Blue Agave served very old pork I had to spit out. The majority of the menu at Mina steakhouse is substandard.  The Malva restaurant is the same food as the Lunchbox, these are there general restaurants. One will close and the other might open. Food is very bland, simple things like cooked beans/refried beans no restaurant had. Tokimeku was a ghost town and sketchy. There were several incidents with stares, attitude and rudeness from several employees including the  female  manager. Lying is normal. Service is terrible for towels, room service, drinks, etc. Some in our group were reoeatedly flirted/sexual innuendo  everywhere they went and couldn’t  relax. They were very annoyed. Several employees pushed for internet reviews, wanting you to scan QR codes after they get you food or drink. They tell you to mention there name. There is no thought for respecting or assisting guests when you have problems with room or dining, look angry.

reviews.author: Gary L
reviews.title: Resort promises a lot but does not deliver
reviews.text:
This resort promises a lot but does not deliver on the promises advertised.   The hotel caters to conventions and prefers to service the conventions and disregards the other guests.  In a 11-day period, there were 4 conventions and a large wedding.  Night life was provided for the convention members but was very poor for other guests.  In the large plaza, there were DJs and sometimes people playing music.  The seating to watch the entertainers was limited and few people stayed to watch the show since it was not a high quality show.   We were told by staff that during the renovations management decided to eliminate the entertainment theatre and most of the entertainment that guests like at other resorts. 

I found out very quickly that this hotel is no longer what it used to be based upon staff and returning guests feedback about how well the hotel was run before the renovations.  Multiple staff stated that there was a change in management because they kept saying that they liked the old managers better than the new.  The staff believed that the management’s decisions were not good for bringing back tourists to the hotel.

The resort had few guests, down to 12% occupancy when we were there.  The hotel would post the activities for the day for the reserve section and two hours later, no one would be there to provide the activity – for example Aqua fitness.  The staff in the bar closest to the activity did not know if it would happen that day, the activity people did not post a sign or tell anyone that there were no classes today. The reason would be is that there are not enough people in the reserve section yet in the morning they posted the activity for the day knowing the number of people in the resort. 

Not all the restaurants were open because there were not enough people in the resort. One restaurant we were told was only open if the hotel had 70% occupancy.  It opened only for the wedding guests when we were there.    The food was okay but nothing special.  Dining was rushed, we were finished our 3-course meal on two of the nights in 40 minutes even though one night, we were the only ones in the restaurant.  

We stayed in the Reserve section with a swim out room.  This is not a traditional swim up room, we walked 50 feet to the swimming pool and could walk down the steps into the pool.  There were lounger chairs by the pool but no sign to say that these were exclusive to our room.  As a result, other guests did not understand these were exclusive to our room.  

We were at the resort for 11 days and I never saw the pool vacuumed, there was always sand in the pool particularly on the steps. 

Room – unless you complained, the staff would not clean the room on a timely basis.  On one day, we called our concierge to ask about cleaning and the staff then came at 4 pm to clean the room after he followed up.  Another day, they promised to clean it in the morning, when we complained, the concierge said the room was marked as cleaned at 2 pm when in fact they had not come to the room.  There is a mini bar and snacks in the room, these were not replenished unless you complained.  There is supposed to be nightly turn down service, we had that 3 times in our 10-night visit.

Reviews – do not believe everything you read.  The hotel must pressure their staff to get guests to write good TripAdvisor reviews.  In the last two days we were in the resort, several staff kept coming up with a QSR code and asked that we complete a favourable review for the hotel right there and then. 

The staff at the Sante restaurant were excellent. We ate there for breakfast and lunch most days.  Our visit would have been a disaster if our concierge Nicolas Maracallo did not follow up with the continuous problems we encountered.  These two areas were the bright spots of our stay.

The premium price for the room did not match the expectations of the services to be provided.  While I have vacationed at numerous resorts, this was my first time at a Paradisus Hotel and after this visit, I will never go to another Paradisus or Melia Hotel in the future.

reviews.author: Jose F
reviews.title: do not buy Melia membership
reviews.text: We booked there and when we arrived it was under renovation!  What a disappointment in service, they sent us to a hotel next door that was old and smelly.  the service is mediocre and the worst majales in the world in the spa but the disappointing ones were the vendude membership Anneurys Sánchez and Juan Espinola.  don't buy that Melia membership!!!  is a gotcha !

reviews.author: LJ A
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text:
Where to begin.... 
Check in-- the checkin took over 3 hours and was extremely chaotic. We  finally got to our room which was a lovely ocean view. 
Room--Later in the evening  we started to hear some type of scurrying within the ceiling and walls of the unit. When we shut off the lights to go to bed the noises turned into screeching sounds. We called the front desk and maintenance arrived and was unable to do anything for us as the animal type, noises were coming from inside the walls. The following day the hotel was unable to move us due to being completely oversold. So we had another night with loud screeching noises. Ultimately we moved to another room but was offered no apology.
Food: very inconsistent and bland
Service: making reservations was a long and tedious process.
Overall-- for the all inclusive price, it was not worth the experience my husband and I encountered.

reviews.author: Adventurer704555
reviews.title: Awful experience
reviews.text: me and my boyfriend had an awful experience, we even left a day early and had to pay to change our flight because we were starving. The first day we got there around 2 pm and no one told us we had to book dinner reservations by 4 so by the time we were done checking in it was 4:06 and they told us “sorry can’t book reservations after 4 pm” we wish someone would’ve told us that when we got there because we hadn’t eaten all day due to traveling and we had to wait until 6:30 until the buffet opened and the food was awful. The second day being there I got a fraudulent charge on my credit card after leaving it in our room during dinner the night before and had to call and close my card. when we got back to our room that day we saw that the sodas in our fridge were half empty and sticky.. me and my boyfriend don’t drink soda. The third day our hot water in our shower wasn’t working… the list goes on. Every restaurant  we went to we were not happy with the food, and we felt that everything we wanted we couldn’t have because we weren’t circle members. We even asked the desk how to become circle members and they didn’t have any answers for us. All in all we are very upset with our experience and I’m looking for some type of compensation on all of the money wasted. Long story short DO NOT stay at this resort unless you want to pay $17000 a year to be a circle member.

reviews.author: LJ A
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: If you like bats in your room, poor service, horrible coffee, bland food, and uncomfortable beds, this is the place to go. We had to wait 2 days to switch to a room that didn't have bats. Of course the room was of lower quality. At the very least we were expecting an apology and never received one.

reviews.author: Keeper109
reviews.title: Food Options Are Beastly
reviews.text: Room is spacious and OK. Clean. All Inclusive is a deep disappointment, Staff were lovely. I wanted very much to give a 5 star, I just cant. It is what it is. It could be so much better with some management. It is a lovely area. But there is no effort from management, only the commitment of line staff trying to eke out a living. God bless their souls.

reviews.author: Juliana B
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo para nada. Un timo!
reviews.text:
Muy muy mal! Buffet malísimo falta comida, bebida ni achocolatado para desayunar. El
Hotel es muy caro y es un Melia pues hay pensiones con mas niveles. Tu pides una piña y te dicen que se acabó y eso a las 8:30 de la mañana, les pide un kiwi y te dicen que no vino, una tomadura de pelos.

reviews.author: jose s
reviews.title: No me cumplieron con lo pactado y y abonado en club MELIA.
reviews.text:
Me vendieron dos membresías del club y no me cumplieron en absoluto   Cada viaje me quitan beneficios pactados y abonados.  No hay con quien hablar. 
Ya no se puede ingresar a los principales restaurantes y otras cartas tiene cargo en el consumo.  Vendieron por cifras de centenar de dólares cobran una cuota anual y luego te quitan lo comprado sin ninguna explicación.  Y cuando raclamas en el hotel te dicen q lo hagas por la web.  Una decepción

reviews.author: Nichol H
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.text:
I booked a 4-5 star luxury vacation package through Sun Country Airlines and this resort is NOT luxury. The resort apparently changed ownership since we booked and we either didn't receive the property level we booked or this property has been allowed to become so run down & poorly managed while they upgraded other properties that it is no longer luxury. 

ROOM: Room was run down, dirty, smelled moldy and the air conditioning leaked & dripped on us. There were missing bulbs,  broken light fixtures, rusty fixtures, dirty floors, & bugs. The toilet stopped working twice. We didn't take our shoes off in our room. Everything felt wet - bedding, towels. The room was freezing & we could not change the temp. The outside hot tub had a trickle of water and took 45 minutes to fill. There were no cushions on the lounge chairs for days (chairs were unusable w/o cushions). The pull-out couch didn't fit a 12 year old kid on it, it was so small. The outside canopy smelled of mold and body odor. Hair dryer barely worked. No king size bed - they pushed 2 double beds together which put the bed at an awkward spot - the double bed headboard was sticking out right where your pillow/head would be for the king set up. You couldn't comfortable sit up on that part of the bed. There are no outlets/chargers close to the bed.
A couple good things: The room was huge. The swim up master suite outdoor space was partially private & very relaxing. Beds were comfortable. After the live music/karaoke ended, it was pretty quiet.

STAFF: virtually no staff were helpful - it took multiple calls to get the maids to clean our room or for staff to fix issues. Had to call multiple times to get a couch made into bed - we all slept in the double beds the first night - uncomfortable first night. We had to call SIX times to get cushions for the outside lounge chairs over 3 dsys: I was told I didn't have a high enough package for cushions - but the chairs weren't usable w/o cushions & every room exactly like ours had the same chairs & cushions - it made no sense. Staff pretended not to speak English so they didn't have to help us (they were speaking English behind us). Staff refused to drive us within the resort on the resort golf carts to resort locations like the adventure park and back to our property from other properties - I had to enlist bell hops & other guests to tell cart drivers that we were part of the resort even though we had our resort bracelets on. Wait staff barely came to our swim up room - maybe 1-2 times per day in a 5 hour period. (this waiter was the nicest & most helpful person on staff & made some effort). Restaurant staff were utterly incapable of understanding when we ordered off their menu and it felt like we were bothering them. Apparently there is room service but we never saw a menu & were told it wasn't available when we asked about it. When I called the front desk the phone rang & nobody picked up. At a certain point, we just expected poor service during every staff interaction. At first I thought it was because I wasn't able to tip because I didn't have any small bills (first night) but then I got some change & it made no difference. Also, it was very hard to get change for tips.

RESORT ISSUES: When we first arrived, we got driven between multiple properties within our resort, with a lot of Spanish being spoken, like they didn't know where to put us - the first indication something was up. When we finally got to our supposed property, the concierge did not explain anything upon check in: he tried to upsell us to a nicer room (I literally booked the nicest room on property so again I'm thinking they bait & switched us) & then told us some restaurants need reservations but you have to take a golf cart over to the sister property to make them. There was no explanation of daily activities, no restaurant menus available (had to go between the 2 properties to see any menus). We never found half the restaurants (and again, staff was  unhelpful). Power went out multiple times during our stay, including during check in. Wifi shut off several times a day. Food was poor to marginal, and the upgraded/reservation-only restaurants, (which I know I paid for the upgraded package) cost extra, which was never explained until i was looking at a menu & saw the upcharges, (again bait & switch)...and the food was terrible at those restaurants too with tiny portions. The only restaurant worth eating at was Ruby Rocks Sports Bar. The Pool was in disrepair (tiles missing/sharp scraps on the floor of the pool & freezing). It's way too far from the beach (10-15 min walk or 8 min resort ride, if you can convince them to take you) and the beach is full of locals hawking junk & pressuring you to buy excursions. When I finally got my hands on an activity schedule, it was really disappointing - some crafts for the kids & music in the evenings, beach volleyball - nothing worth the price.
One good thing: the outdoor space is well manicured. 

This is maybe a 2-3 star resort at best but it came with 5 star prices. It was not at all busy - you could tell the place wasn't close to full. There appeared to be plenty of staff. I've traveled to other countries and know there is a different level of service in different places but this was so far below expectations, I reached out to Sun Country Airlines. Even at half the price we paid, it would have been overpriced.

reviews.author: Guillaume S
reviews.title: Nice hotel but terrible service
reviews.text:
We stayed 11 nights in a pool room with the nikte service. The room and the hotel are very nice, beautiful beach but the service was the worst i have ever experienced.
We had the airport transfer included but when we contacted the reception they ssked for 50 dollars. After many emails, we managed to get it.
Despite our online checking, the room was not ready on arrival at 10pm, and we had to wait another hour to get a bed for our son.
We wer supposed to get a concierge as part of the nikte service, but everyone told us that this does not exist. We managed to get it after 1 week when we shouted at the reception.
I asked for a meeting with a manger to talk about our issues, they organised a meeting but when I arrived, they told me he was busy for the next couple of hours.
These are just a few examples of what happened. And it is not a langage issue as we speak both Spanish and English.
I will never go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: LaMonica J
reviews.title: Just Say No!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?!?!
1: They checked us into a family swim-up. I paid for the Reserve area (adults only) swim-up. By the way,  after complaining moved me to my room 3 hours later to a poolside room. 
2. The room I was moved to had no soap. Did I say no soap? 
3. One of the amenities was supposed to be a daily bar service. I'm still waiting on that to happen. 
4. Another amenity that was SUPPOSE to come with the “Reserve Area” is having a reservation and priority dining. Needless to say, that never happened. And was also told we could not eat at the Itailian resturant after waiting for an hour after our reservation was to begin. 
5. LAWD, can a person just get some towels in this place to wash their body with? Asked several times for face towels and they would only bring one for a room with three people. 
6. I’m a little tired but I got to do it. Our Concierge was sweet but, his follow thru sucked.  He complained about the service as much as I did and did nothing about it. 
7. Food, NOPE! I'm hungry!
8. Spoke with several people at the resort and they are having the same experience. 
9. Overall, beautiful resort very poor customer service. 😔

reviews.author: Mauricio Z
reviews.title: not as promised
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real resort and was disappointed with the experience I had. While the serving staff was exceptional, the management's lack of attention to detail and corporate rebranding style put a damper on my trip.

When we arrived at the resort, we were informed that we would be staying in a different suite than the one we had reserved.
