Not only was this suite smaller and less luxurious than the one we had booked, but it was also not located by the beach as advertised. This was a major letdown, as we had specifically chosen this resort for its beachfront location.  We found as we were there that we were not alone, our reservation was to stay at the Reserve at Palma Real (which has now become their luxury suites), instead they put us in The Garden Suites, a small, dirty mosquito infested room.  We brought it it to the front desk, concierge and anyone that we could complain about but nothing was done.  We didn't choose this resort for the value, we had options and we decided on this one because of the pictures and the proximity to the beach.

Despite this setback, the serving staff at the resort were outstanding. They were friendly, welcoming, and went out of their way to ensure that we had a positive experience. Their service was a bright spot in an otherwise disappointing stay.

In addition to the room mix-up, we also experienced issues with the resort's rules.  There were pools in the resort that we couldn't use, sides of the beach that we couldn't stay for no reason whatsoever.

reviews.author: Nikita H
reviews.title: Don’t stay here. Horrible service!!
reviews.text: This is the worse vacation ever.  You should book with another resort. This place is HORRIBLE!  4 hour check in after a long flight. Tried to downgrade my room, but charge me the same price as if I wouldn’t realize that I was in the family section when I clearly booked the adults only reserve swim up with a king bed.  So many people I spoke with were having the same issues I have. Mini bar with snacks not replenished daily.  Liquor was NOT provided in the mini bar as stated when booked.  Customer service is awful.   Reservations to restaurants is a joke. The staff does not care. They lie and try to cover their butts when you call them out in their horrible business practices.  Very poor entertainment. Spend your money with a resort who will appreciate you as a guest because this place will not. They act as if you’ve done something wrong when clearly the mistakes and bad service is on them.   Supervisor takes zero accountability for the numerous mishaps.  Not apologetic nor do they try to figure out what’s needed to improve your stay.

reviews.author: GPFarms
reviews.title: Terrible - Worst Check-in ever / Room paid for / confirmed/ not available - 3 hour wait / 24 hours later - Not resolved.
reviews.text:
Saturday, Feb 18, 2023 - 3.20 pm arrival - Lots of people, no action

You arrive - They take your name - nothing happens

No welcome drink offered 

Carlioledi  - Appeared helpful - nothing Happened / more just waiting  / they just disappear

Room not ready - 4.50 pm / need 10 minutes

We remote check in back on Feb 16 - What a joke!  Booked this reservation 9 months ago, but that has no weight at all / not taken into consideration.

New Manager comes out - explains they have booking issue…..Emelin Mercado (very nice person)

I had confirmed everything on Feb16 via remote checkin / confirmation on room, dates, price - total BS process…..

Room now is not available, trying to move us to Adult, but not 2 room master that we booked - the rooms that are available would not be next to each other and we have a 15 year old which is unacceptable.

We agree to 2 rooms / one night with a guaranteed for the two bedroom master suite for the remaining six nights. We go over to 2208, with her and there’s somebody in that room. Now back to lobby area.  So now we’re waiting again.  

I wrote this on signed agreement - We have Emelin’s personal guarantee for 2 room master on Sunday, Feb 19.

Was told no charges to credit card until Monday due to issue, but they charged full price anyway

Now 5.35 pm, no room

Finally get 3302/3304 at 6.10 pm.  3302 has no security lock, you can push door open with no key

3304 - Safe does not work.

Sunday, Feb 19, 23

Emelin said she wild be back at 12 noon Sunday

2.10 pm - nothing

reviews.author: Len J
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs!!!
reviews.text:
We are long time club Melia members. We have been to the reserve on a few occasions. The resort has fallen into disrepair. Our concierge was absent the first day, nice as could be the next day. They are currently undergoing a "rebranding" to The Circle by Melia. I'll concierge made dinner reservations for us for three out of the six nights we are staying. We were told that the reserve will be taken over by the falcon hotel group and become part of the circle club by Melia beginning next month. That's when the pressure to attend the sales pitch started.

When we bought into their system years ago we were shown the best accommodations and our first couple of trips were very very nice. Since that time the service and accommodations have declined. 

Given our current experience and the high pressure applied by our concierge to meet the club circle manager to "receive information on the changes", we decided to not go to the big upsell and extreme high pressure sales exercise that they press upon you. We already bought the story once and look at where we are now? Why on earth would be believe anything they say now?

As a result our concierge promptly canceled our reservation at the nicer steakhouse in the new reserve they were trying to sell us into and has largely ghosted us since that time.

The service staff here has always been amazing. They are kind, friendly, and take customer service to a greater level. It's unfortunate that the sales arm of this organization has nearly ruined our week long vacation here.

Whatever you do, avoid the sales pitch and do not buy in to their system. Ignore the canned responses to this review. They are meaningless. Nobody is trying to regain our trust. Nobody cares that we are dissatisfied with our stay here. Nobody cares that we have already spent thousands upon thousands of dollars here from the first time they started with the high-pressure sales tactics. They care about one thing. Your money.

reviews.author: TITTI T
reviews.title: evitatelo
reviews.text:
assolutamente da evitare. Struttura che si propone come un 5 stelle ma in realtà ha la pessima gestione di un 3 stelle. Dilettanti allo sbaraglio. Assistenza Melià inesistente.
Prima stanza: Niket Junior Suite con aria condizionata e minibar mal funzionanti. Cambio stanza: dopo 2 ore si soggiorno Tubature rotte.
Da parte di Melia ufficio prenotazioni assoluto silenzio e nessun tipo di riscontro. 
Da evitare assolutamente. Pessima esperienza ancora in corso.

reviews.author: Didier
reviews.title: Un séjour de rêve entaché par un service d’ordre malveillant. Agression par la relation clients avec un malabar
reviews.text: Mon épouse et moi même en vacances sur un lieu merveilleux avec des personnes dominicaines toujours très gentilles venons de vivre une agression de la part d’une femme se prétendant chef des relations client . Elle était accompagnée d’un malabar de la sécurité. J’ai bien cru que j’allais être jeté de l’établissement par la force. Je n’ai pas fini mon repas pour cause au vue de la violence altercation j’ai eu une crise d’angor j’ai même cru que je faisais un infarctus. Je ne comprends pas cette situation car nous avions tout fait dans les règles. Je ne parle pas espagnole ni anglais. Mon épouse un peu mais le dialogue ne faisait pas partie du référentiel de cette dame et de son vigile baraqué. Cela fait plusieurs années que nous venons dans cet établissement en général de 15 à 21 jours et jusqu’à maintenant nous n’avons eu qu’à nous féliciter de nos séjours. Je ne compte pas en rester là….

reviews.author: Alvin P
reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: Reserved 2 bed room suite, got 2 room adjoining rooms in alternate facilty, the Gardens. Room reserved for pool side, got placed on back side of facility. Except for pool, small, and buffet  and bars that's all folks. In order to enjoy sut down dinner,  had to take golf shuttle Real or Falcon facilities. Large pool, paddle boarding, and other had to take shuttle to Real. To go to beach had to take shuttle to Real. Took 48 hrs and 2 rooms before final room and keys to come and go as we pleased. Don't go there! On could add more, butt.

reviews.author: avk2023
reviews.title: Not a luxury experience
reviews.text:
My stay was less than enjoyable. 

On the first day, after I unpacked my bags, I went to leave my room and the door would not latch. I called the front desk and a security person was sent to fix the door about half hour later. It look him almost an hour to get the door to latch. Later that night when I was ready to go to bed I went back to my room and the deadbolt did not work. It took over 2 hours and 3 trips to the front desk (and my room was not close to the front desk) to get maintenance out. They eventually fix it but the door still looks not completely secure. After an hour the second time I asked to be moved to a different room but was denied. 

For the first 3 days I did not have any chairs on my balcony. I finally came back to my room one afternoon and there were 2 chairs as there should be. The next morning I was excited to wake up and sit on my balcony. As soon as I sat down on the chair, it broke and I fell through the chair. I notified staff the chair was broken but if was never replaced. 

The power went out multiple times. On my second last day it went out while I was in the shower and the water stopped as well. I stood in the shower for 10 mins covered in soap and shivering while I waited for the water to come back. Eventually I got enough cold water to rinse off. 

At least one day my room was not cleaned. 

The elevator to the side that I was on was in an area of the hotel that is being renovated. I had to use the stairs every time I left or came to my room on the 3rd floor. Because of the construction there was also no way to get to my room without getting rained on when the weather was wet. 

The food was not good. Everything was cold at the buffets. It was impossible to get food anywhere between the breakfast and lunch swap over.

reviews.author: shawn12505
reviews.title: Horrible Company
reviews.text:
Not one thing this company does is professional. Rude & terrible company. 
You have been warned. Won’t provide toll-free numbers to pay Reservations. Customer service will insult you.  
Listed reps don’t return emails & they don’t care.

reviews.author: Nishant B
reviews.title: Never return!
reviews.text:
When we arrived we realized that the main Paradisus Palma real resort ( Melia Falcon) is closed for renovation so they asked us to go to Grand Cana resort which was not a type of resort we would like to enjoy in, and it was such an inconvenience to go to this other resort fr lunch and dinners. 
Reserve area now called Melia gardens has very basic amenities. 
Rooms were out dated and smelled bad, my room had a kitchen and the sink was leaking, air condition wasn’t working properly, toilet wasn’t flushing, they changed my room bt again it had issues. staff is not professional at all. 
Reserve area buffet area was very small, hardly any quality food option. We always had to go to grand cana resort. Reserve area only had 2 restaurants even then they couldnot run it professionally. Staff dosent care about gursts. 
Concierge is of no use they just want to sell you time share. 
There was no entertainment in this property. They had no theatre or anything for guests. Same goes for Grand cana. We were super bored after 3 days staying in. It was just food, swimming and same food. 
Beach area food was bad. Flies were sitting on salads and they ran out of fries. 
I will never return to this pradisus renamed as melia falcon, gardens. Very bad experience. 

Pool is good but the down side is, it dosenot have a bar facing pool, they just share the buffet area bar, so if you need a drink you need to shout at them to look at you standing in pool for drinks. 
Room service food was the only good food in this property. 
House keeping will do its job nicely only if you tip them.

reviews.author: James C
reviews.title: Beware, not a 5 star and will move your room
reviews.text: Was moved from the Palma Real and sent to the garden inn which used to be the reserve. 90 minute check in. Room had no towels or soap, mini fridge empty nothing stocked.  Room smells like a damp basement, toilet not working correctly.  Today no running water in the room.  Dishes from two days ago still in the room. Beds not made and floors not swept.  Food is rough.  This place is a 2.5 resort on its best day

reviews.author: Alexis M
reviews.title: Worst experience ever at Melia….!!!!
reviews.text: The worst experience ever had to wait in the lobby for my room for four hours then apparently the room that they gave me was the wrong room. They gave me a master room and I paid for a swim up master room. Also, the service was terrible I had to wait for towels every day till like 3 o’clock in the afternoon People in the front lobby where the worst people ever ever a counter with the very disrespectful. Do you not have no compassion for a person like me coming all the way from Connecticut to punta cana for the first time and had to wait four hours for our first room then the next day we had to move to our original room  Whole Lotta inconvenience in this experience. We also paid for an experience at the Paradis’s Palma riyal resort spa and they ended up putting us in the Palmer reserve because the Palmer riyal was not done till December 15, 2022. So again they put us in a wrong hotel  Experience that I seen on the Internet was a totally different experience that was in real person real time. Please whoever is experience this with Melia please make sure you check your flights in your destinations because it seems like whatever destinations you put, they put you in a different hotel, or a brother hotel . I did not pay for to experience in the reserves hi paid for the experience at the Palmer riyal. Very disappointing with this issue. Try to make the best out of it but didn’t have a good time wasted a whole Lotta money and a whole lot of my time and I also wasted my time for vacation with my wife. Please be careful with ordering or making plans with Melia the hotel.

reviews.author: BARBARA A
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE.  DO NOT GO TO THIS RESORT UNLESS YOU WANT TO PAY $133.00 PER NIGHT TO EAT COLD CUTS.
reviews.text: The worst experience of my life.  I booked this vacation (as a Melia Club Member) for 14 people having stayed here many years ago and bragged about how great it was.  Well to my surprise and that of my guests the hotel is totally run down, the rooms are musty and wet, there is black mold on the ceilings.  Our concierge apologized over and over but  he could not get us reservations for dinner we had to eat at the buffet, the buffet was out of orange juice and bacon 3 days out of our 5 day stay.  We were eaten alive with the amount of mosquitos, I have stayed in other Melia resorts which give the children gifts and toys as a grand gesture here there was nothing for them.  I was truly embarrassed after having told my guests of what a great place this was and then having to experience this disaster with them. I later learned that the hotel is being renovated this month.  I wish I would have known that the hotel was not being kept up due to upcoming renovations this should have been disclosed upon us making the reservations I would have never asked friends to join us on this vacation.  I truly believe that we should get a refund on the all inclusive price that was paid since we were unable to experience dinner outside of the buffet which was basically the same food night after night.

reviews.author: M K
reviews.title: Hands off if looking for a 5* hotel
reviews.text:
The beach is a construction site. 
At the central pool area there is extremely loud music who nobody is interesting in and is disturbing even 150 yards away. 
Also at the restaurants very high noise level. 
Front desk is not really helpful and does not take care of complaints.
Concierge service unreliable.

reviews.author: William S
reviews.title: Pior hotel que fui na vida!!!
reviews.text:
Estou hospedada no hotel, triste e decepcionada com o descaso do hotel comigo, entre tantos hotéis que poderia ter ido escolhi o paradisus palma realpra passar o meu aniversário, assim que cheguei avisei sobre a data, ficaram de preparar algo para comemoração e nada!! Meu esposo reclamou no dia seguinte, e se desculparam dizendo que fariam algo, e NADA de novo...Procurei pela Manager Cristielle, e ninguém (das concierges) sabia quem era!!!

RESUMO , se pretende comemorar uma data especial na sua vida NÃO É AQUI!!!

Estragaram minha comemoração pois se não vão fazer nada, não prometam!!!
Hotel bonito, comida regular, atendimento uns bons(quando pago propina) e outros péssimos.

Tínhamos um concierge, mas era uma farsa, não ajudou em nada e mal víamos ele. Na verdade ele apenas procurou para colocar a gente junto a um vendedor do circulo melia  e para pedir avaliação aqui no tripadvisor.

Como no ano de 2021 me hospedei no HardRock me arrependi muito de ter escolhido eles para conhecer, pois sabendo da qualidade e atenção que tive no HardRock  deveria der me hospedado lá novamente.

reviews.author: JeffersonSilva13
reviews.title: NÃO RESERVEM ESTE HOTEL, PIOR EXPERIÊNCIA DE VIDA!!!
reviews.text:
Ainda estou no hotel, e passo a todos os brasileiros que tenham cuidado!! 

Sou membro Melia Rewards Gold n: 15846504H

Fiz a reserva por minha agência é não nos informaram que o HOTEL PALM REAL estava em reforma completa, minha agência manteve contato com eles, temos o e-mail, informando minha solicitação de Checkin antecipado, porque sou membro e tenho direito, ao chegar na recepção por volta das 11h00, mesmo mostrando o meu cartão do clube, a mim foi dito que a suíte só estaria disponível as 15h, reclamei na hora e a mim foi dito que iriam falar com a supervisão, depois de 10 minutos vieram falar que a suíte estava pronta, ou seja, a equipe completamente despreparada.

Seguimos para a suíte, tudo ok, conforme havia contratado, eis que vamos para a piscina que fica a frente do quarto e pasmem: um odor terrível de …….. gato (não posso falar o nome pq ferr as diretrizes do tripadvisor), logo vimos que haviam gatos andando pelo local, e possivelmente foram eles que fizeram o …… na beira da piscina, isso tudo no dia 10/11, fomos hoje dia 13/11 para a piscina novamente e estava o mesmo odor, não estão cuidando da parte externa (ISSO É NOJENTO), você paga por uma suíte com mais exclusividade e luxo, e ganha odor de ……… de presente!!!

Outra coisa muito ruim, a cama muito confortável, porém do lado que minha esposa está, tem um buraco, estamos com medo de reclamar e nos colocarem numa suíte ainda pior, enfim, estamos passando férias/lua de mel terrível, a única coisa que está nota 10 são os restaurantes que a comida é muito boa.

Outro ponto desagradável é que quando vc fecha passeios com outras empresas que não estão dentro do hotel, você tem que pegar um carro de golf e ir lá pra frente na entrada do complexo, ficar fora do complexo e aguardar em pé no meio da rua a VAN chegar, você se sente um completo escanteado, no meio da rua esperando uma van (PORQUE ELES NÃO PODEM ENTRAR PARA LHE BUSCAR NA FRENTE DO HOTEL), porque eles induzem você a comprar com os passeiros deles dentro do hotel (QUE SÃO BEM MAIS CAROS).

Não somos de ficar reclamando com o Staff, pois acho isso muito feio, até porque são coisas básicas que deveriam ser feitas todo dia.

Estou completamente decepcionado com a rede Meliá e não voltaria jamais para a rede Melia de Punta Cana.

Voltarei, porque o destino é lindo, porém para outro hotel, e aos brasileiros que conheço e que me seguem aqui no TripAdvisor e no Instagram, recomendo não vir a este hotel.

Já visitei outros Hotéis Melia como o de Cabo Verde (Melia LLANA) e não passei por isso.

reviews.author: Thomas L
reviews.title: Katastrophales Hotel, abgewohnt, dreckig und schlechte Gastronomie NICHT ZU EMPFEHLEN
reviews.text:
Dieses Hotel ist sehr abgewohnt, das Mobiliar ist alt, verschlissen und defekt. Überall viel Dreck. Die Gastronomie ist schlecht.
Als wir das Hotel gewechselt haben wurde uns vom Hotelmanagement ein Schreiben vorgelegt, das wir unterschreiben sollten. In diesem Schreiben wurde uns damit gedroht, dass wir verklagt werden, wenn wir unsere Bilder veröffentlichen bzw. eine Bewertung schreiben.

reviews.author: Almudena M
reviews.title: Dinero mal gastado
reviews.text: Experiencia nefasta ,después de ir 7 veces al caribe esta es la peor experiencia de ellas hotel creía más lujoso y el más pésimo ,no lo recomiendo a nadie ni a las agencias que lo recomienden recio calidad es mejor otros hoteles como bahía o paladium no tienen nada que envidiar les

reviews.author: Oscar M
reviews.title: Desilusión total
reviews.text:
Acabamos de volver de paradisus palma real y llegamos muy desilusionados mi esposa y yo después de 9 días en Palma real. Ella estuvo hace 20 años y siempre la he escuchado hablar maravillas de el hotel , pero tengo que decir que no cumplió las espectativas en ninguno de sus servicios, primero medio hotel está en reforma y nadie nos informo de ello, llegamos al hotel y ni tan siquiera nos esperaban , el chico que nos recibió no tenía constancia de quienes éramos ni de nuestra reserva, nos dijeron en la agencia de viajes que nos recibirían con una fiesta sin bebidas o con un cocktail de bienvenida, pero todo ello brillo por su ausencia. Llegamos casi a las 9 de la noche después de 20 horas totales de viaje y el recepcionista nos dijo que si queríamos cenar fuéramos al grand cana, que no teníamos ni la más remota idea de dónde estaba , por qué los restaurantes de nuestro hotel ya habian cerrado. El segundo día de camino a la habitación encontramos una cucaracha enorme en el pasillo , que no fue la única por qué en la habitación vimos dos más. 
Es la 7 vez que visito punta cana y es en único hotel que he estado que no he tenido la sensación de estar en el Caribe , la animación está atada de manos y pies les ponen a hacer clases de pintura y yoga , yo al menos voy al Caribe a bailar, reír, y disfrutar, allí nada de eso , no con esto quiero decir que sea culpa de los chic@s de la animación ya que ellos hacen lo que se les indica. Lo peor de todo es la restauración , bufettes extremadamente pequeños con muy poca variedad y cada día la misma comida, arroz, habichuelas, bacon, hamburguesas y poco más, cuando en otros hoteles te hacen jugos naturales de 8/10 variedades, en varios restaurantes íbamos a cenar pedíamos una cerveza , y en algunos llegaba junto con el postre, en definitiva después de 3 años sin viajar debido ala pandemia y con mucho esfuerzo por qué todo vale mucho dinero , una enorme desilusión. Si que debo decir que para mi mujer y para mí cabe resaltar los chicos y chicas, y Carmen que son el equipo de la playa que son lo mejor del hotel con mucha diferencia.
Restauración nefasta.
Las playas llenas de algas, aunque debo decir que eso no es culpa del hotel.

reviews.author: Damián
reviews.title: Una muy triste experiencia
reviews.text: No nos informaron que el Hotel se encontraba en reparación.  No hay baños, restaurantes ni wifi en la playa. Hay que trasladarse en carrito a La Reserva o al Circle. El Melia actúa de muy mala fe al ofrecer un Hotel en estas condiciones.  Desgraciadamente todos los turistas sorprendidos y molestos por la situación.

reviews.author: Fria
reviews.title: Kein Paradis(ius)
reviews.text:
Wir haben im Juli 1 Woche Ferien für unsere Familie im Paradisius Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort gebucht. Wir haben uns auf eine Woche Strand und Erholung im Paradies /Paradisius gefreut. Die schönen Bilder auf der website machen ja auch wirklich Freude. 
Aber NUR die Bilder!
Als wir nach 14 Stunden Reise mit unseren 3 Kindern im Hotel ankamen, war nichts so, wie gebucht/beschrieben.
Der wunderschöne, überall abgebildete Teil des Strandes ist geschlossen, am Strand sind keine Restaurants - nur ein Foodtruck, um an den Strand zu kommen quetscht man sich mit anderen Gästen in einen Golfwagen - nur 5 - anstatt 13 - Restaurants sind geöffnet. Nichts von Paradies.
Anscheinend hätten sie allen Gästen im Januar ein Infomail geschrieben. Nur, wir haben im Juli gebucht, wurden nie informiert, und man liess uns also etwas buchen, was so gar nicht erfüllt werden konnte.
Freundlicherweise haben uns dann zwei Angestellte des Hotels geholfen, ein anderes Hotel zu finden.
Auf den 10% des Preises bleiben wir nun sitzen, obwohl die Kette Melia  ihren Teil des Vertrages nicht einhält. 
Für uns nun klar… nie mehr Melia. Und wir empfehlen allen, vor der Buchung, genau hinzuschauen, genau abzuklären!

reviews.author: Hernan M
reviews.title: Stay away - Scam, pictures published by the hotel don’t match reality
reviews.text:
stay away from this place, they don’t disclose that the hotel it’s under construction up until you signed and paid for it, and only until you ask how to get to the beach. They will deceive you by giving you an “upgrade” to another hotel, “The Reserve” but that’s also a lie, it’s not an upgrade, it’s the only thing the have to offer. 

The pictures in their website show a direct access to a big beach area, and in reality you need to take a golf cart to go to the beach, driving by the gigantic construction area the “Paradisus Palma Real” has turned into (see my side by side comparison pictures below). The beach area has been reduced to less than half of what it was, and you will relax, seating looking at the ocean with a construction site in your back, with the natural noise of tools, jack hammer, trucks and workers doing their thing.

As i said, don’t even consider Melia “Paradisus Palma Real”, the pictures you see in their website are showing a hotel and facilities that don’t exist anymore.

reviews.author: marie j
reviews.title: Disaster
reviews.text: Extremely unfriendly staff with the exception of 3 staff members. Food was terrible with flies on food in buffet area. We both got food poisoning as did other guests we were talking to. Left sitting in the American restaurant for 15 minutes without being served we were the only people in there they just ignored us. Breakfast by pool Slow!!!!!!! And wrong orders each morning. Hotel beach definitely not 5star and hassled a lot buy people selling crap. Definitely will not return the experience in the airport wasn’t any better EXTREMELY RUDE!!I couldn’t believe it and no running water or toilets working in the whole airport.

reviews.author: Alessandro S
reviews.title: The resort is closed until 2023, they will divert you at 1km from the beach
reviews.text: Worst experience ever for my family: sea was a carpet of seaweeds and the hotel told us just few days before departure (and 85 days after our reservation) that "Main building" is closed therefore you can access to Paradisius Gran Cana (which is nice but 1km from the beach). Reality is that it is not the "Main building" to be closed... it is the entire resort except a small area with rooms and pools for kids where you can barely swim. It's true they will give you access to another resort but should you have a family with kids, you will end-up spending time on a pool far from the sea because the beach is so dirty that you don't even want to see it. Moreover, Melià asked us to pay an upgrade to stay in the rooms nearby the services, pretending to give us the same services that we booked (but we choose this one to have direct access to beach, having the pool and the restaurant beach-front. Should you want to go 1km away from a dirty beach.... then please check directly Paradisius Gran Cana so you know what you are booking. This one is closed until 2023 (and they are not saying it!!! Totally unfair, probably illegal too....)

reviews.author: Yemina P
reviews.title: Estan REMODELANDO ES UN LIO LLEGAR A LA PLAYA!
reviews.text: Es excelente hotel pero por ahora no recomiendo ir hasta que terminen las obras, estan en plena remodelacion y es un lio llegar a la playa! Nada que ver a otros años donde podias llegar caminando a la arena y al mar. Hay que tomar carritos y carritos, se escucha el ruido de las obras!! Asegurarse de no ir durante el tiempo de remodelacion!

reviews.author: Tara
reviews.title: It’s closed, don’t book this resort!!
reviews.text: I am supposed to stay here next week, but apparently this resort is closed! My travel agency and I both tried to contact the resort numerous times to get more answers. How can a resort continue to book clients while they are closed! This is illegal! I have yet to receive a confirmation email from the resort about this, but some rude person told me this after rushing me off the phone. I am so frustrated by the lies and lack of communication. Way to ruin a trip that hasn’t started yet.

reviews.author: Mo D
reviews.title: The customer service worst experience to date
reviews.text: This trip was a disaster from start to finish. We booked a bachelors party in December of 2021 for June 2022. We booked the ADULTS ONLY Section through Expedia. Three weeks before our trip in June I called multiple times in May to make sure everything would be ready for us and to confirm our room selection. In the last week before our trip was set to begin. The resort informed be via telephone that they no longer had the adults only section, and it had been under construction for months. Due to people calling in they changed the reservation with online parties so the adults only selection would no longer be available. I asked why we were not informed of this prior the resort staff Daniel simply said I don’t know I apologize. I req a full refund they denied me. I call Expedia and asked why they had not informed us of the change the agent Michelle said I don’t and apologized. Again I requested a full refund I was denied and told our room would be upgraded. I explained to the Expedia agent and the Resort agent that we did not want to spend a bachelors party at a family resort with children running around. Neither were helpful and our money was not refunded. Without being able to cancel we were forced to be at a family resort on bachelors party due to the lack of communication from both Expedia and this Grand Reserve resort. We spent the weekend watching kids running around and the only group of guys there with no kids or family. This was absolutely the worst trip of our lives. Paying for a service and getting something completely different, far from what you requested has got to be  the biggest slap in the face. The Reserve at Grand Paradisus owes us an apology and a refund

reviews.author: Diego M
reviews.title: Avoid this hotel, it’s being remodeled and they don’t tell you this until it’s too late and can’t cancel your reservatio
reviews.text:
Avoid this hotel - it’s being remodeled and they only mention this 10 days prior to arrival without the possibility of canceling the reservation. 

I received an email 10 days prior to my arrival indicating that the pool and Infrastructure close to the beach is being remodeled. For my troubles they offer access to another area (that doesn’t have access to the beach). I don’t go to punta cana to go to the pool, I want to go to the beach and hence I want to go to another hotel and cancel my reservation. 

The email I received with this bad news has a contact phone number that doesn’t work. After two days trying I finally called another number. The response was that my reservation is not refundable and there is only one person capable of solving this. This person (Aidee Basora) can only be reached by email and there is no way to contact her immediately. 

I have sent 3 emails and after more that 2 days waiting I have not received a reply. The hotel staff doesn’t acknowledge the importance of solving this asap as I need to book another hotel. I have contacted 5 different teams and the hotel and they don’t offer any solution. 

I’m afraid I will get a reply when it’s too late for me to book another hotel. 

Even worse, this is the second time I book this hotel and the first time I went there I had the same problem. I was not able to change hotels and had a terrible experience. Shouldn’t have booked it again, I never thought I would be so unlucky that another remodeling would be taking place.

reviews.author: Yaninma H
reviews.title: Ascensores
reviews.text: Necesita el hotel ascensor para las habitaciones , para los clientes, para sus trabajadores, ellos no son esclavos, y los customers venimos a disfrutar, hagan mas placentero nuestras vacaciones con mas actividades y música

reviews.author: Jessica Roland
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK!
reviews.text:
DO NOT BOOK! 

The room we booked was in a building that is not even open. Booked beach front and got an “upgrade” to a swim up room with no view and had to take a golf cart to get to the beach. We were told that we received an email about this change but never received anything from the hotel. We went on this trip with several other couples and expected to be in the same building but this was not the case. We also booked the “adults only” side and this was also not open. Management was unwilling to reduce our rate, gave us a 30 minute massage for free (that I did not use). Don’t get me started on the horrible food and bugs in the room. 

Avoid this place! They are committing fraud by letting people book rooms that don’t exist!!!

reviews.author: Angel M
reviews.title: An Honest Review with no Bias.
reviews.text:
Many reviews are based on emotion and one thing I have come to learn is that everyone has a different set of standards. So I have decided to give a brief recollection of all the facts and allow you to form your own opinion.

Upon check in (5/29/22), we were informed the main building, along with the majority of the resorts restaurants were closed for renovation until December 2022. So the many options for dining and activities were not available to us during our stay, to make up for the lack of options they gave us the opportunity to book restaurants at another sister property called Grand Cana. While walking to our swim up room suite, we met our concierge, very sweet lady. We told her to make us reservations at some of the restaurants at Grand Cana. She proceeds to give us the news that it will be very difficult to book those restaurants due to the fact they give priority to guests staying at that resort, as it should be. We continue on to our journey...

We get to our room and see that the AC had not been turned on for quite some time, the Premium Mini Bar was not stocked and welcome snacks were not replenished. At least the sheets on the bed were made. The room was nice and well maintained, you can definitely see the patch work over the years and the tired decor, I would guess the room has not been renovated since the early 2000's. We immediately went to turn the AC on and come to find that it was already running, this sense of dread came over us, we instantly knew that the AC we have come to know and love will be completely different here in Punta Cana. 

The next morning we hit the Buffet, It was a bit small, and several flies had made their way to the food before us but we knew these things were to be expected since we're in a Tropical Island. Good Latin food options, not much for the kiddos who are shy on trying new foods, and the eating is to be done in open air seating. The pool was empty and lacking of any activities for kids. We decided to make our way to Grand Cana. The hotel has continuous golf cart rides to/from the sister properties because the walk would be too long and the sun was blazing. Once we arrived we were met with a beautiful open air lobby along with koi ponds, it was vibrant, full of people and you could hear the music from the pool. All their restaurants were open for Lunch/Dinner and their Buffet was about 10 times larger with indoor AC seating and a patio for outdoor seating. The pool was large with a swim up bar, music blasting and several activities for people to enjoy. Needless to say Grand Cana was beautiful. Spent the day there and came back to our hotel.

Our concierge informed us that she was unable to make reservations at Grand Cana but she was still trying. So we ate at one of the two restaurants on site, Mizu. The food was good, the chef was funny and entertaining, and the drinks at the bar right outside the restaurant was delicious, with martini's being the bartenders specialty. 

The next day we woke up, the room was humid, enough for the bed sheets to stick to your body. The clothes hanging in the closet was slightly moist. On our way out of the room we noticed our door lock ran out of battery (electric only), we saw our house keeper and told her the issue, she said she would call maintenance to fix the problem. We came back later that day and found the door lock to still be out of battery. I walked over to the lobby and informed them of the issue, they assured me it would be fixed. I went to the pool to kill time, an hour later I checked and still not fixed. I informed the lobby again. This time I stood by the door to wait for someone, they came and informed me it was out of battery, but they had no idea on how to access the room. After about 20 minutes and 3 maintenance engineers later they get the idea to go into our neighbors room without consent and use the connecting door to access my room. Obviously the room was not done by housekeeping, so I went to the lobby again, an hour later a person shows up to clean the room, they left no towels and took the used ones, toilet paper was not replenished either. Off to the lobby again. An hour later they came with towels and TP. By this time it was 6pm and we still had to clean up from the day, needless to say our dinner plans were shot...

By the third day, we had decided to forgo the buffet in our hotel for good, the food was very repetitive and lacking any AC. We would eat exclusively at Grand Cana. But on this day we decided to ask one of the many empty restaurants at Grand Cana for reservations for dinner. The host was very accommodating and told us he could fit us in all the while our concierge was not able to get us reservations, odd! 

At this time we had already had several different drinks at many bars between both properties. The drinks were very watered down, almost lacking any alcohol. They always preferred to use the well bottles, and the majority of those bottles were unmarked. When asking for any of the premium spirits they would claim that it was an additional cost. The only exception was our fantastic bartender at the Aqua bar, which sits right outside of Mizu, you can find us there every night. Strong martini's and great conversation.

The golf course is not on property, its at one of the sister hotels, which is about a 5 minute golf cart ride away. We rented clubs there and the full round cost about $65 and the rentals another $25. The course was in pretty decent shape, greens were rolling good, tee boxes were in good shape, and the course is wide open.

The beach entrance is not on property as well, its located next to the building that was shutdown for renovations. This was about an 8 minute golf cart ride. When we arrived, the beach was full of chairs and umbrellas free for use, you had a few tents there serving drinks and food. And about 10 street vendors trying to sell you everything under the sun. One thing the resort does not tell you is that the beaches in Dominican Republic are all public, none of them are private. This means street vendors, local residents, and guests staying at other resorts can simply walk onto any part of the beach and use it at their leisure. Beware, even though you can say No to the many street vendors there, they will wait a few minutes, come right up to your chairs and ask again, and again, and again. At this current time, and we are not sure how long this will last, there was a seaweed infestation on all the beaches in the DR that were on the north side of the island (Atlantic). If I had to guess about 50 feet worth of shoreline and about another 25 feet into the water. We're also talking about thick seaweed the type you would have to power walk through, to get to some sort of clean water. But none of these items were as distracting as the constant jackhammers, dump trucks, and drilling that fills the air from the nearby renovations to the adjacent property.

All the waiters were very friendly, and had a pleasant demeanor. They are very hard working individuals who went out of their way to make sure you were taken care of. The staff at the lobby/checkin area seemed unresponsive and did not care for anyone who had to complain about issues. Don't expect to speak to a manager, we asked for one on two separate occasions and they never answered the call. The concierge is limited and has no control over any of the bookings at the sister properties. 

I believe had Melia been honest with their guests at the time of booking then we would have avoided all this and gone with a different resort. I have no doubt once the construction is done it will be beautiful, until then stay at your own risk.

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Don't Book - They Are Closed!!!!!
reviews.text:
We booked our trip back in March and when we showed up on May 13th – they were closed!  They closed in May 2022 and are closed through Dec 2022.

A person sitting in a golf cart redirected us to the Melia Reserve where they then sent us to the Melia Paradisus Grand Cana. Once there, they told us this is an “upgrade”.  While the hotel was modern and very nice – it was not an ocean front room (what we paid for), or adult only (lots of kids), and you needed to take a golf cart to get to the beach.  

They then sent us to the Punta Cana Beach Level resort where we ended up staying.  It was near the beach and had an adult only section. While it was nice, it was not on the level as the Paradisus Palma Real (my wife and I have stayed there many times). 

The Bad:

-	They took our reservation and are still taking reservations even though they are closed through the end of 2022.
-	We confirmed and checked in online the night before we traveled, and they still did not tell us.
-	They tried to charge us the same room rate as the Paradisus Palma Real for the Punta Cana Level.

The Good:

-	The people at the Melia Punta Cana Beach Level worked very hard to help us (Michael Bautista and his team, and Luis Rodriguez, our butler, to name a few). After some negotiations they correctly reduced my room rate, provided us access to the Level restaurants as well as the Pardisus Grand Cana restaurants, and added some free services.
-	We ended up having a great time.
-	We wandered down to the Paradidus Palma Real and found many of the people that worked there previously were still there working there on the beach – Wanda, Luis, and Pedro to name a few.  These are the people that made all of our previous trips so great. It was wonderful to see them again - it felt like coming home!

The renovations they are planning seem great and the Paradisus Palma Real will be even better when they open.  I plan on going there next year.

MELIA – JUST BE UP FRONT AND TELL EVERYONE! They will understand, and try one of your other properties.

reviews.author: Anthony C
reviews.title: Not a 5-star experience. Not worth the money.
reviews.text: Not a 5-star experience whatsoever. I recently stayed here at "The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana" for 8 days, 7 nights for a wedding that brought over 80 guests to the resort (40+ rooms).If you're interested in a beachfront resort experience, the Reserve is not what you're looking for. The Reserve is down the road from the main resort and requires you take a golf cart over every single time you'd like to go to the main resort or beach. I had a Deluxe Master Suite. The room was large and had amenities like a hot tub and dual showers, but all very outdated. Old furniture and rusty coat hangars, pipes. We had constant problems. My room was not available at the promised 3pm. Our safe was broken. Food was a 5/10, many restaurants were also inexplicably closed. The hibachi chef handed me a hot plate that left a large burn scar on my arm. At 11pm day one, we discovered our mattress was completely soaked underneath. Room service covered the wet spots with dry sheets. It took over an hour to resolve. Next night, our toilet didn't work. We called at 11pm and it was resolved at about 12, or so I thought. The next morning, we had booked a $180 excursion for snorkeling on a party boat and we were set to leave at 8:45am. My girlfriend woke up very sick at about 6:45am only to discover the toilet was broken. I called reception at 7am. At 8am, I called again. At 9am, after we had missed our plans, I called again. By the way, my girlfriend was forced to use the main lobby bathroom because of this delay. Talk about a luxurious experience. A person finally arrived past 10am and it was resolved by noon. Next day, we returned to the room to discover half the room was covered in water and my girlfriend's luggage drenched. Some leak somewhere near the window. Our concierge set us up with a new room, which had a working toilet and was dry. But most of the sinks and one shower was missing hot water. We complained to Reception Manager and Hotel Assistance Manager, Jose and Edward, who offered us an upgrade on future stay. That's essentially it. No reimbursement for all the troubles or for the missed excursion due to hotel shortcomings. Not a great customer service whatsoever. I spoke to multiple people who all claimed that they had to discuss with a different manager. They just jerked me around until it was time for me to leave. Absolutely horrid experience, would not recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Ana J
reviews.title: LA EXPERIENCIA FUE FATAL!!!!
reviews.text:
Tuve una experiencia fatal ! 
1- la comida del buffet no tuvo gran variedad a la mayoría del equipo nos tocó elegir pizza casi todos los días al almuerzo porque casi nada se salvaba tanto en variedad como en sabor 
2- la actitud del persona en general fue poco amable, displicente 
3- lo peor de todo fue recibir una llamada de una persona que trabaja en el hotel a decirme cosas no apropiadas, ( encargado de llevar el roomservice) literalmente me sentí irrespetada, por lo anterior cancele mi reservé para los días restantes, consiguiendo una opción más económica con mejor servicio
4- hacer una reserva en alguno de los restaurantes es una odisea, alcanzamos a reservar en Aqua, y de verdad que es penoso que un hotel que ofrece un servicio 5 estrellas ofrezca una calidad tan pobre en la comida 

Escogí paradisus porque en mi primera
Experiencia en punta cana, él hospeda en el paradisus punta cana fue genial, pero en esta ocasión fue un desastre, no volvería jamás y tampoco lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: Donnapcdr
reviews.title: Horrendous...Scam Alert !
reviews.text: If you are thinking about this hotel and have any interest in getting what you have paid for you'd better run not walk away from this one !  This hotel is running the biggest scam I have ever seen in 21 yrs of traveling to the DR after having stayed in most of the 4 and 5 star hotels on Bavaro beach and Cap Cana.  If you stay in the higher priced rooms and are in Royal Service,  according to the booking and the website you are entitled to have a butler.  You will not get one because they will tell you that they don't have them because they have concierge service.  I clearly witnessed them walking throughout the resort in white suits with a bright blue sash.  We were not the only people being denied a butler who were entitled to who we spoke too. We were tipped off that the butlers are paid a salary,  and the concierge are paid commission only based on whether they can get you to attend the hotel club membership talk.  Be prepared for your concierge to beg and bug you to go and don't do it because you will not get out there in under 90 minutes!     This hotel is just not bothering to offer any shows or decent entertainment under the excuse of covid when all the neighboring hotels I researched were back to normal offering shows and beach events. Also, no Caribbean night of vendors happened.  The food was honestly so bad that we had to request to go to another hotel to try to get a decent meal. The quality of the food was so low it was unbelievable and I should have heeded previous bad food reviews, yet the hotel charge is as high as ever.  Understand that these hotels are operating on 30% to 50% occupancy and they are cutting back at your expense even though they will tell you they are at 85%. The buffet was fine and we had no issue with many of the workers who work very hard. Terrible maid service, had to chase them down daily for things taken out of the room and to get pillowcases for stripped pillows left in the middle of the room, had to restock our own mini bar after many requests.  It did not help that was a very big birthday trip that they did not acknowledge till I said something.  Do yourself a favor and stay away from Melia completely because their corporate management  could not care less whether you are happy or if they have fulfilled their hotel responsibilities.  They have just showed me this in their response.  Go with Excellence or Secrets and you will get what you pay for and will rarely be disappointed !

reviews.author: Deena R
reviews.title: Plan on eating at buffet for every meal! No chance of getting reservations for dinner
reviews.text: Let me start by saying, the hotel and the property are beautiful. However, if you book this property, plan on eating at the buffet every meal.  The very first day, I tried to make reservations for dinner, and was told nothing was available. I called everyday, and was told the same thing. The only reservation I could get was for lunch for 2 days at the steakhouse. I made sure to order "house wine". When I went to check out, I had a $307 bill for wine. I find that very impossible, since It was just me (with 3 kids) and only ate at restaurant 2 days. I asked to talk to manager but I was told that no one was available. I feel that I was taken advantage of. PLEASE BEWARE!

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.title: Terrible restaurant reservation system
reviews.text:
I am writing this review while staying in the hotel - room 3039.

Don’t get me wrong - food in the buffet is quite good, but it is the same every evening, even on Easter Sunday.

We are traveling with two other families - 11 ppl in total. Not Reserve, not Circle - just “regular “ Palma Real - which is actually quite expensive compare to other similar hotels in Bavaro area.

For that kind of money you would expect an ability to make the reservation at the a la carte restaurants without any hassle.

Surprise! There is no restaurant reservation desk at the hotel. You have to call certain number to make the reservation. But the line is either constantly busy or no one is answering the phone. And you have to call from the hotel phone - either from your room or lobby. Who has time to spend 5 hours in the room trying to get through?

Even if you get a chance to speak to operator, you get ZERO availability for “regular” hotel guests. All spots are pre-booked for Reserve and other “VIP” guests by their concierges.
The interesting thing is that restaurants are half-empty - management is saving the money and not allowing full capacity (even though there are zero COVID-related measures at the resort - no mandatory temperature checks or hand washing or mask wearing).

Front desk gave a hint - upgrade to VIP service and we will help you.
This is completely unacceptable for such luxury resort to treat the guests by how much they had paid and what type of room they are staying at.

reviews.author: Esther D
reviews.title: Cancelled my reservation and switched me to a different resort
reviews.text: We have our vacation set for next week, and received notice that they are closing for renovations and we are getting moved to another resort! We planned our vacation with another family, and now we are going to be at different hotels! We did a lot of research before booking and specifically chose this resort for its rave reviews and closeness to the beach. If we wanted to stay at the hotels we are being moved to, we would've chose it ourselves. I don't understand how this happens, especially since we booked less than 3 months ago. Beware!

reviews.author: Frederik D
reviews.title: Being sick at Paradisus Palma Real because of their food
reviews.text: As guests with a little baby we certainly did not experience that the wellbeing and health of your customers was of greatest importance to the staff at Melia. We left 1 week early because we were sick from eating the Food at Melia resort restaurant. We were not supported by the guest service and the reception except from one time in the very beginning.  We did not get better. Hence, we walked up to the guest service desk and requested medical help and the day after I called the reception for medical assistance from the room. Reception promised me to get back to me but nothing happened. I expected to get a full refund for the full stay because we were not being prioritised and taken care off. We always had to walk all the way down to the reception while sick, the reception kept calling our room walking up our baby and a service agent from the concierge desk in the lobby got angry at us when I asked him to order immodium and not to call our room anymore.   We would strongly advice against staying at this hotel chain. They seem to big to care.

reviews.author: Vsaumell
reviews.title: Worst experience ever! DO NOT STAY IN THIS HOTEL. I GOT FOOD POISONING and the hotel didn’t take responsability!
reviews.text: Tuvimos muchos problemas En este hotel desde el momento que llegamos. Nuestro cuarto no estaba listo hasta después de las 5. El aire acondicionado del cuarto nunca enfrió y hacía un ruido muy feo en el ducto del bano que no me dejo dormir la primera noche,  lo reportamos bastantes veces. Fueron dos veces a arreglarlo pero al rato volvía a sonar. Y el aire nunca llegó a bajar de 25 aunque nosotros tratábamos de ponerlo en 23. Cuando hicimos check in el minibar estaba casi vacío y había una lata de cerveza vacía tirada.  Y lo peor de toda la estadía por que si hay más!!!! Es que me intoxique al segundo día de estar en el hotel, después de estar vomitando y con diarrea por la comida del hotel llamamos al médico del hotel a las 6 de la mañana Del miércoles y el nos derivó a un hospital porque me encontraba totalmente deshidratada y con una infección gastrointestinal. El hotel no se hizo cargo de la cuenta del hospital ( fueron 900 dólares, ni en Estados Unidos sale una cuenta así por lo que me hicieron) ni de la consulta del doctor en el hotel  que me vio 10 minutos y nos cobro 180 dolares. Cuando hice mi queja de todo lo que me había pasado, lo que me ofrecieron fue un Gatorade a las 12 del mediodía que llegue del hospital después de estar 6 horas ahí que nunca llego a la habitación. Lo único que pudieron hacer por mi después de todo lo sucedido fue darme un late check out hasta las 5 cuando lo pedí hasta las 7 porque me encontraba en muy mal estado. Cuando salimos del cuarto pedimos hablar con la manager para ver si habían podido ver el tema de los gastos médicos. La manager nos hizo esperar dos horas para despues mandar a un supervisor a decirnos que el hotel no podía hacer nada, como no estaba contenta pedí hablar con la manager, que apareció después y nos ofreció un upgrade para futura estadía lo cual no arregla nada de lo que paso en esta estadía. Estamos muy descontentos con la estadía y con cómo se comportaron a cerca de todo lo ocurrido.

reviews.author: Hanieeh E
reviews.title: Lack of Customer Service
reviews.text:
We are currently staying here and our experience has been so frustrating that I could not wait till the end of the stay to write a review. We booked a family reunion of 14 people for a week long stay. The property looks nice but that’s about it. The hotel “prides” itself with the variety of restaurants onsite. HOWEVER, once we got to the property and asked about the restaurants, they told us it’s by reservation only. We checked in 3 days ago and still have not been able make any reservation for the restaurants! Their excuse is that they are fully booked due to a conference #ConvoTech being onsite and their attendees HAVE PRIORITY over the other guests. We were told the conference has reserved majority of the restaurants. Leaving NOTHING for the other hotel guests. NO ONE at the hotel wants to help either! Yet, the interesting part is that previous to our arrival I was told that we could not prebook dinner reservations and had to wait till we were onsite! We’ve been going back and forth with guest services and they keep giving us the run around . Giving FALSE timelines of when they will get back to us and they never do! 
My advice to future guests. If you just want beach pictures try this hotel, but if you want a 5star experience as promised for the price you are paying, look elsewhere!

reviews.author: Inspire746160h
reviews.title: Worst resort ever-waste of money
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that we chose this place for our family reunion, so we were all looking forward to our time there. To start, there is NO covid protocol. Employees half wear their masks, areas are not being constantly cleaned, food are does not follow the covid protocols AT ALL. The floor in our room was filthy, we have a crawling baby so had to wipe all surfaces and clean floors with Clorox wipes. 
We had simple requests to the staff like "can we have a bottle of water?" and the constant answer was "im not allowed on that side, ask this other waiter" like..seriously, what on earth? Customer service was TERRIBLE. 
Now, the food..guys, when I say the food was bad its an understatement. The food was OLD, and disgusting. It was not appetizing at all. Even at the restaurants it was awful (that is if you can even get a reservation).
The only thing that was good was the beach, which honestly in the DR is something you can find anywhere so nothing special.
To summarize, do not waste your money..this place is AWFUL.

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: The only thing all inclusive was the rude staff.
reviews.text: Wow, where do I begin? Oh I know- how rude the staff is. Nothing but a nightmare since checkin. Imagine being told you can’t eat dinner at an all inclusive restaurant (that you paid for) because there are no reservations? Or having a manager thank you for your patronage because with us giving him business he can feed his family but has no problem taking our money and not making sure his guests are taken care of? Or having managers be in a “meeting” all day and can’t step out to solve situations with multiple upset guest? Being denied entering the buffet because you’re wearing a bathing suit with a cover up because it’s too “inappropriate” but yet half of the people inside the buffet are practically naked? When the staff thinks you don’t know Spanish but you do and here them talking about you in their language? Yup, imagine it because this is what happens at the Paradisus Palma real. You must need to have a severe attitude problem to be hired here, if not, you won’t be fit for the job!

reviews.author: Marina
reviews.title: Disasterous Trip
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real with my husband, and another couple, from February 27 - March 5, and we could not have been more disappointed if we tried. We stayed in the Adults Only section, and the problems started upon arrival. There was no concierge, which was supposed to be included, no cleaning services till after 6 PM (and only after we had to complain aggressively multiple times), no resupply AT ALL of shampoo/toiletries or coffee/creamer/sugar/etc, despite multiple requests (and assurances that everything would be brought up within "5 minutes"). The beds were FULL of some kind of bugs/flying ants and we had to switch rooms in the middle of the night instead of an immediate change due to the bugs - absolutely disgusting. The service overall was incredibly disappointing and we all felt like we were imposing on the staff rather than being actual paying customers requesting what amounted to the bare minimum of service. The rude treatment we received throughout the week should be unheard of at a so-called "luxury" resort. We were also overcharged upon arrival, since they insisted on charging my card in their domestic currency rather than USD, at whatever exchange rate is current at the time of arrival, so it was nowhere near the total amount I actually purchased my trip for and had a confirmation for. Had to dispute the amount with the credit card company since there was a literal contract in place from the day of booking. Absolutely absurd.

reviews.author: J Stewart Roberts MD
reviews.title: Horrible example of a Melia property.
reviews.text:
Maybe the worst Paradisus. First, we are Club Melia members for 10 years. We booked the presidential suite. See pics below. 
1. No greeting at the hotel, no champagne, no tour or the property. Nothing. 
2. Food may be the worst I’ve ever had. Literally, not eating anything may be the better option. Brisas was absolutely disgusting. 
3. At the Reserve section (as we are), there is no beachside service. For two days I’ve had to find towels and set ourselves up on the beach. 
4. We have had to hunt for change. Yes, we like to tip the staff but reception never has change. They always say “come back after 5pm”. What kind of property with hundreds of guests doesn’t have change? 
5. The staff is incredibly lazy and they are bordering on condescending to their guests. This may be a product of the culture of the Dominican people so most of this review is based on the quality, or lack thereof, of the staff. Inefficient, lazy and unwilling to accommodate simple requests. 
6. A few bright spots, Zenovia was a great concierge and she herself was embarrassed at the way we have been treated. Jonathan at Gabi Beach was the ONLY friendly server who was actually appreciative of our tips. He makes a great Aperol Spritz. 
7.  We will not be entertaining the upgrade to Circle at this resort. Our home resort Playa del Carmen La Perla is so much better. Hence, we will not be returning here to the DR. In fact, I’ve never looked forward to leaving a resort…until now. 
8. Finally, see pics of the jacuzzi in the presidential suite, leaves, trash, water rings all in the jacuzzi.

reviews.author: Lucille W
reviews.title: Bad Experience! Stay away
reviews.text: STAY AWAY! This resort has gone to hell! Very bad experience after spending a lot of money so disappointed! Door handles to patio missing. shower spraying all over the place, ac vents on ceiling dripping water on bathroom floor. Suite we booked was not available. Bad experience

reviews.author: Lisa J
reviews.title: Lied to during our stay. Booked a room directly through the website, was overbooked and was given a smaller room.
reviews.text: Well, we checked in expecting a presidential suite and was told during the check in process that they had overbooked the room and was down grading us the a smaller room without communication prior to our arrival.

reviews.author: Doctor C
reviews.title: Absolutely horrendous….
reviews.text:
So my wife and I booked this based on the pictures and the ease of getting to the DR.  Upon arrival we realized that it was far less glamorous than the pictures on the site.  They attempt to make you feel special by escorting you to a “special” check in area…. We should have ran for the hills.  First our room was not what we booked, it was a make Believe version of what they say a panoramic suite is on the site……

After going back to the “special” area, they moved us one room over, which was better but it took 6 hours.

The food…… DISGUSTING x 100000, every person we met on the resort said they were living off potato chips.

Alcohol options - HORRIBLE - unless you buy a bottle, even then they charge you an outrageous amount for the bottle and it takes forever to get one.

They refuse to make change, they refuse to do anything quickly, honestly it is the absolute worst waste of money that I have ever experienced…..

1 week of misery.

Luckily there were a few bartenders that went above and beyond, Ruby, Alfonso, Miguel, Illesete and Yiri were the only people that actually put effort into making our stay fun…..

Our concierge was a good person, but, even he only can do so much.

My advice - go anywhere else, literally anywhere, this place is garbage.

reviews.author: JHL
reviews.title: DONT TAKE THE RISK of booking ANY room advertised as Palidisus Real Golf /Reserve /Palma this place is a hot mess
reviews.text: This resort has the potential to be great. Our experience has not been so great. Staying one of the (only) two most exclusive rooms our expectations based on our many other travels has been lackluster and has included nothing more than someone staying in the cheapest room here. Check in was a nightmare. We are staying in the Presidential suite yet have had to get up at 4 am just to ensure we will have a place at the exclusive adult pool located outside our building. In prior stats at other hotels - spending double the money to upgrade to this level room has always provided us the most exclusive and attentive details from the resorts. Here - Little things that would be provided at a motel 6 in the US are things we have spent days trying to get (such as wash cloths or for our room to be cleaned). Everyone we have met seems to have their own frustrating story during their stay here. Such a beautiful location yet relaxation doesn’t come because of the constant need to return to reception to try and get any issue resolved. It’s a management issue no doubt. Filled with Timeshare style sales managers that don’t really seem to care. We are here for another week and we will make the most of it but if you’re looking for a real relaxing get away - this should be your last choice.  We feel bad for for the day staff because they are clearly not trained, nor given permission to make things happen. There is no Royal service anymore, butlers service is a joke, free pressing each day is not free as it says on the Meliá website, etc. Only a couple restaurants have better than mediocre food (although paying extra for the upgraded dinner option does equal better food - except they don’t have many items on the menus).  So if you only care about a beautiful location for sunrise and don’t mind getting up at 4 am to secure chairs at the pool or beach, and don’t mind mediocre (and cold food at buffets) then maybe this will meet your needs. The mini bar for a Presidential suite is a joke (saltines, chips, Oreos - no wine, or rum or anything just Heineken minis & a coors light, “hydroshower” is a regular shower head, coffee pods only replaced if you ask over & over - see pics)

reviews.author: Bob L
reviews.title: False Promises, Horrible Execution, Zero Follow Through
reviews.text:
What to expect:  You won’t have the room you booked when you arrive and an upcharge to get into the room you were actually supposed to be in – or – a downgrade in room to be closer to the beach with no compensation * Lukewarm Food * No one can fix a problem*   Also - you will pay at the resort, they will convert it to local currency and then be charged for the service by your bank --- for every credit chard charge you make.  

CURRENTLY STAYING AT THIS RESORT.  This will be a long review.  I want to state up front, I would highly recommend seeking a different resort – this one totally missed the mark on what an all-inclusive experience is supposed to be – somewhere in management, either here or at the corporate level, they just don’t get it.  We have stayed at numerous all-inclusive resorts in the Caribbean, but here at the Palidisus Palma Real aka the Palidisus Golf resort aka The Reserve at Palidisus (it’s all the same place just different locations on their property)  the term all-inclusive means you have a room, can eat mediocre food, and have access to the ocean.  To be fair, the property itself is beautiful (although there are needs for updating throughout) and we’ve heard that in the past, the experience here was very different.  Also, while this is a review of our stay over the last six days (with eight more to go) and based on our individual experience, it is also submitted on behalf of the DOZENS of people we have talked to at various locations throughout the resort who have experienced similar issues.  It is truly sad to see so many people so frustrated while on vacation.  So, not only does the resort itself suck the living life out of you trying to get simple things, like a washcloth, hanging out at the pool is filled with everyone talking about their horrible experiences – although there is some comfort in that on some weird level.

Many things are promised on the Melia site, if I don’t include it here, then it was satisfactory.  

Pre-Arrival:  We booked our two-week stay here through Melia directly.  We were booked for 4 nights in a room before we could upgrade to the best room on the resort.  We don’t want to sound pretentious – but it’s important to have an understanding of this review to know that we upgraded to the Presidential Suite because you would expect the best room on the resort (there are actually two of these suites here) would have the most superior service.  The rate for the upgrade was very reasonable – made the decision a true no brainer.  We had a week in the suite, then would go back to an ocean view room for our last few nights here.  We probably made a dozen calls to make some pre-arrival arrangements (dinner reservations, special occasion reservations, etc).  Every time, whether we contacted the call center in Miami or called the resort directly, we were told we could not make those arrangements until we arrived.

Airport: There is NO hotel transportation from the airport to the resort and it could not be arranged through the hotel beforehand.  We were shuffled off to another company (one we did not use).

Upgraded Services:  Upgrading to “Royal” or butler service – even the best service – does not give you everything for free.  You will still pay for some top shelf liquor (Grey Goose for example) and even some of the “included” liquors (Tito’s and Jim Beam as examples) are only available at certain bars.  Same goes for wine and some champagnes.   Upgrade really doesn’t get you much except someone to make dinner reservations for you but their system doesn’t work well so expect you may have a “reservation” but still be turned away due to some error on the part of the resort.

Arrival:  It was simply a mess.  We were not in the area we specifically requested (adults only).  We were forced to spend over three hours trying to make arrangements to get a reasonable room.  In short, we were forced to take a downgrade in rooms to be in the area we had requested and were not offered ANY compensation for that.  We were offered the opportunity to stay in the upgraded suite for the remainder of our stay…however, the charge for that was four times --- yes four times what it cost to upgrade for an entire week.  We were told it was because we didn’t make those reservations prior to our arrival  of course we were also told that room wasn’t available prior to our arrival so we couldn’t have booked the room prior to our arrival.  To be honest, we were tired, hungry – very hungry, and just wanted to change clothes and shake off the travel dust … so we paid it.  NOTE: Two days later, we were asked to a meeting with the hotel manager who told us how sorry they were for our troubles, that they wanted to “make it right” with us because they had screwed up, and they offered to refund us what we paid for the extra days in the suite.  Then the bait and switch --- only if we agreed to move out of the room we are in for the rest of our stay here and DOWNGRADE AGAIN!!!  We told them no way.  Since then – crickets, nothing done to make up for their errors.  I could write paragraphs on this experience – suffice it to say, it was one of the worst check-in experiences we’ve ever experienced.   We have spent HOURS in reception over the last few days and have had little, if anything, taken care of.

Also – for people from the USA.  The do not let you pay for your room online because THEY WILL CHARGE YOU IN DOMINICAN PESOS AND ALSO PASS ALONG ALL OF THEIR BANK FEES TO YOUR BILL

Service in general:  Unlike other resorts we have visited, the staff here seems put out by requests for almost anything.  To be fair – there have been some very helpful people here, but most seem sad to have their job.  In fact, the happiest person we met was a young lady who told us this was her last day – she quit her job and was going back home the next day.  

On to our time here so far.

Promised: 

“Personal butler service during the stay”

Delivered.  Beyond the lowest we’ve ever experienced.  A person who is assigned to you, and many other guests, that basically serves as a go-between for you and the front desk.  Our “butler” is a really nice guy.  He simply is not allowed to do anything without first checking with his boss – who then has to check with their boss and, often, it goes up the chain like that.  These people are simply not given any authority to do anything on their own.  As a result, it is not really butler service.  While some of the things we requested were produced, they did not come without us having to follow-up, in some cases – many times.  Our butler did not even know how to arrange for laundry service.  These folks are simply overwhelmed.  F

Promised (when called): “Don’t worry about dinner reservations, your butler will take care of it for you”.  

Delivered:  You will often not get reservations at the restaurant you want, certainly not at the time you want, and you will be told the food is good at places where it really isn’t.  While on the subject of food – unless you like it tepid to cold, make lunch reservations at the places that serve hot food.  The buffet does have some cook stations, like omelets in the morning, where the food his hot.  Otherwise, most of the food out on the buffet is cold or barely warm.  For the restaurants, you must scan a QR code to get the menu – so bring a smart phone (with a data plan).  One restaurant offered a great tasting menu – we were excited to try this out.  We tried to order it – were told it was not available, that it was a left-over from a “previous event” (to our waiter’s credit – he provided us two full servings of every item on the tasting menu – it was A LOT of food!!).  Also – at the buffet – if you find something you like, eat a lot of it as they may not have it again the next day.

Promised: Access to all Melia offerings

Delivered:  Access to all Melia offerings …. With a 20 plus minute wait for transportation or a 15 minute walk to the nearest property.  If you choose to stay stay at The Reserve (where there are swim up rooms) – it will be a wait for transportation to almost all the restaurants at Las Palamas and any activities on the beach.  Also – “Access” does not mean there isn’t a cost attached so expect to pay!

Promised: Panoramic View

Delivered:  The panoramic view rooms are located directly over or next to the main square.  This means that you shouldn’t expect to get quiet time until well after 10 pm.  And during the day it is located at the children’s area and is quite busy – so time on a balcony has no real privacy or a quiet experience to sit and enjoy the view.

Promised: 24/7 Room Service

Delivered:  24/7 Room service … with a wait of at least an hour for the arrival of cold (in some cases barely warm) food.  There is a limited selection of food on the menu.

Promised:  Daily restocking of mini-bar, snacks, & room cleaning.  

Delivered:  The mini bar and the snacks (which were limited to chips, soda crackers, Oreos, & was only restocked when was asked for it to be restocked).  The room was cleaned daily – kind of and getting things like wash cloths required three phone calls the first day then a constant follow-up with the cleaning crew to have them in the room. As of right now – we have one.

Other observations:  

Tipping – doesn’t matter.  Tipping does not seem to improve service in any way what-so-ever.  As an all-inclusive, you’re told you don’t have to tip.  We are a culture where tipping in ingrained and, most often, appreciated.  Here, it does not seem appreciated and it has made little to no difference in the level of service received.  Additionally, tipping should be done for good, great, or exceptional service which you find very little of here.  

On a good note - when over charged at the store and we went back the ladies there were truly apologetic and embarrassed, we couldn’t have been treated better by great
Lunch at the reserve?? Santo gave the customer service we were going expecting!  5 minutes of Heaven.

RECAP
•	Had to ask over and over for simple things like hand/face towels
•	Hydroshower is a regular shower head
•	No Turn Down Service
•	Tipping really well does not make a difference
•	Room service = 90 min wait and cold food
•	Expect a horrible reception experience
•	Our “butler” didn’t know how to get our laundry pressed. 
•	Manana manana manana is when you will get an answer on something.  (Which means you don’t)
•	Expect to scan menu and then be told they don’t have what’s on the menu  
•	You can’t Even find something you like and just eat it on repeat because they may have it today but not tomorrow - but they might have it the next day or not
•	Having dinner and complementing the food because it’s “warm”  YEAH!  (“not necessarily good or great” is how you define your dining experience)
•	Royal service has been done away with
•	Presidential Suite does not equal Presidential service
•	Top shelf vodka = absolute 
•	All inclusive means a room, mediocre food, watered down drinks (e aren’t big drinkers so not that big of a deal to us but prob to others) and access to the ocean 

We will update this post as necessary

reviews.author: E M
reviews.title: Muy mal.
reviews.text:
Aquí hay que armarse de paciencia. Llegamos al hotel por la noche tras un largo vuelo. Nos pasamos la noche con el inodoro haciendo ruido. Al día siguiente no funciona, he tenido que hablar con todo el personal del hotel para que me arreglen el problema y cada vez me dicen que mandan a alguien. Solución… moverme a una habitación con dos camas en lugar de una… realmente agotador. 

Viajo mucho y Melia suele ser compromiso fiable pero esta vez no lo ha sido.

reviews.author: harveys2016
reviews.title: The Art of Deception… the Melia Way.
reviews.text:
Imagine arriving in a foreign country only to find the hotel you booked was closed and you were rebooked in another hotel without ever being told! Hard to believe? Not possible? Just 4 days prior to arrival, I received the following in an email from Melia: “….. we'll be waiting for you at the The Reserve At Paradisus Punta Cana on 14/02/2022.” But this hotel was closed for 3 months for renovations! Upon arrival in Punta Cana, we were sent to The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real. This mistake didn’t seem to bother management at all! 
Our family had stayed at Palma Real two years earlier (@The Level”). Melia’s  “shtick” is to cut costs by combining several classes of hotels on a very large property. To keep things orderly, guests wear wrist bands to manage where they can and cannot go, a class system with its own issues.
