Llame a atención al huésped  para ver se nos podían recoger a los que estábamos esperando y la respuesta de ellos fue. "Los carros son descubiertos, igual se van a mojar.... y entonces??? A sacarse los zapatos, mi mujer los tacos, los chicos las zapatillas y a mojarse! quiero aclarar que no pasa por MOJARSE, pasa por el abandono al HUÉSPED. Hay más pero voy a nuestro último día. Tema gua caliente, si uno se quería bañar pasada las 00 hs o antes de las 12 am solo tenía agua tibia tirando a fría. Para esto nos habíamos levantado a las 7am  para estar bañados y listos ya que a la 10 nos pasaban a retirar para llevarnos al aeropuerto. Llamo a atención al huésped, me dice que deje la ducha abierta por diez min hasta que empiece a salir, pasaron 15 min. y vuelvo a llamar, me dicen que me mandan un técnico, pasan 30min y nadie aparece. Vuelvo a llamar y me dicen que él técnico ya había salido. Luego de 40min viene el técnico, abre la canilla de la cocina, hace un poco de circo y desaparece dejándome con agua fría. 
Conclusión: no nos pudimos duchar y nos tuvimos que ir así. A la hora de hacer el check out le preguntamos en recepción donde nos podíamos contactar con el encargado y nos dijeron que estaba en una reunión y que LAS QUEJAS SE HACÍAN VÍA TRIPADVISOR, le preguntamos el nombre a la persona de recepción y no nos lo quizo dar. 

A DESTACAR: MARIÉ Y SUS COMPAÑEROS DE ROOM SERVICE  QUE NOS AGASAJARON TODAS LAS MAÑANAS . ELLA VERDADERAMENTE SE INTERESÓ POR NOSOTROS Y HACIA HASTA DONDE PODÍA Y MÁS!

Y DE CORTESÍA POR LAS QUEJAS QUE PRESENTÁBAMOS NO DIERON DOS VINOS CON SUS RESPECTIVOS DESTAPADORES, LOS MISMOS SE DEVOLVIERON A ATENCION AL HUÉSPED YA QUE NOS PARECIÓ UNA CARGADA. 

Nos hubiese gustado que el Sr Domingo Beltré (Guest Service Manager) se hubiese contactado con nosotros para brindarnos algún tipo de solución, pero eso nunca sucedió

reviews.author: vuhienngoc
reviews.title: Bad experience in Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
should not stay in this hotel/resort. 
We stayed in this resort from July 07,2019 until July 14, 2019
Staff is friendly but food in buffet restaurant is terrible
It was extremely hard to get a reservation the same day in the restaurants, other than the buffet. We're not sure why, as the restaurants usually seemed empty.
night entertainment is good.
no coffee maker in my room
no cable TV in my room
no mini bar in the room as advertised.

reviews.author: Florencia
reviews.title: Pésima atención en los restaurantes y mal servicio de limpieza
reviews.text: He estado en una estadía de diez días y he tenido muchísimos inconvenientes con la limpieza, estuve todo un día con la habitación sin limpiar no teníamos toallas para bañarnos ni habían hecho las camas luego de estar 4/5 horas afuera de la misma, lamentable de parte de un hotel de 5 estrellas. Otro problema que tuvimos fue que en los distintos restaurantes tuvieron una pésima atención hacia nosotros desde el momento que no nos prestaban atención al tomar las órdenes, no recargaban el agua y nos servían con desdén una pena verdaderamente.

reviews.author: Maria C De Pena
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Horrible experience. The food was cold, uncooked. I found cockroach in my room and the restaurant. The servers are friendly however the ladies dressed in black are extremely unfriendly. Reservations at the restaurant were a mess!!! The bathrooms were dirty. So many unhappy experience! I would NOT recommend.

reviews.author: jasmls12
reviews.title: July 2019 ..  hopefully updates to follow
reviews.text:
We have made this resort a regular part of our annual vacation planning over the last years and always enjoyed the property, people, food and particularly the extra amenities and services offered by the family concierge service.  

Unfortunately this year has been off to a bad start.  9 days before arrival we were informed our resort would be closed and they’ve shipped us off to another property.  They have not provided any details on the property, the rooms offered, or services offered in this new resort.  Most upsetting, the dedicated phone number and email established to address this ‘inconvenience’ all go unanswered and unreturned

With 5 days before departure now we are debating weather to roll the dice and see what we get when we arrive or cancel the vacation altogether.  

Very disappointed in the lack of professionalism (taking reservations for a property that is closed) and disrespect from this organization.

reviews.author: Daniela M
reviews.title: Não recomendo
reviews.text: Não voltaremos! Atendimento em geral muito ruim, desde a recepção até nos restaurantes, pouca atenção para com crianças e idosos! Tivemos problemas desde o check in com o quarto reservado até o último dia! Muito status e pouca qualidade de fato! Quarto limpo, hotel bem conservado, porém não vale o custo-beneficio!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Reserve at Melia Punta Cana
reviews.text: Stay away, everything was a disappointment. We arrived only to find our trip had been down graded and wanted to move us to another area. Spent one night at the resort and the room we were given was full of both live and dead bugs crawling on the bed and all the furniture, air vent full of mold and the lovely aroma of pesticide. They eventually moved us to the Palma Real which was better but no compensation or apology for a day and a half of lost vacation.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: I was so I'll (3 types of ECOLI)
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Reserve from June 6-9, 2019. Multiple people in our large group were very ill. On the 8th I began feeling very ill and I got progressively ill on the 9th traveling home. On the 10th, I was so sick that I had to go to the hospital. I just got my test results back which were positive for three types of ECOLI. No one seems to be able to return the travel agents call to resolve this problem. I only stayed at the resort and never left. I did not drink the water and did not drink any alcohol while there. I even used bottled water for brushing my teeth. It's clear that the safety procedures for handling food at this resort are very poor.

reviews.author: Dragon
reviews.title: Stay away, multiple illnesses
reviews.text:
My wife, young daughters and I vacationed here and regret ever going. My kids were extremely sick the entire trip... vomiting, fever, diarrhea, etc. My younger daughter remained sick for days after we got home and needed prescription meds. One of the scariest moments of my life seeing how sick she was.

Our experience, and the current headlines about DR resorts, should be enough to keep you away. But, in addition, the food was terrible. Also, mosquitoes attacked all of us and in fact, I had over 30 bites on one foot! Staff did not impress me except for one or two individuals. Most were not friendly and even argumentative. Totally miserable time. Nightmare vacation. Worst ever. And not cheap!

reviews.author: Debi H
reviews.title: We will not return to the Dominican Republic.
reviews.text: The service was very inconsistent. Vendors approach you on the beach constantly. The excursions booked through the hotel were a scam.  We enjoyed our time together as a family but will not return to the DR.

reviews.author: Don D
reviews.title: Worst Vacation Ever
reviews.text:
We have been to approx. 8 resorts and hands down this was the worst. I would not recommend going to this resort for the following reasons. 
1. Safe/lights/room card/telephone/fridge were not working when we checked in. It took 3 days to resolve all of these issues. 
2. This resort is all about up selling you. It took 45 mins to get into our room because she spent so much time going back and forth with the manager regarding up grades. In the end we paid $600.00 for them to shuttle us back and forth to another resort that had slightly better food. 
3. Staff stole my head phones. They have a turn down service which allows them to come into your room at night. This is random. It does not happen every night so I made the mistake of leaving my wireless beat headphone on the night table. They were gone when I came home that night. 
4. Food was cold, no variety. Same thing every night. Often food was burnt. Cooks would disappear for 5-8 mins at a time and create a long line up of people waiting to get food made. 
5. Buffet is the smallest I have seen out of the 8 resorts. 
6. They have a time share scam that they try to reel you into. Be careful, they say it will just be a few minutes of your time to talk about their new resort but they don't tell you what it is truly about. Thankfully we got suspicious when they had us sit down and start filling out information about our yearly salary, etc. and when we looked up people's comments, we realized it was going to be a 3 hour ordeal. 
7. No one to serve you drinks on the beach 
8. They have a tonne of people selling parasailing, jewlery, etc. which is common but at this resort there are 5X the people. In one day, I was approached by 14 people! It left me feeling uncomfortable and wary. I would spend my time avoiding them or thinking of ways to say no. They would sometimes try to guilt you out by saying they have had no sales and really need some help. 
8. I left my sweater on a chair in the lobby and within minutes is was gone and no one could tell me where it was. The staff had me going from one person to another for 5 hours, until finally they said someone stole it. No apologies or ways to try to find it. I finally got angry and asked to fill out a customer service card which spooked them and within 10 mins my sweater was found. 
9. When I complained to the manager, he did not even take the time to write any of my complaints down and tried to offer an upgrade, which I refused and then he walked away!

reviews.author: bernardojulian
reviews.title: Vacaciones arruinadas.
reviews.text:
Viajé tres veces a Punta Cana pero nunca la pase tan mal. 
Fuimos un grupo de 12 personas a festejar mi
Cumpleaños. Al tercer día 5 estábamos intoxicados y obviamente sin poder comer mas que arroz. Invito al Señor Gerente a ir a la habitación 1373 y abrir el grifo del agua del lado izquierdo y oler el olor nauseabundo que sale con el agua. También a recostarse al sofacama, una verdadera vergüenza el colchón de 5cm de espesor totalmente gastado clavandose el huésped los caños del sofá. En ningún momento nos repusieron el frigobar, y eso que lo solicitamos varias veces. El TV de la habitación principal nunca funcionó y la luz del area de yacuzzi no funcionaba (alli estan los placares y había que elegir a ciegas la ropa para ponerse de noche). Fuimos con Niños e infantes y todos los dias fuimos temprano a la playa donde las reposeras con mas cercanía al mar (ideales para ver los bebés dormir desde el agua) estaban reservadas hasta las 10am por el family concierge. Una vez pasado ese horario se podían ocupar, lamentablemente por viveza de los barman de la playa, quienes les ponían objetos perdidos y toallas encima diciendo que ya habían sido tomadas en el transcurso de la mañana (nosotros llegábamos 8:30/9) arreglando por propina con gente el día anterior para que estos puedan dormir mas y llegar 12pm. Todos los dias ocurrió lo mismo con una familia de vivos Argentinos. Una vergüenza total la falta de respeto hacia las madres y sus bebés. Me he hospedado previamente en el Paradisus Palma Real La Reserva y realmente ese es un hotel de categoría. Este hotel está totalmente en decadencia y lo único que les interesa es venderte hospedaje en el nuevo hotel Circle. Hemos esperando con los bebés hasta 20 minutos a pleno calor para poder tomar un pequeño bus que te acerca al mar. No hay restaurante para almorzar que no sea el buffet y ninguno de los dos cuenta con aire acondicionado. Comer con niños y bebés con 30 grados de calor y muchísima humedad es un calvario. Obviamente que todas nuestras quejas fueron respondidas con un “lo vamos a mejorar” al igual que responden cualquier tipo de post como el presente. Esto es para alertar huéspedes que paguen un poco mas y vayan a un hotel mejor y no en decadencia. Gracias

reviews.author: Ags7584
reviews.title: Horrible Baby Zone Experience
reviews.text:
First - if you are planning to travel w/out children feel free to skip on over. 

The GREAT - Upon arrival we requested to upgrade to concierge. They gladly honored at an add. $75 usd per night. Our concierge, Yarol Rijos, was a gem. Professional, tactful, caring and understood his job to the “T”. Any and everything we requested, Yarol was there for us and made sure it was done. The most valuable part for us (and the only reason we sought out the concierge) was being able to have one point of contact to handle EVERYTHING. We planned this trip 7 months in advance after months of research solely to celebrate our daughter’s first birthday and to try and take a relaxing family vacation after few major life events. We also traveled with our 2.5 year old son. Yarol made it so we didn’t have to make our al la carte reservations, book the Passion rest, seek out the private sitter or arrange the professional photo session. He also made sure that our room was cleaned exactly at the requested time and that any additional items we needed were available. On more than one occasion we saw others in our building in line to use the building concierge. It was wonderful to not have to do this and simply text Yarol and know it’s done. Yarol - you are an asset to the hospitality business. Hopefully your employer has rewarded you and commended your dedication to their product. Thank you for making our little girl’s 1st birthday special. 

The BAD - I could list everything but that would make us seem as if we are high maintenance. We are the furthest from this. That said I’ll keep these short. 
- ROOM was a tad dated. Shower jet flew off after one use and never worked after. Our stay of 9 days, 2 had zero hot water
- HOUSEKEEPING the worst we experienced anywhere. The bldg 39 maids literally took 1.5-3 hrs to clean a room. We have two little ones and they need to nap still. We were in our room a lot. It takes me 3 hours to clean a 5 bedroom house not sure what their deal is. 
- MOSQUITOES! Holy crap, there is a problem here. We’ve been all over the Caribbean, Asia, South America and pacific islands and live in southern Texas. We were eaten alive. This was our 9th visit to the DR. and first to this resort. Our worst case of mosquitos was not even half this bad. Our legs and arms looked like a case of measles or as another lady put, “Paradisus chicken pox” The problem is all the standing water. They have these “lovely” ponds (Paradisus side) with fountains but for whatever reason the fountains are off and the water is stagnant and filled with algae. This is also where all the al la carte restaurants are. These restaurant are all open air save but a few. They just swarm you to death. The Grill restaurant,  if they seat you outside, demand inside or leave. This was the worst spot. They sat us at the very last 4 seater table, next to water. Within seconds they swarm you. The remedy for this area was the hostess coming to each table and spraying you with OFF. Food or no food on the table. You could decline but not a single table did. We only saw a mosquito spraying truck twice our entire 9 day stay. Our usual resort did it daily at dawn and dusk. Bring hardcore bug spray + Benadryl + cortisone cream + few prayers. 
- RESTAURANTS - Food was good but found the selection extremely tiny and monotonous. The beach buffet was closed so we only had Gabi or venture to Naos and face the demonic mosquitos along the way. Breakfast was the same every morning except French toast might have fruit loops or might not... Again, our usual resort has a lovely big buffet with heated/carving stations and wonderful themed nights. Nothing like that here. Also brings us to their open air concept. We might be the only ones but after spending our entire day in the sun we want to shower and eat our dinner in a cool indoor area. Everything is open air or they keep the ac 3 degrees cooler. So we would start sweating and just get uncomfortable again. We found this annoying. Our kids found this incredibly annoying and nearly always became fussy. Vento is closed but the damn hostess kept propping the door open so it just got hot and low and behold the mosquitos were alive and present. 

Lastly, the ABSOLUTE reason for the 1 star.
The baby zone. This was the reason we booked The Reserve. All the wonderful reviews. What happened here? Our children’s first visit was lively and they were happy, a little sad when we left but normal since we leave them in a play-care here in the states. The next two visits were in the eve so we could eat in the open air restaurants. The second of these was when our children were more fussier than normal. We’d like to point out that Danyelsi (sp) was here this eve. Not a single smile from her, period. The other lady was charming and suited but Danyelsi was cold in demeanor. The last visit which was also on our last day, we arrived at 10, Danyelsi was her again along with Jack. We walked in and I enthusiastically greeted her thinking perhaps she had a bad evening the night before. She literally just stared at me and didn’t even look at my son. I saw Jack and he greeted us and smiled and chatted w/ my son then ran off to finish stocking up. As I was signing them in she pointed at the paper, tapping on it saying “where, where” somewhat aggressively with a disgusted look on her face. She was pointing at my daughters name. At this point I was a bit more assertive and explained she is right outside feel free to look and you’ll see my husband is changing her diaper. She peered over and just looked at the tv. My husband made it in, greeted her and kid you not she just stared at him and walked away. Jack finished at this point and came out and grabbed the kids, cheerfully and they went off into the baby zone to play. We thought they would be in there with Jack so that’s why we let them stay. 3.5 hrs later we go back to bring them lunch. My husband goes in and my daughter is In her stroller in the dining area crying and my son is running around with older kids. It looks like there is barely any supervision at this point. Thinking she is just a bit hungrier than usual my husband gets her lunch ready. He notices that Danyelsi immediately goes outside and Jack follows about 10 min later. MY HUSBAND WAS THE ONLY ADULT THERE AT THAT TIME. There were a total of 6 children, one of whom was bullying other children and all were running around together. My daughter was still upset when my husband notices her legs are wet. She had completely urinated herself. So much so that her clothes up her back were wet and the stroller was also saturated in urine. She was pushed up to the table so it was not noticeable. He immediately grabbed her diaper bag to count diapers. Neither her or my son had been changed. When he takes her to clean her up another employee arrives and he demands she call a manager     She in turn asks Jack to call. The manager arrives and immediately goes over to the employees to talk with them before even acknowledging my husband and daughter. When she finally comes over my husband is still trying to calm and feed my daughter and informs her “No, I need to take care of my child, I’ll meet with you and the GM at 4pm.” In the Lobby my husband is waiting for the Mgr & GM and after 10 min the Guest Relations Mgr, Carlos De La Garza. Is sent out. After going over all of this with him, he was sympathetic and listened well but simply provided a well scripted and rehearsed, almost PR-esque response with a whole lot of “we must investigate” thrown in the mix. He thanked my husband for bringing opportunity to his attention and this was the point my husband seriously almost lost it. There is room for opportunity with room cleaning, bar service, poor wait staff but there is no opportunity for OTHER PEOPLES CHILDREN. None whatsoever at any point. This has to be the most solid part of your operation. The fact that my 1 year old sat in her own urine for hours and no one even tried to see why she is upset scary. The fact that my son hadn’t drank any fluid is unacceptable. The fact that they had my little children meshed with older children because they didn’t want to sit in the baby zone and interact with them is unacceptable. I am appalled and heartbroken over this. I have no plans to visit this resort or this chain again. In fact, this is so upsetting we made this our 9th and final trip to the DR. We informed Mr. De La Garza that we’d leave a review as we are appreciative of those who do and feel this may be helpful to at least one person or family. He didn’t seemed bother by this. 

Icing on the cake, I got a bad stomach bug,  and needed medication. My husband and son both had sick stomachs.

reviews.author: Kingston
reviews.title: Misleading and outright dishonest
reviews.text:
We have been to Paradisus two years in a row, and loved it. We had a great time and planned to come back year after year. So when we naively went to the Club Meliá pitch, we were open to it because we had enjoyed our vacations there so much.
We were outright lied to, we specifically told them that we were not interested in a time share deal, not a problem this is access to one week a year at any of over 400 all-inclusive resorts. That is the first and biggest outright lie. It is access to 5-7 days at this resort each year. Oh and it is an all-inclusive resort, but you must pay a daily fee for the all inclusive part. That is on top of what you have already paid. We were promised a specific type of room as members, but that was a lie as well. In order to get the type of room that we were promised, there is an up charge.
These are just a couple of the lies we were told, I will not list them all but rest assured there were many.
The thing that truly indicates that this is a scam and known fraud within the Melia company is that whenever I complain or ask questions about why none of these things that I was told are true, the response that I get from everyone that I talk to is “did you read the contract?”
No one has ever said, I am sorry that you were mislead or misunderstood, let me see how I can make this right. Not a single person has attempted to make anything right. The only response that I get is, “did you read the contract?”
The Circle By Melia Club is an outright scam. If you go to this property, do not fall for the marketing ploy. If you do, there is a very easy way to tell when they are lying to you. Anytime their lips are moving they are lying.

reviews.author: Katerina
reviews.title: Family vacation went terribly wrong
reviews.text:
Our family of 5 (my husband, me and our three little children) traveled to Paradisus to celebrate Christmas 2018. We have paid over $9,000 for this trip which included 6 nights stay.
I will start from good things: the beach is nice and big for DR. The entertainment was fun. And the food at the buffet was really good. With the above we were ready to overlook that rooms are old needed TLC and that beach bathrooms are badly maintained and are running out of soap within the first two morning hours. So, for the first three days we were actually happy at Paradisus despite some things mentioned. 
Our troubles began on a third day. Or rather night. Our 6 year old child woke up with bad knee pain. The pain was so bad that the child could not move without experiencing sharp pain in her knee. In the morning my husband had to carry the child while I had to take care of two other children including 1-year old baby. I spoke to the nurse at the hotel and she recommended that we buy a painkiller and get a wheel chair. The hotel informed us that all of the wheel chairs were taken by the elderlies. It was very disappointing to hear that hotel does not have wheel chairs for emergencies. Our situation was getting worse and worse. Here, it is important to note that we had no clue what affected child’s knee. The child never had any joint problems and was absolutely healthy when we went to DR. She also did not injure herself while playing in Paradisus. At first we thought she fell asleep in uncomfortable position. However, the pain was too strong if she had to move her knee even tiny bit. So, we really needed that wheel chair while deciding what to do. After continuous requests, hotel finally brought us a wheel chair from local hospital that afternoon. It did not occur to us that the reason for our child’s strange sickness could be an infection as we never experienced anything similar before. So, for three more days we rolled our 6-year in a wheel chair which significantly affected her and our ability to enjoy our vacation. She was still in pain when moving and had to skip on absolutely all of the activities including meeting Santa who arrived by a helicopter on a Christmas Day. All we could do at that point is to eat and chill on the beach. We still enjoyed the buffet food. However, on the last night I decided to make a reservation at Vento, a restaurant located at Paradisus’ premises. Big mistake. The entire last night after this dinner I had to spend in the bathroom. I suspect that I have poisoned on cooked(!) salmon because the rest of the family ordered meat and did not suffer from food poisoning. Barely alive by the morning, I had to pack for our trip back, feed children and roll/carry two of them. I informed Paradisus guest services of my food poisoning just as we were leaving. Two days of my life were literally wasted because of food poisoning. Instead of feeling energized and happy after spending time at the beach, I’ve felt like I was run over by a track. However, if this would be the only problem, I wouldn’t be writing this review. My sick child’s knee felt significantly better on the first day at home. However, the following day she experienced just as debilitating pain in her OTHER knee. Our pediatrician immediately suspected an infection and sent us to ER. There we’ve spent the entire night of December 31st with my crying child. At the ER a variety of tests were performed. Initial blood test showed an elevated white blood cells level and an X-ray showed an effusion. Doctors suspected insect-born disease. Tests for Lime disease and Chickungunya came back negative. Unfortunately ER did not order Zika test. There was nothing a hospital could do for us other than to give painkillers to my daughter. So, we were discharged to be under our pediatrician’s watch. My formerly healthy and active child had to be carried still and suffered from really bad pain. We were in a state of shock not knowing what to do next. Luckily, the child gradually got better during the following week.
She still missed some school and other activities though. 
At that point I wrote an email to Paradisus about our ordeal and also attached child’s medical records from ER. It has taken Paradisus days to reply. In their reply they denied any liability because the reason for my child’s sickness is still unknown. In my opinion, there is definitely a negligence involved. Whatever the reason for the sickness was, whether a virus or a bacteria, the child would not get infected if not the negligence on the part of the hotel. Again, this is my opinion. 
Here, all of our family members including the baby had dozens of mosquito bites. I even suspected they were finding their way into our room through a ventilation system. This is not what one expects when heading to the beach. Perhaps the reason was the everyday spilling from decoration pool near our room which provided perfect breeding grounds for mosquitos. Hotel knew or should have known about dangers mosquitos carry in warm climates. One would expect that Paradisus by Melia which is among the most expensive hotels in DR would provide better treatment and protection to its guests. However, in our case they didn’t. We are never vacationing with Melia again.  
While the child is doing well now. We are still extremely concerned if her strange illness brought from DR has any long-lasting effects. 
I originally tried to post this review in a winter but for some reason it was not posted.

reviews.author: Courtney Theodo... K
reviews.title: So dissapointed. All the good reviews were only if you get “royal service” for $120 extra per day...
reviews.text: SO dissapointed with ALL of the staff here and this will be the reason we will never return. I booked it through Costco and will be asking them to remove it from their website as it not a good representation of who they are as a company. My boyfriend and I were treated HORRIBLY by 95% of the staff here. Getting any sort of service was an absolute chore and nightmare. Ex. Getting water in the buffet, ice or coffee.... a joke. The staff who is everywhere by the way is only there to socialize and is upset if godforbid they have to perform an actual task.

reviews.author: Voyager36844795610
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - Terrible for everything else
reviews.text:
Broken toilet, asked 3 times to get AC working before having to move rooms
an employee came into our room into the middle of the night
employees were rude to us
our assigned staff worker was unresponsive and even told us he left early the first day because he wanted to go party, and we were left high and dry

I could list 10 more things that went wrong....it was an overall terrible experience

reviews.author: Jou_Mo_Alv
reviews.title: The worst experience in Punta Cana
reviews.text:
I’ve been enjoying holidays in Punta Cana during the last 6 years. I come to Punta Cana 2twice a year and we have had some good experiences and some others were ok, with opportunity areas, but ok.
 
This time, in this hotel, by far it was the worse.
 
First is the scam: we were approached by the head of activities of the hotel (Jim) indicating that we have included a full day in the Brand new hotel - Grand Reserve Palma Real – because we did the booking directly in the Melia webpage… what a nightmare!
First we confirm on a Saturday at 8 am with Jim, with the reception and with the concierge. At 755AM we were in the concierge as agreed, and after 30 min waiting the concierge told us that the person in charge to bring us to the other hotel was waiting in the main reception. Once we arrive there, next surprise, the person was not there and the supervisor started to treat us as stupid people, saying that this visits always are at 9AM and the we should relax a take it easy. Then we questioned his unfortunately answer to us, telling him that this was the proposed time done by the hotel’s organisation, not by us. So if it true that this visit always start at 9AM why the hotel organised this at 8AM. It is a non-sense or you don’t respect the time of the guests. Then, he changed the argument saying that the person had a trouble with his car and this is the reason of the delayed.
 
Finally we let the hotel at 945AM and we arrived to the other hotel. They told us at that moment that we need to wait because they will communicate to us an important information and they need 45 min, we will be offered a special package of the hotel for the future. We had to stop this telling them that we are not coming to attend any sales activity for them to push a package to us. We came here based on the offer to have the full day in the other hotel and to continue with our vacations.
Terrible situation and very uncomfortable because they are wasting your time to enjoy your holidays.
 
On the other hand, every time that we requested for an information like the transport bus from our room to the beach, the standard answers were these 2: I don’t know or every 15 min, but we had to wait 40 min for this transportation. It is incredible the poor level of service in all areas (restaurant: very late coming with the beverage, cleaning the tables, etc). Honestly, the worse of the worse.
 
I don’t recommend at all this hotel

reviews.author: Glenn D
reviews.title: The reserve is lacking
reviews.text: Well we arrived late last night in 1411 and 1413 and I must say I’m underwhelmed. I’m trying to get adjoined rooms, no luck yet. I’m trying to get in touch with  my Concierge and Royal service , no luck yet and no one appears to speak any English and some seem a little surly. I’ll update in a couple days but I’m not impressed so far.

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: The Worst Exoerience of My Life
reviews.text:
2 minutes ago on  Google
This place is a disaster! The food is so bad you will probably lose 10lbs. You are trapped because there is no where else to eat without risking your life outside of the resort. There is so much more to say but it dreads me to think about it.

reviews.author: Ariele G
reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.text:
We are currently staying at this resort with our family of 5; everything about this experience has been subpar from the second we arrived. The check in took about 45 minutes - we were repeatedly told to “sit down” and someone would be with us. No one actually works at the front desk rather it’s a casual get to know opportunity. What!?! We just travelled six hours and just want to get into our hotel room!! We finally were checked in, after an annoying wait and more registration forms that needed to be filled out  - not even for the hotel but to be a member of Melia Rewards. It felt like a scam and we were resistant to fill out yet another registration (wouldn’t the hotel already have our address and phone number? Why do they need this info yet again?!) the “family concierge” is also less than acceptable. The language barrier is really difficult and much is left not understood. Reservations are blundered and times are messed up. Spring breakers are everywhere. Passing out on the beach, slurring their words as they walk by you. This is NOT a family resort - staying at the Reserve may make
 It marginally better but then you can’t even use the beach! You have heard about how gross the food is - it’s that bad. Inedible, and we are a foodie family who eats everything. I truly hope this vacation turns itself around - right now we just want to go home.

reviews.author: Marcos Mtz
reviews.title: Todo marchaba excelente pero terminó pesimo
reviews.text:
Quinta noche para finalizar la estancia y tienen un problema con el agua!! Desde las 00:50 hrs del sábado 9 de Marzo hasta las 4 am hora de nuestra salida rumbo al aeropuerto sin agua!! Qué les pasó? Son un excelente hotel magníficas instalaciones ... Pero me fallaron y más con su contestación.. no podemos hacer nada, mantenimiento se encuentra trabajando y le informaremos... Imaginen regresar el viernes noche de un paseo, llegar a cenar, hacer maleta y no hay agua!! Ni para el inodoro ni regadera, y teniendo que viajar de madrugada por más de 9 horas sin poder acearnos!!  

Hotel galardonado con múltiples premios de 4diamantes y aún así la respuesta a este problema fue deplorable.

reviews.author: mariafN9658HX
reviews.title: UNHAPPY CUSTOMER....FIRST AND LAST VISIT
reviews.text: Resort is very nice. However the rooms are very old...at least the two I visited were....the walls were chipping and broken, paint was terrible but worst thing was that the room smelled of urine and the sheets felt damp.  Its unfortunate that no one was willing to help make our stay better.  Therefore will never visit again...I literally cringe thinking about my stay.

reviews.author: aldaky
reviews.title: Not impressed at all
reviews.text:
Stayed at Paradisus Real and upgraded to the Royal service.. aside from the gentlemen servicing drinks on the beach who was good, the rest of the staff is unfriendly, uncooperative, not helpful at all. 
They kind of let you fend for yourself and are bothered when asked for help.
Food service is terrible, took us over an hour to get food at any restaurant, hibachi was closed on a Saturday night, buffet no one offered water, picks up plates on time..
There’s no music through out, no livelihood, shows at night are in random spots and you have to find them on your own, on a Saturday morning at 6am they start work on the coconut trees, workers screaming, talking, yelling, fighting with no regards for sleeping customers 
Overall the staff makes no attempt to be friendly or even speak a language other then their own 

Just terrible!! Never again

reviews.author: Jet12030043317
reviews.title: Worst 2 week stay ever. Night mare
reviews.text: This experience was horrible from the time there was no elevator to a 3rd floor room to the fleas and the toilet that didn't flush and the power that was off nearly as much as it was on to save energy. WOW

reviews.author: Robert J
reviews.title: Poor Customer Service/Theft
reviews.text:
I would not have written a review based on the sub-par food alone. Do not use guest services, one guest services representative alone caused us to waste hundreds of dollars and about 1.5 days of our vacation, I'm certain for her own financial gain. The worst part is her boss, Domingo Beltre, asked me to get in touch with him the next day, but he ignored us all day, the day before we left for home. We told guest services we wanted to scuba dive, we did not know they offered an easy and inexpensive package right at the resort, she proceeded to put us in touch with an outside person buy the name of Juana Carlos. He set us up for two dives at Catalina Island for $525.00, to be clear, we are not certified, we made this clear to guest services as well as Juana Carlos. This was expensive, but sounded awesome so we said yes. We were supposed to go on a Wednesday morning, it was supposed to take all day from 7am til 6pm. Tuesday night Juana told us that Scuba for Wednesday was canceled. We rescheduled for Thursday. Wednesday night he text us to tell us it was canceled again, however then was able to get us in, telling us we would still go to Catalina. Thursday morning we met our shuttle, without a clue as to where we were going. It stopped in a random location where I met someone to swipe my CC, then we proceeded to drive to a small village about an hour away, were we did the Padi class (to be expected) then went out to do a single dive right off shore. The dive was great, but it was not two dives at Catalina Island. This entire process took from 7am til about 4pm, we could have done this at the resort in half the time for half the money. Upon our return, I asked Juana Carlos for some money back as we did not do two dives at Catalina, we did the class and one dive, he refused. I talked to the guest services supervisor Domingo, he assured us he would get us some spa package the following day, he ignored us the entire day. Very poor service I would say. On top of all of this, on Wednesday we wanted to go to fleet market and shop, the same guest services rep that sent us with Juana Carlos, I'm sure to her profit, sent us to a little mall with museum, hardly any shopping we wanted to do there, we ended up paying for a cab to take us to a fleet market that was 5 minutes from our resort. Again, very disappointing. We will not return to this resort, it is unreal they would first off take our time, our money, but then not step up when things are not right.

On top of all of that, there are people constantly bothering you on the beach trying to sell bracelets, cigars, meets with monkeys and other things. It is non-stop... Never seen this at an all inclusive.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.title: Servicio avergonzante - lugar terrible
reviews.text: Muy indignante la forma de comportarse de los directivos de este hotel. Me cobraron descaradamente de mas en mi reserva y me tuvieron hasta el ultimo dia de mi estadia dandome largas para reembolsarme el importe  pagado de mas. En definitiva  arruinaron mis vacaciones. El hotel esta bien ubicado pero las habitaciones son antiguas y poco higienicas, el olor a humedad es asqueable. Fue lo peor de nuestras vacaciones.

reviews.author: DEEP R
reviews.title: 5-star hotel with a 3-star experience
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel Room 3825 from Feb 10-15, and were totally disappointed. After reading other "great" reviews, I am skeptic if they have double standards on how they treat their guests. This was our first "all-inclusive" vacation and our first "5-star" experience and sadly it was disappointing. For the price we paid, we would have rather stayed in a affordable hotel, since we had better experiences in a lower star hotel.

To start with,  the main problem with this hotel is language. We don't speak Spanish, and trying to get help was difficult. Most staff, here either speak no English or some English. The Front Desk staff we found to be most rude. We arrived here after a 10 Hr journey with a one year old kid and extremely tired. We could not understand his English and had to ask him to repeat, and as he repeated he got more rude. We asked what services and facilities does the hotel provide, as well as for infants. And all he was stuck with repeating the "free" food and "free drinks, and that's all. We asked if we could get tour of the hotel to see what the hotel has to offer, and again rude response, that it's all inclusive - "free" food and "free" drinks.  After that he went on explaining the charges -medical services, premium drinks, room services, bla, bla. It almost felt like he was doing a HUGE favor to us and totally felt un-welcomed. O, and also even seeing us with a kid - and a stroller, he gave us a room on a 2nd floor with no elevator. For the checkout we had the same problem as well, our 1 year old son got sick with 103+ fever, and I went to request for a late checkout so that he could rest a little. The front desk person had no concern and did not care at all. He wanted us to checkout at the set time of 12, after what I felt like after "begging" he gave us 50 more minutes to stay in the room . Being disappointed, we left the room at the actual checkout time with our sick kid. 

We stayed for 5 days, and I still have NO clue on what drinks they serve. We were totally new to the Caribbean culture and had no clue what drinks they had to offer. At least at 3 instances or more, I went to the bar and asked them what they have to offer for drink or if they could recommend some. All they kept repeating back is "what do you want ?". Sometime it does feels little embarrassing with other guests looking at you, and you have no clue what drinks they offer or what to get and they rudely keep repeating what I wanted, when I didn't knew what they have. 

The hotel has No what so ever activities/event . At least after staying for 5 days, we had NO clue what the hotel has to offer. We saw some decoration on the valentine's day, but I guess that was all we saw. And if they had any activities/event in the hotel, they made no effort to let their guests know, no hint nothing. Probably if you spoke Spanish you could figure out some, but our "5-star" experience was limited to a nice-looking hotel and "free" buffet food and "free" restaurants food as well as the beach. Only good thing about this place is Good-looking Hotel and Good food at the buffet. There are some staff who are friendly and nice, and we felt they should have been in the front desk, rather than serving food or cleaning tables. 

If I had known that's all they had to offer, I would have not spend extra $$$ for this expensive resort and could have booked somewhere else. 

Also, The Hotel coupons/vouchers are pretty much worthless. It's like they give us $1000 or something with hotel credits, but you have to spent $10,000 or so, it use those credits. It's like, buy something for $100 and get $10 off types.

Total disappointment for the money spent. More than the money, the feeling of being un-welcomed is what we didn't like at all. Will not/never stay again at this place.

reviews.author: Patricia C
reviews.title: Horrible!!
reviews.text:
Mi esposo reservó en la zona Royal habitación con jacuzzi y todos lo que eso conlleva, al llegar más tarde de lo habitual pensaron que nos daríamos cuenta que nuestra habitación se la dieron a otro huésped, son tan brutos que me dan el sobre con la reservación del que siiiii tenía mi habitación. Para colmo me dan una habitación con dos camas juntas, me cambian a una que si tiene cama king size pero igual demasiado dinero para tan poco glamour. 
Son tan descarados que después que nos ofrecen desembolsar o hacernos sentir bien por su falta. El gerente de la noche se puso de tú a tú con mi esposo, buscando el cancelar porque ahí ellos defenderían su causa!! 
No vuelvo ni que el dueño nos invite!!  
Muy mala experiencia

reviews.author: Jodi D
reviews.title: Worst resort! Save your money!
reviews.text: Was so excited to check out this hotel after a wonderful experience at The Level at the Melia Caribe Tropical. The Reserve at the Paradisus is also a Melia property but that is where the similarities end. The Reserve is a joke and a way to charge you extra. No special anything!! A room that has a sofa is basically the only perk. No butler service, no top shelf liquor no private pool at the beach,! Dinner reservations never honored, and all you get is excuses and please eat at the buffet. The buffet is awful! Everyone pretends to care and all they do is pass the buck over and over. The supposed Manger wouldnt even tell us when the hotel manager would be there! She flat out refused to provide us with a time that we would be able to meet with the manager. They offered us to go to restaurants that we didn't like, apparently neither did anyone else hense the availability! They continued to lie to us trying to get us to be quiet about the terrible experience. Trying to go home early! Save your time and money!!

reviews.author: Wanderer
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text:
I never write bad reviews, but this place is ridiculous. I am very surprised it has so many good reviews. 
- Terrible food
- mediocre service, even as a Royal Service guest 
- power and water went out multiple times during our stay 
- toilet didn’t flush half the time
- got sick from food and this never happens, I have traveled all over the world 
- weak watery drinks with crappy liquor 
I would not come back to this hotel and don’t recommend.  I paid a lot of money and the extra to upgrade to Royal Service and it is not worth it. 
I am completely disappointed in this hotel. I have stayed at many other Meliá resorts and this one is terrible.

reviews.author: Michael N
reviews.title: POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: My wife and I were confirmed for a stay at the Paradisus Palma Real and wanted to upgrade to the Royal Service room category.  We also noticed that there was a special offer for resort credits and complimentary RT airport transfers so this made it all the more important.  After trying for three days to upgrade on the final attempt I called in on 2/6/19 at 6:09pm EST and spoke to the gentlemen in reservations who started to look into our upgrade.  He hung up mid stream and when I called back immediately, I was told reservations was closed.  I was sooo frustrated with this lack of customer service and attention to a customer trying to pay the hotel more money and we hadn't even checked in as yet.  Why would I stay here based on this weak customer service - I cancelled our reservation and booked at a competing property, received resort credits, free RT airport transfer and a better room with Ocean view and paid less!!!

reviews.author: Travel63519418487
reviews.title: Over Priced.
reviews.text: A beautiful, over priced hotel which serves high school cafeteria food buffet style.  Some of the rooms don't have hot water in the shower and are in disrepair. The all you can drink drinks are sugary concoctions made with cheap booze in your own coffee travel mug if you bring your own.  The House/ Club/Moby-type music plays loudly until 1am.  If you're looking to super size yourself on cheap food and booze and pay huge sums of money doing it, this is your place.  If you want quality, go somewhere else.

reviews.author: J6453FNtraveller
reviews.title: Avoid nightmare. Stay somewhere else
reviews.text: Stayed in All-Inclusive resorts 7 times. Twice in Paradisus. DON'T STAY IN THIS HOTEL.  ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE!  Were told all restaurants were full on Christmas Eve.  Thought we could go to the buffet restaurant. Said it out loud to the woman who made reservations.  She did not say a word. Buffet restaurant closed when we arrived because there was a big Christmas dinner for most guests in the conference hall. Were not told when making dinner reservations for entire stay. Went to Christmas dinner place and could not eat there because we did not have reservation. Know Christmas or New Year dinner is a big feast, but willing to give it up.  HOW DARE PARADISUS STAFF KNOWINGLY LET GUESTS (MANY) GO HUNGRY ON CHRISTMAS EVE!  Many services and physical appearance problems with this hotel. Glass door to the toilet was broken - unsafe. Wooden door to the hallway cracked everywhere. 1/2" gap. Picture on the wall is white because color has faded away. It seems employees are not happy working there.  Don't help each other to make guests enjoy their stay. Restaurant waiters/waitresses use your tables as workstation.  Put clean silverware, glasses, and cups on your table and constantly retrieving them for other tables while you are eating. Tables are used as waiter workstation because there is no place for clean utensils.  Workstations only large enough to keep 3 water bottles instead of water pitchers. Kitchen too far away to walk. Complaints documented & given to hotel management - Resolution not satisfied. Met some good restaurant staff, of course we tip! Stay in Royalton 12/2017.  Much better hotel and services. Have never written review before. Really angry!

reviews.author: Наталия
reviews.title: Самые ужасные 5 звёзд
reviews.text:
Первый раз пишу отзыв, но как говорится «накипело». Отель уровня 3* Азии. Внешне все симпатично, но когда зашли в номер были в ужасе- номер старый, на вид годов 90х. Сейф не работал, Часы, свет в спальне, весы так же отказывались нам служить верой и правдой. Ручки почти на всех дверях болтаются на « честном слове». Вентиляция шумит так- что не слышно собственных мыслей. Грязь и разруха вот все впечатления от Номера. Мы были с ребёнком, Постельное белье которому пытались получить 5!!! часов!!! И звонили и приходили и вылавливали горничную- бесполезно. Пока уже на скандал им не закатили ничего не изменилось. Море грязно или водоросли или водоросли и всякий мусор. Питание на 3+, на третий день уже надоедает. За пару дней до отъезда отравилась в их японском ресторане, что с кровати не могла встать. Сотрудник отеля порекомендовала купить на рецепции местные таблетки, сложилось впечатление что это стандартная ситуация. За время нашего отдыха в отели отключили свет и не работали рестораны, вернувшись с экскурсии не было возможности даже накормить ребёнка, только бары были готовы к такому отключению.
Все наши поломки мы передали нашему тур оператору в тч о чем он подробно написал в отель и приложил фото, после этого письма (спустя 4 дня) к нам пришли ремонтники и починили одну ручку на двери ( это было б смешно, если не было так грустно) остальное все так и осталось не тронуто.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: House of cards
reviews.text: We have been to over 15 countries hundreds of trips and this is the worst one yet.  Beautiful from the exterior but so many things were terrible.  Most things didn't work properly - toilet, TV, blinds, etc.  food sanitary conditions were terrible. Many people got very sick. Wedding party got sick, business people got sick, vacationers got sick. Can not believe it had good reviews since our and so many others experience was just the worst.

reviews.author: Margo L
reviews.title: Worst Vacation of my life
reviews.text:
We (Me and my son and daughter) just returned from a 5 day stay at this resort.  We stayed in a luxury junior suite.  While the exterior of the resort is very well maintained, I wish I could say the same for the interior of the room.  The toilet didn’t flush and they keep sending people to fix it.  The minute they left it stopped working again.  It took two long days and four repairmen to finally get it fixed.  The shower was filthy and the water trickled out of the shower head.  The room itself was large but I would guess it hasn’t seen a renovation in 15 years.  I tried to call the manager to discuss this with him/her but the call went unanswered. The pool isn’t heated and the water is really cold.  The 
water by the beach is filled with seaweed and so is the shore.  The only reason I gave it one star was I liked the bartender by the pool and the food in the restaurants with the exception of the buffet was good.

reviews.author: luis v
reviews.title: El peor buffet del caribe
reviews.text:
Desde hace 10 años pasamos las navidades (semana  Fin de año ) en el caribe, las 7 últimas en punta cana en distintos resorts.
Escogimos este hotel tras haber tenido una experiencia magnífica en el melia caribe the level. siendo hoteles de la misma cadena y este siendo superior nuestras expectativas eran altas. También se debe tener en cuenta que son las 2 semanas mas caras del año donde el precio por persona puede hasta triplicar los precios pagados en verano ... vamos que hemos pagado un pastón
.
Ahora el resumen:

1º llegamos a las 11:03 P.M a un hotel que sabe a qué hora aterriza tu avión y la recepción VIP ... por la que pagas.. te dice que cierra a las 11, da vuelta a la llave de la puerta y que te vayas a la otra recepción a hacer el check in... los ojos se te salen de las orbitas, pero estas de vacaciones, tragas saliva por los niños.. 10 clientes (4 niños agotados) a cargar las maletas en un trenecito y cambiar de edificio...  luego trenecito de vuelta a tu recepción... en españa hasta en un hostal te esperan a que llegues del areopuerto.

2º cenas, todo el día hablando de la experiencia gastronómica que ofrecen ... cenar 10 es cosa imposible, es necesario reservar en los restaurantes y es todo un infierno.. horas para organizar cenas... venimos  a que nos lo den todo hecho no ha hablar con gente que es incapaz de resolver nada. 

hemos cenado en 3 de los restaurantes acabamos el resto de noches en el buffet.

Restaurante Fuego: después de horas de gestión de la reserva ... literales. conseguimos reserva para los 10, llegamos al restaurante y sorpresa... no tienen reserva, no cenan.. vergonzoso, mi hermano y su mujer se marchan y a  nosotros tras 20 minutos nos pasan a un restaurante a medio gas... increíble, nos montan un pollo por error suyo cuando tienen hueco para 100 personas... la comida, los platos de sushi decentes el resto no valía nada,  un 5 pelao.

Restaurante Martín Berasategui: Si martin ve la sardinita que te ponen en la interpretación del emblemático salmonete con sus esquemas.. les da garrote en la cabeza...6 cm de lomo de salmonete no lo he visto tan pequeño en mi vida.
Por cierto este hay que pagarlo y apenas te descuentan 20 $ por estar alojado con todo incluido.. otro detalle, llegamos y nos pasan una fotocopia con el precio modificado porque esta semana que pagas 3 veces más, también tienes que pagar más por el menú... y no lo tienen ni impreso. La comida de 5 siendo generoso.

Restaurante Grill: cena especial de nochevieja.. sin duda la peor cena en restaurante de mi vida... 3 entrantes y un principal, los 2 primeros entrantes indescriptibles.. se volvieron a cocina igual que llegaron y el principal, un mar y montaña (cola de langosta congelada pasada por la plancha al mediodía y un filete gordo carbonizado y doblado para parecer un taco de solomillo acompañado de patatas asadas frías). No se merece ni el cero.

Buffets: Son pequeños por lo que las opciones son menores de las que estás habituado en el caribe.
los desayunos son correctos, parecidos a otros hoteles del caribe de INFERIOR CATEGORÍA.
Comidas y cenas pobres en variedad y calidad.. pescados de rio de 2 duros mero que es panga, tilapia... calamar.. todo cutre con poco atractivo, un 5 estrellas de lujo comiendo pollo frito, arroz y hamburguesa… y comer a la carta en el restaurante Gabi de the reserve no se puede, melia en el level además de tener un buffet mejor el mismo gabi te permite pedir desde un solomillo a una langosta.. aquí solomillo, chuleta, langosta, tienen suplemento en todos los restaurantes que lo tienen que son pocos ya que dicen tener veda de langosta… bfbfbffff

Instalaciones: las habitaciones son grandes y están muy bien (calcadas a las del level de melia) pero tuvieron el detalle de darnos 3 en la 3º planta sin ascensor y una en la primera.. sumado a la nefasta comida debemos haber adelgazado estas navidades.

Las piscinas y jardines están impecables, otro pero.. Te dejan tantas toallas como desees que a priori es un lujazo pero se traslada en falta de tumbonas porque la gente ocupa todas las tumbonas con toallas que no usan y no hay nadie que recoja las toallas OLVIDADAS.
Transporte a la playa.. otro 0, pagas mas para estar lejos de la playa con unos trenecitos que pasan cuando les da la gana... en el level también estas mas lejos pero tienes servicio a petición.

Y para acabar Ryan air de mesas para la fiesta de noche vieja.. no daba crédito ponen mesas por los pasillos de la recepción previo pago de botella de moet por cada 2 sillas a 200$ … ni bolsa de cotillón ni donde sentarse si no pasas por caja… una mierda pinchada en un palo. Por supuesto el late check-out previo pasa por caja.

Lo único que funciona bien es el servicio de bar tanto en piscina como el la playa y hay que reconocer que había música en directo agradable todos los días. vamos dedicate a la  piscina, piña colada, patatas fritas, manises unos bailes y a la cama… el resto dieta.

La diferencia con el level es tan grande que el segundo día pedimos cambio de hote al level que es más barato pero todo pegas, no nos lo hacían, teníamos que gestionarlo todo nosotros con la agencia española  siendo sábado 29 de diciembre hacer la gestión desde allí… todo lujo de facilidades y ganas de agradar.

reviews.author: Tejas P
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
Customer service is horrible. Food is not great and restaurant reservation system sucks. They tell you that you have reservation and once you go there, restaurants refuse to serve you saying no reservation.  It happened to us twice in four days. Rooms are not cleaned, door locks are jammed. Even key swipe shows green light, you can't open the door. Customer Service is useless. We booked for golf..They told us that we will be picked up from main lobby at 3.50.  We were there at 3.45 and waited until 4.10. When we went to customer service and asked about pick up they said bus came and go. We were waiting at door and no one informed us that the bus came. We can not go and ask every incoming vehicle that if they are coming in to pick us up for golf. 

Food was not cooked up properly. Pasta were dry and hard. Not much variety either. Would not recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Dan V
reviews.title: Cockroaches and Mosquitos in room!!
reviews.text: Brought my family since it was supposed to be a 5-star all-inclusive resort, but as soon as I entered the room, I found the room infested with mosquitos. I called the reception to fumigate the room and they never send anyone, I had to follow up twice. Then, while falling asleep I saw 2 giant cockroaches on top of my blankets! I talked to the reception supervisor to change rooms and she wanted to downgrade us without refunding the difference. After 6 hours of arguing and “please come back later”, they gave us another room. AVOID THIS RESORT AT ALL COST. THE WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE AND CLEANING CONDITIONS THAT I HAVE EXPERIENCED EVER.

reviews.author: Go56863292721
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY AT THIS RESORT
reviews.text: Although the property is very nice my family of 8 has never been so sick after eating the food. We needed to check out 2 days early due to the sickness and the resort would not comp us nay money back. I caution anyone from staying at this resort

reviews.author: Departure05389916629
reviews.title: Un desastre viejo tremendamente caro
reviews.text: Un hotel antiguo, con muy mal servicio. Hay que quejarae de todo... y asi y todo no arreglan nada. Lo unico bueno: Luis el camarero de la playa. Muy majo y eficaz, lo que demuestra que el buen servicio es posible

reviews.author: MSkinner1983
reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text: Our family of 12 stayed at this resort during Christmas week.  A month prior to arrival, my husband tried to book dinner reservations with Elias from Restaurant Reservations.   He assured us that he could accommodate us.  My husband sent many emails confirming this with our restaurant choices each night, but Elias never confirmed them.  Upon arrival, we met with him, and he told us that the resort was busy and, unfortunately, no reservations were booked.  We were told that we would have to check in at the restaurant reservations desk every day to make our dinner reservations.  My sister and I everyday, twice a day, went there to book our reservations in the morning and then came back after 4 pm to confirm them.  We were told many times that the restaurants were booked only to find passing by them at night that they were empty.  We believe that tables were set aside for VIP members or Royal Service guests, which we were not.  The restaurants were very small.  They need to expand them or add more.  Nobody wants to go to the buffet every night!  Also, upon arrival, we were surprised to be given a concierge, Xavier (probably because my husband was checking in and paying for four rooms on one credit card).  He immediately took us for a tour of the property and invited us to a special breakfast the next morning in the VIP section.  My husband was skeptical, but I went with my sister and her husband.  The whole thing turned out to be a set up to get us to join as Circle members.  The “fantastic” lunch at the Reserve lunch place, Fuegos, was mediocre at best.  They golf carted us to the Circle resort for a sales pitch and wanted us to sign papers.  When I said I needed to speak to my husband regarding this, Abraham, the rep who took us, suddenly became less friendly.  Unless you are Royal Service or a VIP member, there is only one pool that you can use and a small section of beach.  You also can’t go to certain bars.  You couldn’t swim in the pool, as it was freezing.  There was also a bad sewer like smell at the pool and throughout the resort.  The seaweed was also bad at the beach, as well as the people trying to sell you things or get you to go to the shopping area.  We would go out at 8:00 in the morning, and all of the pool side chairs were “saved” with towels.  It was ridiculous, as nobody was sitting in the chairs for hours, but the towels were there.  They also ran out of towels a couple of days.  We had issues with our rooms...clogged showers and sinks, as well as a thermostat that did not work.  We also weren’t aware that there was no elevators in the buildings where we stayed.   We were traveling with two children and had to carry baby strollers up flights of stairs.  The maid service was very friendly, but it was very hard to get washcloths.  The wine selection was very poor.  There was no Chardonnay nor Pinot Grigio, and the mixed drinks seemed very watered down.  The service at the buffet was not very good.  I had to ask three waiters one day for a tea bag because they had no idea what I was talking about!  It seems to me that all the positive reviews on TripAdvisor for this place are from Royal Service guests or VIP members who have butlers or concierges setting up their beach chairs and serving them drinks and catering to them with excellent service.  We did not have that and felt like second class guests!  We will not be returning!

reviews.author: GregNYC2
reviews.title: Disgusting rooms and terrible experience
reviews.text:
FULL DETAILS BELOW

Disgusting rooms infested with ants
Mold covered shower
Ran out of chairs and towels at pool
Freezing pools
Stupid dinner reservation system (in person)
Ponds and walkways smell like sewage
Intentionally rude staff
Operational incompetence
Mediocre food

This is my third time at a Melia resort and it is my last. This place absolutely sucks. Do not stay here. It just sucks. We just finished our third night here and unfortunately have one more night to go before we can get out of here. The positive reviews on here must be from staff members and their friends, not real guests. 

Where do I start? The mold and ants in the bathroom. Let’s start with the mold and ants in the bathroom. We are staying in a “luxury junior suite” for which we paid $1,100/night. Our shower is COVERED in mold (see pics). It’s literally everywhere. On the floor, wall, door, ceiling, faucet. Everywhere. I am trying to shower as little as possible because it’s disgusting in there. I guess the fact that one night there was no hot water or water pressure for the shower helped in that regard. The sink is covered with tiny little ants. We had to wipe them off the tip of my kids toothpaste tube. Everything about the room feels dirty and dingy. We asked for a new room but they are sold out. I should mention that our “luxury junior suite” was in a different building, on the third floor, without an elevator. My kids managed the stairs. But wouldn’t you think they’d tell you that booking? In case your kids can’t do two flights of large stairs multiple times per day?  

The pullout couch absolutely is horrendous. You can feel bars running underneath the disgusting mattress. I feel guilty for my 6 year old son having to sleep on it. 

Our first morning we went to the pool at 8am. No chairs left, even though the pool was totally empty. Literally every chair was “taken” (ie someone put a towel or their stuff on it to hold it). We found a pool with some empty chairs so I went to get towels. Turns out there’s only one place to get towels and it’s all the way in the far back right end of the property. This pool was all the way on the left side. Literally a 10 minute walk back and forth across the entire property just to get towels. Only then do we learn that this pool is for “reserve access” meaning you have to pay extra to use it. We have two young kids and need chairs at the pool to sit at and put our stuff down on, so we basically were forced to pay an extra $70/night. And one time the towel hut had no towels. Sorry. We ran out. No towels. At a beach resort. 

Pools are absolutely freezing. My kids who are normally totally immune to cold pools, didn’t want to go in. 4 days in the DR and I haven’t been swimming once because the pools are unbearably cold. 

Our “reserve access” gave us access to the pools at the reserve area, including the kid zone, so we went there. It’s a 20-25 minute walk with kids (15 for an adult). After lunch, I went to the lobby to call to make dinner reservations (you need reservations for the restaurants). This is where you start realizing that the guest experience here is stupidly designed and extremely frustrating. Reservations MUST be made in person at the buffet and only during certain hours. You can’t call - that would make too much sense - you must go in person. Did I really want to leave my family to spend 30 minutes walking back and forth to make reservations? No. So I waited until we were ready to leave the pool and went to make reservations when we got back at 2pm. Guess what? Everything fully booked. No availability. Sorry. Nothing but buffet for you. 

Yesterday morning I wasn’t going to force my family to eat at that buffet again for dinner, so I went to make reservations for tonight. There was a 30 minute line - see attached pic. The whole thing is ridiculously frustrating. This entire place is run like it’s owned by people that have never operated a resort before. You should be able to reserve by phone (or even better with an app) - but why make things easy and relaxing on vacation? Instead you must allocate a chunk of time during your morning/day to make a dinner reservations. 

Our first morning when we were going to the pool, my wife went with the kids to buy sunscreen at the hotel store. She tried to charge it to our room. They said we needed to open a credit account. I thought we had done that when we checked in and they took my credit card. But apparently you need to ask them to add credit to your room. So I went to the front desk to add credit. They said they couldn’t use the card swipe they took at check in and needed the card. So I had to trek back to my room to get the credit card. It took 45 minutes to get sunscreen. 

On the way from our room to the main pool and beach are landscaping ponds. They literally smell like sewage. Like actual sewage. Our walk to breakfast and the beach every morning smells like human sewage. Yesterday a large puddle appeared in the grass and onto walkway. It hadn’t rained. And it looked brown like sewage. Can’t imagine it was anything other than a pipe leaking human sewage that was blocking our path?

Yesterday one of the staff members was walking around advertising for their new sister property next door, Circle. He offered us a day pass to go there and added our name to a list. We took a golf cart over to the Circle (10 min ride). Went to reception and said we were on the guest list with a day pass. Reception sent us to the business center. Business center sent us back to reception. Reception had us wait 15 mins and then asked us if we had a pass from the person who booked us. We said no and that he wrote our details on a list. She said she would need to call back over to our hotel and find the guy and have him send over a form. As in physically bring over a form. Who knows how long that would take. So we left. The entire thing wasted an hour of our morning. 

Some staff are friendly, some are intentionally rude, just about all are not competent. We had to ask our waiter four times this morning for water for our kids at breakfast. My son kept complaining he was thirsty. Sorry buddy - no water for you. At New Years dinner, there was a set menu and a set vegetarian menu. At dinner the waiter gave our table of 8 one paper copy of the regular menu. I asked for the vegetarian menu for my wife. He gave me a paper copy in Spanish. I asked for an English version and he said there wasn’t one. I told him I saw an English version in the front of the restaurant and he said no, there isn’t an English version. So I got up and walked to the front of the restaurant and took a picture of the English version to bring back to the table to show my wife so she could order.  We also asked for the kids menu. He said it’s only chicken nuggets. I said they were vegetarian and he said there’s only chicken nuggets. We asked someone else and got them pasta. I want to say it’s just incompetence. But given their attitudes, I’m certain it’s intentional. 

The food is generally pretty bad (maybe dinners in the restaurants are better - we wouldn’t know). The wine they serve is just terrible. There’s only one beer, Presidente (picture paying more than Ritz Carlton prices and the only beer choice is Coors Light). 

Francklyn at the front desk has been very friendly dealing with my complaints and trying to find us a different room. But there’s not much he can do. He said he will try to switch us to another room but it will be the same type in the same building so it will be no different. 

I’d be disappointed if I was paying a few hundred dollars per night for this. But at $1,100 per night ($1,200 after factoring in “reserve access”) which is more expensive than a Four Seasons or Ritz Carlton, it’s pure robbery.

reviews.author: JackClark
reviews.title: WORSSSSSTTTTTT NEW YEARS EVE PARTY!!!!!!!! AND FOOD SUCKS!!
reviews.text:
this place sucks. the food sucks and worst part was that i couldn't get any champagne for the new years eve countdown. how horrible to pay 15k+ on a vacation and nobody was passing champagne. typically in the "real" resorts in the dr, the bartenders usually walk around handing out the champagne. it was just my luck that i had nothing to toast or  drink during the new years countdown. i went to the one bar available to ask for champagne and no bartender served me.  i asked about 5 different bartenders and nothing! the only thing they did well was sell the champagne "bottles" and "seats" to make money off. so if you wanted to sit down, you needed to pay for that too. there were at least 10-20 frustrated guest that couldn't get any champagne either and expressed how horrible it was to not be able to sit down. Worst new years party, service, bartenders, and food sucks in genera!! Great job upper management for not knowing how to throw a new years party. go to another resort for a better new years party, food, and better quality rooms. I expected better from this place after traveling 9 hours from europe. Nothing but a nightmare! 

FYI - nothing that this management response with in regards to my expereince will fix/change what happend. the damage has been done and this place suckkkkkkssssss!

reviews.author: Fred Ha
reviews.title: bad experience during the holidays
reviews.text: We had a family trip during Christmas arranged by American Express travel. We had a bad experience there; most was due to the food poisoning of three of our family members. The food in general was not good except the hibachi restaurant and there was very high recycling of the old food between restaurants which was very obvious. The service was also very poor for what was supposed to be a luxury resort. The staff speaks very poor English. We stayed at The Reserve which was a little far from the beach and if you have kids it would be a problem since their shuttle system was not very prompt and there was no organization for it. There was no special arrangements for Christmas Day in the restaurants but they offered extra activity for extra charge which was very expensive.

reviews.author: Emily O
reviews.title: The Worst Service
reviews.text:
Pretty place, but wow... have never experienced worse service. Maybe it's because it was so busy during Christmas time, but the service was extremely lacking. It would take 15 minutes and multiple requests every morning just to get water or coffee. At night, there would sometimes be no host/hostess at the stand outside the restaurant to handle the reservations. It just seemed to be overbooked/understaffed. 
There was also a shortage of towels every day at the pool. Come on, you should not be running out of towels daily. 
I think since everything is all inclusive and there is therefore no tip incentive for the workers, they have low motivation and little drive to go above and beyond. Will not be returning here anytime soon.

reviews.author: Chierdoc
reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
We are staying there in 2 wks and there is no email to ask the hotel questions. I am trying to figure out transportation from the airport to the hotel and vice Versa for our departure but there is no way to contact the resort other than calling. I already got charged $20 for booking this over the phone even though it advertised itself as a customer service number. 
So if anyone knows an email to email the resort and also advice on setting up transport please let me know.

reviews.author: Falijuvi
reviews.title: Rien de bien
reviews.text: Nous y avons séjourné une journée, cela nous a suffi. Personnel incompétent, déco vieillissante, nourriture type cantine. Clientèle internationale bruyante et ordinaire, voiturette à prendre pour tout déplacement, tous les restaurants complets dès notre arrivée, ne restait que le buffet, management sans efficacité  .... À fuir !

reviews.author: Inspire644281
reviews.title: Horrible service!!
reviews.text: I came with my family for a Christmas vacation, my family members are platinum member with paradisus Palma real. We have been coming to this resort since 2011. Since our first visit a lot has changed with the resort everything for the worse. From service to rooms and food. Our room was not safe and/or clean and they said they are all booked and there is nothing they can do. For 4 days they were giving us empty promises and telling us they would switch our room to their new hotel, circle grand reserve. In the end nothing was ever done. Please do not become a member of this hotel. Attached are the images of the room that I stayed in. Completely unsafe with exposed wires and mildew in the bathtub.

reviews.author: Swiss Italian
reviews.title: A great resort on a steep decline
reviews.text: I visited this resort back in 2015 cause TripAdvisor listed it as #1. And I believe it did live up to it's rating back then, everything about the resort was excellent. Earlier this month I revisited and did'nt bother to check the ratings. Well to my surprise the resort is no longer what it was. The staff informed me that Melia hired a young man in Spain to cut costs in order to make the resort more profitable. Well the cuts are extremely obvious to us travellers. Not a smart move cause I will never go back as a repeat customer. All top shelf liquor is no longer included, your bottle of dinner wine from France or Italy has been replaced with a glass of cheapens sour unknown wine. In room Minibar has been de-stocked. The restaurants have been downgraded to miniscule portions that will have you running for the boring buffet before it closes for the night. The service has been cut as well, many of the staff insist on speaking Spanish even when they know you don't speak their language. They will apologize and tell you "I no speak english" well the resort is full of Americans and English speaking Canadians, why would you hire non English speaking staff employees??? There are also lots of signs of wear and tear at this resort from torn pillows, beach and pool lounge chairs, mildew smell in rooms, mismatched pool tiles, old and  rickety shuttle carts to beach, chipped ceramic dinnerware, cups and glasses, soiled areas in need of cleaning, and the general attitude of staff is that they really could care less whether you are happy with their service. Most of the staff is obsessed with their smartphones, paying more attention to facebook thannyour needs as a traveler to their resort. Not one person went out of their way to help us. The worst experience we had during our stay was Melia wasted one entire day of our 5 day vacation pitching a timeshare which they explicitly said was not a timeshare when asked, only later to reveal they teamed up with Scammer RCI timeshare company to pitch their sell for $129,000. This infuriated us, cause they only toldnus at the end of the 5 hours we spent off the resort at their new Reserce Grand resort which lacks everything a seasoned traveler would want. "BEWARE" of the scam which happens at the "Winery" (which is nothing but a room with a bar and a few wine bottles on the wall) over a complimentary glass of wine, where you are then scheduled for the next day where you will waste it hearing about the "timeshare" which Melia insists is not a timeshare. As a previous RCI customer who took RCI to court, I know too well of their scamming tactics.

reviews.author: Anand K
reviews.title: Stop marketing new property
reviews.text: Snatching all the stars as the only focus was on selling new property. Went there but they did not let us return for 3 hours. Ruined our day. Our 2 year old slept without lunch and later got sick. Never returning.

reviews.author: DavidWIndyCity56
reviews.title: Do not waste your time and MONEY, mosquitoes problem!
reviews.text:
Me and my family stayed in Paradisus Palm Real at the end of November of 2018.
