Decidí pasar en el sector Royal Service mis vacaciones para tener la tranquilidad que me vendieron, cobraron.  Al llegar al hotel y luego de hacer el check in, compruebo que todo el hotel está en obra con golpes desde las 8 am y el sector de Royal Service invadido por obreros que hablan a los gritos y hacen imposible estar en ese sector. No hay toallas a mano, nadie pregunta si queres tomar algo. En la playa hay un sector ocupado con las cosas de construcción y cómo si eso fuera poco nos informan que a partir de mañana cerrarán el sector por lo cual el lugar tranquilo y soñado deberá ser suplantado por la pileta comunitaria con niños. ME SIENTO ESTAFADA, en ningún momento el hotel me aviso en las condiciones que se encontraba, ni siquiera al momento del check in. El resto del hotel también está en reparaciones, lo cual hay que cambiar el uso de las instalaciones. En el buffet no hay gente en su lugar de trabajo, faltan jugos, no hay quien te sirva las cosas del mostrador, etc. El servicio en las mesas es pésimo, al momento de desayunar las mesas están preparadas con cuchillo y tenedor, no cambian los cubiertos y no hay un lugar donde tomarlos, sirven el café sin cuchara o sea hay q revolver con el dedo. Mi opinión es que el SERVICIO ES PÉSIMO , ya estoy harta de escuchar la palabra DISCULPE, aunque cabe destacar que la arquitectura es hermosa

Blanca perez

reviews.author: Aline Tatiana G
reviews.title: Aburrido!
reviews.text:
Después de 3 años volví al Paradisus Palma Real porque para mí era el hotel de mis suenos. Pues bien, ERA!
Que tristeza, que decepción. Desde que llegamos la atención era cualquier cosa, jamás nos ofrecieron o nos informaron sobre los otros servicios o habitaciones superiores que tienen en el hotel. Con gusto cambiaría, porque la nuestra era antigua y fea. Las almohadas de plumas olían muy mal. Nos asignaron una concierge que se llamaba Reina, que al 2do día que le dijimos que no participariamos de su reunión de venta porque ya la habíamos hecho, no nos hizo más caso. Jamás nos llamó ni nos entregó los cheques que lo fuimos a retirar el último día porque un huésped nos dijo.
No tiene vida nocturna. Es aburrido y a las 10 cortan la música. Tienen Un noche de Jazz (en serio alguien se va a Rep. Dominicana para escuchar Jazz?) casi nos dormimos. No había música. Tuve que irme hasta el Shopping y comprar un Speaker para escuchar música.
El equipo de animación es excelente, pero eso de solamente hacer clase de danza todo el día es del pasado. Nadie quiere hacer y no hay interacción.
La comida: Mucho para no tener nada. Repetido en todos los sectores. Cucarachas y ratones había en el buffet. Reclame dos días consecutivos a dos personas diferentes y como no obtuve respuesta me pareció que era algo común. Un asco! No coman nada frio, porque Era ahí dónde siempre estaban.
No pierdan su tiempo con los restaurantes a La Carta. 
Mi consejo es: Busquen otro hotel!

reviews.author: queenangeln
reviews.title: Terrible.
reviews.text: Please do NOT come here unless you want your belongings STOLEN FROM YOUR ROOM. I stayed here for 4 days and on the last night, I came back to my hotel room to find that my entire WALLET with cash, ID, credit cards and my iPhone have been TAKEN FROM MY ROOM!!!! Unbelievable. I saw other reviews of this hotel warning me of this, I should have listened.

reviews.author: Pat_and_Girls
reviews.title: One of our worst family vacations
reviews.text:
Few words about the resort :
- one of the first resort built by Melia in DR, even with a good maintenance, you feel that the resort need rest
- the Reserve itself is quite far from the beach and since the Gaby Bar is under maintenance you need to go to the beach for every meals except if you enjoy eating in a blind room during your vacations...
- the room are ok if you are lucky, in our case we had to change due to noise coming from the city all night long
- the service is just ok in average, I mean some guys are very helpful and very nice, some are let's say just not motivated to make you happy. The service in Mexico is just night and day
- the food is ... let's worth the famous all you can eat for $3...in other words Terrible with a specific reward for Mole with the worst "mexican" food I've ever ate
- the beach is full of sea weed so you can look at it but do not try to swim
- golf : the Resort tells you that it's included they just do not mention that you pay €65 for the cart so considering the poor quality of the golf course, you can play elsewhere !
As a conclusion : 
- food : horrible
- beach : not good
- resort : just ok
- golf : not good
- service : ok
- weather : nice
Next vacations : elsewhere and likely not with Melia !

reviews.author: Irene W
reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: Everything was bad.  Everything.  I can deal with bad, the beach is there.  What I could not deal with was the lack of security.  No dead bolt locks on the inside of the room.  Hotel personal would wonder in when they pleased, caught my beau but naked coming out of the shower.  Even better they would leave your door wide open when the room was unoccupied.  There is nothing worse than being scared due to lack of security in a foreign place.

reviews.author: Marcel C
reviews.title: Buena Estructura, pésimo servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel está ubicando en una excelente playa tropical y tiene buena estructura. Sin embargo, el servicio es malísimo! El motivo de mi reclamo: tuve un ataque terrible por mosquitos (algo esperado por estar en área tropical!), pero la asistencia del hotel fue NULA. El cliente que pague por la asistencia médica de 150USD. No fue una "ataque" simple... creo que las fotos son aclaradas! Además intentan vender paquetes adicionales y se olvidan de informar sobre los beneficio ya previstos. Ejemplo: área exclusiva en la playa! En fin, tienen un potencial que no saben cómo explotarlo! 
Ps.: el médico que brindo la asistencia (tercero!) no cobro la consulta, no por intervención del hotel y si por buena voluntad!
Amigos: atención al hospedar en el hotel

reviews.author: Jose Manuel T
reviews.title: No vale la pena
reviews.text: Estuvimos 9 días con el servicio family concierge. Luego de haber visitado varias cadenas en punta cana y otros lugares, no me parece que el servicios que contratamos estuvo a la altura de las circunstancias. La comida con poca variedad, te moris deshidratado antes de que alguien te traiga la bebida, 100 mozos para diez mesas y nadie te atiende, muy pobre la organización. La habitación no fue gran cosa en función del precio. El hotel lejos de la playa y te pasas tú vacaciones esperando el trencito. Los shows medio pelo. La atención (a excepción de santos, y la conserje Stefany Ruiz) muy mala. Comunicación descoordinada todo el tiempo todo el mundo te informa algo distinto. La zona de chicos muy básica y con pocas actividades. La pileta de chicos dos toboganes viejos y nada más. La playa sucia llena de algas que jamás nadie limpio. La gerente de family conciergee, cada cosa que reclamamos nos dió respuestas negativas y tuvo una actitud que demostraba que le molestaban nuestras inquietudes. Pagamos el servicio más caro y a todo el mundo que iba al Paradisus y lo terminaban pasando a the reserve que sale el triple, super injusto para quien contrato The reserve. Por desgracia nos tocó el huracán María y por 4 días   estuvo el 90 por ciento del hotel inutilizado, e inundado, no vimos mucha proactividad   en limpiar las piletas y la playa dsp de los  destrozos, y la atención durante la crisis fue lamentable, nadie sabía que tenía que hacer. No vale  la pena. Mejor Iberostar o Barceló y más económico.

reviews.author: As100419
reviews.title: Who is rating this hotel...
reviews.text: Let me tell you first this hotel does not fall into the category of a four star hotel.  The buffet area is old, the food is so bad and there's flies flying around on the food, I went and told one of the guys there was a fly on the food and he did nothing, did not remove the food from buffet.    The rooms bathtub and walls had old soap attached to eat, looked dirty.  Nothing to be compare with a 4 star hotel this maybe fall in the category of a 3 star.  The family concierge lady was very nice and helpful, but the food and the condition of the buffet area and rooms is bad.

reviews.author: Z_pal
reviews.title: Absolutely the WORST Vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
I would give this resort a Zero if I could. My family recently stayed for 4 nights at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and all I can say is that it was the WORST vacation experience of our lives! Our vacation started off poorly and ended up being more of a tortuous experience than a vacation.  We decided to try this resort even though it was on the pricey end based on other reviews we saw & it was featured as a great resort through JetBlue Getaways,  however after our experience I can honestly say it was a waste of our money & time, there is nothing to desire about this resort, the food, & it's staff. We booked the 2 bedroom family concierge suite and if I have to say anything good it would have to be our family concierge Sandra. She saw what was happening & tried her best to help but she could not compensate for so many negatives. The resort is aware of everything that happened to us and has taken no real accountability for our experience.  We arrive at the main Reserve lobby around 1 pm, I provided the check in attendant my phone showing my JetBlue reservation details (vacation #, with our names). The attendant looked in her system for about 5 minutes during which she kept asking if I'm sure this is the hotel we are booked for, to which I kept saying yes and she kept looking. She finally said I'm sorry but I do not see any reservation for you & she proceeded to say something in Spanish to our driver who started taking our luggage back into his vehicle. He said we might be booked at the regular Paradisus but I knew we were at the Reserve so I kept saying no, this is our hotel and feverishly started checking for more details from JetBlue. I located where it stated "The Reserve" showed it to her, she then took it more seriously & finally came over & said yes I found it with no apology. I was happy it was found but when you've spent so much to stay at what you believed to be a 5 star hotel, that's certainly not the reception you expect to receive. No drink, no warm towel, or reception, just a please stand here, someone will come to take you to your private check in at family Concierge. We waited over 10 minutes and no one came, eventually the Doorman, who saw everything that had happened came over & offered to tag our luggage & walk us to concierge, saying it was easier than waiting. We got to concierge, they took our passports, checked us in but since it was earlier than ckeck in time our room was not ready so we were escorted to a restaurant to have something to eat & told to come back around 3pm. Upon returning at 3pm only 1 part of out 2 bdr suite was ready but we agreed to go to our room as we were tired. The other half of our conjoining room did not become available till after 4pm. When we arrived in the room that was supposed to be ready, our son jumped onto the sofa and said something scraped him, as we looked closer we realized the entire front of the side was missing and there were exposed nails. We did not see any scrapes on him & assumed he was okay & called for it to be fixed. As we settled in we proceeded to put away our valuables in the safe at which time we realized the passport belonging to my son was missing. We remembered giving our passports at check in so we called the concierge desk to chk. I was told they would look & my family concierge Sandra will be in touch in 10 mins or so. 10 minutes felt like 10 hours as I frantically unpacked bags in search on if in case it was not with them. I even started calling the airport to see if we somehow left it there & looking into the US embassy in case we had to get a replacement. After 10 mins & no call my husband decided to walk to the front desk to chk & he stated when he arrived it was sitting on the desk next to the attendant. It was terribly upsetting that that individual did not feel the urgency to at least call & let us know it was there or even appease us that they had it. We were so upset but we decided a trip to relax at the pool was best after this but as we were approaching the front desk the 2 individuals there were laughing about it. Guess they did not think we should've been so upset about possibly loosing a passport in a foreign country. 
The next morning our concierge arranged Cabanas for us at the beach so as our kids slept in a bit my husband headed to claim them. He returned around 11am and we headed down to Gabi club at 11:04am for breakfast, but were informed that it closed at 11am even though many ppl were eating. We asked where we can get some breakfast as we have 3 kids & were told to try Hydrogrill, went to Hydrogrill & was told they do not have any food available. Were then told to go to try room svc or Gabi beach. Because we were set up at the beach for the day we decided to head there, well once there we were told Gabi beach was also now closed. At that point we headed back to our room to call room svc, it was now almost 12:15 and room svc also said they did not have breakfast. Here we are with 3 kids who had not eaten since 8pm the prior night, exhausted from the heat & walking. At that point our family concierge got involved & ordered them to prepare us some food. They did but it arrived well after 12:30 & pancakes were burnt, the toast was cold & dry, with only 1 silverware fit 5 of us to eat with. It set us up for another day of terribly treatment by this hotel. Our concierge made us dinner reservations at Vento, when we got there they couldn't find our name, it became a reoccurring theme of us not being on any list or priority. The next day our son developed a fever of 105 degrees & a cold which we can only attribute to sun exposure due to all the walking in the hot sun the prior day. While trying to commute between our room, the beach & restaurants; trolleys would literally pass us, drop us off wherever was convenient to them & the other guests they were carrying. No consideration was ever given to the fact that we had kids with us & they should drop us where we asked to be dropped off. We just could not understand that at all. The reminder of our time there was spent trying to get our son better. We were beyond happy to leave & be over with this terrible experience that was supposed to be our yearly family vacation. An hour & a half of walking around in the hot sun with our kids looking for food & be told there was no place to eat was just terrible. It's not what anyone would expect from an all inclusive resort that proclaims to offer such great service to its guests. It set the stage for the illness of our son & the overall detriment of our vacation. Our concierge relayed everything that happened to us to management & the manager Stephanie did reached out to us & offered to arrange a special dinner on the beach for us as compensation, however when we got there there was nothing special about it. It was not on the beach at all, but under a covered restaurant area with no beach in sight, and it was also where everyone else who chose to dine at Gabi grill could have eaten. We felt as though she did not understand or comprehend how poorly our treatment & experience was & it was downplayed. We left extremely unhappy & feeling like it was all a very bad nightmare, however the worst part was that the Hotel & it's management took no responsibility of what happened even after JetBlue reached out to them for answers after being made aware, they did not feel the need to genuinely make it right. It was our first & last time at a Melia property.

reviews.author: Ossama F
reviews.title: Don't let the reviews get you to visit this horrible place
reviews.text:
Don't take a room near the buggy roads!
The place is big and they don't care about you or even try to make you enjoy the place
The staff are busy talking to each other and if you don't know the Spanish language, then you will be a part of the jock. Very disappointed very disappointing very disappointed

reviews.author: oksana m
reviews.title: Horrible!!!! The worst place ever!!!!
reviews.text: Food is nasty not fresh!!! Roaches running around buffet!! Service is horrible!!! Everything is broken !!! Bloody sheets!! Pools are dirty!!! I have over 50 pictures but it won't allow me that many to post!!! Rooms smells like gasoline and Mildew !! Every day I had to call in for room service. Screen door was broken!!! No hot water after 4:30 pm every night!!!  Me and My kids had to shower in ice cold water !!! My five year old almost drowned because the steps in the pool drop drastically!!! From 3ft to 5ft!! Sushi is served warm. No activity for kids!! kids pool had no water in it!!! Not enough chassis around the pool!!! Cheap alcohol!!! I asked the pool boy for four towels and his answer was "I could only give you one have the other people come and get" What kind of services is that?! The  power lights went out twice ,in the week that we stood.  We had to use our phone as a flash light... ridiculous!!!Iron in in the room did not work.. and they tell me they did not have a replacement... The beach is dirty!!! can't even go in the water there's nothing but  seaweed,that they do not clean... screen to come out to the porch was broken. This place was a disaster!!!every day there was a problem from the minute we got there. Every two days we needed to upload the key that was another 20 minutes walking back-and-forth just to get your key working to get into the room... people say five star they have no idea what five star is and this is not it ....this place is robbery and a big Joke !!! I would never recommend this place to anyone!!! I did not expect the Ritz Carlton service!!!but they are places out there that I've been to a lot cheaper than what I paid here with Ritz Carlton service and food was amazing!!!they have no food for kids at all!!!leftovers from the night before!!! I could go on and on and on about this place that's how disgusted I am with it!!! I really hope that you guys do not waste your money on this horrible place,,,,, and I really hope this review was helpful!!!!

reviews.author: KatTatiana
reviews.title: Disappointed for a 5 star resort
reviews.text:
This review is a pretty long one ... I'm trying to be as honest as possible. 

We arrived on Sunday Aug 13 around 1pm to The Reserve. We were told our room wasn't ready until 3 pm since that's check in time. We had lunch at GabiClub which ended up to be our favorite buffet for the whole stay ... amazing food. At 3 pm we were told they were moving our room to Palma Real since we were a couple and would have more fun there & they were upgrading our room to a beach front room and etc etc... I was so excited and shocked!

We leave the reserve in a golf cart to come to Palma real only to find out that our room STILL wasn't ready... it was 4 pm by now. We been sitting around for 3 hours... they gave us a tour of the facility to kill time, introduced us to random staff... at this point I'm furious & exhausted I was looking forward to relaxing after a long flight. It's now going on 5 PM & we are finally told our room is ready!  We go upstairs only to find a random couple in our room ( they were laying on the beds & the room was steamy from a hot shower) I automatically told them I wasnt pleased and needed a different room. 30 min later they give us the room right next door and it still wasn't what I asked for... at this point we are furious. How could a 5 star resort have such horrible communication and treat their guests like this ? 
The room that we received had a king bed but no jacuzzi in the balcony which was specifically what I payed for ! After speaking to the manager and other staff we were told that there was nothing they could do... a couple hours later they told me they could move our room to the second floor with a jacuzzi ... we took it and ended up moving there the next day! The view was horrible of construction. 

CONS:
-not enough activities to do in resort... we were bored after the 2nd day there.
- no washcloths in room 
-only given 2 towels per day in room 
-found a housekeeper in our room at 9 pm folding towels and making our bed ( forgot something in our room and came back to find her there... we thought it was very suspicious) 
-mini bar never stocked, chips were never given 
-loud noise in walls and hallways around 1 am 
-beach towels were impossible to find 
-NAOS buffet was mediocre. Received a raw runny omelette for breakfast
-public beach... constantly harassed to buy parasailing/banana boat/ jewelry/ tours
-way too much seaweed in water... not enjoyable at all 
-pool was very deep for us. No 3ft areas where u can stand to relax
- bad service at the buffet... they give u drinks when you have aready eaten all of your food. 
- expensive wine, expensive spa services 
-resort credit is pointless since everything is so expensive 
-mall was horrible! Very expensive and you are followed and watched when walking into stores. 
-drinks don't taste like they have an ounce of alcohol... never got even slightly tipsy. 

PROS:

-zenovia was amazing! She was our personal concierge and missed no details! Came to our room to find surprises ! She's great at what she does! 
-beautiful grounds 
-95% of staff is friendly ( pool towel staff and some staff at Gabi Club weren't)
-robe and slippers were a nice touch 
-conditioner/shampoo/ lotion smelled great. 
-bed was very comfortable

reviews.author: U3823VUanthonyb
reviews.title: Palma paradises real punta cana
reviews.text: I wouldn't go back to this hotel. The food and service were horrible. There was one waiter and bar tender that were great but all others were horrible. Our family had a good time due to the company with us but all 10 of us would not recommend it.

reviews.author: Rodrigo L
reviews.title: Personal muy poco competente
reviews.text:
La verdad estuvimos en el paradisus de Cancún y como fue excelente el trato y hotel decidimos seguir con la misma cadena y conocer el de punta cana contratamos el royal service un desastre no vale la pena...en la recepción me trataron de estafador habiendo pagado 6 meses por adelantado la tarifa total...es más como mi banco me cambio de gold a platinum me subió de categoría me cambiaron la tarjeta y cuando llegue al hotel me hicieron un débito otra vez por el total de la reserva habiéndola pagado 6 meses por adelantado. Pedí por la gerente y vino uno (que no era gerente ) que no me soluciono nada y me tuvieron más de 5 horas esperando y no me solucionaron nada lo único que me dijeron que tenía que volver a pagar. Ósea pague 2 veces habiendo pagado 6 meses antes...tuve que comunicarme con el banco y que me escaneen el recibo de 6 meses atrás que decía que estaba pagado...nunca me trataron así. Y la gerente nunca apareció habiendo solicitado hablar con ella. Volviendo al servicio royal service lo único que tiene de más son 2 restaurante que son ricos en comidas pero pésimo en el
Personal que atienden uno el palazo cuando llegas te da la bienvenida una señora que te mira despectivamente de arriba a abajo poniendo incomodo a mí y a mi pareja. Y el otro el fuego...que tan mal no atendió y lento que ni el postre pedimos estuvimos ahí adentro 4 horas...muy mal atendido.

reviews.author: Anabella S
reviews.title: Decepción
reviews.text: Contratamos nuestra estadía con el royal Service "supuestamente sería un trato especial y personalizado" pero para nuestra sorpresa desde que llegamos el personal del check in un desastre y con un rendimiento muy bajo para un hotel de esta categoría y por lo que habíamos pagado, ya por adelantado, CERO SERVICIALES. Ante un problema no tiene capacidad de resolución que es uno lo q espera cuando está de vacaciones. UN DESASTRE. Los dos restaurante q son "exclusivos" del royal (fuego y palazo) de trato exclusivo no tiene nada, en el palazo la señorita si se le puede llamar así, entrabas y tenía cara de pocos amigos, y no solo eso te miraba de arriba a abajo como si ella fuera superior por diosssss que te creíste, EDUCACIÓN ANTE TODO. En el fuego! La moza q nos toco una chica de pelo corto hizo q cenemos sin bebida porque nunca venía y que nos vayamos sin postre de cansarnos de esperarla HORROR. Y por último la experiencia en el blue agave q a la tarde hay un burguer, cuando llegamos vemos q hay una mesa con vista al mar, pensamos en sentarnos ahí, solo le faltaba ponerle dos vasos, cuando llegamos la recepcionista (lisa arias) si así se la puede llamar nos dice que no porque esta sucia ( lo cual era mentira) tuve q decirle q la arreglaba yo para q me ponga dos vasos y me la de. Sin decir de la forma que me miraba. Noté, y para que tengan en cuenta los dueños del hotel que el personal es lo que arruina el hotel, y hace poco hospitalaria y placentera la estadía! Deben enseñar y educar a los empleados, porque les van a arruinar la reputación del hotel! Yo al instante que llegue me quería ir por el trato! DUEÑOS DE PARADISUS REVISEN LAS CAPACIDADES DE SU PERSONAL.

reviews.author: Blue S
reviews.title: Don't let the reviews take you away
reviews.text:
The whole experience was not even close to any of the reviews we read before we did a big mistake and book a full week in this resort! Horrible food, staff totally impolite especially if you don't speak Spanish, very noisy rooms, horrible services anywhere you turn.
Can't be disappointed more than being here.

reviews.author: Mantrinbago
reviews.title: Poor management, good staff...
reviews.text: If you decide to stay at this property and pay for in advance bring your receipt! Our two families (6 adults and 2 teens) spent 2 hours in a check in process I still do not understand because the resort could not find our payment even though we showed the credit card charge. General Manager had the audacity to threaten to 'kick us out' the next day when we voiced issue with our check in process! Sandra, our concierge, made up for the early issue and did an excellent job in making the rest of our stay enjoyable. Unfortunately due to the senior and mid management behavior we will not return to this otherwise great resort.

reviews.author: Carl L
reviews.title: Worst Resort Ever
reviews.text:
Do not go there. Do not use any Melia Properties. Outdated Facility in disrepair. Unfriendly Staff.
Language barriers. They do not speak English well and don't care. Inattentive staff. Horrible food at all restaurants and Buffet.

reviews.author: GSNova
reviews.title: Third and final visit
reviews.text: We came to celebrate a milestone birthday and have been so disappointed in our first for hours.  This is not our first time.   The poor service started the minute the driver dropped us off.  I asked the bell man for help.  He directed me inside.  A nice lady came out and assisted others who came after me.  When I approached her she asked me to go inside to the check in lobby.   When they saw my ticket she than said I had the family check-in in a private area.  I explained this when I first got here.  They said I needed to go to another check in area. The person at check in was nice.  She suggested we go eat.  The room would not be ready until 3.  We had a horrible meal the dirty buffet at the main hotel.  We returned to the the reserve and found a better meal.  We went to check on our room.  No one was there.  We found our guy assigned to us.  He said it would be 15 minutes.  I waited 45 minutes. No word.  I went to the desk.  No one was there. It was empty.  I mean no one.  I dialed zero and asked for the manager.   Someone showed up.  10 minutes later I was in my room.  I cannot tell you how disappointing this has been.  I asked to speak to the GM.  I will keep you posted.

reviews.author: V5147THcarolc
reviews.title: Terrible service.
reviews.text: This resort was clean and small, which is why we booked here. However I couldn't believe how bad the service was. We waited over 2 hours to eat. Even though we felt they were short staffed no one was apologetic. Just to get a drink was a hassle.

reviews.author: Jackie H
reviews.title: #TeamHines Celebrating daughter's 18th Birthday
reviews.text:
-------- Original message --------

From: whaarn4 <whaarn4@aol.com> 

Date: 7/22/17 6:15 PM (GMT-06:00) 

To: whaarn4@aol.com 

Subject: 

This trip was in celebration of our daughter's 18th Birthday. I researched many resorts before choosing this one.  The rating was 4.5... we all were so excited to be coming to DR.

Upon making the reservations I made sure to mention our special diets.  I'm a vegan and one of my daughters is a vegetarian.  

So let me first list the great things about our vacation:

Family,  celebrating daughter's 18th birthday, beautiful resort, grounds well kept,  Trazy, Genesis, Juan Carlos, Sanama Adventure, 

The things that weren't great:

Reported laundry machine didn't work within 30mins of arriving to room,  NEVER was fixed nor replaced.  When inquired about another room,  they didn't have one available.

Food, awful. Buffet items always cold,  no options for vegans other than , rice and vegetables.  Was given a quaunio burger,  to later find out it had eggs in it.  Very few of the servers even knew what a vegan diet was.

COMMUNICATION BARRIER!! The people at the front check in didn't understand English very well, in fact when I referred to the washer she thought I meant sink and sent someone up to fix it.  

NO ACTIVITIES OFFERED THOUGHOUT DAY....activities all ended by 430p and was isolated to a certain area of resort. Sitting at the pool or beach summed it up,  unless you purchased an excursion. 

Most of the workers wore frowns or either showed no interest in their jobs. TERRIBLE customer service, just TERRIBLE. 

Casino had 10 machines in it and 3 were broken. 

Required reservation for all of the restaurant but, the buffet.  The food options left a lot of room for improvement at these restaurants. Small portions, with very little flavor.  We would leave restaurants and go to buffet, which wasn't any much better.  Leftover food, poor presentation,    tasteless food, overcooked vegetables.. just not appealing.

Would we use this resort again, NO!! Would we recommend it to anyone, NO!!

AGAIN THE GOOD THINGS: Beautiful grounds,Trazy, Juan Carlos and Genesis. 

Trazy attempted to get the washer fixed,  but wasn't able to.  Juan Carlos sold us our excursions and they were what he said they would be and we enjoyed every moment.  Genesis,  her smile. Personality goes a long way. 

Finally,  after my husband and I listened to the sales presentation for the resort vacation homes, we were given two free 30min messages.  We  allowed daughters to use them.  Well,  after they reported to me their messages were only 20mins, I inquired at the desk were we booked them and basically she stated that because they were given on behave of the presentation and that the spa was short of staff, that the message  may have been cut short! REALLY!! So that's how you treat a guest? 

Again, I would not recommend this resort to ANYONE!

reviews.author: 140mckenziek
reviews.title: Our stay
reviews.text: We had many problems with our stay. First was when we checked in, I didn't bring my bank card with me and that's how I paid in full before hand. I did have 2 credit card, my ID and my passport but they wouldn't check me in. We had been flying all day and were hot and very tired. The wifi was down (the first 2 days) so I couldn't pull up my bank account info to verify. The only way they would let us check in was to pay 6K over again. That was ALOT of money... That really put a bad taste in my mouth. I was never told that info when I booked with the man on the phone. (I called the resort directly to book.) We booked reservations for 3 nights and for some reason EVERYTIME they couldn't find our reservation! Water was out in our rooms many times, Our rooms was located right next to another resort and we heard the parties happening every night until the early mornings. The beach was gross with seaweed. (I understand that's mother nature and noting you can control but it was very disappointing)  We were told to meet a guy at 10 am to have a VIP breakfast and go over the resort and be given our resort vouchers. We got there and he wasn't there...Once someone was finally able to help us were we brought to the regular breakfast (no VIP)and then was trying to be sold something... We didn't want to buy anything. (We hadn't been on a vacation like this with our kids and we don't get to take many vacations because of our business) 2 hours wasted...that was frustrating and disappointing. We were never told that there were activities on the resort until the 2nd to last day...we were there for 6 days (another guest told us)  That would have been nice to know when we got there. We only hung out by the pool and were thinking it would be nice to have other things to do based on the pool closing so early and not being able to be in the ocean because of the seaweed. A print out of the weeks activities would have been nice at check in. There were many weddings on the beach while we were there. They had bands or entertainment so that was nice because there wasn't anything to do after the pool closed. Over all the weather was beautiful, the food was good and the pool was nice but for the money I wasn't impressed and wouldn't be back for a second visit.

reviews.author: ctj11
reviews.title: ..but the people are nice!
reviews.text:
Amongst the chaos that is this place- one employee stands out as particularly surly, petulant and rude.Mr Hilgado at the Vicy Spa gym was the absolute worst.  Every day I went to the secret exercise class ( nobody ever tells you about it) he told me there was no class- it was at "the other gym"- there is no other gym.  Then when I told him that the class name on the schedule matched the paper I was holding he said "oh- not enough people".  On the second day- I walked around the gym like an idiot recruiting people for the class- is that my job on vacation?!  Then, when all 4 of us were ready to start the class he just stood there- went and talked to his friend, and then walked out with all of us lying on the floor.  That is something a 4 year old would do.  I mean really.
The one good thing I can say about this resort is the people are lovely- they don't so a single thing you ask,from a birthday cake that was ordered and met with blank stares the night of the birthday to dinner reservations made 4 times with no record of them...they were still lovely, and that is very nice.
One other thing t one sure to know- the Reserve is not on the beach- is is poolside- and getting shuttle to the beach is not easy. I also find it interesting on this forum that the only replies from management are to the 4 star comments-fits the bill!

reviews.author: 879fernandoh
reviews.title: Es muy malo hay mucha diferencis fe atencion con otro melia no parece un hoyel de la cadena
reviews.text: Es muy malo hay mucha diferencis fe atencion con otro melia no parece un hoyel de la cadena La pasamos verdaderamente pesimo las reservas en los testaurantes los empleados sin ganas no tiene gana de trabajar

reviews.author: yadyg14
reviews.title: Don't waste you money!!
reviews.text: This is an honest review, hope it's helpful to you. I have plenty experience when it comes to all inclusive, I have been to several resorts in the Caribbean and like to 7 or more in the Dominican Republic. Let me start by saying that this resort is very beautiful and it's gardens are very well kept. When you get there since you are staying at the reserve it's a very small area for the check in. They have a beautiful lobby even with flamingos in the main resort so I really didn't get why not to show that beautiful lobby from the beginning. Check in was fast though. They say they are welcoming  you with champagne but they give u a very bad fruit punch instead. We got there around 2 so the room wasn't ready. They told us we could have lunch and just come back to get the key. The buffet it's small very for an all inclusive but I found the options to be good. After eating I sat in the dinner reservations desk, they informed me that I had only 2 nights options to have dinner and I needed to fill out a wish list. So basically you don't get to eat where you want, if there's space then they will let you. I'm not even use to doing reservations anymore at resorts so this was very shocking. The Grill was very disappointing. They are so busy that they can't even say hello. Vento was ok. At the grill by the pool they have a menu with a lot of things. When you order they say they are sorry but they don't have it.... I hated that they give u all the drinks in paper cups...they are so cheap they can't afford to buy at least plastic cups like most resorts. The room was ok nothing wao. They don't serve bottles in the rooms only wine but you have to ask for it. Basically this resort it's very beautiful, used to be very nice years ago, but now they don't have enough staff neither restaurants to provide good service and quality. Most of the staff don't know what they are doing or are really rude. Do yourself a favor, go to another resort even if you have to pay a little more. It is not worth a dime!!!

reviews.author: jerry l
reviews.title: Please reconsider your travel plans.....
reviews.text:
We just returned from our family vacation at the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana DR (July 22nd to 25th)To summarize,  7 out of 8 of us got a stomach virus and spent a lot of time in the  restrooms.  

Service was questionable from the second we arrived at this so called 5 Star Resort. When we checked in we were escorted to our rooms only to find out that none of our 4 room keys worked.  The  Bellman looked at us as if "oh well" and literally walked away.  

From then the next five days were down hill. A lot of things seemed not to make sense or were a little off;  no one explained to us how to make dinner reservations, towel booth ran out of beach towels, they ran out of ginger ale, tables settings were always missing something, staff seemed very unhappy, beach littered with seaweed, beach vendors continuously trying to sell you something, some food servers don't wear gloves, no attention to food safety,
TVs didn't work properly in room, no one answer when you call front desk, inconsistency in maid service, and the casino is a joke.

SORRY TO SAY, THIS IS NOT A FIVE STAR RESORT.

I wish I had read previous post that mention how service has suffered since the new management.  From my understanding, there are many new employees and it's apparent that these employees have not been trained properly..... their Service Model is greatly flawed from the reception area, bellmen, maids, waiters, cooks, beach attendants etc...

Quickly call your travel agent and rebook someplace else... a Ritz Carlton this place isn't.

reviews.author: jjts1972
reviews.title: Nos arruinaron las vacaciones
reviews.text:
La verdad que ya ni sé por dónde comenzar...un hotel que por servicio ya no puede tener 5 estrellas, ni 3, ni 2...desde la atención en el call center antes de llegar en que no daban respuesta a nuestra necesidad de tener habitaciones conectadas hasta el final, hasta un buffet en que nada tenía nombre ni nadie sabía qué era, porque habían despedido a una enorme cantidad de personal y los que estaban eran nuevos sin capacitación.
- Nos estafó el tipo de los tours que está debajo del Lobby, nos vendió un tour VIP en un catamaran solos y luego habían 16 personas más. Cuando lo llamé, me trató de mentirosa...cuando yo no tenía de donde sacar esa información si no era de él, si ni siquiera sabía que existían tours en catamaran.
- Fue el cumpleaños N3 de mi hijo y me dijeron que no tenían amenities para cumpleaños de niños, solo de adultos. Si quería un bizcocho tenía que pagar 5 dólares por persona, a lo que accedí. Nunca me llegó, tuve que ir al supermercado de afuera a comprar una torta. Dos días después vi en la puerta de una habitación globos y un cartel...era un adulto, a el si le correspondía (?)
- Nuestro hijo se enfermó y necesitábamos un médico...llamaban para comprobar que habíamos anulado la hora o para decirnos los valores, en circunstancias que les dijimos que daba lo mismo, que lo pagábamos directo, que el niño tenía 39 de fiebre...pero eso parecía no importar. Tuvo que ir mi marido a armar un lío a la recepción para que alguien se dignara a contactarnos con un médico.
- La piscina principal a eso de las 4 de la tarde huele a pis, asqueroso, pésimo olor
- Si querías una reposera cerca de la piscina en la sombra no tenias posibilidad de tenerla, salvo que entregaras un soborno a alguno de los chicos, que se movían por propinas. Gente nueva.
- Cuando pedí una habitación en mejores condiciones que las que habíamos tomado (tomamos dos habitaciones por 10 días) porque habían filtraciones, el frigo bar no funcionaba y de la habitación del lado no nos dejaban dormir, el "conserje" que teníamos a cargo de nuestra estadía me dijo que no había problema pero que eran U$4.200 extra para que nos cambiaran de habitación...o sea, para recibir lo que pagué, tenía que pagar el doble de lo que valía, porque este señor F. nos llamaba para tratar de vendernos cosas más que para entregarnos un servicio. Una vergüenza...después cada vez que nos veía, se escurría.
- Desapareció un adaptador de una de nuestras habitaciones y cuando lo notificamos, milagrosamente apareció al día siguiente.
- Me hice dos masajes en el SPA con una excelente terapeuta...pero el aire acondicionado en las cabinas no funciona y el agua sobre la cual las cabinas están situadas está estancada, verde y con hongos...
- Si se les ocurre tomar hora para los restaurantes, junten paciencia para la fila y ojalá que no esté malo el sistema de reservas cómo nos tocó dos días seguidos.
- Yendo al mall que queda en la entrada del complejo, esperamos 45 minutos para que pasara un carro de acercamiento que pasaba se supone cada 15 minutos para llevarte al hotel...tuve que entregarle una propina a un chico con un carro de golf para que nos llevara. Lo mismo si quieres ir de un lado a otro, no creas en los plazos que te dan, están under staff y la gente super descontenta, nos enteramos que habrá una huelga de los empleados por sobre explotarlos. Y los entendemos, la nueva cabeza del hotel es de verdad alguien que ha tomado pésimas decisiones, dejando descontentos a empleados y clientes.
Así podría enumerar tantas más cosas que sucedieron...mi marido acabó hablando con una gerente de turno que en su condición nos entregó una pulsera para acceder a un área del hotel que no sabíamos existía antes (la hubiésemos tomado de primera) que se llama The Reserve y que es totalmente diferente en servicio e infraestructura. Quisimos quedarnos allá, pagando la diferencia, pero no había cupo....Como un hotel entonces hace la tontería de nivelar hacia abajo en vez de hacia arriba!? Como es posible que no mantengan un estándar de servicio que no desprestigie a este nivel la marca Meliá??
No es fácil encontrar el tiempo para tomarse vacaciones, el tiempo es probablemente uno de los factores más complejos a la hora de tomar la decisión de salir del país en un viaje de placer...entonces que teniendo toda la ilusión y las ganas de tener unos días inolvidables en familia, que quien te lo arruine sea el hotel que elegiste, donde pusiste la confianza para que esos días fuesen un real descanso, resulta IMPERDONABLE.
Nos dijeron que antes el hotel no era así...huéspedes que estaban ahora allá y que habían ido antes...pues ellos no volverán, y nosotros tampoco al Paradisus Palma Real Resort Golf & Spa Punta Cana

reviews.author: holcombjennifer
reviews.title: Major disappointment
reviews.text:
I could go on and on with the disappointments but I will sum up my review into pros and cons. We stayed at the royal service area for 6 nights 

Pros: property and grounds are beautiful 
Food is excellent (at the sit down restaurants , Buffett wasn't my favorite but not horrible)

Cons: service , what service? Honestly the service was close to non existent 
Room were not cleaned when we asked them to be, and I'm talking by 6:00 at night they were still dirty 
Workers are under new management and not happy, and they have no problem telling the guests this, problem is we as guests are paying the price 
Spa appointments run late 
No towels to be found by beach or pool

Overall our experience was horrible and it is unfortunate bc this resort came highly recommended to us, I also researched a lot and before it was hard to come by a bad review of the paradisus, now it seems like there are more and more negative reviews. The staff is disengaged, no one greets you with a smile, no one wants to help you with the exception of a few. We paid extra for the royal service and I still don't know what we paid extra for. There was supposed to be pool/beach service and I honestly didn't even know we had that , that is how non exsistent the help is. Out of the 6 nights we stayed here there was one day that was great, we had service all day by the beach and we actually felt paid attention to, but one day out of 6 is unacceptable. I know I'm not alone in this as we met several families who felt the same.

reviews.author: roblum
reviews.title: ***Read Before You Book***
reviews.text:
I'll begin by saying that all the reviews previous to the most recent ones should be completely and utterly disregarded. The hotel has changes management and as a result has become a very different hotel than what we were led to believe before we booked.

Whenever I read reviews I am keenly aware of the bad ones and look for tell tale signs of crazy people who can never be satisfied. I saw a lizard in my room!!! 1 star. Crazy... So with that being said, let me start with the positives. The hotel and the property it's on is beautiful. really. The architecture, design and location are stunning. Zero complaints and frankly, my wife and I took some pictures for our own home renovations that we'd like to copy. The pool was fantastic as well and shallow enough that we could stand and swim with our young ones with little to no issues. 

The food was alright at the buffet and alright to outstanding at the restaurants. That being said, we tend to eat out more often and may or may not have pickier tastes so I'll leave that in the undecided category though food was never an issue for us.So if the property is beautiful, the pool great and food pretty good, why a 1 star rating. Sounds kind of harsh. Well here's why...

The service was world class terrible. In all seriousness, this was far and away the worst service we've ever had anywhere. Lets start with the staff. Some had smiling faces which was great. In particular, the bartenders at the lobby bar, whose names I forgot, were easily the nicest and most welcoming faces there. Outside of them, the rest of the staff looked disgruntled, disinterested and not really happy to help in any way. From refusing to give me change so I could tip our waiter, to not giving us way when we're walking while holding our babies or pushing the stroller, to not being available, ever. Room service wanted to limit us to 4 beers a day in our fridge. Then they said the changed their policy and began charging us for room service. The buffet was locked to prevent guests from going on for a time, the gellato/coffee bar server was short tempered and ill prepared with constant line ups after it opened while nothing was prepared. There was no staff walking around the pool to offer drinks and only one man I saw at the beach but I never saw him again after that one time. At one point my wife asked me if we had a bad reputation amongst the staff and maybe that was why we were getting terrible service. I reminded her we had been incredibly nice to everyone to that point and had tipped the staff over $250 USD over 5 days at an all inclusive in the hopes of getting better service, which never transpired!

Another example just to drive home the point of how terrible this hotel is the following. When we were checking out, we had asked for a late checkout. As I stated previously, we have two young children 3 and 18 months. In the tropical heat, they take long naps which is why we asked for the later checkout. At 1:00 we get a call from the front desk asking us of we wanted a bellhop to help with the bags now. I reminded him we had a later check out and that our kids were still napping. He said we'd have to vacate the room in 20 min. or they'd charge $80 per person for the extra time! I asked him to transfer me to the manager at which point he hung up on me. After several calls that went unanswered to the front desk I called guest services and again no answer. Can you imagine the annoyance and stress of not being able to connect to anyone from the hotel hours before checking out and having them hang additional charges on top of the charges they wanted us to pay for room service etc. Enough was enough and my wife and I had one final drink to celebrate us leaving and never having to go back to this disaster of a resort ever again.

In talking to other guests and staff after a few days, we discovered that the service had been exemplary in the past but there had since been a management change and 250 employees had been laid off. In talking to the staff, they complained to us that the new management hasn't been paying them what was due and they were over worked on top of that. So whereas I can understand their frustration, that didn't help to make our stay there any better as they were talking their frustrations out on the guests who were for the most part, tipping them and being extremely pleasant for the most part. In any case, when staying at a 5 star resort known for it's service doesn't provide the one thing their reputation is staking on, well that means they didn't deliver what was promised and what we paid a lot for. 

For these reasons along with several others that just fortify the existing points I've already made, this is not a hotel you want to stay at. There are better options that will provide a better experience than this terrible resort!

reviews.author: Argytraveller

reviews.author: melissasJ4584YV
reviews.title: Don't be Fooled

The mangers or supervisors also can never help you with any of your concerns.  It seems like that is their answer to all questions asked.

reviews.author: Tigran H
reviews.title: Poor security

reviews.author: Joanne C
reviews.title: What a nightmare...service was nonexistent!
reviews.text: The hotel and rooms were very pretty, but the service was a joke. There was no service! I'm not sure what was happening but we couldn't get coffee, spoons, napkins...forget making reservations, everything was booked before we even got there! Then when we would finally get into a restaurant there would be maybe 10 people in there. The food was just ok, the swim up bar closed at 6 pm! It was impossible to get service of any kind. reviews.author: Thinh T

We signed up for dinner reservations for 4 nights however we didn't get the reservations of the restaurants that we chose and also didn't get a confirmation at all.  We want to speak to the guest services and didn't get result.  No one seem to care.  Also we upgraded to get the best for our family.  This is very disappointed trip.  We are never coming back here.  Poor! Poor services!!

reviews.author: Parth P
reviews.title: Stay Here If You Want LOW-QUALITY VACATION
reviews.text:
This place does not deserve to have any praise. I have been to 5 all-inclusive resorts (2 in Punta Cana, 1 in Cancun, 1 in Cabos, 1 in Jamaica) and this has been the worst experience I have had yet. The customer service is very disappointing and unacceptable. I planned to stay here with my family and my sister's family (total 8 people, 3 rooms) for a relaxing 5 night vacation, yet it was anything but relaxing. Sadly, the worst experience for this trip was checking in. I entered the property around 1:15 and did not settle into my room until 5:00. I should not have to wait almost 4 hours to go to my room which I paid to check in early. The lady at the front desk said the check in time is at 3pm, which I understood, and gladly waited for. At 3:15, I go back and the front desk representative told me to wait another 20 min because our rooms were not ready. This process continued for another hour. I was very angry because I was not able to check into my room when everyone else could get their room upon checking in. This is not how customers should be treated at a Paradisus resort. Finally I asked for a manager and he gladly gave us an upgrade for an ocean view room. When I get to the room, I found a cockroach in the bathtub and the light in the shower to be broken. So I had to complain again. (one of many more to come)

In addition, the food at this property was average compared to Riu, and Hard Rock properties. The main buffet has tons of seating but there was never a hostess to give us a table to sit at. Even if we did get a table, we had to wait around 20 minutes each day just for a waiter to get us water (not a specialty drink; water)! The food itself was alright but never any variety in type of food from day to day. The reservation system for the restaurants is bogus. You cannot make a reservation 2 days in advance and you cannot call in for a reservation. We ate at Rare and Vento with reservations, and found most of the restaurant to be empty - a total of 30 people inside. The restaurants have space, the property should open up more reservations so guests can be happy and dine. The worst restaurant to eat at is Blue Agave; it has the worst service I have every seen. There is a total of 5 workers in the restaurant (1 chef, 1 hostess, 2 waiters, 1 bus-boy) It takes 30 minutes to get seated, 20 minutes to get water and take your order, 40 minutes to get your food; HIRE MORE PEOPLE!!! Plus, the menu has no room for customization because everything is either premade (frozen food) or they are just too lazy to make you happy. If you want good-tasting food, just get room service.
The drinks at the bars were average as well. They only have one beer, Presidente, which is alright but they should at least have a few more for variety. Their top shelf drinks are only for show. I went gabi beach bar and asked for a margarita with Patron instead of their cheap domestic tequila and the bar attendant said no. I even offered to pay extra for it but he said "they are for display only." Why keep stuff like Jack Daniels, Patron, and Absolut on the shelves if I cannot even pay to drink them??

The water, pool, and views at this property are amazing. The water is blue and the pool is massive. The only issue is that they run out of pool/beach towels around 11am. The towel desk is usually lined with 45 people waiting 30-60 minutes just to get a towel. If you are a beach front resort in the middle of the summer, how on earth can you run of towels?? The management should know that people pay and come to go to the beach, not waste an hour each afternoon waiting in the burning sun for a freaking towel. 

Overall this trip was the worst experience I have had with all-inclusive, especially Melia group. The service and sub-par management made this a LOW-QUALITY vacation. I spoke to few of the workers, and they are agitated as well because the property received a new manager in February and it seems like the problems started then. My verdict is that I WILL NEVER RETURN to Paradisus Palma Real even if I got a free stay. They do not care about your happiness. The only good aspects of the property is that they have a casino and that room service is free. 
DISAPPOINTING, TERRIBLE, 3rd CLASS

reviews.author: Melissa N
reviews.title: Not a 5 star - safe and our luggage was broken into - money stolen by hotel staff and never returned. No one cared.
reviews.text: Not a 5 star - safe and our luggage was broken into - money stolen by hotel staff and never returned. No one cared. Domingo was promised a solution - never got back to us. $125 was stolen from our room

reviews.author: TBD161616
reviews.title: Poor Service and Food
reviews.text:
I went to hotel for July 4 weekend 2017. I am was told this hotel was very good and value for your money. I honestly was in SHOCK with the level of service and quality of food. my expectation on any hotel depends on price you pay and this hotel is not cheap. The hotel is under staff and employees are stressed which leads to bad response to customer and service. Here are some examples i experienced.

1) Room not ready during check in. I had to wait for room.
2) I asked for coffee several times in buffet area and took 1 HOUR to get coffee. I had to ask to employees with authority.
3) The variety of food in buffet area was very bad.
5) The restaurant a la carta open with delays and I add to ask several times for anything such as a coke anything. 
6) The pool bar ran out of liquor I drink and since limited staff. The employee was honest and said we ran out and it will take a while to receive the liquor from storage location. This process took two hours. 
7) Every time  I was in buffet area there was no plates or cups available. I had to ask employees several times in order to get something.

Honestly, this was not normal for me and I started to investigate how can an hotel at this level be so bad.  I asked questions to employees and they all said there is no staff and general manager was changed two month ago. The new manager is making a lot of changes which has impacted to quality and level of service.

Please don't go this hotel at the present time until they improved their service.

reviews.author: Margot M
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: I only have this resort a 1 since I had to rate it to leave a review. We stayed at the "Royal Service" area where the service was unprofessional & NON EXISTING. Food was terrible, Wifi was down for over 2 weeks, no one was helpful or polite and our check in took over 2 hours and when we arrived they "lost" our reservation & CHANGED our room 2 times. Francis was our butler and he was he only wonderful experience we had. We will NEVER stay at his establishment EVER again!

reviews.title: Misled
reviews.text: Paid extra to have better service for me and my family and did not received what we paid for.  We will definitely not go back to this part of Melia again. Staff was inattentive, spent 3 hours at the pool one day, never saw a server walking around offering refreshments for my family.   Room service never delivered my food and did not care to take care of the problem.

reviews.author: Fidel D
reviews.title: Mr F Deesa
reviews.text: Warning!!!!!the worst customer service. They cancel the reservation without previous notice and relocate customers in other hotels. If you do not want to go to that hotel they said that unfortunately they did not have any other choice and you can cancel completely your reservation. ( hotel customer service words). When call the melia customer service they do not solve anything.WARNING guys they are thieves down there, any think can happen if you reserve with them.

reviews.author: Fearless296249
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: This customer service when trying to obtain assistance is horrible. For such a high-end/high priced resort, you would expect top notch service. I called several times to obtain information on transportation service information from PUJ to the resort, which they provide for a fee. I was told they don't do that and to get a Taxi. However, their site lists transfers, again for a fee. When I called back to speak to someone, I was hung up on 4 times and transferred to a number that just rings twice.

reviews.author: Cl M
reviews.title: Pésima experiencia
reviews.text:
Vinimos con muchísima expectativa por la cadena Meliá,sin embargo tuvimos una estadía llena de complicaciones. Al momento de check un nos querían cobrar un plus adicional que no correspondía y recuerdo cuando pedimos hablar con el gerente nos aclararon que todo era un error, pero perdimos más de una hora en esa conversación. Luego le comentamos a la señora que nos hacía la habitación y a las recepcionistas de nuestro bloque que amanecíamos con múltiples picaduras y que no eran de mosquitos. Ellos nos insistieron que eran de mosquitos pero pasaban los días y el repelente ni el benadryl calmaron las ronchas q se multiplicaban. Eran chinches. Dijeron q fumigaron pero no fue cierto. Toda la estadía dormíamosmal y con una urticaria fuertísima. También notamos que a la
Hora de vendernos el paquete de tiempo compartido algunos de los vendedores utilizaban frases muy despectiva hacia nosotros a para querer persuadirnos. Realmente no volvería. Y encima el último día había un gusano dentro del vaso de cerveza. No lo recomiendo menos si vas con nenes.

reviews.author: Alex W
reviews.title: Lack of service with everything
reviews.text: An ok resort, which desperately needs help in the service department, from the front desk to guest services to the restaurants.. housekeeper was nice when she remembered to clean our room. Don't expect to be greeted as you walk around the resort, and ensure to make dinner reservations well in advance otherwise you will not be able to get in despite the restaurants being only half full. If you want to make a reservation for the specialty restaurant (not part of the package) expect to be greeted with "that is not part of your package" rather than which day would you like and are you aware that there is an extra charge.. let me worry about the charge as I have read all about the restaurants and the staff worry about providing an actual service! We did find one exception to the service and that was from a staff member of the Italian Restaurant called Sheulius! Apart from that, the resort is expansive with a beautiful pool and grounds. As you arrive you are met with a beautiful colonial plaza which is the heart of the resort. Rooms are spacious with a semi four poster bed and balconies.

reviews.author: NIRU D
reviews.title: Worst resort we visited in our life. We have visited lots and lots of resort in the the world, this one Really Bad.
reviews.text: BAD BAD_BAD resort. Lack of service, Lack of man power, lack of maintenance, Mosquito in the room and language barriers. Disaster form start to end. Front desk to restaurant . Again this was the worst resort we have visited in the world and surly in Caribbean Islands (our 11th visit to these Island). This may be representation of Melia properties management.

reviews.author: NJVMichigan
reviews.title: SUBPAR SERVICE ..SUBPAR EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: The best thing about this resort is the pool and beach. The rooms are very tired more of what you would expect at at a 2 or 3 star. The worst thing about this that tainted the entire trip was the the attitude of the employees, servers. They would never approach you for a drink...not exaggerating on this. You had to flag them down. In the restaurants the servers were very inattentive and demonstrated poor attitudes. Rarely do you even get a smile. One hostess even rolled her eyes when we told her lunch for two. I would NEVER again stay at a Paradisius and I especially will never go to the Dominican Republic again.

reviews.author: 아라 파
reviews.title: No way!!
reviews.text:
No good bad conditions reserved villa is too far to walk to beach and restaurants thus i have to take small truck And wait for come back.  Leaking my room and kitchen   Difficult reservations dinner restaurant. I use expedia travel company with air hotel and ground public transportation.  When i back to airport they dint pick up also call me.after 40 minutes later i call blue travel company they say i need to call taxi to get airport with miney
What a bad service

reviews.author: roadwarrior495
reviews.title: Run down and not maintained
reviews.text:
This place is a dump.  When I checked into my room, TV did not work,  Telephone did not work.  WiFi did not work.  I called the front desk from my mobile phone and all three issues were fixed within an hour.  Day 2:  took a cold shower in the morning and the TV again did not work.

Hotel is very old and tired.  It's a great location but the property is not maintained.  It rained this morning and water was leaking from the ceiling in the hallway - thank god it was not in my room (was on the top floor).

Food is mediocre.  Drinks are served in paper cups - you can taste the wax from the cup in the drink.

Most of the staff claim they don't speak English when you ask for something.

At best, this is a 3 star property - much better options are on the island.

reviews.author: James L
reviews.title: Great Location, Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Great location, nice resort, horrible customer service. They spent more time trying to sell the next trip vs. making the current trip a great experience. Reservations for dinner were messed up every night. For the rates they charge you should expect more.  Visit Punta Cana but choose from one of the many other fine resorts.

reviews.author: C B
reviews.title: run down, rude front desk personnel, tough to communicate with staff in english, some terrible food
reviews.text: run down hotel, awful seating on beach and around pool, poor quality food. limited choices, rude staff when bringing up an issue, phones don't work, room service fails to bring complete order, requests not followed up on, lot of staff just standing around doing what??,  laundry not picked up, ice buckets don't get filled even when requested ... 2 star amateurism at its best ... over priced, waste of money for what you receive ..... back to cruising and international top hotel chains

reviews.author: Mayra L
reviews.title: Feo, viejo, NO lo recomiendo! Barcelo deluxe mil veces mejor!
reviews.text:
Habitación: piso 3 por escalera (NO HAY ASCENSOR), manchas de humedad, frigobar apagado (bebidas calientes), no funcionaba el inodoro, tampoco la televisión (de tubo). 
Hotel: antiguo. Mal servicio y comida. 
Hay todo el tiempo fiestas privadas, casamientos, etc. Mala organización para los que estamos de vacaciones descansando. 
No hay show nocturno. Las barras cierran temprano. Aburrido.
Los restaurantes ofrecen menú muy limitado. La comida en general es poco variada.
Mala señal de wifi.
Vine por segunda vez a punta cana y en esta oportunidad de luna de miel, lamento haber elegido este hotel, no vale el precio que cobran. Recomiendo una y mil veces el Barceló Bávaro deluxe (donde vine la primera vez) donde todo es moderno, la atención excelente, la comida riquísima y variada, divertido y las habitaciones soñadas. No vengan a este hotel que no es nada de lo que publican.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Health concerns with cleanliness, food, & pest control.
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach clean and can always get a place under a hut. 

Top Resturant in main lobby, I got food poisoning from Seafood.  Pool bar so much foam and scum "urine" at the edges.  Make reservations and confirm them 10 times.  Some how ours were lost and we had to beg to get into one of their restaurants.  When we did I got sick and hardly anybody was in the restaurant.  Multiple empty tables.  Why did they consistently tell us "Sorry we are full?"  They want you to eat at the Buffet " it is a money loss for them to fill up the good restaurants."
Pest control went off sporadically so when walking a mile from Main restaurants/Lobby to room or beach prepare to get Sprayed with chemicals.  Hold breath and run. A family member got bit by something.  She was ill with rash from bite, her joints stiffened and she was down for a month.  Several dead pools of water "swampy" from main area to beach and rooms.  Pretty walk long walk with flamingos etc.., but beware of the bite.  They again spray, but only mid day when walking thru.  They will tell you they only spray at night.  Those pretty huts behind each room the minute you sit prepare to be attacked by bugs.
Lastly, one of the rooms the entire wall to the outside with sliding doors was lined in Mold.  If you have allergies beware.
Rooms only cleaned with 1 chemical "vinegar?" I searched for something since my bowels exploded for 4 days.  Maids cleaning closet scary.
First night, room was not available until 10:00pm.  Manager would not upgrade or compensate all restaurants stopped serving.  Starving we waited from 5:00pm to 10:00pm.  We were meeting up with a group, but wanted to clean up before seeing everyone.
Night life fun DJ and beach dance.  However, they dress in Drag and dance on countertops.  Entertaining, but highly offensive!  Not the Drag, but the Drag in USA red, white, and Blue.  Sexy tiny clothes with the USA flag all over.  Sorry, but I love my country.  I did not disrespect their Country.

I am not a fuzzy person and this is the first review I ever wrote on a resort.  In fact, I went a year ago.  I was searching for a new place and finally decided to write this.

Maybe they got their act together?  However, Manager & Melia Corporate acted as if they did nothing wrong.

Oh, I thought I was spending $1,600 for 5 nights (not including flight) It ended up being over $2,000.   Get the Travel insurance because they do have a busy Doctor at the resort.

reviews.author: Paula S
reviews.title: Servicio Real lo peor!
reviews.text: Decidimos pasar 7 días en Paradisus con una pareja de amigos. Elegimos el servicio Real, ya que queríamos una atención de lujo, por lo cual pagamos un gran cargo extra. Este servicio consiste en una serie de instalaciones exclusivas y un mayordomo que se supone te tiene que hacer la estancia más agradable. A nosotros y a nuestros amigos nos tocó uno de nombre Ariel. La verdad es que la atención de dicho mayordomo fue pésima, con una falta de detslles y profesionalismo, que nos echó a perder la semana completa gracias a sus mentiras, errores y excusas. Como ejemplo un día estuvimos varias horas afuera de nuestra habitación, todos mojados y de noche, porque nuestro mayordomo y nadie del servicio Real era capaz de arreglar nuestras llaves, perdimos una serie de descuentos que el nunca nos notificó y cuando se lo dijimos, se excusó con tonterías, a nuestros amigos los tuvo durante un día completo sin su maleta, tenía un trato displicente desde que noto que los latinos no dábamos tanta propina como los norteamericanos . La verdad es que el hotel tiene instalaciones correctas pero la atención del personal es pésimo, nunca más vuelvo a servicio Real de Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Worst vacation ever!
reviews.text:
I have never written a review in my life but felt compelled to share my thoughts here so others can avoid making the mistake I made in booking this resort.  The treatment and service we received by this resort was criminal.  Parent company Melia overbooked hotel by 160 rooms. It took 24 hours for them to give me my room at check in. Yes 24 hours! 
Screwed us out of our upgraded rooms yet still charged us for them. Rooms not cleaned each day. Reservations at restaurants denied every night.  Rat droppings in rooms. Rude and disrespectful management.  We did not agree with any of their charges but when it comes time to checking out they hold you hostage and won't give you your luggage or allow you to get on any transportation until you pay them whatever charges they demand. Criminal!!

reviews.author: Smicunek
reviews.title: Worst Food in the history of hotels
reviews.text: First the good, rooms were decent and clean, pools were nice.   Now the bad, the food was unedible.  For an all inclusive place, I starved all week because I couldn't find anything good to eat at all.   The meats across the board didn't taste like the USA, bacon, sausage, hamburger, steak, chicken, all tasted artificial and gross.  No creamer for your coffee, only milk.  No snacks to be found anywhere except lays potato chips and plantain chips.   I can honestly say the worst food I have ever, ever, had to eat.

reviews.author: TualatinChris
reviews.title: It could be the worst hotel experience...EVER
reviews.text:
I travel more than 100 days per year.  

In spite of tipping well, I can't remember a hotel that had more indifferent service that was darn near hostile at times.

Our experience started at check-in, electronic rooms keys that didn't work - three times.  No bellman at either check-in or check-out, dragging luggage to one of the farthest rooms (3046).  Also there was no apparent way to lock the room door from the inside...housekeeping interrupted us at particularly inconvenient times.

On check-in you are given a color coded bracelet to wear.  If you have the "right" color the staff and servers are high 5ing the guest and are very attentive.  If you have the "wrong" color you are ignored.  In 35 years of traveling throughout the world, I have never experienced class distinction like this!

It felt like the concierge that made our dinner reservations at the property was doing us a favor.  The concierges clearly didn't communicate the dinner reservation to the restaurant's front of the house staff.  

The buffets look much better than food tasted.  The steak at Rare was quite nice but the gentlemen that had sommelier on his apron and zwearing the tastevin (silver cup) was clueless in the art of wine service, including reaching across my wife to serve me the nice Brunello that we had ordered.  With one exception, (Edwin Padilla who was amazing) the restaurant servers were inattentive at best.

The beach is nice but it remained a mystery how to get lounge chairs and towels, in spite of tipping.  

In the evenings there is no way to escape the techno and disco music.  That was the one advantage of having a room far away from the lobby.

The very worst experience was when I went to front desk to get change for tips.  I gave the front desk a US $50 and explained I need to tip hotel staff.  He only gave me US $45 back.  When I asked why only $45 he said "the $5 is my tip," seriously.

In a million years, we will never return to this property!

reviews.author: bjpete2017
reviews.title: Bed Bugs! Disgusting
reviews.text:
I arrived with my daughter on Monday 3/6. We were stayed in building 37. Noticed red bumps on our shoulders, hands legs, neck and face when we woke up. My husband and son arrived on Wednesday. My son then woke up with the red bumps/bites on his limbs also. I started searching our Odom and we discovered bed bugs crawling up the walls by the bed and in the bathroom. I then took my daughter to the front desk while my husband began packing our things. I told the man at the desk who told me it must be mosquitoes. I had taken pictures of the bugs on my cellphone and my daughter's which I showed him. He admitted the weren't mosquitoes and sent someone to spray our room. I asked that our room be changed and he picked up the phone and told me he would see what he can do. We waited for about 20 minutes and he said nothing else to us so we decided to go back to the room to see what was happening. The men arrived to spray told us to go onto the porch and sprayed for about 5/10 minutes and said we could go back in. There were still bugs crawling all over the walls so my husband then went to the front desk and told the same man we needed a new room. He then tried to tell my husband with me standing right next to him that it was mosquitoes. My husband showed him the pictures on the cell phone again and he. Agreed to change our room.

Our new room was in the the building 38 the next building over. When we arrived we immediately checked the room and found bed bugs crawling up the walls behind the bed in this room also. At this point my daughter and I were so upset that we were crying and just wanted to go home. We took pictures in this room also. We then went back to the front desk showed them the pictures and we told they would come spray. The men arrived to spray with a hand held spray bottle which they told me was alcohol and roach traps which they put down. They finished spraying with us still in the room in about 2 minutes this time.

They obviously have a very serious bed bug problem which they are covering up by trying to convince people their bites are from mosquitoes. Bed bugs are not killed by spray alone. We are in the process of trying to decontaminate everything we took with us and will have to now throw out all of our luggage.

You could not pay me to stay in this resort again.

reviews.author: luckyd2005
reviews.title: Be Careful of Melia Club Scam!!!! Resort Ok
reviews.text:
This was our second time in Punta Cana. The year before we stayed at Melia Level and since the experience was so wonderful, we tried this one because rooms were closer to the beach. I rated TERRIBLE since the scam of the people working at Melia Club. To sale you the membership, these people will come up with any type of lies, from free weeks on any "Melia  resort" (then it will be only RCI properties which are terribles) to promise big discounts in Melia hotels if you become a member. Because we travel a lot in Europe, we thought that was a good idea but there is no a such discount. Expedia gives you a considerable better price. Their A1plus customer service like reward points is another lie. it has been more than 6 months and messages rewards and stay still do not reflect on our account. Victor and Jorge from Melia Club are the worse, they lied you and then never answer calls or emails, their supervisor even bother to contact us after repeated complaints. 
The resort is good, our rooms were confortable and clean, housekeeping did response to all our requests. The staff was super friendly and professional except the front desk which was rude and distance. The personnel at the buffet was incredible. Specialist restaurants were ok, although the food was not big deal. Hence the staff and the resort were OK, I don't think so to go come.

reviews.author: Dwain W
reviews.title: Could have been way better
reviews.text:
Well, frustration sums up our last night. The dinner reservation process is broken and my family left here pissed. We made all of all our dinner reservations upon check in on day 1 of 7 only to find out the next day that they were misplaced. This process sucks and should be much better managed or automated.  On the first day we actually had one, it was written for us at the wrong restaurant. Then that evening we got a new card under our door that changed all of our previous reservations but left off our first choice and left our last night of vacation without a reservation. After a third trip and more than hour wasted on something I normally do on OpenTable in less than 5 minutes to accomplish a basic task we were given a 9pm reservation at our second choice restaurant our last evening and assured our troubles were behind us. Not the case. 

When we showed up for our last night dinner, guess what...no damn reservation.  After being rejected and my wife being disrespected by the person in charge, our last evening was a bust. After a scene and 20 minute wait  the staff made a late gracious attempt to accommodate us, but the damage was done. We left disappointed after losing our appetite for this whole place. It is ashamed because certain elements of the stay were great.  We liked our room and location and the  entire pool staff at the reserve were all really awesome. Unfortunately our expectations were so underserved that a Melia property will never be considered again. The building concierge staff were completely inept to deliver.
