Oh yes and if you do an excursion, be prepared for long and painful bus rides through every resort before and after. Add at least one hour and 200 speed bumps. This property is one of the first to be picked up and the last to be dropped off.  Ouch. Wish it could have better.

reviews.author: Deb A
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort but Horrible Service and FAR FROM THE BEACH!
reviews.text: We spent 4,642.00 US dollars for 3 nights (2 adults and 2 kids) and in order to get any type of decent service you have to pay more to be on the Family Concierge Plan or else you basically get nothing.  You cannot even reserve a cabana by the pool unless  you are on that plan.  All the beach cabanas are reserved for them too so no matter what you try to do- you never get the best of anything because they get all the privileges.  They tell you a golf cart will pick you up at various pick up stops, but they never come and so plan on a LONG walk back unless you walk tot he main hotel lobby that is the quickest way.  Lots of people complained about how far away it was from he beach.  Our so called Butler never made us dinner reservations so we ended up eating at the buffet every night, my husband ate some scallops and he was sick in the room for 24 hours- what a waste of a day.  We checked in at 8:30am and when we got back from he beach at 6:00PM ALL OF OUR belongings that I was told would be locked up and safe was still outside piled up and they had no idea whose stuff it was !!!  I had all my jewelry, laptops, GoPros, etc.  Then we proceeded tot he front desk and they did not even have a room for us!  Finally they came up with one but it was like the last room from the front desk so it was a hike every time you needed something.  I booked a room with 2 double beds and a pull out and they gave us a room with one king!!!!!  Our room was with a bunch of families with babies so we had like 15 strollers at the bottom of the stairs and our lobby had all kids games and cartoons on the TV, it was not what I expected.  Kids were always crying and my boys are 11 and 13 so I am over that stage and was hoping for peace and quiet.  The grounds were beautiful, but that is it!  I complained tot he general manager, but they don't do anything, but say sorry and that they will work on my concerns.  It was a huge waste of money!  We would never return to The Reserve again.

reviews.author: kb5478
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text:
Let me start with the property, my only positive.  Our initial impression of the property was "wow", lobby is open air and beautiful, the grounds of the hotel were lush and well maintained, but thats where the good ended for us.  My family of four traveled with another family of four.  Our room was not ready on arrival (earlier than posted check in, so not a problem)  they kept our bags out by the curb while we went down by the beach to eat lunch.  Lunch was buffet style and food left a lot to be desired.  Service was poor, no refills on our water, nobody cleaned up our plates and staff seemed generally annoyed if we asked for anything, a sign of things to come.  I took a trolly back to the lobby (the place is huge and they seemed to be the quickest way to get around especially with young kids).  My room was still not ready and our luggage was still sitting out by the curb with everyone else's and people walking all around.  I was able to get to my luggage open it and remove bathing suits for me and my kids, leave, come back a few minutes later to get sunscreen, without any staff so much as looking my way, glad to know it was secure!  
Dining-  You have to make a wishlist when you arrive of places and times you like to eat then they choose for you and get back to you with where you can go and when.  First night, "sorry nothing open, eat at the buffet", second night we ate a Mole, Mexican food, our waiter was great, very friendly and the food was good. Third and last night, "sorry nothing open, eat at the buffet"  not acceptable we were celebrating a birthday.  "we can get you in at 9pm at Vento, take it or leave it, all the other restaurants are closed", then she slipped and told us that the other places were busy catering to large business retreats who were taking up all the open spots.  So we had to take 4 kids to dinner at 9pm, they slept at the table.  So many places to eat and they weren't the least bit interested in accommodating  us.  On top of that with the exception of Mole, the food at the buffet, Gabi, was terrible, under cooked omelets, cold food, can't see how anyone reviewing this place could say the food was good.  Oh and the drinks, any decent liquor was an extra charge!  Not a big drinker but saw a lot of people complaining at the bar.

Rooms-  Our room was nice and clean when we arrived, but only cleaned once out of three nights, one day we didn't even get towels.  

Beach-  Unfortunately the weather for 2 of ours days was rain and we could not go to the beach.  All 4 days were very windy but we were able to get to the beach for a few hours.  The beach is nice but there was garbage, bottle caps, cigarettes, etc. littered all throughout.

Pool- The reserve pool was nice and the outdoor grill was quick and food was ok, but finding a lounger was difficult, never mind a cabana.

Overall-  we've done several all-inclusives with different companies and this was by far the worst, Staff was not helpful and often seemed like we were bothering them, i.e. getting eyes rolled at us when asking for  6 towels for 8 people at the beach.  Resort seemed more interested in conferences and work retreats than families spending hard earned money on a vacation.  Food was poor quality, trollies were few and far between, better off walking everywhere, and the restaurant reservation system is terrible.  Needless to say we won't be back.

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text:
In March 2017 I traveled with my family of 4 and another family of 4 to the Paradisus Punta Cana resort in the Dominican Republic. I had previously stayed at this resort 12 years prior and my how things have changed.

This resort is enormous, having added a "Reserve" section, which makes getting anywhere on property extremely difficult.  You either have to walk everywhere and risk being run down by the countless trolleys, pick up trucks, flat bed trucks and large box trucks that are CONSTANTLY driving around the paths of the resort.  There are no service pathways at this resort and all of these vehicles, are constantly driving around these walking paths. If you do decide to wait for a trolley, chances are that the wait will be more than 20 minutes and then when it arrives, it will be full. Especially pleasing is the constant smell of exhaust flowing from these vehicles that you are breathing in at all times while touring this "Eco-Friendly" resort.

We booked our vacation through Jet a blue Vacations, which we have used many times in many other parts of the Caribbean and Mexico without issue. Here at the Paradisus if you didn't book through a travel agent and pay for the Reserve Family Concierge or the Royal Service they treat you like dirt! We had to pick a "wish list" of restaurants for our reservations and were not able to get any of them. These upgraded guests also were guaranteed beds by the pool and at the beach which were very hard to come by. People would get up at the crack of dawn to put towels and personal items on the pool area beds and chairs and them go to the beach for the day. So, in short, no available chairs by the pool and just sand to sit on at the beach.

The resort was full of conferences which caused many of the restaurants to be closed for their events and didn't allow us to enjoy our vacation at all. It is especially pleasing to have hundreds of middle aged European men, in business casual walking by and gawking at all of the female resort guests who are lounging by the pool. A wonderful addition to our vacation was having all of these clowns staring us down. 

The restaurants were a total crap shoot, should you be able to get a reservation, you never know how the experience is going to be. Naos served traditional Dominican Food which was edible, but the service was atrocious. Several times we ordered drinks and did not receive them. The staff speaks only Spanish and we spoke very little, making this a nightmare. The staff when they did understand us, were extremely rude and this was a forgettable experience.

We experienced meals at Mole, which was traditional Mexican food and was fantastic, the staff was attentive and charming and this was easily the best meal of our trip. The constantly cold breakfast buffets at Gabi Beach, the Gabi Club and Naos were terrible. The omelette station was filthy and the eggs were always undercooked. Dinner at Vento was fine and the staff was exceptional. 

The beach was dirty, littered with garbage, bottle caps and cigarette butts. They do not rake the beach like most resorts, and the amount of people smoking cigarettes on the beach and leaving their butts was countless. Think walking on an ash tray is fun? Then you should try this resort. 

The room was not ready when we arrived, although we arrived at noon and were told to return for our keys at 3pm, when we did get the keys and make it to our room, they were just beginning to clean it. The next and subsequent days, it was at least 4 pm or later when they arrived to clean the rooms, which is really awesome when you have room service left overs sitting on the table for 12-16 hours. 

I am sure that once I post this review that the management is going to post a reply that says something along the lines of "you should have told us so we could have fixed these issues." Funny, because I tried. When we received no dinner reservation for 3/7, I went to our concierge on our building and was told that "the reservation department was unable to accommodate any of your requests" Fantastic, so they couldn't accommodate any requests Ao THEY DIDN'T MAKE ANY RESERVATIONS? How does this make any sense? So down I went to the concierge in the hotel lobby who offered me a 930 pm reservation at a restaurant we didn't want to experience. So to the front desk I go, ask to speak to a manager, who isn't available, directed back to the concierge I ask to speak to the reservation department directly (because the concierge has no power, they have to call someone on the phone to do anything). Not able to do that either, ask to speak to the food and beverage manager, no dice...So after wasting almost 1 1/2 hours on this we were offered 2 options. 9 pm dinner or.... Dinner in a closed restaurant with food from a fully booked restaurant, but we would have to eat and be out in 1 hour as a conference was coming in for an event....

In conclusion, spend the extra money, go to Mexico, the weather is windy all the time, the people aren't  friendly and the Paradisus Punta Cana in the Dominican Republic isn't a good place to go for a vacation.

reviews.author: Nathalie C
reviews.title: Service et chambre pourris
reviews.text:
Nous sommes 6 personnes d'une même famille dans 3 chambres. 2 chambres sont proches et comme demandé soit à l'étage et un lit king. 1 chambre au rez-de-chaussée toilette brisé, coffre-fort brisé, porte-patio brisé insécure, 2 lits séparés, très loin des 2 autres chambres. Dans une chambre la TV ne fonctionne pas . Les employés ne sont pas au courant de rien. Pour une recommandation de l'agent de voyage, c'est très très très ordinaire. Quand tu t'attend à mieux que des riu ou des gran Bahia c'est très décevant. Ça commence mal notre premier voyage à Punta cana. On s'ennuie du Mexique ou la Jamaïque. C'est notre premier et dernier voyage dans un Paradisus ou Melia.

Nous sommes très déçu. De plus la température  n'est pas la.

reviews.author: jleung40
reviews.title: Worst. Hotel. Ever.
reviews.text: We chose this hotel because we had stayed at a sister hotel in Madrid which was lovely. However, this one, not so much.  If you expect to get what you pay for, don't stay here.  Any time you stay at an all-inclusive resort, there is no incentive for the employees to put forth an effort to go above and beyond.  The upgraded room we originally purchased was dirty and lost in the '90's.  The bathroom had not been cleaned prior to our arrival and it appeared the room had not been updated since hotel had been built.  There was hair in the shower and along the back of the bathtub as well as nail clippings.  The tub was cracked.  The room had a foul odor about it.   The food is subpar at best.  Portion size is adequate for a child.  The restaurants were not much better than the terrible room service.  The menus are minimal.  There were not enough lounge chairs around the pools or out on the beach for a hotel this size.  If you can afford to stay in a room with a butler, service and rooms may be better.  The staff constantly knocked on the door without any pending requests.  Annoying.  They also need to pay their Dish bill....

reviews.author: PJB001
reviews.title: Massenabfertigung und schlechtes Preis / Leistungs Verhältnis
reviews.text:
Wir hatten eine Juniorsuite, alles inklusive gebucht und waren leider nicht zufrieden.
Das Hotel war voll ausgebucht (überbucht) und das Personal überfordert, der Service in den Restaurants war schlecht, keine Organisation oder Ueberwachung durch einen Supervisor und die Ausbildung der Mitarbeiter war nicht sichtbar.
Falls aber jemand einen "Jubel-Trubel-Heiterkeit" Urlaub liebt ist dies die richtige Adresse. Alkohol, Essen und laute Musik ist in grossen Mengen verfügbar.

reviews.author: Carlajneves
reviews.title: Descaso
reviews.text:
Estou hospedada no hotel, triste e decepcionada com o descaso do hotel comigo, entre tantos hotéis que poderia ter ido escolhi o paradisus palma realpra passar o meu aniversário,  assim que cheguei avisei sobre a data, ficaram de preparar algo para comemoração e nada!! Meu esposo reclamou no dia seguinte, e se desculparam dizendo que fariam algo, e NADA de novo...Procurei pela Manager Cristielle, e ninguém (das concierges) sabia quem era!!! 

RESUMO , se pretende comemorar uma data especial na sua vida NÃO É AQUI!!!

 Estragaram minha comemoração pois se não vão fazer nada, não prometam!!!
Hotel bonito, comida Boa, atendimento uns bons e outros péssimos.

reviews.author: 138guest
reviews.title: POOR TO WORSE
reviews.text:
Been on dozens of all inclusive trips and this is the first review ever>>>i feel compelled
This was my family of 4 (children 11 & 7) 2nd time visiting this resort, we do so mostly for the rooms which are lovely and spacious (master suite)...last time service and food was OK, this time it was terrible....no selection
Also beware that our concierge informed of at the beginning of the week that we were only entitled to 3 a la carte reservations as this was a new rule...turns out this was a lie and she just too lazy to try...BUT THE BIGGEST PROBLEM WAS BEACH SEAWEED!!!...it was windy during our stay and the beach filled up with the residual seaweed etc....the neglected to clean the beach ALL WEEK!!...we literally had to walk down the beach and spend our time at other resorts where the sand was clean and our children could play...PATHETIC...
We will never consider a this resort or the Palms Real again...

reviews.author: aferrisw
reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Slow staff, and the majority are unfriendly.I would give it a 6 out of 10 in cleanliness.  Food was not very good either.Very disappointed,  would never recommend it to anyone.  Everyone we travelled with agreed it needed to be updated.  This is my first bad review ever!!

reviews.author: Слава О
reviews.title: the most overrated hotel i have ever seen
reviews.text:
very surprised at such a high rating on tripadvisor. 
was very dissapointed with hotel and left after two days. 
although the common areas of hotel and bars look nice it is much overweighed by the factors i mention below:
1. the room is ancient. mayby it looked good 20-30 years ago, with its cassete player and furniture of that time, but since then it became very worn out and outdated, the room had an unpleasant smell, and almost nothing was functioning properly (internet,telephone, shower etc). 
2. the food at the resort not tasty at all. moreover it gets extremely crowded, so you have to stand in lines to get omelette in the morning, or chicken at lunch. 
3. the staff (except waitresses at the bar and bell boys) were arrogant and unpleasant.  at reception you feel as if you came uninvited to their private home. i don't know maybe they get tired of the guests because its such a huge hotel, but in the result any question or request must be asked as a personal favour several times otherwise it just gets forgotten or for example you get left haning on hold on the phone for about 20 minutes. 
very big disapointment.
i was very happy to leave this place.

reviews.author: Larissa S
reviews.title: NÃO COMPRE CLUB MELIA
reviews.text: O hotel é otimo. Mas nos primeiros dias você vai ser abordado pelo time de vendas do Melia Club. Como vc vai estar encantado e eles vão te mostrar o que eles tem de mais bonito. Vai te dar muita vontade de entrar pro club Melia. Eu e meu marido entramos nessa. Vc assina um contrato abusivo com aquelas letras bem muidas e NÃO TEM POSSIBILIDADA DE CANCELAMENTO. Já tentamos solução amigável e a corporação disse um NÃO. Vamos ter que entrar com medidas judiciais.  Então, caro viajante, não perca uma manhã da sua viagem, curta mais e evite dores de cabeça no futuro.

reviews.author: Kristen F
reviews.title: Disappointing family vacation
reviews.text:
My family checked in yesterday and I couldn't be more disappointed in this resort.  The service is bad, the food is awful, and the rooms are not comfortable.    This is not a 4.5 star resort.   

I read the reviews about how nice they were to kids and I have not found this to be true.  They do bring treats to your room but even the chocolates are horrible.

reviews.author: Marisa D
reviews.title: No Customer Service
reviews.text: I visited this hotel for Christmas 2014. I learned that year that if you arrive after Christmas Day (Dec 25) and wait to make your dinner reservations, you will either eat at 5:30 or 10:00 pm.  I WAS booked again for christmas 2016.  In the last few weeks, I have sent several emails to make reservations for dinner and reserve a Family concierge.  My emails have gone unanswered.  When I called to speak to Guest Services (of which there is no toll free number from the US), I was told that I can only make dinner reservations in person at the hotel.  When I explained my dilemma about arriving late during the Christmas holiday, I was told that there was no other option.  I cancelled my trip.  BEWARE:  if you are arriving after 12/22, most of the restaurants and water sports that require a prior reservation will be fully booked.  It's such a pity that this hotel cannot address this ongoing problem.

reviews.author: AnnaE4142013
reviews.title: Rooms Need Updating
reviews.text: The resort is average.  I wasn't impressed with the food from the buffet area.  The food from the restaurants were much better.  The rooms definitely need upgrading and soon.  Three rooms we were in had big leaks when it rains.  One of the rooms (#1059) is very damp.  They could not get the mustiness or the dampness out of the room.  When I got into bed, the sheets were wet.  Room 1204, the microwave did not work.  All the showers had no pressure.

reviews.author: zuesssssss
reviews.title: Terrible service and will never go back
reviews.text:
Room:
Lights didn't work
Phone 
Toilet sometimes flushes
Not enough towels
No remote control
Leaks thru shower door
Hand faucet pressure low
Bed squeaks
Radio didn't have antenna
I called to arrange made service for 11a.  I get a knock on my door 8:30a next morning.
I have to call for turn down service if not no service.  Chocolates one night yes another no.
Dress drawer handle broken.
Mini fridge leg broken.
Bathroom hairdryer old and works bad. Takes up both outlets.

Buffet:
Breakfast: could never find a place to sit.  We have to almost yell to get fork and knife.  I always need to flag someone for coffee.  Not enough plates and glass cups. The people barely understand English I have to use sign language.  This morning they ran out of bacon while I was standing there waiting for an hour long egg line no one came to replenish it.

Restaurants:
Sushi - sushi was disgusting.  I asked for shrimp and there is none.  All sushi comes in cream cheese.  

Mexican - I ordered 2 starters, soup and main dish.  I got 1 starter.  Soup is like soap.  

Dinner buffet:
Mice running around.  My wife couldn't sit there.  I had to ask 2 times to bring hot tea and second time I gave him a mean look.

Snack  blue agave:  40 min wait in line to order and get food.  One guy grilling for everyone.

Bar pool:  10 people standing waiting for drinks and it takes 30 mins sometimes to get just one drink.  

Beach: no service.  No one comes up asking if u want a drink or food.  Everyday they run out of beach towels and one run out same excuse, laundry can't keep up.

Entertainment:
So far the actual entertainment is good.  Yesterday they held circus on beach, not enough chairs or seats, we stood up the entire show.

Basic sentiment is not enough staff to take care of guests.  Quality of food is medium to low.  Supplies of anything is minimal.  Our workaround.  Grab 8 towels in morning.  Call operator for made service everytime.

reviews.author: suleonor
reviews.title: Sin seguridad
reviews.text: Increíble en tan hermoso y buen hotel que hayamos pasado un muy mal momento..A mis nietos les han revuelto todas sus cosas y de sus mochilas les han robado dinero yyy estamos en un lugar privilegiado con mayordomo o sea que no se puede pensar que ocurra nada malo yyy lo peor ha sido queee el hotel no se responsabiliza las quejas que hemos dado para nada entonces yo pregunto para qué uno elige este lugar especial Sii no tenemos Seguridad...Espero que cambien la forma de protejer al turista y quiero destacar la mala atención de Domingo Beltre y Eddy silvestre .

reviews.author: Gabriel R
reviews.title: Una pena por los trabajadores honestos
reviews.text:
La mala calificación es para la dirección del hotel .
En Dicienbre del año pasado estuve con mi familia , al tercer día me enferme del estomago por comer algo con una bacteria .
Quiero aclarar que yo fui el único y el hotel me mando a un centro asistencial .... de terror ,,, de terror es poco .. no tengo palabras para describir lo mal que atienden ahí .se llama HOSPITEN .
Nunca nos atendieron después de estar más de 1 hora esperando retorcido del dolor , cuando quisimos irnos a otro centro ... CENTRO MÉDICO PUNTA CANA ... ( ahí me sentí a salvo atendido como una persona ) 
No nos dejaban salir hasta mostrar que habíamos pagado estuvimos 10 minutos esperando que corroboren que no fuimos atendidos .
Por este inconveniente estuve 1,5 días internado y pase una estadía muy mala .
Por esto es tambien pedí que me otorgue el hotel otra estadía para volver , estuvieron correctos y recibí la estadía .
Ya hoy Noviembre 2016, llegamos nuevamente con mi familia , fuimos muy bien recibidos , quiero destacar él desempeño De Francisco Santos  el mayordomo , este hombre está un paso adelante , el sabe lo que necesitas antes que uno lo pida .
Los mismo para Pedro y Francisco en la playa , para todo el Staf de Palazzo, y para el mozo de Aqua  Keidy Trinidad.
Hasta que al 4 día en la habitación de mis hijos les faltó dinero y pertenencias , les habían robado revisándoles las pertenencias .
Hicimos la denuncia , era muy fácil descubrir al autor o autora ya que ellos se dieron cuenta en un lapso de 5 horas de tiempo , solo tenían que hacer una lectura de llaves de la puerta .
Pero nos sorprendió la respuesta de Beltre Domingo y Edy Silvestre .
La investigación no arrojó resultados , aquí no a pasado nada .
Que mal manejan los problemas , a mí ya no me importa , ni yo ni mi familia volveremos , pero los turistas que vendrán y los empleados que desempeñan su trabajo tan fiel y efusivamente no se lo merecen .

reviews.author: fk0160
reviews.title: Para que se enteren lo que hacen
reviews.text: Vinimos en familia a festejar mi cumpleaños y todo fue perfecto hasta que nos robaron dinero y revisaron todo en la habitación! Un desastre! Nadie se hizo responsable ni siquiera pudimos saber quién es el que roba, así que mucho cuidado ! Realmente pasar unas vacaciones con esa amargura es muy feo, no recomiendo para nada el hotel y menos el sector de Royal Service que es donde estamos porque te vas a amargar las vacaciones! Nunca me pasó algo así en ningún hotel ! Si no fuera por la gente de palazzo y de Francisco y Pedro de la playa, que son la linda gente que vale nombrar, no esperen nada más! Roban tus pertenencias!

reviews.author: Sharon S
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: This is the worst. The rooms smell of mold and mildew. There is actually mold growing on the AC duct.  We had moved to 3 rooms and gave up. Our sons room was filthy and not cleaned. The restaurant Passions is the only good thing about this resort which of is extra cost and actually worth the cost .   You have to pay extra for good liquor and food at every restaurant  Staff only speaks Spanish and is not friendly. To eat at any place other than the Buffet which is not the best you have to make reservations which is extremely difficult and once you show up they don't have room or food for you.  Our family had booked 30 rooms and a wedding.   What a disappointing trip.   Shame on Paradisus Palma. You ruined our family vacation!

reviews.author: schic1
reviews.title: NEVER GO IN THE CASINO
reviews.text: Never spend any money in the casino. The entire staff try's to steal your money. They are all in it together and give you conflicting answers when you question them about the hand, roll, minimum bet, coupons....everything.

reviews.author: Ralph V
reviews.title: Royal Service is Royal Shaft
reviews.text:
The letter below was sent to the resort  and upper management at Meliá, the owners of this property  and their response was too bad so sad. 

To Whom It May Concern
I am writing to share with you about our experience at your resort Paradius Palma Real in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  

First I would like to begin by saying that our trip was mainly to celebrate our one year anniversary and to be able to relax and  recharge our batteries from our hectic day to day life.  Upon on arrival to the resort we were taken to the royal guest service check in area. We were greeted by a lady who gave us the cell phone for our butler and an envelope with resort  credit vouchers.  Vouchers were simple (see attached sample) and No further explanation was provided with the vouchers.  Angelo our butler picked us up and took us to our room.  Upon our arrival in the room we noticed that the room was hot but he assured us it would get cooler.  Angelo asked if we would like to store our valuables in the safe and he would take us on a tour of the property.  We attempted to use the safe but it was not working so he called for someone to fix it. 30 minutes and  three workers later the safe was fixed. Room was still a stifling 80 degrees.  We went on our tour came back approximately 25 minutes later and the room was still extremely hot. Angelo dropped us off called for someone to come and look at the AC.  A worker came looked at it and said "Angelo didn't know how to use the AC" he pushed a couple of buttons and left.  We sat there and waited for the AC to cool off, one hour later still  at 81 degrees.  At this point we asked to have our room changed. We were moved to the first  floor.  I'd like to point out that prior to us arriving the room had been decorated with rose petals, which meant that someone from the hotel staff had spent time in the room and should have noticed that the AC was not working.  The second room we were placed had a humidity problem so we asked for a humidifier to be placed in the room.  This didn't help and the reality is that the room was never cold.  I also like to point out that for a five star resort I have never seen such poor quality in bath towels.  Towels were so rough that using them after sun bathing was very painful.  I find it funny that the resorts puts effort into asking what type of pillow you want (not that we got them) and even the scent you want on your pillows but doesn't put any effort into purchasing quality towels for the guest. 
Prior to arriving the hotel we were asked for our interests and we had indicated dun buggy and horse back riding. Angelo our butler recommended we see Salvador at Olympus tour coincidentally the same tour company our travel agent used to book our trip.  We met with Salvador and he recommended two tours. He showed us pictures of the tour and read off from the back of the receipt what we needed to bring on the tours (e.g., water shoes, camera, sunscreen, money).  At no point did he mention we should bring disposable cloth.  The dun buggy tour was a disaster. The tour guide advised to keep our mouth covered at all time as we would be exposed to "cow poop, donkey poop, dog poop, all kind of poop".  It had rained the night before and God knows what the mud was made off.  Mud seeped from the floor into the Polaris dun buggy covering all of our belonging in mud including us. We were covered in mud from head to toe from the start of the tour through the end.  We were told we would visit a cave and beach but at no point did they tell us that the tour included stopping at a shop in the middle of nowhere to hear someone trying to sell us "natural" tea, chocolate, oregano, oil, vanilla, etc.  Tour was scheduled to last 3 hours, we were picked up at 740 am and did not arrive back to the hotel until 130pm.  My $60 tommy Bahamas t-shirt and baseball cap was ruined and my wife's nylon Longchamp bag was covered in mud amongst everything else we had with us. On our way back the open aired bus had rolled up plastic shades as it started to rain you would have thought that the driver would have pulled over to bring them down but no he drove the entire time while we got soaked.  Upon on arrival at the hotel we went to see Salvador to tell him about our experience. He gave us a hard time and advised us that we should have 
Known better. He even went as far as to say if we didn't like  the tour we should have taken a taxicab back.  I was flabbergasted, I could not believe that this was his recommendation when he knew perfectly well we were in the middle of no where.  I requested a refund and canceled the horseback riding tour we had scheduled. Salvador would not refund our money until I mentioned that my comments on trip advisor would not reflect positively on this experience, then he agreed to a refund if I would sign a waiver indications I would not right anything negative.  At this point I requested to speak with the hotel manager.  A gentleman named Domingo met with me listened to what had occurred since our arrival and offered to launder our cloth (which by the way didn't work, my shirt was ruined) and take us to the spa as a consolation for the stress we had incurred.  He stated that "we would be taken care of that our bill would be almost nothing" he personally took us to the spa spoke with the manager and asked her to take care of us.  At the end of a wonderful spa experience we were given a bill for $425.00 US dollar. At this point we were a bit perplexed as to "what being taken care of and paying almost nothing" meant.  We were asked if we had Royal service vouchers and we said yes but had not brought them with us.  We returned the next day to hand in our $50 voucher per treatment which was not applied to our final bill until we checked out and had to complain about it. 
We also attempted to use the vouchers at the gift shop not sure how they worked only to be told by the staff they were not valid.  After speaking with a store manager who looked at the vouchers again she advised us that we needed to spend $100 and then They could apply the $10 voucher.  Nowhere on the voucher did it states how the vouchers were to be applied or how much we had to spend.  If you recall at the beginning of this letter I mentioned vouchers were just handed to us.  Only to learn upon check out that the "official" vouchers were not available when we checked and copies had been given to us with no explanation.  

Anytime we stepped out of "Royal service" area, service deteriorated.  The Restuarant that serviced the breakfast buffet was short staff and you could barely get anyone to serve you in a timely manner.  On two occasions that we ate there we had to get up and find wait staff in order to get coffee or napkins.  We attempted to use the catamaran three times on three different days which meant we spoke with the staff coordinating these services three times and finally was able to secure one and upon getting into the water was told we needed lessons and had to pay for them AND book them separately.  Do you think they could have asked or mentioned this any of the times we  met with them so that our time would not have been wasted.  Needless to say we never rode the catamaran. 
We made Gabriela the Royal Service manager and Domingo the Guest Service Manager aware of all of our situations.  I also made attempt to speak with the general manager and was told I could not speak directly to the GM that all concerns had to go through Domingo.  At this point I felt I was in some type of dictatorship were I was being restricted.  Completely understand Its a different country from the US but good customer service is good customer service regardless of where you are and especially if I paid for ROYAL SERVICE.  

On our last day as we checked out we discovered that our spa treatment still were $425 no vouchers applied and no " being taken care of by Domingo".  And we refused to pay the bill because we explained that we were owed a credit our luggage would not be released.  At this point we just wanted to go home. So I was left with no choice but to pay. 

Please take a moment and put yourself in our shoes. We just wanted to relax recharge and celebrate our one year anniversary. However we left stressed and disappointed.  I am requesting a full refund to be able to redo my anniversary trip due to your lack of responsiveness, the fact that you promised Royal treatment which we didn't receive and poor customer service. 

Ralph Viera

reviews.author: JonahG1085
reviews.title: Cockroach and Blood found in 2 different rooms
reviews.text:
After being recommended by family and friend to visit the Paradisus Real Resort, I was extremely DISAPPOINTED in the Service, Cleanliness, Food offered by the resort. 

My fiancé and I arrived at 2:30pm to find that not ready and the gentlemen who was checking in told us the room would be ready in "5 minutes", which in reality mean at least 30min to locals. Upon checking into our room, we encountered 2 cockroaches, Stained Towels, Stained Carpets, Stained Windows, half empty mini bar and clogged toilet. I contacted management immediately who at first didn't seem to believe that I had found a cockroach but left it there for them to see. Out check in took 2 hours.

After being switched to another room, we found what looked to be blood stains on our sheets and once again contacted management. At this point we asked kindly that we didn't feel comfortable staying at the hotel after everything we had encountered in that short amount of time. The manager offered to change our sheets and once he did, the ones he replaced the blood stained once was ALSO dirty. I couldn't believe that it happened not once or twice, but 3 times.

We tried asking to be let out of our night but were forced to stay or LOSE our MONEY.

The food was extremely POOR quality which caused my fiancé and I to eat outside of the resort.

This place is a complete steal. STAY AWAY

reviews.author: Renat T
reviews.title: Horrible from Start to Finish
reviews.text:
We booked the Royal Service and were treated like peasants. 
I am the type of traveler that is usually willing to look past certain imperfections when traveling, nothing is ever perfect, but my experience at this hotel has been terrible. A lot of this has to do with the staff and their training, and possibly for the entire hotel thinking that losing one customer is not a big deal. A waiter should acknowledge customer's presence in a timely manner and not have to be called over multiple times before finally taking an order (it shouldn't take 1 hour just to place an order), a waiter needs to do a better job communicating with guests regarding their needs it shouldn't take an hour just for the order to be placed and another hour before your food is finally brought out to you, and perhaps teach your waiters to smile and be courteous, this is the service industry. WiFi only worked a one third of the time. Why advertise these amenities if they don't work. The staff is taught to apologize 10 times, but no action is taken to actually resolve the problem. The rooms are dirty we had to have them re-cleaned when checking in not just one room but two... The food is atrocious in every restaurant outside of the one restaurant that is for a fee. Beach Butlers are ill mannered - overly rude, for the extra money that you pay for royal service you would expect it - apparently not at this property...
 I will never stay at the Paradisus Palma Real ever again, nor will I recommend it to anyone. This may have turned me off from coming back to Dominican Republic ever again. And P.S Front Desk Management just doesn't care...

reviews.author: 60travisf
reviews.title: I would avoid
reviews.text: The problems my family experienced from start to finish were enough to make us never want to use this resort chain again. The resort feel's like something out of a 1980's movie. The rooms are so outdated and boring. The food was blah. The service we received was either hit or miss and they missed frequently.

reviews.author: Humberto M
reviews.title: Robo de lentes correctivos en habitación. Notificado al momento del Check Out. El check in fue muy lento.
reviews.text: Fueron robados Lentes correctivos dejados en una de las habitaciones de la reserva. Se notificó pero no se recibió colaboración sobre el problema. No se aprecian los beneficios de Melia Rewards a pesar se que poseo el mayor estatus posible. Check in muy tardío. Una de las habitaciones se entregó pasadas las 4:00 pm.

reviews.author: JGeary
reviews.title: Disgusted By Treatment
reviews.text: I pre-paid for a friend's honeymoon room as a wedding gift. When he arrived the resort asked that he produce my credit card, which he obviously could not do. Despite the fact that the room was pre-paid, they demanded his credit card or threatened that he'd have to leave the resort! Now both my friend and I have paid for the same room and no one from Melia can help. I've called the resort only to be met by silence on the other end. I've emailed the resort and received zero response. I've called Melia International Customer Service, and all they can do is direct me back to the resort. To add insult to injury, I'm a Club Melia member! If this is how they treat their members, imagine how they'll treat you and your family. I would advise anyone considering a vacation with Melia to consider a different resort.

reviews.author: Jacqueline M
reviews.title: Please be ware!!!
reviews.text:
I must admit the resort is beautiful and the beaches are nice.  We had an awful experience.   I must share with the public. Be wary before you book this resort.  
We booked with Travelocity.  (Fantastic company).  We arrived at the resort after many hours of traveling after an hour and a half of confusion the finally get us a room!   It was a one bed for 4 people !! After complaining and hearing excuses that Travelocity should not have booked it as 2 even though we paid for it we got a room with 2 beds. 
The employees are polite but the administration is awful!!
This morning upon checking out at 4 Am. While the taxi was waiting to get us to the airport. I was robbed of $435.00
on my credit card.   They would not give us a PASS to. Leave without this additional money!!   They made another excuse about needed more money .  I was under duress and wanted to leave ASAP so I paid . All evening I was on the phone with Travelocity. Who are fantastic at resolving theses problems.    I hope it works out 
Please.  Note there are many choices for Vacation.  Do not pick this one !!!

reviews.author: Robertluba
reviews.title: Overpriced ripoff!!!
reviews.text: Paid for the Royal Service. Service was poor. Nighttime activities and entertainment were terrible. Would never pay for Royal Service again at this hotel. In room bar service and amenities were pathetic.

reviews.author: S M
reviews.title: If You a e thinking of staying think again
reviews.text:
First the food SUCKS. There are a good number of restaurants but unless you like eating crappy food with little to no flavor then you are out of luck. We went to the pay to eat restaurant hoping we would be able to get a good meal and it was like you stepped into a 1990s time warp with a menu that was uninspiring and we even sent one of the plates back. 
The people are nice and the staff is nice but since it is an all inclusive resort there is no rush to open the bars. We booked the best package and the room was nice but there was mold all in the shower and it needed a serious scrubbing of the soap film that was everywhere. 
Would I stay here again. Probably not although the the kids did have fun. 
Oh and be prepared to try to be sold a crazy vacation membership for upwards of 80k US. Yes that is right Melia is all about trying to sign you up. It is not a timeshare but you can assume the sales process is exactly the same. 

Book if you want but look for something else if you want good food and good booze.

reviews.author: CBN1310
reviews.title: Una lástima, porque el sitio es verdaderamente maravilloso...
reviews.text:
Antes de expresar mi opinión, quiero agradecer a cuatro personas en particular, sin las cuales la estadía habría sido simplemente insoportable: Gerardo del Rosario (alimentos y bebidas), Rosana (camarera), Daniel (minibar) y Edwin (playa): a ustedes, muchísimas gracias por sus atenciones, de verdad hicieron la diferencia.

Volví al Paradisus Palma Real después de 9 años, porque aquella vez la experiencia (corta) fue maravillosa... Tenía una deuda conmigo misma que quise honrar convidado a TODA la familia, a lo que pensé iba a ser una experiencia maravillosa y por ende inolvidable.

Dicho esto, comienzo por expresar que la oferta en la página web del hotel es engañosa.  Las reservas no prepagadas no son tales reservas (al menos así nos ocurrió). No es cierto que haya un espacio para niños y para adolescentes, como lo ofrecen: el kids zone, con acceso muy limitado para los huéspedes ajenos a The Reserve, es para niños pequeños (máximo de 8 años): no hay acceso a la piscina, sino para actividades programadas; no hay derecho ni a un vaso de agua.  Cuidado con la descripción de las habitaciones.  Nuestra Luxury Junior Suite no tenia ducha spa (más bien estaba roto el piso de la ducha), los televisores son vetustos y no tenía reproductor de DVD. Ah! y la kitchenette que ofrecen en Internet no existe: se limita a un fregadero, un tope, unos gabinetes de cocina vacíos y el minibar (que es muy pobre en oferta).  Nunca supimos cómo funcionaba la bañera de hidromasajes. El servicio de comida a las habitaciones es muy limitado.

Me voy a detener un poco en la habitación (una Luxury Junior Suite): en términos generales, estaba bien; incluso nos prestaron una cuna para nuestro bebé de un año. Sin embargo, el colchón del sofa-cama que usó nuestro hijo mayor era verdaderamente inaceptable; luego de dos días lo cambiaron por uno apenas aceptable.  Nos atendieron muy bien Rosana (camarera) y Daniel (minibar), pero la camarera del turno nocturno nos eliminó de la ronda, con el inconveniente de que no nos dejaba el programa del día siguiente. En cualquier caso, a pesar de la amabilidad de las personas que nos atendieron, las toallas son un horror (incluso nos dieron toallas rotas un día).

El servicio de recepción es terrible.  Por nuestra experiencia, recomendamos que antes de salir a Punta Cana, obtenga directamente del hotel (no del sitio web) la confirmación de sus reservas (habitaciones, transporte, etc.) y que exija, antes del check out, que le den un corte de cuenta (porque no todo está incluido): no se vaya a llevar la sorpresa al salir.

El servicio de atención al cliente por vía telefónica es bastante deficiente.  Hacer las reservaciones para cenar o para el spa puede ser un martirio.  Menos mal contamos con Gerardo para las comidas de cada día de nuestra estancia, y que encontramos a María en el Gabi Beach Club a media tarde para hacer las reservas en el Spa.  Hay que ir personalmente a hacer las reservas o pedir auxilio en atención al cliente.

Debo decir que el servicio al cliente en el escritorio especial para eso, funciona bastante bien; como funciona bien el servicio para pedir transportes internos o externos.

La comida está bien. El buffet (Naos) está muy bien surtido, literalmente para todo gusto; pero hay que estar pendientes de los horarios: no es cierto que este abierto durante TODO el día.  En Olio, las pizzas, especialmente el calzone, muy ricas (las pastas no tanto). Fuego (peruano), muy rico.  Vento, la verdad, me decepcionó. Aqua, NADA QUE VER (y eso de que está sobre el agua¿?). Ibana (japonés), divertido. Rare (carnes), malo. Blue Agave, de mexicano poco, pero está bien para un almuerzo rápido mientras se está en a playa o la piscina. Grab&Go, cierra cuando más lo necesitas.  Resiento que no haya opciones de comida o alguna flexibilidad para bebés que ya comen sólidos, pero no la típica comida de los menúes para niños (poco saludables por demás), ni compotas saladas (buark).  Pedir un arroz blanco sin condimento, jugo natural sin azúcar… proezas; y menos mal Daniel del minibar nos preparó una pastina (dos veces).

No estuvimos en las discos, bares o afines, porque viajamos con niños.  En todo caso, como la camarera del turno nocturno nos sacó de su ronda, nunca nos enteramos de las actividades previstas para cada día.

La playa, simplemente maravillosa, especialmente en el área del Club.  También la piscina, aunque debo decir que no había servicio de toallas ni de nada...

El Yhi Spa: me atendió maravillosamente Aracelis (fisioterapeuta), para un masaje muscular profundo... No lo voy a olvidar. Lamento no haber usado más las instalaciones.  Notar que hay dos sedes: una en el área principal y la otra en The Reserve.

Otra cosa que no voy a olvidar es que, como leí en otro comentario, algo pasaba con el personal: a pesar del trato cordial en general y la evidente formación de todas las personas que trabajan en el hotel, pasaban el día discutiendo entre ellos, molestos por algo, y francamente se notaba mucho.

Para terminar, así como la primera vez me quedé con ganas de volver, esta vez digo: no vuelvo.  Y lo lamento, porque el sitio es verdaderamente maravilloso.  Tal vez no han sabido manejar el crecimiento.

reviews.author: trujiyi
reviews.title: Day 1 - awful
reviews.text: S so I wouldn't normally write a review on the first day of my vacation but I am so upset that I had to. If we had paid a small sum for this vacation I would suck it up but we paid $2,500 for a 4 night stay for 2 adults /2 kids so I'm expecting a little more. Let's start with the room.. Old, motel looking room. Sofa bed lost a spring and they supposedly were bringing a bed big enough for my girls except they left the springless sofa bed. We paid $800 extra for the concierge service which is the biggest waste of money because we have been walking and taking care of everything ourselves. Then they offer in-room dining 24 hours a day except nobody picks up the phone. I will definitely be speaking to management tomorrow because this us unacceptable. One of the worst hotels I have ever stayed at. Very disappointed

reviews.author: kacraze35
reviews.title: WORST HOSPITALITY EVER
reviews.text:
Worst hospitality EVER! Have sworn to never return again.
 
To begin with let me first state that the property itself is beautiful. It is massive and there is much to do (so I hear). Having said that I think I can safely say that this has been my worst experience in any hotel as far as the service goes. I have never been this disappointed or annoyed with any hotel, ever! Brace yourselves; this is going to be long.
 
We checked into the hotel at about 6pm and were given a green wristband (all inclusive resort) indicating our package. Once the check-in formalities had been fulfilled we asked Cruz, the lady at the reception, what was in our package, about the property and if there was someone who could show us around. We were told that Juan would escort us to our room and will give us the necessary information. When we ask Juan the same thing, he told us since the guest services desk had left for the day, we would be taken around tomorrow. He would meet us for breakfast at 10 am and would show us around then. At this point we remembered that we read at the time of booking that we were to get resort credits, no one at the hotel mentioned anything to us. We asked Juan about this, he said the staff had left and that again, we could only get it the next day.  We ordered some dinner and retired for the night.
 
The next day we woke up to lovely weather, famished we were looking forward to having a quick bite to eat, be shown around our own resort and spending the afternoon at the beach. We caught up with Juan at about 10:15 he said we would be taken for breakfast shortly, we were made to sit at the lobby, sign a few papers saying that we are agreeing to be shown around and be told about the “Melia” rewards club. I am sorry to say but this was an emotional blackmail on his part as he coaxed us into signing our session for 90 mins as he would only then get his points, we weren’t even sure if we had an option to sit for less time. Just to be clear, I have no complaints against Juan, he just seemed to be doing his job.
 
We were then taken to a separate room and introduced to Ari who was to tell us about the Melia club membership, take us around the property and take us for breakfast. By the time we were made to sign and fill multiple papers and asked about our vacationing it was past 11am. And guess what, the breakfast buffet was on only till 11am. By this time we were extremely hungry. Ari took us to a snack bar and well in short I was having nachos for breakfast, I didn’t even get to eat till I was full as we had to move on with the “tour”. Again, no complaints against Ari, she was just doing her job. For the next 2 hours we were taken around the premium property (Reserve) not even our own and shown what we COULD benefit from, from joining the Melia Membership. We have still not been told what our green band (package) gives us access to or what’s in and around about our property. After this long tour that has already eaten up into our day we are brought back to the Club membership room and are asked about our interest in signing up. All in all they ate up 3.5 hours of our vacation time. Finally at 1:30pm I was too hungry to be polite any more and asked to be excused for Lunch. So relieved at the chance of a proper meal and to finally get on with our day. Its no wonder they hound you on your first day, as if you stay any longer you would realize what a big mistake it is to even think of signing up. Lunch was great. A special mention here for Chef Besant (I hope I am spelling his name correct) and the wait staff. Being vegetarian is tough but they went out of their way to accommodate us.
 
At this point it has been almost a day we have been here and we still don’t know anything about our resort (which is massive and the multiple coloured bands leave you wondering what you have access to). We scouted out the counter for our resort credits by ourselves, no one seemed interested to assist us in anyway and we knew if we waited any longer the guest services staff would have left for the day.

THE RESORT CREDITS ARE NOT CREDITS THEY ARE COUPONS which have numerous terms and conditions and you are only allowed to use a certain amount for one particular item.
 
A special mention here about the keycards. They were getting discharged whether we kept them with the phones or not. It did not matter. Later we realised they were only charging our card for a one time use!!!!!!! The resort is huge and just walking from the room to the reception takes a full 6 minutes (I timed it). Can you imagine how much time we wasted just going up and down to re charge the key card every single time we wanted to get to our room! By the second day we figured this out so we used to stop by the reception to get our card charged before we headed down to our room. Only after we complained, for our very last day there, our key card worked for the full day.
 
We spent the rest of the day out with our friends. When we got back at about 11pm the gentleman at the reception said that at check-in our credit card details weren’t taken (goof up at their end) and therefore we needed to give him our cards details instantly. While all this was happening since we were at the reception we decided to ask (since no one was interested in helping us anyway) about what benefits our green band gave us and what the different colours indicated.  We were told the black band was for people who had booked via the Melia website and gave guests access to many more areas than the green. And guess what, of course we had booked through the website and had been given the wrong band this whole while. (Reiterating here that had we not asked we would have been with the green band for our whole stay here)
 
Oh by the way, the dirty plates from our first night here are still lying outside our room and continued to stay there for two full days (I have pictures!).
 
Again we were out all day the next day got back at about 5pm, tried to make dinner reservations for 7pm but the guest services counter was closed (how would we know when no one has bothered to tell us anything anyway) and they said our best bet would be to go directly to the restaurant. We went and ate a lovely meal ordered wine and since we couldn’t finish the bottle we asked them to send the bottle to our room. We got back to the room, waited for a while, the wine didn’t reach, and we had plans so we left. The bottle only reached the next evening 7pm after I called room service.
 
The next morning we called for breakfast in the room, I asked for a cappuccino, they out rightly said no, and that they were too busy and I needed to go down to the bar to get it. I requested a little harder saying I don’t mind if the froth disappears, then after thinking about it they said okay (I must mention here that I was sick with a stuffy nose and just wanted to drink my coffee in bed). What I got was watery coffee with split milk (I have a picture). What a wonderful way to wake up right? (Just to add here, the next day I went down to the bar for a cappuccino and was told I would only get it at the buffet restaurant so I went there next and was given machine dispensed coffee, I cannot believe a resort this big does not own a cappuccino machine)
 
At this point we decided to speak to the manager. We went to the reception and asked to speak to the manager and were told to wait 10 mins. 10 mins turned to 30mins with no sign of the manager. When we went back to the reception she tells us that he is in a meeting and is not sure how long he will be! Like jeez, how about you inform the person waiting.
 
At this point I was so over this hotel, I barely wanted to spend anytime here (so much for the all inclusive) so we were out pretty much the whole day. When we got back I immediately went to the reception to get the key card charged for the Nth time (since we figured the drill to save us the long walk back and forth) The cheeky receptionist decided he wanted to interrogate me (and when I say interrogate I mean Interrogate), what my names was, who was saying with me, what my room number was, when did I check in, when do I check out etc etc made me sign some stupid register apparently stating it was protocol (protocol that was not being followed the past 8-9 times we had recharged our cards or for anyone else that was asking for their card to be recharged) despite the fact that I did not ask for a NEW CARD but was RECHARGING a card that was discharged. This was the last straw for me.  I have never been so humiliated or have ever had such trouble getting to my own room before (a place I have already spent 2 nights and 3 days!)
 
I got back to the room very upset and ask to be told when the manager (I have to hunt for his name) was around. The manager arrived. He heard us out said that no one has ever had such a bad time at their resort and so many things have never gone wrong all at once. He said he would look into the matter and investigate to see what was going on. Believe it or not, till the time we checked out (which was 2 days from then) we never heard back from him. Ridiculous!
 
Oh and did I mention, I was celebrating my 30th birthday here and despite the fact that the receptionist, the guest services desk, the manager, the room service attendant and the Melia Rewards Membership desk knowing it was my birthday not one person bothered to wish me. Just to be very clear this is not something I expect, it is just called courtesy. The so called all-inclusive super exclusive hotel did nothing but ruin my stay and my birthday whereas a tiny corner restaurant just down the street where I only had a couple of drinks managed to make it so much more special.

At check out, I am still confused at to what areas my band allows me access to and I realise that not one person ever game me a straight answer when I asked them.

Let it be said that with the experience that I have had here, I don’t understand why anyone in their right mind would ever want to be a part of the Melia Club. Never ever again. I am disgusted beyond words. This is the very reason I believe properties have no value without exceptional service.

reviews.author: Rmerk2
reviews.title: In Room Service is awful
reviews.text: Don't Trust the in Room Service 24 hrs, is a waste of time, only 4 things in the menu and when you finally get it  touch with them they will say they only have pizza and sandwich and you'll have to wait an hour. They offer this service as a 24 hrs and if you call during midnight you'll remember about this comment.

reviews.author: silviariba2016
reviews.title: La peor recepción del mundo
reviews.text:
El peor servicio de recepción del mundo.
Buenos días,  el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real, de la matriz Meliá, disfruta de una excelente ubicación, entre Bávaro y Punta cana, dispone de notables instalaciones, con un atrio monumental a continuación de la piscina y ésta dispuesta al mar. Cuenta también con un servicio gastronómico muy recomendable. Pero pueden hacer que en una estancia de descanso merecido  te sientas con la incomodidad de un rehén.  ¿Cómo se consigue?  Con el peor servicio de recepción del mundo, y cómplices en los servicios de limpieza y animación.
Permítame explicarme. Por el aniversario de mis primeras cinco décadas,  mi mujer me preparó un viaje a República Dominicana con el punto álgido en el Hotel Paradisus Palma Real.
Con la experiencia de los años,  uno ya sabe que las cosas, aunque nunca son perfectas, pero que se puede, y se tiene que disfrutar de ellas, pero eso puede resultar imposible. Detallemos. A la llegada, en el lounge de la recepción, el Sr. Ardanza, un compatriota, mostró más interés, en vender el plus del Royal Service, que en alojarnos en la Master Suite que teníamos contratada, nos dejó una tarjeta de la habitación, con el anagrama del Royal Service para que lo tuviéramos siempre presente.  La Sra. Suelegel , que era nuestra conserje, no quiso que hiciéramos las  reservas de las cenas en los restaurantes temáticos, ya que lo haríamos mañana. Nosotros amablemente reusamos el servicio.  A la llegada a nuestra Suite, el ruido de  máquinas era ensordecedor, una vergüenza que un hotel así tenga habitaciones con estas condiciones, por lo que pedimos cambio de habitación. Al Sr. Ardanza, se lo pusimos fácil, no queríamos el Royal Service, y estábamos dispuestos a cambiar la ubicación de la habitación aunque fuera de categoría menor. Entonces nos dijo que pidiéramos las nuevas tarjetas en el mostrador de la recepción y que él se ocuparía que nuestras maletas fueran enviadas a la nueva habitación. En mostrador, entregamos las tarjetas, reprogramaron la del anagrama del Royal Service pero no la otra. Al  llegar a la habitación una tarjeta no habría.  Entramos con la otra y esperamos las maletas. Después de reclamar las maletas, hablar con los maleteros  y esperar dos horas llegaron las maletas, y nos dijeron que estaban en la primera habitación. Todavía teníamos paciencia y no protestamos. Siguiente servicio de recepción, llamada a las 23: 45 h, que nos despierta, para decirnos que nos enviaban un cuadro de los que se vendían en el hotel y que habíamos encargado, cosa que no era cierta. Después de minutos de confusión la recepción me pregunta con que habitación está hablando. Tardé en conciliar el sueño un par de horas.
Al día siguiente, salí pronto de la habitación y me dirigí al gimnasio. Al regresar a la habitación, la llave no habría. De nuevo volví a la recepción, y me encontré con la Sra. Suelegel, que me dijo que podíamos reservar la cenas y que me quería hablar de un almuerzo VIP, (ventas),  le dije que primero solucionáramos la problemática de la habitación y me envió al mostrador. Allí mostré mi disconformidad por el mal funcionamiento de las tarjetas, y me soltaron la típica charla que no se pueden llevar con imanes ni teléfonos móviles, etc. Cuando se le indica que no había estado en contacto con imanes, me dijeron que mi mujer había estado en recepción y que habían cambiado la tarjeta porqué no funcionaba. Ahora al darme nuevas tarjetas las anteriores dejaban de funcionar. Tenía que encontrar a mí mujer, y decírselo, porqué a ella no se lo habían dicho. Un Resort es un sitio muy grande para buscar a una persona. 
Fuimos a la tarde a reservar las cenas y nos dijeron que no podía ser. Que el sistema se cierra a las 16:00 y que volviéramos mañana. (Por lo visto, no tienen papel y lápiz para hacer una anotación en una agenda). 
Al día siguiente fuimos de nuevo y hablamos con recepción, encontramos al Sr. Valdimir, que  de explicarle las problemáticas nos dijo con semblante altivo, que ellos no estaban acostumbrados a las críticas y que recibiríamos las reservas de las cenas en la habitación. Con la experiencia, pedí los comprobantes, que me facilitó todos menos dos, que me dijo que recibiríamos en la habitación, ya que él se lo apuntaba en la agenda. La palabra del Sr. Vladimir vale tanto como su agenda, cero, pues nunca llegaron a la habitación ni tuvimos noticia alguna.
En la piscina también vi la importancia de no ser ni mujer ni disponer del Royal Service. Estaba tomando el sol en la piscina, y el equipo de animación me ofreció participar en una clase de Spining acuático, cuando ya estaba encima de la bicicleta y había colocado el asiento a la medida de mi peladeo, aparecieron un grupo de mujeres, por lo que el Sr. de  animación con el sobrenombre de “Gasolina”,  me dijo que dejara la bicicleta porqué estas estaban reservadas y que ya haría la actividad en otro turno o día.  Me vinieron a buscar ellos para hacer la actividad!. Por respeto a los otros clientes del hotel, no exterioricé mi desacuerdo.  Pero la próxima vez que el Sr. “Gasolina” se me acercó para participar en algo, se lo reproché, el negó primero que fuera él, y después dijo que no se acordaba.
Reclamamos el comprobante de reserva de la cena y la Sr. Sueligel, nos dijo  que eso lo habláramos con el Sr. Vladimir, que ella quería que fuéramos al desayuno donde vendían una membresía del Hotel. Aunque le expliqué que yo no había contratado con el Sr. Valdimir, ni el Sr. Ardanza, sino con Meliá,  No son capaces de reservar una cena en un restaurante del propio Resort y quieren vender un servicio de años de duración.
Pero el clímax llegó el día de mi cumpleaños. Mi mujer, cómo  sorpresa, encargó un pastel, que tenía que servirse en la cena, con la típica presentación de diversos camareros. Cenamos y mi mujer parecía enfadada, yo no sabía el motivo, no quiso postre. A la volver a la habitación, en el pabellón más alejado del Resort, las tarjetas no funcionaban ninguna de la dos. De nuevo a la recepción y otra vez la charla de que las tarjetas se borran si están en contacto con los teléfonos etc. etc.  Aquí ya fui tajante y les expresé que las tarjetas las habían inutilizado desde la recepción porqué habían fallado la dos, y pedí cita con la gerencia de recepción para explicar todas las molestias que estábamos sufriendo. Me dieron cita para las 09:30 horas de la mañana.
Al regresar a la habitación, vimos la tarta que había de ser servida en el restaurante, (mi sorpresa) y que había sido el motivo para entrar en la habitación y desactivar las tarjetas.   Al día siguiente, en vez de disfrutar de las vacaciones, esperamos en recepción para hablar con el gerente. El Sr. Domingo Beltelec, (perdonen si no he escrito bien el nombre), no sabía nada,  ni lo acontecido, por lo que explicamos de nuevo la situación. Nos dijo que reuniría a su personal y nos informaría.  Por los resultados puedo indicar que su palabra vale como el servicio de su equipo, pues nunca más volvimos a saber nada de él. 
El último día, después de la cena y el vino, nos enviaron a una bella y simpática señorita, para hacernos la típica entrevista, que te dirige para que pienses y digas que todo ha sido bueno.   Bien, le di mi palabra de que lo escribiría. 
En las tragedias, siempre queda una sorpresa final, esta llegó cuando en la habitación, habíamos sacado las maletas, y empezado a recoger, vimos como una CUCARACHA se paseaba por las pertenencias de mi mujer.  Entonces vimos, el polvo acumulado debajo de la cama. Mi mujer no quiso dormir en la cama y ya no pegó ojo en toda la noche. 
A las 07:00 de la mañana pedíamos la hoja de reclamaciones y hacíamos el Check out. Increíblemente nos preguntaron si teníamos algún problema, no tenían ni idea de nada.
Ese día teníamos una excursión contratada y nos venían a buscar, por lo que nos urgía marchar pero hasta el último momento hubo problemas porque en lugar de traernos las maletas a la recepción,  olvidaron una de ellas, por lo que la agencia y los otros viajeros que también iban en la excursión, tuvieron que esperar media hora.
La recepción de este Hotel, Paradisus Palma Real, es tóxica. No ayuda a resolver incidencias a los clientes, los molesta,  hace perder tiempo y engaña.  Además el servicio preferente es una mentira, es peor que el servicio general.
Ésta es la primera vez que escribo un comentario, después de muchos años de viajar por el mundo. Por cierto Sres. de Meliá Paradisus Palma Real, no me den las gracias por mi tiempo en los comentarios,  no lo hago por ustedes, lo hago por los lectores y porqué di mi palabra.  Somos lo que hacemos, no lo que decimos, y valemos lo que vale nuestra palabra, lo demás, son mentiras como su cacareada voluntad de servicio.
Después de esta experiencia, nunca más iremos a un hotel Melià, no vamos a arriesgarnos a volver a pasar por lo mismo.

reviews.author: Kristen R
reviews.title: Not friendly
reviews.text: Our rooms smelled musty, and 3 weeks later still trying to get smell out of my clothes after 4 washes. Staff act like they are doing you a favor. Grounds nice, spa is the best part. Could never get dinner reservation, yet when you showed up restaurants were empty.

reviews.author: Deborah  A
reviews.title: HORRIBLE RESORT! Pictures are misleading! Do NOT GET MARRIED HERE! Handicap Discrimination.
reviews.text:
Where do I start. This was my second time visiting the DR and it was such a horrible experience. This trip was for my sister's WEDDING. Do not get married at this resort the pictures are misleading. 

Okay so I'll start with something small. I stayed at the Majestic (stay there if you visit the Dominican Republic). I typically do not stay at all-inclusive resorts because often people make it seem as if because it is all inclusive, expect the food to be horrible. I LOVE FOOD. I travel for it. Why spend the money and hate the food, you know? Now the majestic resort's food was absolutely delicious, from room service to the restaurants. As a foodie, I stand by this. But the Paradisus proved this myth to be true. THEIR FOOD WAS DISGUSTING. Seriously. At every restaurant. The buffet was okay.

Speaking of restaurants, the first night in town my sister made reservations for her wedding guests at the resort's Italian restaurant. However we were unable to eat at this location. When I go on vacation to an island, I generally wear relaxing and cool clothing. I suspect most people are like this. My niece's husband had on a very nice linen short set and they refused him entry into the restaurant. We explained to the personnel that the only pair of pants he had was for the wedding because generally on vacation he only packs shorts. They didn't care. This was the start of our introduction to their horrible customer service. Then the manager came and was very rude and began talking rudely about our party in Spanish to one of his workers. He was shocked when he realized two of our family members were fluent in Spanish and understood every word. 

Okay so the rooms. The rooms are poorly kept and poorly ventilated. The grounds of the resort is beautiful but the rooms are horrible. Don't be fooled by the photographs. The rooms are outdated and look nothing like the grounds of the hotel. 
Customer service. Each day we had to call room service 3 to 4 times just to receive  towels or toilet tissue. One day we were without toilet tissue in our room for about half of the day. I recall one morning waking up at 9 am and calling to request new towels to shower.  After calling 4 times the towels were brought at 9:40 am. Making me late for the bridal party's brunch. We actually had to call for our room to be cleaned some days which I am not use to. 

Okay so the wedding. DO NOT GET MARRIED HERE. You will regret it. The garden area does not look how it looks in pictures. My sister's husband is in a wheelchair , so a  beach wedding was not an option. The garden area does not look how it is depicted in photographs. The bridge is not a long walk from the gazebo as shown in pictures, limiting the bride's grand entrance. So my sister decided to instead walk all the way around the garden. The pond around the garden is poorly kept,  is unappealing to the eye and smells like swamp water. Don't get me wrong my sister's wedding day was amazing because of the joyous occasion but Paradisus had no part in making it a great day. It was family and our traditions.

Natalia, my sister's wedding consultant was HORRIBLE. She was unprofessional, rude and just plain incompetent. If you do decide to get married here after my warning, opt out of using Natalia. She did not direct the event well and didn't appear very knowledgeable. During the ceremony the garden was supposed to be closed off; Natalia didn't ensure that it was done, so other hotel guests were actually walking through the garden during the ceremony portion. Just unacceptable. During my sister's last meeting before the wedding, she cried TWICE because Natalia just kept saying "you didn't pay for that, you didn't pay for that, there's nothing we can do, I'll have to check with my manager." But those things should have been discussed with my sister during her planning process. She was simply just a horrible wedding consultant. For such a special day, I would expect more care but it did not happen that way. My sister had over 45 guests. 

There's more. As I previously stated, my sister's then fiancé, now husband is in a wheel chair. Therefore my sister ensure's any where we go is wheelchair accessible. This was too communicated to Natalia (Paradisus wedding consultant). My sister was supposed to spend the honeymoon portion of their trip in the "Royal Service" section of the resort. It is suppose to be the VIP section of the resort with nicer rooms and a personal butler. These rooms are more expensive, of course. The day after the wedding my sister finds out these rooms are NOT wheelchair accessible and therefore they can't use the room THAT THEY ALREADY PAID FOR. Natalia again shows no concern and refuses to refund my sister and her husband their money.

But there's more. Myself and another one of my sister's roomed together. Let me first say that the Paradisus requires that you take care of your stay when you first arrive. 
You can not obtain a resort access wrist band or room keys without paying your full balance. So of course, my sister and I did this. During the check in process, they make copies of your passport and staple your payment receipts to this. However upon check out they were asking us to repay for our room because THEY LOST THE RECEIPT. They would not allow us to leave the resort. They requested my sister print out a copy of her bank statement. Just foolishness. This process took over an hour, we almost missed our flight. Our only saving grace was my sister emptied out the contents of her purse in the hotel
Lobby to finally find her copy of the receipt. Can you believe that. They were implying that we didn't pay for our room but you CANT GET ON THE RESORT UNTIL YOUR BALANCE IS PAID! Would you believe that they didn't even apologize once my sister found her receipt, they were smug and still rude and just handed us our exit ticket.

I've traveled worldwide. All through the Caribbean and I have never experienced such a horrible stay. I highly suggest not staying at this resort.

reviews.author: joa20162016
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here!
reviews.text: Poor customer service, rude staff, horrible food, slow housekeeping and room service, poor room maintenance/cleanliness. Staff lose documentation of payment, keep all receipts. They will attempt to overcharge!

reviews.author: Hellen R
reviews.title: Worst Experience EVER!
reviews.text: This has been the worst experience ever! I booked this vacation for my husband, our 2 small kids and myself.  Upon arrival the room wasn't ready and we were told to go get something to eat, we did as we were told and when we came back the room was still not ready.  After having us wait for 30 minutes they told us that there was a problem with the room they had booked for us and sent us to another room, that room had a horrible smell of mold.  We went back to the front desk and after we spoke to 4 different people they sent us to another room, the AC didn't work and the patio door wouldn't lock. We called the front desk and no one would help us, finally a hotel employee took us to a third room were we stayed.  However, in that bedroom there were mosquitos and the next day my 4 and 5 yr old boys had bites on their faces and legs, I was covered in mosquito bites myself and so was my husband.  We went back to the front desk and told them about it and about the TV not working in our room.  They said they would send an exterminator and someone to fix the tv but that never happened. We mistakenly left the "Do not disturb" sign on our door and they said they couldn't come in but yet they left a bottle of wine in our room. I don't understand how they came in for one thing and not the things that were really affecting us.  The restaurants are filled with mosquitos and there's not much of a selection, Also, no DOMINICAN food.  I don't understand how a resort in The Dominican Republic doesn’t serve Dominican food.  Actually we were able to eat Dominican food at the Fuego restaurant one night and it was pretty good.  The Grill restaurant was good as well but the mosquitos didn't even allow me to enjoy my meal. We went to the front desk to complain again about our TV not working and finally were told that they didn't know when it would get fixed so they offered to upgrade our bracelets so we could have access to the other part of the hotel BUT they had the nerve to give me a legal paper saying that they were upgrading our bracelets due to the inconvenience and because they were doing so we couldn't hold the resort or any of their chain hotels responsible for anything that happened to my family... THE NERVE OF THESE PEOPLE!!! They though that because I spoke Spanish I couldn't read what they tried to have me sign.  I REFUSED to sign; I work for a real estate company and work closely with Attorneys so I know what a legal paper looks like.  They tried to calm me down by offering me a room at "the reserve" which is a better part of the hotel but after all the things they put us through we only had a day left and didn't want to spend it moving all our belongings to a different room.   They should've offered to do that after the first day.  I can't believe we wasted 5 days at this resort, we travel to Punta Cana often and been to Barceló (best resort yet), majestic, grand palladium, etc. and never had all this problems.  Last but definitely not least the lights went off on the entire hotel the last day we were there.  We were left with no light, AC, phone or internet.  There was no way for us to call the front desk and have someone pick us up or our luggage, we had to walk all the way to the front desk because even transportation is a problem there.  I seriously wish this trip would've never happened. Now my kids are petrified every time they see a fly because they think it's a mosquito and will bite them... Please take my review into consideration because we saw several bad reviews and we still chose to try it out for ourselves, THAT WAS A BAD IDEA!!!

reviews.author: Algen A
reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: Within 5 minutes of arriving at the hotel our experience went wrong. The hotel staff forced us to wait several hours before the would locate and process our reservation. They did give us bands to eat however what we needed was our room. After several calls we discovered that they were stalling us because the staff member who processed our payment failed to process it in us dollars. A simple mistake that we would have gladly corrected immediately. The food was below average. However it is the service that makes this place so horrible. The office staff was of the worse i have ever encountered. I honestly could not believe what I was experiencing. It was ridiculous. The property staff that you encounter on the regular are nice enough but the admin and supporting staff............absolutely laughable. I'm still trying to figure out how this a top destination spot!

reviews.author: Manu M
reviews.title: Pior hotel que fui na vida!!!
reviews.text: Estive no hotel na Convenção do meu trabalho e fiquei muito decepcionada, fui furtada no quarto do hotel, o que ocorreu com mais 5 pessoas do meu grupo, a gerência do hotel abriu investigação, mas até minha saída não tive resposta, informaram que seria feito contato pelo telefone deixado ou por email, mas nao tive nenhum retorno. O atendimento em alguns restaurantes do hotel é horrível, os garçons te ignoram, te vêem na mesa, mas fingem não ver. Muito decepcionada.

reviews.author: Nebell87
reviews.title: Awful
