reviews.text:
I have tried to call the hotel for days and 100 times and still can't manage to get an answer yet. Once someone answer the phone, I tell him what I'm asking about (a shuttle bus from the airport to the hotel etc.) , he put me through a voice mail box with Spanish, or the phone just went silence.

If that's how the hotel treats any customer, I guess it is a zero star.

reviews.author: RobfromLondonontario
reviews.title: Not worth the money beware or timeshare sharks!
reviews.text:
So we just returned from Punta Cana and I've always said I wouldn't stay anywhere else than Majestic Elegance but after being there 5 times in the last 7 years I thought I would try something new. 
That being said I was a good trip advisor and read up on the "best resorts" in PC. #1 was "The Reserve at Paradisius Punta Cana" surely I couldn't go wrong! 
After arriving I was quite impressed, small quaint check in with extremely nice check in staff. Almost too nice. It was very quiet as well which I found odd. 
Well after we got to the room which was a decent size and in reasonable condition we decided to look around. That's when we figured out we were almost 1.5 Kms from the beach! ( turns out that wasn't a bad thing as it helped keep the weight off from eating so much) 
There are little trams running every 20 minutes or so if you really don't want to walk. 
That being said it started to head downhill from there. To get a "palapa" by the pool or the beach it had to be reserved but the catch was that it was only reserved for the families that had concierge. So really as a couple we were screwed unless we were up at an ungodly hour to put a towel on the very few ones that haven't been marked the night before.
Which lead to the next problem. We knew that it wasn't an adults only resort but on the website it says that there is a kids pool. What it didn't say is that there is absolutely no where that a couple can relax without having screaming kids throwing balls and splashing around. 
Ya I know that it doesn't sound nice but we paid top dollar to be there as well and left ours at home to try to have a quiet holiday.  The large pool is completely open to families so the kids have the run of both pools in the "Reserve" area. 
Now hearing from the families constantly complaining as well about the "reserve policy" they were having as much trouble as well as they had far too few for the amount of guests that were there. You had to pretty much bribe the beach guy to remove planted towels from a "taken" one if you were to have a chance to get one after 10 am. Overall a lot of pissed off negative people walking around.
The food was ok. Far from 5star which we have had in the past at other resorts. The 3 buffets all served the same boring food with very little change during the week. We had a cockroach walk across out table at the "bama" Japanese restaurant which was mediocre at best. Saw another roach crawl across the wall there as well. Not very appetizing. 
We also saw a huge roach in the hallway right outside our room but I guess rats and roaches are to be expected in the DR we just have never seen them at the better resorts. 
We got duped into spending the $150 ($120 plus tip) at the passion restaurant which is played up to be 6star cuisine. What a joke. Although the service was great and the manager was nice the food was non existent and not special at all other than how it was presented. A total waste of money. Also they nail you another $60 per couple to do their wine sample during dinner. 
Other a la carte restaurants were decent, but nothing memorable. 
The thing that stood out the most was the poor service overall, I think because of the high price of the resort and the family nature that not many people tipped so the staff didn't seem motivated to please. I usually tip 4 to 5 hundred dollars over a 7 day period and you have staff happy and willing to wait on you hand and foot. It is a vacation you know! Also doesn't hurt helping these poor people that make next to nothing slaving in these places.
We happened to run into the general manager "Roderico" at one of the bars and I voiced my displeasure. He was extremely nice and said he would fix it. Offered to send us to the other $20 upgrade restaurant but nothing ever came of it. 
He said the ultra small " adults only Royal service" area was overbooked internally so he couldn't accommodate us there either. ( funny thing is that that area was cheaper when we booked) 
We walked through and it was a 20x 40 pool with people crammed in. Another joke.   
So in the end I take the blame for not somehow figuring out that the only privacy was in this tiny area that we were not allowed into although we paid the top price at this paradisius resort. 
And one last thing, the reason why the concierge staff was so nice when we arrived is that their primary job is to whisk you away to the hard sell time share that is the true heart of this "melia club" resort. 
Nothing like spending good money to get away only to be pressured and then looked down and ignored once you refuse to buy into the hard sell of a timeshare. 
So take my advise and don't always think that #1 on the list is the best. I'll be returning to the majestic elegance for some great food, great service and an overall relaxing vacation next time!

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: They give a whole new meaning to all inclusive. I have just returned from a four night five day stay and brought home bed bugs. The service, staff, food and overall experience was by far the worse experience I've had in years.  Trying to get assistance with reservations, basic first aid and table service was next to impossible. The wifi was turned on at 8am and off in the evening. Asked for no first floor room but that is what I received. We asked to have rooms located next to each other, didn't receive that. Was pressured to join rewards program even after declining several times.

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: It's the little things...
reviews.text:
This review is for the royal service in a garden view room. 

This hotel has a great setting. The grounds, beach, pool and room size are all very good and if you get a decent deal and come with average expectations it'll be ok. 

However do not get the royal service. Our butler never picked up his phone. It's a complete waste of money. Whenever we went to complain at the desk they wouldn't give a straight answer and just tried to push you back to calling the butler (who didn't answer).

My biggest gripe however is the with the small things that don't take much to fix but make the difference. 

Things like you order breakfast in the room but they never give you another ordering card, you go the gym and there are no clips for the barbell, towels don't get replaced, the mirror is affixed to the wall at a weird angle, the shower only has 1 temperature, you ask about checking in and they say in 15 mins whilst you wait for over 2 hours, they ask if you want a newspaper but never actually give it to you.

The list is pretty endless and these a small selection. The service just isn't that great... 

Also we were staying with 2 other couples on the royal service and they all had equally bad experiences.

Basically save your money, don't do royal service, bring your kids and enjoy the grounds at a good rate and you'll be fine...

reviews.author: Kerry F
reviews.title: Does not live up to photos or expected level of luxury for price.
reviews.text: So many things wrong...broken...unkept.  Towels at pool ran out first day, no loungers to be had.  Tried to make restaurant reservations upon arrival and was told they were all booked for remainder of my stay (despite only being half full every time I walked by at dinner hours).  Food at buffet (that what we had to eat all week) was OK but nothing special.  Included alcohol bevs were weak.  Free snorkel was booked whole week, and we were told to come everyday to see if they could make room.  Free snorkel was a joke...the life jackets were all ripped and latches broken (unusable) and the boat was  basically a small open fishing boat.  Dropped off at reef, told to jump in, and had no ladder to get back in the boat.  Ridiculous.  This resort frequently presented you with many options to purchase extra excursions, upgrades, option, etc....but the all-inclusive was a total joke and waste of money.

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: The worst vacation ever!
reviews.text: After reading the many favorable reviews of this property, I took my first plunge into a Punta Cana vacation.  Beginning with two rooms with showers that did not work and WIFI that was at best intermittent, followed by repeated evasions and misstatements by the senior staff about corrections and concessions to be made, and wrapped up by fantastically high prices for poor service and facilities, I have to wonder at the experience and truthfulness of the reviews I read.  My wife and I travel 3 to 5 times per year for vacations, and have never had anything approaching the abysmal experience at this location.

reviews.author: ThomasR239
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
Paradisus palma real is a big hotel with a nice beach. However the service is severely lacking. 

From the buffet servers to the bartenders, you will notice a sense of indifference from the staff. You are merely the inconvenience between them and their paycheck. There will be 3-4 staff members standing around chatting with each other and you will be lucky if they choose to acknowledge you.

A few examples: for some strange reason the buffet was closed for lunch on a Saturday. Leaving no other option but the snack bar Blue Agave. With only 5 other occupied tables and 3 waiters, i sat for 15 minutes with my girlfriend for a waiter to come by and serve us water or at least take our drink order. We along with a couple next to us were never approached. After making eye contact many times and being ignored i got up and went to the bar myself to get our drinks. The waiters seemed to have selective service, as some patrons were ignored and others served immediately.

The buffet servers seem to be annoyed or hate their jobs. They simply point at you and you tell them what you want. No greeting, no smile. 

Even the concierge who showed us around seemed to be just going through the motions and had everything on auto pilot. Like he just wanted to finish so he could hang out with the other concierges (which he did).

Reservations are also difficult to obtain. Do not expect to eat at a place you want unless it's booked 2-3 days in advance.

This resort also allows sales people to wander around the hotel. Expect to be harassed by people offering excursions or trinkets on the hotel grounds.

There were some pleasant staff members but the negative interactions far outweigh the positives and ruin the whole vacation.

This resort is not worth the price you pay. You're better off staying at a regular hotel and paying for food.

Furthermore i seemed to be the only one tipping yet i received no better service.

Service may be better with royal service or family concierge.

reviews.author: Shay B
reviews.title: HORRIBLE STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
Don't be fooled by the beautiful property. The service is awful they oversold our rooms. I was there for a wedding and the bride and groom didn't even have a room.  They even made some of the guest at the wedding stay at a completely different resort.  Just sad I can't believe how much money we paid and the poor service we received.  We were treated so poorly.

1. Room switch - When we first arrived to the resort we were not given a room until hours after our arrival. Once we were given a room we were told we had to move out the next day.  When I asked if we can stay in the room I was told another guest booked the room. I do not understand why some guest were given priority over us. There where two other guest that were given the same room type and we all paid the same price only to have us be the only one kicked out of our room. Which was extremely inconvenient during our vacation.  

2. Broken Door - Once we arrived in our room the door would not open properly. When told them to have it fixed they came to fix it but it still did not work only this time it would not close. My door was left wide open leaving all my personal belongings at risk. This was another inconvenience where I had to immediately leave after the wedding ceremony and miss a part of the wedding reception to wait until I was able to lock my door.  Yet another inconvenience where I missed a portion of one of my closest friends biggest day. 

3. No telephone - During all of this turmoil our telephones did not work. So each time we had an issue I had to go to the front desk in person only to be told to go back to my room and wait.  

4. Stranger in the room at midnight - Somebody walked in the room while my sister was not dressed in the middle of the night somebody walked in our room because the front desk gave our room to another individual. My sister was sleeping and not properly dressed. She was startled and awakened to a stranger in our room. That experience left her frightened and terrified. She was so scared she had to sleep with mace by her bed to try and feel safe enough to fall asleep. Even after being traumatized by this event, the front desk immediately called her (which surprisingly the phones worked for them) and told her that she was not supposed to be in that room and to come down immediately to the front desk and show our itinerary. This is extremely unacceptable my sister already had a pre-existing nervous condition and this only exasperated it more leaving her more traumatized. 

5. Bugs in my food -  I was eating at the 24 hour restaurant and a roach ran across my plate. Completely disgusting and unsanitary.  
 
6. Power Outage - The one side of my room had no power leaving us to shower and use the toilet in dark. Yet, another inconvenience.  

7.  Awful Food - The food was awful. I'm not sure why they had so much american food I think they need to leave the american food to the Americans. Really didn't want to travel all that way for poorly made pizza....

This trip was very important to me and I spent a lot of money and valuable time.  I've traveled to many resorts and never have I experienced such unprofessionalism and lack of respect for a guest.  The staff was arrogant and treated me like I was nothing.  They treated other people with lighter skin better than they treated me. Which was even more disheartening because we look alike. I personally would never recommend such resort with poor service nor would I return. 

I believe that the resort owes me for such hassle, inconvenience and the personal trauma that my sister received. 

The managing director Conrad BERGWERF said he would be happy to compensate me for my hassles but I never heard from again nor did I receive the agreed upon compensation.

Save yourself the nightmare and stay away from this resort!!!!!!!

SSM

reviews.author: JoelleWeidner
reviews.title: Absolutely awful!
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. Beautiful place, but we did not feel safe the entire time we were there. Customer service in the restaurants was pathetic too.  For a five star place and $700/night I expect WAY more than what I got! Things were stolen from our rooms, wait staff were rude and unaccomodating. We will never return!

reviews.author: PAUL R
reviews.title: Worst food
reviews.text:
Every single one of these reviews has completely missed the case that booking a room at the reserve is literally 10 minutes from the beach and the food and the buffets are terrible

It's amazing to me that you have 1400 reviews and nobody talks about the fact that you can't get to the beach from the reserve without a trolley and literally the buffets and the food are just frozen frozen and frozen go somewhere else that's my recommendation

reviews.author: Jane W
reviews.title: NEVER GO THERE
reviews.text: Third world quality in all manners except if you are Member ($60k-$100K).  Impossible to get reservations at the "real" restaurants unless you upgrade.  Pressure to join as a member by sales team.  No or little scheduled activities.  Basically a third rate hotel.  A little better if you want to pay for Royal Service but in general staff and hotel caters to Members (about 1/3 of those staying).  Otherwise, not too good.

reviews.author: Rosalynd M
reviews.title: Worst trip ever, notified them and they didn't care
reviews.text:
I wrote this long review and sent it to the hotel to give them an opportunity to rectify all the problems that we have.  They replied and said they would pass it along to the resort, basically sorry not sorry.  This was the worst trip and the biggest waste of money.  On at least 3 separate occassions we were served under cooked beef, chicken and fish.  None of the chefs spoke english.  The Playa Del Carmen Paradisus was MUCH better.

Planning
Planning this trip was a nightmare.  We decided to use our Free Certificate of stay that we got for touring the vacation club as well as using our options and extending our stay for a whole week.  Well we had to call Marketing, then Club Melia and go back and forth to verify the dates were available so that we could have a complete week.  We finally have everything figured out and try to book Club Melia and the agent informs me that I can’t book anything using my options till I pay my maintenance fees.  Maintenance fees that I hadn’t even been BILLED FOR!! It was early December and the bills hadn’t even been issued, I had literally spoken to 3 different people in marketing and 3 different people at Melia and this is the first anyone mentioned I had to pay a bill that wasn’t even DUE yet that hadn’t even been mailed yet in order to book our trip.  That was RIDICULOUS.  The next day someone else booked us and didn’t even ask us to pay the will that we didn’t get.
Also, I asked if there was a way that we could upgrade and stay in the same room for the whole week, of course nobody can help with that.  They said ask when you get to the resort, which there were no rooms available.

Meal Plan
As club members we were charged 101.00 per person, per day on our club stay.  On the “free” marketing trip they charged us 109.00 per person per day, I told them we were Club Melia and our rate was supposed to be 101.00 but they refused to acknowledge that and still charged me 109.  The hotel did NOTHING for us, Club Melia booked all of our meals.  So we were overcharged over 60.00 which is very very frustrating.

Meals/Dining
The food was not very good.  The Paradisus Playa Del Carmen food was MUCH better so we expected something comparable.  At the buffet at Naos, the chefs didn’t speak very good English.  At breakfast they would be making eggs and they’d be just about ready to come off the griddle and they’d pour an omelet down with raw egg touching the cooked egg they were about to put on my plate.  That is cross contamination and you can get SICK or other food borne illnesses.  Also, at the same buffet at lunch they served me chicken and beef that was cooked on the outside and raw on the inside.  Thank goodness I cut and check my food before eating it. My husband had fish that wasn’t fully cooked at this restaurant.  Also, at the Blue Agave at lunch 2 days in a row they served me raw burgers that were again cooked on the outside but not the inside.  The griddles are up too high so they aren’t properly cooking the food.

Accommodations
Our first room was in a great spot close to the pools and dining but all the golf carts parked right outside of our bedroom windows so it was loud and smelled all the time.  Then when we had to switch to our second room it was 5 buildings away and there was a huge generator giving off smog and pollution right outside our door.  It was loud and it smelled (I have pictures I can share).  Also, the roof was leaking.  On our last day there it rained so that night as I lay in bed trying to sleep water droplets were falling on my HEAD.  I was so exhausted I rolled to the middle of the bed so I wouldn’t get wet all night.  I was definitely disappointed in both rooms, they were loud and outdated. 

Club Melia Presentation
At the pool someone invited us for a “refresh” at the club.  He assured me this was to talk about our membership and all the benefits and how we can “optimize” our membership. He said to bring any questions we have and we would work them all out.  I asked point blank is this a sales pitch, because we don’t need any more options we have another vacation club and a beach timeshare and was told NO this was not a sales pitch.  That was a huge LIE.  We went (on our vacation, more time wasted).  When I started asking questions and explaining the horrible booking experience he just kept pointing the finger at Playa Del Carmen Paradisus and saying it wasn’t their fault and there was nothing they could do.  As a consumer that is not what I want to hear.  You are ALL club Melia and you should OWN it and try to resolve it and not pass the buck and play blame games with everyone else.  Also, might I add he had all his paperwork and was going to try to sell us more options.  We left and said we’d come back another time and we did not return.  Our time is valuable and we have no interest in buying more than we have especially given our experience thus far.  

Nexxus Tour Company On Site
Upon arrival we were told as Melia members we get a private shuttle to the resort to/from, that was great.  However on the way home the person that booked our transport did not book us the private shuttle we were entitled to, he also signed the slip with someone else’s name and he checked the box saying we paid with credit card even though we paid him in cash.  In the morning we had to stop at multiple hotels to pick people up and had to leave earlier than normal because we didn’t get our private shuttle.
We also booked a tour with Nexxus.  It was supposed to be a 9 hour tour to Santo Domingo, they told us to be in the lobby at 6:20am and we’d be back around 6pm.  They never showed up until 6:40am, it was NOT a Nexxus tour it was another agent that they were reselling for.  The tour guide was awful and brought us to the same stop twice.  Everywhere we went he passed us off to someone else that was looking for a tip.  We booked through Nexxus because your hotel recommends them and promotes them.  The tour ended up being almost 14 hours.  We ended up arriving back at 7:55pm after being gone ALL DAY.  We had an 8pm dinner reservation, so we ran over to Vento and they would not allow us to dine there because my husband didn’t have long pants.  That was frustrating because we were supposed to be back at 6pm to get ready for dinner.  So, back to the buffet again.

Butler
The only good thing about this whole trip was Charlton.  He was very friendly, helpful and accommodating.  He did what he said he would and he helped us when we needed it.  He was just plain awesome!

reviews.author: Lisa D
reviews.title: Don't do it
reviews.text: Our ten day experience wa offal!!! The only part of our wedding/honeymoon that was enjoyable was the romance team. They were truly amazing. The hotel was awful.  We transferred from a standard room to the royal service suit, which was worse then there standered rooms.  Service was the worst I have ever seen in all my years of traveling!!!!!!! The employees are not nice nor courteous and your often find them huddled together talking about customers. We paid extra for the Royal service to have a butler on her honeymoon, well we got nothing not even an interdiction. We requested a meeting with the supervisor who said they would give us their best Butler. Again horrible customer service, we couldn't even get a butler to make our dinner reservations or even call us back. The food at the resort was nothing special. The restaurant outside during the lunch with constantly filled with bugs. They use no protectors over their food and you could see bugs crawling all over all the food. Minibar is a joke, it's a small refrigerator filled with two cans of beer and two sodas. good luck getting room service or house keeping to deliver extra to your room.cleanliness was was lacking! I understand on the beach there will be bugs but the amount that we had in our room was unacceptable. I would 100% recommend the romance team if you had your wedding at this hotel however anything else you're wasting your time and money.

reviews.author: WendyBethG
reviews.title: Avoid this resort
reviews.text:
My family of six (2 adults, 4 children) is currently at this resort. We travel extensively, booking 3-4 trips to islands each year.  We are very disappointed in this resort. The service is beyond terrible. The resort looks nice, but the service is really, really bad. We are currently waiting to have our two rooms changed because the ceiling is leaking onto the master bed. We were told "that's the risk you take when you're on the top floor".  (What???  And by the way, I didn't request to be on the top floor). 
We now have to pack up all of our belongings (family of 6) and move (in the rain) to different rooms. However, four hours later, (now 10pm), we still don't have our new rooms. We're sitting in the lobby with our four children just waiting....
What a lousy way to spend our $2000 PER NIGHT vacation. 

Did I mention the service is really bad?  Between our room situation, dinner reservation issues,  and no towels (they ran out!) at the pool & beach, we are beyond frustrated. 
Save your time and money and go to a Ritz or Four Seasons on a different island. At least there you know that the service will be much better.  If an issue arises at a Ritz or Four Seasons, it will be addressed in a professional and timely manner. 
We will never come back here and never recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Dave K
reviews.title: Go there AT YOUR OWN RISK !!!
reviews.text:
To be fair, there were some good things: the hotel is gorgeous. The staff really TRY to do a good job. We had a group manager who was very nice and consistently tried to be helpful. She clearly did the best she could within a management system that severely limits her ability to help. She regularly had to email someone in management to clear her ability to help us.

Now the bad news:
We are a group of about 30 people. We have travelled together at the end of the year for about 30 years all around the world (including 2 times to the Dominican Republic to other hotels.) I can say without reservation that this hotel was the worst we have ever had. Here is why.

ROYAL SERVICE
We paid extra to get some of our rooms with "royal service" (mostly for the adults in our group). We were assigned a "butler", who was supposed to make our stay better. We saw him 2 times during our 8 day vacation. Once when we arrived. The second time when he entered our room without knocking, while my wife was changing. Although I believe this was unintentional, the butler never apologized and asked to be reassigned. We never got another "butler." I did not need another one, but I mention this, as a constant theme throughout our stay was the spotty service. For example, our mini fridge was supposed to be filled up every day, it was not. We were supposed to get a newspaper every morning, we did not. We were supposed to get new bottles of alcohol every night, we did not.

Four of our rooms had problems with the door lock. In my case, as I came bach from the beach my room did not open. I asked the housekeeper to open and she could not. After about four levels of supervisors and security came in a period of about 2 hours, someone came with a screwdriver, opened the room, and about an hour later fix the lock. Needless to say, I lost about 2-3 hours of my vacation with their Royal Service...

My son's room's lights went off, and when he called for help and he was told to open the electric panel and try to fix it himself.  Thankfully, the lights went on shortly thereafter.

FOOD AND RESTAURANTS
The food was overall mediocre. Bread was regularly stale. Choices of food were vey limitted, especially at the buffet. We were regularly sitted about an hour after our reservation, although once we were sitted more than two hours late. We were sitted in three groups (they claimed that they could not deal with our large group, although we regularly saw group tables at some of the restaurants. We made our reservations about 8 months in advance).

TIPS
The hotel does not have a clear policy on tips. Most servers seem to expect tips, but it is unclear how much is customary, and you have to bring cash from your room to pay. At all other hotels you simply sign up for the tips, and are charged at checkout. I mention this because the staff seemed generally unhappy and unmotivated, and i think this explains, at least partially, the uneven and generally bad service. People really try, but they do not have the tools or motivation to properly serve.

In at least three ocassions, employees volunteered, without prompting, their unhappiness with their job, and stated that they would immediately quit if they could. They especially cringed when I asked about the GM of the hotel.

NEW YEARS DINNER
Terrible food. Terrible music. Terrible party. Absolutely no local music. I do not know wha else i can say.

MANAGEMENT
The general manager at the hotel , Belen (i do not know her last name) gave me a clear example of the disconnect between management and the staff.  

Some of my family members were playing touch-football close to the "Royal Service" beach area. About an hour later, two guests aggresively placed their beach chairs in the middle of the field. The situation escalated quickly and the manager came to the scene. SHE THREATENED TO THROW SOME OF MY FAMILY MEMBERS FROM THE HOTEL. When I went to see her, simply asking for an explanation and an apology, she said that she would not apologize because one of my family members called her a liar.  As i understand it, my family member responded to the aggression stating that the beach is public (which is true under the DR constitution). The GM responded by saying that the beach was the hotel's, all the way to the shore line. He called her a liar, and then apologized. I write this because i simply cannot believe the incompetency with which she handled the situation. 

IF YOU GO TO THIS HOTEL, DO IT AT YOUR OWN RISK!!!!

reviews.author: Glen S
reviews.title: Needs better Management
reviews.text: There is a need for management to address the following issues: lounge availability at the pool and beach; language issues with wait staff; hotel staff always having their hand out for a tip (gratuities are included); house keeper quality; noise level.

reviews.author: 373denise373
reviews.title: Warning!
reviews.text: I recently visited this resort with friends who are members of Sol Melia, the resort company.  On our third day there we discovered we were burglarized.   Our room safe was emptied of all our American dollars.  Nothing that was traceable was taken.  My belongings had been rummaged through prior to the theft, but it did not compute until I realized we had been the victims of theft. The investigation conducted by the security showed the maid and a security person was in our room during the time the money went missing but we were told there was no evidence they took the money. Not only were we not compensated or apologized to, but we were made to feel we were the criminals and were insulted.  We left with a heavy heart but contacted the Sol Melia company in hopes that they would compensate our loss in some way.   I have traveled many places for many years.  Never have I had my property stolen and then treated with such disrespect.  The company, Sol Melia was so unresponsive and uncaring.  It was not the first time I vacationed at a Sol Melia resort.  But this trip to Paradisus Palma Real is certainly my last vacation with them.  It was admitted to us that the protocol is for the maid to first check the room safe.  Why would a hotel chain encourage such temptation??

reviews.author: Jenifer H
reviews.title: Horrible Everything!
reviews.text: This was by far the worst resort I've stayed at. The service was terrible and there was nothing luxurious about it. When I complained they did nothing to help the situation. We had to switch butlers because ours assigned through royal service kept dropping the ball. Don't bother with Royal Service. They don't monitor it so people who didn't pay for it were in the reserved areas, ect. Sadly this place was incredibly disappointing in every aspect.

reviews.author: EllieMiz
reviews.title: Terrible food, horrible management, gross, dirty and run-down rooms.
reviews.text: First off I've traveled to at least 20 different islands in the Caribbean and consider myself an expert traveler. The positive reviews for this place must be fake because this place is awful. The most attractive thing about this hotel is the grand and beautiful architecture around the lobby but that's where the positive ends. Food at all the restaurants are below-average in quality at best. My husband found a rock in his lunch, two people in our party got sick from the food and there was nothing I ate that tasted great. We ate at the sushi restaurant which was disgusting (half their raw fish was pickled). It was obvious that they were providing minimum quality food for the all-inclusive guests. Rooms are poorly laid out, poorly decorated, dirty and need a lot of upgrading. If I walked without shoes my feet would get dirty. I could wipe dust off the floor of the closet with my finger. The ceiling in the shower looked like it had mold growing on it. Very little attention to detail overall. The hotel is also situated such that there was A LOT of wind and the beach was incredibly murky as a result. When we went swimming at the beach there was so much seaweed and debris that we had to get out. So don't come to this hotel expecting the calm crystal clear Caribbean beaches you see in pictures. The grounds are so enormous that you have to walk for 5-10 minutes or take a golf cart to get from one place to another which can get really annoying on vacation. The "butler" service is basically an annoying guy who follows you around everywhere and tries to convince you to attend their time-share marketing event. The resort credit they give is a complete scam and rip off. They claim to give you a "$1500 resort credit" but you have to spend $100 to be able to use $10 in credit. All in all, they paid a lot of attention to the appearance of the lobby and pool area but pretty much nothing else is special or positive about this place. There is free wifi everywhere which was nice. I would not stay here again.

reviews.author: gyz123
reviews.title: VERY Poor Service & VERY Poor Food
reviews.text: I had the Royal Service. Upon arrival, I was made to check in a the regular check in not the Royal Service. The front desk was not able to find my reservation for an hour. If I hadn't printed out my reservation they would not be able to find it at all. I was then led to the Royal Service check in where they once again were not able to find my reservation for an hour. I was then given useless orientation information. A total of 2.5 hours wasted upon check in. I really wanted to use that time to enjoy the weather during my short 5 day stay. Thanks for ruining and wasting my entire first day! When you book Royal Service they send you a form to fill out giving them your preferences such as the type of pillow you want, the type of alcohol you want in your mini bar, etc. Guess what? They must have used that form to wipe their butts with because I did not have any of the special pillows nor anything else that I picked on the form. Please tell me the purpose of sending that form if you're not going to provide any of it. The butler did what I had asked him to do, but did not go out of the way to impress me. Bottom line...Royal Service is NOT WORTH IT. The Royal Service Restaurant (Palazzo) serves the EXACT SAME FOOD AS THE REGULAR BUFFET. In fact, my non royal service friends were able to attend the same restaurant. AND they were also able to use the spa facilities without having royal service, they were also able to use the royal service beach. As you can see....ROYAL SERVICE IS A SCAM. The rooms are ALL THE SAME, unless you have a suit. So again, Royal Service or not, it will be the same room. My pillows were dirty as well and felt old. Now on to the food. One word. AWFUL. Literally, nothing was good including the so called michelin rated Passion where they charge an extra $60. Averall, the service in the hotel is very slow, poor, and the staff has a lot of attitude. I get it, you don't make a lot of $ and your job sucks, but its still your job. This resort needs to be better managed especially their front office operations. The only positive I can share about this hotel is the decor. It is a very nicely designed hotel. However, being that this is DR, the beach sucks everywhere in DR and this place is no exception. I WAS VERY DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS HOTEL AND MY EXPERIENCE WILL LEAVE A SOUR TASTE WITH REGARDS TO ALL MELIA PROPERTIES GOING FORWARD.

reviews.author: LauraMWWhite
reviews.title: RCI MEMBERS MUST READ!
reviews.text:
Like many of us, I did most of my vacation planning through Trip Advisor, so I feel like it’s only right to write this review and hope that it helps spare other hard working individuals who are looking for a honest, stress free vacation experience.  

We booked our HONEYMOON through RCI for 7 days/ 6 night stay at The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real. We get to the hotel after a long day of travel to start our once in a lifetime trip and the front desk tells my new husband and I that we have been moved to The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana because they are overbooked. We booked this in June mind you and at this time, we had no problem getting our reservation and a master suite... supposedly. 

We were 2 of MANY RCI members that were bumped to The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana upon arrival to The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real. That was the 1 thing we all had in common, we were all RCI members. Furthermore they did as little as possible to accommodate their "overbooking mishap." My husband and I spent our HONEYMOON sleeping in 2 double beds and everyday in the office trying to work out the compensation. 

They will try to offer you the following compensation:

Option A: They will take off 1/2 of the all-inclusive price. (Which we took, but hasn’t been placed back into my account yet.)

Or 

Option B: A yearlong voucher to come back to The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real for an additional 7 days/ 6 nights. All inclusive and your stay will be compensated. You only have to pay for your plane ticket. NON- TRANSFERABLE.  

With all this being said, The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana was beautiful and overall a nice stay. It is rated higher on Trip Advisor then The Reserve Paradisus Palma Real. I don't mind where we stayed, but I still wish we stayed where we payed, researched & planned for. 
I will put my review for The Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana on their page. 

Please be aware of this "bait and switch" tactic. I know we weren't the first and won’t be the last.

reviews.author: Kristie
reviews.title: Becareful!
reviews.text:
Trip Duration: November 7 to November 12, 2014  (6 days)

Travel parties: my husband, uncle, mom (senior citizen) and 19 months toddler.

Since my husband and I traveled with a toddler and my mom who is a senior, we were very disappointed for the way we were treated by the hotel upper management and the concierge. 

We booked our trip to Costco- our most trusted vendor. We were told we have $600 resorts credits including one hundred dollar room upgrade for each room (we have two rooms total). When we arrived, we were escorted to the Lounge because we were told we were VIP customers (not royal service), so we didn’t have to wait in the lobby. Apparently, almost everyone there are RS or VIP or Shared Members (I can’t imagine anything less). We have access to everything just like the RS guests. We also have our own concierge – Alverado C., aka A.C. We were told by AC (our own concierge) that he will take care of everything - making dinner reservation, picking up the resort credits, arrange room changes, etc.

We arrived 1:30pm, our room wasn’t ready yet. So, we headed to the buffet for lunch, then went back to pick up our room keys. We were given two rooms far apart from each other. One of the room does not have elevator and it’s on the 3rd floor in a far different building. So, we requested for room change with A.C. He said he will take care of it by tomorrow morning when we meet him for a VIP breakfast and a welcoming presentation. 

So, the next morning, A.C. introduced us to the salesperson who took us to the usual buffet breakfast (nothing VIP like promised), then the time-share like presentation. We didn’t mind about the presentation, because we were actually interested in the purchase but it would be nice if A.C was honest in the beginning. The presentation was not part not the Costco package requirement, it was only the sale pitch from the resort. After the presentation, we did not see A.C. again, he just disappeared. We were lost because we depended on him. We had to check the dinner reservation ourselves and found that he only made two dinner reservations for us, the rest we have to book them ourselves. We never got our room changes as requested. After many attempted with the front desk, we got one of our rooms upgraded in order to have the room be next to each other on the third day.. On top of that, the one master suite that we upgraded had water leakage in the toilet and flooded the restroom.  So we had to call for maintenance to fix and housekeeping to clean up. What a nightmare!

Then, the last night before we left. My toddler accident broke their oversize ornament that was decorated in the main lobby. The ornament was contained in a wooden vase. He used his hand to swirl the ornament around, then the ornament shatter with sharp edges. Luckily his fingers were not cut. I immediately notify the front desk because no one was around. We didn’t want anyone to get hurt even though the pieces are shattered in a vase on top of a table. The front desk told us it is okay because it is just an accident, but as a protocol he has to write up and incident report. The next morning when we are packed and ready to check out to catch our fly. We were told we could not leave until we are to pay $200 fine for the ornament. My husband refused to pay $200 for a fragile decorative ornament. That’s outrages! The manager of the hotel approached us and specifically stated, we were not allowed to leave until we pay, then he went to the security guard at the gate and instructed him not to let us. We felt like criminals. We were very upset, we were put into position where we have to pay just so we can catch our flight. This is when I feel obligated to write this review. We also see other people complaint about the charges made by the hotel at the front desk. We felt they are finding every way to charge you if possible. And if you happen to break anything in this resort, you should keep quiet, otherwise they will charge you over the price that it’s worth. 

I would not hope for anyone to go through the same experience that we all did. We left the country with thought that we would never wanted to visit this place again. 

My family and I take vacation every year to the Caribbean to release our stress and spend more time with each other. Lesson learned for us. Our next trip will be closer to home not a 9 hours flight like this one and to endure such an experience.  We will definitely look for a more kids and senior friendly hotel as well. Melia-Palma Paradisus is definitely not the kind of place for us. We stayed at Melia in Cabo before, and it was completely opposite experience.

Besides from the resort, the beach is beautiful. We brought the beach floatation for our child due recommendation by the reviews online and it was worth. Don’t forget the bug repellent too.  Bring a lot of dollar bills for tips, we got great services from other for these.  

Pros:

- Servers at the restaurant are excellent, especially Emilio. Very dependable and nice.
- The beach is beautiful
- The Bizou and the Gabi restaurant are good

Cons:

- Not a lot of menu selection at the buffet. The food is salty
- Dishonest concierge who disappeared on the 2nd day
- Horrible hotel manager who is ready to charge you for at any opportunity
- Pool is very deep (4.75”) for small children. There is only one very small area that’s 1.75”
- A lot of mosquitoes. Be careful with mosquito bites!
- The resort credits had no real value. We one for room upgrade because we have to in order to get two rooms next to each other.
- Not accommodating. Everything you request is for extra charge
- If you break, you pay a lot more than the item is worth. So be careful, don’t break anything.
- The hotel is under construction, so there are a lot of noise in the eating area
	
Recommendation:

I would not go back to this resort nor recommending it to anyone especially family with kids and senior elderly like ours.

reviews.author: Stephanos A
reviews.title: Worst Food, Unprofessional Staff that do not speak English, hotel needs a major upgrade
reviews.text: Went to this hotel with zero expectations for a family event (wedding). The wedding was awesome. The rest, unfortunately were not good at all. Food/desserts were horrible. Very unprofessional staff thta most of them do not speak English. Plus hotel needs a major renovation. Iam not the type of person that like to write reviews, but this was too bad to let it go.

reviews.author: Excursion110250
reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!! worst hotel!!!!!
reviews.text: This is the worst all inclusive experience we have ever had. Issues included: Bad food, small quantity, main pool jacuzzi's not working, tv not working, small beds, management does nothign when you complain.

reviews.author: AlisaHead
reviews.title: Would not stay again.....
reviews.text:
Dominican Republic has some secret gems. This place was not one of them. The rooms were not as pictured. They are older, have Air conditioning problems, mosquitos were all in the rooms and to find someone who understood english was difficult. Also the shower heads in the bathrooms kept falling off. I went with a group of 15 and many had to change rooms several times due to one problem or another. Many did not get their rooms cleaned until 4 or 5 o'clock in the evening or not at all. Food choices and wine choices were awful. Transportation was all screwed up and I had to pay a cab to get to the airport when I'd already prepaid a transportation company. 

I went to Punta Cana in May and stayed at Club Med which was AWESOME!!! GREAT FOOD, GREAT STAFF, GREAT ENTERTAINMENT, GREAT VACATION!! This second trip was just OK. I had a ball with my friends. Restaurant Vento I got food poisoning from, just by eating a salad. Some may have liked the accommodations but I knew there were better Resorts than Paradisus Palma Real. I love PUNTA CANA. I will go back but will not  use this hotel nor transportation company.

reviews.author: Escape502054
reviews.title: Poor Management
reviews.text: If it was not for our amazing butler Augustine we would have returned home early. We are very easy to please and never called him. He made it a point to find us each day and check in on us. We booked our room 6 months in advance and upon arriving at the resort we were told that they were overbooked and our room was downgraded. They did comp us a meal at Passions but it was the worst meal we had during our stay. The quality of the sheets were extremely poor and kept us up at night. Martin on the beach was great and went out of his way to make us comfortable. Leonardo at the pool bar always had a smile and was very kind. Juan and Miguel with club Melia were very helpful. Juan went out of his way to help us during our entire stay. The travel arrangements were subpar. They asked that we wake up and meet them at 8:30 am the morning after our arrival. Then they called us two days in a row to obtain the same information that we had given them the day after our arrival. On departure they were late picking us up causing us to arrive at the airport almost an hour late. The were only a handful of restaurants that were worth eating at.

reviews.author: Brian B
reviews.title: Nice Property, Terrible Service. AVOID THIS HOTEL.
reviews.text: We stayed 8 days. The positives: beautiful property, nice beach, great staff at the Pallazo (Royal Service restaurant) - only. The list of negatives is long. The property is exceptionally poorly managed by inexperienced staff. Despite paying the upcharge for Royal Service, we received anything but service. We did manage to meet Carlos, the Asst. Manager, and Carmen, the Head of Butlers, during our laborious stay. Neither could effectively perform their job, and all staff were hard to find - apparently spending lots of time at other properties or elsewhere. The manager, Jorge Mora, appeared to be no more than a business card. He didn't really seem to exist. The butler service (that came with Royal Service) was worthless - actually worse than worthless, painful. We had to change our butler mid-stay, with little positive results. Our complaints were addressed with a $10 bottle of cheap California merlot, as well as a 10% spa discount that we never received, despite having three meetings to discuss this issue and a litany of other issues during our stay. Challenges were many, and included, but were not limited to: butler made dinner reservations about 20% of the time; forgot to do it 80% of the time (resulting in no dinner reservations anywhere); could not seem to reserve us a cabana; never saw 1 waiter or received drinks at the cabana - had to go to the bar and wait (staff were exceptionally slow); maid service put bedding on floor daily, resulting in sand in the bed nightly; maid service showed up either late or at odd and inconvenient hours; despite claims of additional services (laundry, pillows, towels, etc.) - these services could not be delivered, despite numerous calls; food at all but the Pallazo was mediocre, and service exceptionally slow; spa charged us $260 for a service that was listed at $210 (no services were listed at $260 in the spa book, by the way), and couldn't seem to discount the $50 in spa credit; our initial bill showed up with $1,200 (US) in erroneous charges (blamed on a regular computer error); took 2 days for shoe service and obtaining an in-room DVD (plus, once you have a DVD, the regular TV channels no longer work); and, to complete our enjoyment, the butler sent our airport shuttle to the wrong hotel, causing us to almost miss our return flight. The staff at the hotel spent more time chatting with each other than serving the guests. The hotel, overall, seemed driven completely by money, not service. This culture seemed to be systemic, endemic, and ubiquitous; when confronted with challenges, staff were rude and combative. As noted, we had three separate meetings while on the property in an attempt to resolve these issues. None were resolved to our satisfaction. This was an EXCEPTIONALLY disappointing experience. With new leadership and management, this hotel could be great. It is NOT now. AVOID THIS HOTEL. There are many, many better choices in Punta Cana and vicinity.

reviews.author: Cris M
reviews.title: guest service pesimo
reviews.text:
Después de leer los grandes comentarios nos decidimos por este hotel y nuestra sorpresa fue que estando de luna de miel nos dejaron completamente desatendidos y no tuvieron ningun tipo de detalle con nostros. Incluso se tuvo que pedir que juntaran camas ya que nos asignaron una habitacion con camas separadas.
Instalaciones de 10, camareros de 10 pero atencion y servicio al cliente de 0.

reviews.author: Lemorah B
reviews.title: Bang...Bang..Bang..Food not bad, But! I got burned by a hot plate in Vento!
reviews.text: I agree with the comments shared by the other guests regarding the noise level, banging and construction all day.  If your coming for a peaceful vacation, seek refuge at another resort.  The food is not bad but I got burned by a hot plate when a waiter dropped the plate on me....No one at the resort seemed to care.  We traveled with a group of 15, booked with vacation express, many of the rooms were not as pictured (older) but, well equipped, mosquitoes are a problem, as is maid service.  I've been to better 4 star rated resorts...Bottom line, shop around.

reviews.author: michelle_r552
reviews.title: Too noisy!!!!!!!
reviews.text:
We are currently here and I recommend all to stay AWAY during the day! Although the service is amazing, food gorgeous the constant banging & drilling from 8am to 8pm is far from relaxing!! 
I am a strong believer of speaking the truth so waiting service is truly amazing just let down by the lack of peace that I would expect from a top class hotel! We didn't pay to be on a building site or were warned of the noise so not at all happy :-(
Even asked to move our room and was told no more.... Of a hotel this size & being club Melia guests this has been far from relaxing holiday we waited for!!!
I would say, once Noas restaurant has been finished...visit 10/10 for service, quality! 
Gutted we stayed here during these works :-( 
If your booked, change/move hotel unless u like constant banging!!!
Unhappy club Melia guests!!!!!

reviews.author: parman23
reviews.title: Jack hammer and constuction noise all day
reviews.text: This resort does not like Americans  we stayed had a party of seven of us, trip booked by Liberty Travel,  Construction at resort all day long JACK HAMMERING BREAKING CONCRETE, all you hear at pool or beach , service was terrible. all inclusive they beg you for TIPS if you do not give it to them they ignore when you want your next drink, Package  had extras we never received, Liberty Travel did nothing to help us. Hotel manager told us you are not in the united states ,You are in in  foreign country  live with the problems you are going home soon, too bad for you, did not want to fix problems,  restaurants over crowded, long lines to eat,  told premium drinks did not have premium booze, Hotel rooms no face cloths, no hot water in shower, bathroom sink glogged  when you brush your teeth. Water sports include they would not let you use them, STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE TERRIBLE

reviews.author: Cheryl B
reviews.title: Not at all happy with the Royal Service
reviews.text: The royal service was bad. We didn't see our so called butler Juan for the first 24 hours. When we did see him, all he could say was call him(our phone didn't work). We would only se him every 24 hours and it was four days before he could call us by name. Our shower  did not work right for the last the last four days. We told Juan and about four other people, and it was NEVER fixed. The royal service bar was terrible, we have to go to the swim up bar to get any service. Getting a drink on the beach was bad, we ended up getting our drinks at the swim up bar, they were better and twice as fast. The place was far under staffed. Nice place to stay do not get the Royal Service!!

reviews.author: Yarly F
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
what a disappointment! I don't even know where to start, 
food: Terrible, no taste at all and in top of it, there were flies, yes, flies flying all over the food, the plates, the silverware, it made me so nauseous. 

service: S L O W, we had the royal service, what a waste of money, we got the most slow and uniformed butler, he never knew anything, his answer was... "I have to ask " anything from the activities (which there were none) to were we could eat better food, there was not Dominican culture anywhere.

Beach and pool: Great if you want to go sleep, for which I rather use a room, there was no people, or activities in either. the drinks were terrible and again the service, slow and bad

Rooms: the only good thing that this resort had, with the exception of the phone ringing every 30 minutes for no reason.

this trip has been the worst trip I had, really bad because it left me with the sensation of never returning not only to the hotel but to Dominican Republic all together.
 I will never recommend this hotel or the destination.

reviews.author: Kurt S
reviews.title: Would not return
reviews.text: 1) The food was not worth the additional money spent for all-inclusive. 2). There are several restaurants on the property that require a reservation.  First, it is difficult to obtain a reservation, you have to go to the concierge in the morning, stand in line, and the wait until they get the reservation department on the phone (~20 minute wait).  However, there are 3 restaurants that never had availability, which was frustrating.  We ate at the Japanese steakhouse, Thai restaurant, and sushi restaurant.  The food at the Thai restaurant was decent.  The other two restaurants did not provide good food.  And the service at the sushi restaurant was terrible.  It was an approximately 2.5 hour meal. 3) the property is undergoing a major renovation and we experienced the sounds of jack hammering throughout the day. 4) the wifi service is awful, so if you need to check email or other work related items, this is problematic.

reviews.author: CMS120
reviews.title: Last time I am coming
reviews.text:
I have been here 4 times
1st time in 2004: loved it
2nd time in 2007: not bad
3rd time in 2009 (with a big group): not as good as it used to be but it was a fun group
4th time was this week: the place is old, under construction and the service was not good. The food quality diminished significantly
Not what it used to be

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: Very poor experience
reviews.text: Too many room issue that were not handled efficiently.   Food was terrible an left in the sun uncovered and unrefrigerated at the buffets. Service was extremely poor and people were rude.  The man grilling chicken at the lunch buffet rolled his eyes at people asking for chicken. Unbelievable.

reviews.author: Pablo R
reviews.title: Terrible Hotel. Don't stay here!
reviews.text: The worst hotel I've stayed in.  Terrible service, smelly and dated rooms with mosquitoes bugging you all night long. Water leaks all over. Nothing works. The staff can't solve the simplest of problems.  Good thing I adore my wife and she's all I need for me to have a great time. My advice: don't ever stay here!

reviews.author: Gleny D.
reviews.title: will never return
reviews.text:
i was 8/13/14/ to 8/17/14 i was expecting so much more about this hotel I was disappointed  of everything the food the staff not friendly the waiters you had to be searching for them to get a drink. compare to the others hotels I visited in punta cana this is the worst experience ever and for the money that I paid. I was there for a wedding I was so excited all my life I wanted to go to this resort. The Melia which are partners is much better the staff way better.
I made reservation for the hibachi restaurant the lady told me that I will get a ticket to confirm Saturday came there was nothing in my room so I called she told me is fine we have it just go to restaurant we went guess what no reservation I was pissed off. the food at buffet bad I had to get my soda myself for my husband and my friends cause the waiter kept ignoring us. I guess cause we all were Dominicans they treat us differently it has happen with another resort in punta cana.. really disappointed. no night entertainment no activities in day. the only thing  I like was the pool.

reviews.author: L M
reviews.title: Damp cold rooms, even in the Royal Suites!
reviews.text: We stayed in what we were told were the exclusive Royal Suites where we had a full time butler.  The suite was damp constantly.  At first we thought they gave us sheets that were not fully dried so we asked for new sheets.  They gave us the sheets and they were still feeling wet and cold.  The rooms need a de-humidifier.  The restaurants were all very bland.  The value of price for what you get is not very good.  Our suite was about $800 per  night.  The furnishings were not the best, the internet was not the best and a cold wet room doesn't feel like luxury to me.  The staff was pleasant however.

reviews.author: LissA819
reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service,
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel along with family and friends for my cousins wedding and I have to say that although the hotel is beautiful the customer service is HORRIBLE!!!  At first they couldn't find our reservations and asked us to pay for an additional night until they figured it out. Of course we didn't do this but the gentleman at the front desk refused to help us and brushed us off to guest services when it was his job to help us!  Once it was resolved, they gave us a room that had the worst bed ever!  Instead of changing our rooms, they bought in comforters to make it softer but refused to change our rooms because they were "sold out" due to a presidential convention.  Dinner reservations always got screwed up by a staff member and I had to fight to get what we wanted.  All in all, pools are clean, grounds are beautiful, food is decent but customer service is horrible!  Save your money and go else where!  I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone!  I wish I could get a refund!

reviews.author: Charles R
reviews.title: Shockingly Awful Service
reviews.text:
My wife and I decided to spend our honeymoon relaxing in Punta Cana, and we decided to stay at two different resorts for a few days in order to try a couple different experiences.  And we did have two, amazingly different, experiences.  If you are deciding between the Iberostar Grand Bavaro, and Royal Service at the Paradisus Palma Real, take my advice and go to the Iberostar.  The service there was everything it should be and more, while at the Palma Real we experienced one frustrating incident after another.  

To show you had bad it was, we paid 600 dollars to change out flight, and cut our honeymoon a day short, just to be able to leave this place.  We spoke with one of the guest service agents in the Royal Service area while waiting on a manager and asked how her day was going, as it seems things were a little hectic.  The response was a dead give away on why service at this resort was so bad.

She said that they had over booked the Reserve part of the resort, and the way they make it up to guests is to send them to the Palma Real and treat them to Royal Service.  But this overextends the Royal Service staff and they can not provide proper service.  This apparently is a frequent issue.  She said it puts them under a lot of pressure, but they either have to put up with it or they are gone.  After hearing this, it pretty much explained a lot of issues we had.

The main problem of the resort was that the service was not only unfriendly, but downright unwelcoming and rude.  At the Iberostar Grand, servers would come around, introduce themselves, and get us whatever we needed during the day.  Here, we were supposed to have a pool butler that would do the same, but we never saw him once during our stay.  That's fine, we could just go to the bar and grab our own drinks, but unfortunately the bartender would just ignore us.  We overheard one of the servers bad mouthing some of the guests on the beach in Spanish to the bartender.  When my wife spoke Spanish to the bartender he finally begrudgingly made us a drink.  We had a similar experience later at the lobby bar, where the bartender seemed angry that we asked him for a drink.  They were not even very busy, it really surprised us.

So the fact that there were no servers to get get us a drink, and it was an awful experience going to the bar to grab a drink, it really made us not want to drink at all.   The service at the restaurants was not much better.  We had sat down at the Royal Service only restaurant, waited around for a server, decided to go to the buffet and grab some food before someone finally approached us.  There was no hello, no welcome, no friendliness, just a "what do you want to drink" in a frustrated tone.  We finally received our drinks just as we were finishing our food.   That was the only interaction we had with any staff during our entire lunch.

We paid a lot of money to upgrade to "Royal Service" which was such a disappointment.  The adults only pool area and beach was just a small section roped off from the main pool and beach, so kids were still around.  You had to rent a cabana to stay by the Royal Service pool but apparently they were booked out days ahead of time, so that did us no good, we ended up having to go to the main section anyway.  

Our "butler" was ineffective and would lie to us.  We asked him to book a tee time for 9 holes of golf which he never did, until we went to the Royal Service and asked them to confirm it.  We could not get ahold of our butler, and neither could the Royal Service agent so she went ahead and made us a new reservation.  Our butler later made a reservation to cover his tracks, so we now had 2 golf reservations which made things more confusing when we arrived to the course.

We later asked for a dinner reservation at a restaurant at 8.  When he confirmed with us he said to show up at the restaurant around 8:20, or 8:10 or just go at 8.  This sounded weird to us, but later, when a manager was present, he confirmed our reservation was at 8 that night.  When we showed up at the restaurant our reservation was for 9:30pm.  Obviously, he knew this but lied anyway.  We would have been perfectly fine with a 9:30pm reservation if he had just told us.  It was pretty shocking that he would so blatantly lie to us.

This was pretty much the last straw.  We did not want to stay at a place where our main butler would lie to us, where the pool butler was non existent, and the interactions with all other staff members were rude and unwelcoming.  We decided to leave a day early, and even after explaining all of our issues with management, it was like pulling teeth to get them not to charge us for the last night we would not be staying with them.  We didn't even want a refund on a night that we did stay, we just wanted to go home a day early without having to pay for the last night.  This seemed like a nearly impossible task for them, but hours later after speaking with the "upper management" the manager finally called and said we wouldn't be charged for the last night.

I can honestly say this was one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever encountered.  My wife was literally in tears over everything that happened.  This was supposed to be our perfect honeymoon as we start our life together, and Paradisus completely ruined it.  I will obviously never stay at this property again, but also not any other Melia property in the future.  Iberostar will have my business, as they had an abundance of employees who were friendly, relaxed, helpful and remembered your name and treated you like family.  While Melia understaffs and overbooks their resorts to provide a terrible experience for their guests, while their management has no power to make things right.

I could keep going on and on about the poor service experiences we had at this property, but this review is already way too long.  As a hotel manager myself, I hate having to write a review like this, but I would like to warn anyone who is thinking about choosing this resort.    I will finish with a list of other problems we experienced with the actual room:

*The shower would not turn on or off unless you used the jaws of life, and the water was very low flow and not hot.  

*There is no wifi in the room.  I'm sorry, but even the worst hotels have wifi in the room these days. If I am paying 500 dollars a night it would be nice not to have to go to the lobby to check my email.

*There were a couple dead mosquitos in the sink, I didn't think much of it as I washed them down the drain.  Until I woke up the next morning with mosquito bites all over me.

*The "all inclusive" mini fridge had one beer in it for it's alcohol.  One beer, for two people, and that's all inclusive, right.

*Clock in room was set for wrong time and an alarm would go off at 11pm every night

*Lots of construction/noise at the resort

*Towel stand ran out of towels and were rude when you asked for one

Just so this review is not entirely negative, I will list the two pros of this place:

*Beautiful lobby

*The food was excellent for an all inclusive

reviews.author: jgarib
reviews.title: Extremadamente Irresponsables!!
reviews.text: Personal descarado e irresponsables..Pues estuve hospedado en este hotel del 17 al 20 de julio, al llegar un vallet parking se lleva mi vehiculo y ohhh sorpresa !! cuando voy a recogerlo al terminar mi estadia y sin el personal nunca haberme devuelto las llaves.... esta chocado con rayaduras en la parte frontal, aviso al servicio de seguridad en la persona de Eddy Silvestre quien me dice, se encargara del caso, al llamarlo unos dias después su respuesta totalmente grosera fue que se reviso la camara de seguridad y no se ve ningun choque por su personal...bien al pedirle que me mostrara el video me responde que NO, que eso es asunto interno del hotel...Osea que yo tengo que creer sin evidencia lo que el me esta diciendo y de una manera pedante y grosera me dice "que si yo quiero que demande el hotel"...Bien pues al no pensar quedarme con mi vehiculo en ese estado por irresponsabilidad del personal del hotel he levantando un acto de alguacil en la policia nacional dominicana y entregue el caso a mi abogado para que inicie de manera legal mi querella....

reviews.author: Hans C
reviews.title: A complete disappointment
reviews.text:
Normally I do not write on these surveys, even when the service has not been exactly the expected one. Actually this is the first time and I am doing it because someone has to do something to avoid these hidden scams continue affecting other travelers.  We paid roughly three times the value of comparable programs on the understanding we would receive the best service during a short family vacation in Dominican Republic.
A complete disappointment. Certainly the beautiful Dominican beach was there but all the rest was completely disappointing.  The first highly negative impact was realizing the toilette was at full sight in the room. Believe it or not, it was possible to see - and to hear - a person using the toilette from every corner of the room.  It was completely impossible to use the private facilities under its main requirement: in privacy. My wife and I have been married for over 30 years, but we do not feel comfortable sharing our bathroom intimacy thus every time one of us required to use the toilette, the other had to get out of the room. In few words, a totally unacceptable situation for this hotel category.  The sheets appeared to have been there for decades.  Our front ocean view room had a huge construction in front of us adding to the unpleasant view, hammers, the strong roar of diesel engines and the whistles when the machines were in reverse gear, the whole day.
The concierge service, another complete disappointment.  He took us to very low level buffet restaurants.  Five hours to provide simple beach rackets, etc..  Nobody offered us drinks or anything while on the beach, a service that was supposedly included. Every time one of us wanted some water, we had to walk to the nearest station to get it.  Nothing could have been more distant from the promised – and paid - Royal Service!

reviews.author: Lawrence Z
reviews.title: Do yourself a favor stay somewhere else
reviews.text:
The staff that makes your reservations for dinner steer you towards the buffet.
It's the cheapest way to feed you. You have to make a reservation for a restaurant at 9:00am. and go back at 4:00pm to find out if you got a table.
most of the time you won't get a table in the restaurant that you choose and they will put you in a restaurant they want you to go to. The food is terrible, the wine is even worse. The only beer they have is Presidente. If you like medium or medium rare steak, DO NOT GO HERE, all meat and fish is cooked well done. The sushi will make you ill. We left early because it was so bad. I lost 6 pounds from lack of food.
The only place for A/C is in the room,gym,business center,and a couple restaurants that you can't get reservations for. The casino that they advertised on premises was closed for renovations. I could go on and on why you shouldn't stay here but I'm running out of space. call me @ 703.850.3331

reviews.author: Kim C
reviews.title: Trip I can't get excited about!
reviews.text: Haven't even gotten there yet and I'm already aggravated. Booked through RCI we have to pay the all inclusive on our own. Called the number provided by RCI to prepay for the discounted rate. I was told I had to submit a form which by the way took a few phone calls and emails to get then I was told to email the form along with a copy front and back of my credit card and ID. I could not believe they could not provide a secure website for this process! Reluctantly I did this we're leaving in 3 days no charges for the fees or on my card. I've called the resort several times only to get transferred to a line no one answers. I tried to make contact through the company's website and have gotten no response and RCI can't help but give me numbers I already have. I guess all I can do is bring all the copies of emails and phone calls they better honor the discounted rate. After all this hassle this place better be spectacular!

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Worst Service Ever
reviews.text:
I haven't finished my stay at his resort and I have to write the following review. 

Pros: Resort is beautiful and clean, pool is great, beautiful beach, nice towels at the pool.

Cons: 
1. You will be pressured to upgrade to the Royal Service. We chose not to get the Royal Service and though I was tempted by the private pool and beach, the pool is small and the beach is the same exact beach as everyone else except you have a roped off section with cushioned beds instead of regular chaise lounges. Big deal.
2. Reservations for the restaurants are a nightmare. They won't let you book a day early and will only let you book from 9AM to 5 PM the day of. However, try calling at 9:01 AM and you will be told that everything is booked. If you do get reservations confirmed by complaining enough, you will arrive to the restaurant to find they had you at the wrong time and suddenly have a problem seating you when there are empty tables everywhere. It has happened 2 of 3 nights so far.
3. Food is terrible, horrible, even a simple Greek salad was chopped iceberg lettuce with no dressing and fake feta cheese on top. The Market Grille has cold hot dogs, cold nacho cheese, and pathetic burgers. The buffets have maybe 1-2 edible items and the restaurants are not much better.
4. Prepare to wait and wait and wait for service at the bars where the bartenders will flat out tell you to wait or ignore you until you demand a drink. 
5. Prepare to wait and wait to be served at the restaurants, you will have to demand to be given menus and simple drinks (water, coffee, etc,,,).
6. You will be pressured to meet with a concierge to hear their time share sales speech and have to constantly refuse if you are not interested. 
7. You will have to request those resort credits that were promised to you when you booked the room because they won't go out of their way to give them out. 
8. Housekeeping will not show up to clean your room every day, even when requested to come after we found they hadn't cleaned the room between the hours of 10AM and 5PM.
9. No one will bring you drinks on the beach, you have to get your own,
10. Repeated requests to come and fix the WIFI in the room went ignored and unanswered. 
11. The on site Scuba Diving outfit is rude and unprofessional. 
12. The bedding is cheap and flimsy and the robes are old and matted. 
13. The on site Company to offer to snorkel or swim with dolphins is overpriced and short on time - you can find better tours and operators if you leave the resort.

This resort has made it clear that my money is better spent elsewhere. I will not stay in a "Melia" resort again.

reviews.author: Fateful
reviews.title: Don't stay here!
reviews.text: Food is terrible, drinks are watered down. Rather be at work! Service is terrible, one of the worst places I've ever been. Got sick second day, the store was sold out of tums. The room service takes an hour to come every time. The one positive is  The grounds are very nice and the rooms are large, but that's about it.

reviews.text:
went to the resort

reviews.author: kish3
reviews.title: terrible experience
reviews.text: This review probably won't make the cut but i'm going to post this anyway. The staff was ok but the manager was rude. Housekeeping didn't come until we called for them to come clean up our hotel room. Room service didn't come until about 2 hours after we called for them. when we called the front desk at 6 am because we had just ran out of toilette tissue and we needed towels, we were told to call back at 8am when somebody would be available.

reviews.author: BlackhawkSix
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: Not worth the price. Could not get towels to bathe each day. Food is not that great so if you're coming for the food guess again. A/C did not work in adjoining room. One fridge not working. Snacks & drinks not replenished in the mini bar. Shuttle service was terrible with long wait times so you end up walking and losing a few sweat pounds. Expect to tip to get service or you will pay the price. Pools shutdown at 6:30 PM sharp. There's a kids pool and adult but they let the kids run wild in the adult pool, so if you like loud crying kids that splash you when your resting on the water chairs then this place is for you. You have to watch them make your drink or you will not get alcohol in it. Paid $200 for family of four to parasail when arranging through hotel and found out later it should have been $80 but staff takes a cut for negotiating a higher price, all for a 10 min ride in a circle right off the beach. This is not a dream vacation, trust me. First time in Dominican Republic and last!

reviews.author: Salvatore D
reviews.title: Awful Experience
reviews.text: Resort is outdated, things don't work, bathrooms are not accommodating to families, website is misleading in regards to rooms & what is available with the room, management is ineffective and does not do anything to help their customers, service is slow.  Our overall experience & review of this resort is very poor & not only would we not stay at this resort again, the likelihood of us visiting the DR is slim & we will never recommend this resort to anyone.  We chose to stay here because of the wonderful experience we had at the Paradisis in Riviera Maya in Mexico and this was a complete let down.  We will have a hard time staying at any Malia resort in the future.

reviews.author: ImanAl27
reviews.title: Relación Calidad precio, Nulo
reviews.text:
Nos hemos hospedado en este hotel durante 15 días, en nuestra luna de miel. En primer lugar quiero indicar que no es la primera vez que viajamos a la Isla, y que hemos estado en hoteles de mucha menos valoración que superaron nuestras expectativas. 
En una sola palabra, DECEPCIÓN, una enorme decepción.
