Nos alojamos en el Servio Real, de "de Real" más bien tiene poco, el servicio funciona por propinas, personas que al saber que eres de "España" lo primero que te suelta es "España crisis", así que nada a pasar de nosotros durante 15 días. Las tumbonas de la piscina "Royal" se reserva por nombres en las mismas, en 15 días y después de una llamada de atención al mayordomo, 2 días estuvo nuestro nombre allí. Es un hotel en el que el servicio deja mucho que desear, la atención lenta, vaga y sin actitudes positivas, hasta tal punto que pueden llegar a amargarte una cena o comida. Palazzo, restaurante del Servicio "Real", tardan siglos en atenderte, y cuando hay una persona de administración o gerencia, os aseguro que vuelan!!, ni contarte ya si dejas propinas. 3 veces hemos tenido que marcharnos en los desayunos, porque simplemente no te atendían. En la página Web de Meliá, indican la cantidad de restaurantes que hay al servicio de los clientes, pues bien el NAOS y el MOLE, cerrados, por qué? Para dar un mejor servicio al cliente en un futuro se encuentran en reformas, y que sin duda pueden seguir disfrutando de la malísima comida del Buffet del Teatro. Horrible, nada de variedad, es uno de lo Buffets del Caribe con tan poca calidad, servicio, y variedad. Desayunos, comidas y cenas, en un ambiente apagado ( debido a que lo han puesto en un teatro), atención 0, ya que los camareros están a conversaciones entre ellos, o porque simplemente no les apetece atenderte. No se nos ha informado en ningún momento del cierre de estos dos restaurantes. Como propietaria de un Apartahotel Meliá, esperaba más, mucho más y por eso aposté por esta cadena y por el Servicio "Real", que deja mucho que desear. Los precios son desorbitados, y por ello uno de anima en una luna de miel, dejadez en la atención. No recomiendo el Royal Service, es una auténtica estafa, no tienes un servicio mejor, en absoluto, sólo tendrás acceso a la piscina Royal, más pequeña y que nunca el mayordomo se molestará en reservar si no depositas un caramelo de 20$ en sus manos. Comida horrible, nada de variedad, espectáculos que se anulan sin previo aviso, en los bares de playa, aunque hayas venido antes que otra pareja, y da la casualidad que esa pareja deja propina, les atienden a ellos antes, y a tí por no dejarla de mala gana y manera. No están a la altura de la espectacular infraestructura que poseen, sin duda no recomiendo para nada este hotel hasta que mejore en su atención al huésped, la calidad y variedad de comidas, y el espectáculo nocturno. 

Os dejo, la relación de restaurantes:
Aqua, 6
Gabbi Beach, 2( atención de risa, camareros que no te atenderán nunca)
El Vento, 8
Palazzo, tardan mucho, 4
Buffet Teatro, 0 variedad y calidad. Atención ninguna.
Teppayaky, 7 buen espectáculo.
Bistro, 8

Ah, se me olvidaba, en cuanto tengas que marcharte ese día, te harán la vida imposible por teléfono, desde la centralita se ponen a llamarte hasta que te despiertes, que casualidad que sólo nos acosaran a llamadas el mismo día que debíamos dejar la habitación. También vino un camarero ofreciéndonos, ( por cortesía de la casa un vino), por sólo 50$, le cerré la puerta en su cara y me eché a reír un poco, sí señores, este hotel es de risa, se ríen de ti y de tu dinero. Y si vas con la intención de pillar WIFI, olvídate, 15 días reclamando... Si ya va, ya va a la orden, enseguida, ... Y hasta hoy.
Os acosarán para que opineis bien de ellos por Tripadvisor, te dan hasta tarjetitas.
Que desastre!!

reviews.author: Stephan L
reviews.title: Really bad
reviews.text: Stay away: bad service, bad food, dirty and expensive. Will never go again, will not recommend to anyone. Just trust me - it's REALLY bad. You can't sleep how noise rooms are, you're always hungry unless you can eat spoiled food.

reviews.author: PJH28
reviews.title: Dont waste your money, go elsewhere
reviews.text:
I went here recently for a wedding and have never experienced a worse "all inclusive" resort. The night of the wedding was definitely the best (thank God) service and food but every other day, between the mediocre food and disgruntle staff, I would have demanded a refund if I were surrounded by  the group of friends also there for the wedding that made it possible for my boyfriend and I to enjoy this trip by the company we were surrounded by.

Dont waste your money, you would be disappointed.

reviews.author: Maria del Pilar S
reviews.title: This used to be a good hotel
reviews.text: We visited this hotel and used to like it.  But in our last trip ( a weekend getaway with our teenagers ) we were very disappointed, we booked 2 connecting rooms, in the first rooms we got the air conditioning units did not work at all, in the second rooms ( it was a nightmare getting them to change our rooms ), the ac only had 2 settings: artic cold or off, they looked dirty, and smelled like mold,with very few exceptions ( specially a very nice supervisor named Silvio ) the staff was rude and treated us like idiots, and to top it all the food was mediocre at best. Needles to say we cut our stay short and left to another hotel in the area.

reviews.author: snuggs5500
reviews.title: I would tell you how bad in detail
reviews.text:
but I was advised that telling you how I got yelled at for requesting a room service menu was "inappropriate". The food was poor quality, the drinks used the cheapest of booze. One bright light was our room attendant. If you like their work, give the the tip directly, or who knows.

Management was rude. Ask a question and the support staff just looked at you. Interesting "mistake" on my bill for Spa services to the tune of $200. 

No place to go outside the resort... Save the airfare and go to SW FLA

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: Never going back....
reviews.text:
This is an absolutely stunning resort, staffed by people who should NOT be in customer service. They were rude, discourteous and NOT helpful. They would tell you what you wanted to hear, but never solve the issue. That being said, a handful of them are wonderful people--FRANCISCO and GREGORIO were great! Even though WIFI is promised in the rooms, we NEVER had it, and you could barely use it in the lobby! You were required to have reservations for the restaurants, but they'd have 20 open tables! The food wasn't good, and there was not much of a selection. Several restaurants had shut down and some weren't available because we weren't Royal Service guests. They'd save themselves a ton of time and confusion if the restaurants were just first come, first served. The drinks were watered down as well. 

This was an incentive trip provided by my company, and thank goodness. I would NEVER go back to this resort using my own money! ....Although having been to the Hard Rock Resort and Casino in Punta Cana, I most certainly would visit the DR again, and the Hard Rock for that matter! Completely different staff, friendly, helpful, amazing people. It's really a shame that such a beautiful property with such potential is ruined by sour staff, and a poor food/drink experience. They must not pay the staff well at the Palma Real.... don't waste your money!

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.title: ROBAN
reviews.text:
Fuí con un grupo... Comentando entre los 10 chilenos que estábamos, 4 personas sufrieron robos. (Dos denunciaron) Y estamos hablando de un hotel 4 estrellas... Realicé el reclamo correspondiente; Hablé con Isabel (administración) me derivaron con vladimir (RR.PP.) y la respuesta fue: "Este es un hotel que produce millones, pero sin pruebas, no podemos hacer nada" Lamentable! Jamas volví a dejar entrar a alguien a limpiar la habitación si yo no estaba. La postventa es pésima.
El servicio a la habitación es horrible 4 veces tuvieron que ir para dejarme el pedido de desayuno completo!! Se cortó la luz dos veces en 5 dias.... y sin luz la ducha NO FUNCIONA...
Estuve dos días sin wifi!!!
Se demoraron 6 horas en llevarme un par de cervezas!!!
Cuando uno recibe lo que pidió... ya no lo necesita!!! :/
 
La playa maravillosa, las personas de la barra y los restaurantes un 7. Freddy Lopez del Sky bar... Un 10 Excelente!!!

reviews.author: Anup S
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Recently spent my honeymoon at The Reserve and the resort was beautiful. However, the service was terrible. My air conditioner was not working properly for the entire stay and when asked to be moved there was nothing that could be done. Also, all the places to go such as the popular restaurants, main lobby, and the beach were located on Paradisus and required a train ride to the other resort which was a very long wait. There were times in which my wife and I were waiting nearly 30 minutes for a train. Would not recommend at all.

reviews.author: DrewScoot
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach - Horrible Service
reviews.text: Staff showed no concern toward service.  I was shocked at how little they seemed to care.  If I were the manager, I would bring the employees together and reemphasize service as being the only defining difference in a customers experience. The food was average at best and sanitation was not the greatest.  Room service was very poor.  As an example, I called for coffee and cream and 2 hours later I finally got it.  Communication with the staff is very difficult unless you are fluent in Spanish.  I am very happy that I got to see Punta Cana but it will be the last time.  If you are going, make sure to do your due diligence before going and don't be shy for demanding better service if needed.  The question is will they listen.  I hope management at the Paradisus is listening!

reviews.author: Jim G
reviews.title: Royal Service is a Joke
reviews.text: If you want Sushi and want to be treated like crap by your hostess Keniaa...all you have to do is wait 3 hours and still not get a seat.  I just left the resort and had a horrible time.   Although I was listed as royal status and I got a gold wristband....which costs extra....do not think you will be acknowledged.  The WIFI only worked a few hours in the week that I was there.  I was with a group of over 50 people and everyone of us had something broken in our Suites.  If you can get this trip for around 50 bucks then do it...if not run.

reviews.author: sally B
reviews.title: Poor Quality Service
reviews.text: the hotel is beautiful, the beaches are warm and although the rooms are a bit old, I think this hotel has a lot to improve, from butlers to the same management, in a way hide when you have some inconvenience my butler thank god forget his name because he was just looking for a tip, he was a young man who did not speak Spanish or English ... who hires these people and entrust them with our holiday? good job guys on the beach and pool, restaurant staff palazzo if not for you this would have been even worse.

reviews.author: HMP S
reviews.title: Terrible old rooms, poor quality, average atention. Avoid.
reviews.text: We contracted this hotel expecting superior service and quality. Well, this is not the case... We paid for a garden view junior suite and found that this rooms are smelly, and extremely old... So we paid for un upgrade and got a luxury junior suite and it was surprinsingly worse! The air conditioning was broken, so we had to wait for mantainance to get it fixed - and by the way, this guy was very rude to us - so we spent almost one day changing rooms and fixing the AC... Additionally we found the room older than the previous one (they had this old tubular TV set in the room!!). As an all inclusive service I found it defficient. The beach service, if you are not VIP, is inexistant... Nobody will get you a drink! Conclusion, if you have to pay this amount of money go to Mexico instead, service is MUCH better.

reviews.author: marcos h
reviews.title: Royal Service should be Royal Scam....
reviews.text: where to begin,what a beutiful hotel, nice place, nice rooms,ni food,nice location, but what a terrible service from the moment we where introduced to our butler till the moment we left the hotel was a major disaster,Agustino basically only call us make sure we meet him before we go,if you know what i mean, theses people are very tip oriented and thats not very nice...on the other hand i was not request a full bilingual person, but pleaseee i know you can do better that that, the guy was a dissaster...without the butler would have been great....

reviews.author: nancy l
reviews.title: beware
reviews.text:
the good news is this resort has a great location. the grounds are on a 1 to 10 a solid 10.  the buildings are also a 10 in design and eye appeal. the resort is very clean.  the ocean is usable.  the rooms are clean and set up nicely.  NOW the bad news.  beware of the price promised and the actual charges. we over paid $700.00.  No help from the management.  The concierge desk has only one person and what they confirm and tell you is only true maybe 40% of the time.  we had restaurants, dates, and times changed several times. the beach has no drink service.  the resort is very restrictive if you are not a member.  management has no authority to solve issues. not enough towels in the rooms.  some equipment in rooms do not work and it takes most of your vacation to get repairs. if you do not swim or if you are short the pool is to deep for a lot of the guest to use. the sound for the night shows (lion king) was so bad we left the entertainment early.  the restaurants service was lacking...we received our drinks after we had eaten our meal almost 75% of the time.  the resort was just a little off the standard in most cases.  things to note:  you need to pay for a visa before you go...otherwise you will stand in a long line at the airport.  make your taxi arrangements to the property before you go.  the resort charge is twice as high.  the water for brushing your teeth or drinking in your room MUST be bottled water only.  day trips and excursions are great to set up and have handled by the resort desk however do not have any of the excursions people handle the photos or DVDs we paid $45 and received about 10 minutes on the DVD for an entire days adventure.
The property is beautiful and can with some management overview be great. it advertises and charges it self as a 5 star but is only maybe a 3 star experience at a 5 star price.  we will not return.

reviews.author: Brandy R
reviews.title: If you have an IQ higher than your resting heart rate you should really read this!!!!!
reviews.text:
Okay, so I don't really know where to start with this. I have never written a review on here before, but because my experience was so mind-blowingly awful, I felt the need to share it with whoever wants to listen. Honestly, I could write a small novel about why not to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, DR, but I am not going to waste too much time because I have a lot to do today. I always keep a notebook or journal wherever I travel and I write down almost everything so I have documentation and so I avoid forgetting my experiences. While staying here, I accumulated a total of 86 negative experiences and 13 positive ones. Here is a short, but very important, top ten list of reasons why not to stay at this resort:

1. Excessive waste of money on so many levels: I hate spending money and not getting what I want. This place is so expensive that it makes me want to throw up. It is completely unnecessary and disgusting to spend over 6000 USD in one week and walk away unhappy, broke, and mentally exhausted.

2. This resort is really not ALL INCLUSIVE. It is a perfect example of corporate exploitation and greed. What is included is pretty much any amount of booze that you can keep down so that hopefully you will remain drunk enough not to notice or care what is happening around you. I watched a guy have 29 drinks in about 4 hours and then the next day I checked on him and he was in the bath tub passed out and covered in vomit. Where was his butler at this moment with the gatorade, cheeseburger, and Ibuprofen???

3. The rooms are not nice by any means. After leaving the resort I stayed in a hotel for 23 USD per day and was happier there than the Paradisus  (around 400 USD per day).

4. Almost all of the food is disgusting with the two exceptions being the offerings at The Palazzo and the Royal Services Club. If you like frozen food or food that will make you sick, then by any means, eat up my friend. My mom got sick twice from the food, her friend only got sick once. I only ate at the resort a few times so I was safe other than a couple of explosive diarrhea experiences. No big deal right???

5. Just because you have a "Butler" in no way guarantees that you will get what you want. They give you what you think you need or what they are allowed to do based on a ridiculous set of rules and regulations.

6. Background music that sounds exactly like the soundtrack for a soft-core porn movie is playing everywhere and never stops.

7. A lot of NASTY people work here. By nasty I mean excessively bad attitudes. There are a number of fabulous, accommodating, and caring employees, but unfortunately for me the bad managed to outweigh the good due to the extremity of my interactions with terrible people that should burn in hell for all eternity.

8. It takes FOREVER to get anything here. It's almost like they go as slow as they want because they know there is nothing you can do about it, even if you are locked out of your room and need your inhaler so that you won't stop breathing. Death obviously isn't on there list of concerns.

9. Constant lies and over exaggerations about places off the grounds. Punta Cana and the surrounding areas are truly amazing. Wonderful everything: Bars, restaurants, shopping, beaches, people, music, food, and I could go on and on. I liked it so much that I am probably going to buy property here and live here for half of the year. Note: I plan on putting this place out of business or at least hopefully forcing them to get new management so that they can't continue to monetarily rape people on a daily basis. 

10. Do you really need a number 10??? I am getting worked up so I need to stop before I ruin my day and have to spend it doing yoga so I can emotionally reset. Just kidding. Kind of. Anyways, I hope this helps a little. If you need any more information regarding my experience here or you want to know where to stay, eat, drink, dance, swim, drive, shop, get your nails done, or anything else for a fraction of what you will spend in this hell hole, feel free to contact me at raraavis120@gmail.com and I would be more than happy to help you as much I can.

Thanks for reading, and remember, it is okay to use your brain to make sound decisions on a daily basis. It's good for you and makes you live much longer so that you will have years and years and years of good vacations!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer285
reviews.title: Huge Fire - No evacuation plan - stay away
reviews.text:
The best part of this vacation was the masseuse on the beach !!! 
Mold in shower , poor management , making reservations for dinner was so difficult .. They would say there' was no availability yet the resturants would be empty .. Basically , they wanted you to eat at the buffet ... Huge language barrier , they had one English speaking guy named Victor - who was very nice and helpful , however , he was always busy ... 
The ladies that work in the reservation section look at you like you have ten heads when all your doing is trying to book a dinner reservation ..
Worst part of all - a HUGE fire happened due to irresponsible managers allowing fireworks to be set off which caused  a massive fire .. All we got the next day was a letter stating we can use another restaurant - really ?? I hope so , since two of yours burned down .. We expressed our concerns to management and they wanted nothing to do with it !! I would never take my family here EVER .... If I had children I'd leave and stay somewhere else , which many people did , since I felt unsafe as 32 years old .. 
Nothing was compensated or followed up when my husband and I complained , they did not care at all for our safety , which to me is scary especially being 30 min from a hospital . Nobody told us that we would be able to return to our room , I had to call from another hotel twice .. It was awful - never again ..
Advice - talk your way into the resturants , don't leave items left in your room unless you don't care about them..
Pros : pool , beach , wine selection

reviews.author: Disappointed Pl... D
reviews.title: DO NOT VACATION HERE - Absolutely Horrible Experience
reviews.text: To say that I had a bad experience would be an understatement. While the hotel grounds were lovely, my room smelled musty and had flies, mosquitos and visible mold spots on the walls. We were there for a corporate event and Camilo Pache was out hotel liaison. ABSOLUTELY AWFUL SERVICE!!! There was clearly a language barrier and instead of trying to understand what we needed, he would just say "yes" and our requests were never fulfilled. Due to his negligence and poor communication we never received our boxes with gifts for our attendees. There was also a massive fire that burned down the main restaurant area of the resort during our stay. The fire was caused by fireworks that were set off on the beach way too close to the restaurant buildings. I personally witnessed a piece of the fireworks land on one of the thatched roofs of Naos Buffet and start the fire. We were beyond disappointed with our experience at Paradisus and would NEVER return. In fact, we will NEVER return to the Dominican Republic!

reviews.author: Go258374
reviews.title: Nasty
reviews.text: Food terrible- lived on bread all week. Beach was all seaweed- Are you kidding me! Maid kept walking in on us at night for no reason- security lock broken.. Dinner & golf reservations were all messed up. Golf- hidden cost- beware! Management could not speak English when our concerns were brought to them. Cab driver to and from airport took us to wrong hotel and part of airport. Waste of good vacation time ! Next year, back to Aruba. At least they are nice people and speak English !

reviews.author: Christopher V
reviews.title: Royal Service a JOKE
reviews.text: During a 2 day stay, transfer arranged in and out was late, later and then very late.  The butler amenities including phone provided didn't work and we had to tell them a day into the stay, WIFI didn't work to which we were told they knew but didn't disclose, price was exorbitant and realized after staying that a basic room would have sufficed--such as we still paid for premium drinks at an all inclusive Royal Service...to the tune of $17.50 USDollars for a gin and tonic!  Manager experience was a very Latin culture "sorry" only with a smile.  More details…Royal Service reception staff pretends not to speak English and when spoken to in Spanish dismisses the client.  I left thinking "I just spent over $1,500 USDollars for this 2 day experience (BTW meals were provided by the wedding couple and therefore not required as part of our all inclusive hotel).  I would NEVER recommend staying at this resort and certainly NOT pay for "Royal Service".

reviews.author: cindy h
reviews.title: poor service before arriving
reviews.text: I just got off the phone from calling the Reserve Paradisus Punta Cana where we are supposed to stay this upcoming Thursday. 2 phonecalls and  transferred 7 times before I was hung up on.This was after I sent an email yesterday after calling the 800 reservations number and not receiving an answer. I wanted a spa menu/pricing so I could make reservations prior to arrival and could not access this info on web page and was rudely told by an agent that the menu would be in my room upon arrival, only to find that i had been transferred to the Punta Real hotel. I also wanted to confirm that a crib would be in our room and ask about shaded pool/beach areas because i read reviews that stated the shaded areas were for higher level "club" type room customers.  Very frustrating and for such an expensive trip, I am contemplating switching hotels if I don't get a response back before my trip. I hope to re-review this hotel in a more positive light.

reviews.author: ireactivate
reviews.title: So many chances but kept failing
reviews.text:
Nothing about this trip was relaxing. Asked for quiet room and got a room facing neighboring hotel that played music till 3am. Had to move rooms 3 times to get one that was somewhat quiet. My wife left a dress in a closet when we had to pack up after the drunken couple in the adjoining room next door would not keep quiet. That dress was never seen again. House cleaning did not come clean the room another day even after I called 3 times to have them come. Was never given a reason as to why. All the rooms are filled with mosquitos. The free internet in the rooms was broken for 3 days. Every time I called front desk I got the same answer...someone will come fix it right away. It was never fixed. My wife cut her foot playing volleyball from a knife buried in the sand. The beach was not cleaned properly after a dinner event. 
I arrived on a Wednesday and could only get dinner reservations to eat at 9:30pm for the next few nights. I told them I eat early and want to eat at 6 when everything opens. They told me to come back everyday at 3 and ask. I think they just want tips.   Each night I walked by the restaurants and saw 2-3 tables full at 6. After complaining to almost everyone, I finally asked for the manager of the entire resort. If you pay extra money you get to see him right away I found out. Domingo tried to make things right and even drove my wife and I to the airport when our tour company never called us to arrange our prepaid transfer back to airport. Entire trip was one stress after another. We stayed at the Iberostar the year before. Rooms were much cleaner and place was much newer. Reason we changed was their food was horrible. Not sure what to do next....

reviews.author: Thiago Q
reviews.title: All our cash was stolen in the room
reviews.text:
My fiance and I spent 4 nights at the resort. At check-in, we upgraded to Royal Service for US$468 to improve our experience. Things went ok until the very last night. When we came to the room in the evening, we realized all of our cash (kept in our wallets inside our luggage) was taken. Situation was immediatelly reported to Mr. Domingo Beltre, hotel guest manager, who promptly initiated an internal investigation procedure. While they found out that only housekeeping and mini bar replacement were in the room that day, they asked for a 72 hours window to conclude on the investigation. A week after we took off, I received a call from Mr. Beltre (after leaving at least 4 messages and exchanging a few emails) saying they found no evidences and there was nothing to be done. I asked him to kindly consider refunding our Royal service upgrade money, because we obvisouly didn't get it. Mr. Beltre refused my request. 
While it was our mistake and our decision not to use the safebox, this is not what you expect from a 5 star resort. Lesson learned. AVOID THIS RESORT

reviews.author: ILuv2Travel_Bri
reviews.title: Would never stay here again.
reviews.text:
I have never experienced such poor service at a resort. 

3 of the days we were there we didn't have running water in our room. They refused to move our room and said it was just an unfortunate circumstance at the hotel. They also refused to provide us with any sort of discount showing that they cared.

The cleaning service stole $150 from my friend's bag on the first night there. We reported it and they said they would take care of it. Every time we checked with them they said they were taking care of it. We can see now it was just their way of stalling us to the end of our vacation. Then on the day we were flying out we checked again and they said they asked the cleaning lady and she said she didn't take it so we must have been mistaken and not have had any money. They said they didn't feel comfortable blaming the cleaning staff if they said they didn't do it. They did nothing and we were furious. 

The keys for the room are cards. Our key continually stopped working. One time we had the neighbours call for someone to come let us in and we called 3 times in an hour before having to go get a key ourselves.

The service at the restaurants was the slowest I have ever experienced. One time I waited 40 minutes at the high-end restaurant for a glass of wine before my friend just went behind the bar and got it herself. I have been to a number of all-inclusives but this one has by far the WORST service!

On top of that the food wasn't good. It was 3 star quality. The options were minimal and not very good. 

Internet is not a big deal - it's vacation after all. However they told us we would have Internet in our room and that is a lie. You only get intermittent Internet if you stand right beside the front desk. 

In conclusion, if you are planning to go to Punta Cana stay somewhere else. There are many fantastic resorts in the area. This is definitely not one of them and not at all worth the money.

reviews.author: Alanai2014
reviews.title: Royal Service NOT good.. Rude management!
reviews.text: Checked in on valentines night at 11pm. Royal service was closed. Front desk gave us a dirty room with liqour bottles half empty. Nothing special in room as they said would be fruit and wine. Complained next day and managers did nothing at royal service. We paid extra when booking reservation and the management at royal service did not do anything about our horrible experience on first night which was valentines night. Talked to 3 different managers. Spent 5 hours during a beautiful day inside their lounge to wait and talk to someone with no results. Very frustrating rude and horrible experience. Butler was good and pool service Billy was great! Overall I would not spend on the royal service. If u have a bad experience they do not accommodate or care. Such a huge hotel chain and such horrible service. Bad valentines weekend.. Would not go back. Rather stay somewhere else. All the had to do was refund money for the first night or maybe make us pay half for that first night. Dirty or a used room for $700 a night is completely unacceptable. They wouldn't let us leave until they ran our credit card in full. Never been to a hotel (and I travel A lot) and the management is not willing to compensate.

reviews.author: crewrest
reviews.title: Never to return
reviews.text:
This was my 3rd visit and the property continues to get worse.  Each bar had different rules on type of liquor I could drink.  The restaurants are impossible to make a reservation.  I had a bug in my salad from the buffet, the lobster was old/frozen at Naos.  I wrote to Vladimir Rodriguez in Guest Services before and during the stay.  He assured me I did not need to make dinner rez before my visit. One of the phones did not work.  Wash clothes were never replenished.  Power outage as usual.
On a good note, Roberto at the Sky Bar was wonderful and exceeded everyone.

reviews.author: Theresa S
reviews.title: Wish I could have actually stayed there!!!
reviews.text:
We booked this holiday to spend time with my sister and her her husband.  They were able to go for two weeks, but with our work we were able to go only for one.  I had heard of people booking with other people and end up not even at the same resort, so to avoid this we booked through a travel agent at the Paradisus Punta Cana.  We even upgraded at $400 per person for Royal Service.  

My sister and her husband arrived on January 17th and were picked up at the airport and taken to what they thought was the Paradisus Punta Cana.  They were actually taken to the Paradisus Palma Real.  These two resorts are run by the same organization, and at no time were they told that they were in a different resort from what was booked.  They had a great time at the Palma Real, and thoroughly enjoyed their Royal Service Butler Javier.  They asked him to keep and eye out for our arrival on the 24th of January in hopes that we could get a room close to them and have Javier as our RS butler as well.  Much to their dismay they found out that we were going to be sent to an entirely different resort.  Luckily they sent us a text message that we got when our flight landed and we went to the Palma Real instead of the Punta Cana to have it all sorted out.

Unfortunately they informed us that both resorts were 110% booked and we would not be able to move to the Palma Real nor could they be moved to the Punta Cana.  We asked if we could have wrist bands for both resorts so we could travel back and forth between resorts and were told that they were not able to do this even though they are essentially the same organization.  We could not understand this.  Their ultimate solution was to move us all to an entirely different resort "Breathless" which was supposed to be 10 min away (more like 45 min).  So after landing at 4:30 pm we arrived at Breathless at approximately 11:00 pm.

I wish I could say what the service was like at either the Paradisus Punta Cana/Palma Real was like but unfortunately we paid $5200 cnd ($800) extra for Royal Service that we were not able to experience.  I believe that the simpler solution would have been to allow us to travel between resorts but keeping their customers happy was an option for them.  They kept saying that they were paying to have us moved but didn't seen to remember that we had already paid them as well.  I was especially disappointed when I found out that they paid to have us transferred to a resort that had the same "Royal Service" called "Xhale Club" at Breathless, but did not pay the extra for us to have what we paid for but were quite happy to keep the extra we paid to them.  Breathless is a very new resort about 45 min away and I have done a separate review for them.  Very disapointing!

reviews.author: SandraRI913
reviews.title: Can't wait to get out of here
reviews.text:
so, I am now in my 4th day at a royal service suite at this resort.  let me be clear, it isn't cheap, over $ 350 a night per person.   where should I start....the food sucks.    At least the people paying the normal rate at an all inclusive expect the food to be average at best, but don't call something royal service 
and serve awful food there too.
Make sure you don't expect requests to be followed up on.....ordered from the pillow menu four times, never got anything.  
Keys are also interesting, seems like they are a one use only.....we had to get new keys every day, and no we didn't put them anywhere near our credit cards.   Clock in the room didn't work, even the butler couldn't fix it.  
One more comment about so called royal service....I would think that comes with the option of ordering food at the pool.    Nope....we get to get up and head over to the buffet with the smart people who didn't fork over extra money to get a better level of service

Never again and there are 24 hrs left to our stay...I'll repost should a miracle happen and there is some improvement 

Sandy Coletta.  Room 2094

reviews.author: laeti1978
reviews.title: Trop cher pour ce que c'est
reviews.text:
Je suis partie 7 jours avec ma fille de 4 ans. Du début à la fin cet hôtel a été lamentable et nul.
D'abord j'ai du attendre 20 min à la réception car à 500 $ la nuit figurez vous que nous n'etions pas attendues... j'ai pourtant envoyé 3 mails avant de partir de France.  Pas meme un mot sympa genre bienvenue ou merci d'avoir lâché 2500 €. Pas même un verre d'eau.
La chambre attribuée (2055) donnait sur rue avec le bruit des véhicules et scoot du room service H24... et les odeurs d'essence. .. un désastre. 
La ventilation ne fonctionnait pas. La TV non plus. Il a fallu la changer.
Super pour un 5 étoiles luxe! ! 
J'ai exigé un changement de chambre.  On nous a mis en 3022. Chbr communicante.  Fuite d'eau au niveau de la chasse d'eau.  Rien n'est fait malgré 3 appels.
On nous a bien rappelé à la réception qu'on n'a payé que pour la deluxe garden view et qu'on n'aura rien d'autre.  Très chic. 
Si on ne file pas 1 dollar dès qu'on lève le petit doigt on ne nous regarde pas! 
Le kids zone est une piscine avec des vieux toboggans fêlés pour les petits.  Il faut prendre un vehicule pour aller ds l'hotel Reserve.  Mais on n'y est toléré qu'1 h par jour!  Et interdiction de commander un coca pour les enfants car on n'a que le bracelet vert soit le forfait qu'ils nomment "standard".... et au prix payé faudrait s' estimer heureux qu'on nous laisse venir!!!!!!! 
Avec ce forfait de base on ne peut pas aller au Gabi beach et dans aucune autre piscine que la principale du paradisus.  J'ai pourtant acheté un accès partout. 3 piscines. ..mais non . Nous étions rejetées telles des pestiferees de partout. 
La plage?   Il faut courir reserver une paillote avant 8 h le matin tels des creves la dalle si vous voulez de l'ombre.  La plage est divisée en 3. Le royal service avec des clic clac en guise de transat.  La plage des "pauvres" avec des fauteuils inconfortables à souhait.  Et la partie des VIP ou résidents de la Réserve avec des transat grand confort. ...
Vous comprenez vous n'avez pas payé assez cher pour avoir droit au confort.  Vous avez juste le droit de loucher sur ce que les autres ont!!

Les bateaux passent et repassent. Ca pollue l'air. Hélicoptère et parachute ascensionnel en permanence. On nous harcele pour nous vendre les excursions et le parachute. 
Aucun calme.

J'ai perdu un temps infini à essayer de regler les soucis.  

Au final on ne peut pas dire qu'on nous a aidé.  C'était NON pour tout. L'hôtel reçoit beaucoup de séminaires. Et là ils sortent le grand jeu. Ils preparent des tablées sur la plage.  Nous genent avec les bruits.  Mais nous n'avons qe le droit de nous taire.  A ce prix là c'est logique! !
Les séminaires ont des verres de bienvenue,  des cadeaux et attention.  RIEN DE TOUT CELA AU CLIENT LAMBDA QUI ECONOMISE 1 AN POUR SE PAYER DES VACANCES!!!!

Les restaurants. ... du moins le Naos ...bo. mais en rien sensationnel. Le room service. .. pas bon. Hamburger sec. Pizzas sèches. .. viande minuscule! ! Frites au goût de vieille huile. ..

FUYEZ CET ÉTABLISSEMENT! !

reviews.author: Ranfys R
reviews.title: El personal del hotel es lo que vale
reviews.text: Todo fue muy bonito solo contando con el personal, si la direccion no cuida su personal el hotel va a desaparcer o los huespedes se van a ir y no van a regresar, deben de mejorar la cominda y la areas tanto las habitaciones ya que estan muy viejas

reviews.author: Amanda S
reviews.title: WORST SERVICE EVERY
reviews.text:
Worst service ever!  The staff is useless and barely speaks English.  

I had requested a room near my mom and her boyfriend, who we were surprising there to celebrate her birthday.  When they checked in (before us), there wasn't even a reservation for their room.  When we checked in, they completely disregarded our request and then tried to get us to pay more to be closer to them.  I also wanted to do something extra and have a gift or decorations in her room for her birthday and put in several requests and no one got back to me or did anything.  

We were introduced to someone who was supposed to follow up with us to make all of our dinner reservations (because you need to do that there), etc.  His name was "AC".  After checking in, we never saw or heard from him - useless!  Our bags didn't arrive with us so no one showed us to our room.  I asked "AC" to show us how to get there because we just arrived and were completely unfamiliar with the property and he said that the bellhop is supposed to take us - knowing that we had no luggage!  I said we have no luggage. He laughed ad shrugged.  

We were left to our own, wandering all around the large property for at least a half an hour asking various staff members for direction.  Most were unwilling to help, said they didn't know and other just didn't speak English! How do you work at a resort and not know your way around?  

We have NEVER been treated so poorly upon checking in.  Additionally, the person at the front desk who said he would call the airline for our luggage to give them our room #, but never called.  He said it was busy.   Because of this, receiving our luggage was delayed even further!  

It seemed as though no one there wanted to do their job.  If you're looking for a resort with excellence service, DO NOT GO TO THE PARADISUS PALMA REAL!  On a positive note, the property was beautiful and well kept; the rooms were clean and the food wasn't bad.

reviews.author: JVMorales05
reviews.title: I'm sorry but TA got this one wrong...
reviews.text:
If you're like me, I check out Tripadvisor, yelp, foursquare everywhere I go.  Sometimes I won't even pick up a menu, rather I'll thumb through pictures on yelp.  Same goes for my taste in hotels, usually I link up with the masses on tripadvisor.  I'll find the highest hotel on the list that fits my budget.  Well in this case my Tripadvisor peers need to re-evaluate this place...

While there were many things wrong with this stay it all roots from the Policies in which this place is managed.  In a heart beat I wouldn't hold my unsatisfactory experience against any of the service staff and most importantly our butler.  The terrible experience is all managements hands, they own this one.

Lets start with SERVICE...  9 out of 10 times I would be disappointed for asking a question.  When most places you'll hear "es un placer" (it's a pleasure) this place most common response was "no, sorry".  Majority in part that I paid for a royal service experience, you justifiably would expect the frustration free, no worries, good time feeling.  Almost every night I was told, no reservations, we don't have this drink, that fruit, not open at this time, you can't use this...  Literally every day was one aggravation after another, most commonly were restaurant reservations which ALWAYS had plenty of tables.  The resort credits are a JOKE.  I basically let it go, but inside was furious, because it's just so DECEPTIVE.  For each credit you have to spend a certain amount, where the benefit is about 10-20% off in most cases, not outright credits.  So when you think you're getting a 1500$ credit, which may have factored into your length of stay, it's really just coupons for 20% off your getting.  Similar establishments in mexico let you use them outright, were services may end up being free to a point.  It's all good and accepted giving it was a promotion to earn your business, not to deceive guests into staying with you. 

FOOD and DRINKS are laughable...  the market grill is a step below high school cafeteria food and the prank on everyone is... that's what they call their steakhouse in the evening.  Just gets rebranded after 5pm.  So think of the pizza and fried food grill on your last cruise, now dim the lights and call it a steakhouse.  Thats just the beginning, we ventured to every restaurant including the reserve and all were hands down subpar cruise food.  You might say, well it's a large hotel what can you expect, food has to be scale-able at some point, can't be perfect?  I would agree but I also wouldn't give the place # 7 on hotels in punta cana!!!!  Seriously hotel should be in the 30s with this food quality.  And Drinks... the bottomless sugar coma non alcoholic beverages.  So I'm a big fan of fruity drinks when on vacations but these were just watered down, sugared down, messes.  First thing I wanted when I got there was a nice fresh fruit drink, shortly after disappointed because nothing is fresh.  Anything you want will be pre bottled, most likely watered down.  Only time I ever got a buzz from drinking on a 8 day trip was when I left the hotel for an excursion.  I'd have to ask them to serve 3 quarters alcohol just to taste it, even then would have several later without a buzz.  Yeah i know I must be an alcoholic (not the case :) just looking to have a good time while in paradise) And OMG open lunch at 12PM, you're killing me with the logic behind the time you open for lunch.  IT's like they purposely only want you to eat at the Marketplace grill.  The Royal service restuarant opens at 1:30 for lunch, gabi beach opens at 1pm and the buffet opens at 12:30.  12:30, 1pm doesn't sound bad, i know, but its incredibly inopportune when you have excursions scooping you up at 12 every time.  Or if you start the day earlier and therefore start getting hungry around 11:30.  The marketplace grill is just that bad that you will be doing everything to avoid it...  Also no menu service by pool or beach.  I wanted to take something out of the restaurantand bring to beach or room, would not allow it.  Don't even try ordering room service from a restaurant, they'll look at you with 10 heads.  It's an all inclusive, why are you being so STINGY????  Just remembered! They constantly ran out of alcohol at night! Instead of them running to another bar or asking for my supplies, they would tell you sorry all out and then point to the dozens of empty bottles behind them as if proud.  While I stand there stupified...  Seriously where is the supervision?  They don't even properly stock for the next day... went down to the cafe for cappuccino and baileys at 10am, "sorry sir all out of baileys"?????? Killing me....

I'm now tired of typing and while I could go on it's not worth my time.  Anybody excited about punta cana, sorry for being a buzz kill.  Had an exponentially better experience at Le Blanc in cancun.  Where Le Blanc was actually ROYAL SERVICE.  No matter what you ask for, they do their best to reasonably accommodate.  While paradisus royal service is by far better then not having it, it's still a low standard to go to for the expense. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE until this place starts shaping up.

reviews.author: Ashley C
reviews.title: Worst vacation ever! :( staff steals
reviews.text:
I want to start off by saying this is my very first review on trip advisor. I feel so strongly about this that I just had to write a review of our experience. We love to travel and we fly to the Caribbean 2-3 times a year but never had been to Punta Cana. 

We were SO disappointed in our stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. We came here to check out the resort and meet the wedding planners for our wedding next year. Needless to say, we will never go back.... Probably not even to Dominican Republic! 

The food was absolutely horrible. We were ready to leave by our first full day because we had not even had one good meal. My fiancé and I figured that we would give them the benefit of the doubt and keep trying different restaurants..... Unfortunately it kept getting worse and worse. 
We ended up changing our flight to an earlier day.... WE PAID to LEAVE our vacation early! .... That's how bad it was! We were in shock that people were actually eating the food!!!! Even after a day of being back home, I am still sick and nauseated with a suppressed appetite. 

The resort itself is breathtaking. We were in awe of the beauty of the landscaping and the ambiance this place has. It is such a shame that the food is so bad..... Paradisus Palma Real could truly be a 5 star resort if they get their act together. 

Upon arrival, we upgraded to the "Royal Service" in an oceanfront room.... Which came with our own butler. This was a waste of money. We were supposed to have our own private pools and private areas..... They had no staff making sure the area was for Royal service only. 
The butler was supposed to make restaurant reservations for us, but every restaurant we went to had no reservation at all! 

The rooms need to be updated a bit...the overhead fan in our room didn't work and we had a serious ant problem. 
If you visit this resort **USE THE SAFE!** We made sure everything valuable was in our safe..... I would even put my nice Bobbi Brown/MAC makeup in there ..... I'd rather be safe than sorry. (I did get my Coach luggage tag stolen which is something I didn't even think about putting in the safe UGH!) 

Even though it took almost 2 hours of getting the "run around", we FINALLY got to speak with a few managers. They were very concerned about the issues that we had and tried to make it right for us.....unfortunately the damage had been done and we just wanted to leave. 
We were very mislead about this resort..... We really did our research in trying to find the best place to stay in Punta Cana but it was a total BUST!! We have never been so happy to be back home in the U.S. Because of this trip, we will not be leaving the United States for a while.....We have completely changed our dream of having a destination wedding in the Caribbean to having it here in the United States. 

If you are used to 5 star food/service/quality, this is not the resort for you! Beware!

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.title: Food is terrible beware
reviews.text: The hotel is great.  The staff is great.  Its a wonderful place.  But beware the food is gross and its the same everywhere.  I felt like I was on a diet the whole time and still couldn't get a decent salad.

reviews.author: Alp K
reviews.title: Worst front desk ever (Melvin L.), No Internet in rooms!
reviews.text:
They advertise that rooms have wireless internet connection.
Front Desk is very rude, and they never heard the word "Customer Service" in their life. 

I called 6,7 times the front desk and complain about not having internet connection in my room for the whole week I stayed, they kept saying, we'll send someone and they never did.

When I checked out, I told the front desk about this issue (His name was Melvin L.) and he was arguing with me and basically told me there is nothing he can do. All managers are gone (1:30 pm by the way) and that's it...!

Then I took his name and told him that I am going to write a review about my experience and he said "one second, let me get the manager." All of a sudden now he can call the manager.

He was laughing on the phone when he called the manager ( I don't know Spanish so have no idea what he was saying) and I felt like he was making fun of me. Someone came with a stupid smile and told me he will investigate. made me wait an hour and told me I only called 1 time for no internet. Which is a lie! He said he can't do anything.

So, Nice beach, nice weather, nice spa with a terrible staff who doesn't know how to treat people with respect and courtesy and not trained enough to know not to laugh at a customer who just paid $500 a night.

I Will never go back there again..

reviews.author: Eric P
reviews.title: pretty place, disappointing food and horrible service
reviews.text: Nice pool and beach.  Room was nice too.  Otherwise, this place was absolutely horrible.  If you ask a member of the staff to do something for you, or bring you something, you can bet it won't be done right.  The service at the restaurants was so bad -- and not just bad for an all-inclusive resort, but bad compared to any Denny's or diner.  Similarly, the front desk and room service were worse than I have ever experienced in any hotel.  For example, my wife and I lugged our own luggage from our room to the taxi stand (because the people who were supposed to come get the luggage never showed up, despite my calling the front desk -- no surprise there.   We, burdened by luggage, passed several employees who said "you are leaving?  ok, bye bye... safe trip...".  No offer to help.  No surprise to us by that point.  After 4 days here, we expected as much.  Once during my stay they brought me a warm can of beer and when I pointed out that it was warm and asked for another, I was told "do you want some ice?" I asked "could I have a cold one please?".  The response was a doubtful expression and "sorry.  I will check."   I knew I'd never see that server again and I was right.   This place is unbelievably bad.  Finally, they seem to spray A LOT of insect repellant around the place -- not many bugs (good), and constant stench of chemicals (can't be healthy).  Finally finally, the spa was really nice with excellent massages.  After the food and service at this place, I was reluctant to pay them another nickel, but the money I spent on my spa services were well worth it.

reviews.author: VacayGolfer
reviews.title: Read this carefully before booking!
reviews.text:
First and foremost, the Dominican is a beautiful country with diverse resources, beauty, great people, etc. The grounds are beautiful at the Reserve and throughout the Paradisus resort in Punta Cana. Everything else is DISTURBING. I do not recommend this hotel in any circumstance or situation. First, we arrived and having booked three rooms, they decided that two was enough - and when I told them they were incorrect, they tried to argue and did not believe me. I had to pull up my reservation to prove that we did, in fact, have 3 rooms. Read carefully below - this is a $7,300 reservation for 6 nights.. FYI. 

1. Do not expect anything to happen fast (service is a 1/10). After traveling for 15 hours, we waited 3 hours for a crib to be delivered for our child (after calling service 4 times). FYI - the crib was from circa 1940 and not large enough for a 3-month old, much less a 9-month old. 
2. Be prepared when ordering room service for them to either hang up on you or continue to tell you to dial X8320 over and over again. Guess what.. no one answers that extension. 
3. Being in the reserve, you have a select area on the beach. Well, this is pointless because in order to reserve a spot, you will need to arrive before 8 a.m. and take your belongings and YOURSELF - DO NOT LEAVE THEM IN ANY SITUATION! 
4. Do not expect to sleep, the doors in each villa (in the reserve area) are very heavy and do not have any spring action or padding to prevent the doors from slamming. If you have children, they will wake up and cry/scream every time a door closes in your building. This happened 42 times after midnight in our building our first night. Exact count. 
5. Transportation around the resort is horrible at best. On more than one occasion a cart (for melia club members - we are) shook their head and refused to pick us up. The train service to get to the pools/beach/restaurants is 15-minute wait on average. 
6. Making reservations at the restaurants is absolutely insulting for an all-inclusive. Do this on your very first night or you will be eating buffet or room service for your entire stay. 
7. Met multiple families who were in agreement everywhere we went about all the issues mentioned above! One family has been to this resort for 7 straight years and will not ever come back they said! 
8. Finally, this is not a resort for a vacation, expect nothing but headaches, inconveniences, extremely poor service, horrible food, and extremely overpriced. Do your research but more importantly, do yourself a favor and choose somewhere else to "vacation".

reviews.author: leitishaj
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my entire experience at your resort during my stay, Jul 27 - Aug 3.  I planned this family vacation for a party of 9 and can say by far this was one of the worst vacations we've had and would never recommend this resort.  We requested to have all 3 rooms together 7 months in advance and received the complete opposite.  One room contained mold in the picture frames, water damage to the ceiling with peeling paint, a hole in the wall above the cabinet, and a horrible smell of mildew (1435).  The second room contained a dirty/stained shower (3435). The third room kitchen cabinet and wall would leak of water when the faucet was turned on (1372).  I attempted to get reservations changed for dinner on 2 separate days at the check in area across from the Vento restaurant with no success, claiming the restaurants were completely booked.  It was extremely irritating especially since there were plenty of open tables at all of the restaurants we ate at every night.  When I requested a reservation change the last 2 days we were there from our building concierge (Claudia) she was able to make the changes without any problems.  How is it the front desk claims restaurants were full but our building concierge can change them without hesitation???  It was nearly impossible to get drinks at the swim up bar in the reserve swimming pool.  The shuttle/transportation services were horrible as well.  You should NEVER have to wait 40 minutes to get a ride across the resort.  You need more employees and shuttles to transport people around the resort.  On top of all of that, the food, with the exception of Vento, The Grill, and Fuego, was not pleasant.  It was luke warm, not cooked properly, and lacking good flavor.  This is the most money ($2500 US per room) we have ever paid for on a vacation and it turned out to be the worst money ever spent.  When I spend that much money I expect excellent service, immaculate rooms/facilities, and food to order at every meal.  I highly suggest new management and a reevaluation of your facility.  I will do my best to spread the word to as many people as possible to avoid The Reserve at Punta Cana at all costs.  The only nice thing I could possibly stay at this resort is the out of this world beach, but that for us is not enough or worth the money we spent in total ($8000).

reviews.author: Carync6
reviews.title: Horrible Service!
reviews.text:
My husband and I traveled to this resort as part of a large group.   We would not normally go to the large all inclusive resorts as you will typically find the food to be very average. This resort did not disappoint!   With the exception of the food at the Palazzo, which is only accessible through royal service, the food was not good.   When we arrived, it took over 90 mins for them to deliver our luggage to our room.  We were introduced to our Butler for our royal service room and given a phone so that he could be at our fingertips.  Well, he was not!  We called right away and he didn't answer twice.  Two times I called the Royal Service main number and once was cut off and the other I was put on hold.  I asked for ice, it never came.  The butler showed up once to put hot water in our tub (which we didn't ask for).  I wouldn't have used it anyway but it was lukewarm when we arrived.  Wouldn't you think they would find out when you planned to return to the room if they were trying to provide a nice surprise?   The only other time our butler appeared was the last night.  He came delivering a plate of fruit but you could tell his only purpose was to get a tip.  We did not give him one as he had done nothing to earn it.
The royal service rooms were ok.  The privacy into the bathroom is awful.  There is a wood frame barrier with see through posts. The doors to the shower and toilet are faintly frosted but you can see through them.  The sound carries!   They pushed two double beds together and made them appear to be a super king sized bed.   We might as well have slept in two separate beds because there was a big him in the middle where they were shoved together and you could not lay on it.   Furthermore, the light switches were in the middle between the two beds, so since the beds were pushed together, you had to crawl onto the bed to get to many of the switches.   Many of the couples in our group experienced the same issues.

The beach itself was pretty but the water is not!  It is filled with sea grass.   It feels like pine straw in the water and isn't clear so not really nice to hang out in.  The pools were nice enough.  The royal service pool is tiny so we hung out at the end of the main pool that is designated for royal service.  The downside to this is that the staff NEVER waits on you if you are there.  We always had to go to the bar ourselves.

Our worst service came at the Palazzo one evening.  My husband and I were hungry at 6:15 pm but our group dinner wasn't until 8pm. We thought we would stop by the restaurant and eat an appetizer.  When we arrived, we were asked if we had reservations and we said no and explained we just wanted to eat an appetizer.  We asked if we could sit at the bar so we did.  They asked what we wanted but only took my order.  A few minutes later they came and moved us to a table.  It was 6:20 when we sat down.  They said they couldn't take our order (which we thought they already had) because it wasn't 6:30.  We said no problem, we can wait 10 mins.   5 mins later my food came (my husband's didn't).  It was the wrong order.  I explained this to the waiter and his response was "well, we have  a problem.  You don't have reservations and then he pointed to my husband and said you don't have the right shoes on!  Unbelievable!   If this was an issue, they should have politely asked him to change shoes when we arrived.  However, they were not happy about having us there and then getting the order wrong so then they turned the tables on us.   We got up and left.    This type of service was consistent throughout the resort.  If you wanted to charge something to your room at the store, it took 5 or more minutes for them to verify that you could do that and then they were very put off by the request.  We were not the only ones that experienced this.   Anytime we asked for help on something, the staff just said they couldn't answer, we should go see someone else.   I would never return here because the staff really is horrible!  They do not care for anyone who speaks English.  There were a few exceptions and these were all in the NON royal service area.  I would not waste your money on the RS and these folks are the rudest and want tips only.

My husband and I have traveled around the world and stayed at luxury resorts around the world and this is certainly NOT  a place I would return.

reviews.author: Philip L
reviews.title: They need to get it together.....
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort May 30t - 31st and we somewhat disappointed. Although the staff was friendly, they moved very slowly. We checked in lat 11:00 PM on Thursday night and it took about 30 minutes just to check-in. The gentlemen that checked us in did not give us any information on the hotel or how it worked or was laid out. When we got to our room (1008) the door was jammed and hard to open. The safe was locked and did not open and the telephone by the nightstand did not work properly. There was no room service menu in our room..... I could go on and on... The coffee in the morning was cold and the toilet ran all night. The TV did not work and on Saturday morning our keys went dead and it took 45 minutes and two trips to the Front Desk to get keys that worked properly. Overall, the property was beautiful but I would not recommend this property to anyone.

reviews.author: Dale R
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but poor service
reviews.text: We leave tomorrow after a weeks stay. We are here for a conference of about 120 people attending. This resort is just beautiful. Nice beaches & amazing pool. Room is very nice. It is just too bad that the service was so poor for us. One day we did not get our room cleaned until 9:30pm. I made 3 calls to housekeeping and was told we will send someone. I finall had to go to the front desk to get towels & toilet paper. The next day they cleaned the room about 10am & said they would be right back with towels. They never returned & we were using toilet paper to dry our hands. At 3pm I went to the front desk to complain. During the conference we were given a 1 hour lunch break. That morning before I left I ordered room service for lunch service at noon. At 12:40 I call as no lunch. I was told it was not yet ready. This left me no time to get lunch at their buffet. A call to advise of a late delivery would have been nice. I complained to the desk. The kitchen manager did come to our room to apologize & that was nice. I would not stay here again & recommended to our conference to not return here next year. Too bad as the staff is nice & a beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Margaret
reviews.title: Bad Food, Bad Service... No Thanks
reviews.text:
Yes, the grounds and rooms are nice but most Caribbean resorts are.  If you’ve been to one you’ve been to them all, so what it comes down to is good food and good service and this place is way below par in both of those categories.

I’m not sure what the deal is with this place but the service and friendliness of the workers was horrible during our stay.  We were part of a large group and most people we ran into said the same thing so we know it wasn’t just us.  To get any information, restaurant reservations, etc is difficult. No one is willing to help with anything or make your stay easy.

The food is absolutely disgusting.  Everything is served cold and the quality is inedible.  We ate at both buffets, the Mediterranean, the Asian, Mole, and Aqua.  At Aqua we had a table of 10 people, and half of our food came out under cooked, raw grouper. We sent it back and asked them to cook it more and when it came back out it was still under cooked.  At other restaurants, my husband had bones/cartilage/unknown hard pieces in a couple of his meat dishes. I can go on and on about the food but will stop, you get the point. 

Ohhh and bring some super glue for your resort bracelet, if it falls off be prepared to pay $250 or be told that security will be called to take you off property. Yep, $250 for a piece of string.  Also, when you let the front desk know it fell of be prepared for attitude, eye rolling and a finger point at you saying it’s your fault.  Your fault that the resort didn’t tie it tight enough, yes that is correct. If you need to speak to a manger about this matter there is none there on Saturday night so hope that this scenario doesn’t happen on a Saturday.  True story.

Another thing to point out is that the resorts wi-fi only works in certain parts of the lobby, well on the days that it works at least.  There is no wi-fi in the rooms.  

Also, on two of the days there were no beach towels.  I spend an hour wandering around the resort looking for a couple clean towels to use. Of course no employee of the resort was willing to help me with this.

I do not recommend this place to anyone. Again, we were part of a large group and everyone we talked to had the same experience we did.

reviews.author: Amaia C
reviews.title: Sólo una persona de todo el staff nos prestó atención
reviews.text:
Sábado 8 de septiembre. Llegamos a The Reserve Punta Cana donde habíamos reservado y ¡CERRADO!. 
El hotel nos ofrece un Servicio Real en el Paradisus Punta Cana que queda lejos de nuestras expectativas y lo contratado. Pasados tres días después de varias quejas a distintos empleados del hotel dimos con un señor llamado Silvio Lantigua que solucionó eficiententemente el problema apenas 30 minutos después. 
The Reserve es un concepto totalmente diferente al hotel normal, es incluso mucho mejor que un Royal Service en un Paradisus. Lo digo porque hemos estado alojados en los dos regímenes y la diferencia es de tener en cuenta. 
Gracias a la ayuda de este señor, que gestionó rápidamente nuestra reubicación en The Reserve Palma Real tuvimos unas de las mejores vacaciones de nuestras vidas. 
Agradecidos por su interés quisimos darle una propina que rechazó diciendo que si la aceptaba se perdía la esencia de su trabajo. Muchos profesionales deberían aprender de él. 
Desde aquí mi más sincero agradecimiento.

reviews.author: Paulo F
reviews.title: Decepção Total
reviews.text:
Algo estranho acontece no hotel: a maioria dos funcionários faz questão de ser desagradável, com bem vindas exceções, padrão que não se aplica a nenhum dos outros 3 hotéis que nos hospedamos em Punta Cana, durante o mês de abril / 2013.
        Além disso, é muito desagradável a segregação imposta pelo tal do club Meliá e Royal Service. A maioria dos lugares na praia, os melhores restaurantes e até algumas piscinas são exclusivas aos hóspedes dos dois programas. Para quem não entendeu, nós, hópedes comuns, temos que nos digladiar para conseguir um lugar na sombra, já que se você aparecer na praia ou piscina às 7 da manhã em busca de uma cadeira, perceberá um fato curioso: 90% das cadeiras estão reservadas pela quantidade ilimitada de toalhas distribuídas aos hóspedes. Fontes me confirmaram que alguns funcionários da área da piscina, em troca de algo como 10 dólares,  fazem o trabalho de reservar cadeiras e principalmente as famosas cabanas familiares. Em 7 noites lá não consegui aproveitar nenhuma....
        Desde o momento do check in, um “concierge” cuida de suas reservas nos restaurantes. Na verdade, tudo é desculpa pra lhe empurrarem uma reunião na empresa Club Melia. Pra ajudar o simpático moço, você se compromete a ceder pelo menos 90 minutos de seu tempo (US$ 56,25, se considerarmos que paguei  US$ 400,00 por noite). Achei a proposta ABSURDA, mas que cada um forme sua própria opinião. Detalhe: para entendermos bem o que estavam nos oferecendo, levamos pelo mais de 2 horas – confirmamos mais tarde que a maioria das pessoas não entende bem o que lhes é oferecido, principalmente porque nem todos os vendedores falam bem o português. 
        A comida é boa para o que nós, brasileiros, estamos acostumados nos resorts brasileiros, mas MUITO abaixo do padrão de Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Ulises M
reviews.title: Cuidado al realizar pagos con tarjeta de credito
reviews.text:
Estuve en Paradisus Punta Cana The Reserve el pasado mes de Diciembre, durante mi estancia realice una reserva para una cena romantica frente a la playa para el día viernes, pagando por adelantado con tarjeta dicho servicio, los ineptos la programaron para el jueves, el dia viernes al preguntar porque no me habían mandado la carta de confirmación me dicen que ya perdi la reserva pues era para un día antes, es decir el jueves, revisaron y contactaron al personal involucrado y se concluyo que fue un error del personal, me piden disculpas y me dicen que el cargo no se realizará a mi tarjeta.
Al finalizar mi estancia efectivamente esta restada esa cantidad de mi cuenta total, sin embargo días posteriores me hacen el cargo, TRAMPOSAMENTE ya que estoy fuera del país de regreso en mi lugar de origen. 
Levanto la aclaración ante la institución bancaria y durante la investigación el Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana envía un voucher firmado por la cantidad y un texto donde argumenta que es un cargo por "cena Romantica" el cual es un Servicio queme brindaron. Lo cual es Totalmente FALSO!. 
Despues de 3 meses en los queel Hotel Paradisus Punta Cana insiste en su mentira, envié correo al area de calidad y de esta manera ahora me explican que en realidad fue un cargo que se les paso cobrarme, que no corresponde a la cena sino a varios cargos que por ERROR nuevamente de ellos no me cobraron y que se les hizo facil ingresar el cobro del servicio que no me brindaron.

CUIDADO!! ES GENTE QUE ACTUA DE MALA FE Y JUSTIFICA SU INEPTITUD AFECTANDO A LOS CLIENTES.

ademas de que durante su estancia LOS HOSTIGARAN PARA QUE ADQUIERAN UNA DICHOSA MEMBRESIA. cON LO QUE SEGURAMENTE OBTENDRAN DATOS BANCARIOS Y HARAN MAS COBROS INDEBIDOS.

reviews.author: Reuben-advisor
reviews.title: Terrible servicio de transporte de los carritos, quita las ganas de estar acá.
reviews.text:
Estoy actualmente en el Reserve, el hotel en general es bueno, tiene detalles modernos y el servicio es acogedor.

La comida al igual que comentarios anteriores, tiene una rotación casi nula, todos los días lo mismo.

Ambiente, playa, piscinas y personal son todos de buen nivel. No quiero que mi comentario reste lo positivo de estos puntos.

Mi comentario central es acerca de los carritos de transporte (hay solo 3 para 600-700 habitaciones). Me estoy quedando en la primera villa y la playa es bstante lejos, por lo que nos movemos en estos trencitos. Es inaceptable la demora que tienen, casi 40 minutos en promedio ysiendo que es una zona "exclusiva". Lamentablemente se piede unas 2 horas al día en "espera de carritos".

Hemos alegado al desk de reserve y el general, hace dos días nos responden que no es la primera queja y que vendrán más.. estamos 72hrs. Después y la misma cantidad de carros con la misma demora.

Realmente es decepcionante tener que perder tiempo de las lindas atracciones del hotel por esto,  se pierde tiempo y llega el stress. Adicionalmente comp pasa tanto tiempo, se juntan 30-40 personas en los stops, cuando llega el primer carro hay peleas y es un desagrado.

Como si eso fuera todo, hay carritos pequeños de otras funciones en el hotel dando vueltas, cuando le pedí a uno de esos (25min esperando carro) si me puede acercar me responde que "no está autorizado y debo seguir esperando al carro de pasajeros",  la politica de hospitalidad llegó hasta ahí nada más.

Me queda  tres días de mis vacaciones y he optado por caminar 10-15 minutos a la playa todas las mañanas para no seguir perdiendo el tiempo y empezar el día reclamando.

reviews.author: patyr508
reviews.title: Mi familia fu humillada y maltratada en este hotel!!!!
reviews.text:
Quiero expresar por este medio nuestra insatisfacción e indignación debido a la humillación y el mal trato recibido por parte de ustedes el día 28 de Marzo durante el proceso de registro en este Hotel.
Nos presentamos un grupo de 21 personas, incluyendo 4 Bebes, los cuales nos trasladamos desde Santo Domingo, y  4 de ellos vinieron de Texas, para pasar el fin de Semana Santa en familia. 
Lamentablemente no pudimos hacerlo debido a que la reservación nos fue cancelada el mismo día 28 en la mañana, no obstante habernos confirmado la noche anterior la reservación que habíamos hecho incluyendo reservaciones en los restaurantes Asian Fusion, Steak & Grill y Ventos.
En adición a lo expresado, fuimos maltratados por la Señora Belen Santamarina, no solo de palabras si no que también amenazo con sacarnos a la fuerza del Hotel llamando a los agentes de seguridad.
En fin, perdimos el fin de semana y todo el dinero que habíamos invertido en los arreglos, viajes, traslados, etc.
Entendemos que ustedes representan una empresa de gran prestigio, por tanto tienen la obligacion de asumir su responsabilidad ante los hechos ocurridos e indemnizarnos por los gastos y maltratos recibidos.

reviews.author: JRTX77
reviews.title: NOT A HOTEL FOR A BIG FAMILY!!! THEY OVERBOOK!!!
reviews.text:
CONFIRM!! CONFIRM!!! CONFIRM!!!  Your reservation. 
I traveled from Texas with my wife and daughter to meet with my parents and relatives in Punta Cana to expend Easter from Thursday to Sunday with them. In total we were like 20. We confirm our reservation and also we made reservations in a couple of the restaurants of the hotel the night before arrival. (Restaurants Asian fusion, Steak & Grill). When we arrived Thursday morning they said our reservation was cancelled. Nobody knew how? Or Why?  The reservation was cancelled. We had the confirmation number with us but that didn’t help at all.  They offered us to look in another hotel because they didn’t have any rooms available at that moment. (They found a hotel that didn’t accept kids. WHAT?????  They knew we were traveling with 4 babies). Anyway we never got a concrete answer of what happened neither an alternative solution to the situation.  After 2 hours there, a lady named Belen Santamarina, called the security of the hotel kicking us out of the hotel. I don’t know if this hotel tends to overbook rooms on a busy season and latter on randomly cancel your reservation without letting you know in advance. 
My advised is to be paranoid about your reservation confirmation!!
Avoid going on a big group. 
Avoid going on a busy season.

reviews.author: laurel l
reviews.title: Stolen items
reviews.text:
During my stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Resort, belongings from my room were stolen- my cell phone that was charging on the desk, my ipod touch, and all of my cash thatw as in my wallet. when I brought this to the attention of the management they claimed that it was my fault since items were not in the lock box.

They also told me that they found no violation in my room and that nobody had entered it during the time things were stolen. I.e. they were basically telling me I was lying. I would stay far away from this place if you want to keep your belongings.

reviews.author: Fixu
reviews.title: Mieser Service, durchschnittliches Essen...
reviews.text:
Trotz einiger Lichtblicke, wie z.B. Jose Salvador unser Butler als auch die schoene Lage, ist das Paradisus Palma Real niemals sein Geld wert. Der Service ist miserabel, da viele Versprechen nicht eingehalten werden koennen. Das betrifft viele Kleinigkeiten wie Reservierungen in Restaurants die nicht klappen, Teller, die einem fast voll unter der Nase weggezogen werden, unertraeglicher Laerm durch Veranstaltungen von grossen Firmen, die anscheinend Prioritaet haben und und und...

Sehr schade fuer dieses eigentlich sehr schoene Hotel!

reviews.author: xyzzy_ma
reviews.title: Not impressed. Poor service. Overpriced.
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days at this resort, and unfortunately, this place failed to impress, by any stretch of the imagination.  There were so many negatives, it was hard to know where I should begin with this review.  Rather than detail all our issues, I'll simply highlight the ones likely to be most useful to fellow travelers.

Service was poor, poor, poor.  This was the overwhelming problem of our stay at this resort.  Other members in our group confirmed this.  The staff at this resort seemed amateurish and inexperienced.  On more than one occasion, I asked members of my party if they felt like we had arrived on a week when the resort was training a large number of new staff.  That, or the resort was understaffed for the number of guests.

I was reduced to self-service on more than one occasion.  During lunch, after waiting 10 to 15 minutes for someone to get me a soft drink, I just went to the beverage bar, and got one myself.

Communication.  If you do not speak Spanish, you may find language to be a barrier to communication.  This was true for much of the staff we encountered.  When I asked our restaurant waiter about an appetizer on the menu, he indicated the dish was his favorite.  When I asked him to elaborate more on the dish and its ingredients, he couldn't tell me anything more about it.

We had similar communication issues, when ordering drinks at the resort's various bars.  There must be a shortage of bar-tending schools in the Dominican Republic, because the bartenders were awful.  Many of my drink requests were met with blank stares.  They had no idea how to mix well-known cocktails.  I ultimately had to explain to bartenders how to mix a number of  very common, well-known drinks.  Seriously, I was dumbfounded when I couldn't get a Kir Royal apértif drink before our meal.

The Room.  Ours had a strong musty smell to it.  When we complained and requested another room, we were told there were no other rooms available.  We had arrived as part of a group, so the front desk advised us that we should find another person in our group willing to swap rooms with us.  Seriously?  Can you imagine that?  Asking another member of our group, "Would you mind swapping your room for our musty-smelling room?"  Keep this in mind, when you read the hotel management's response to negative reviews, indicating they "have a commitment to provide quality service beyond our guests’ expectations."  That's the kind of quality service you can expect at this resort.

About the bathroom ... I hope you enjoy taking cold showers.  Our room provided enough warm (not hot) water for only 1 person.  The second person's shower was always cold.

Food was typical of all-inclusive resorts I have attended.  Acceptably good (but not great), and certainly not of a quality that you will write home about.
