When you arrive to one of the evening restaurants on the resort, you will be asked about your reservation.  When we indicated that we did not have a reservation, because we had just arrived from the airport an hour earlier, we were made to feel that the restaurant staff were doing us a favor by seating us.  Really?  Only a third of the tables were occupied, and it was 9 pm, well after the dinner rush.  The hostess was acting as though we were trying to walk up to a hot new restaurant in Beverly Hills, expecting to be seated without being a famous celebrity.  This is an all-inclusive resort, is it not?

Heed mine and other negative reviews about this resort.  These comments are not the exception.  In our experience, they were the norm.  Bottom line: You will most likely regret coming here, as it will feel like a waste of your time and money.

The only nice thing I can say about this hotel resort is that the grounds were beautiful.  The beach is very nice and just a short walk off the property.  If that alone is worth your time and money, then go for it.  If not, then I must suggest that you pass.

reviews.author: Marshall S
reviews.title: MUST READ review! INHUMANE TREATMENT @ Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that we travel between 45-60 days per year for pleasure.  We have stayed at motels, hotels, world class resorts, you name it, we have been there.... that should set a basis for understanding our assessment of our travel experience in Punta Cana this past weekend.  Also, please note that we have written DOZENS of reviews on hotels and have NEVER EVER left a negative review.  THIS IS OUR FIRST NEGATIVE REVIEW EVER!

So, to start...The reason for this trip was to let my wife enjoy a relaxing weekend away given that our baby is due in less than 8 weeks.  When we booked our vacation to Punta Cana we made it clear that we wanted a "no hassle, stress free, convenient get away."  To our dismay, we received  the opposite of that.

It started when we arrived at the resort on Friday afternoon at approximately 4 pm EST.  We checked in via the upgraded VIP system for "royal service" (which is the hotels equivalent of a caste system by which they classify guests based on their status of "general guest, vip, royal service..."  With royal service, we were assured the best room location, a full time butler, premium dining upgrades, and access to all hotel accommodations.  FYI, we feel very bad for any guests not taking the upgrade, as most of the desirable locations on the beach and cabanas are reserved for royal guests only.

And so, this is where we encountered our first mishap of the trip.  We were kindly guided to our room by a friendly host, he gave us a tour of the hotel grounds and then took us up three flights of steps to our room in the "royal tower".  Immediately, my wife (8 months pregnant) looked at him and asked, where is the elevator?  To our surprise, he said there is no elevator in this building, and he continued upstairs to our suite.  We were a bit shocked that an evidently pregnant woman would be given a third floor (top floor) room, especially that we specifically requested a convenient room to accommodate her pregnancy.  When we inquired about switching rooms we were told that they had a large group in town and there was nothing else available....and so, we dealt with it.

So, now our trip started off a bit disappointing, but it got even better.  The first night we went to shower in our room and the hot water didnt work.  We turned the knob all the way to 45 celcius, and after 20 min of running the water it became luke warm at most.  When we called our butler to let him know, he was "off that night".  We then called "0" on our room phone and were put on hold, transferred 3x, and disconnected.  We waited until the morning to confront the butler once again, when we told him that the water wasnt working properly, he said he would have someone look into it.  Needless to say, the same exact scenario happened that evening as well....no hot water, nobody to help.  We decided to take a deep breath, relax on our patio and order a cup of cappuccino while watching the ocean waves.  Comical it was, but when we called room service for a cup of cappuccino, they said "we don't do cappuccino, we deliver coffee only, if you want cappuccino please go downstairs and get it on your own".  NOTE, we paid an upgraded fee for ROYAL SERVICE.....being told to get our own cappuccino was not part of the protocol so we thought.   So, we then called the butler that we paid for with our upgraded package.....he reiterated the same thing....room service doesnt do cappccino delivery, but he would call someone to see if they can accommodate us as a special favor, we never received a call back so we called the head butler...4 phone calls, 3 transfers and 1 hour later our cappuccino arrived, cold

It was now 7:20 on saturday night, Jan 13, 2013.  We had made reservations in advance for the well known "Vento" gastronomic restaurant at the hotel where we would be meeting two of our friends who were also vacationing in Punta Cana.  We booked the reservation for FOUR people two nights prior, and we confirmed it in the morning just be ensure that we wouldn't have any issues.  We also CONFIRMED that our guests from outside the hotel could join us and pay separately given that they were not on our all inclusive meal plan, it was verified as well.  When we arrived in the hotel lobby to meet our friends for dinner, we were confronted by a concierge who notified us that he couldn't let our friends onto the hotel grounds unless they paid $250 for a "night pass".  I then explained that our friends were not at the hotel to use any of the accommodations or drink; but solely to go to dinner at our expense as we had  planned.   He then asked for our dinner reservation confirmation, so we showed him.  He logged into an internal hotel computer system and then got nasty with my wife and I, telling us that we were LYING to him about having a reservation for four people.....and that he only saw a spot for two people on his screen.  

Outraged, we asked him to call our butler and confirm that we had a table for FOUR, not TWO.   He then disappeared for 20 minutes, came back, and once again insisted that we must have misunderstood, but we only had a table for two!!  He offered for us to go to a different restaurant, as Vento had no more available tables..... My wife and I are not stupid, we had booked, CONFIRMED TWICE, and now a random concierge is going to contradict and argue with us? Besides being horrible customer service, it was outright insulting to our intelligence.  The concierge was named "Vladamin Rodriguez" insisted that we pay him $125 per guest ($250usd) total in order to let them past the hotel entrance and have the "right"  to eat dinner at  our hotel.  We then explained AGAIN that they were there for dinner, and we were going to pay for their dinner a la carte.  This was what were told by our butler prior to booking our dinner reservation, and so, this is what we expected.  Vladamin didn't want to listen, and in his broken english he stated that "our hotel policy is you can only go to Passion or Gabi Beach, not Vento".....rather than go on and on...let me summarize it this way....Vladamin was RUDE, DEMANDING and THREATENING.  When we asked him to call the hotel manager he walked away for 50 minutes and mumbled a few sly remarks in spanish...little did he know, we are fluent in spanish as well (:  We then called our credit card American Express and reported our situation to them.  When the AMEX rep asked to speak with someone at the front desk of the hotel, NOBODY that spoke english was available.  Finally nearly TWO hours later after demanding to speak with a supervisor, the hotel food and beverage manager arrived and apologized for what had occurred.  He personally escorted us to the restaurant where we had reservations, sat us down and we had a nice, but VERY late dinner. *we were seated at 9:18 pm for a 7:30 reservation!! Come the end of our meal, we received a bill for our guests (as expected in a normal situation) but a bit classless after wasting 2 hours of our time with an internal hotel error which was NOT our fault.   My pregnant wife was in tears, her get away vacation was ruined, and she couldn't even eat dinner from all of the anxiety caused by this evening.  I must say that on a POSITIVE note, the waiter that we had at Vento was AMAZING, friendly, cordial and did everything he could possibly do to make our evening enjoyable.  We showed him our appreciation at the end and gave him a handsome gratuity as well.

To calm my wife down, we ended up staying with our friends at a different nearby hotel for the night, as she didn't feel comfortable nor did she have the energy to make it up 3 flights of stairs after not eating dinner and being 8 mo pregnant.  (not to mention the inability to take a warm shower for 3 days) She was completely distraught, humiliated by the insulting hotel concierge, and had no energy to continue arguing for what we knew was right.   We slept on it for the night and figured we would handle our problems with our hotel in the morning.

By monday morning we were ready to go home.  We packed our bags, went down to the pool for a few minutes, and were confronted by our butler and his assistant who came to somewhat apologize for what had occurred the night before.  We could see that he was nervous (possibly afraid of being reprimanded by his boss), but his partner then said to us "At least the restaurant let you eat for only $50, that was a good deal"........Are you kidding me?  Don't try to justify poor customer service by telling a client what a great deal they got on a dinner that they couldn't even eat.

This was by far the worst vacation experience we have ever had.   We have traveled the world.  This was our 4th time to Dominican.  At this point we have no option but to dispute many of the charges for our hotel "stay and accommodations" with amex, as the hotel was not helpful at assisting us in any way whatsoever.  They failed to uphold even the most basic of commitments to us as clients.  When we went to check out at the royal service guest center, we were told that the royal service manager would meet us at 1:30 pm sharp to discuss our situation from the night before.  We showed up at 1:20 pm just to ensure that we would have time to go over our experience in detail, and it turned out that she was out of the office, and her assistant Maria was at lunch.   We were then asked to wait for her....and so we did, until 1:40 pm.  By this time, we had to catch our flight home.  Our credit card balance was printed out, handed to us, and we were told that since a manager wasn't there to adjust our balance, we would have to do it from the USA.  We asked for them to put a note on our hotel ledger stating our disapproval of the charges; and so, we notated this on our final printout to later supply to AMEX as well as the necessary legal entities in DR if need be.

We are warning you now, beware of the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana!!!

This is by far the WORST experience we have EVER had at a hotel or resort. Feel free to email or call with any questions. Dont say we didnt warn you!!!  We repeat, we have been to over 40 hotels in 2012, 14 countries, 200 restaurants....NEVER once have we left a negative review, until NOW!

reviews.author: Rwbdadof3
reviews.title: Front desk attempted to overcharge on 3 different occasions
reviews.text:
If you MUST stay at the Paradisus be very careful not to give the front desk your credit card without putting a limit on what they can charge.  Upon check in a very pressured sales pitch was pushed 3 times to upgrade our party of 6 to access to the kids zone, for over $1200 dollars more.  We had 2 children traveling with us, who were not interested.

2 days before leaving the bracelet fell off of one of our twins in the middle of the night.  We later located it under the mattress.  When we asked for a replacement, we were told it would cost $250 more.  The couple in front of us in line were told it was $60 to replace.  It 2 strings of nylon and a small disk.  Outrageous!

Upon check out we were given a bill for over $1,600 for our "pleasures".  We asked for clarification and were given a paper in Spanish for items we all knew were bogus.  We were then asked what we wanted to pay.  After a very unpleasant exchange the bill was settled but they FORGOT to give us a "purple ticket" from the front desk.  When we finally arrived to enter the taxi they refused to allow us to leave the resort without going back to the desk for the "purple ticket" with the number of people ALLOWED to leave.

We never had any luck getting a manager to discuss these business practices.

Aside from the front desk, the staff of the Paradisus was lovely and very helpful.  The food was not good, except the paid restaurant, Passion.  

I would cancel any reservation possible and try another resort.  We travel for 30 days a year and have never encountered such business practices.

reviews.author: Jonathan K
reviews.title: 5 star price for 1 star service
reviews.text:
Came here with a group of 22 people for a one week stay. Stayed at the "reserve".  Place is awful. Looks nice to the naked eye, but quality of staff and amenities are on a scale to a motel 6. Food is uneatable. No hot water and I mean none. Staff just walks in your room with no notice to bring you nothing. We had a New Year's Eve dinner last night that all 22 of us walked out on. Not one plate of food was even Luke warm, it was cold to the touch. Even after complaining about the food to the "manager" at the time. Food still kept coming out cold! Staff seems clueless all around how to handle basic hospitality services. When the price is as high as it is, staying at the "reserve" , especially with a group of 20+, You would think they would attempt to cater to your needs. 

This is my first time in the Dominican and I can promise when I come back i won't be staying here. 
If it wasn't for the nice beach, I'd imagine we would have left a long time ago.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Do not go to Paridisus
reviews.text: On the 3rd day of a 7 day trip to Paridisus PalmaReal Punta Cana and we can't wait to get home...terrible food, horrible service... My partner is sick in bed due to food, all inclusive activities booked, no one will answer phone....not worth the 6000.00 we spent to get here. Will go to Atlantis or Hawaii next time......HUGE Rip Off!

reviews.author: Noel R
reviews.title: Total disaster, worst resort experience ever!
reviews.text:
The organization i work for chose this resort to celebrate our christmas party... What a mistake.

To start off, the checkin process lasted for hours and was very disorganized. Food was terrible, bad taste, bad look, i've had better food on lower prices/stars hotels in the zone. 

Service in the restaurants was awful... Waitress did not pay enough attention to us, for three times one of them dropped cups of wines and water in the ground, spilling wine on our clothes, there was pieces of sharp glass everywhere on us, my girlfiend had few cuts on her body (nothing serious) and my white clothes was ruined. After this accident no one came close to us or took responsability for this... We should had sued them...

Do yourself a favor and stay away from this terrible resort!

reviews.author: Patrick_G
reviews.title: The worst food I had in 15 years...
reviews.text:
...and the best dinner I had in the Dominican Republic at the same time...!!!
The positive point is the Passion restaurant (with $40 extra charge) : excellent, even if still not worth a Michelin Star like they try to sell it; I will write a specific review for it.
Nice gardens, nice pool and nice beach. Pretty OK rooms, but we stop here for the good things.
Our first room was a little bit smelly (like many in most of the all-inclusive hotels in Punta Cana), but still OK. We had a problem during the night, hearing big and strong water noises, and waking up in the morning we discovered a lot of water in the bedroom itself. In the evening it came back, but this time we realized that the black waters of other rooms were escaping from our bath tub, shower and toilets (see pictures) !!! We called the reception and they did not seem very surprised, just telling us that they would come asap to transfer us to another room on the second floor. One hour and 6 phone calls later, we were still waiting for the bellman for the transfer, missing our restaurant reservation.... The day of our depature we also waited more than 50 minutes to have our luggage picked up. It is a deep feeling that the whole hotel management is very bad and unprofessional, and the service is very poor.
But the worst remains the main buffet restaurant : the (very small) buffet room is really ugly, the choice is so limited that it looks like a real joke and I don't speak about the food. It is just totally UNACCEPTABLE to serve such food in a so-called "5*" hotel !!! My university restaurant was 100 times better !!!
Paradisus Palma real used to have a good reputation, but some years ago. It is now one of the worst managed hotel in the area, and the food is really not acceptable.
Just AVOID !
Two months ago, we tried the Riu Palace Bavaro, which for a lower price gave us 10 times more !

reviews.author: Teddorjan
reviews.title: Don't go. Worst hotel resort i ever stayed. After 30 years travelling.
reviews.text: Rude, untrained staff. Horrible food buffet. Bad organized organization.  Unprofessional check in. Room smells bad. Wrong room. And that all for the price of over 300 dollar a night!!! If i compare this with hotels and resorts in the rest of the world. This is realy the worst for  this price i stayed until now.

reviews.author: Ariel V
reviews.title: Worst trip of my life
reviews.text: We purchased an upgraded wrist band. We were not given the benefits of the wristband until 6 days into our trip. We were supposed to get an upgraded room. We did not get that upgraded room and stayed in a musky tiny room for the first 6 days of our trip. The manager (a woman) is horrible. The rest of the staff are friendly. The food in the main buffet is disgusting. (I am not a picky eater, nor do I frequent high class restaurants). You have to have to VIP wrist band to get into Gabi Beach to eat edible food. The pool is falling a part. The frogs that spit out water fall off of the side of the pool everyday. There are cracks in the pool structures. This hotel is all about levels of service. Do not go to this hotel unless you are going to upgrade to the highest wristband. That is the only way you will get service, edible pool, and a nice room. There is a ton of walking at this hotel. I would have stayed at a different hotel if I had the chance. Also, there is sea weed all over the beach and in the water. Kind of ruins the perfect picture image we all expect.

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: After 6 visits, this resort continually goes downhill
reviews.text:
Save yourself money, exasperation and disappointment by avoiding this resort. When we first came here six years ago, it was a delight. The turnover of staff and their substandard training and focus will leave you wondering why you chose this resort for your vacation. 

Any all,inclusive hotel that charges luxury hotel rates should be prepared to deliver quality service which this resort does not. As an English speaking customer, I am offended when the waiter keeps interrupting me while I´m trying to order (yes, yes, yes.....) and the brings me exactly what I did not want, or trying to relax by the pool or ocean while someone is constantly trying to sell you something.

The food is substandard, the service extremely poor and the atmosphere one of high pressure sales tactics. I will never return.

reviews.author: ahara39604
reviews.title: WORST BEACH EVER-FULL OF SEAWEED
reviews.text:
I don't know where to start, but lets just say I can't believe all the positive reviews for such a bad stay:
1. First and foremost, the beach was horrible, murky and full of seaweed....you cant see your feet when standing in 2 feet of water.  We were being sold an excursion and the guy even told us he will take us to a nice beach, and that this is a "dirty beach".....just see my photo.  MIAMI has nicer beaches.  

2. Service was equally worse....I'm not so picky but this was a disgrace. We ate at the buffet for 17 meal...we have 2 small kids....most of the time, we didn't have a waiter for the first 15 minutes.... if you order a drink like a juice of milk, there was a 50% chance you would get it.  There was not tip so no once cares.

3.  The room was nice, except for blood and hair spotted by my wife on multiple occasions on the sheets (I always laugh at her when she inspects, but my jaw dropped when I saw the blood stain).  The shower the first day didn't drain, and the water was up to our ankles...that was gross.  The TV is an original plasma TV from 2004 and changing the channels was so painfully slow.  The volume didn't work the first night and they had to fix it.  2 lights were out as well.  The towels were usually not well folded and I wondered how clean they were as a result.

4.  I agree, the staff was so incompetent when you called and asked for anything....

5.  We were in a taxi at the gate 1/2 mile away when we had left, and security brought us back, because we didn't give them a purple check-out card.....I didn't even know we were supposed to have one....so we drove all the way back.....it was absurd....

SAD TO SAY THAT BY DAY 2, I WAS READY TO GO HOME.  I HAVE NEVER SAID THAT ABOUT A CARIBBEAN ISLAND BEFORE, BUT THEN AGAIN, THERE WAS NO BEACH.  WHAT A WASTE OF MONEY IN SO MANY WAYS.

IF YOU HAVE TO PICK THIS ISLAND, PICK A RESORT ON A DIFFERENT BEACH.

reviews.author: Cyndi V
reviews.title: BEYOND DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text:
I was so excited about coming to Punta Cana for our friends wedding and to enjoy our time in through photos online what seemed to be a luxurious hotel. 
GROUNDS: Upon arriving the hotel looked very clean, hotel design and decor beautiful. However, there was no AC in the lobby or throughout the entire hotel with the exception of restaurants and our room. The humidity level is @ 100% which means your clothing is soaked by the time you arrive to the elevator or stairs.. 
ROOM: Our room is beautiful! Clean, decor is amazing very tropical and luxurious.. 
SERVICE: This was the most disappointing of all you're never asked if you need assistance, however you have to ask and BE PATIENT cause your going to have to wait a LONG time before you receive what you requested. 
ROOM SERVICE: 24 hr room service (what a joke) called @ 7 am for a 1/2 hr no one answered the phone. Called front desk they promised they'd communicate with room service on my behalf and get back to me. 9 am after no return call we were at the market grill eating from there poor selection. Following day tried room service again no answer spoke to the front desk which took my order and I was so excited as I'd finally get to have a nice breakfast on the balcony.. (Wrong again) 1 hr later no bkfast called complained 1 hr received COLD bkfast. (SMH) 
ALL INCLUSIVE: Beware you are easily identified and the staff will not attend to you as they assume you won't be tipping.  
POOL: There's no service, no help by the pool.  You'll die of thirst.. And by 1:30 there are no TOWELS.. 
I've never been to a hotel were I was made to feel as if I had to make the staff happy.  The staff will literally stare at you before greeting you or heaven forbid ask if they can help you. Needless to say I will NEVER return. Furthermore I have cut our trip short. We're out! I'd rather spend more money to leave than stay here!!! From this experience I will never return to the Dominican republic there are many other places to visit. 
This hotel should be named SERVE YOURSELF RESORT...
 I recommend the Fountain blue in Miami, Atlantis paradise island, Sheraton in Cancun, Marriott Orlando, Continental hotel Puerto Rico. 
Before I leave you LOCK your doors when you're doors as many barge right in 3xs to be exact! For those who have written great reviews all I can say is I don't know where they were staying on these grounds. 
Someone call Hotel impossible this place needs help... and that's an understatement!!!

reviews.author: e b
reviews.title: not worth it for the money
reviews.text:
If you have never visited all-inclusive resorts, you might enjoy it but if you have PLEASE stay away from this one. 
It's half inclusive, there are areas you can not use based on your packages, including bars, lounges or swimming areas, we had standard package and we were told we can go anywhere, ( not really).
Gabi beach bar belongs to different resort and we were told you have to pay to go there.
Check in: was very late even though we got in 2h earlier, (they kept saying 30 more minutes)
Baggage: we left it with bell boy when we got there, when we went to check in they gave us little tickets to brig back to bell boy, and then the luggage did not even get to the room until 3h later until I started calling and looking for it. (I never had to go back and forth with no tickets and look for my luggage)
Cleaning ladies: they were awesome! They are the only people who did a great job!
Over all service: in restaurants and bars servants are great! But in common areas they don't really care much, in buffet we tipped few waiters so instead of same waiter taking care of us he send us totally different person ( himself never to be seen) we did it few times same result.
Booking a restaurant: we were told you have to book every day in the morning ( for that day), not the case! For 2 days we ended up going to whatever was available because apparently you had to book it 2 days in advance in order to get in in some places (I guess it was a busy weekend)

Constant lack of beach towels, if you want beer other then "Presidente" you are in trouble (we were able to get 2 corona bottles and one Heineken, we tried all bars), if you want a drink in a fruit (from my experience common thing in resorts) you will not get it here, they told us "no pineapples" next day " no pineapples no coconuts" once I asked how come you never have them, bartender told me there is a man walking with green t-shirt in resort and he has pineapples, bring it to me and I will make a drink for you ! So you have to find some dude with coconuts or pineapples in order to get a drink in fruit. around the swimming pool cleanliness is not the greatest. They also ran out of chips at the bar. 

Resort promotes vouchers that you get with some online deals that they advertise, don't fall for it, you basically have to pay for anything and everything you do with them, for example if you use your $100 voucher for casino you have to add $100 of your own cash, or if you want to get a spa treatment you still end up paying $$$. Basically it's a way to pull more money from you, that is understandable but why convincing and trying to trick people in getting vouchers and saying you don't have to pay anything just use them!

So over all we felt tricked and I am sorry if I am offending anyone with my comments. This is the first time I am doing this but I felt the need to say this. It's a nice place but it is lacking sooooo much to deserve those 5 stars

reviews.author: 21Mona
reviews.title: WORST
reviews.text: The worst experience we had at this resort treat you according to the color of your bracelet,we went to visit some friend at Paradisus Reserve and one of the manager in front of another guess and our friend told us we need to go because we don't have the bracelet with the color wich allow us to be in that area we had to pay,we never get inform about this descrimination,next day we went to do some shopping in the mall that was in the resort and we asked the driver how we can get back he said you just ask the security to call to the front desk and someone will come over, we did and after 40 minutes on the sun it finally arrived we had said no because we did not have the bracelet that gave us that opcion.He told the security we need to call a CAB and paid for.Was our first time in Punta Cana and supposedly the best resort on the island but the worst resort I've been in my life never turn back or I'll stay in any of the resort or will refer this company to anyone who knows.

reviews.author: allisonminus
reviews.title: CHOOSE ANOTHER PLACE TO STAY!
reviews.text: The resort lost our reservation, had to wait two hours to get our rooms!  Booked two of them.  The second night we were there, one of the rooms backed up with feces and urine on the floor of the bathroom and in the tub in shower, tried to explain this to the front desk and "maintenance" crew.  They came to the room with a plunger after about 2 hours and cleaned the bathroom after another hour.  This happened two other times during out 10 day stay.  Finally after the third occurrence, and explaining this to "DOMINGO" a so called manager, the sent a maintenance man and they figured that the pipes were broken outside the room.  This should have been done in the first place, not the toilet plunged.  My daughters were wading in feces on three different days!!  The hotel kept sending  DOMINGO to talk to us, which was wasting out time on our vacation. DOMINGO said he would comp two nights for us. The night before we left DOMINGO gave me some sort of receipt for this.  It looked real and we left the hotel.  When I got home I checked my credit card account and only saw the charges for the hotel and not the credit for the two nights.  I can only assume that DOMINGO was lying to us to get us off his back.  That is no way to treat a customer that has rented two rooms at your resort for 10 nights.  The only correspondence from I would like is the credit I am to receive of the two nights.  Thank you, Allison LeoMinus, Rooms 1021 and 1022 dates of stay July 8 through July 18, 2012

reviews.author: mleibs
reviews.title: review while here now
reviews.text: I am actually staying at the resort now.  I have to say that when you call to ask for service no body picks up the phone.  Room service does not deliver. No call with an explanation, just nothing. Maid service?  What's that?  Call to ask for serivce?  No one picks up the phone.  Report issue to lobby?  Get a big blow off.  I've been to over 20 all inclusive resorts in the past couple of decades.  Never seen anything like it.  My first trip to the Dominican Repulic.  Can't wait to go back to Mexico.

reviews.author: Monica W
reviews.title: Leaky roof, stolen earrings, 10 days of diarrhea
reviews.text: First of all, I want to clarify my rating- I gave this hotel a "terrible" rating because when a hotel is labeled as a "5 Star Hotel", I have certain expectations. I'll start with the positives- the property is beautiful, the architecture is amazing, the beaches are perfect, the hotel is very clean and the staff is very friendly. However, this hotel fell short in all other areas- ESPECIALLY SERVICE. Upon arrival we checked our bags to be delivered once we checked in. Once I turned in my ticket to the gentlemen who checked the bags, they stated it should be between 10 and 15 minutes before they were delivered. It took over an hour for the bags to be delivered and I had to wait because my swimsuits, coverups and everything I needed for the beach was in the bag. I understand that is a huge property, so I tried to not let that spoil my first impression. As I looked around the hotel room, the room was immaculate. Honestly, I don't think I have ever stayed at a hotel that clean, and I have stayed at many top rated hotels. After I spent the day at the beach, I came back to a hotel room that had huge puddles and a leaky roof. A pipe had broken in the room and I called the front desk to address the problem. It took 30 minutes for someone to show up. The gentleman's name was Antonio and he conveyed the severity of the problem to the front desk over the phone. (He spoke in Spanish not realizing I am a fluent speaker and he made it clear I was not overreacting) Once he got off the phone,  Antonio said that someone would call me when the issue was resolved. I asked how they intended to call me, seeing as how my cell phone was not turned on. He told me he couldn't answer that, but not to worry- the room would be fixed. When I asked who would be fixing the pipes, he responded that he didn't know. I asked if he could find out a timeline as to when I could expect the problem to be fixed and who I should follow up with should the problem not be fixed. Antonio said he couldn't answer those question, but if I was Royal Service, THEN he could help me. Two hours later and nearly an inch of water on the floor later, I called the front desk. The man at the front desk said they were working on getting someone to fix it. I then walked across the property and demanded my room to be changed. I had to speak to TWO different people before someone FINALLY decided that I deserved to have a clean, dry room. I did not ask for an upgrade. I did not ask anything other than what I paid for (clean, dry accommodations)and it took 3 hours and 4 different staff members to actually get that. Day Two was a lovely day, except that the food wasn't very good. It wasn't awful, but it was not of good quality. It doesn't seem to be kept at proper temperatures while on the buffet station. You can see the "sweat" on the cold deserts and cheeses. The flavor of the food was similar to cruise buffet food. The exception was the Italian restaurant- where the food was delicious. The Asian bistro had food similar to Panda Express. I had different expectations. The food also seems re-used. I stayed at the resort because a friend of mine got married there. The day following the wedding, the buffet style restaurant was offering the SAME EXACT food that was served at her cocktail hour. This may have been a coincidence, but considering the fact that the wedding had over 100 guests and we all thought the same thing, it was a bit disturbing. The rest of the stay was fine. The beaches were amazing, the staff was friendly, the pools were lovely and the casino was fun. HOWEVER- KEEP A CLOSE WATCH ON YOUR CHIPS. My friends and I all had the dealers make "MISTAKES" and "ACCIDENTALLY" take our chips when we won hands. The day before check out I had my first issue with diarrhea. (Sorry to share, but it really has been an issue.) I never drank the water, I never used the water to brush my teeth, yet 10 days later I am taking antibiotics  because I am STILL suffering symptoms. I am not sure if is caused by the poor storing of re-used food, if it was caused produced being washed in the tap water, or what other things could have caused this- BUT I am still dealing with it. LASTLY, on the day of check out I noticed my faux diamond earrings (with real gold backings) were missing. I thought perhaps my husband had packed them or maybe I had packed them in a different bag. Because they were fake, I did not put them in the safe- even if I  was leaving the room. I know I did not leave them behind because I am a woman of habits and I always placed them the same location( on the dresser) when I took them off.  Also, my husband did a thorough check of the room to make sure we didn't leave anything behind. However, I am VERY hesitant to ever accuse anyone of theft, so I emailed the hotel to see if someone turned them in as a "lost" item or "left behind" item. It has been 6 days and I have not had a response. SO- basically I would never return to this hotel, even if it was free. I had a good time because it was a family and friend filled trip. I was there with over 100 people whom I have known my entire life, so we had a ball. HOWEVER, in addition to the ridiculous price we paid for a "FIVE STAR HOTEL" I am also out the $100 earrings, a $50 co-payment to my doctor's office, $15 for my prescription for my antibiotics and of course the time spent frustrated that getting what you paid for was nearly impossible at this hotel.

reviews.author: Cindy B
reviews.title: Nice Wedding
reviews.text: I was not a happy auntie!!  The service was less than desirable.  Rooms smelled very musty water on coffee table there for 3 days from plant.  Unable to use any restaurants do to time constraints.  Checked in at 5 so had to do buffet even though checkin clerk stated just show up and they will let you in when my sister got there late 9:30 pm. Refused us and dressed very nicely!!  No one could understand English.  Transportation arranged by Romance, they insisted my sister call day before departure.  The hotel charged us after 45 min lost in translation...$17.  She gave them $50 and another 20 min to find change!!  They actually took it out of my debit card too which created an international fee.  They only had beer in refrigerator and did not ever replenish our water the whole time.  Our room was comped as my sister is groom's mother.  So they said they had to charge us $400 last night even though much less online or other guests!!  Food was not the greatest although I only got to eat at a restaurant 1 night out of 4.  It advertises all these restaurants not open for lunch and all reservations.  Did not make you ever feel welcome there.  It is hotter than the 3 trips to Africa, Aruba, Puerto Vallarta etc.  I would never return to this resort.

reviews.author: Alberto
reviews.title: Cobros indebidos
reviews.text: Tuve la oportunidad de quedarme en el hotel durante el mes de Abril de 2012, en relacion al servicio ofrecido no tengo comentarios negativos, sin embargo ha sido muy decepcionante la forma en que el hotel se comporto con respecto a los cargos realizados a mi tarjeta de credito. El dia de nuestra llegada teniamos reservaciones en el area de Royal Service en cuanto nos presentamos en la recepcion nos ofrecieron un upgrade de habitaciones de Garden View a una Ocean View, cosa que aceptamos y nos hicieron cancelar el monto adicional por este upgrade, hasta ahi todo bien, resulta que el upgrade no se hizo finalmente y me indicaron que el reeintegro del dinero se haria directamente ha mi tarjeta de credito en un plazo no superior a 10 dias habiles. Al dia de hoy 45 dias despues del final de nuestra estadia aun no se nada del dinero, en reiteradas oportunidades he escrito mail a un senor Genue Jimenez Reservation Agent USA & Canada quien fue quien me ayudo con mis reservaciones y no he conseguido ningun resultado. Me parece una falta de seriedad de una cadena de hoteles internacionales no cumplir con lo pactado y a todas luces robarme esa cantidad de dinero, en la medida de lo posible me gustaria tener una respuesta pronta de parte de ellos a esta situacion y esperar que a futuro ningun cliente caiga en este engano, si aceptan un upgrade paguenlo un vez que esta realizado y consumido para no tener problemas.

reviews.author: Todd R
reviews.title: Royal Service = Royal Disappointment
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful. The grounds are kept up well, the rooms are clean, updated, and the accommodations are truly wonderful. However, that's where the good things about this resort stop. The food was atrocious and the service was appalling. 

Problems: shower had no hot water, A/C not working, restaurants refused service if men did not wear pants, housekeeping did not do their job if you did not tip $5 for daily cleaning & $5 for turndown. Making dinner reservation was a huge hassle. No one knew what restaurants were open which nights, and your reservation times changed constantly. 

We paid for royal service after reading reviews that you are treated better - what a complete waste of money. The "butler" you get that is supposed to help you by making dinner reservations, setting up excursions, etc etc. However, the butler was nothing but a pain. They speak little to no english. They are not helpful whatsoever. Our butler, antonio, was a nice guy, but could barely communicate with us enough to make a dinner reservation, moretheless set up an excursion for us. Royal service has an extra small pool and bar, but there is no food at the pool/beach and staff does not walk around asking if you need drinks. You are given a cell phone upon arrival to the resort for royal service. Random people call the phone at all hours of the day and start blabbing in spanish at you (when only your butler should be calling you to confirm activities and dinner reservations) & it was extremely difficult to hear the person on the other end. Besides the small pool, the worthless butler and a pasta restaurant, there are no perks to paying extra for royal service. We met other couples and a conference that were also unhappy with the royal service at the resort - it was nice to know that we were not alone in our disappointment and irritation with Paradisus. 

As part of our package, we got resort credits. However, there are very specific limitations on what you can use them for & how many you can use at one time. When using the credits for wine at restaurants, we always had to pay extra because the wine is more expensive than the credits you can use. The waiters scammed us by pocketing what we used to pay for the wine and charged our room for the wine without our authorization. Additionally, make sure you redeem your resort credits as soon as you check-in - they do not tell you that there is a room upgrade credit but it can only be used when you check-in. Whenever you pay cash for anything, MAKE SURE YOU GET A RECEIPT. They do not give receipts at the restaurants for wine purchases or at the spa for services, and this caused the biggest hassle when checking out. 

Overall, whenever there was an issue, such as the pants rule or the wait staff scamming us on the wine, we always had to fight with the royal service staff to fix the problem. Nothing comes easy at this resort. For the price of the resort, the service and the food should be better. For some reason, tips did not even give the staff an incentive to work hard. We will not be returning to Paradisus or Punta Cana again. We should have listened to the bad reviews of this resort and not the good ones!

reviews.author: bsoba2000
reviews.title: No se dejen engañar
reviews.text: Al llegar a Punta Cana, para ir al Hard Rock Hotel, el maletero me llevó directamente a un representante del Paradisus Palma Real. Nos dijo que por ser huéspedes del Hard Rock nos invitarían a un evento VIP, como parte del aniversario del hotel, para ver las instalaciones y probar el servicio. Que todo sería gratis y todo el día. Que no aceptara ir a la reunión de ventas del paquete vacacional de mi hotel, pues debería disfrutar mis vacaciones y que lo que él nos ofrecía era la mejor forma para hacerlo. Al llegar al Paradisus Palma Real, nos percatamos que se trataba, precisamente, de una tomada de pelo y que nos dirigíamos a los famosos 90 minutos de orientación para la venta del plan vacacional. Ya que estábamos allí, aceptamos. Nos invitaron a desayunar -nada del otro mundo. En ese restaurante me quemé la mano, ya que el cocinero que estaba confeccionando los omelettes dejó el plato cerca del fuego. El representante de ventas, ni su gerente hicieron algo para ayudarme. Únicamente las empleadas de mantenimiento me ofrecieron cebolla y salsa de tomate para mi mano. Al culminar la presentación, que nos dicen los precios "altísimos" del paquete vacacional, la gerente, de nombre Laura, nos trató de manera ruda, burda y muy grosera. Le expliqué que estuvimos allí por engaño y que no pretendíamos comprar nada y ella se alteró. La experiencia fue horrorosa.

reviews.author: OzVetea
reviews.title: Be carefull!!!
reviews.text: Be very, very patient about personal belongings. Do not leave money unattended!!! Me and my family had very bad experience about that. I mean IN THE ROOM, NOT OUTSIDE!!

reviews.author: exptrave101
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text:
Beautiful property with awful service. Incompetence rules.   Called housekeeping 3 times still no t
Response.   Food poor unless you pay upgrade of 40 per person for upscale restaurant.  Front desk totally unresponsive.   Thankful the beach is nice because hotel service is awful

reviews.author: Emil H
reviews.title: Hotel Ovesold. Reservation not guarantee
reviews.text:
I had not a pleasant experience in Punta Cana Palma Real yesterday 4/5/12. Hotel was oversold and did not guarantee the reservation. This previously happened 2 years ago in Paradisus Punta Cana. Seem to be a trend on high season. I booked my stay on 3/18 and prepaid full. Got my booking confirmation 120337098. During check in yesterday afternoon, the Hotel was oversold and after 3+ hour of delay and notice that " we are working in your case" finally the Manager show up and we settle in what was suppose to be a good deal: relocate into nearby Hotel and credit to stay in the Hotel a different date. The offered Hotel was for adult only. I had my daughter with me, so we have no option than to drive back and upset ask for a refund and demanded a free night in a nearby place, since it was around 10 pm. Finally settle on this. 
What was supposed to be a relaxed Easter Weekend started with a very disappointing event. To the Administration and Reservation Manager thanks for your dis- service. 
Definitely do not recommend to stay in Punta Cana Paradisus or Palma Real.

reviews.author: WindyCityMitten
reviews.title: If any resort can ruin your carribean vacation -- this is the one!
reviews.text:
Beach fleas - EVERYWHERE.  Food tables, beds, etc.   Came home covered in bites head to toe.. Creepy crawly feeling for sure. 

Rooms were never cleaned. We had to hunt down housekeeping for towels.. And call and request bottles of water.   I've never seen such an absence of housekeeping at a "luxury resort".

Pool bar service means you get out of the pool, walk to the bar, get your drink and go back. Not what I'm used to at other resorts. 

The grounds are pretty, pools are pretty,.. That's all I can really say that's positive.

reviews.author: JmChoi
reviews.title: Horrible Resort Experience
reviews.text:
I don't even know where to start. First of all, I travel a lot and this is my third and my husband's fourth time to the Dominican Republic. This is our first time to Punta Cana though and I will never go back. We stayed at this hotel for our friends' wedding on February 12th and spent more money on 4 nights here than 12 nights in Thailand for my sister's destination wedding last year.

When we first arrived (after a horrible wait at the airport) we had a couple more daylight hours and were excited to just relax before dinner. Instead, we were taxied over to Melia, next door as they had overbooked Paradisus and assured us that with our upgraded royal service there, it would be practically the same. After checking in, we were about to get escorted to our rooms when some of our friends came back to the VIP check in and told us to turn around because the rooms they were just in were disgusting. We asked the Melia ladies to call someone over to talk to us about the room situation and were assured that he/she was immediately on their way. After about a half hour, the lady said, "I just spoke to the booking manager at Palma Real and you MUST stay here for your entire trip" Excuse me? We don't have to do anything and we paid to stay at Paradisus! We immediately picked up our bags and went back to the front desk at Paradisus where it took another hour or so to miraculously find the rooms that they didn't have a while ago but had now. I had to pull up my confirmation email proving that I had paid for a master suite as they were trying to put us into a junior suite. How is it that the hotel doesn't have this information in their system?! Irritation beyond belief.

When we got to the room (3937), the door was WIDE open. The room was fine. It would have been great if we spent at least half of what we did but because it was so expensive, you'd expect it to be amazing. The bathtub doesn't have working jets and the stopper didn't work so we shoved a face towel around it to take a bath. As many other reviewers have said, I have to give it to the housekeeping staff as it was really clean however, on the second day, we came back to the room and the door was open again! This time it was simply ajar but still! Nothing had been taken and I called the concierge right away and they sent a memo to housekeeping and security. It didn't happen again.

The food was terrible. We ate at Gabi beach twice and it was terrible there too. Everyone's taste is different but for us, the food was borderline inedible and they did not offer any Dominican food. I don't know about you but I want to eat and drink local when I travel. Terrible... that is all.

Service. Settle in because this is where it gets really good. Now, we're tippers but by the middle of the second day, we mostly stopped because it got us nowhere. The only place to get a good drink is at the lobby bar and preferably from Esteban. Drinks from the pool bar were weak and often disgusting. I had a bloody mary that tasted a bit like actual blood. Yup, true story. Service at meals was attentive. At one dinner our waiter was there to pull out our chairs and brought new drinks when the last ones were almost done. Service with the concierge was either non-existent or amazingly slow. Our friends that were trying to set up a babysitter during the wedding reception was at the desk for almost an hour although they had already set it up prior to arriving at the hotel. I'll let them review their own experience.

The managers are no better. After the room debacle the groom negotiated an upgrade in bracelet color from white to black for those of us that were affected. To this day, we have no idea what we got with the upgrade as not a single person could tell us. We asked many people and no one could give us a clear answer. One thing we do know is that it allowed us to eat at Gabi Beach without any additional cost. We were supposed to meet before the rehearsal dinner at the front desk to upgrade the bracelets where the groom was told by Frederick that they did not have them and could not do it right then but come back before 10pm and they could chat. This meant we had to pay for the rehearsal dinner at Gabi Beach. Directly after dinner, the groom and my husband went to talk to Frederick for an hour and a half. 

They missed the Michael Jackson tribute concert, which was, on a side note, the highlight of the resort. Kudos to those performers and they should do it every night.

Now, I don't know the details of their conversation with Frederick but I didn't want to be in my husband's path when I saw him at the front desk afterward. I do know that at one point, Frederick said to my husband after asking him who he was, "Oh, you're the one who keeps leaving your door open." Excuse me?! Anyway, back to the bracelets. It got to the point that the bride was crying on the night before her wedding day. My friend and I were livid and tried to set up a meeting with Frederick the next day. We were told he would be back by 7am and left him a note with the concierge that we would be there at 10am. He was offsite all day, we had the front desk call him, we went to the wedding coordinators and spoke with Manesa and she couldn't find him. She assured us that she would call us and set up a time with both the head of the wedding department, Maciele and Frederick to discuss the problems. We never got that call. I think their tactic is to ignore their guests repeatedly until they give up because it worked on us. We were so tired of all the BS, we didn't pursue it after the wedding.

The day after the wedding, the weather was cloudy and rainy and that was when it was obvious that there is absolutely nothing to do at this resort if the weather isn't beautiful. As I'm writing this, there is so much more to say that I'm completely overwhelmed and I'd be surprised if you're still reading. I can't believe this place has any good reviews. If it weren't for our friends and a very happy wedding, this would have been the most expensive disappointment of a trip imaginable.

reviews.author: alex l
reviews.title: The TRUTH about this resort
reviews.text:
I have been going to Dominican republic for over 20 years, and in fact my mother is from there, so everything here will be the truth as much as it is a disappointment.  This resort had reserved the wrong room for us, we needed one with two beds, they had told us they were fully booked but amazingly after 2hrs of complaining we got a new room.  The shows which they have were never held in an auditorium although they did have one.  They just did the show right next to the lobby on the floor (no stage).  The service at every restaurant is beyond slow, and the food is horrible everywhere.  The MOST ANNOYING part is every bottle of liquor is WATERED DOWN, i drink vodka tonic, and do not like them strong.  After figuring out how weak it was i had someone open a bottle and let me drink it straight, it was a little vodka with mostly water, and all of the other liquors are either not what they say on the bottle or just sugar water.  The whole beach is full of seaweed, they never clean it up.
I will say there is one good thing about the resort, the have good tennis and a good pro there to play with.  So if you like all you can drink watered down drinks i guess this could be your place, if you want a better resort go to the Iberostar Grand Bavaro, top shelf liquor and better food.  I cannot stress enough how i would no go here ever again even if it was free.

reviews.author: NYC42000
reviews.title: Please don't waste your hard earned money !!
reviews.text:
We saved and looked forward to what was supposed to be a relaxing family vacation to escape the everyday stress of life ...what we found at the Paradisus was bitterly disappointing to say the least. The staff only notice you if you tip, which after you've paid through the nose for this standard of all inclusive, is totally unacceptable. Food is disgusting and completely not for kids. Our family is not fussy, chicken nuggets and non rubbery pasta will do the trick . Instead we were offered mahi mahi sticks or nothing. 

I have to agree with the service level reported in other reviews...just terrible would describe it...we travel a lot and this was by far the worst service for the money it costs to stay there that was possible......getting towels at the pool is work, getting a drink is work, getting a seat at the beach is work, getting breakfast is work...getting coffee is work...well you get the picture..!

All in all...this is not relaxing and the staff seem to laugh at you that you have paid to go there and they are not going to let you enjoy one minute of it......the only decent food was the market grill lunch time which was a burger....not even a fraction of what it's costing you to stay there..but it was edible and had some taste.....not like anywhere else on the property ! 

We have travelled the world and this is the first review I've ever written as I feel that this place is just a complete rip off. There is NOTHING for kids, don't be fooled.....the staff in the kids club are lovely but the slides won't suit any child past 3 years old and the only channel on the tv is in Spanish, so unless you have a bi-lingual tot, Good Luck !

The reserve was just pathetic. Sterile , boring and stuffy. I also had the experience where the room you had booked was totally overlooked and they gave you a lesser room and then tried to make you pay right of the plane for the upgrade to the room you had actually already paid for. They even took my reservation and ripped it off and gave it back....sorry for them I had duplicates ! So I could prove my room was not what the travel agent had booked for me...and so they conceded to the room we were actually supposed to have...

The ONLY thing positive is that the place is clean, and I mean spotless... I have to be honest, from the room to the surroundings, it really is very very clean....

Language is a problem if you have no Spanish....room service sucks...freezing cold food and barely edible..at this stage you are hungry and will eat anything...

They don't update the mini bar EVER..not even for bottled water and good luck if you need extra towels.....

REALLY DISAPPOINTING !!

reviews.author: Elaine T
reviews.title: Very disappointed in the level of service
reviews.text:
I picked this resort even though it was very expensive because it was the only Punta Cana resort on "tripadvisor" without negative reviews. I thought the expense would be worth it to have a problem-free experience.

Just the opposite happened.  When we checked in a t 3 pm all the desk clerk wanted to do was upgrade us at the tune of $60 a day.  We refused.  Guess what? Our room wasn't ready.  We were told to come back in 15 minutes.  We did.  Only by standing at the desk in front of a clerk for 45 minutes did we finally get  a room.

Everything was fine until day 3 when the keys to our room wouldn't work.  Same thing again on day 4.  I don't want to go through all the in's and out's of our very frustrating and stressful experience.  Suffice it to say,  I know problems do come up. but I do expect staff to be cooperative and make an effort to solve them.  Some people even hung up the phone on my husband.  (He was not being rude.)

While the facility is gorgeous, it's not well maintained other than the grounds.  Our unit, also beautiful had a number of issues...there was no microwave as promised,  the refrigerator barely worked, the safe didn't work, the sofa cushions were shot (if you sat on them for more than a few minutes they hurt your back), the balcony furniture was peeling paint, many of the outlets didn't work and the roof leaked.

The food was very average.  Actually, the food at our local diner is better.  The wine included in the price was really cheap.  I'd say at the $3 a bottle level. 

The shows were topnotch.  You wouldn't find better in NYC.

The free golf promised turned out to cost $40 a person per day.

The real disappointment was the service--very inconsistent--and downright unacceptable when it came to handling problems.  I would never go back, nor would I recommend this resort to any one.  (And please know, this is the first time I've ever taken the time to write a review like this.)  I think the all-inclusive concept is inherently flawed.  Employees have no motivation to serve or solve problems other than individual pride and integrity.

reviews.author: Barbara P
reviews.title: Péssima experiência
reviews.text: Viajei agora no reveillon de 2012 para este hotel, fiquei 7 dias e tive uma surpresa péssima. Me roubaram 8 mil dólares no apto dois dias após minha chegada. Esqueci minha bolsa com meus dólares da minha viagem inteira no quarto qdo voltei para pegar estava sem nada. Reclamei para gerencia e surprevisores e nao obtive nenhuma resposta. Só consegui algum retorno após ter mandando um e-mail para o diretor da rede Melia no Brasil. Ninguem deu a minima importancia para o roubo deste valor. Resumindo acabou com minha viagem, passei um reveillon horrivel, tive que ir na delegacia umas 2 vezes para fazer BO e provar alguma coisal. No final o hotel nao tomou nenhuma atitude com relaçao ao roubo e ficou por isso mesmo. Estou muito decepcionada por um hotel deste nível reagir como se fosse uma coisa normal. Paguei muito caro pelo meu pacote de ano novo pois achei que fosse um hotel bom e seguro, mas infelizmente nao foi o que vi.

reviews.author: brasil b
reviews.title: surpresa negativa
reviews.text:
achamos que seria um otimo hotel pelo que pagamos
mas a rede melia ta pessima pelo menos em punta cana
voce fica preso no hotel  ou entao paga mais de 100 dolares para o taxi do hotel te levar em lugares proximos como o shopping san ruan
piscina nao e aquecida
funcionarios despreparados. os unicos que se salvam sao do aqua bar(gloria,luis ramon)
a comida muito fraca deixa muito a desejar
telefone do quarto nao funciona
a noite desligam a caldeira  chuveiro com agua fria
varios funcionarios com ma vontade
nao pega internet nos quartos nem na piscina
vi varias brigas de hospedes com funcionarios
com certeza nao volto nunca mais

reviews.author: Jennine J
reviews.title: Hotel Makes You Ill and then Denies
reviews.text: This hotel gave me an acute parasitic intestinal infection and fell violently ill. I needed hospital care (at the direction of their resort doctor) in the Domincan Republic. I do understand that you take some risks travellign to other countries but in a "5 star" resort this should not be a concern. The hotel has denied having anything to do with me falling ill and suggested that i had travel anxiety. Beyond falling ill our toilet was broken the entire time and the maid only cleaned our room once over 5 days - despite our requests.

reviews.author: camaro2002
reviews.title: Not for Adults
reviews.text:
Mr Torres  responds only to the good traveller reviews. This place is great if you have small children or you are use to having screaming toddlers crying while having a nice dinner...for that matter every where on the resort ....it is a steady drone of crying babies.
The staff are not trained to ask the parents to try and not disturb the other guests and for the life of me cannot understand how some parents can be so ignorant as to have no regard for the people around them. In one of the restraunts we watched as a woman laid her baby out and changed its diaper at dinner time. In another so called fine dining restraunt  (Vento) children are walking all over the benches where you sit andeat......do not wear white trust me your clothes will be filthy when you leave!
This place is a great disappointment do not waste your money

reviews.author: MKS2010
reviews.title: ADULTS  ONLY ----  NOT REALLY  !!!
reviews.text:
We booked the Royal Service section..   Advertised as "adults only section --- a resort within a resort"  FORGET IT.  The only time you are in "adults only"  is in your building complex (your room).   That is why I rated it only a number ONE.   

The small beach in front of this building is restricted to adults.  It is a nice beach.  The private "adults only" pool is ICE COLD.    EVERYTHING else on the resort is loaded with kids ranging from babies in strollers to young teenagers.   There is one restaaurant, I believe, that caters to adults.  There are kids everywhere, including the theatre, buffet and even some sitting on bar stools around the bar, waiting for reservations.

Mini bar not stocked daily and requests were not filled.

WIFI was non-existent during the entire week.  On the 4th day a technician came but was unable to provide WIFI.

FOOD;  not consistent.  Some good.  Some bad.  Some mediocre.

Most of the personnel are friendly and obliging.

If you plan to take kids on your vacation, then this resort would be suitable.

However, if you are looking for a peaceful, "adults only" atmosphere, then immediately look for another resort.  THIS FACILITY IS NOT FOR YOU.

reviews.author: Valerie M
reviews.title: Some v good things, some v bad things
reviews.text:
First the positives; clean room, spacious and comfortable pool area,amazing kids zonerelaxing large spa,staff try their best(details to follow),beautiful well manicured lanndscapes.
Negatives,  the food, the food, the food
if you like hot fresh meals do not go there, we had a terrible time ordering as most dont speak any english, no matter what you ask for they nod and smile si si, but dont have a clue what you want. a meeting with the food manager resulted in a 'special' non menu dinner served poolside, great gesture but five different courses of shrimp just didnt cut it....
the staff try so hard to please you instead of trying to understand you it frustrates the heck out of me, if they just said they didnt understand and got someone else it would be so much better. my kids enjoyed it but had nuggets and fries for six days, we joke that the adults lost weight on vacation. We wont return to Dom Rep for a long time.

reviews.author: IsabelA484
reviews.title: Destination Wedding DISASTER
reviews.text:
Went to my nieces wedding with 26 others in our party. Let me tell you that first impressions always count. When you have terrible management what can you expect from this hotel. Upon check in there were 3 buses full of college students all checking out at the same time. Now i would think there would have had a representatives checking the students out not all the students checking themselves out im talking about 300 people all at once. Once i saw that first thing that came to my mind was I came at the wrong time boy was i right. 2nd thought was going to another hotel however, we had a contract for 3 nights which meant if I didn't stay I would lose my money. So, it was downhill from that point on.

PROS - Beautiful beach and nice architecture and beautiful pool.

CONS - Mangement, i asked for manager never came out
              Staff - attended to you when it was convient to them. You would have to go get  someone to bring you a drink unless you just got up and got your own drink at the bar.
Food not bad but not hot. Now the reason to all of this is due to the management at the hotel they OVERWORK their staff so, of course they are too tired to help the guest. The hotel staff works 22 days on 8 days off. I wouldn't want to work either. 
You would think that a 4 DIAMOND property would have superb service they DON'T. I have been to 4 Diamond properties and 5 star resorts and I would give them 3 stars and that is alot for the service that was given.  The only time staff will acknowledge you is to sell you their time share.
The hall ways are poorly lit and they use 25 watt bulbs so, it's hard to see where your going at night. If your on the 3rd floor the water pressure is very low so, you might find that your toilet doesn't work properly nor does your shower or sink. BEWARE on picking up the phone to make a call i made the mistake and made a call within the same country and i spoke for 6 minutes and was hit with a $25.00 US phone bill thank goodness I didn't call to the U.S.
This hotel is OVERPRICED for the terrible service one recieves. Maybe at one time this hotel had great service but they do not now. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone. Now, those of you that don't believe me go ahead give it a try and prove me wrong. 
I had to make the most of this for my niece and her special day but I will not be returning again. I have been to better resorts in Punta Cana,Puerto Plata,Sosua,Samana and Santo Domingo that have 0 diamonds. HOTELS STAFF SHOULDN'T  IGNORE GUEST.

reviews.author: maria g
reviews.title: A self service 4 Diamond DUMP
reviews.text:
I have been in the travel industry for 22 years and this was the WORSE place I have stayed in  this place doesn't believe in customer service it does not exist. I got to the hotel little did i know there was a group of over 200 checking out. I arrived at 2:45pm for a 3pm check in I got my keyes to my room at 5:45pm got to the room got a room with a sofa bed. I stayed in the room since i didnt want to go back to reception and wait again. Went down for dinner at one of the restaurants (Asian) food was bad ended up going to the buffet which wasnt bad food is cold however. The waiters come to your table after 15 minutes to ask you what you would like a drink. After that I would just go to the bar and get my own drink since the waiters would either take long, forget or bring the wrong drink. mind you I would ask them in spanish so, they understood.
I always feel one should give everyone a chance but this place is RIDICULOUS no customer service i asked for the manager the first day I left and never saw the manager. The only thing this hotel has is its architecture nothing else. Its very dark they dont turn on the lights in the hall. Someone is getting a very good cutback cause this hotel is a self service hotel. Nothing works,it's overpriced and their is not one bit of customer service. GO ELSEWHERE. I guess that the persons that say this hotel is good must travel very little and has not gone to many hotels. I can't say all of the CONS to this hotel cause there is not enough space. And there are no PROS.

reviews.author: Shaya R
reviews.title: What a terrible resort!
reviews.text: I normally am not the type to write a review, however, I have never been so disappointed with a vacation. Although the property is beautiful, the service and quality of food was subpar to terrible. From the moment we stepped foot onto the resort, we were constantly harassed to spend more money on water sports, upgrades, etc. The entire staff was unhelpful, especially Alberto (with concierge) whom we only saw once at the very beginning of our stay and did not take care of or help us with anything! We stayed in a room with an "ocean view", however only had a very small partial view of the ocean and was told that there were no true "ocean view" rooms except for in the royal service part of the hotel. We were treated like second class guests during our entire stay because we were not part of the reserve, royal service or VIP sections of the resort. I am a very frequent traveler and out of all of the vacations I have ever been on, this was by far the worst! I absolutely would never go back and would never recommend this resort to anyone!

reviews.author: gvomvol124
reviews.title: STAY ANYWHERE BUT HERE!!
reviews.text: My wife and I are currently still here at the Paradisus with our 2 young children and I couldn't wait to submit a review to make sure that others don't waste their vacation at this place. Food sucks, service is horrible, rooms smell and nothing works. This place is one big mirage. Everything looks great from afar but a closer look reveals tremendous flaws. We are tired of complaining to management for every little thing. Take my advice, stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Nancy R
reviews.title: I do not  recommend this resort
reviews.text:
We booked a week at the Reserve however upon arrival they did not have our reservation, therefor we were put up at the Paradisus Palma Real.  Although the resort, and beach was beautiful, friendly and helpful staff, the food was horrible and the liquor watered down.  I understand this is a 4+star resort (not sure who's doing the rating).  I would not recommend this vacation spot, and feel they have turned me off to all inclusive' vacationing.
Nancy
NYC

reviews.author: Ali35805
reviews.title: Don't go to this hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel made our vacation stressful before we even left.  We booked the hotel 3 months before the trip and a week before we were to leave they called us to let us know that they overbooked and they have to relocate us from the Reserve portion of the hotel.  The only reason that we booked this hotel was because of the Reserve.  Don't go there, they will make your vacation miserable before you even leave!

reviews.author: hhislop
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here
reviews.text: My husband and I went here on our honeymoon last week.  We were supposed to stay at The Reserve and only upon flying over, going through customs, getting a taxi and finally trying to check in to The Reserve, were we told that the Dish Network had a weeklong function (the entire length of our stay) and that everyone who was booked at The Reserve had to be moved to the main hotel.  No mention of an upgrade or added bonuses to make up for switching our rooms that were confirmed and clearly written out on my printed out confirmation that I made one year prior!  We were pretty much just told to deal with it.  Only after complaining about it and asking for a manager (who we couldn't talk to) and explaining that it was our honeymoon and how we didn't understand how everything was double-booked.  Upon speaking to some of the guests that were part of the Dish Network group, we came to find out that their group booked 8-9 months prior.  I can't tell you how many people were upset by this.  And the fact that they knew about this or 8-9 months and don't let you know until you check in.  So poorly managed.  I absolutely DO NOT recommend this place.  Food is not good either.

reviews.author: HeidiMM14
reviews.title: DO NOT plan your Wedding at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Palma Real resort is indeed beautiful.  However, when it comes to service it gets a BIG ZERO.  
 
I was upgraded to the Royal Service since we chose to have our wedding there - You would think that we would actually get the best service possible, but it was the total opposite.  
 
The butler we were assigned to was nice, but I only saw him the first day we met.  When you dial their ext, no one was ever there.   If youdialed the front desk or even the Royal service office, no one ever responded.  If you needed anything, you might as well just get it yourself. 
 
 
For couples considering this hotel for their wedding, I truly recommend DO NOT do this to yourselves.  
 
WEDDING IDEAS SOLD--Most of the images on their digital albums are not available and they don’t tell you this.  I was sold a number of things that when the day of the wedding came, they did not have available.  So of course I had to settle with what they had. 

WEDDING PLANNING TEAM-- The resort's romance wedding planning team, although very nice, are just not experienced in planning quality weddings.  They don’t provide the support or availability the bride/groom need.
 
FLOWERS--The flowers look gorgeous on their digital album, but in reality it’s the cheapest looking thing imaginable in person.  I was SO disappointed because this is supposed to be a top quality resort.  I greatly regret not bringing in a wedding designer to do the entire decor, even if it would have cost me more.  
 
RECEPTION –-During the middle of our reception, I noticed some random people who were not our guest in shorts and baseball caps walking in.  I had to literally get the planner and have her take care of it.  This was so ridiculous. They do not provide people to work the door at your event. 

RECEPTION MEAL-- As the bride and groom, we were the first to get up and get our meal.  We immediately noticed a random dish added to our buffet without our approval - "french fries".  Luckly, I was able have the chef and remove it on time.  

To sum up, there were so many unbelievable moments at this hotel - NOT “Omg how wonderful” type of moments, but “are you freaking kidding me with this!” type of moments.  The one that broke the camel's back was when we got to our hotel room, post reception, and a bill for the makeup I had gotten done for the wedding was laying on our bed.  Mind you, this charge was already added to our room and I was aware I would have to pay this at our check out.  This was so tacky and tasteless that it truly made me regret having my wedding there.  This is sad to say, but as a bride, on my wedding day -  I cried of anger and not happiness thanks to this hotel and their awful services.

reviews.author: csutfin
reviews.title: First "all-inclusive" resort vacation and super disappointing!!
reviews.text:
My finace and I went to DR on a group trip with about 24 of our friends. The day before we left we got a call saying we were being "upgraded" to the 5-star Paradisus from it's 4-star sister resort only to find out that 18 of our friends were still at the other resort. We were assured they would make it right with day passes, or something else...didn't happen. In fact, when we went to the other resort we were told it would be an extra $214/couple to use all their facilities besides the rooms. 
Our resort only had 5 restaurants that were included compared to the 10 or 12 that the 4-star had. Only one of our restaurants didn't need reservations and getting a reservation for 6 was hard to do without 2-3 days advance notice. One night we went to eat at said restaurant and it was closed, when we asked to front desk they didn't even know it was closed. It ended up being in the theatre for a dinner theatre, so we showed up only to find no seats available, so we got plates went outside and ate with our fingers...some 5-star resort. Things only declined from there...I won't bore you with all my complaints. Just know that if you are expecting to be treated like "royalty" it won't happen.
The rooms were clean, the service was fair, but overall, I was highly disappointed and wouldn't even consider going back.

reviews.author: joe77743323
reviews.title: The worst experience I've had out of dozens of all-inclusives
reviews.text:
I've been to dozens of all inclusives and would strongly recommend you move onto another.  My favorite?  Sandals in Jamaica.   But Paradisus was the only high end (we paid much more for better service and upgraded room) all inclusive where we were constantly harrassed to buy time shares and excursions by the hotel staff.   I can understand if they ask at checkin but they had apparantly no system in place and dozens of staff walking around asking, none of which really knew you had been asked 15 times already to buy them.  A couple of the people literally harassed us while we were trying to enjoy ourselves and were pretty aggressive.  Not good. 

Some of the staff were friendly, others were not.  It was pretty inconsistent.  We paid extra to get an upgraded room which was definately sub par.  There was  a bright light right outside our room lighting our patio which we were told "shut off each night at midnight automatically".  So much for early sleep.  Our sink wouldn't drain and the safe only sporadically worked.  At a high end resort, details like this should not be overlooked.  

The resort itself was elaborate and beautiful and the beaches were great, but definately only a "so-so" experience over all.  

My girlfriend spent an hour sitting through a time share presentation to recieve a gift shop gift certificate (at least we were promissed it was good there).  After hauling a bunch of items to the gift shop counter we were told the gift cert could not even be used there.  We spent an hour getting redirected from one end fo the resort to the other trying to get resolution before eventually getting frustrated and just letting them keep the useless gift certificate.  To be honest, I don't know if I would go back to this resort if they gave me a free trip....

reviews.author: jsgViajero78
reviews.title: septiembre no debe ser buen mes
reviews.text:
Para empezar, como digo en el titular, septiembre no debe ser buen mez para ir a paradisus palma real. Yo comparto aqui mi experiencia en este hotel.

   Para empezar a la ducha de hidromasaje le falta una pieza, el buffet estaba cerrado casi tods las noches obligandonos a reservar en los restaurantes a horas tales como las 19:15, las 18:30 y caosas asi. Resulta que nos dicen que por temporada y ocupacion (30%) tienen cerrados 4 de los 7 restaurantes. Intentamos pedir un menu en español del room service hasta en 3 ocasiones y terminamos al final con 2 menus en igles/griego.
  Por la tarde/noche salimos a dar un paseo por la otra ala del hotel y vimos cucarachas correteando por los pasillos. Como es el mes que es (septiembre) pasaron algunas tormentillas por la zona y para nuestra sorpresa hasta 5 veces se fue la luz en todo el hotel, a todo esto añado, si habeis estado o teneis pensado visitarlo en algun futuro mirad en la parte baja de los armarios, tienen los cuadros electricos al aire.
 Mas cosas, se me ocurrió la feliz idea de ir a preguntar a recepcion los precios de la conexion a internet del hotel....atentos...12$ el cable de red sin reembolso + 15$ por dia de conexión....por una conexión de tan sólo 5 megas.
