Finally, a truck comes along and a crew removes the sacks.  The whole process takes a good four to five hours, all the way down the beach, and finally concludes just after noon.  Surely, if the hotel had to pay these poor individuals a reasonable wage, or was interested in having the beach fully available to its guests for the guests’ entire day, they would invest in a more efficient way of doing this, such as a tractor!
The food is pretty good for all-inclusive.  There are several “reservation only” restaurants on the site as well, which were good, but not something you would want to pay extra for.  One night, my wife and I had reservations at one of these restaurants.  The name escapes me, but you can’t miss it – it was decorated with about 2000 red, glass bottles in the shape of hearts.  It is their romantic rendezvous restaurant.  I wanted to get a nice bottle of red wine for the meal, even if I had to pay extra for it.  When I was presented with the “ala carte” wine list, I had to laugh.  It had about twenty selections on it, mostly Gallo’s, Fetzer’s, and cheap boujeaulais.  But what made me laugh was the price these normally five to ten dollar bottles were being offered at – average $60 to $80 dollars a bottle!  I guess if you set the price high enough, even a rhinestone can become a diamond!
Our particular room was a ground floor room that was plagued by mosquitoes and cockroaches.  The construction of these rooms is amazingly cheap and shoddy, and on two days during which it rained very heavily, we found the floor of our bed-room soaked due to a closed, but poorly sealed window that had leaked.  One of the two sliding doors separating our room from the area where the children slept would not slide, and was not fixed during our stay, despite our request.  But the best part was the huge handprint smudge on the bathroom wall, probably left there from construction days.  Every time I went to the restroom, I would swat mosquitoes, stare at that handprint, and ponder just how these places get the star ratings they do.  Do they buy them?
In conclusion, this is indeed a nice hotel, but is certainly not what I would call a luxury resort by any means.  As for the Sol Melia Vacation Club people… either be rude or lie, whatever it takes, to get them to leave you alone!

reviews.author: dfCt
reviews.title: thought it was going to be the ritz yet it fizzed!
reviews.text:
we went during presidents week with our 2 kids(3 rd graders)
first comment- if it rains your in trouble. nothing to do at the hotel period

i just read the march 7th article and agree with several points:

restaurant system is horrible- good luck getting in to the good restauarants and yet there are empty seats?

rooms are ok

trays of food were laying in the halls for days!

turn down service was horrible!

we did the concierge service which was a waste.

the hotel wasnt prepared for an entourage of people during the biggest vacation week.

the hotel itself is beautiful but doesnt make up for the lack of service

my biggest disappointment was that when i expressed my frustration to management  they countered all my points as a defense instead of realizing that they werent prepared for heavy crowds yet. off the record the staff will tell you if you ask!

my travel agent(deals with high end properties ) has heard this from many families and took them of there property list.

too bad.  its a 50/50 bet when you go there.  we will never go back . the Ritz knows how to treat customers and would never make a customer feel bad for vocalizing "poor service"

spend your $ elswhere

reviews.author: dpim
reviews.title: Looks aren't everything and that's all this place has
reviews.text:
My husband and I, along with another couple, stayed at the Paradisus for 4 nights from 2/28-3/4. Everything other reviewers have said about this hotel's appearance is accurate. The grounds are immaculate, the decor is beautiful, the restaurants are decorated well, the pool is amazing, the beach is great...clearly they have put a lot of money and effort into getting this part of the property right. However there are some major, MAJOR issues with this place that I think others have touched but I feel really need to be elaborated on. Particularly at this price level, these things are just unacceptable I think.

#1: The system they have in place for dinner reservations is absolutely absurd. There are 4 beautiful restaurants at the resort, all of which require reservations to eat at. That wouldn't be so bad except you can only make reservations for that day from 9 am - 2 pm and for the next day from 6 pm  - 9 pm. If you are arriving at the resort after 2 pm on the day you check-in (as we and many others were) you are out of luck for a dinner reservation on your first night. They will direct you to their dinner buffet which is little more then a taco bar but you can not eat the restaurant, end of story. Our walk to the buffet took us by all the restaurants where we saw at least 4 tables open at each but they WILL NOT make any exceptions, even when we explained we didn't have the opportunity to make the reservation for that night because we'd only arrived at 5 pm AND that they clearly had room for a party of 4 at one of their open tables. This would be annoying anywhere but it's particularly infuriating when you're at an all inclusive resort and have already paid for dinner but their silly "system" won't allow you to eat where you want! At 6 pm (the first available time to make reservations for the next night), we thought we'd figured out the system and got on the phone to make our reservation for our second night.  Somehow, even at 6 pm, the only time they had available for us was 9:45!!!! When we challenged them on how and why this was possible, they just said "that's all that's available"...no effort to help at all. You are explicity told in your check-in materials that you can only make reservations 1 day in advance but even then we couldn't eat until almost 10 pm?!?! We eventually figured out that they were allowing people to make reservations 2 and 3 days in advance (not what the information they provide when you check in says) so the first night we could get a reservation that was NOT 9:45 was our 3rd night at the resort. Who wants to deal with such hassle when they are supposed to be relaxing on vacation?  
#2: As you can see, their staff is not very helpful.  They seem more hasseled then anything when you address them with a question.  We even had a Spanish speaker in our group and that didn't help.  With a few exceptions most really couldn't be bothered with explaining why or what something was or even just smiling and saying hello when you pass them in the hall.  Again, totally not on par with what I would expect for a hotel billing themselves as a "Leading Hotel of the World".
#3:  THE FOOD!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  I simply don't understand how anyone can say this food was good, let alone great. We were absolutely perplexed by how horrendous the food was day after day at this resort, regardless of which restaurant or buffet we were eating at. What we originally  wrote off as a fluke turned out to absolutely
be the norm there. Foods you would expect to be served hot were warm at best, usually just plain cold. While there would be grills hot and ready to go, you couldn't get a burger cooked to order. Instead you had to take a pre-cooked burger, hot dog, etc from their chaeffers and use one of their stale buns.  he cheese display sits in an refridgerated container with only 1 door (the other sliding side is no where to be found) so it's warm and swarmed with flies. Chips on the nacho bar were stale, fries were cold and soggy, pizza was some disgusting frozen pizza...I could literally go on and on and on. The food at their restaurants wasn't any better.  We all commented that they appeared to just take the gross food from their buffet and present it nicely on a plate. The french onion soup came out with a 2" square of yellow American cheese on top that was hard as a rock...looked like it had been microwaved or something. In addition to just poor food quality, many of the dishes were just tasteless and bland.  We were all so disappointed in the food.  None of us are picky eaters and didn't even have high expectations for the food...this isn't even school cafeteria quality.  We all commented that a Chili's or TGI Friday's was 5 star compared to what they were serving. So in addition to making you wait until 10 pm, the food they give you is absolutely disgusting!  You can understand why we were all looking forward to going home and eating something decent (and by decent I mean Chef Boyardee would have been better then the pasta they were serving at this place) food. After paying this much for a place I wouldn't expect any of these things and would never recommend this resort to anyone. While it's beatiful and the drinks are great, the overall experience is completely shattered by how hard it is to do something basic like eat dinner and then how disgusting the food is. We were looking forward to a relaxing vacation with friends, enjoying some great meals together. Instead we spent much of our time discussing how gross everything was and how a place that is this beautiful could be overlooking such a crictical piece of their guests' experience.  
In short, if you're thinking about booking at this place, DON'T.  And if you already have, I suggest you pack lots of Power Bars or you'll be subsisting on boxed cereal from the breakfast buffet for your stay.

reviews.author: Vikkivette
reviews.title: Not paradise after all
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel from 2/8 to 2/16/07, we had a Royal Srv Oceanfront suite. My husband and I have traveled extensively and have always stayed at luxurious resorts. That is why I chose the Royal Srv and this new hotel. The hotel is just beautiful, the dream stops there. We found it to be way overpriced for the ever disappearing butler that came with our suite, we would request things over and over and it would never come, he would write it down in front of me and never return. I just wanted bottled water to brush my teeth! You cannot drink the water, the bugs are huge, no one understands basic english and the casino staff are rude beyond description. The ceiling fixtures were falling out of the ceiling, green mold on the faucets, my bathroom mirror went a week without being cleaned. The food is always cold, even at the buffets. The drinks were great ,and yes, you must drink alot of them just to relieve the anxiety with accomodations and butler shortcomings. This hotel is not even 2 yeas old and it looks 20. My bed had bedbugs in it, I would wake up with a whole new set of bites every morning, and  one day I was locked in the RS bathroom stall  by the pool along with another lady in the stall next to me. The tumblers in the lock were broken, she and I came out on our stomachs on the bathroom floor-YUK . That about did me in. For 9000.00$ I could have gone somewhere much , much nicer where you can actually drink the water,  and sleep in a clean bed and actually be treated as a guest. If you do not travel much, you will think this place is heaven, if you fly first class, as we do and travel first class, take my advice,cancel and go elsewhere, anywhere in fact. This hotel will not live up to whatever expectations you will have. I filed multiple complaints with the management and the company in the states Sol Melia, they were mostly ignored, except for one email from the hotel manager Mr Wyss basically telling me my complaints were all unfounded and his staff had a completely different recollection of the events! My parents were with us,  had a royal srv suite too and all their problems were very similar so I do not believe our experience is isolated .I guess the customer is not always right?!! For a vacation , the whole thing seemed like way too much work for me, struggling for every little request to be granted, it is irritating after awhile, not relaxing at all. Good luck if you are going soon, bring your bug spray, immodium, and some very low expectations.
Vikki Laidman- New York

reviews.author: LongIslandSteelydan
reviews.title: Whatever You Do, Stay Away!
reviews.text: If you want to come home from vacation feeling like you've been mugged, this is the place for you.  This hotel is a pretty facade with nothing behind it.  We were greeted the first night by giant bugs hopping all over our childrens' bed, and that set the tone for our entire stay.  It takes hours to get a towel, or pillows, or any other basic necessity, and that's assuming that you can even get anyone to pick up the phone in the first place.  Staff is clueless and totally unhelpful:  You have to escalate to a manager for the most simple of requests such as a beach chair or a dinner reservation.  At the breakfast buffet, people crowd around empty serving trays, waiting for some food as if they were disaster victims waiting for the supply truck to come.  On top of that, the food is mediocre and often cold (except for the beer which is warm), and there is no child-friendly food at this supposedly child-friendly resort.  Don't be fooled by terms like "family concierge" and "royal service," these are just bigger royal ripoffs.  From what we could see, this place makes its real money from conventions, which were basically mobs of noisy drunks carousing all over the grounds and jumping into the fountains, which was the main evening entertainment and a horrible spectacle for the children.  If you haven't reserved, don't.  If you have, get whatever money back you can, and write off the rest.  But whatever you do, don't get on the plane.

reviews.author: horadia
reviews.title: Una gran decepcion.
reviews.text:
Acabo de regresar con mi familia (esposa y dos hijos de 2 y 3 años) de una viaje de 7 dias en el Paradisus Palma Real y la experiencia fue realmente muy mala.
Si bien no soy un amante de los hoteles con servicio all inclusive, me decidi por este hotel por la excelente experiencia que habia tenido un año atras en el Paradisus Playa Conchal en Costa Rica (gran hotel).
1.Habitaciones: el punto mas fuerte del hotel. Son espaciosas y, por el momento, estan en buen estado. De todas formas el sofa cama del pequeño living es claramente el peor que vi en mi vida (impresentable para un adulto); cuando llegue a la habituacion tuve que pedir que arreglen la ducha (se inundaba), la caja fuerte (estaba trabada), y tuve que solicitar por tercera vez que enviaran una cuna a la habituacion.
2. Comida. Pesima. No puedo hablar de la comida de los dos restaurantes a los que no fui (Passion -solo para adultos- y Vento), pero en el resto de los restaurantes la comida es de mala a pesima. El desayuno es muy malo, el almuerzo regular y la cena, por lo general, pesima. Ni hablar del servicio de room service que realmente parece un chiste (Pedimos una ensalada cesar y nos enviaron una planta de lechuga sin ningun aderezo ni otro ingrediente)
3. Pileta. La pileta es grande y visualmente muy linda. De todos modos cabe puntualizar que en enero, casi nadie (ni los chicos) se mete en la pileta porque el agua es helada. Tampoco hay suficiente cantidad de reposeras, las cuales se agotan alrededor de las 9:00.
4. Playa. La playa es buena. La arena es blanca y el agua cristalina pero ambas estan llenas de algas. Si bien el personal de hotel trata de despejar al menos la playa de algas, inmediatamente se vuelve a llenar. Tambien hay que señalar que durante enero hay mucho viento todos los dias y las condiciones para bañarese en el agua no son las mejores.
5. Instalaciones. Si bien el aspecto general del hotel es bueno, las intalaciones son claramente deficientes. Ni siquiera existe una zona de juego para los chicos menores de 5 años (cosa curiosa en un hotel lleno de chicos), la habituacion del club kids (solo para chicos de mas de 5 años) es chica y oscura; el gimnasio es casi un pasillo con algunas maquinas, etc.
6. Servicio. Para un hotel que pretende ser lujoso el servicio y lisa y llanamente muy malo. Me quede sin pañales para mi hijo menor, el drugstore del hotel no tenia (es muy poco surtido) y, si bien la gente de servicio al cliente me contacto con una farmacia que me envio pañales al hotel, tuve que esperarlos en la recepcion porque no me permitieron cargarlos a la habituacion ni tampoco dejarle plata a alguien del hotel para que los pague y los envia a la habitacion
En sintesis: una expeciencia decepcionante en un hotel que se precia de ser un all inclusive de lujo. He estado viajando por el caribe regularmente dos o tres veces por año con mi familia en los ultimos años y realmente por el precio que cobra este hotel, pueden encontrarse cientos de alternativas mejores en todo el caribe.. El hotel es claramente mucho menos de lo que cobra por sus habitaciones.

reviews.author: Jane R
reviews.title: Don't Go Here
reviews.text:
My partner and I were here from 11/18-11/25.  Our problems began immediately.

We booked an upgraded package (not Royal Service) but, they did not honor the booking.   When we inquired, they responded by saying "your travel agent did not book what you asked for".  Imagine their surprise when we whipped out a copy of the reservation which showed exactly what we reserved.

Needless to say, it somehow took them 24 hours to honor the upgrade and move our room.  At this time, the hotel was not running at full capacity so, to this day, I can't imagine what took 24 hours.

The new room was loaded with issues as well.  The safe did not work.  When Security came, they said they could not fix it until the following day.  I asked them to lock into a time because we had to wait for them.  They said they would come at 8:00 a.m. but, they did not arrive until 9:30 a.m.

There was also a problem with the lock on the door to the room.  We went through endless keycards throughout our stay.  At one point, we were told that they were waiting for a part for the door, which had to come from Santo Domingo.  The part never came and, every day, we got locked out and had to go to the lobby to get new keys to access our room.

While some of the staff was pleasant, nobody has a sense of urgency.  Five minutes means one hour.  When you have as many problems on vacation as we did, you tend to run out of patience.

At one point, we asked to speak to the property manager and we were told he was on vacation.  Really?  A hotel of this magnitude and there is no manager on duty? Really?  I don't think so.

Our upgraded package was supposed to have included a 15% discount on services at the spa.  Needless to say, the discount was not factored into our bill and it took almost an hour to resolve when we went to check out.

For the most part, the food was awful.  The only good meal we had in seven days was at Passions restaurant.

After the third day, we wound up making ourselves a viennese table plate from the dessert bar and eating that for lunch.

The grounds were lovely and the booze flowed.  

The bartenders at the lobby bar have an idea of customer service.

The waitress delivering drinks at the beach made a point to ask us "not to forget her".

The first night, we went to the Casino.  We were playing the slot machines and decided to cash out.  One of the staff heard the sound of the coins dropping, ran to our machine and started scooping the coins up and putting them in a cup.  He actually had the nerve to turn to me and ask "do you have anything for me?"  I was completely appalled.

At lunch one day, one of the busboys actually asked us for one of our cigarettes.  Isn't he supposed to be doing things for the guests other than grubbing from them?

Two years ago, we went to Iberostar Bavaro.  It was half the price but, ten times the customer service.  Go there instead.

This was the first vacation in many, many years that I did not enjoy-largely attributable to the neglectful staff.

I will write a letter to the chain as well as a manager with a Miami address.

reviews.author: stb3
reviews.title: Never again. Ever!
reviews.text: I have to rate this resort as a very poor way to spend a vacation. I was so dissapointed with this place. I travel quite a bit within a great range of places from the finest to the merely average. I have traveled extensively in the Carribbean and I know what to expect. Slow service is the norm so I don't get upset about it, ever. However... the service at paradisus is so terrible and somtimes non-existant.  I am a patient, considerate person. I do not expect perfection but I came away very upset I spent my money on this place. I traveled with my husband and my 13 month old daughter. We paid for Family Concierge service. If you must go to this resort, and I do mean MUST, don't pay for this unless you have a gaggle of children who can use the walkie talkie and have fun calling the concierge. He will never fulfill requests but at least the children won't care. It was useless and our few requests never were fulfilled. They were as nice as pie, but no success. I ordered feather pillows and they came after we fell asleep. The feathers also smelled mildewed and they covered it up with a green apple scent! Gross! By the end of the trip it became a big joke to see what would and would not get done. They would clean our room one day and not the next. Turn down service would be done one evening and not the next. The rooms were nice and the resort itself is very beautiful, but that is the only positive thing I have to say. We had a trail of ants running through our room and we saw some small black centipedes around the toilet. They were not so bad- but someone kept leaving room service dishes outside our door and the ants would literally come in the thousands and I would call for someone to take the dishes away but they would not pick them up until the next day -literally in the late afternoon, so we had to step over the ant hill each time we went to and fro. The noise level in my room each morning (6am) was insane- mostly slamming doors and kids crying. If you have one well behaved child do yourself a favor and ask for a room away from the the gads of bratty, unsupervised children. It was awful having to fend away an annoying little girl who kept trying to lick my baby's fingers and pick my baby up all day, each day. Her parents were nowhere in sight most of the time. The food was not very good, but if you really look you can find something edible at the buffet, unless they decide to serve the entrees from the evening before. They did a nice job on the Thanksgiving buffet, they really tried so incredibly hard. I don't have the heart to say anything bad about it. Then the next morning I noticed the same dishes in the breakfast buffet. It was weird seeing turkey and stuffed pork, etc... the next day at breakfast. Some restaurants are horrible while others are only decent. I know good food and wine, so if you do, than don't come here expecting it. The shows were bad, but who really cares- this is not New York or Vegas. The beach is beautiful, it really is. There was a ton of seaweed washed up on the shore and in the water so if you don't like the feeling of things brushing all over your skin in the water you may not be happy with it. The resort is huge and there was always a palapa open on the beach-another positive thing! I should mention that it took over an hour to check in for no good reason. It is never nice to fly somewhere and then finally get there only to have to wait for nothing- the room actually was ready. So annoying. You will have to wear a Paradisus bracelet for the duration of your stay.  Upon checkout the concierge was not helpful with arranging our airport transportation when asked. Pardon me, but isn't that a concierge's job??? The problem is that although they are nice, no one here has accountability or an understanding of their job description. The food was only edible and you will most likely enconter a situation where you need help but you may not get it. I think your money would be better spent elsewhere. My time is too valuable to waste here ever again.

reviews.author: Minkky2424
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real -- A Roach Hotel
reviews.text:
I spent ten nights at this resort with my boyfriend and we were very disappointed.  The whole resort is a BEAUTIFUL unfinished thought. 

We paid for an ocean view suite but the ocean was located about a 1/2 mile away. So we ended up with a garden view.  Which would have been okay with me if they did not mow the grass every morning starting at 7AM -- which would wake us up... very inconsiderate.

Even thought the resort had only about 250 people, they kept of running out of water...then the electrify would go out for several hours at a time.

We were not informed advance that the resorts restaurants for dinner had a dress code for men...therefore when my boyfriend and I were headed to dinner we were turned away.  Women can go in the restaurant anyway that they please (flip flops, shorts etc) but the men have to have dress pants an shoes.

They had very poor nightly entertainment...the only thing that we had to do in the resort was gamble at the casino....which I truly do not recommend to anyone.  If you want to gamble go to Vegas!!!!!!!

The beach closes at 6:00PM and the pool closes at 7:00PM…we would have loved to have a nice midnight swim….but I guess not.

The food at the resort is not great…it is okay, I lost 5 pounds on my vacation with no exercise.

I should have paid more attention to the review from ALEXISGM, from Lakewood (reviewed on Sept 11th 2006) on the roaches…We had them in our room, when we complained and wanted to change our room they did not accommodate us.  They sent a man to our room to spray it while I was in the room.  We had to leave because I could not tolerate the smell of the chemicals in the air.

There are many other little things that ruined our vacation.  I would never go back to this resort nor would I recommend it to anyone.  

THE ONLY GREAT THING ABOUT THIS VACATION WERE THE AMAZING FRIENDS THAT WE MADE AT THE RESORT…

Full of Roaches A DISAPPOINTMENT

reviews.author: maherdon
reviews.title: Disapointed in Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
I just returned from Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana.  They only have about 9 rooms that are actual Ocean View Rooms.  They are all located so far away from the main restaurants and areas of central locality.  The remaining rooms are either partial ocean view or they are not an ocean view at all.  The hotel has roaches in the rooms.  The meals at the restaurants were beautiful but the food was over rated.  They need a program director as they did not offer any stimulating activities during the day or the evening.  Bring lots of single dollar bills with you.  It's almost impossible t get American change other than $20's.  The evening shows are extremely poor.  To see most of the shows you are in a huge auditorium with no air conditioning.  The resort is beautiful to look at but it is over rated.  If you are going to just COMPLETELY RELAX, THIS IS THE PLACE FOR YOU BECAUSE THERE IS NOTHING ELSE TO DO.  mY MOTHER IS 75 YEARS OLD.  i WOULD NOT EVEN RECOMMEND IT TO HER.  SHE'S TOO YOUNG FOR THIS PLACE.  IT'S BOORING.  THE PLACE IS OVER RATED, THE FOOD IS OVER RATED, THE ACTIVITIES ARE OVER RATED.  The only thing they had to do all day long was to lay in the pool, relax at pool side, relax by the ocean that some days was difficult to get to because the resort did not clean the beach area of seaweed.  

I WOULD NEVER GO BACK.  I'D NEVER RECOMMEND IT TO ANYONE.  IT'S  TOO OVER RATED.  Price is not an issue to us but you certainly do not get your monies worth out of this resort.  This is not an inexpensive resort to go to. I've been to better resorts for the less money that were not rated a 5 start resort but had 5 star qualities.  

I'm 50 years old.  IThe entertainment and activities are for the dead or close to it.

reviews.author: steph44w1
reviews.title: Service/Management not Luxury at all
reviews.text:
I waited a long time to write this review to give the Paradisus Palma Real/Sol Melia company ample time to reconcile my problem with them. Unfortunatly they did not act in a way that a "luxury 5 star resort" would. The Sol Melia company has hundreds of resorts and have been around for a while, they should know how to handle any situation. 

I will not comment on the grounds, room, etc. It has all been said before. The seagrass is bad. I have never saw that much before and I have been to 4 carribbean islands. The food was so so. You can find something to eat. I did get sick the last day which was horrible even though I took every precaution.

That being said, my boyfriend and I were quite dissapointed at our so called "vacation" on April 22-28th at this property.

My boyfriend got hurt while on their property and the resort did not take care of the emergency room bill, the ambulence, the taxi ride back to the hotel from the hospital, the resort accomodations. Nothing. He was confined to wheelchair and could not go in the pool or ocean or do any of the activities offered. 

After many letters beck and forth even to the president of the carribbean hotel chain they offered us a couple dollars off the price to go there again. We would never give them a dime to go back to any of their resorts after we already paid for a vacation and couldn't participate in any of the activities.

The resort staff including senior management was very unprofessional and unhelpful. They did not accomodate us in any way. To use the word 'luxury" in describing themself is a joke.  

I will never go back to any Sol Melia resort.

P.S. We also met another person that got hurt on their property. 

steph44w@yahoo.com

reviews.author: lnewby
reviews.title: This hotel is a rip off scam specialist!
reviews.text:
I had confirmed MONTHS in advnace to stay at the Punta Cana Rseort with a rate of $280 per ROOM per night for 2 persons. Upon arrival at the hotel at 10 pm, I was told I was to stay instead at their NEW Paradisus Palma Real just 10 minutes away. Luckily I was able to get the airport shuttle driver to reload my luggage and take me to the sisiter hotel. Upon checvk in, which took almost 30 minutes,  we were FINALLY taken to our room. The first thing we noticed in the stuffy musty room that the entire sliding glass door was cracked. SO DANGEROUS, we called the front desk and were told there were no rooms to move us to. So for 4 nights we continued to stay in that unsafe room while we had the maintenence manager in, told our room service attendant....any one we could get to listen to our story and see the door. We never used the patio deck because we were afraid to open the slider.

THE RIP OFF came when we went to check out. ONLY THEN were we told that the rate was $495 per nightm almost DOUBLE what we were quoted. They said it was becaouse we made a "Voluntary Change of Hotels" which is just not true! We showed them our written emails that confirmed our rate, arguesd for almost an hour while the bus left to take the others to the airport and still they would not release our luggage to leave until I signed the charge slip. I told them I was doing it under duress and would decline charges upon return. They have never replied to my numerous emails or phone calls and I have declined partial payment through my credit card company. My card company rebilled the charges as "the hotel had my signature" on the much hiher rate charged at check out.

BEWARE; what can you do when they rip you off? They always were surely at the resort but I didn;t think they would be down right criminal!!

reviews.author: Passenger15889
reviews.title: Choose another hotel!
reviews.text:
This is a new property with real problems that should bar you from choosing it. While Punta Cana has nice beaches it has no flair of a downtown worth seeing as many other islands have. So its resort life only.

This hotel which I just came back from has bad service, one in 20 staff speak any english at all! Friends on beach were robbed by staff who used there master key to get in there room. Hotel denied it til they admitted the system allowed them to see every room door open by key and trace the exact key. They were offered a free weeks stay less airfare as compensation,,so what!

Restaurants were overcrowded with no reservation system and hour waits at 20% occupancy,,I laugh to think what they would do at 50% plus!

Staff would wait to service you choosing to wipe tables. It was standard to wait 5-15 minutes for coffee service at breakfast, despite there being more servers then people to serve.

Yes the hotel is nice looking, nice pool etc, the rooms are also nice but you can get this anywhere and is not the only criteria to make a holiday 5 star. Bottom line 4 star location, 3 star entertainment, 2 star service.

Choose another place! We travel 2 times a year on holiday and this was the worst choice we have made in 5 plus years!

reviews.author: Journey24292
reviews.title: Rip Off!  Don't waste your time!
reviews.text: We came to the resort w/out reservations and got a room for 3 nights.  The resort was breathtaking.  They wanted $450/person for "Royal Service" (which is all they claimed they had available).  We were told everything was included - golf, watersports, gym and that we did not need reservations for their restaurants.  It took over an hour and a half to check in our royal selves and the girl told us we would each have 3 free rounds of golf per person.  My friend asked if that included the cart and a guy there said yes.  When we got to our room the man told us we could get a special jacuzzi and gave us a menu.  Bottom line - needed reservations for dinner, snorkeling was the only free sport we were told when trying to book some activities, they wanted $28 for a lavender scented jacuzzi set-up from the menu, to use the sauna or jacuzzi in the gym they wanted us to purchase a service from the spa.  This nickel and diming going on for $900/night for a room!  We were so upset we should have just left.  My friend tried to get one tee time five times!  They said they'd call back and never did each time.  Then they told her she had to pay for the cart and club rental.  We later found out that they own the Cocotal Golf club, but EVERY resort in the vicinity uses it as well and they PAY for it while the guests at Paradisus have it "included".  It's all a big sham.  We left after the first night and went to Occidental Allegro not even five minutes away and called and got a tee time at the Cocotal immediately...because they were charging $167 for 9 holes.  The people at the resort basically lied to us and inflated their price.  When my husband pressed them at the checkout to see what the royal service was, it basically bottom lined to a private beach and pool area.  I would have been happy if we paid $150-200/person, but $450 for that?  Please!  Save your money and use it to fly first class on your trip.  Would be a better investment.   Some nice resorts nearby were Ocean Bavaro, Ocean Blue - Secrets resort is about 40 minutes north and is beautiful and the same caliber starting at $230/night.  Oh, and they use the Cocotal Golf Course for their guests as well....

reviews.author: MDVal
reviews.title: Buena experiencia sin cubrir expectativas
reviews.text:
La experiencia ha sido buena pero con algunas incidencias.
Como muy positiva mi experiencia con el servicio del bar en la zona The Reserve y en especial con Antonia que se ha preocupado de que estuviera bien durante toda mi estancia.
La experiencia del spa también positiva y con el personal muy amable.
Respecto a la habitación reporté varias incidencias porque la caja fuerte funcionaba muy mal, la tapa del inodoro estaba floja, la ducha estaba suelta  y la luz se iba y volvía frecuentemente, pero nadie solucionó nada durante mi estancia.
Los restaurantes están bien aunque la comida es más cantidad que calidad. 
En resumen buena experiencia pero esperaba más por el precio de cada noche en el hotel.

reviews.author: Anna-Leigh B
reviews.title: Amazing and Safe Solo Trip Experience
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience during my stay here. I traveled solo, and as someone doing a solo trip for the first time, I felt very safe and comfortable throughout my entire stay. The staff was attentive, friendly, and almost everyone spoke English very well, which made everything feel much less stressful and easy to navigate.

My room ( reserved adults only swim out suite) was clean, comfortable, and relaxing. The only downside was that the walls seemed fairly thin, so I could hear the couple staying next door at times. Aside from that, the room itself was very nice and comfortable to come back to after long days outside.

The beach was one of my favorite parts of the resort. Even though I only stayed 3 nights, every time I went down to the beach there was always someone there to help lay out towels and check in with me. Even though there were multiple vendors trying to sell you thing, the beach area was beautiful, relaxing, and very well maintained.

I also really enjoyed the restaurants on the property. I ate at Flora, Mina, and Sante during my stay. Sante had the best view, and Mina had the best atmosphere and vibe, but Flora was my favorite overall because the food and service were excellent. The staff at Flora especially stood out to me because they actually came over and made conversation with me, which I really appreciated since I was dining alone. The buffet food personally wasn’t really to my liking, but the room service was great and ended up being my preferred option.

My concierge, Eriol, was amazing throughout my stay. He always responded quickly, answered my questions, and was extremely helpful whenever I needed information or assistance. I also got a massage from Ironelis, who was very friendly and did an excellent job.

The resort also sends out a daily list of events and activities, which I appreciated. My only issue was that I sometimes had trouble figuring out where the activities were located because there weren’t many signs around the resort directing you where to go. Since I visited during a slower time of year, some activities also felt a little empty when I arrived.

Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this resort, especially for solo travelers looking for a safe and relaxing experience.

reviews.author: jenny A
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
Great customer service
Great value for price. Will come again!

reviews.author: Amber B
reviews.title: The reserve is it!
reviews.text: Once we were assigned our concierge he was amazing from the start. His name is Gustavo. He was willing to do anything that we needed to ensure our stay went smooth and was relaxing. He made the most romantic room for our honeymoon! He went above and beyond. We will book in the future and have him assist us again.

reviews.author: Barbara V
reviews.title: A trip to remember!
reviews.text: This was our first trip to the Paradisus and certainly won’t be our last. The facilities were beautiful, nightly entertainment fun, pool side and concierge services Excellent! Gustavo made sure we were well taken care of, with a few special surprises for our anniversary.

reviews.author: Mandy
reviews.title: Truly Exceptional Care
reviews.text:
I was incredibly lucky to have Alan/Alam as my concierge during my stay. From the moment I arrived, he was a steady, warm, and genuinely reassuring presence — the kind of person who makes you feel completely taken care of without ever being intrusive.

Near the end of my trip, there was a brief logistical mix-up, and although it wasn’t the hotel’s or his responsibility, he handled it with such calm professionalism and kindness that it completely diffused any stress. He made everything feel smooth and manageable.

What stood out most was how naturally attentive he was — checking in, anticipating needs, and making me feel genuinely looked after. It felt less like a standard concierge experience and more like having someone you could fully trust to be in your corner. That sense of care made my entire stay better.

The hotel is very lucky to have him. He’s a natural at what he does, and I truly hope to return and have him as my concierge again. A wonderful and memorable part of my trip.

reviews.author: Rlmorganjr
reviews.title: Recharge Vacation
reviews.text:
Always a great experience. Seeing familiar faces on staff and meeting new people is always a highlight but not always expected. 

“Little Chick” (Johan) was great host and conservationist, the events and dancing were phenomenal.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience — Reserve Upgrade Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin. I am genuinely confused as to how this resort has received such glowing reviews, with “lackluster” being the most consistent theme throughout my stay.

Despite my room being ready, I waited nearly an hour in the Reserve lobby while the front desk agent assisted multiple other guests. The check in experience set the tone for what was to come. 

The Kanna / private members-only area is visually appealing, but unfortunately it highlights how underwhelming the rest of the property is by comparison. I paid $575 to upgrade to The Reserve, and upon arrival, seriously considered leaving altogether.

My first experience with a Reserve-only restaurant was shockingly bad. The host appeared visibly annoyed by my presence, and after being seated, no one approached me for an extended period of time. The food was genuinely inedible. I initially tried the buffet, couldn’t stomach anything, and then ordered from the menu hoping for improvement. It wasn’t. The salad was soggy and unappetizing, and the gazpacho was equally unpleasant.

The two Reserve-only pools were extremely secluded and had no bar service, which made the upgrade feel pointless. Ironically, the large adults-only pool with a swim-up bar was accessible without any Reserve upgrade and was far superior.

After exploring the property, I immediately returned to the Reserve lobby to ask about a refund and potentially changing resorts. While the hotel did agree to refund the Reserve upgrade, they refused to refund any portion of my stay. As a result, I downgraded my room and stayed for the remaining five nights.

I have previously stayed at a Meliá property in Mexico and had an excellent experience, which made the quality gap here especially surprising.

The rest of the resort is, at best, mediocre. Poor maintenance was obvious everywhere: bad paint jobs, cracked fixtures, aging infrastructure, and neglected landscaping. Most staff members appeared disengaged and unhappy, which unfortunately showed in the service. I tried three specialty restaurants, all of which were underwhelming. The food quality across the resort was a 4/10 at best. Ironically, the buffet offered the best food and service during my stay.

Housekeeping was inconsistent. My minibar was never refilled, and service often consisted of only making the bed and removing towels. The magnifying mirror in my room was falling out of the wall, and I walked past the same dead roach on the stairway for four consecutive days before it was finally removed.
Basic guest conveniences were also lacking. Obtaining small bills to tip staff was surprisingly difficult. At the sports bar, I ordered a gin martini twice and received a vodka martini both times. The walls in the rooms are extremely thin — I could clearly hear everything happening in the adjacent room.

I also visited the spa, which was another disappointment. The reception staff were unfriendly, and while I was required to prepay for my service upfront (which was fine), there was no option to tip the therapist. I booked the 80-minute signature wine massage, which sounded unique and indulgent, but it turned out to be nothing more than a basic Swedish massage. None of the advertised elements were incorporated.

That said, a few employees truly stood out and deserve recognition. Christopher, my concierge, was excellent and the highlight of my stay. Jimbert and Rosanna in the buffet were very warm and personable and consistently went out of their way to make breakfast enjoyable. Luis at the Ginger bar and Jonathan at the pool bar were also fantastic, as was every member of the bell staff I encountered.

Unfortunately, good employees cannot compensate for poor management, inconsistent service, subpar food, and a tired property. I would not return to this resort and would not recommend it to others. For the price and the promises made — particularly around the Reserve upgrade — this property falls well short.

reviews.author: Vicki P
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Intro
reviews.text: This was my first all inclusive resort visit and an excellent place to start. The grounds are mature, well maintained and can be fully navigated by foot. The white sand beach is stunning. Not much seaweed at all. The rooms are fully renovated and always clean. The staff provides above average service. I’m pretty sure I didn’t pay for a concierge but still had one. Lloelis was lovely. He helped me book day trips and reserve seating at restaurants. Because I travelled solo the price was high for a one week visit, but that’s common among all inclusives. I fully recommend Palma Real for travellers who wish to relax and who are not interested in partying and tons of activities.

reviews.author: Jay W
reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Breathtaking 50th Birthday at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
I returned to Paradisus in the Dominican Republic to celebrate my 50th birthday, and after seven years away, I can say it absolutely did not disappoint! From the moment I arrived, the front desk provided an immediate, warm welcome that set the tone for the entire stay.
The highlight of my trip was being paired with the most amazing concierge, Alam. He is truly exceptional. Alam has an incredible spirit and a way of making you feel like his absolute priority, even though he was managing several other guests. He ensured every single one of my needs was taken care of with genuine care.
Alam’s level of service "caused an uproar" in the best way possible—he truly made the experience memorable. Anyone lucky enough to be helped by him will be well taken care of.
The resort itself is beautiful and breathtaking. It was the perfect backdrop to commemorate my 50th birthday. I had a truly amazing time and I will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Harriscj9
reviews.title: Not an adults only resort
reviews.text:
This is not an adults only resort. Not at all actually. This resort cuts corners/blends and if you’ve ever been to the one in playa del Carmen Mexico, you will understand what I mean. That’s basically two separate resorts with two totally independent sides. 

This resort has no real distinctions between the adult and family “sides”. The adults only buffet (Malva) is closed during the day for breakfast and lunch so everyone eats at one location, “the lunch box”. Malva restaurant is only open at night and that’s because the resort restaurants are open so they count on most people and families eating at those instead of the buffet which is very limited as a result food wise. There’s also families there (Malva) at that time. So unless you’re in a reserve section, there are no adult only dining options. The restaurants for reservation are family restaurants as well. Adults and kids alike. The pools are also not adults only really. There’s one on one side but it’s so dead with no activities and kinda pointless to be at unless you just want to be in water. No poolside bungalows, in water pool beds or poolside entertainment/activities at that pool. Just a swim up bar and water. The main pool is basically adults and kids with most of the entertainment and activity catering to the kids and parents. 

The heart of the resort (main entry) is the same. This is where all the restaurants line up and where the sports bar (kicks bar) is. Again, another family area so much so that they even have face painting for the kids at night. 

There’s nothing wrong with a family resort but if you identify and select a resort as adults only, that’s what you expect. Not kids running around, screaming, crying and having to listen to their screen entertainment devices playing while you’re eating. But that’s not what you get here by far. 

The staff… there were a few shinning stars but in all, the staff is not very friendly as experienced at other resorts. Not horrible but not as warm and just bubbly and welcoming. 

The resort is also old. At least the side I stayed on was. It def needs revamping and reconfiguration. The main terrace furniture is kinda old and dated. Hard plastic with thin cushions I hate comparing this place to the playa del Carmen location but it’s night and day as far as luxury, accents and even upkeep. 

This is my 3rd time at this resort since 2010 and I definitely remember it differently. 

There’s a lot that can be improved on here. 

I will say that the buffet food is pretty good. 

Overall, I think there are other resorts for a cheaper price for what you get here. But go see for yourself.

reviews.author: lisarenee b
reviews.title: Personalized and pampered.
reviews.text: We had the most amazing time at the Palma Real. We had a personal concierge assigned to us, Zenovia. Not only did she make us feel welcome, but she made dinner reservations for us each night at a different restaurant, recommended and booked excursions (golf, yoga on the beach) and even a massage at the spa. We felt so taken care of and returned home feeling pampered and refreshed. Zenovia made us feel like family and we would seriously consider returning with friends.

reviews.author: Tonya A
reviews.title: Honeymoon and birthday bliss
reviews.text: Emmanuel was so engaging and sincere. He came highly recommended by my cousin and we are so happy we got to meet him. His consideration and thoughtfulness is unending. We will always recommend him!

reviews.author: D R
reviews.title: a solid 90%
reviews.text:
90 of of a 100. Great resort. Great food, especially in the reserve buffet.  Wonderful drinks all around.  Jendry was especially good. His help made my stay amazing. 
The only issue is their preferred car service. Paid for a solo trip, the driver arrived 3 hours early and said he could not come back later. Ridiculous. I paid for a private ride, not when you feel like it.

reviews.author: bruna a
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text:
Un hotel de lujo con un servicio excepcional. Desde el primer momento, todo fue perfecto: el ambiente, las instalaciones y, sobre todo, la atención del equipo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a Marc, Jendry y Fernando del equipo de animación por su simpatía y profesionalidad — ¡hacen que cada día sea especial!
Recomiendo 100% este hotel, una experiencia verdaderamente inolvidable.

reviews.author: Susan D
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: My Destination Concierge, Eriol, made my stay go so smoothly!! I felt very pampered!! Having the adult only option was very nice. The fresh fruits at breakfast and those sent to my room were amazing!!

reviews.author: Flor A
reviews.title: Best time ever!
reviews.text: Great customer service. Great food, great property! My concierge Christopher was the best. I will definitely be coming back to this resort, pretty soon! I came to the resort by myself, and they made me feel like family! Everyone was super friendly and respectful!

reviews.author: Stanley K
reviews.title: Amazing Resort for Adult Very Nice
reviews.text: Great resort, for adults perfect. Romula is amazing. thank you for making my trip fun The beach was great and the pool was extremely relaxing, everyone was very nice and helpful and I had a very nice and relaxing time. again, thank you Romula.. - Rozaliya

reviews.author: yerson130192
reviews.title: Mejorar
reviews.text: Identificar los empleados y que tengan una  Mejor presencia de empleados que sean  más agradables y empaticos

reviews.author: Jason P
reviews.title: Flora is great
reviews.text: The server, Ana Michel, at Flora was amazing. Very friendly, attentive, and helpful with the menu. The food was also the best at Flora. I would recommend others to make reservations here if they can. The ambience is earthy and tropical at the same time, along with a very soothing atmosphere with the music and lighting.

reviews.author: Maya663
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
Had an awful experience during my stayfrom Dec 27 2024 to Jan 2 /2025. 
I was awaken at about midnight by 2 security guard claiming that I had not pay for the room. They were absolutely rude and treated me poorly. 
The hotel failed to apologize and make this right. 
Very disappointed

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: We love the Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Great time. Extremely clean, upgrading to the reserve was well worth it. Friendly staff and great service all around!

Pools were well kept, food was decent, and the events were entertaining at night. All in all, highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: U B
reviews.title: DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text:
"DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!"

This is not a hotel – it’s a backstreet circus! If you value your money, peace of mind, and respect, do not even dare to book here. Staff act as if they’re paying you to stay and treat themselves like kings of the planet. Smiling? Forget it. Courtesy? Non-existent. You pay $500 per night, but what you get is rude, unprofessional behavior and an experience that feels more like a punishment than a vacation. You will feel like you are in prison, you are the prisoner and the staff are the prison guards

The rooms are small, outdated, and not worth the price at all. They assign you a so-called "concierge" who has absolutely no clue about anything. I asked the concierge to book me for the sauna, and he assured me it was done. When I arrived, there was no sauna booking, and no one had a clue about it.

The staff also went so far as to openly discuss my gender, questioning whether I was a man or a woman. This level of disrespect was appalling and incredibly offensive.

If you ever use the in-room phone to call for assistance, be prepared for an absolute nightmare. It takes a minimum of 30 minutes for someone to answer (if they even bother), and when they do, a man named Carlos will interrogate you like you’re a criminal and then hang up on you. Forget about reaching a manager—managers are completely unreachable, and the staff couldn’t care less about solving any issues. If something goes wrong, you’re completely on your own.

The front office and check-in staff stare at you with the most hostile, hateful expressions, like you’re their worst enemy. If you request to speak to a manager, they take you to a random computer room with no explanation. No one understands English, and no one cares to help or even try.

Stay far, far away from the following staff members: Gustavo, Richard Sanchez, Carolina Marchi, and Vicmar Simeoli. These individuals, along with the rest of the team, are the epitome of unprofessionalism and rudeness.

This place is a disgrace to the hospitality industry. I wouldn’t recommend it to my worst enemy. Save yourself the time, money, and frustration, and book anywhere else. This was, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience of my life.

reviews.author: isaenz2025
reviews.title: No está a la altura del resto de Paradisus
reviews.text: Una atención de clientes Platinum y The Reserve que no está a la altura de otros establecimientos que tienen en Mexico, por ejemplo. Viajando solo no se tiene el mimo y cuidado que requiere un viajero single y no se maximiza la experiencia para este público. El personal es simpático, pero no es exactamente lo que se espera de un servicio premium/de lujo para público europeo.

reviews.author: Mehdi K
reviews.title: Great experience at Palma real
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to DR and I absolutely loved it. Stayed at paradisus Palma real and I was blown away.

Amazing staff and team. Great resort.
My concierge Adriel was amazing. He made my trip exceptional by taking care of everything from reservation to booking transport and informing me of activities.

I really appreciated his proactive initiative.
I absolutely loved my stay and hope to visit soon again.

Cheers 

Mk

reviews.author: Tabi OYAJI
reviews.title: You are excelente, Basillo!  See you again soon!
reviews.text:
12月のはじめに行きました。プンタカーナは大型のオールインルシブ型のリゾートがどんどん建設中で、今後もいろんなところが進出してくると思われますが、そんな中で今回はParadisus Palma Realを選びました。ここはMelia系列のリゾートで、広い敷地に３つのMelia系列のリゾートがあります。空港から車で３０分弱で到着して、距離も近いので便利です。Paradisusはファミリー全般で滞在できるのですが、Reserveという地域は大人専用で、こちらは特に喧騒から離れてゆっくりしたい方にお薦めです。Reserveエリアを予約すると、特別のブレスレットが与えられ、担当のバトラーが付きます。このバトラーのBasilloさんは常に気を遣ってくれて、滞在中も頻繁に連絡をくれ、ニーズにこたえてくれました。レストランの予約もいち早くアドバイスをくれ、人気がある混雑しているレストランを抑えてくれたので、ディナーも大変楽しめました。彼には大変感謝です！
　またReserve Areaですと専用のレストラン、Santeにも入れますので、特に朝食時は混雑を避けられてゆっくりと楽しむことができました。泊まるなら是非、Reserveエリアをお薦めします。また３月に行ってきます！See you all Soon!

I went at the beginning of December. Punta Cana is currently seeing a surge in the construction of large-scale all-inclusive resorts, and it seems that more companies will be entering this space in the future. Among these, I chose Paradisus Palma Real for this trip. This is part of the Melia group of resorts, and there are three Melia-affiliated resorts within the expansive grounds.

It’s conveniently located just under 30 minutes by car from the airport. While Paradisus is suitable for families in general, the Reserve area is adults-only and is particularly recommended for those who want to relax away from the hustle and bustle. When you book in the Reserve area, you receive a special bracelet and are assigned a personal butler.

Our butler, Basillo, was incredibly attentive, staying in frequent contact with us throughout our stay and meeting all of our needs. He gave us great advice on restaurant reservations, securing spots at popular and busy restaurants, so we were able to fully enjoy our dinners. We are very grateful to him!

Additionally, by staying in the Reserve area, we had access to an exclusive restaurant, Sante, which allowed us to enjoy a relaxed and uncrowded breakfast. If you’re planning to stay here, I highly recommend booking the Reserve area.

I’ll be visiting again in March! See you all soon!

reviews.author: Jason C
reviews.title: Amazing Angela at Paradissus Palma
reviews.text:
Arrived Monday night. Checked in at front desk. Had a very smooth check in process with Angela. Special shout out to Angela who went above and beyond to take care of me. She made sure to check in everyday, stock the fridge, refresh supplies in the room and best of all check in with me and see if I'm OK. 

Gracias Angela you are amazing at your job! I can't wait to come back to Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Camila B
reviews.title: Experiencia en blue agave
reviews.text:
El servicio en el restaurante mexicano es muy bueno. Milton el mesero es muy amable y atento y estuvo pendiente de que tuviera la mejor cena en el restaurante. 
El servicio es ágil y la comida y las bebidas estuvieron muy bien. Volvería a reservar acá sin duda

reviews.author: Lynn B
reviews.title: My first visit to a Melia resort.
reviews.text:
I am sitting here in the Reserve lounge waiting in my ride to airport. The best thing about this resort was Harry, my butler. I would say one of the best I have ever had. I had many conversations with him. A true gentleman. 
The food is hit or miss. If you are used to Secrets etc you must book Reserve and eat at Sante or you will be disappointed.Some things I liked, some I didn’t . They need to watch food temps a bit more closely. Someone could get sick. I received excellent service from the restaurants , never a problem. The Reserve bar had great drinks. Jason shout out ., I think he spells it differently. He kept me in alcohol the whole stay! 
Gustavo at Samte was an excellent server! His really was attentive and knew how I like my coffee! The little things count. I did not receive any bad service from any of the people here. The only issues were other guests but I won’t get into that here. 
Yes, I would come back but Reserve is the way to go here.

reviews.author: Bryan P
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente servicio al cliente y excelente actitud de las personas que te atienden. Definitivamente es un lugar que tienes que visitar. La comida es espectacular, en cuanto al vino tienes mucha variedad y además cuentan con un menú de chef en donde podrás deleitarte de una comida diferente.

reviews.author: Darya B
reviews.title: Amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text: Excellent stay at Paradisus Palma Real - I loved every minute there!!! The hotel is beautiful, food is delicious, drinks are great and service is impeccable. Right on the beach, with several beautiful pools, and great entertainment, I could not have asked for a better getaway experience. Highly recommend it, and I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: melissa l
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
Great stay at Paradisus Palma Real- they take great care of the Circle members. I loved the swim up suite.  Juan Castillo is a wonderful concierge. My favorite restaurant was Santé, Brisas has the best gelato (try the leche flavor!), the mosquitoes are all over though- they came right for me.
Also, please use “STREAM2SEA” sunscreen or Zinc sunscreen - something reef safe!

reviews.author: Francisco Alber... m
reviews.title: Nice bar coffee
reviews.text: Gracias a todos los chicos del bar Ginger por las buenas atenciones . Mientras estuve aqui recibimos de los mejores café, estuvimos muy felices de las atenciones del grupo con el que estuvimos. El grupo da excelentes atenciones durante la estadía en el área

reviews.author: Francisco Salinas
reviews.title: Great experience and would visit again!
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. Very attentive staff to my requests.  Installations were in good condition. The restaurants had great options and the staff was very friendly. The golf course was partially under repair but overall it was a fun experience.

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real like visiting home!
reviews.text:
This was not my fisrt time at Paradisus Palma Real and this stay was just as wondeful as the others. I choose to stay in the adult only section called the Reserve. My personal conceige was Basilio and he was very nice, professional and kind! When I arrived he places a bottle of wine and fruit/cheese plate in my room, which was perfect after my travel day!  And when he found out this was my birthday trip, on my birthday he placed a bottle of champagne and birthday cake in my room and decorated the room with balloons! It was a wonderful surprise! And oh yes, I popped the champagne and ate the cake and both were delicious!😁
I would definitely recommend Basilio as a concierge!

The reserve has wondeful pools but I am a beach girl and they have the best beach beds (yes I said beds) of any resort in the DR I have been too so far. And I have been to 6 different resorts!  

Wanda is the bartender at the Reserve pool area and she is amazing! She is my favorite bartender on the resort, quick to service, fun and very nice! I consider her a freind!

All the restaurants are great, the beach is one of my favorites in the DR and the resort is easy to navigate! It is one of my favorite resorts thus far!
Happy traveling!😁

reviews.author: AMR
reviews.title: Stay elsewhere.
reviews.text: I chose this hotel as part of The Hotel Collection with AMEX. Upon arrival service was good though a bit on a shaky start since they could not find my reservation and had me waiting out front with the bellhops which was awkward. Front desk was nice but I was put off by the fact that they offered me a paying upgrade, but when I pointed to the fact that the Program offered said upgrade in a complementary fashion... mysteriously the upgrade then offered was suddenly "not available". Fine. Hotel grounds are beautiful and well kept. Servers are attentive and cheery. Sadly, my stay began to fall short as my dinner reservation at Mina was a disaster. I arrived 10 minutes before as suggested, but ended up gettin to my table about half an hour after scheduled. My dinner took 52 minutes to get to my table: burnt steak and cold potatoes. My guess is they were otherwise engaged with the 10-guy table next to me. Somehow they were timely served. Anyways, thanks to Stephanie who seemed to be the only manager who cared. She was attentive and caring. Dinner at Blue Agave was wonderful, best experience there. Also, I was madre to wait about 35 minutes at Yhi Spa because they were doubtful of recognizing the resort credit that comes with the AMEX program. They finally did and my service was great. Honestly AMEX should revise how hotels are trained about the program because its very annoying to have to be explaining this to them, and they get annoyed if you wish to use your benefits which I find ridiculous. If not for the AMEX program I would have probably not stayed there in the first place. Trip was ended on a bad note as I found a roach, yes a roach in my room (see picture). I discretely expressed my concern to the night manager and he was extremely dismissive, as if nothing happened. He even made jokes as to how big the roach was, since I took a picture with my phone to show him. In sum, for a hotel this pricey I expected a better stay. Will not return. If you want a short answer: stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: A8188YWjessicac
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Estuve en el restaurante Mascalzone y todo fue una delicia, el servicio de Ridel, Celia y Milton fue excelente,súper serviciales y siempre atentos a mis necesidades, luego llegó el chef a preguntar si me había gustado el platillo o su tenía alguna sugerencia

reviews.author: SweTee
reviews.title: Some little niggles but overall pretty fabulous!
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at other Melia hotels before so Paradisus was next on the list. It’s another  quite a big hotel so the check in / lobby was large but not much of a queue luckily. A few hiccups along the way of my stay, hence 4 stars.

 The room I had was in building 20 and was a basic garden view. I was pleasantly surprised, it was certainly spacious enough and near the many pools and beach, big bonus for me. The slight disappointment was you could hear the neighbours talking next door as it was an adjoining room (door separating). I also had two cockroaches visiting in the evening of my first night but housekeeping came with spray and sorted it out. No site of the roaches since, thankfully. My bracelet key card didn’t work either when I first arrived so I had to return to the lobby but as it was 2 mins walk it wasn’t a big deal. It’s a stunning looking property and you can take some amazing pictures around the grounds. No one really explained how the beach towels worked etc so other than the ones in the room it took me a while to figure out that staff place some out on chairs but I’m still not sure where to ask for them! The map provided of the hotel grounds has super small text so not easy to read so I took a picture of it to be able to make things bigger and I don’t even have bad eyesight! 

I’ve seen a lot of complaints about the food from others. The only absolutely horrific food I had was at the Mediterranean a la carte. It looked like prison food, uncleaned prawns and rice with no seasoning. I actually left to go to the buffet. Buffet is hit and miss as they undercook the potatoes so they were hard to get time I tried and the bacon in the morning wasn’t crispy cooked on all occasions. Other than that, I always found something to eat and I liked the teppanyaki and Mexican.  Sometimes the hardworking waiting staff struggle for keep up on cleaning tables at busy lunch hour and evening hour at the buffet but there’s a lot of people here! Quite a few areas to sit around and have a drink, nice rocking chairs, sports bar, wine shop, upstairs by the lobby, main courtyard area etc. Didn’t catch much of the entertainment or activities as I did my own thing off the resort a few nights and day trips. 

There’s always free beach and pool loungers and it doesn’t fill up with towels laid out by 7.30am as at other hotels I’ve been (at least when I stayed). The pools are plentiful and both adult only or kids / families so if your avoiding kids then choose wisely. I also went to the spa - super stunning with little huts and obligatory Buddhas placed around. Massage was amazing (thank you Yeimi). A tad bit pricy compared to London where I’m from, but DR is not cheap for anything, really. Worth it though! I also went to the gym several times and it has some decent machines and free weights (I’m not a cardio bunny!). It was always quite hot so the aircon could be turned up in my view. Not busy around 6.30-8am when I went, mostly the same 3-4 faces. 

The final niggle was that I extended my room check out time, of course the key card bracelet didn’t work to get in to the room when I tried. I had to queue up at reception with 20 mins to spare of my extended time. Again, not a biggie to deal with but not 5 star. 

I would come back here again, i enjoyed my experience. As a European with a healthy dose of realistic expectations of service (we are way behind Americans in that space) it was pretty fabulous all things considered. Maybe I will go for a room with pool next time though!

reviews.author: Manuel Emil T
reviews.title: Ese calor humano que te hace sentir como en un sueño, tanta gente hermosa y amable desde que pisa las instalaciones.
reviews.text: Excelente muy buenas atenciones en especial al hacer el check up, un recibimiento caluroso y amable. Gracias mil,  Katherine lantigua  eres super sigues así Dios te bendiga. También debo decir que las habitaciones son sumamente cómodas amplias y muy limpias.

reviews.author: jcolestoapple
reviews.title: A wonderful resort to escape to!
reviews.text:
I had a very enjoyable stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. My stay was in early March and I opted in for the Reserve, Adults Only package. The biggest perk of this package was staying in a building/room much closer to the beach. 

Overall, the grounds are spacious and extremely well-maintained. This includes the beachfront which arguably has the cleanest/best patch of beach to any of the neighboring resorts. This is due in part to the incredible staff who are as professional as they are attentive. A big shoutout to my concierge, Osvaldo. He made my stay the best it could be, and elevated the experience through his responsiveness and help with whatever question I had! 

The drinks were great, and the bar staff in the Reserve areas were friendly and attentive all day long. The restaurant selections are plentiful, and are enjoyable but not otherworldly. The spaciousness of the common areas are inviting to a lot of patrons, but never did it feel overwhelming busy.

Overall it was a satisfying stay and enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Angelina_Serra
reviews.title: DONT book with this hotel.
reviews.text: Summary: DONT book with this hotel. Don't be with Expedia. Major dissapointments Nothing of my reservation was honored. When I arrived my room was not ready. I had to wait 40 min. Poor customer service. They didn't give me the VIP promised pass. They also added terms to the $100 credit that was promised with the spa which were not there during booking.  No elevator. General poor customer service given the very price tag. They promised sparkling wine which never arrived. Take your business elsewhere, LEAVE EXPEDIA.

reviews.author: Hope I
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful trip! The drinks were good, the bed was comfortable, the hotel was very clean. We had a great experience with the help of our butler Fernando. Fernando went above and beyond to give us a wonderful vacation. After a surprising proposal from my now fiancé, Fernando went all out decorating our room! Bartenders Victor and Luis are phenomenal at their job!! The best drinks and such fun guys! Jesus was delivering us drinks while we were hanging by the pool and on the beach and he was so great always checking if we needed something. The ginger bar is such a cool hangout spot. Lots of good entertainment! Kelvin at the steak restaurant was a wonderful waiter and was so quick to getting us anything we needed! The Italian restaurant was my favorite, the shrimp basil pasta was incredible! The buffets for breakfast and lunch did have tons of options, but the food was cold a lot of the time and quality not the greatest. The beach was not crowded at all and the ocean water felt wonderful! The gentlemen that were working in the towel area by the pool we so fun and spunky. They were always having a great time with the guests! The pool was a bit chilly, but after jumping in it didn’t take long to get used to. It was a nice, relaxing trip! Cant wait to return!!

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.title: 10/10 experience, people, food, service. RECOMMEND
reviews.text: Wonderful experience, beautiful resort and even better Service. Rosanna, yougeis and Fanny are great. All of the employees are absolutely amazing. The food is delicious. I do not have a single negative thing to say. I never go same place twice but definitely coming back to this resort.

reviews.author: Chelsea P
reviews.title: It just depends on what type of traveler you are
reviews.text:
Overall: 3.75 Stars. Best suited for age 55+ and desire peace & quiet over fun. I’ve stayed at many resorts in the Caribbean and this was the most beautiful. You’ll feel like a Kardashian as soon as you enter. However, the low quality, limited variety, and poor taste of food will probably keep me from returning. If the food was good, this would truly be a [third- world country standards] five star resort, in my opinion. 

In Depth Review: I’m a 47 year old black American female traveling solo for 5 nights without hubby. I’ve traveled the world on a shoestring budget, lived in South America for 7 years,  and currently live in a major metropolitan city on the east coast. I’ve stayed in huts in the jungle with flying bats and roaches and I’ve stayed in some pretty swanky joints. So I’d like to say my review is pretty trustworthy. However, reviews must be taken with a grain of salt because they are simply opinions. You’ll have to form your own, but below was my experience. TIP: Spanish speakers, like myself, will have a better experience due to the language barrier.

Arrival: 2 Stars. Resort is a quick 20 minutes or so from PUJ. Nobody helped me unload or carry bags to front desk and acted like it was a chore to walk me to the check-in desk. No welcome drink or extra fanfare but at least I had no wait and the whole process took about 10 minutes. The desk girl was nice and even upgraded my room. I was given a bracelet but it wasn’t explained that it doubled as an electronic room key. I was given a map of the property and basically a “good luck finding your room and everything on your own” since nobody offered to help me any further. I had to ask directions from another worker. He pointed, but didn’t offer any other help. I was starving from a long day of travel but nobody told me where I could eat. I wandered around tired, hungry, and feeling unwelcome. TIP: Request to be personally taken to your room. Anything else is unacceptable.

Room: 5 stars. I will be upfront and say I did need to open windows and air out the harsh bleach and cleaning chemicals. But the room was spotless, spacious, and posh. I even had a private patio with my own Bali bed. I  was truly impressed with all the little details that make this a fancy place. No need to call the front desk if you forget your toothbrush. All toiletries are included, even toothpaste. TIP: Leaving sliding door open turns off your AC and lets in mosquitos! Also there is a red or green button by your door to push if you desire privacy or cleaning. 

Food: 1 star. Due to low capacity, the main dinner buffet was closed and we were forced to either have a restaurant reservation (also not explained to me and not all were open) or dine in a tiny makeshift buffet area called Malva. Hot foods were lukewarm (I never saw heat lamps) and cold items were not kept on ice at all. Breakfast and lunch were just as gross. I’m talking gray asparagus, chicken put in a blender and called “shredded”, and an Inedible omelette that tasted like Fabuloso. It left my tongue slimy and I got an instant headache, which leads me to believe they are washing their pots and pans in non food-safe chemicals. The restaurants I tried were just as terrible, but friendly service. TIP: If you ask for a paper plate from the hostess you can take your buffet items to the beach/pool. Otherwise, no food is served on the beach or poolside, which was sad. 

Drinks: 4 stars. At one beach bar I was told that technically they weren’t supposed to serve me because I had a green bracelet. Another thing not explained to me. But they were nice and served me a piña colada anyway. It was poured from a bottle mix and I ended up throwing it away. Hands down the best bar is Ginger Bar in the lobby. That’s where all the cool kids hang out and the drinks were strongest. TIP: Mixed drinks will give your tummy syrup rot but stronger cocktails or simple drinks are amazing. Try a refreshing Basil Smash!

Entertainment: 5 stars if you’re part of the older crowd and like to be in bed by 10pm. Amazing singers/musical performances, but not much else. I absolutely loved it and enjoyed getting a quiet restful sleep since the shows end early. TIP: Get your seat for the show early as they fill quickly. 

Beach: 5 stars. I was there in early February, so there was no seaweed to muck through. Clear waters with small waves and miles of beach to walk. Weather was perfect! Drink service was far and few between but Vanessa was a sweetheart. TIP: Bring your good attitude and realize you will be asked to buy something from hawkers frequently. But remember they make like $5 a day and you’re staying in a 5 star resort. Don’t be a jerk, Karen. 

Pools: 5 stars. Sparkling, clean, and not overpowering with bleach odor. However, the color of your bracelet will determine which pools you can swim in. I never had an issue getting a chair; no need to wake up early and reserve it. TIP: You can purchase towel clips at the gift shop to prevent your towel from blowing off your chair into Neverland.  

Staff: Extremely hard working. Yes, they are hoping for a tip, but don’t act like it’s required. TIP: Remember, you’re visiting a different culture. What might seem rude or apathetic to you is really just their shy and quiet nature to some extent. Dominicans don’t try to be best friends with strangers like Americans sometimes do. You have to earn their trust and respect their country first and foremost. Speaking Spanish will get you preferential treatment, but that’s at any resort in DR. 

THE GOOD: Pure relaxation and great sleep!

THE BAD: The food is disgusting!

THE UGLY: If your skin is darker than a paper bag be prepared for horrific racism. I had to discuss this with management when a security guard tried to get me thrown out. Vicmar truly seem to care and said he would launch an “investigation”, but nothing was ever done, and I wasn’t notified of the outcome nor offered even a free massage to compensate for my humiliation.

reviews.author: Pierre R
reviews.title: A place to go to!
reviews.text:
This place is a goto!
Nice food
nice drink, specially at the ginger bar in the main lobby

the room are very big
many chair at the beach and at the pools
