reviews.author: Mary Anne G
reviews.title: Another fabulous week in Paradise
reviews.text:
Just returned from our 14th stay at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. Our visits are obviously always memorable because we keep returning...and this time was no exception. Our friends, Maria Ester & Leida, make beach massages a MUST. In fact, we had 3 this week. This is an experience that stays with you long after you return home. (I miss you already, Maria!)

The pros that take care of us on the beach are THE BEST!  Ramon Ramirez, Jose Luis de los Santos, Maiker Ramirez, Benita Mercedes, Santos Frias, Jairo Minier, & Luis Santana make a great team to see that each person is set up with towels, drinks & a good atmosphere to enjoy the best beach in the world. The piña coladas have been upgraded & are the best!  There is a new tiki bar in The Reserve beach area where things are very festive & lively with some informal dance lessons & 2 very nice bathrooms.  Also the wifi works better on the beach than it used to. 

Upon checkout, Yorandy was extremely courteous & printed our boarding passes for us. Eddy Wilson went over & beyond for us when our shuttle didn't show up on time. He made several calls until a private coach arrived & we made our flight with some time to spare. Thanks again, Eddy. 

Besides our favorites mentioned here, everyone is very polite & professional at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana. We can't wait to go back to our see our "other family" again soon.

reviews.author: GRANNYDENISE V
reviews.title: AGAIN FASCINATED!
reviews.text: Na een grandioos ontbijt begroet "Towel" meisje Pamela je steeds met de glimlach Buenos dias Como estas! Shaky Shaky dé TOPANIMATOR sport dans vermaak steeds met de grote "smile" voor jong en oud, een topper van formaat! Caramelo , Angel en Snoopy doen ook alles om van je verlof een feest te maken.;'s avonds wordt je steeds opgewacht door Yubelkis ,, zij zorgt met haar dansteam telkens voor een toffe avond. Een sterdanser van niveau is zeker Leo, in één woord "klasse".

reviews.author: 261brettf
reviews.title: 2nd Visit and Loved it Even More the 2nd Time
reviews.text:
I had a great stay in January, returning after I stayed 2 years ago for a friends wedding.

This time, I upgraded to the 'Royal Service' and took a room on the beach which was amazing... More modern than the Reserve rooms, closer to the beach, and there is a private pool / bar / concierge lounge with top shelf alcohol in a very upscale setting.

Hector my butler was also very friendly and attentive.. He helped make the trip truly memorable and even arranging a super fun dune buggy trip that was a highlight of my trip.  The resort was also not too crowded this time of year, and the beaches are some of the nicest in the world! 

Definitely recommend, and recommend the beach front rooms (*some have jacuzzis) and they are cleaner / newer..  Some of the Reserve rooms are older and so I'd recommend the newer rooms by the beach per above although they don't have the in-room tubs.

The resort is very large, and there are many restaurants and it's just fun to explore all the different pools and pathways. They have golf carts to shuttle people around to wherever you want to be. One of my favorite destinations.

reviews.author: MzLadiie
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Previously I stayed at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana, that was nice. But this was much better. I went with Royal Service and it was more than I expected. I was treating myself for my birthday. My butler Fermin Mato was beyond accommodating. I am not a demanding person and did not want to run him, but he was eager to be of assistance for whatever I may have needed. There was a guy named Angel on the beach who always had a beach bed ready for me in the shade every morning. 

The Pallazo restaurant for Royal service provided great service and decent food. I tried a different restaurant every night. My last night I broke down and tried Passion for dinner. This restaurant cost $70, but it was a wonderful experience. I went with the tasting menu and was pleasantly surprised. The level of service they offer at Passion is off the charts spectacular. 

The only thing I did not like was that I was given coupons for different services, but did not use any. Reason being is that they have a minimum spending that is noted anywhere in the literature provided.

All in all a great trip and I plan on returning.

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Almost Paradse
reviews.text: Great layout, great scenery, great service, great beach, good food and good golf. If you can afford it, go for it. You will not be disappointed. If you have a disability, make it known. There are more stairs than elevators. Anyway you look at it, it is almost paradise.

reviews.author: Jen C
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
We were celebrating a friends birthday in December. The room was spacious enough for 3 adults. The first few days the room was cleaned rather late but after we requested It be cleaned earlier the resort immediately changed the cleaning schedule.
We celebrated the birthday by having dinner at Passion. It was unforgettable, everything was so delicious. Even though we paid extra for the meal it was well worth it. In N.Y we would have paid hundreds more. The food at Naos (buffet) was very good. Although there was prepared food, It wasn't sitting there for long. There were chefs at each station replenishing the supply. The meat, fish and pasta dishes were made to order. 

The staff  was very attentive, and very friendly. Caesar the captain at Passion also supervised staff at Naos the buffet and he would always come over to say hello to us. We received excellent service from Naos staff Johnny, Francisco, Junior and Victor. Everyone was so friendly and helpful that when we asked the ingredients of their local dish they went out of their way to go into the kitchen to get the root potatoes and yams so we see what they look like.
The entertainment was fabulous. The live shows were fantastic and the entertainment team " Live and Rich in entertainment" were the best. Shaky Shaky, Carmelo, Angel, Yudy, Agrippina, Snoopy, Carlos and Boom Boom kept us busy from morning to late afternoon. Morning was stretching, volley ball then water aerobics or water spinning. At 4 pm it was Zumba then merenge lessons. The only negative, these classes were too short. After the evening show we hung out at Gabi beach where the entertainment team was present to keep the party going.
The other negative the restaurants were not as good as my last stay. Naos made up for it. After the shows I would pop in to grab a cup of coffee and dessert. The worst was the sushi restaurant stay away from it.

reviews.author: Kate B
reviews.title: Потрясающе
reviews.text:
Это не первый мой отдых в Доминикане и есть с чем сравнить. Пока нахожусь в отеле - напишу свой отзыв. Отель конечно роскошный и премиум. 
Начну наверное по порядку:
1. территория огромная,  при этом удобная и интуитивно понятная, красивая и очень зеленая. Отель находится на территории Paradisus Punta Cana, но имеет свой ресепшн, бассейн, рестораны, бары, пляж. Так как это повышенная категория проживания, пользоваться бесплатно можно абсолютно всей инфраструктурой, кроме Роял клаб (ресторан и пляж). 
2. Номера большие и очень большие). Вначале приобрела стандартный люкс, но потом поменяла за доплату на огромный главный люкс. По сути обе категории номеров одинаково хорошие, но отличаются планировкой (в стандартном спальня расположена отдельной комнатой и лично мне там не хватало света) и размером. Главный конечно роскошен с огромным джакузи!  Сами номера расположены в отдалении от моря, но по территории постоянно курсируют машинки и вас довезут куда скажете. Лично мне было приятно прогуляться 5 минут до моря.
3. Сервис на высоком уровне. Есть русскоговорящий менеджер Виолетта (спасибо ей огромное!!), но и все остальные сотрудники искренне пытаются максимально помочь и сделать отдых незабываемым (я много путешествую, всегда выбираю высокую категорию отелей и с уверенностью это утверждаю). WiFi бесплатный, на неограниченное количество устройств, ловит на территории всего отеля, скорость отличная (качала фильмы спокойно).
4. Питание - вкусно, правда. Мне больше всего понравился габи клаб ресторан, там в основном и ем. Меню не огромное, но как минимум 2-3 вида рыбы, мяса всегда есть, при этом не приходится набирать полную тарелку, а потом из этого выбирать съедобное - вкусно все, серьезно (хотя я нереально привередлива). Наверное показательно, что в первый мой завтрак я увидела черную икру. Мидии, тунец, креветки и тд - есть всегда. Помимо этого в бесплатный сервис включена доставка в номер (заказывала лосось гриль, вкусно!). Бары отличные, коктейли делают вкусные.
5. пляж чистый (хотя с погодой в первые дни не повезло, были дожди и сильные волны), водорослей нет. Лежаки-кровати ну нереально удобные, места всегда есть. Бассейны тоже достойные.

В общем, можно много говорить, но я резюмирую "Это рай!". Еще не уехав из Доминиканы, уже планирую следующую поездку. А ведь после прошлогоднего посещения, совершенно не хотела возвращаться)

reviews.author: Irene C
reviews.title: Ano novo em Punta Cana
reviews.text:
Hotel especial. Ambiente agradável animado pelos queridos Josias inirio (obama). Noel. Happy face
Todos os atendentes são simpáticos.
Paisagem espetacular. Acomodações incríveis. Esperando a entrada do ano em grande estilo. 
Experiência única!

reviews.author: Jermaine G
reviews.title: Recent stay at Royal Service
reviews.text:
My most recent stay (December 2015) was my second consecutive year to visit Royal Service at Paradisus Palm Real Gold & Spa Resort.  The environment is completely relaxing and the service is remarkable.  My stay was 4 nights in an ocean front room (the same room I stayed in last year, as requested).  The room was not brand new, but was very well-maintained with large king bed, nice linens, bath robes/slippers and awesome beach/ocean views.  It also had all of the usual amenities one would expect to find in a nicer hotel/resort.  Room service was prompt and very friendly.  The Royal Service offers a Butler service that makes the experience seem even more luxurious.  Samuel (Sammy) attended to my every need, from making my dinner reservations each night to planning time on the resort's tennis courts with one of the tennis pros to reserving time in the beautiful Yhi Spa.  He would also leave various treats and surprises in my room that would await me after a relaxing day on the beach.  Even though this resort is very nice and ALL staff members are extremely accommodating, it was the butler service by Samuel that made me want to go back time and time again.  I hope they are ready to see me for a third consecutive December!!!!

I will comment also on my butler service from the previous year since I failed to write a review last year.  Joelvi (hope i spelled his name correctly) was just as amazing last year as Samuel was this year.  These gentlemen went beyond their level of training to make me feel as though I was their only priority, even though they had other guests and responsibilities. 

The thing I liked least was the presence of solicitors on the beach.  Although they were not allowed on the resort property, they would stand along the shoreline and wait for people to ask them to shop at the various beach shops where they worked.  At times, it was a bit too much.  

Overall, this is a resort that I would visit time and time again without hesitation.  I can't wait until next December!!!!!

reviews.author: GRANNY-Denise
reviews.title: FANTASTISCH
reviews.text:
Prachtig resort mooie tuinen;maar vooral de animatie is enorm en vooral te danken aan Boom Boom en Big Mac topanimatoren en vooral TOP dansers Angel is een uniek schilder. De buffetten zijn heel gevarieerd en de vele restaurants een "must"

GRANNY!

reviews.author: Deanna M
reviews.title: Already planning to return!
reviews.text: I booked a four-day stay at the Paradisus Palma Real the first week in December and it was THE most peaceful and relaxing vacation I've ever had. PROS: 1) The resort is absolutely beautiful and the beach is gorgeous. 2) If you want to take your experience to the next level, you MUST book the Royal Service. My Royal Service concierge, Jose Salvador, took my experience from good to great! I work in a business where we consistently emphasize that great customer service is about anticipating customers' needs before they even think to ask, and Jose did just that throughout my entire stay. When I checked into the resort, as part of the Royal Service, I was provided with a phone to contact Jose whenever I needed assistance, and if I didn't call Jose, he checked in each day and made suggestions about services he could provide or activities I could participate in. I decided to use the jacuzzi tub one night, but unfortunately the drain didn't work. When I mentioned this to Jose, he not only had the drain fixed, but when I walked into my room that night, the jacuzzi bath was prepared complete with rose petals and candles! This is only one of many examples of Jose anticipating my needs and going above and beyond. GENERAL ADVICE: 1) I paid extra for the Garden View Suite, but in my opinion the extra money isn't worth the mediocre view. Unless you decide to book an Ocean View Suite, book a standard room and save some money. 2) The best rooms in the resort are the newly renovated family concierge rooms, but unfortunately, as a solo traveler I wasn't given the option to book this room. These rooms should be offered to everyone. CONS/ISSUES: 1) My room was clean; however, it had a consistenly damp, moldy smell -- a bit annoying but not a deal breaker. 2) I mistakenly thought that the ATM service fee was $195 U.S. dollars -- turns out the actual fee was 195 pesos -- silly mistake! I mentioned this exhorbitant fee to TWO different employees at the currency exchange desk, but not one person listened to me carefully enough to confirm that the fee was in pesos so I decided to forego several services because I didn't have enough cash for tips. This is a mistake that I can see other Americans making so it would make sense to train the currency exchange employees to be aware that this question/issue may come up. Fortunately, my conciege, Jose, saved the day by doing the research and letting me know that the fee was in pesos so I was at least able to get cash to pay for my taxi ride back to the airport. 3) Twice, I got the distinct impression that waiters at Naos and Blue Agave were annoyed when I sat in certain areas (I even got an eye roll). It finally dawned on me that they preferred to seat me at specific tables since I was a solo traveler, but to show irritation towards me was a real turnoff . OVERALL: The Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort that's perfect for fun-filled family vacations, romantic couple getaways, or low-key solo respites. I'll definitley be back next year.

reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: Nueva visita a "mi casa"
reviews.text: Hola a todos, regresé nuevamente a "mi casa" jaja. Los maleteros y En la recepción de socios Melia me dicen "bienvenido a su casa" jajaja, ya perdí la cuenta de las veces que visité el hotel. Como siempre excelente la atención, las instalaciones, los restaurantes, aunque no estaban todos abiertos todos los días por estar en baja temporada, la comida como siempre excelente, Agradeciendo especialmente a Franklin de la Rosa ( Restaurant Oleo), la habitación muy buena ! También mantienen en un excelente nivel el wifi e internet, No tuve que pedir nada ni hacer ningún tipo de reclamo. Mi mayordomo Gabiel Dalusma  se esmero para que no me faltara nada No quiero ni conocer otro hotel en Punta Cana, ya que este lugar es un paraiso en la tierra !!! Mi sincero agradecimiento a todo el personal del hotel, especialmente a los Sras. Yesenia Farias (Barman) y Wendy Tavarez ( Yhi Spa)

reviews.author: Rebecca P
reviews.title: Beyond Amazing Staff
reviews.text: I planned a week long vacation from Oct. 21-27, 2015.  I selected the Royal Service.  The staff were EXCELLENT.  Francisco Cabrera and Angel Frias were very attentive, always up beat and smiling.  I never had to ask for anything; they always had my bed or bungalow ready and waiting and I either had a fresh water or fresh drink in hand at all times.  It was a pleasure to be around two exceptionally professional, yet positive and happy gentlemen all day for a week.  My Butler, Nicolas Marcallo was also excellent.  He always had a smile and was always honest when I asked about things I didn't quite understand.  I'm big on integrity.  Nicolas had my dinner reservations made every night and baths drawn in the evening.  I felt very pampered and well taken care of.  I would definately recommend staying at this resort and getting the Royal Service.  I will definately be back.  Thank you to all the staff behind the scenes as well.  Although I didn't have the opportunity to meet you, you do an excellent job of keeping the landscape nice and the property clean.  Job well done.

reviews.author: Vania L
reviews.title: Best hotel around!
reviews.text: Coming second right after Royalton Hicacos in Varadero, this is the best hotel in the Caribbean I've stayed at. I loved everything about it: from the service to the food, the staff and the room. Everything was excellent. You can choose between these three places by Melia and they are all awesome, but this one is the best. Make sure to book with a travel agent, since the prices online are extremely high.

reviews.author: Celeste P
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia!
reviews.text:
Personal muyy amable, muy buenas personas, excelentes especialmente  josias inirio(obama)y daniel ! me gusta mucho la interaccion del personal con los huespedes.
Muy buen ambiente en los shows, buena comida! Excelente lugar para pasar las vacaciones! Sin duda regresare.

reviews.author: shayshay825
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: So far, this property is the best location that I visited in DR (approx. 6). It has the upscale, modernized look and feel that I prefer to have when I'm spending my hard earned cash to travel. There's one buffet area which is the best I've ever seen for an all-inclusive property there are lots of options. Although, it one location it was never overcrowded and did not lack service. You have to make reservations for a la carte by 9am. The pool area lacks a lot of shade but there are several huts on the beach which is steps away from the pool. The gym, the beach and hotel are very clean.

reviews.author: Ncstevie
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
I had a lovely 7 night stay in The Reserve. My room was spacious, clean and very comfortable. I really liked the modern/Asian type  decor. Checkin made me feel like a queen upon arriving. I was personally guided through the offerings of my all inclusive status as a guest in The Reserve, provided refreshments (which were much appreciated after a long journey and into scorching hot weather.)  my sister and her family were to be staying at the resort too but were delayed. My checking person, Rosemery, kindly offered to move me to the same building as my sister and her family, which I gladly accepted. 

My first buffet lunch I met Luis and was introduced to other wait staff who took great care of me by myself. They proceeded to greet me each time they saw me and made me feel right at home. 

My sisters concierge, Sophia, was amazing. Family concierge is the way to go if you want to be super pampered. Sophia took care of making all reservations, booking a snorkel trip, spa services, seeking us out each day to remind us of the entertainment at night, and even provided special treats for my sister and her kids: chocolate covered strawberries and/or wine in the room after returning from the pool, making up a Bubble bath with balloons for the kids, and bottles of bread crumbs as fish food for their snorkeling adventure. Any concerns or questions, Sophia was there to take care of it. But above and beyond that, the staff at the desk in our building lobby were always happy to help you if needed. 

Part of family concierge as being able to book a daily cabana by the beach or pool. We chose the beach the first day. Santos was our beach service contact who greeted us warmly and bright towels to our reserved cabana with luxurious beds, enough for each of us ( including me even though I wasn't family concierge level!). Santos was very attentive, kindly offering to bring drinks on a regular basis, which was great in the hot weather.   We found the ocean to have a LOT of seaweed, which we could see was trying to be managed, but it was still an issue for most of us except those who were happy boogie boarding (with boards we borrowed from the recreation center after paying a deposit). 

We ended up booking a cabana by the pool the rest of the week, as we discovered beach cabanas were easier to come by. Again, the cabanas were super comfortable and the wait staff were phenomenal. Anthony offered great entertainment and service and the poolside wait staff was amazing!

reviews.author: Sam A
reviews.text: Доминикана!!!  Белые пески тёплое море!!! Позитив от увиденного просто распирает!!!  Улыбка тут ни сходит с лица ни когда!!! Отель шикарный питание напитки фрукты и бассейны!!! Номера чистые ухоженные!!! В общем райский уголок!!!

reviews.author: Wilo936
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real with Faustino Ramos "The only way to go"
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palmas Real Resort is a beautiful location to visit. The resort is full of employees who want to make your stay special, not because it's their job, but they truly feel you deserve it. 
"The only way to Go" is via "the Royal Service," and their is no one better than Faustino Ramos to help you live that amazing dream. He was our personal butler who made sure that our every moment at the resort was one to remember. I went on this trip reluctantly because we already had been away on 3 other trips this year. I was done for the year. Boy was I wrong!!! and I jokingly say, "That was Faustino's fault. My wife and I loved the experience so much, we became members, and are now working in time to return to the Paradisus. (Thanks to Faustino) LOL. We are planning to renew our vows at this location next year, and will insist that we have the man, Faustino. So do yourself a favor, visit this resort (Royal service), and make sure Fausitno is available to take your vacation experience to the next level.  William and Carol Lopez

reviews.author: Jenjenkay
reviews.title: One of the best all inclusives I've been to!
reviews.text:
Pros: location is only 15-20 minutes away from the airport making it very convenient. Nice long stretches of beach area. Massive pool area. Extremely fun evening events and bars on site. All inclusive drinks & food. Daily activities. They had 2 gyms at the resort but one of the gyms i went to had equipment that looked a little worn down. Butler Service [if you were in the Royal Service wing]. Food was SURPRISINGLY good. When I go to all inclusives, i'm normally prepping myself for really awful food. Not in this case - the breakfast buffet rivaled some Las Vegas buffets! 

Cons: There's not a lot of cons to this resort. While well maintained, there were some parts of the hotel that looked a little worn. I was able to hear outside noise but I was so tired by the end of the day that it didn't really matter. 

Tips: Make sure you opt for the Royal Service. It made all the difference in the world. My butler was awesome and amazing...he didn't see me all day so was worried about me [the only person in the world who was concerned about my safety and well being that day] and had drawn me a bath with flower petals in it. It was absolutely perfect. You get to eat at a RS only restaurant which is quiet and relaxing.

reviews.author: brendonm73
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Had a great time here. A lot of activities to do. Only bad thing was the food. Not that it wasn't good, but everyone that i traveled with spent 1 of the 7 days we were there in the room because of diarrhea. (Excuse my choice of words)

reviews.author: Noodles_travel
reviews.title: Best birthday trip
reviews.text: This place is so beautiful it looks like a post card. I was treated like VIP. You must get royal service. Everyone was so friendly. The pools and hotel is beautiful. The food was great. There was seaweed on the beach, but daily they tired to clean it up. My butler was so great and very attentive. Make sure to ask for Yohelvis if you get Royal Service. The lobby bar I would say is the best bar there. Had great signature drinks like "watermelon crush" and the bartenders are friendly and make great drinks. Just the best trip.

reviews.author: Carmennelly
reviews.text:
This is my second time at this hotel and my first time experience with Royal Services.  I got one bedroom master suite that was fantastic. It was huge and clean. Very quiet. Housekeeping was great not only for the bedroom but for all the facility that was great! the landscaping was so well done and care that it was impossible to believe how well conserved it was even that there is lack of rain.
Regarding the restaurants, we were able to get reservations at every restaurant thanks for the steward  provided by the Royal Services, "Agneris".  A young guy that was always looking to satisfy our needs. Thank Agneris for all you did for us.
We enjoyed every meal. Ate at the restaurants at night and the buffets for lunch.  Breakfast was always at the  Royal Service Restaurant, served in a quiet environment and by  expert personnel. Restaurants meals were the best I've had ever had in the all inclusives I have stayed in. The employees were very nice and very helpful. Would get you anything you needed. 
The entertainment staff was exceptional. Specially people at the Gabi Bar like Janeric,Oscar, Drayi, Anabelis, Delvin, Jairo Marrero, All were great providing excellent care to my husband and me.
I want to specially thanks to Luisa and Agneris for their great contribution to make this vacation the best I ever had.
Definitely, I will return, I didn't want to leave, I found in this place an extended family care.

reviews.author: MAAndrews
reviews.title: Perfect service
reviews.text:
I was very fortunate - staying at the Reserve, gave me open links to concierge services and amenities allowing me limosine (gulf cart) service to where ever I needed to go, however. The walk through the grounds was too breath talking to cruise by in a a land-rover; I prefer the walk; especially since packing on the calories was no hard task. The food was good quality - rating from other resorts in DR, Punta Cana area; the restaurants in the resort are tyoical of whats to be expected; the service is what I consider to be of importance, which is exceptional. Acces to the facilities PT was a plus; free weights as well as cardio.
My sincere gratitude to the people whom made me feel special; Cristian Fernandez, Andres Medina, Lilion Jimenez, and a special thank you to Angie Parra for her patience in reserving my room and fees.Beautiful people, beautiful country and wonderful hosts.

reviews.author: brooklyn626
reviews.title: Royal Service is an Oasis in Paradisus
reviews.text:
I visited the Paradisus Palma Real Resort for 5 nights over the Fourth of July holiday.  I traveled solo as I was exhausted and looking forward to a few days of rest and relaxation.  I booked my trip through American Express, which placed me in a room in the main hotel.  However,  after reading the reviews on TripAdvisor, I contacted the hotel and upgraded to Royal Service Adults Only.  It was the best decision I could have made and worth the extra money.  

From the moment you arrive, Royal Service elevates the vacation experience.  I was ushered into a sleek, air-conditioned lounge, served a cold cocktail and finger foods while a Paradisus representative checked me in.  She explained the many amenities available to Royal Service guests, including a personal butler, children-free pool and beach area and Palazzo, an intimate Italian Restaurant reserved exclusively for Royal Service.   The child-free zones were critical to me as a solo traveler looking for quiet and solitude.  Right after check-in, I was introduced to my personal butler, Juan De Leon.  Personalized butler services include dinner reservations, reserved Bali Beds on the beach, jacuzzi bath preparation and even ironing (I never used the ironing service).  

I cannot praise Juan De Leon enough!!  He made my stay at the Paradisus wonderful!  Juan is an old-world gentleman who takes great pride in his work.  When I checked-in, Juan gave me a cell phone to contact him whenever I need or wanted something.  I only called him to make dinner reservations.  However, when I didn't call him, Juan looked for me when he arrived at the resort every day.  He usually found me on the beach, relaxing on my reserved Bali Bed.  He asked about my evening, whether I had everything I needed, and what he could do to make my stay better.  Without request from me, one evening he had chocolates delivered to my room, a cheese plate another evening, scented lavender pillows and had a bath drawn for me.  I felt pampered beyond expectation.  I was so relaxed that I slept 12 hours a night, exactly what I needed to relieve my burn-out.  Juan was the consummate professional - attentive without being intrusive, informed, charming and unflappable.  He made my stay a memorable one.

Juan made nightly dinner reservations for me at the resort's numerous restaurants.  The resort offers many dining options such as a steakhouse called Rare, a Mexican place called Blue Agave and an Asian Fusion place called Bana.  All seemed lovely but were too large, busy and overwhelming for the solo diner.  I explored them all but each evening I retreated to Palazzo, the quiet Italian restaurant reserved for Royal Service guests.  The food was excellent and the service impeccable.  I dined there just about every night of my stay.  Felix Garcia was my waiter just about every night, including my first night at Paradisus when I was so exhausted I fell asleep while eating dessert!  Felix is the kind of first-rate, professional waiter one encounters in New York City's finest restaurants.  Alexander Guzman waited on me at breakfast and the one dinner when I wasn't seated in Felix's area.  He was attentive, engaging and professional.  The entire staff at Palazzo - the hostesses, bartenders, and wait staff are wonderful.  

Finally, I would say that as much as I enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus, I do not recommend it for solo travelers.  If you travel here solo, you must do Royal Service, as the main section of the resort - while stunningly beautiful and the site of three destination weddings during my stay - caters to families and couples.  I felt overwhelmed by the scale of the place each time I ventured out of the intimate Royal Service section.  The place is the first choice of couples and families.  I did not meet any other solo travelers during my stay there.

The resort also has a separate section called The Reserve, which caters to more upscale families.  Royal Service guests also have access to private pool and beach reserved for guests of The Reserve.  I spent a quiet, wonderful day there.  However, the mostly male staff there fixated on my solo status, repeatedly asking why I didn't have a family. I was left with the impression that they never encountered a woman traveling on her own.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay at the Paradisus; it served my goal of a restful, relaxing vacation.  I was well taken care of by Juan De Leon, Felix Garcia and Alexander Guzman.  However, in the future, I would choose a more solo-friendly destination.

reviews.author: Rgonzales234
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: Gran hotel lo recomiendo mucha variedad en su platos actividades todo lo que necesito en un solo lugar buena playa las habitacion son muy amplia y super limpio todo lo unico es que todo es super costoso cuando sales del hotel pero es lindo para conocer

reviews.author: rbcustom
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was a wonderful surprise has nothing But positive comments service was Great the dios was top notch and the all inclusive liquor menú was the best ive ever seen in punta cana well worth the investment

reviews.author: 155sergey5212
reviews.title: отдыхал в 2011г в феврале-марте
reviews.text: сервис на высшем уровне во всём, и питание и всё остальное тоже.. огромная территория с курсирующим постоянно транспортом по всей территории, много экзотических деревьев и различных видов птиц и рыб в водоёмах.. недалеко от отеля рынок и дискотека местная... по городу очень развито недорогое мото-такси...

reviews.author: Msjanet73
reviews.title: Club Melia at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana-outstanding Resort!!:)
reviews.text: I just got back from this Resort and had an absolutely amazing time.  There were a few not so perfect things, like an occasional foul smell in my room that occurred twice.  Smelled almost of feces.  It seem to come out of the blue and eventually went away but I never did figure out where the smell originated from.  Also, the mosquitos were the worst.  I eventually figured out what to do, purchased mosquito repellent spray just for the room and mosquito repellent spray that went directly on my body.  That finally did the trick and I stopped getting eaten alive.  What seems to cause this issue is the Maids leaving the door wide open when they clean your room.  Also the back and forth with Management, prior to getting there, was a pain.  There were a million and one emails back and forth between me and Management with just trying to get my check in sorted out.  It was tiresome and cumbersome.  Also the WiFi was extremely spotty, they didn't have SAP for Cable so English speaking channels were limited which was annoying, to me personally, and no free calls to the US or Canada like my Hard Rock and Palace Memberships.  There were a few other minor issues but overall this is a beautiful Resort and I loved it.  I look forward to going to another Club Melia Resort and the next time I go I will purchase a Trial Membership as that is the only Membership they have with no maintenance fees.

reviews.author: Maggie D
reviews.title: Great trip- especially for solo traveler
reviews.text:
This was my second solo trip to the Royal section of the Paradisus Palma Real.  What a wonderful, relaxing trip- an easy trip to do for a solo traveler. The resort is beautiful, staff wonderful, good liquor selection and food is quite good too (amazing lobster at fuego). I’m sure I’ll be back again.  

I wanted to especially thank a few of the staff at the resort.  My pool concierge, Francisco was so very helpful and thoughtful making sure I had water or a cocktail made by talented Crème de la Crème (who makes the best margaritas!).   I was always warmly welcomed by the hostess at the Palazzo (I’m sorry I can’t recall her name, lovely young woman).  Miguel Jimenez at the Palazzo- the perfect waiter. He’s charming, funny, polite, very attentive but not intrusive- I can see him going far in the business.  My butler, Omar made sure I had everything I needed. He is a true gentleman. He is so very kind, interesting and intelligent. I would definitely request him again the next time I go.  Thanks to everyone at the resort!

reviews.author: Kristie M
reviews.title: The most relaxing place to be!
reviews.text:
My husband and I took this trip to celebrate our 10th anniversary. A few of my husband's co-workers have been and had suggested we looked in to it - we couldn't have been happier. We arrived on Sunday and were immediately taken in to the private Royal Service lounge.  We were met by a hostess that provided us with drinks and then  showed us how to hook in to wifi and use our butler phone. We then met our Butler Evian - he was great. He took us on a tour of the property and then brought us to our suite. The rooms are beautiful - a beautiful suite with canopy bed, sitting area and patio overlooking the beautiful gardens. The bathroom had a huge jacuzzi tub and stand-up stall shower. the only complaint about the bathroom was it is totally open, so you have no privacy when using the toilet! Each night they offered turn down service and sprayed our pillows with lavender, it was heavenly!
The resort its self was clean and the ocean was breath-taking. The weather could not have been any more perfect! We would start each day with breakfast and then hit the gym. The gym was staffed and had quite a bit of equipment. It even smelled like a spa!!. After our workout we would head to the pool and sit and relax for the entire day. There was always some sort of water aerobics, pool party or drinking to be done. We also took some nice walks on the beach to see what the other properties looked like. There is a lot of water sports to try and some shops down the beach that you can barter on goods (never fall for their high prices, always get them down :) !!)
Each evening our butler set up reservations at the restaurants for us.  We never had a bad meal. Our favorites were Fuego and Rare, the steakhouse. We had excellent service and meals at both. Evenings brought more entertainment and drinking. Lots of places to just sit back and relax and enjoy your company. We would typically sit at Gabi Beach and enjoy the giant beds to relax and take in the view.
Our last evening was quite special - our butler, Evian, set up our jacuzzi with flower petals and got us a cake to celebrate our anniversary. It was a nice final touch. 
The one tip we can give everyone, make sure you bring plenty of sunscreen.  You will need it and if you run out, the cheapest bottle on the resort and surrounding shops was $28!!

reviews.author: Albertomiami
reviews.title: Great bartender, excellent hotel
reviews.text: I had an absolutely WONDERFUL experience at Paradesis Palma Real Resort.  The staff was so very friendly, and the hotel was clean with very spacious rooms.  I could not write this review without mentioning Luis the bantender, he is something else. He did an excellent job preparing drinks, he is really an Expert. Luis keep up the good work. reviews.author: Elaine G
reviews.title: Fabulous trip and service
reviews.text:
I can't say enough about my trip to the DR. The Paradisus Royal Service was more than advertised, in large measure due to Luis Martinez of the butler service. He made sure I had everything I needed and anticipated things I didn't know to ask for...plus who could resist those dimples. 

I wanted to stay in Villa A for convenience. I asked early and often. The royal service team made sure I was where I needed to be. 

My last night I ate at Passion, the one restaurant at which there is a charge - tasting menu is so worth it.  Plus the service is definitely 7 star. I made dietary requests and they didn't blink. Sergio, Hector, Loris and the Passion Team are first rate.

One recommendation - the onsite casino is tiny but a cab ride away is the Hard Rock Hotel and Casino, which has more to offer.

With NYC below 0 wind chill, February is the perfect time for Paradisus Real in DR.

reviews.author: Norm L
reviews.title: Great Week
reviews.text: First Class resort. Treated like a king all week, Food was excellent especially at Steakhouse on site. Pool and beach excellent and service as well. Went with royal service and would highly recommend that to spoil yourself. My butler Samuel was excellent all week.

reviews.author: RicardoHolligan

reviews.author: Mario0222
reviews.title: Mangelhafter Gäste Service
reviews.text:
Die Homepage des Hotels ist sehr vielversprechend bezüglich Services in allen möglichen Belangen. Leider traf dies in meinem Falle absolut nicht zu und in einigen Gesprächen mit anderen Gästen konnte man von mehreren Seiten dasselbe hören. Einen kurzen Bericht zu den Überbuchungen bei meiner Ankunft hatte ich ja schon gemacht.  So erging es nicht wenigen  Gästen genau so. Nichts desto trotz wurden wir auf andere Anlagen umgebucht. Mit etwas Glück bekamen sie ein Zimmer in einer vergleichbaren Anlage ,bzw. Kategorie. In meinem Falle hatte dies leider nicht zugetroffen und ich landete in einem dunklen Standard Zimmer in der Nebenanlage welche auch zur Melia Gruppe gehört. Nach der ersten unglücklichen Woche in einer Anlage die ich von früher kannte und selbst nie gebucht hätte sollte es die zweite Woche nicht viel besser werden
Derzeit gibt es eine Baustelle im Bereich Strandabschnitt oberhalb der Restaurants Market Grill und Buffet Naos gibt. Dort entsteht  ein neuer  Zimmer / Wohntrakt und gelegentlich ist mit Lärm zu rechnen.( Photos siehe anbei )
 
Wie gesagt meine Bewertung für Service mangelhaft / unbefriedigend bezieht sich auf Gästeservice allgemein.  Als ich endlich nach einer Woche vom Hotel Melia Caribe, wo ich als Ersatz für meine One Bedroom Mastersuite ein abgewohntes Standardzimmer bekommen habe ins Hotel Paradisus Palma Real wechseln durfte, hatte ich bei Hr, Douglas Jonathan(Frontoffice) angefragt ob ich gegen Aufzahlung natürlich ins Royal Service wechseln könnte. Immerhin hatte ich schon ein Woche von meinem Urlaub verloren und in einem Zimmer verbracht welches absolut nicht meinem original gebuchten dem Standard entsprach.

Nach einer kurzen Absprache mit Front Office Manager Adriana Guzmann wurde mir mitgeteilt dass das Royal Service ausgebucht ist und keinerlei Zimmer zur Verfügung stehen. Dies hatte ich akzeptiert und auf meine Anfrage ob  ich gegen Aufzahlung zumindest nur den Royal Service Pool und Strand benützen darf habe ich von Hr. Douglas Jonathan nie eine Antwort erhalten, obwohl er gesagt hat er wird mich sofort verständigen sowie er seinen Supervisor kontaktiert hat. ( so kann man sich natürlich auch Umsatz entgehen lassen)                                                                                                 Ich wollte die zweite Woche einfach nur etwas mehr Ruhe genießen, um die erste Woche in der ich ins Melia Caribe umgebucht worden bin schnell zu vergessen.

Nichts desto trotz meine One Bedroom Mastersuite mit Gartenblick war absolut top und immer sehr sauber gehalten. Wobei ich beim Gartenblick bemerken muss - Gartenblick kann verschiedenes heißen.In meinem Falle haben die Palmwedel meinen kompletten Balkon verdeckt und somit wurde das Zimmer sehr dunkel und na ja Gartenblick waren halt die Palmwedel.(siehe Photos )                                                                                                                                                                   Die Palmwedel sollte man trimmen- somit gäbe es wieder mehr Licht in den Zimmern und einen besseren Ausblick.

Ein anderes Anliegen - wiederum Gäste Service: Eines abends bin ich um Mitternacht aufgewacht da ich auf die Toilette musste, ich machte einen Schritt aus meinem Bett und lag schon flach auf dem Boden. Der Grund dafür - die gesamte Suite stand unter Wasser und wenn ich sage die gesamt Suite dann meine ich wirklich vom Wohnzimmer bis ins Schlafzimmer.
Das kann schon mal passieren und da kann auch das Hotel nichts dafür.Ich hatte die Rezeption angerufen und erklärt  dass die komplette Suite unter Wasser steht. Nach 40 Minuten kam endlich ein Techniker und  als er die Wassermengen sah hatte  er sofort Kontakt mit der Rezeption aufgenommen. Mir wurde mitgeteilt dass ich das Zimmer wechseln muss und sofort jemand von der Rezeption vorbeikommen wird. Also habe ich mittlerweile meine Koffer das dritte mal gepackt und wartete bis ein Bell Boy kam um mir meine neue Zimmernummer mitzuteilen und mit meinem  Gepäck behilflich zu sein. Nach einer Stunde war leider immer noch niemand hier und ich ging selber an die Rezeption um mich nach meiner neuen Zimmer Nummer zu erkundigen.(absolut kein   5 * Service)                                                                                                                                                                               An der Rezeption wurde mir mitgeteilt dass schon längst jemand bei mir sein hätte sollen.(das übliche Vertrösten und nach Entschuldigungen suchen). Nichts desto trotz bekam ich dann endlich ein neues Zimmer . Die Freude trügte , als ich im Badezimmer Licht machte sah ich sofort dass das Zimmer noch nicht einmal ganz fertig gemacht war und im Kühlschrank außer ein paar Wasserflaschen und Bierdosen die außerhalb gekauft wurden, noch von meinen Vorgängern sein mussten. ( siehe Photos )                                                                                                   Nach einem kurzen Anruf an der Rezeption hieß es wieder warten bis ein neues Zimmer lokalisiert werden konnte. Endlich ein neues  Zimmer gefunden, wurde mir mitgeteilt dass dies ein Zimmer in absoluter Ruhelage ist, was ich mir gleich dachte da es in einem der letzten Blöcke lag. ;)                                                        

Dies war dann kurz nach 3.00 Uhr früh und ich durfte meine Koffer endlich wieder auspacken und meine Bettruhe genießen.                                                                                                                                         Dass vor dem Balkon die Durchzugsstraße vom nebenstehenden Hotel ist ( Lkw Lärm- Personal Lärm; ect ), hatte ich gleich in der früh herausgefunden, deshalb waren die Zimmer neben mir oder der gesamte Block mehr oder weniger auf dieser Seite die ganze Woche so gut wie leer.

Ich versucht ein Gespräch mit General Manager Hr. Conrad Bergwerf führen zu dürfen. Hier wurde mir von Hr. Douglas Jonathan  mitgeteilt, dass ein Termin vereinbart werden muss, und  somit hatte ich um einen Termin mit Hr. Bergwerf gebeten. Da ich ja im Urlaub war und keinerlei Zeitzwang hatte, würde ich mich natürlich dem Zeitraster anpassen. Es nur ein Gespräch unter Berufs Kollegen sein. Leider kam auch hier nie eine Rückmeldung trotz nochmaliger Nachfrage vom Frontoffice zurück. 

Die Krönung meines Aufenthaltes aber war dann eines abends als ich Roomservice bestellt hatte.Ich wollte nicht im Restaurant essen und hab mich entschieden im Zimmer mein Abendessen zu nehmen, was ich auch schon mal Tage zuvor tat. Als ich den Roomservice bestellt  hatte und eine Flasche Weißwein dazu haben wollte , der natürlich extra bezahlt werden muss (immerhin eine Flasche Pouilly Fume USD 95.-), wurde mir dies verweigert  bzw. gesagt ich muss diese auf dem Zimmer bar bezahlen. Auf meine Frage warum die Weine die anderen Tage auf die Zimmerrechnung geschrieben wurden , was ja eigentlich normal ist konnte ich keine konkrete Antwort erhalten.
Übrigens die Weinkarte für den Roomservice  ist sehr gut- keine große Auswahl – aber die Weine welche angeboten werden sind absolut top.
Also wiederum die Rezeption kontaktiert , da ich einfach wissen wollte was der genaue Ablauf ist , bzw. eine Antwort haben wollte wieso die Tage zuvor die Weine auf die Zimmerrechnung geschrieben worden sind, wurde mir mitgeteilt, bzw. wurde ich wieder wie schon einige male zuvor vertröstet , dass sich gleich jemand darum kümmern  würde. Leider war auch in diesem Falle nie eine Rückmeldung gekommen und so habe ich mich entschlossen mein Abendessen in einem der Restaurants einzunehmen.
Komischerweise wurde mir am nächsten Tages eine Flasche Champagner angeboten ( welche ich dankend ablehnte)

Ich könnte noch einige  Vorfälle oder Angaben zum Hotel erwähnen die für mich dann teils obwohl negativ , eigentlich schon lustig wurden, werde aber davon Abstand halten.
Ich finde es sehr schade da das Hotel in diverser Media für den „ einzigartigen Gästeservice „ so groß Werbung macht und dies meines Erachtens absolut nicht zutreffend ist. 
Unter anderem auch in dem Wilkommensbrief  auf dem noch der Vorgänger von Hr. Bergwerf angegeben ist.
Paradisus Palma Real …………..to pamper and create an experience you will remember forever. Our main commitment is hat your Paradisus experience touches all your senses. Our staff will accomodate all your needs. Thank you for giving us the privilege of hosting your vacation.
Nichts desto trotz versuchte ich die restlichen Tage der Woche noch so gut wie nur möglich zu genießen.
Kurzerhand habe ich mich an dem Tag meines Check outs entschlossen meinen Flug umzubuchen und noch eine Woche in Punta Cana zu verlängern, nachdem mir ja die erste Woche wegen der Über/Umbuchung in ein Hotel was ich von früher kannte und nie gebucht hätte, entgangen ist und leider auch in meiner zweiten Woche zu viel negative Dinge in dem Hotel wo Service so groß geschrieben wird erlebt hatte.
Mag sein wenn sie den Royal Service buchen, was ich versucht hatte aber leider nicht gelungen ist, dass dann der Service etwas besser ist. Dazu kann ich leider keine Angaben machen.                             Definitiv stimmt dass der erste Blick von den Angestellten immer auf das Armband fällt und dies scheint den großen Unterschied bezüglich Service zu machen.
Fazit  Ich würde dieses Hotel keinem meiner Freunde oder sonst jemanden positive empfehlen. 
In meinem Falle leider alles andere als zufriedenstellend , deshalb die negative Bewertung und die Überlegung ein Schreiben an den CEO der Gruppe weiterzuleiten.

The brown skin young lady that got me checked in was very very kind, helpful and hands on in making sure that I did get situated smoothly and quickly... reviews.title: Heaven on earth!!!
reviews.text: I just got back from this Beautiful resort. All of the staff and service are top notch!! I had two butlers while I was there because I was there so long and they're days off were different. They were Samuel and Johnfi. They really go all out and give great customer service. Also want to give a shout out to Pedro and Leonardo at the royal service bar. They go all out to satisfy!! Just about everyone I met remembered and called me by my first name "Rico" which I really liked. The food was outstanding in the restaurants and I really love the steak and lobster at the Gabi and Market grill restaurants. Room service was very fast and prompt and I also really liked the wake up service with the follow up wake up call.The entertainment staff was fun and kept the activities going. Especially Reynaldo (love that guy)! The YHI spa water treatment is a must try experience and included. I would also like to thank Omar in the business center for all his help and courtesy. The casino is small but I won at the Blackjack tables every night. You get more value for your money if you gamble with Dominican money instead of US money at the tables I found out. Overall, it was a great trip and I met a lot of new friends both staff and guests. I will definitely be back next year!!

reviews.title: It's Paradise!
reviews.text:
I've just spent 6 days in this amazing resort. Took the Royal Service and was amazed with the level of service provided. My butler was Faustino Ramos and he was extremely efficient and discrete. He arranged restaurant reservations, prepared my bath and brought me a fresh fruit plate every night. He was always available, without being intrusive.
Food was amazing at the Pallazzo exclusive restaurant. Miguel Jimenez was an outstanding waiter who knew exactly what I was going to order and took excellent care of my needs. 
The guys at the beach were also incredible and extremely kind. I never heard a "no" at this place: anything you could ask for, they would make a way for you to have it "con mucho gusto".The grounds are very, very beautiful, the rooms are classic, but some renovation would go well. The only point for improvement I could see was some inconsistency in house keeping- although rooms were extremely clean, on my last day I had to call the room service as my room hasn't been cleaned yet ( it was 4pm). I also had my room prepared in 3 out of 6 nights, but no big issue.
 It's simply the perfect place to relax and enjoy a great vacation.

reviews.author: ijisus
reviews.title: Lo Mejor de Dominicana
reviews.text:
Una de las mejores experiencias vacacionales, si bien es cierto que las playas de República Dominicana son sin duda una de las más bellas del caribe, tener las mejores instalaciones y la mejor atención hacen el mejor conjunto para disfrutar unas vacaciones al máximo.

Es un complejo de gran tamaño donde al entrar tienes todo a primera mano, un área de compras, una variedad gastronómica fabulosa entre todos sus restaurantes... el red lounge está bien para las noches de fiesta sin necesidad de salir del resort (que no hay muchos sitios donde salir) y por supuesto el Gabi Beach Club también ideal por el beat de música que maneja.

La cena de Passion, el restaurante del Chef Martín Berasategui es una delicia, cocina Vasca de Autor con excelentes sugerencias del somelier para maridar.

Qué decir del entretenimiento... no hay forma de aburrirse, tienen un equipo de actividades muy grande que desde primer hora hasta al final del día te mantienen ocupado entre juegos, concursos, clases y demás... el spinning en agua es una maravilla  pero debes reservar tu participación por que el acceso es limitado.

El Gimnasio es pequeño pero muy completo y bien ubicado por lo que puedes hacer una pequeña rutina antes o al finalizar tus actividades... 

Lo mejor, tienen unos shows, de miedo, el STOMP y el REY LEON valen mucho la pena...

Sin duda, excelente lugar para vacacionar

reviews.author: stanvard
reviews.title: Terrific Property - Not quite luxury, but almost
reviews.text:
I just got back from 5 nights at Paradisus Palma Real.  I needed a getaway to a beautiful, high-end resort where it was warm and I could just relax, and I got exactly what I was looking for.

If you are a true luxury traveler, a big all-inclusive isn't going to do it for you.  A huge resort just can't feel exclusive and completely, even if areas of it are devoted to being such (which this one had).  For some reason, I hadn't processed that before I arrived.  But once I accepted that fact (and hearing/reading about many of the other resorts in Punta Cana), I realized that the Paradisus is probably the best place to stay in Punta Cana, its staff does a great job at creating as luxurious an environment as possible, and I had a really great time.

In order to be helpful to future travelers, I'll focus my review on a few specifics:

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service
2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service
3.  A few good things
4.  The resort's challenges to expect
5.  Things the resort can improve on

1.  The Reserve vs. Paradisus Royal Service

I was originally booked to stay at The Reserve, the newer, fancier, smaller, and more exclusive property of the Palma Real situated behind the main hotel (away from the beach).  I was really looking forward to my swim-up room, an outdoor jacuzzi, private garden, and private Bali Bed (The Reserve comes with full access to everything at the main resort).  When I arrived, I was told that they had a room at the main resort in the Royal Service section, which is the adults-only luxury section of the main resort - right on the beach, with a butler - that they could upgrade me to for free.  I wasn't sure what to do, as I had been really looking forward to the room at the Reserve, but they convinced me to go to Royal Service as my room was right on the beach with a balcony overlooking the beach.  

It was a tradeoff that I think was ultimately worth it.  When I booked, I didn't mind that the Reserve was 1/2 mile from the beach, but it ended up being a huge plus to be right there, since I enjoy sitting by a beach more than sitting by a pool, and the Royal Service comes with butler service (including a cell phone to contact him), which is not offered for folks without kids at the Reserve.  My butler (Yohel) was great, made all of my on-property restaurant reservations for me, and helped me out with anything I needed.  Royal Service also comes with its own large section of the beach with lots of big cushioned lounge chairs as well as bali-beds on a beautiful stretch of beach where you are not disturbed by folks trying to sell you things.  My room was also lovely and spacious and again - right on the beach.

What I did give up was what I think would have been a nicer room experience at The Reserve and a more exclusive feel, as well as a much more tranquil atmosphere overall.  The private pool for Royal Service guests was the size of a postage stamp and always crowded, whereas the pools at The Reserve and even the main pool at the resort felt fairly empty and peaceful.  If you want to spend the day sitting by the pool (or in your own private garden!), choose The Reserve.  If you have a family, choose The Reserve (lots of kids activities).  If you are looking for privacy, choose The Reserve.  If you prefer to be on the beach, choose Royal Service to be close to the beach and go to The Reserve whenever you want quiet pools.

2.  Royal Service vs. No Royal Service

If you can swing the added cost (or you are offered a free upgrade like I was ;) and you are not with kids, Royal Service is the way to go.  You have access to 4 restaurants on the property that the main resort guests do not have (for free), and priority booking at all of the restaurants (and these restaurants are MUCH better than the rest).  You have an exclusive beach area with lots of staff and great lounging options.  You have a great indoor lounge, very close to your room with internet access and food & drink throughout the day.  You have a butler devoted to you to help you with anything you need.  I never thought I would want that, but it came in handy and made my stay easier.  All that being said, the rest of the resort is beautiful as well, the main pool is huge, and there are plenty of great seats on the main beach.

3.  A few good things

- The service was really excellent, even outside of a great butler.  Sure there was a glitch here and there, but there were tons of staff and everyone was extremely professional and tried very hard to accommodate and help you relax.  I have heard it's the best service in Punta Cana, and I don't doubt that.
- The food was really quite good in the exclusive restaurants (and all of The Reserve restaurants), and they also have 24-hour room service.
- The property is really beautiful - well-landscaped and well kept.
- The beach is really beautiful - lots of white sand that they manicure every morning, with amazing beach chairs/bali beds and great staffing.
- Really easy/fast to get from The Reserve to the main resort.

4.  The resort's challenges to expect

- There is The Reserve, Royal Service, Melia Subscribers, Family Concierge, and other distinctions which have different privileges, areas, and benefits.  It all gets a little confusing.  Some of the amenities are at the main resort, while others (like exercise classes) are at The Reserve.  There is a huge book of options/services in the room It can feel like too much thinking (vacation-thinking that is!) to parse out everything.  But I guess that's just the way they cater to the broadest clientele they can.  Just know that it feels like a big resort, even if you stay to just your 'exclusive' area - for good or for bad.
- The food at the non-exclusive restaurants really isn't as good as the food at the exclusive restaurants.
- Many of the resort's restaurants require long pants and closed shoes for men for dinner.  I didn't know this ahead of time and brought one pair of each, but found it irritating to have to put them on every night.  I don't think it would detract from the atmosphere to have men wear a nice polo and shorts and sandals.  Who cares?  Get dressed up only if you want to.
- While the beach is gorgeous, the water is not great.  It's not the resort's fault at all.  But there is really tons of seaweed which you have to walk over and swim with.  I spent a lot less time in the ocean than I expected to.  But I guess that's Bavaro Beach.  And it's not crystal clear like Turks & Caicos - really because of the seaweed.
-  While the service is great, it is very in-your-face.  I have found that service at really top-notch places is largely invisible and more subtle.  But I think that's The Melia's (company who owns the resort) style and I am confident all of the employees were fulfilling their expectations very well.

5.  Things the resort can improve on

These are good to know (and did not ruin my trip at all), and things I think management can improve on to make this an even better experience in the future:
- The main buffet is really sub-par.  Anyone used to buffets at resorts or cruises will be disappointed (so I'm told).
- The reservation system is weird.  It was easy for me, because my butler set everything up via Royal Service, but I heard a lot of griping, since folks sometimes could not get reservations or we were told we had to make them, and the restaurants were often fairly empty.
- Neither the Spa at the main resort nor the Royal Service reception had a spa menu from the Reserve (bigger spa) with prices.  So I had to go all the way to The Reserve to look at prices and book (or I could have called, but still - silly).
- The spa treatments were so-so and indistinguishable from one another.
- The Yoga class I took was laughable.  It did not resemble Yoga in any way.  It was a combination of vogueing, sleeping, and stretching.  I left after 25 mins.  Anyone expecting real Yoga should stay away.
- Keys get demagnetized easily/often.  Pain to keep going back to get them re-magnetized.

Those are some details I hope will be helpful to future vacationers/management.  On the whole, I really had a terrific time.  I am not sure I would go back to Punta Cana because of the so-so ocean and not great access to great excursions, but as a stand-alone resort/beach, it was pretty terrific and just what the doctor ordered.

reviews.author: DocGirl6
reviews.title: Perfect Solo Trip
reviews.text: Decided to take my 1st solo trip and chose Punta Cuna.  After reviewing several properties, I selected Paradisus Palma Real.  I definitely was not disappointed! I arrived to a beautiful view of the ocean and the moment I stepped on to the property, I was transported into Paradise. I decided on a Royal Service (adults only) ocean view room. It was exactly what I wanted.  My check-in went smoothly and was greeted by my butler, Juan de Leon.  I was in good hands. I decided to have a massage on the beach on the afternoon of my arrival---best choice---nothing like relaxing to the sounds of the ocean and the feel of a cool breeze after a stress-filled summer.  I enjoyed drinks near the pool (served by Leonardo) and juices on the beach served by Jorge.  The beach was amazing and the attendants (Martin and Francisco) were very accommodating.  I decided to have meals in the Palazzo, Market Grill, and Gabi Beach.  Juan was able to arrange for me to have some Dominican food one night---perfect!

reviews.author: Alina S
reviews.title: First time in traveling alone
reviews.text: It was my 1st time vacationing solo but never once felt alone. Astrid Mercedes and Natalia made check in/out and everything in between so easy in the Royal Service VIP lounge. My butler, Jeuri  Ferreira, seemed to always find me to inform me of the day's reservations or to make sure that my every request was met. He was sweet, attentive and knowing he was around made me feel safe and looked after. Pedro, the beach concierge, always had my palapa ready, kept the drinks flowing and always had a story to tell. The WIFI in the room was not always working but that was a sign to unplug and relax which i was able to do so easily. Overall, the staff is what made my vacation so exceptional, everyone is happy and friendly and that is what would make me return to Paradisus Palma Real. (food was good too!)

reviews.author: SusanMTtoronto
reviews.title: Wow factor form the moment you arrive
reviews.text:
Accommodations were spectacular.  Hotel staff were courteous and helpful.  Room always spotless

The setting is spectacular - I was a bit hesitant about Dominican Republic overall but was very impressed.  IF you are going to go this would be the place to go - no need to leave the property. Beaches and pools had lots of options to be either where the action is, or to have some peace, quiet and privacy.

reviews.author: Melanie R
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: I have just returned from my vacation at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana which totally exceeded my expectations.  Anabel Gonzalez, Yeuri Beltre, and Ada Morla along with the excellent waiters, housekeepers, waitresses, and others made my stay unforgettable.  I came solo and everyone did their best to take care of me.  They were very warm and attentive and made me feel very comfortable.  The food was great.  The grounds are amazing, the rooms were contemporary and spacious, the beach was breathtaking.  There is so much to do & discover at this resort.  I am looking forward to going back in the near future.  This resort is highly recommended.

reviews.author: cruehd
reviews.title: Very Nice Property
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at The Reserve and had a wonderful time.  This review is going to be long but well worth it.  After reading, you will have a full detail of the property and what it has to offer. So here goes...Just for a side note, I was a solo traveler.  The first thing you must do after checking in, is to see your concierge and book ALL your dinner reservations. They fill up quick.  For those into the water activities, it means dragging your butt to the beach area.  They have a separate section to reserve various activities (scuba/snorkeling/kayak/etc).  It's a small sacrafice of 2-3 hours for the first day only.  Then after that, there are no worries  =)

The staff is wonderful.  Very friendly and courteous in all aspects.  Many speak English and those who don't, call their co workers over to help.  The waiters/waitress/bartenders are all attentive to accommodate your needs even if you have special needs or requests.  

The room...I stayed in a one bedroom master suite.  very spacious, comfortable bed (king size), nice living room/kitchen.  The shower had multiple jet streams so you can choose which option you prefer.  there were 3 different sinks to wash up.  The patio was great.  Two lounge chairs to sit and relax and even have a smoke if you’re a smoker.  The gentleman who restocked my minibar was great.  it was filled every day with a variety of soft drinks.  My room was cleaned by 5pm everyday and restocked with towels.  The air conditioning blasted so cold I actually had to shut it off at times. The only negative part to this was the Jacuzzi.  It took close to an hour to fill up and the jets were not powerful.  A bit of a letdown for me seeing I enjoy sitting in hot tubs.

The food/restaurants.....let me start off by saying EVERYONE has different taste buds/pallets, so you need to keep an open mind when eating in the Caribbean. They have 6 different specialty restaurants and after eating at all of them, I was never dissatisfied.   Some of the sauces are different than here at home (BBQ/Marinara, etc) and they can tend to be heavy handed with the salt, but all you have to do is request it to be lightly salted or light on the sauce.
The Reserve also has 3 different buffet halls.  One by the main reception (  ) which is plain and basic.  The other two (Gabi Beach & NAOS) are located on the other end of the resort which offer more choices and a variety of ethnic foods.  This can be burdensome to get to, but if you’re willing to be patient to get there, it’s well worth it.

The Beach/Pool.....In my opinion, the pool was better than the beach....It wasn't as crowded and the cabanas and huts were an added bonus.  These are all free, but it is first come, first serve. Some of the huts are reserved for families that pay for the family plan, but still plenty to go around.  The beach was a bit unpleasant to me.  When I was there, A storm must have hit which brought in seaweed.  It was everywhere; along the shore and even in the water.  However, the water temperature was nice.  Waiters come around both areas taking drink orders.  The pool even has a swim up bar area.  Obviously, the beach doesn't.

The Resort....This property is humongous.  It's actually two resorts combined into one.  There are a variety of activities/night life/restaurants scattered throughout the place.  In order to get where you want to go, you either have to walk or wait for the TRAM (golf carts) to transport you. This is definitely an inconvenience, but it's a good way to walk off all the food you eat...lol
The resort is also maintained beautifully.  The workers are out there everyday taking care of the grounds.

Nightlife/Activities...There are a variety of shows for both kids and adults.  Check the weekly bulletin.  

Some details may have been forgotten, but if you need additional info, feel free to ask.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**
I understand that it is an ALL INCLUSIVE place and it is expensive to stay here. However, some of the workers go above and beyond and I feel you should tip them a few bucks.  Coming from a person in the service industry, when someone brings you a drink/meal whether you're sitting at a buffet table or lounging in a chair, giving them a buck or two is a nice gesture.  Especially when asking for extras or special accomodations.

reviews.author: KathleenFras
reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: I enjoyed relaxing in the shade by the ocean by day and the wonderful eateries they had to offer for dinner.  I enjoyed a waiter by the name of Nestor at the Grill.  His personality helped sell the place.  In fact all the employees were friendly!  I highly reccomend this resort!

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: Beautiful property!
reviews.text: I love this resort! It is so clean and well kept - I have never been to a place where all of the restrooms are clean all of the time!!  The bartenders Leonardo and Jorge (fresh fruit) were always on top of their game! Richard Ortiz at the Palazzo was so attentive and courteous everyday. It was a pleasure to see all of these people as they always had a smile ready for you! Little Angel from activities is a joy - from the aqua spinning to dancing at night during the shows! Chef Alexis at Vento outdid himself with a meal that was out of this world!! OMG it was orgasmic! LOL Royal service is the way to go here and Elvis is extraordinary! Will definitely return.

reviews.author: WakeChmp
reviews.title: Frequent Travel with complete review (Royal Service)
reviews.text:
For starters, I can understand why an average or less than frequent traveler would rate this property 5 stars.  It is very nice and I will comment on some of my experiences.  I rate this resort 4, based on an extensive amount of travel experience I have.  I don't typically stay at all inclusive resorts, but a majority of the hotels in Punta Cana are all inclusive.  
Secondly, the reviewers who comment this resort is "perfect" or that it's the best resort in the caribbean are mistaken.  Also, the reviewers that comment on how nice there weather was when they were does not help you in your travel decision.  Instead of writing a novel, I am going to make this as short and sweet as I can.  

I stayed May 2014 in a partial ocean view room, Royal Service package.

The Positives:
1- The resort grounds and lobby are absolutely amazing.  I haven't seen a hotel in Punta Cana that can compare.  Open air lobby lobby with perfect views of the pool and ocean.  
2- The pool and beach area are excellent as well.  The pool is gigantic and there was always plenty of space.  The beach area is very quiet and the ocean was just right. 
3- The rooms were not elegant, but they were above average. The in-room jacuzzi is a nice tough, but everything else is was nothing spectacular.  Partial ocean view rooms are only partial ocean views if you lean over the balcony.  The mini-bar was pretty good too.       
4- Overall, the restaurants were above average.  They offer a good variety and selection of different foods.  We are very picky eaters and we found stuff that we enjoyed at all of the restaurants.  I really enjoyed the grilled lobster at Market Grill.  The steak was hit or miss.    
5- The cleaning staff was outstanding and I would give them 5 stars.  They were always there early in the day and did an outstanding job.  They were also very friendly.

The Negatives:
1- The so called 500 "resort credit" offered when we booked online ended up being a complete scam.  I was extremely disappointed.  Essentially, they are just coupons to use towards stuff that you have to purchase.  They should be called "resort coupons."  Example, several of them were 10 dollar coupons for purchase of wine.  Well, at an all inclusive resort I don't really want to spend much money out of pocket.  Their wine for purchase was extremely expensive.  All the other coupons were bad, except for the Spa discount, which we used and saved me 50 dollars.  I didn't think a resort this large would have to offer gimmicks to get people to make reservations, but I guess not.  
2- The excursion/Tour Guide desk was a complete disaster.  There are three different companies all at the same desk, and you have to choose one.  They offer the same tours, but at different prices. Also, they didn't know anything about the tours and were reluctant to try and explain anything.  I would think they could offer suggestions or have a list of most popular excursions, but instead they have a bunch of outdated fliers. 
3- The seating and reservation process at the restaurants was strange.  I understand why they have to take reservations and spread things out, but there would be two or three other couples in the restaurant and they would sit us 2-3 feet from them. 
4- The bars didn't offer a drink menu or any "specialty" drinks.  I think this would be a nice touch and help guests decide.  The resort should have a few signature cocktails. 
5- The pool and cabana service was weak.  If you are really aggressive and find someone, make sure to tip and tell them to come back or you won't see them again. 
6- While I wouldn't say the service was "great," it was pretty good.  The workers and servers really tried hard.  They just need some more training, but they do a pretty good job in the restaurant.  I tipped most of them in the restaurants if they did good. 
7- Wifi.  Wifi works occasionally.  I believe the resort is in the process of fixing this. 

Finally, I will review my Royal Service Experience. Most people want to know, "Is Royal Service worth it or not?"  The answer is "well, maybe."  I will start with the bad.

1- The Butler services were terrible.  Other than making reservations at restaurants, which he screwed up, he really didn't do anything for us.  He was hard to get ahold of and really at the end of the day, it didn't work out for us.  So, luck or the draw, maybe you will get one of the better Butlers.  One evening he told us, "I can't get you a reservation at Market Grill, I am sorry."  Immediately after, I walked directly to the Market Grill and asked for a reservation at 9, and they said, "yes, of course."  I believe the purpose of the Butler is to essentially "control" the guests.  He was persistent we only use one tour company, and was making reservations without consulting us. He let us down in the end, when the concierge didn't show up to pick up our bags and we had to carry them across entire resort.  I tried calling, but he didn't answer his phone. 
2- The hotel does not police the Royal Service areas.  Other guests end up in the Royal Service areas, and I never saw the resort manage that at any point. 
3- No drink service to the cabanas.

The good:
1- Royal Service pool and beach area are much quieter and have nice chairs, day beds, and cabanas.  We never had an issue getting one.  They day beds were really nice to lay on the beach.  The other side has basic chairs and no cabanas.  Royal Service has two private pools that are Royal Service only.
2- The smoothie bar in Royal Service was nice.  They make fresh fruit smoothies all day.
3- No kids in Royal Service
4- Location of Royal Service rooms are much closer to the beach
5- Access to the Palazio restaurant and breakfast in the morning.  The breakfast here felt more private and upscale, as it was just reserved for Royal Service guests.
6- Free access to the spa at resort, and YHi spa at the reserve.  The YHi spa was outstanding! I highly recommend. 

So, you have to decide if the good vs bad I mentioned is worth the extra money.  Also, you will take a risk of having a bad Butler. For us, the good outweighed the bad because the resort grounds, beach, and pool are outstanding. Personally, I think they should just do away with the Butler service. 

Overall, despite some complaints in Royal Service, we had a great stay so I rate it 4 stars.  We enjoyed the privacy of Royal Service.  Make sure if you stay here you are aggressive, or you won't get drinks.  In the end, I don't think you can go wrong with this resort, but let's not call it "perfect."   

Note to manager:  We started off on a bad note when the hotel forgot to pick us up.  I sent the hotel three e-mails requesting pick-up, and they never responded.  I followed the instructions exactly on their website.  When I checked in, I mentioned this and the employee told me, "show me the e-mails."  Sorry, at that point it was too late.  At check-out, not one person asked us, "how was your stay."  Employees saw us carrying our own luggage out and nobody said a word.  Get rid of that resort credit! It was very misleading.  The actual employee herself at check-in told us the only good ones are the spa and casino one. Our check-in and check-out overall here was an F.

reviews.author: Kurt N
reviews.title: Butler Service
reviews.text: This was my first stay at this property.  I only had two days, and had a great time.  I definitely recommend springing the extra $50 for the Butler Service.  I was assigned Edward, and he was very professional and was focused on providing top-notch customer service.  Excellent job staff - I will be back.

reviews.author: Lovethebeach085
reviews.title: Royal Service Fantastic
reviews.text: I love this place! The Royal Service I read about in other reviews so I went for that. My butler Elvis is the greatest! He is so attentive to detail, courteous, friendly and all in addition to doing a fantastic job overall. Since I am traveling by myself it is very comforting knowing I can count on someone for assistance and he is very reliable. I feel more secure for sure. Leonardo at the pool bar is the best! He remembers your drinks and starts making it before you even order :) I wanted to pamper myself so I picked the Royal Service and I couldn't be happier. The room is soooo quiet and close to all I want and need so I don't have to hike anywhere. Pedro the beach concierge is amazing, too. Helping you to set up and bringing you drinks to your chair. Will definitely recommend...

reviews.author: Kerry H
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
Beautiful property. Not a great choice for solo travelers. Overall disappointed with the food and service, especially because I paid for the upgraded service. 
I upgraded to royal service, they arrange private transportation from the airport to the hotel. How I was taken to the wrong paradisus is beyond me. And their lack of apologies and acting as if it was my fault made it worse. 
Check in went smoothly. Most of the advertised services with the royal service package I did not experience. My butler did not pack or unpack for me. He was rarely to be found. There was no aromatherapy. And I had to check up on dinner reservations- would've been less stressful to have done it myself.
